The agent can therefore exploit highly informative structural guidance, although the privileged per-item information does not establish what could have been learned from experience alone. These results suggest that memory design may affect where accumulated experience becomes useful, even when its average benefit is modest.

AI.tldr: 记忆的累积对于LLM解决问题有轻微的积极影响，尤其是在后期更难的问题上，结合可重用代码的记忆设计显示出潜在的优势。然而，这需要额外的结构指导才能实现更大的改进。
AI.motivation: 探讨是否以前的努力累积的记忆能帮助LLM解决新问题，并且这种记忆如何设计会影响记忆带来的收益。
AI.method: 在相同的项目上测试五个不同条件的代理，比较具有不同记忆设计的代理的表现。
AI.result: 自由形式笔记的记忆设计提高了初次尝试的成功率4.6个百分点，而结合自由形式记忆和可重用代码的设计提高了2.8个百分点。代码库在后期更难的问题上显示出潜在优势。但只有当代码库代理受到目标特定和结构化的额外指导时，才能实现更大的改进。
AI.conclusion: 记忆设计可能影响累积经验何时变得有用，即使平均而言，这种好处是轻微的。

title: AI-Experiment: an augmented reality art project co-created with artificial intelligence
comment: presented and published at AI for Visual Arts Workshop and Challenges (AI4VA) in conjunction with European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026, Malmö, Sweden
summary: We describe the creation of a physical artwork that was performed in synergy between an artist, a computer scientist and generative AI tools. A latent diffusion model was finetuned on photographs of the artwork of the specific artist and the generative model then generated synthetic artworks in a similar style. From the generated artworks a subset was selected to be painted again with acrylic on canvas by the original artist. In addition to the physical artifact an augmented reality component was added which brings the artwork to life with a set of generative video models. Together with this paper we release part of the artwork (training data), the code that was deployed to generate the artwork as well as the augmented reality experience for arts, research and education under https://github.com/BernhardEgger/ARTimate

AI.tldr: 艺术家、计算机科学家和生成AI工具合作创作了一件物理艺术品。使用艺术家作品的图照片训练了潜在扩散模型，生成了类似风格的合成艺术品，部分作品被艺术家重新创作。此外，还添加了增强现实组件，通过生成视频模型使艺术品生动。项目的相关部分已开源。
AI.motivation: 旨在展示人机协作在艺术创作中的潜力，并通过开源代码和资源推动创意和技术领域的教育和研究。
AI.method: 采用潜在扩散模型对艺术家的摄影作品进行训练，生成与原作风格相似的合成艺术品，随后由艺术家将部分合成作品重新创作成物理艺术作品，通过增强现实技术增强作品的互动性和表现力。
AI.result: 生成了多个高质量的合成艺术品及物理艺术品，并集成了一个增强现实体验，使艺术品更加生动。开放了用于生成这些艺术品的代码和资源。
AI.conclusion: 本研究展示了跨学科合作在艺术创作中的可能性，并为相关领域的研究和教育提供了丰富的资源。

title: Injection of Space Radiation Errors on Low-power NVM using Generative Deep Learning
summary: We develop an error model for a Non-Volatile Memory (NVM) device that represents the effects of physical faults experienced in a CubeSat mission in Low Earth Orbit (LEO). The CubeSat carries an off-the-shelf low-power Ferroelectric RAM (FRAM) chip and runs repeated read/write tests according to a predefined pattern. We compare every memory snapshot received from the satellite with a reference bitmap to identify bit errors. We visually analyze erroneous values distributions in the memory snapshots and we understand that they are frequently distributed according to regular spatial patterns. We define a generative deep learning technique to automatically learn these spatial patterns and to synthetically generate additional error patterns mimicking the observed ones. The model is capable at producing memory errors for general application-level experimentation. Our preliminary validation indicates that when comparing the model output with the data we collect, 0.92 of the generated bit flips correspond to bit flips in the memory snapshots and the model captures 0.91 of the observed bit flips. A comparison of the spatial distribution of bit flips in 10,000 generated error patterns also provides a Wasserstein distance of 0.073, indicating that the two distributions differ by roughly 7% of the maximum possible displacement of their probability masses.

AI.tldr: 论文开发了一个错误模型，用于模拟低地轨 CubeSat 上 Ferroelectric RAM 设备中的物理故障导致的位错误，该模型能够生成记忆错误以供应用级实验使用。
AI.motivation: 论文的动机是为了研究 CubeSat 在 LEO 中发生的物理故障对 Ferroelectric RAM（FRAM）设备的影响，并希望能够通过生成误差模式来模拟和验证这些故障，提高数据存储系统的可靠性和准确性。
AI.method: 论文首先进行了重复读写测试，然后通过与参考位图进行比较识别出位错误。接着通过视觉分析发现了位错误值在内存快照中的分布模式，随后定义了一种生成式深度学习技术来自动学习这些模式生成模拟误差模式。实验对比了模型输出与收集的数据，验证了模型的有效性。
AI.result: 初步验证显示，模型生成的位翻转与收集的数据中有0.92对应，且模型捕捉到了0.91的观测位翻转。位翻转的空间分布距离为0.073的Wasserstein距离，表明两者分布差异约为最大可能位移的7%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种能够生成记忆错误的错误模型，可以用于一般应用程序级别的实验，以模拟低地轨 CubeSat 中 Ferroelectric RAM 的物理故障。

title: CoDA: A Human-LM Collaborative Codebook Development Assistant for Domain-Specific Text Annotation
comment: In Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing: System Demonstrations
summary: We present CoDA, an open-source human-LM collaborative codebook development assistant that helps domain experts develop annotation guidelines for annotating new variables in unstructured text with language models. Existing language model annotation systems primarily focus on downstream classification performance, while assuming the availability of high-quality annotation guidelines, or codebooks. In practice, developing these codebooks is time-consuming and challenging, particularly for concepts that require expert knowledge. CoDA addresses this gap by collaborating with domain experts to iteratively develop codebooks through targeted review of incorrect language model predictions and incorporating expert feedback into the evolving codebook. We demonstrate CoDA on two real-world case studies: extracting health indicators from homelessness case management notes and classifying sentiment of wildlife trafficking posts on social media. Across both domains, CoDA produces codebooks that achieve downstream classification performance comparable to expert codebooks while reducing codebook development time from several weeks to two hours and requiring 5X fewer manually annotated examples. Applying CoDA to generate annotations at scale, we identified 2,410 case notes that contained health discussions or referrals and 10,196 social media posts expressing negative sentiment that may warrant investigation for potential wildlife trafficking. By accelerating codebook development, CoDA helps practitioners use language models to extract domain-specific insights from unstructured text at scale.

AI.tldr: CoDA 是一种协作式代码书开发助手，通过与领域专家合作，迭代开发代码书，特别是在语言模型预测错误时，整合专家反馈。这使开发代码书的时间从几周减少到两小时，并减少了所需的手动注释示例数量。
AI.motivation: 现有的语言模型注释系统专注于下游分类性能，假设高质量的注释指南可用。然而，在实践中，开发这些指南既耗时又具有挑战性，特别是在需要专家知识的概念上。
AI.method: CoDA 通过与领域专家协作，针对语言模型预测错误进行审查，并整合专家反馈来迭代开发代码书。
AI.result: 在两个实际案例研究中，CoDA 生成的代码书在下游分类性能上与专家代码书相当，将开发时间从几周减少到两小时，并减少了手动标注示例所需的数量。
AI.conclusion: CoDA 加速了代码书的开发，使从业者能够大规模地从非结构化文本中提取特定领域的洞察。

title: Cache2LoRA: Understanding and Improving Context Internalization
summary: Context-to-LoRA methods encode documents as low-rank parameter updates, allowing language models to answer without retaining the source text in their decoding context. How reliably do these updates preserve facts and support their use under different instructions? Controlled diagnosis of existing context-to-LoRA methods separates fact discrimination, target retention, and response adaptation. Competing sources influence answers, while target-only construction and memory-state optimization improve recovery at fixed update size. Recovering facts also does not ensure that answers follow response instructions. We introduce Cache2LoRA, which uses each query to aggregate evidence from a reusable frozen document cache before generating LoRA updates. Trainable encoding operates only on the query and memory-token suffix, and multi-style supervision teaches both evidence preservation and answer expression. Across 17 tasks, Cache2LoRA improves on existing context-to-LoRA methods and achieves macro F1 of 0.663, approaching full-context in-context learning at 0.671. For 32K documents and 256-token outputs at batch size 16, its decoding throughput is 5.9$\times$ that of full-context ICL. At matched memory size, generated LoRA preserves answer accuracy more reliably than the learned-KV variant under long, diverse intervening text and combines more effectively with retained document KV, yielding higher hybrid F1 and EM.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了Cache2LoRA方法，在处理长且多样的上下文信息时，能够更好地保留事实和遵循指令，提升了语言模型的推理和生成能力。
AI.motivation: 当前的Context-to-LoRA方法存在事实保留不完整和答案不遵循指令的问题，为了改进这些问题并提升模型在复杂任务中的表现，提出了Cache2LoRA。
AI.method: Cache2LoRA使用每次查询来从可重用的冻结文档缓存中聚合证据，这在生成LoRA更新之前完成。训练编码仅作用于查询和记忆标记后缀，并进行多风格监督来教导证据保留和答案表达。
AI.result: Cache2LoRA在17个任务中优于现有Context-to-LoRA方法，宏观F1得分为0.663，接近全上下文的在上下文学习性能0.671。对于32K文档和256标记输出的大小为16的批量，解码吞吐量是全上下文ICL的5.9倍。
AI.conclusion: Cache2LoRA能够在保持答案准确性的同时，更好地遵循指令，这种方法在处理长且多样化的任务时表现更为出色，解决了当前方法存在的问题。

title: LVMH: A Meta-Optimization Harness for Long-Video Agent Memory
summary: Long-video agents must map hours or days of multimodal evidence into a bounded context while respecting token and latency budgets, making memory design a context-management challenge. Existing memory systems largely rely on hand-designed policies, leaving open how to jointly optimize memory design for performance and efficiency. We propose Long Video Meta-memory Harness (LVMH), an automated multi-agent framework that formulates memory-policy development as multi-objective code search around a fixed answer model. To guard against self-certification and development-set overfitting, LVMH separates implementation from independent review and enforces protected observation boundaries. Persistent meta-memory records past proposals, traces, costs, and failures to guide subsequent policy revisions. Through this harness, we discover Self-Evolving Evidence Memory (SEEM), a "text-first, vision-second" policy that answers from compact structured event memory and evidence specialists, consulting localized frames through a selective visual gate. The policy evolved on EgoLifeQA generalizes to unseen benchmarks, outperforming Meta-Harness on both Ego-R1 Bench and Video-MME (L) with GPT-5 mini. Across the three benchmarks, SEEM with GPT-5 achieves 65.7% average accuracy, surpassing the previous state of the art by 7.7 percentage points with approximately 32x lower average evaluation token use and 91x shorter average response time.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出LVMH框架，通过自动多代理方法优化长视频记忆设计，发现了一种‘先文本后视觉’的策略SEEM，该策略在未见基准上的性能优于Meta-Harness，并实现了更低的评估令牌使用和更快的响应时间。
AI.motivation: 针对长视频处理中记忆设计的挑战，即如何在保持性能的同时优化效率。
AI.method: 通过一个自动多代理框架LVMH，将记忆策略开发视为在固定答案模型周围多目标代码搜索，同时确保独立审查和受保护观测边界的真实性。
AI.result: SEEM策略在多种基准上展现出优越性能，平均准确率达到65.7%，比先前的最佳状态提高了7.7个百分点，同时使用较少的评估令牌和更短的响应时间。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了通过自适应记忆模型提高长视频代理表现的有效性，证明了这种方法在处理大规模数据时的优越性和效率。

title: A Generic On-Board AI Processing Chain for Earth Observation: From Application Development to Embedded Deployment and Mission-Level Orchestration
summary: Earth observation satellites acquire more data than they can downlink. Extracting information on board with artificial intelligence (AI) turns the satellite into a data-reduction stage that downlinks compact products, such as masks or detections, instead of full scenes; deploying it in a mission, however, involves the whole processing chain and not only the neural network. We present a generic on-board AI processing chain along three axes, with wildfire segmentation as the worked example among ship detection and cloud segmentation. (i) The AI model is tuned (spectral-band selection, input normalization), quantized to 8-bit integers (int8) and ported to an AMD Versal VCK190, with its excellent segmentation performance preserved on the board. (ii) A modular tiler-inference-mosaicer workflow, reused unchanged across applications, brings the tile-level model to scene level, turning a full acquisition into a scene-level mask or detection list. (iii) Each step is packaged as a unikernel and orchestrated on board by ORCHIDE, a cloud-native orchestrator. The chain is characterized end to end, from the standalone execution on the target to its execution under orchestration with parallel workflows on a representative test bench. Beyond AI inference on individual tiles, this approach aims at increasing the maturity of on-board AI deployment by addressing a complete processing chain, from the acquired scene to the mission-level execution.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个适用于地球观测卫星的数据处理链，通过在卫星上应用人工智能模型，减少下传的数据量，同时保证了处理性能。该系统包括三个主要部分：模型优化与部署、图像拼接和云原生编排。
AI.motivation: 地球观测卫星获取的数据量超过其可以下传的范围，通过在卫星上使用人工智能技术，可以将卫星变成一个数据精简阶段，下传紧凑的数据产品如掩膜或检测，而不是完整的场景。这种方法旨在提高卫星上人工智能系统的成熟度。
AI.method: 该处理链分为三个主要步骤：首先对AI模型进行调优和量化，并在卫星硬件上部署；其次使用一种模块化的图像切片-推理-拼接流程，将单个切片级别的模型结果转换为场景级别的掩膜或检测列表；最后，将每一步骤打包为unikernel，使用ORCHIDE云原生编排器在卫星上进行编排。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，该处理链在保持图像分割性能不受影响的情况下，成功地将图像分割模型部署在卫星上，并通过云原生编排器实现了高效的端到端处理，可以支持多种应用任务。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的方法和系统为地球观测卫星上的人工智能应用提供了成熟的解决方案，未来有望进一步优化以应对更大的数据量和更复杂的任务需求。

title: Pronouncing Hard Words: Phoneme Adaptation of a Pretrained Conversational Text to Speech Model
summary: Voice agents built as cascaded automatic speech recognition (ASR)->large language model (LLM)-> text-to-speech (TTS) pipelines increasingly rely on conversational TTS: streaming, context conditioned models that adapt delivery to dialogue history. Such models are natural and expressive but offer little explicit control over how rare, trust-critical drug names are pronounced, because these entities are too infrequent, and their vocabulary too fast-growing, to be covered by any amount of pre-, mid-, or post-training. We retrofit phoneme controllability onto a pretrained conversational TTS model without any pre/mid-training, using an ARPAbet vocabulary exten-sion, continued phoneme-augmented supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a training-free inference-time acoustic-biasing step. On a 7,500 clip clinical drug-pronunciation evaluation, our model raises strict Gemini-judged correctness from 54.6% (no phoneme augmentation) to 90.7%, outperforming every conversational and stateless TTS baseline on the automatic metric. Because no training stage sees a drug name, the entire evaluation is out-of-domain, so the gains reflect learned pronunciation rather than memorization. In a blinded, randomized human study, adult listeners judge 84% of our clips correct, versus 82% for the strongest baseline, with overlapping confidence intervals on a stratified subset. Across all 250 matched clips, Gemini agrees with the human majority on 84.8% of binary labels (k{appa}=0.57).

AI.tldr: 该研究表明，通过扩展ARPAbet词汇表、持续的音素增强监督微调和推理时的声学偏见步骤，可以在无需预训练或微调的情况下，显著提高语音代理对药物名称的发音准确性。
AI.motivation: 针对递归声学语言模型管道中的对话式TTS模型对罕见、信任关键的药物名称发音缺乏严格控制的问题，研究提出了一种新的方法。
AI.method: 研究方法包括扩展ARPAbet词汇表、使用持续的音素增强监督微调、以及推理时的声学偏见步骤。通过这种方法，无需任何预、中期训练即可在对话式TTS模型中增加音素控制能力。
AI.result: 该方法在7500个临床药物发音评估中表现出色，将严格Gemini判分的正确性从54.6%提升到90.7%，优于所有对话式和无状态TTS基线模型的自动评价指标。在盲法随机试验中，成人听者判断84%的录音正确，相较于最强基线模型的优势显着。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，通过上述技术，对话式TTS模型可以在不依赖训练的情况下改善对药物名称的发音准确性，且这种改进是基于实际学习而非记忆。

title: Joint, Decoupled, or Agent: When Each Multimodal Alignment Paradigm Wins
summary: Jointly pretrained multimodal encoders are a common way to combine modalities, while alternatives integrate their information during downstream training or inference. When does each approach win? We compare three paradigms, instantiated with public checkpoints, across 16 paired datasets in five domains and multiple training-label budgets. JOINT trains a fusion head on frozen, jointly pretrained encoders. DECOUPLED trains a fusion head on frozen, independently pretrained encoders. AGENT gives a frozen LLM task instructions, labelled examples, available sample text, and supervised unimodal readouts. No paradigm dominates the complete 144 dataset-budget combinations: DECOUPLED wins 54, JOINT 44, and AGENT 46 by mean utility. ScienceQA, MELD, and MetMeme shift from AGENT to fusion as supervision increases. Between the fusion paradigms, JOINT leads on four of five QA datasets across all evaluated budgets, while higher unimodal 5-NN accuracy is associated with a relative shift toward DECOUPLED across eight classification datasets (Spearman $ρ=-0.67$). We test whether representation and task diagnostics predict these preferences on held-out datasets before fitting their candidate systems. A two-step cascade combines these diagnostics with task and budget metadata to select AGENT or fusion, then JOINT or DECOUPLED. Under leave-one-group-out evaluation, it selects the winner in 71.4% of cells versus 54.2% for metadata-only routing, with mean relative regret 0.028 versus 0.057. Using geometry, supervised representation diagnostics, and text-label matching together yields higher accuracy and lower regret than using any one of these sources with metadata. These results connect paradigm preferences to supervision budget, task format, and unimodal 5-NN accuracy. Target-task diagnostics thus support selecting among the three paradigms before candidate fitting.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文对比了三种结合模态的方法，结果显示没有一种方法在所有情况下都是最优的，而是根据监督预算、任务格式和单模态5-NN精度等因素有所不同。
AI.motivation: 研究者希望了解在不同的数据集和任务预算下，联合预训练多模态模型、解耦预训练多模态模型和代理方法哪一种更为有效。
AI.method: 研究者使用公共检查点在16个由五个领域组成的数据集上，通过不同的方法尝试解决多项下游任务。
AI.result: 结果显示三种方法在144个数据集-预算组合中没有一种占据主导地位：解耦方法获胜54次，联合方法获胜44次，代理人方法获胜46次。具体的偏好随着监督预算、任务格式和单模态5-NN精度的变化而变化。
AI.conclusion: 一种两步级联方法结合了表示和任务诊断与任务预算元数据来预测哪种方法最有效，在71.4%的时间内正确选择方法，相对误差较低。

title: Instance-Specific Classifier-Free Guidance for Text-to-Image Diffusion/Flow-Based Editing
summary: In recent years, a variety of prompt-based image editing methods have been developed based on text-to-image (T2I) diffusion/flow models. Image editing introduces an inherent trade-off between adhering to the original source image and realizing the change specified by the target prompt, which are typically measured by the LPIPS and CLIP-T metrics, respectively. Intuitively, this trade-off can be controlled by the classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale. Most existing editing methods, though, use a fixed CFG scale, ignoring that different edits require varying levels of modification. In this paper, we first explore the potential benefits of using an instance-specific CFG by exhaustively re-running prominent editing methods with a wide range of CFG scale values on benchmark datasets. We show that instance-specific setting can significantly improve LPIPS without compromising CLIP-T. Yet, tuning based on repeatedly executing an editing pipeline is inefficient. To prevent slow inference, we train a light-weight neural network that predicts the metrics of the underlying editing method for a given edit instance and CFG scale. At inference time, these predictions enable fast selection of an instance-specific CFG scale. Experiments across multiple editing methods and benchmark settings show the performance advantage of our approach over the baseline methods.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索了在图像编辑中使用实例特定的分类器无指导规控（CFG）的潜力，并开发了一种轻量级神经网络来预测给定编辑实例和CFG尺度的指标，以实现快速选择实例特定的CFG尺度。
AI.motivation: 当前的图像编辑方法往往使用固定的CFG尺度，忽略了不同编辑可能需要不同程度的修改。因此，该研究旨在通过使用实例特定的CFG来改进图像编辑结果，同时开发一种轻量级模型来加速这种选择过程。
AI.method: 研究首先通过在多个编辑方法和基准数据集上广泛实验不同的CFG尺度值来验证实例特定CFG的有效性；其次，为了提高效率，研究团队训练了一种轻量级神经网络来预测给定编辑实例和CFG尺度下的指标。
AI.result: 研究发现实例特定的CFG设置可以在不牺牲CLIP-T的情况下显著提高LPIPS，同时通过轻量级神经网络实现了快速选择CFG尺度。多个编辑方法和基准设置的实验显示了本研究方法相较于基线方法的优势。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过探索实例特定的CFG和开发预测器，提高了图像编辑的质量和效率，展示了轻量级神经网络在选择合适CFG尺度上的强大性能。

title: Prosodic Structure as a Critical Component in Phonemic Language Modelling at BabyLM Scale
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the BabyLM Workshop, EMNLP 2026 (archival track)
summary: Human children learn language from continuous, prosodically structured speech long before they can read, yet almost all language models train on orthographic text. Building on previous phonemic BabyLM training (Goriely et al., 2024; arXiv:2410.22906), we ask whether supplying an estimate of the prosody infants exploit improves phonemic language modelling at BabyLM scale. We compare an orthographic baseline to three conditions forming a ladder of phonological richness. All conditions are trained as BERT MLMs at 10M and 100M words. Addressing the ecological validity of existing metrics in the small-data regime, we build a lexical decision task and two semantic organisation tasks. Our new lexical decision task offers improved insights into the distinction between wordlikeness, token familiarity, and lexicality as factors. Triphone phonotactic control and pseudo-log-likelihood scoring shows that these scores reflect phonotactic familiarity rather than wordhood: every model sits near or below chance on an adversarial inverted condition, revealing prior results of this kind as partly artefactual. On our new semantic tasks, a prosodically annotated phoneme stream gives the strongest taxonomic organisation at both the 10M and 100M word scales. Phonemic models with boundary structure are competitive with the orthographic baseline. These findings suggest that prosodic structure is a key component of phonemic language modelling in the small-data regime most analogous to infant learning.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了在BabyLM规模下，提供婴儿利用的语调估计是否能够改善基于音素的语言建模性能。研究构建了新的词汇判断任务和语义组织任务，并发现具有边界结构的音位模型在小数据范围内与词汇表 baseline 竞争，表明语调结构是婴儿学习中最关键的语言建模组成部分。
AI.motivation: 研究指出，尽管人类儿童在学习语言时依赖连续的、具有语调结构的口语，现有的大多数语言模型却基于拼写文本进行训练。因此，探讨在婴儿学习范式下，提供语调信息是否可以帮助改善学习性能。
AI.method: 研究使用了与先前研究类似的BabyLM训练方法，不同之处在于引入了不同程度的音位丰富条件进行对比。所有条件均在10M和100M词规模下作为BERT的MLM进行训练。此外，还设计了新的词汇判断任务和语义组织任务以评估模型性能。
AI.result: 除了基线条件外，三个条件中具有语调标注的音位流在词汇判断任务和语义组织任务中表现最佳，特别是在较小数据量时。通过triphone 语形态控制和伪对数似然得分，研究发现这些得分反映了语形态熟悉度，而非词汇性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论指出，语调结构在小数据集范围内对于音位语言建模至关重要，与婴儿学习过程更加一致。

title: A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt
summary: We ask how much an autoregressive transformer retains of its prompt after generating $t$ tokens. Consider two different prompts followed by the same continuation text, so that any difference in their hidden states comes from the prompt alone, and we find that the distance between their hidden states decays approximately as a power law $t^{-α}$, where $α=1$ is the rate at which a fixed prompt's share of uniform attention shrinks and smaller values mean longer memory. Trained models forget fast ($α\approx0.55$--$0.7$), untrained ones slowly ($α\approx0.2$--$0.5$). We prove that this offset is $O\big(P(\log t)^{L-1}/t\big)$ for a prompt of length $P$ and depth $L$. The bound holds for finite-depth pre-LN softmax transformers with bounded attention logits, under one additional condition: the pre-norm activations stay away from zero. The mechanism is geometric: the prompt's direct influence is diluted as the context grows, and \emph{relay} --- continuation tokens passing on what earlier tokens read from the prompt --- can only add logarithmic factors. This is what we call the \emph{conditional no-hair theorem}: given the text generated so far, the prompt's influence on the next token vanishes as $t$ grows, so any property of the prompt that survives, such as its language, must be carried by the text itself. An exactly solvable linear relay model shows that the bound cannot be improved and reproduces the rise of the local exponent towards $1$ seen in untrained networks. Cancelling the dilution with a logit bias stops the decay early in training and reverses it after, so dilution is necessary for the forgetting we measure; untrained networks and the solvable model show it is also sufficient.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了自回归Transformer生成t个令牌后保留其提示信息的程度，发现提示隐藏状态之间的距离随时间呈幂律衰减（$t^{-α}$），其中$\alpha$值的大小表示模型的保留记忆时间长短。训练好的模型忘记得快（$\alpha\approx0.55$–$0.7$），未训练的模型忘记得慢（$\alpha\approx0.2$–$0.5$）。
AI.motivation: 探讨自回归Transformer在生成过程中保留初始提示信息的能力，通过比较不同长度的提示在相同后续文本下的隐藏状态距离来表征遗忘率。
AI.method: 采用相同后续文本比较不同提示之间的隐藏状态距离，通过分析证明了遗忘率的渐近形式，并给出了具体条件下的数学证明。
AI.result: 证明了遗忘率与文本生成长度之间的关系，揭示了模型在训练过程中遗忘率的变化，并通过线性接力模型验证了理论。
AI.conclusion: 提出了条件无毛定理，证明了Transformer在生成文本时对初始提示的直接影响在长文本生成后会消失。

title: Beyond Generator-Specific Shortcuts: Open-World AI-Generated Video Detection via Adversarial Training
summary: AI-generated video (AIGV) detection is increasingly important for mitigating misinformation, impersonation, and other malicious uses of synthetic media, yet existing detectors often generalize poorly to unseen generators in open-world settings. To better understand this challenge, we analyze the failure modes of AIGV detectors under cross-generator out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts and observe that detector representations strongly encode generator-specific cues, which are associated with substantial ID-OOD performance drops. Further analysis shows that naively perturbing generator-sensitive tokens can even reduce OOD performance, indicating that generator-related cues and detection-relevant evidence are only partially separable. Motivated by these findings, we propose Forensic Obfuscation of geneRator-specific cues via Gradient-guided Embedding perturbation (FORGE), a token-aware adversarial training framework for open-world AIGV detection. FORGE identifies tokens that are strongly associated with generator-specific shortcuts yet less critical to real/fake discrimination, and selectively perturbs them during training to suppress generator-dependent patterns while preserving useful forensic evidence. Through synchronized adversarial training between an attacker and a detector, FORGE encourages the detector to learn more transferable generator-invariant forensic representations. Experiments on 29 held-out benchmark entries show that FORGE achieves an average F1 of 92.62, outperforming eight strong baselines by 5.31 points, while also remaining robust under four common post-processing attacks. We will release our code and datasets upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为FORGE的框架，用于开放世界AI生成视频检测。FORGE通过梯度导向嵌入扰动，选择性地修改与生成器特定线索强关联但对真假鉴别影响较小的标记，从而鼓励检测器学习更可迁移的生成器不变法医表示。
AI.motivation: 尽管现有的AI生成视频检测器在一定程度上有效，但在开放世界设置下，它们对未见过的生成器往往表现出色不足，导致性能下降。因此，本文探讨了解决这一问题的方法。
AI.method: 提出了FORGE框架，一种基于梯度导向嵌入扰动的对抗训练方法。该方法首先识别与生成器特定线索强关联但对真假鉴别影响较小的标记，然后在训练过程中选择性地扰动这些标记，以抑制生成器依赖模式，同时保留有用的法医证据。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，FORGE在29个保留基准条目上取得了平均F1得分92.62的效果，比八个强大基线高出5.31个百分点，并且在四种常见的后处理攻击下保持了鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的方法显著提升了开放世界AI生成视频检测的效果，并展示了其在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。

title: Multi-author style detection with stylistic embeddings
comment: Submitted and accepted to Workshop on Natural User-generated Text (W-NUT) in Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP), 2026
summary: We investigate the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) in multi-author style change detection. Using off-the-shelf LLMs or supervised fine-tuning solely within the target domain fails to yield effective features; for this reason, we propose cross-domain transfer learning with LLM-based embeddings fine-tuned for authorship verification. We fine-tune Mistral-7B embedding model and compare it with DeBERTa, used in the state-of-the-art (SOTA) systems in PAN-25 multi-author writing style analysis challenge. Results show that DeBERTa and Mistral excel in different user-generated text scenarios. We exploit this diversity by combining both embeddings, leading to more effective style change detection.

AI.tldr: 研究利用大型语言模型（LLMs）进行多作者风格变化检测的任务，提出了跨领域迁移学习的方法，并结合了Mistral-7B和DeBERTa的嵌入表示，以提高风格变化检测的效果。
AI.motivation: 传统方法在目标领域内的监督微调效果不佳，为了解决这一问题，研究引入了LLMs进行跨领域迁移学习，以提高多作者风格变化检测的效果。
AI.method: 研究利用了现有的LLMs或者对特定任务进行微调的方法，但效果有限。因此，提出了基于LLMs的嵌入模型进行跨领域迁移学习的方法，并结合了Mistral-7B和DeBERTa两种模型进行嵌入表示的微调。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Mistral-7B和DeBERTa在不同用户生成的文本场景中表现出不同的优势，通过结合两者的方法提高了风格变化检测的效果。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了跨领域迁移学习的方法，并结合了两种嵌入模型来实现更有效的风格变化检测，这一方法在多作者写作风格分析挑战中取得了较好的效果。

title: TorchTPU - A Hybrid Eager/Compiled Architecture for Native PyTorch Execution on TPU
summary: TorchTPU is an open-source collaboration between Google and Meta that introduces a native and principled PyTorch backend for Google TPUs. It enables seamless out-of-the-box model execution and TPU migration while delivering industry-competitive inference and training performance through eager execution optimizations, torch.compile integration, and native hardware acceleration.

AI.tldr: TorchTPU 是 Google 和 Meta 合作开发的开源项目，为 Google TPU 引入了一个原生的 PyTorch 后端，优化了动态执行、torch.compile 集成以及原生硬件加速，实现了与行业竞争水平相当的推断和训练性能。
AI.motivation: 通过提供一个原生的 PyTorch 后端，TorchTPU 解决了用户在使用 Google TPU 时可能遇到的兼容性问题，并简化了模型部署和迁移流程。
AI.method: TorchTPU 采用了优化的动态执行策略和对 torch.compile 的支持，同时利用了 Google TPU 的硬件特性进行加速。
AI.result: TorchTPU 实现了与行业竞争水平相当的推断和训练性能，提高了 PyTorch 在 Google TPU 上的执行效率。
AI.conclusion: TorchTPU 成功地实现了 PyTorch 在 Google TPU 上的原生支持，为用户提供了更好的性能和用户体验。

title: EgoVine: Post-Training with Branching Experience Compiled from Real-World Videos
summary: Real-world egocentric videos capture multi-step household procedures, but their recorded trajectories leave alternative actions and recovery from the learner's own mistakes largely unexplored. We introduce EgoVine, a post-training framework that turns a fixed demonstration set into interactive experience for long-horizon planning. EgoVine operates in executable symbolic environments compiled from real-world video annotations, where an agent must coordinate object manipulations under partial observation and account for delayed consequences. Restoring a decision state allows the learner to explore alternative actions and compare their eventual outcomes. Union jointly trains action generation and consequence prediction in one model, using the same executions to supervise candidate comparison and recovery. Verified repairs add recovery targets from failed attempts, while comparisons among sampled continuations guide policy updates. The updated planner then returns to the environments, with its own decisions and mistakes shaping the next round of experience. On a shared benchmark, EgoVine-1.5B achieves 81.8% success on Main planning tasks and 66.7% on longer task compositions, outperforming all evaluated Flash LLM baselines on both. EgoVine connects real demonstrations to an iterative learning process that trains compact planners on choices and futures beyond the recorded trajectories.

AI.tldr: EgoVine 是一个后训练框架，它将固定演示集转化为交互式体验，用于长期规划。EgoVine 在可执行的符号环境中运行，这些环境由真实世界的视频注释编译而来。该框架通过联合训练动作生成和后果预测，更新计划并在环境中执行，从而实现迭代学习。
AI.motivation: 目前的实时个人中心视频记录了多步骤的家庭程序，但未能充分探索其他可能的动作和自我错误的恢复。EgoVine 的主要目标是提供一个后训练框架，使学习者能够在执行过程中探索替代行动，并通过恢复决策状态进行自我纠正。
AI.method: EgoVine 使用可执行的符号环境，该环境根据真实世界视频的注释编译而来。系统中的智能体在部分观察和延迟的后果下必须协调物体操作。框架通过联合训练行动生成和后果预测，在一个模型中使用相同的执行来监督候选比较和恢复。验证的修复从失败尝试中添加恢复目标，而对采样的后续行动之间的比较指导政策更新。
AI.result: EgoVine 的 1.5B 版本在通用基准上的主要规划任务中实现了 81.8% 的成功率，在较长的任务组成中实现了 66.7% 的成功率，超过了所有评估的 Flash LLM 基线。
AI.conclusion: EgoVine 将现实世界的演示与迭代学习过程连接起来，用于训练紧凑的控制者来处理超出记录轨迹的选择和未来。

title: Reasoning with Context Management and External Memory
summary: Reasoning models maintain information about the status of their reasoning process through in-context memory. Complex problems require larger context windows and memory requirements. In this scenario, context management without caching risks discarding useful information for reasoning. We propose RCMEM, an approach that extends context management with an external memory to maintain additional information without burdening the reasoning model with additional context. RCMEM significantly reduces computation time on problems that require repeated computation of intermediate steps, while achieving better performance on complex problems. We demonstrate our approach on a few mathematics problems using model sizes ranging from 0.4 to 25 million parameters, and GPT-2.

AI.tldr: RCMEM通过引入外部记忆机制，解决了复杂问题中的上下文管理难题，减轻了推理模型的负担，提高了计算效率和性能。
AI.motivation: 随着问题复杂性的增加，传统的上下文管理可能无法保留推理过程中有用的信息，导致性能下降。
AI.method: RCMEM通过使用外部内存系统，以非侵入的方式扩展了现有的上下文管理，从而保留更多的推理相关信息。
AI.result: 在需要重复计算中间步骤的问题上，RCMEM显著减少了计算时间，并且在复杂的问题上实现了更好的性能。
AI.conclusion: RCMEM证明了其在应对复杂数学问题方面的能力，展示了从0.4到2500万参数的不同规模模型以及GPT-2模型上的应用效果。

title: Self-Improving Video-to-Action Models
comment: 33 pages, 18 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://wilcoxsonm21.github.io/mirror/
summary: Video generative models are an emerging tool for embodied agents: they can serve as scalable visual planners, generating videos that depict how to complete previously unseen tasks. However, executing these plans typically requires a video-to-action or "inverse dynamics" model trained on large, human-collected video-action datasets, severely limiting scalability. We introduce Mirror, a self-supervised approach that learns video-to-action mappings through environment interactions, without prior action data or hand-crafted rewards. Mirror learns by attempting to follow a visual plan by executing its best guess of the underlying actions in the environment. Mirror then trains on the resulting video-action pairs, incrementally self-improving and following the visual planner more closely. Across Atari, OGBench, and DeepMind Control, Mirror outperforms leading learning-from-observation methods with learned video plans, and achieves near-expert performance with oracle plans. On Minecraft BASALT, it outperforms methods with access to expert actions or hand-engineered task knowledge. In Minecraft survival, it is the first method to acquire an iron pickaxe through self-improvement alone, without rewards or expert action labels. In the offline setting, with expert action labels but no environment interaction, it sets a new state of the art in obtaining diamonds. Our results suggest that advances in video models can translate into increasingly capable agents without a corresponding need for hand-crafted rewards or large collections of expert action data.

AI.tldr: Mirror是一种无需先验动作数据或手工设计奖励的自我监督方法，通过环境互动学习视频到动作映射，实现了在多种环境下的出色表现。
AI.motivation: 目前，视觉规划工具的执行通常依赖于大型、人工收集的视频-动作数据集，限制了其可扩展性。因此，研究提出了一种自我监督方法Mirror，以解决此问题。
AI.method: Mirror通过尝试根据环境中的动作猜测来遵循视觉计划，从而自监督地学习视频到动作映射。
AI.result: 在Atari、OGBench、DeepMind Control中，Mirror超过了领先的学习观察的方法，并在Minecraft BASALT中，它超过了具有专家动作或手工程任务知识的方法。在Minecraft生存模式中，它无需奖励或专家动作标签即能自我改进获得铁镐。在离线设置中，虽然有专家动作标签但没有环境互动，它在获取钻石方面达到新纪录。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了视频模型的进步如何能够提升代理的能效，而无需依赖手工设计的奖励或大量专家动作数据。

title: ContraSafe-VL: A Contrastive Safety Preference Dataset for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as general-purpose multimodal assistants, making multimodal safety alignment an important challenge. Safety depends on the interplay between textual and visual content, with visual context often playing a critical role. However, VLMs may fail to use visual information appropriately, either overlooking safety-relevant visual content or over-interpreting sensitive visual content, leading to unsafe responses or over-refusal. Existing multimodal safety alignment datasets largely follow the response-preference paradigm, which teaches models how to respond but provides limited supervision on how visual context should inform the safety judgment, making it difficult to balance safety and over-refusal. To address this limitation, we introduce ContraSafe-VL, a Contrastive Safety preference dataset for Vision-Language Models. For each fixed textual query, ContraSafe-VL constructs paired visual contexts that result in multimodal queries with different safety labels, providing direct supervision for how visual context should inform multimodal safety judgments. It further provides response preference pairs based on harmlessness and helpfulness to encourage models to generate responses that are both safe and helpful. Experiments across three VLM architectures and multiple benchmarks demonstrate that training with ContraSafe-VL improves cross-modal safety recognition and achieves a better safety--over-refusal trade-off while preserving general multimodal capabilities. The dataset will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 介绍了ContraSafe-VL数据集，这是为视觉-语言模型设计的对比安全偏好数据集，通过对比不同的视觉上下文来提供直接的安全判断监督，从而提高跨模态安全性识别并改善安全与过度拒绝之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态安全对齐数据集依赖于响应偏好范式，这使模型难以平衡安全性和拒绝过度的可能性。ContraSafe-VL提供直接监督，指导视觉上下文如何影响多模态的安全判断。
AI.method: ContraSafe-VL构建了在每个固定文本查询下具有不同安全标签的配对视觉上下文，来直接监督如何使视觉上下文影响多模态安全判断。此外，还提供了基于无害性和有益性的响应偏好对，鼓励生成既安全又有益的回应。
AI.result: 针对三种VLM架构和多个基准进行的实验表明，使用ContraSafe-VL培训可以改进跨模态安全性识别，并且能够在保持跨模态泛化能力的同时实现更好的安全与过度拒绝之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: ContraSafe-VL提供了显著改进多模态安全性识别和平衡安全过度问题的新方法，该数据集将被公开发布，支持进一步研究。

title: Language Models are Lazy Poets: Creative Mode Collapse at Scale
summary: While aligned large language models (LLMs) can successfully complete many creative tasks, their outputs tend to be highly self-similar. Though solutions to this problem of "mode collapse" have been proposed, comprehensive large-scale surveys of the phenomenon in specific textual genres are still lacking. We address this gap through an extensive treatment of LLM mode collapse in poetry. Across 15 poetic forms, 248 subject matter tags, and 16 open-weight models, we generate over 1.1 million poems. To our knowledge, this constitutes the largest corpus of LLM-generated poetry to date. At million-poem scale, we find that LLM poetic vocabularies and rhyming abilities are substantial, but severely underutilized. In other words, LLMs are "lazy" poets: despite possessing large poetic inventories, LLMs over-rely on a small number of words, opening phrases, and rhymes. Further, we find that lexical homogenization differs across models and poetic forms, noting observed rhyming vocabulary is correlated with model size.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了大规模语言模型在诗歌生成中的模式塌陷问题，通过生成超过100万首诗歌，揭示了模型在词汇和押韵能力上的潜力被严重低估。
AI.motivation: 当前，虽然对大型语言模型在多种创意任务中的应用已有较多研究，但在具体文本类型（如诗歌）中的全面详尽分析仍然不足。因此，这一研究旨在填补该领域的空白。
AI.method: 研究团队采用了16种开源权重模型，涵盖了15种诗歌形式和248个主题标签来生成诗歌。通过这种方式，他们构建了一个迄今为止最大的大规模语言模型生成的诗歌集合。
AI.result: 结果显示，语言模型在诗歌生成中的词汇和押韵能力具有显著潜力，但这些潜力被严重低估了。具体来说，模型倾向于过度依赖少数词汇、开场表达和押韵。
AI.conclusion: 研究认为，语言模型在生成诗歌时表现出了‘懒惰’的特性，尽管拥有大量的诗歌库存。此外，词汇单一化现象随着模型大小的不同而在不同诗歌形式中表现出差异。

title: Agents' Last Doubt: Knowing When to Act and When to Step Back in Tool-Using Agents
summary: Tool-using LLM agents repeatedly face decision points under uncertainty, choosing between autonomous action, additional information gathering, and human escalation. These decisions require balancing task success against interaction cost and the risk of irreversible errors. Learning to make these trade-offs is challenging because existing interaction trajectories record only the outcomes of actions taken, leaving the consequences of alternative actions unobserved. To address this gap, we construct a counterfactual dataset containing 3,115 action outcomes from 1,036 decision points in ToolSandbox. At each decision point, we execute each legal action and evaluate its downstream outcomes based on task completion, interaction cost, and irreversible errors. Using this dataset, we train SURE-Act, a controller that selects actions for a frozen backbone agent at inference time. Our experiments show that learning to rank alternative actions improves offline action-selection utility by 0.0309 over a regression-only baseline. We further show that adding SURE-Act enables end-to-end gains of up to 0.0575 in ToolSandbox's Overall Score with the Qwen3-4B agent. Moreover, SURE-Act outperforms adapted decision rules from SAGE-Agent and Calibrate-Then-Act by 0.1506 and 0.1438, respectively. This work establishes the first counterfactual dataset for ToolSandbox and provides actionable insights into decision-making under uncertainty for tool-using agents.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过构建ToolSandbox的反事实数据集，训练了一个名为SURE-Act的控制器，该控制器在不采取行动的情况下评估不同行动的后果。研究结果表明，SURE-Act能显著提高行动选择的效用，并在工具使用代理TaskSandbox的综合评分上展示了端到端的改进。
AI.motivation: 现有的交互轨迹只能记录已采取行动的结果，忽略了其他可能路径的结果。这使得工具使用LLM代理在决策时不便于做出合理的选择。因此，研究者开发了一个反事实数据集，并基于此训练了一个控制器，旨在改善代理的行动选择。
AI.method: 研究者构建了一个包含1036个决策点、3115个行动结果的反事实数据集。在每个决策点，他们执行每个合法行动，并基于任务完成情况、交互成本和不可逆错误评估其后续结果。然后，他们使用这个数据集训练了一个控制器（SURE-Act），该控制器可以在推理时为冻结的代理选择行动。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，学习排名不同的行动能够比回归基线提高0.0309的离线行动选择效用。进一步实验表明，在Qwen3-4B代理上，添加SURE-Act可使ToolSandbox的综合评分提高到0.0575。SURE-Act还优于SAGE-Agent和Calibrate-Then-Act的调整决策规则，分别高出0.1506和0.1438。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功建立了ToolSandbox的第一个反事实数据集，并展示了在不确定性的决策任务中，评估不同行动的后果对于智能代理的实际效用。

title: When the Editing Intent Is Split: A Cross-Modal Jailbreak Attack for Large Image Editing Models
summary: Large image editing models increasingly infer editing intent from both textual and visual inputs, creating an underexplored safety risk when harmful intent is distributed across modalities. In this work, we formalize this split-intent vulnerability and propose the Split-Intent Jailbreak Attack (SIJA), which asymmetrically distributes an unsafe editing intent by specifying the editing referent in text while concealing the safety-critical action and specification through graphical visual semantics in an auxiliary cue. To systematically study this threat, we introduce the Split-Intent Image Editing Safety Benchmark (SI2ESBench) for evaluating image editing models under split-intent inputs. Extensive experiments on representative commercial and open-source models demonstrate that SIJA effectively compromises state-of-the-art image editing systems, achieving ASRs of 68.28% on GPT Image 2 and 91.38% on Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro. Our results expose a mismatch between multimodal editing and safety assessment: the distributed intent can be recovered to execute the requested transformation, yet its harmfulness often remains undetected by existing safeguards. To mitigate this vulnerability, we propose editing-intent reconstruction, a defense principle that explicitly evaluates the complete transformation implied by the joint multimodal context and substantially improves rejection of split-intent attacks. Our findings expose a cross-modal safety gap in modern image editing systems and highlight the need to assess the jointly inferred transformation rather than individual inputs in isolation. https://github.com/yexianmin/SIJA

AI.tldr: 该研究定义了一种名为Split-Intent Jailbreak Attack (SIJA)的攻击方式，通过文本指定意图但通过图形隐藏关键的安全行为，提出了一种基准SI2ESBench来评估在混合意图输入下的图像编辑模型，实验表明该攻击有效，提出了编辑意图重建作为防御策略。
AI.motivation: 随着图像编辑模型越来越依赖于文本和视觉输入来推断编辑意图，该研究发现了跨模态的不安全行为风险，并提出了一种新的攻击方法和基准以推动这个领域的安全评估。
AI.method: 该研究设计了一种攻击方法SIJA，并建立了一个基准SI2ESBench来评估图像编辑模型在面对跨模态攻击时的表现。同时，他们还提出了一种防御机制——编辑意图重建。
AI.result: 实验证明，SIJA攻击可以有效突破先进的图像编辑系统（在GPT Image 2上ASR为68.28%，在Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro上ASR为91.38%）。同时，防御机制在面对这种攻击时表现出了显著的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了现代图像编辑系统在跨模态安全评估中的差距，并强调了有必要评估多模态上下文联合推断的整体变换，而非单独的输入。

title: Analyzing Repetition and Interference Effects in Memory-Constrained User Simulators
summary: User simulators can help evaluate and train AI systems to interact with humans at scale. To do so, evaluation of user simulators must measure behavioral parity with people. We evaluate whether memory-constrained user simulators are sensitive to two factors known to affect human information retention: repetition of a fact and interference from competing information. We find that some simulators achieve human-like overall accuracy, and replicate the magnitude of repetition and interference effects, but none match people's accuracy on particular questions: while humans misremember facts, models forget them, leading to different error patterns. We release this data as a challenge benchmark for future work on user simulators.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了记忆受限的用户模拟器在重复信息和竞争信息影响下的人类信息保留行为的一致性，发现虽然部分模拟器在总体准确性上达到类似人类的表现，且能复制重复效应和干扰效应的幅度，但在具体问题上的记忆力表现与人类不同，导致错误模式不同。研究发布数据作为未来用户模拟器研究的挑战基准。
AI.motivation: 用户模拟器对于大规模评估和训练与人类交互的AI系统至关重要。为了准确评估用户模拟器，本研究旨在评估其在表现重复和竞争信息影响方面的人类信息保留行为的一致性。
AI.method: 本研究对记忆受限的用户模拟器进行了评价，考察了在重复和竞争信息影响下模拟器的表现，以评估其是否能够达到接近人类的记忆力表现。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，部分用户模拟器在整体准确度上达到了类似人类的表现，并能在重复效应和干扰效应的幅度上进行复制，但在特定问题上，人类会误记事实而模型则会遗忘，导致不同的错误模式。
AI.conclusion: 本研究认为，虽然部分用户模拟器在某些方面表现接近人类，但在特定问题的记忆表现上仍存在差距，这为未来的研究提出了挑战。研究者发布了该数据集作为未来用户模拟器研究的挑战基准。

title: Distillation, Self-Training, and the Fragility of Learned Chemical Reasoning
summary: Automating synthesis planning for small-molecule drug design requires chemical reasoners that are accurate as well as open to inspection and adaptation, yet frontier language models remain unreliable at predicting reaction outcomes and difficult to deploy, while small open-weight models lack the necessary domain reasoning. We show that frontier supervision can serve as a one-time bootstrap for open models on forward reaction prediction. Our models, Resonance, distill an open-weight teacher's reasoning traces and then learn from their own verified outputs, turning a small base model with near-zero accuracy into a capable reaction predictor, while a stronger student surpasses its teacher through distillation alone. Accuracy, however, does not bring robust reasoning: the small student inherits its teacher's single-pass style, self-training mainly sharpens answers it could already reach, and it readily abandons correct answers under pushback, suggesting that chemical reasoning models should be evaluated on the robustness of their reasoning as well as on the accuracy of their answers.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过监督学习方法提高了小分子药物设计合成规划的模型准确性，尽管提高了准确率，但模型的推理稳定性仍然不足。
AI.motivation: 当前的前沿语言模型在预测化学反应结果方面不够准确且难以部署，同时小型开放模型缺乏必要的领域推理能力。
AI.method: 通过监督学习方法，模型将开放式教师的推理痕迹进行精炼，并从自己验证过的输出中学习，将一个小基模型转变为具备反应预测能力的模型。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，在经过训练后，模型的预测准确率显著提升，然而模型的推理稳定性不足，仍需改进。
AI.conclusion: 研究者认为，化学推理模型应该不仅评估其答案的准确性，还应该评估其推理的稳定性。

title: Grounding Confusable Movie Moments
summary: Characters, locations, and actions recur throughout a movie, so many of its moments differ only in fine-grained details. Grounding such a moment in a full-length movie requires resolving that detail rather than matching the attributes it shares with other moments, yet existing temporal movie grounding benchmarks rarely test this. We introduce CoM$^2$-Bench, a benchmark of confusable query pairs, where the two queries in each pair share most attributes but differ in a single distinguishing detail within a full movie, posing a challenge for recent temporal grounding approaches. To locate where grounding breaks down, we analyze a retrieve-then-localize pipeline, in which a retriever first selects a short candidate chunk and a localizer then performs temporal grounding within it. Separating the two stages lets us attribute each failure to either retrieval or localization. We find that retrieval is the major bottleneck: state-of-the-art retrievers often select a moment's confusable counterpart, because their choices follow the content the two moments share rather than the detail that tells them apart. To address these failures, we propose a simple, training-free remedy, Agentic Window Search (AWS): an MLLM agent $\textit{Decomposes}$ the query into attribute-level sub-queries, then $\textit{Inspects}$ each candidate window against them and $\textit{Expands}$ the window when evidence is cut off at its edge. AWS works with existing retrievers and localizers without additional training, raising mIoU from 18.5 to 26.8.

AI.tldr: 研究团队提出了一个新的基准CoM$^2$-Bench，旨在评估和提高电影中的时间定位性能，特别是细粒度细节的匹配能力。通过引入检索-本地化两个阶段，该研究揭示了当前最优检索器存在的问题，并提出了一种无需训练的方法AWS来改进检索效果。
AI.motivation: 当前的电影时间定位基准大多仅关注共享属性的匹配，忽视了细粒度细节的区分。这种局限性使得现有的时间定位方法难以在实际应用场景中有效工作。
AI.method: 引入了新的基准CoM$^2$-Bench，基于一系列类似但具有细微差异的查询对进行测试。同时分析了检索-本地化双阶段流程，并提出了一种无需额外训练的方法AWS来改善检索器的表现。
AI.result: 实验表明，当前的最优检索器在处理细粒度差异时容易出现问题，而AWS方法在保持现有框架的同时显著提升了表现。具体地，mIoU从18.5提升到了26.8。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，细粒度的时间定位仍然是电影理解和时间定位领域的一个挑战，而AWS方法提供了一种简单有效的解决方案。

title: Preserving Reasoning Diversity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards via Adaptive Replay
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but often reduces the diversity of their reasoning behaviors. We study this phenomenon from the perspective of finite-sample learning dynamics and show that limited on-policy rollouts can progressively suppress semantically distinct but equally rewarded reasoning modes. Once a mode becomes sufficiently under-sampled, standard on-policy RLVR rarely recovers it. Motivated by this observation, we propose TAR, a Targeted Adaptive Replay framework that preserves diverse correct reasoning behaviors already present in the base policy. TAR constructs a compact memory bank of diverse base-model solutions and selectively replays them through an adaptive mechanism that activates only when stored behaviors are being suppressed during RLVR. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two Qwen2.5 model scales, TAR consistently achieves a better balance between reasoning performance and diversity preservation than existing diversity-preserving post-training methods, while substantially reducing the forgetting of correct base-model solutions. Code is available at https://github.com/wenzhilics/tar.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为TAR的自适应重放框架，用于在强化学习中保留多样的正确推理行为。TAR方法通过构建多样性的基础模型解的记忆库，并在特定情况下选择性地重放这些解来实现这一目标。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在提高大型语言模型推理能力的同时，可能会减少其多样化的推理行为。本文通过分析有限样本的学习动力学，发现局限于on-policy回放会导致某些具有不同但等价奖励的推理模式逐渐被抑制。因此，本文提出TAR框架来保护已存在的多样正确推理行为。
AI.method: TAR是通过构建并维护一个含有多样化基础模型解的紧凑记忆库来运作的。在强化学习过程中，该方法会在特定条件下跌激活这个记忆库，选择性地重放这些已经被抑制或即将被抑制的正确解，以恢复和保护这些多样化的推理模式。
AI.result: 在六个数学推理基准测试和两种不同规模的Qwen2.5模型上，TAR方法能够在保持或甚至提高推理性能的同时，比现有的多样性和性能保留方法更好地保持这些多样化的推理行为，并且显著减少了正确基础模型解的遗忘。
AI.conclusion: TAR方法在多种场景下展示了对增强推理能力和保持多样化推理行为的显著优越性，为改进多模态推理框架提供了新的思路和方法。

title: Training-Free Prompt Selection for Efficient Reinforcement Learning With Partial Rollouts
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for training reasoning models, but its computational cost makes efficient data selection increasingly important. Since training examples contribute unequally to learning, selecting a small, informative subset can offer a more efficient alternative to using the entire data pool. The training-free selection method estimates prompt value with hidden states from complete greedy rollouts. However, in our datasets, $26$--$32\%$ of these rollouts fail to terminate within the generation budget. We introduce LIFT, a training-free data selector that identifies impactful prompts using only partial reasoning rollouts. At its core, LIFT uses Partial Rollout Context Lift (PRCL), a score inspired by pointwise $\mathcal{V}$-information that accumulates token-level log-likelihood ratios between a question-conditioned context and a null context with the question removed. This enables prompt scoring from a short rollout prefix rather than a complete trajectory. Across Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B, prefixes retaining at least 90\% and 95\% of the full-rollout PRCL score, respectively, require only 26\% and 4.7\% of the tokens generated by full rollouts. Compared with SHIFT, LIFT reduces selection cost by 3.7--9.1$\times$ while achieving competitive downstream RLVR performance, with the highest six-benchmark average in three of six settings.

AI.tldr: LIFT是一种无训练的数据选择器，利用部分推理回放进行有效的提示评估，显著降低了选择成本，同时保持了出色的下游强化学习奖励模型性能。
AI.motivation: 由于RLVR具有高计算成本，需要一种更高效的示例选择方法，确保数据集的选择既高效又能保持模型性能。
AI.method: LIFT通过使用Partial Rollout Context Lift（PRCL）分数来评估提示的重要性，该分数利用点积$	ext{V}$-信息量，对比包含问题的上下文和去除问题的上下文的token级别的对数似然比。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B数据集上，保留90%和95%的完整回放PRCL分数的前缀分别仅需要完整回放26%和4.7%的生成token。与SHIFT相比，LIFT将选择成本降低了3.7到9.1倍，同时在三个设置中达到了最高的六基准平均性能。
AI.conclusion: LIFT为训练高效的示例选择提供了一种新的方法，能够在显著减少训练数据量的同时保证模型的性能。

title: Pseudo-Label Foreground Quality Weighting for Domain-Generalized Fundus Image Segmentation
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at SIPAIM 2026
summary: Optic disc (OD) and optic cup (OC) segmentation is central to automated glaucoma assessment, but models trained on limited labeled fundus datasets often degrade under domain shift. Semi-supervised Teacher-Student learning can improve generalization by leveraging unlabeled data, yet standard Noisy Student training treats all pseudo-labels as equally reliable. In this paper we investigate a targeted extension of Noisy Student training in which OD- and OC-specific pseudo-label supervision is modulated using a mask-derived reliability estimate. A multitask Dice predictor estimates OD- and OC-specific pseudo-label quality from Teacher-generated masks, and these estimates are used to weight the pseudo-label loss during Student training. This preserves the baseline contribution of low-scoring foreground pseudo-labels while assigning greater relative emphasis to pseudo-labels predicted to be more reliable. Experiments across known and unseen domains show improvements over the Noisy Student baseline, particularly for OC segmentation, while maintaining competitive generalization performance.

AI.tldr: 通过对伪标签监督进行可靠性调节，该研究改进了Noisy Student方法，特别是在视杯（OC）分割上取得了显著提升，同时保持了较高的泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 传统Noisy Student方法在处理有限标注数据集和领域变化时表现不佳，因此研究旨在改进这种方法，通过可靠性估计来优化不可靠伪标签的权重。
AI.method: 使用多任务Dice预测器评估伪标签的质量，并基于此估计调整标签损失的权重，从而增强更为可靠的伪标签的影响。
AI.result: 与基础的Noisy Student方法相比，新方法在多个领域和分割任务中表现更佳，特别是在视杯（OC）分割方面。
AI.conclusion: 这项方法的成功应用表明，通过考虑伪标签的可靠性，可以有效提高模型在不同场景下的泛化能力。

title: Encoder-Free Multimodal LLMs Learn Implicit Encoders
summary: We empirically analyze two recently proposed encoder-free multimodal LLMs, Gemma-4 12B and Inkling-Small. Unlike previous multimodal LLMs, these models do not use modality-specific encoders to extract tokenized embeddings representing audio and image input; instead, they directly feed windows of samples, pixels, or spectral features to the Transformer language model. We analyze whether the early layers of these models learn to function similarly to dedicated audio and visual encoders. We find that these early layers do in fact act as ``implicit encoders,'' encoding audio and visual inputs in a way that is largely invariant to their cross-modal context. Furthermore, when performing multimodal reasoning tasks, we show that independently encoding the modalities throughout these early model layers achieves the same accuracy as jointly encoding them from the first layer onwards. Finally, we use layer-wise probing to analyze the salient information captured by the implicit encoders and find their behavior to be similar to several popular encoder models.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过实证分析两种新型无需编码器的多模态LLM (Gemma-4 12B 和 Inkling-Small)，发现它们的早期层实际上像隐式的编码器，能够编码音频和视觉输入且对跨模态上下文基本不变。此外，在执行多模态推理任务时，独立在这些早期层中编码模态与从第一层起联合编码具有相同的准确度，进一步分析也显示隐式的编码器行为与常用编码器模型相似。
AI.motivation: 研究者们通过实证分析方法探索两种新型无需编码器的多模态LLM架构的有效性，旨在理解其在处理多模态信息时的行为机制，以及是否能够达到与传统方法相似的效果。
AI.method: 研究者使用了多种分析方法，包括直接向Transformer语言模型输入片段样本、像素或光谱特征，以及使用层间探针分析隐式编码器的行为。
AI.result: 研究发现，这两种新型多模态LLM的早期层能够像隐式的编码器一样处理音频和视觉输入，且这种处理方式在多模态推理任务中达到了与传统方法相似的效果，且独立编码与联合编码在准确度上无显著差异。此外，通过层间探针分析还表明隐式编码器的行为与一些流行的编码器模型相似。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了无需编码器的多模态LLM在处理多模态数据时的有效性，并揭示了其早期层的行为特征。

title: Probing Ambiguity: Adversarial Intent Resolution for Robust Text-to-SQL
summary: Text-to-SQL systems typically assume a one-to-one mapping between natural-language queries and correct SQL translations. In practice, however, many queries are inherently ambiguous, admitting multiple valid interpretations that yield distinct outputs. We introduce Adversarial Intent Resolution (AIR), a multi-agent framework that actively probes and resolves such ambiguity without any task-specific training. AIR first constructs competing interpretations, verifies through SQL execution that they produce genuinely different results, and generates targeted clarification questions grounded in the observed data differences. Evaluating on leading benchmarks for ambiguous questions, AIR demonstrates strong performance, efficiency, and robust cross-benchmark transferability. On the AMBROSIA benchmark under schema-only context, a realistic production setting where exposing the full database is infeasible, AIR outperforms IntentRL, the state-of-the-art reinforcement learning model, across all metrics (e.g., F1 0.679 vs. 0.618). Crucially, AIR exhibits only ~7% performance degradation without the full database, compared to ~20% for IntentRL. On the AmbiQT benchmark, where ambiguity arises from schema design rather than linguistic structure, AIR achieves higher F1 under both context settings without any benchmark-specific adaptation.

AI.tldr: Adversarial Intent Resolution (AIR) 是一种多代理框架，能够在无需任务特定训练的情况下探测和解决语义上的歧义，通过生成基于观测数据差异的澄清问题来实现。
AI.motivation: 大多数文本到SQL系统假设自然语言查询和正确SQL翻译之间存在一对一映射，但在实际应用中，许多查询都是模糊的，可能有多种有效解释。因此，本文提出一个新的方法AIR来解决歧义问题。AIR能够在没有任务特定训练的情况下解决模糊查询。
AI.method: AIR 是一个基于代理的框架，通过构造竞争的解释、验证它们通过SQL执行是否产生不同的结果，以及生成基于观测数据差异的澄清问题来解决歧义。
AI.result: 在AMBROSIA基准测试中，当没有完整的数据库时，AIR在所有指标上的表现优于现有的先进模型INTENTRL。在AmbiQT基准测试中，AIR在两种上下文中都表现更好，无需针对特定基准进行调整。
AI.conclusion: AIR在解决语义模糊查询方面表现出强大性能和效率，并且具有很强的跨基准鲁棒性。

title: Junction Geometry Survives an Unidentifiable Blur
summary: Thin filaments cross in microscopy, and dispersed spectra cross on X-ray detectors. At a junction, where these structures cross or branch, how many straight arms meet, and which way do they go? Unknown blur obscures the answer. At a balanced crossing, distinct Gaussian blurs can even produce the same observation law. We show that the arms can still be recovered. For separated rays of nonvanishing weight and an unknown centered Gaussian-mixture blur, a distance combining arm count, directions, relative weights and supporting lines is bounded by a constant times the Euclidean difference in cell probabilities on a sufficiently fine fixed grid. The bound is uniform over a bounded model class, including unidentifiable blurs. From $n$ positions or photon counts, the minimax error is of order $n^{-1/2}$. This rate is proved for a global estimator. In practice we fit rays and blur by constrained local likelihood, reducing the BIC count when two detectors agree on fewer arms in the microscopy studies. Across three studies with protocols fixed before evaluation, on 360 crossings and branches assembled from measured single-molecule localizations, the fit gets the arm count and every direction within $10^\circ$ 24 to 37 percentage points more often than a tuned fixed-scale Hessian ridge detector, averaged over 25 to 400 localizations. On acute angles with correct counts, mean absolute error is $3.5^\circ$ to $4.3^\circ$, versus $10.4^\circ$ to $15.5^\circ$. On Chandra spectra, 38 of 90 fits at 800 photons find all four arms within $10^\circ$; among these, median error is $0.023^\circ$.

AI.tldr: 通过显微镜和X射线检测中的臂计数和方向估计，研究在未知高斯混合模糊下的最差情况误差被边界约束，实际测试表明该方法优于现有的固定尺度Hessianridge检测器，并在Chandra光谱中实现了较低的平均绝对误差。
AI.motivation: 研究在存在交叉或分支结构时如何准确估计臂的数量和方向，特别是在存在未知模糊的情况下。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于局部最大似然估计的方法来估计臂的数量和方向，并通过边界约束限制误差。
AI.result: 证明了适用于特定模型类的最差情况误差界限，并且在实践中展示了该方法的有效性，优于其他固定尺度的检测器，尤其是在急性角度和Chandra光谱分析中。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为交叉结构下的臂计数和方向分析提供了一种准确的方法，并展示了其在不同应用场景中的优势。

title: Can This LLM Annotate My Data? Estimating Zero-Shot LLM Performance
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in annotation tasks with varying success. While several studies have demonstrated the opportunities and shortcomings of LLMs for annotation, a critical question remains unanswered: is it possible to predict how well they will perform on a new dataset? To answer this and related questions, we construct two task families which induce 461 text classification datasets. We find that it is possible to predict LLM performance - to a certain degree - and that contrary to other work which highlights the usefulness of LLM verbalizations of self-confidence, internal log-probabilities are the most predictive signal.

AI.tldr: 研究构建了两个任务家族，生成461个文本分类数据集，探讨了能否预测LLM在新数据集上的表现，并发现内部对数概率是最具预测性的信号。
AI.motivation: 研究的动机在于探索大型语言模型在新数据集上的表现预测可能性，以及相较于其他工作，研究更侧重于模型内部的对数概率而非自信度表达。
AI.method: 研究构建了两个任务家族，并生成了461个文本分类数据集，分析模型在这些数据集上的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现，可一定程度上预测大型语言模型的表现，并且内部对数概率比模型自信度表达更具预测性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论表明，内部对数概率是预测大型语言模型表现的最佳信号，支持使用这一信号进行模型表现预测。

title: Cortex: A Fixed-Point Theory of Governed Coding Agents - Technical Report
summary: A coding agent combines a large language model (LLM) with a harness that plans, edits, and executes code. We study Cortex, a supervisory layer for pre-execution governance, requirement tracking, and iterative validation and repair. We formalize requirement closure on a finite lattice. For a fixed requirement set and a sound, monotone validation rule with persistent evidence, exhaustive iteration reaches the least fixed point with no more strict increases than there are requirements. Fair consequence scheduling reaches the same closure. A separate stochastic model bounds expected completion time under a uniform positive-progress assumption. These results depend on their stated assumptions; artifact repair, fallible validation, and finite execution budgets do not satisfy them automatically. We define Gauntlet's trajectory-similarity and build-gated scores, attack-success estimators, Wilson intervals, and case-cluster bootstrap summaries. Effective-feedback accounting counts newly certified requirements, rather than estimating their information value or utility. The five evaluation families support raw-versus-governed comparisons. We report retained benchmark observations, including rescoring of existing artifacts; constructed outcomes are excluded. Unequal observation sets and incomplete provenance prevent causal claims about governance or measured long-horizon scaling.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了一个用于代码规划、编辑和执行的编码代理Cortex，并探讨了监督层的治理、需求跟踪和迭代验证与修复。通过建立形式化的需求闭包，证明了在特定条件下，迭代验证能够达到最小固定点。此外，研究还定义了一系列用于评估和反馈计价的指标。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在通过引入Cortex监督层来提升代码治理效率，包括预先执行的管理、需求跟踪及迭代验证与修复，通过形式化方法确保系统行为符合预期。
AI.method: 研究通过设定一个包含固定需求集和单调验证规则的模型，证明了无限迭代可以达到需求闭包。同时，定义了一系列评估和反馈计价指标，并通过基准测试观察进行了实证研究。
AI.result: 研究成果包括证明了监督层能够有效治理代码执行中的需求闭包问题；定义了用于评估和反馈计价的指标，支持了原始与受治理方的比较。基准测试结果表明了使用监督层前后的观察差异。但这些结论依赖于特定假设，实际应用场景可能存在挑战。
AI.conclusion: 本文为代码治理和验证提供了理论基础和实践指导，尤其是在提升系统行为的可控性和可靠性方面具有重要意义，但实际应用中仍需考量各种限制条件。

title: SPIRIT: Sparse Physics-Informed Inverse Rendering for SAR Imaging
summary: Radio-frequency (RF) and wave-based imaging systems play a critical role in sensing under adverse conditions, but are fundamentally constrained by a trade-off between collection speed and spatial resolution. Reducing measurements to enable rapid collection of fragment geometric information across sensing dimensions, leading to highly non-injective inverse problems that destabilize conventional image-domain reconstruction and super-resolution methods. Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) exemplifies this challenge in sparse-aperture sampling. We introduce SPIRIT, a physics-informed inverse rendering framework for sparse-aperture SAR. Rather than enhancing formed images, SPIRIT reconstructs an explicit three-dimensional surface. By adopting an optimization strategy and explicitly modeling visibility, phase coherence, and wave propagation, SPIRIT aggregates distributed geometric features across sparse aperture views into a coherent reconstruction. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world data demonstrate that SPIRIT recovers accurate geometry and signal under extreme sparsity, reducing data collection by over 90% while achieving low geometric and signal error and consistently outperforming baselines.

AI.tldr: SPIRIT 是一种为稀疏孔径 SAR 设计的物理知情逆渲染框架，它能从少量数据中恢复准确的几何形状和信号，相较于基线方法表现更优。
AI.motivation: RF 和波基成像系统在恶劣条件下至关重要，但受到收集速度与空间分辨率的权衡限制。SPIRIT 旨在解决稀疏孔径采样的 SAR 成像问题，通过物理推理直接重建三维表面，解决逆问题的非注入性，以实现快速而不损失重要信息的数据采集。
AI.method: SPIRIT 采用优化策略，并显式建模可见性、相位相干性和波传播，使分布的几何特征能够汇聚成为一个协同重构。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据的广泛实验中，SPIRIT 能在极低数据采集量下高精度地恢复几何和信号，且在几何和信号误差方面表现优异，优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SPIRIT 为稀疏孔径 SAR 高效而准确地提供了几何重构和信号恢复，为成像技术在受限环境下的应用开辟了新途径。

title: SLA-LENS: From Classroom Transcripts to CSLA-Informed and Evidence-Linked L2 Interaction Analytics
summary: What happens after a learner makes an error, and how does the instructor's response shape the next turn? Investigating these exchanges across classrooms requires context-sensitive annotation that is difficult to scale manually. We introduce SLA-LENS, an end-to-end LLM-assisted framework that connects classroom transcripts to structured pedagogical annotations and evidence-linked descriptive analytics. Grounded in interactionist Second Language Acquisition (SLA) theory, its annotation schema captures second language learner errors, pedagogical functions, and uptake or repair while accounting for speaker roles, conversational context, and hierarchical labels. We apply the framework to 40 authentic online L2 Spanish classroom transcripts comprising over 21,000 sentence-level instances. We evaluate proprietary and open-weight LLMs, including task-specific QLoRA adaptation, using expert-reviewed gold annotations, held-out silver data, and metrics sensitive to different types of annotation error. A deterministic reporting layer generates reproducible visualizations of participation, feedback, learner errors, uptake, and temporal interaction patterns, linked to supporting transcript evidence. By making these patterns accessible and inspectable, SLA-LENS supports systematic classroom discourse research, pedagogical reflection, and curriculum design.

AI.tldr: SLA-LENS 是一个利用大规模语言模型（LLM）辅助构建的端到端框架，用于将课堂转录内容与结构化的教学注释和证据链接的描述性分析相结合。该框架涵盖了交互式第二语言习得理论下的标注方案，并应用于40个真实的在线西班牙语第二语言课堂转录，生成详细的时间互动模式分析。
AI.motivation: 针对第二语言课堂中的错误后学习者和教师之间的互动研究，传统的手动标注无法应对大规模数据，因此需要一种自动化的标注框架。
AI.method: SLA-LENS 采用了基于第二语言习得交互主义的标注方案，利用 LLM 对课堂转录进行自动标注和分析，并通过确定性报告层生成可复现的时间互动模式可视化。
AI.result: SLA-LENS 框架成功应用于 40 个有效的在线第二语言课堂转录，覆盖超过 21,000 个句子级实例。该框架利用专家审核的金标准标注、保留的数据以及针对不同标注类型错误的敏感度指标，评估了多个模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: SLA-LENS 支持系统性的课堂语言研究、教学反思和课程设计，通过可视化和可追溯的证据提供深入的理解。

title: AM-Bench: A Unified Taxonomy and Evaluation Suite for Agentic Misalignment
summary: As LLM-based agents are deployed with increasing autonomy in real-world environments, a critical failure mode emerges: agentic misalignment, where agents choose harmful actions over failure. However, existing safety benchmarks primarily evaluate whether agents comply with explicitly harmful instructions, leaving the conditions that cause agents to choose harmful actions poorly understood. To address this limitation, we propose AM-Bench, a unified taxonomy and 35 scenario evaluation benchmark spanning seven industries for agentic misalignment grounded in the fraud triangle, a well-established criminological framework explaining goal-directed misconduct. We adapt this framework to agentic environments and construct our evaluation suite and detection systems along three dimensions: perceived threat, perceived opportunity, and reasoning. We operationalize each dimension into structured subcategories rooted in prior theory: five threat categories derived from the instrumental convergence thesis, seven opportunity categories drawn from the Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks (ESRR) taxonomy, and a novel four-question binary reasoning framework synthesized from prior literature. Our evaluation of 10 frontier models reveals a 62-percentage-point gap in misalignment across scenarios, with Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro exhibiting the highest levels of agentic misalignment while Claude Sonnet 4.6 displays near-zero rates across all conditions. Our reasoning framework further reveals that models may exhibit harmful behaviours without explicit situational awareness or explanation, complicating both mitigation and detection. AM-Bench scenarios and code are available at https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了AM-Bench，一种针对LLM代理在现实环境中的行为偏差的评估基准，涵盖七个行业的35个场景，并基于犯罪三角理论，评估了10款前沿模型在不同场景中的行为偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全基准主要关注代理是否遵循有害指令，但未能充分理解导致代理选择有害行为的条件。因此，研究提出AM-Bench，基于犯罪三角理论，探索代理在给定条件下选择有害行为的因素。
AI.method: AM-Bench以犯罪三角理论为基础，从感知威胁、感知机会和推理三个维度构建了评估框架，包括五个威胁类别、七个机会类别和一种新型的四问题二元推理框架。通过应用该框架评估了10款模型在35个场景中的表现。
AI.result: 研究表明，10款模型在不同场景下的行为偏差有显著差异，Gemini 3 Flash和Gemini 3.1 Pro表现出最高水平的行为偏差，而Claude Sonnet 4.6在所有条件下几乎未表现出有害行为。此外，研究还揭示出，模型可能在缺乏明确情境意识或解释的情况下表现出有害行为。
AI.conclusion: AM-Bench为研究代理在现实世界环境中的行为偏差提供了统一的评价标准，强调感知威胁、感知机会以及推理对于理解代理行为偏差的重要性，并揭示了一些现实挑战。

title: Your Self-Supervised Projection Head Captures Object Co-Occurrence Statistics
summary: Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) has achieved impressive success in learning semantic visual representations, yet the underlying principles driving this success remain underexplored. In this work, we hypothesize that common SSL pretext tasks implicitly model object co-occurrence statistics, a fundamental cue for visual learning. To test this, we curate three datasets of segmented objects from existing vision benchmarks using a state-of-the-art segmentation model. Through experiments across many SSL models, we reveal a hierarchical encoding of semantic information: while the visual backbone captures object categories, the projection head specializes in encoding co-occurrences between object categories. As a result, the projection head outperforms the backbone in aligning with human judgments of inter-category similarity. Furthermore, by controlling co-occurrence patterns during pre-training, we demonstrate that encoding object co-occurrences can significantly accelerate the emergence of category-level representations. Our findings uncover a previously hidden learning principle in SSL and suggest a path toward designing more effective pretext tasks by explicitly leveraging object co-occurrence structure.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过实验验证了SSL预训练任务隐式模型对象共现统计信息的假设，并表明可以通过控制预训练中的共现模式来促进类别级别表示的形成。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在探索驱动SSL成功背后的基本原理，特别是验证SSL预训练任务是否隐式建模了对象共现统计，以及如何通过控制共现模式加速类别级别的表示形成。
AI.method: 通过使用先进分割模型从现有视觉基准中创建三个分割对象的数据集，并在多种SSL模型上进行实验，论文揭示了层次化的语义信息编码：视觉骨干捕获对象类别，而投影头则专门编码类别间的共现。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，投影头在与人类判断的类别相似度对齐方面表现优于视觉骨干，进一步控制预训练中的共现模式可以显著加速类别级表示的形成。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了一个隐藏的SSL学习原理，指出通过明确利用对象共现结构设计更有效的预训练任务路径，这有助于设计更有效的预训练任务。

title: Best of Both Worlds: Fine-Tuned Small Models Complement LLMs for Cost and Performance Benefits
comment: Work done in 2024, added for posterity
summary: BERT-based models require thousands of labeled samples to train. Larger models like GPT-X require only 1-5 examples per class. However, performance, cost and time tradeoffs of such models remain under-explored. In this work, we classify survey text data into 16 classes. We focus on experimental approaches and results on performance, cost, and time taken for this problem. We compare these parameters of a trained RoBERTa-based model, and an (off-the-shelf) GPT-3.5 model for text classification. Baseline experiments show that the time taken by GPT-3.5 for generating predictions on 10,000 records is 6 hours, whereas a RoBERTa-based model takes only 12 mins on a T4 GPU. To identify the best prompting approach for GPT-3.5, we explore batch prompting. We experiment with (1) batch-size, and (2) few-shot sampling. We find the best batch size is 20 with human few-shot curation. Experiments show the F1 score of a trained RoBERTa-based model (96%) is much higher than a GPT-3.5 model (83%). In case of GPT-3.5, batch prompting is beneficial in lowering inference costs by ~70%, without hindering task performance. We find the best approach is an ensemble of a RoBERTa-based and GPT-3.5 model (F1: 97.5%) incurring only 4.4% of inference cost compared to a standalone GPT-3.5.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了RoBERTa模型和GPT-3.5模型在文本分类中的性能、成本和时间消耗，发现结合两种模型可以显著提高性能并降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 为了解决BERT及其更大模型需要大量标记数据的问题，研究者希望通过实验探索RoBERTa和GPT-3.5在性能、成本和时间方面的权衡。
AI.method: 研究者将调查文本数据分为16个类别，并对比了RoBERTa模型和GPT-3.5模型在文本分类任务中的表现。同时，研究了针对GPT-3.5的最佳提示策略。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，RoBERTa模型在10,000条记录上生成预测所需时间仅为GPT-3.5的20%，且RoBERTa模型的F1分数为96%，而GPT-3.5为83%。GPT-3.5通过批量提示可以将推理成本降低约70%，且不影响任务性能。最终，通过结合RoBERTa和GPT-3.5模型的集成方法，在仅产生GPT-3.5 4.4%推理成本的情况下实现了97.5%的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出，相比于单一模型，结合RoBERTa和GPT-3.5模型的集成方法可以有效优化性能与成本。

title: Can Compact Open-Weight Large Language Models Recover Mobility Events from Incomplete Trajectories? A Controlled Evaluation Using Air Trips
summary: Incomplete mobility trajectories can obscure the observations needed to identify important travel events and their endpoints. This study evaluates whether compact, locally deployed large language models (LLMs) can recover missing mobility information from incomplete trajectories, using high-confidence air trips as a controlled test case, and whether more explicit prompts can compensate for the loss of endpoint evidence. Using nationwide location-based services (LBS) data from the United States in January 2022 and airport reference data, thirty high-confidence air trips were converted into three incomplete-trajectory conditions by removing observations near the origin airport, the destination airport, or both. Four prompt variants and two LLMs generated 720 requests, each using a two-stage procedure to identify the flight transition segment and then select the origin and destination airports. Exact transition accuracy is 9.2%, while origin and destination accuracy are 31.4% and 10.7%, respectively. Only 1.9% of requests recover both the rule-identified transition and the reference airport pair. The most explicit prompt produced the highest observed exact transition and exact airport-pair recovery rates. The study introduces a controlled endpoint-removal framework for evaluating recovery of discrete mobility events from incomplete trajectories, allowing failures to be examined by inference stage and helping analysts decide whether recovered information should be retained, independently verified, or left unresolved.

AI.tldr: 此研究评估了使用紧凑型本地部署的大语言模型从不完整轨迹中恢复缺失的移动信息的能力，使用高置信度航空旅行作为测试案例。结果显示，最显式的提示可以提高恢复准确率。
AI.motivation: 评估大语言模型在从不完整旅行轨迹中恢复信息时的能力，尤其是在识别旅行链路及其端点方面的表现。
AI.method: 研究使用美国2022年1月的全国基于位置的服务数据和机场参考数据，模拟了三种不完整的轨迹类型，并通过定制的提示和两个不同的大语言模型生成请求。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，准确的链路识别率为9.2%，起始与终点机场的识别率分别为31.4%和10.7%。最显式的提示在准确链路识别和准确恢复参考点对方面表现出更高的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了一种新的视角来评估从不完整轨迹中恢复离散移动事件的能力，强调了提示设计在提高恢复准确性方面的重要性，建议分析人员对于恢复的信息进行独立验证或不予采用。

title: Cross-Modal Forgetting and Transfer in Unified Multimodal Post-Training
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents
summary: Unified multimodal models answer questions about images and also generate images with one shared set of weights. This creates a post-training risk that single-purpose models do not have: fine-tuning one capability can damage another that works in a different modality. We measure this cross-modal forgetting for LoRA post-training of Janus-Pro-7B. Every target is chosen by how poorly the base model already handles it, from a poetic register to a language it barely speaks, so that retention is tested against a real intervention; we then evaluate the capabilities we never trained, first after a single run and then after chaining three. A single run looks entirely safe: nothing we did not train degrades on four public benchmarks or in free-form English, even when the adapter cuts held-out Welsh perplexity by 76% with a relative weight change under 2%. That safety belongs to the run, not to the recipe. Chaining three runs destroys the capability learned one run earlier and raises general-text perplexity by one to two orders of magnitude above the never-adapted model, on the very measures that stayed flat before. The cause is in the objective, which constrains only the modality being trained and leaves the other head unconstrained: cutting the learning rate to one fifth does not prevent the collapse, while anchoring the other head removes the damage to the capabilities we never trained, at no cost to what is learned. What is learned also stays inside its own modality, with Welsh acquired from text closing only 3% of the English-Welsh gap in image generation.

AI.tldr: 研究在LoRA微调Janus-Pro-7B后，跨模态记忆的稳定性。单次微调看起来是安全的，但在连续三次微调后，之前学到的能力被破坏，而未训练的能力也受到影响，表明模型目标对其他未训练模态的影响。
AI.motivation: 探索统一多模态模型在单一能力微调后对其他未训练模态的影响，以解决单用途模型所不具备的跨模态记忆遗忘风险。
AI.method: 使用LoRA在Janus-Pro-7B上进行单次和连续三次微调，通过公共基准和自由形式英语测试能力的保留情况，并分析微调的目标对其他未训练模态的影响。
AI.result: 单次微调后，未训练的能力没有退化，但在连续三次微调后，之前学到的能力被破坏，而未训练的能力也受到了影响，即使在文本到图像生成中，仅学习了一种语言，模型仍能保持较低的困惑度。
AI.conclusion: 单次微调是安全的，但连续多次微调会破坏未训练的能力，并且这是由于模型优化目标导致的，只有约束当前训练的模态而未约束其他模态，通过调整学习率或固定其他头可以防止这种现象。

title: Modeling bilingual naming performance through laterally-connected SOMs
summary: Computational models have explanatory power to understand cognition in individuals, but there is usually not enough training data to build such models with traditional machine learning. However, alternative architectures that model neural and cognitive processes in more detail can be more easily fit to individuals and can lead to mechanistic insights into human behavior. BiLex is such a computational model of the bilingual lexicon, containing a shared semantic system and phonetic language systems represented through self-organizing maps. In this study, BiLex was extended further into biological realism with excitatory and inhibitory lateral connections. This extension makes it possible to account for response times as well as common errors such as those based on semantic concept familiarity, typicality, and specificity. The Boston Naming Test was simulated in Spanish and English, and model performance approximated naming accuracy and error types in Spanish-English bilinguals with varying primary and secondary language histories. The results indicated that the approach captures semantic-level processes in bilingual lexical access, thus modeling the semantic cognition of individual subjects. In the future, such models may serve as a foundation for modeling impairments and treatment options.

AI.tldr: 该研究扩展了一个计算模型BiLex，使其能够更好地模拟双语者的行为，包括反应时间和常见的错误类型，并通过模拟波士顿命名测试验证了该模型在解释个体双语加工过程中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统的机器学习方法通常因为缺乏训练数据而难以构建解释个体认知过程的模型。而BiLex通过更详细的神经和认知过程建模，为理解人类行为提供了机制性的洞见。这在处理双语者语言加工时尤为重要，因为它需要解释双语者在不同语言背景下的表现。
AI.method: 研究者使用自组织映射技术构建了BiLex模型，并进一步延伸了其生物现实性，引入了兴奋性和抑制性侧向链接。通过模拟波士顿命名测试，研究者评估了模型在西班牙语和英语中的表现。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，该模型能够捕获双语词汇检索过程中的语义层级过程，近似地模拟了不同主次语言历史的双语者的命名准确率和错误类型。模型表现与真实的双语者测试数据非常接近。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为理解双语者的认知过程提供了新的视角，并为进一步研究双语者语言加工障碍及其治疗方法打下了基础。

title: From SEC Filings to Financial Signals: Evaluating LLMs on Stock Market Reactions and Analyst Forecasts
summary: Form 10-Q MD&A sections combine long-form management narrative with accounting and forward-looking information. Benchmarks for financial filings commonly evaluate question answering or numerical reasoning, leaving unclear whether outputs from large language models (LLMs) align with market and analyst outcomes. We evaluate prompted, zero-shot outputs from 13 general-purpose and finance-specialized LLMs on 45,964 Form 10-Q filing events from 2001 to 2024, linking MD&A text to cross-sectional fundamental ranks, pre-filing analyst forecasts, and realized abnormal returns. The evaluation covers return ranking under five controlled information views and next-quarter EPS forecasting under direct and consensus-anchored interfaces. Relative to disclosure alone, adding cross-sectional fundamental ranks raises mean effective-date rank correlation (RankIC) by 0.0089 for effective-event-date returns and 0.0098 for following-day returns, whereas analyst-summary context provides no comparable average gain. Across the four disclosure-containing views, finance-specialized models show an effective-event-date group advantage but no statistically reliable following-day advantage, while general-purpose Qwen models produce the strongest individual return-ranking results. Under the full-information view, direct LLM forecasts average the 43.4th percentile of the analyst distribution and do not consistently beat individual analysts. Consensus anchoring raises the mean inside-range share from 41.1% to 59.5% but increases reported-EPS error.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了13个通用和金融专用的大语言模型在解释10-Q文件中MD&A部分的能力，研究发现模型得分与市场和分析师表现有部分相关，但差异不大。
AI.motivation: 当前评价财务文件的标准主要关注问答和数值推理，无法明确说明大语言模型输出与市场和分析师表现的一致性。因此，研究旨在通过评估大语言模型在10-Q文件MD&A部分的表现，探索其输出与市场和分析师预测的一致性。
AI.method: 研究团队评估了13个通用和金融专用语言模型在1999年至2023年间45,964个10-Q文件事件上的表现，涉及跨截面基本面评级、事前分析师预测和实现异常回报。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，与披露单独相比，结合跨截面基本面评级提高了有效事件日期回报和次日回报的相关性；金融专业模型在有效事件日期组中表现出优势，尽管一般用途Qwen模型在单个回报排名方面表现出最强的结果。在完整信息视图下，直接模型预测与分析师表现出色度不一致。共识锚定提高了报告EPS误差。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为阐明大语言模型在财报季报解析中的能力提供了有价值的信息，但模型表现尚不稳定，有待进一步优化。

title: Vocabulary-Incomplete Unsupervised Vision-Language Model Adaptation
summary: In certain real-world scenarios, obtaining labeled data is excessively expensive, motivating increasing interest in adapting models without annotations. Vision-language models (VLMs) provide pseudo-labels for unlabeled images through image-text similarity, enabling adaptation without manual labeling. The previous unsupervised vision-language model adaption methods assume access to an adaptation vocabulary containing all class names. However, a complete vocabulary is difficult to construct in real-world scenarios, as unlabeled data may contain classes that are overlooked or fall outside the current task scope. Thus, we propose Vocabulary-Incomplete Unsupervised Vision-language model Adaptation (VI-UVA), where only a subset of class names are available during adaptation.
