The vocabulary incompleteness induces an adaptation bias toward provided classes, which degrades omitted-class recognition. To address this issue, we propose Label Space Reconstruction (LSR), which reconstructs a latent label space from the unlabeled data and incorporates it into prompt tuning, thereby extending adaptation beyond the incomplete vocabulary and mitigating the adaptation bias. Furthermore, we derive an omitted-class semantic discrepancy bound for LSR and identify the key factors affecting the bound. Extensive experiments across eight benchmarks demonstrate that LSR outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的方法VI-UVA，该方法适用于词汇不完整的无监督视觉-语言模型适应问题。通过标签空间重构（LSR），该方法能够在不完整词汇表的情况下对模型进行适应，并减少识别未见过的类别的偏差。
AI.motivation: 在现实场景中，获取带标注的数据成本过高，因此需要开发无需人工标注的数据集的模型适应方法。现有的无监督方法假定词汇表是完整的，但在实际应用中，由于数据中存在未识别的类别，词汇表往往不完整。这会影响未见过类别（omitted classes）的识别。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为VI-UVA的方法，该方法利用标签空间重构（LSR）从未标注数据中重建潜标签空间，并将其纳入提示调优过程中。这种改进能够扩展适应范围，超越不完整的词汇表，并减少类别识别偏差。
AI.result: 在八个基准测试上进行了大量实验证明，通过LSR的VI-UVA方法相比现有最先进的方法显示出更好的性能。
AI.conclusion: 文章提出VI-UVA方法并结合LSR技术成功地将视觉-语言模型的适应扩展到了词汇不完整的情况，提升了模型对未见过类别的识别能力。

title: BanglaShield: A Script-Robust Safety Classifier and Benchmark for Bangla Native, Romanized, and Code-Mixed Prompts
summary: Safety classifiers for large language models (LLMs) are typically built and evaluated on standard-script text, yet Bangla, like many lower-resource languages, is routinely written in native script, in Latin-script romanization, and code-mixed with English, Hindi, or Urdu. We introduce BanglaShield, a resource and model for graded prompt-safety classification across these written forms. We consolidate 10,245 Bangla prompts from six sources under a four-level taxonomy (Safe, Offensive, Harmful, Severe) and render each prompt in three aligned forms that share labels and a group-aware split, enabling strictly paired comparisons. Benchmarking six contemporary LLMs, including a Bangla-specialized one, on 36,882 classification queries and 24,318 judged responses, we find that LLM classifiers label 47.0% of unsafe native-script prompts as Safe, rising to 63.4% under romanization, while response-level safety accuracy drops by 10.3 points. Three multilingual guard models also pass 30.3-57.3% of unsafe native-script prompts. Using a model's own classification as an input filter reduces harmful compliance by only about five points. In contrast, BanglaShield, a compact fine-tuned encoder, reaches 87.8 macro-F1 on native-script and 84.4 on romanized prompts, outperforming the best LLM on each form by 42.8-46.1 points with ~130x fewer parameters than Gemma 4 31B. We release the corpus, splits, judgments, and model.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了BanglaShield资源和模型，针对孟加拉语的不同书写形式进行分级提示安全性分类，展示了其在六种当代大语言模型中的优越性能。
AI.motivation: 鉴于大型语言模型（LLMs）的安全分类器通常基于标准字体文本构建和评估，而孟加拉语作为低资源语言，具有本土字体、拉丁字体罗马化和英语、孟加拉语、乌尔都语混合的特点，因此需要针对性的研究。
AI.method: 研究人员收集并分类整理了10,245个孟加拉语提示，分为四大类，并将每个提示转化为三种形式，同时维持标签和分组一致性。在36,882分类查询和24,318判断响应的基础上，评估了六种现代LLM的性能。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，原始字体不安全的提示有47.0%被错误标签为安全，拉丁字体罗马化的提示这一比例上升至63.4%，响应级别的安全准确性下降了10.3个百分点。多语言守护模型在此期间的表现也参差不齐。
AI.conclusion: BanglaShield在各种因素下的表现均优于其他模型，其精确率比最佳的LLM高42.8-46.1个百分点，且参数量远少于Gemma 4 31B。研究团队还发布了该数据集、划分、判断和模型。

title: SteerSearch: Interactive Search Reasoning with Mid-Response Steering
summary: Search-augmented language models increasingly serve as long-horizon research agents, yet most open training methods assume a fixed user goal throughout search. We study mid-response steering, where users redirect a model during ongoing reasoning or retrieval. We identify answer-target anchoring, a failure mode in which fixed-query search agents retrieve evidence for the updated request but still answer an earlier question. We introduce SteerSearch, an RL framework that trains on interactive search trajectories with injected interventions to enable context-preserving target reassignment, and SteerSearch-Bench, a benchmark adapted from multi-hop QA datasets. We also investigate Contrastive Context Reward (CCR), an auxiliary signal for aligning post-intervention reasoning with the updated goal. Without CCR, SteerSearch improves average steering accuracy over Search-R1 from 11.1% to 31.3% on Qwen2.5-3B and from 36.6% to 44.6% on Qwen3-4B, while preserving standard single-query performance. Gains also extend to larger Qwen2.5 models and natural multi-turn conversations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了搜索增强语言模型在推理或检索过程中用户中途更改目标的情况，开发了SteerSearch框架来训练在交互式搜索路径中包含干预，以实现上下文保持的目标重新指派，并引入了SteerSearch-Bench基准，该基准来自多跳问答数据集。此外，还研究了对比性上下文奖励（CCR）作为辅助信号，以使干预后推理与更新的目标对齐。实验表明，SteerSearch在多个模型和场景下提高了调整准确性。
AI.motivation: 论文关注的是搜索增强语言模型在现实应用中，特别是在用户需求可能发生变化的情况下，如何更好地响应和调整模型输出。多数现有方法假设用户在整个搜索过程中目标不变，但实际环境中用户目标可能动态变化。论文旨在改进模型的灵活性和适应性。
AI.method: SteerSearch框架采用强化学习方法，在交互式搜索路径中引入干预点，使模型能够根据用户更新的目标调整其推理方向。此外，引入了一种新的奖励信号——对比性上下文奖励（CCR），用于确保干预后的推理与新的用户目标一致。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，在Qwen2.5-3B和Qwen3-4B模型上，SteerSearch在不使用CCR的情况下，调整准确率分别从11.1%和36.6%提高到31.3%和44.6%，同时保持了单查询性能。该方法还适用于更大规模的模型以及自然的多轮对话。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一个有效的解决方案，增强了语言模型处理用户中途更改任务目标的能力，并且在多个场景下验证了该方法的有效性。

title: SpinDoctor: Finding Innocuous Prompts for Biased Image Generation
summary: We introduce SpinDoctor, a method for discovering innocuous prompts for text-to-image models that result in images with a chosen target bias, while retaining the quality of the images and prompts. These prompts present a risk for user manipulation, in that a user who is given these seemingly unbiased prompts might be willing to use them and would receive biased images in return. Our method is flexible: it uses models in a black-box way only and the target image bias can easily be changed, and so our method can be applied with various motivations and in various scenarios. Our method shows some transferability between models-we saw the same bias emerge in 78.6% of cases-such that a victim who uses a prompt generated via our method using one model still likely receives a biased image from another model. In our experiments, a subset of which we corroborated with human evaluation, we were able to find an innocuous prompt that moved generated images in the direction of the desired bias in all but two of 304 experiments, with an average improvement of 34.8% and 33.5% on two open-source text-to-image models.

AI.tldr: SpinDoctor是一个方法，能够生成看似中立但实际上具有偏见的文本提示，用于引导文本转图像模型，保持图像质量的同时引入目标偏见。
AI.motivation: 我们引入了SpinDoctor，为了预防用户误用，由于用户可能认为这些提示是中立的，但实际上产生的图像会呈现偏见，这可能会导致不可预测的偏差。
AI.method: SpinDoctor通过使用黑盒模型方法来发现带有目标偏见的中立提示，灵活性高，可以轻松调整目标偏见，适用于多种情境。
AI.result: 实验表明，SpinDoctor能够在大多数情况下（78.6%）产生带有相同偏见的结果，并且在304个实验中有298个能够成功引导模型生成具有目标偏见的图像。此外，它在改进图像偏见方向上的平均提升为34.8%至33.5%。
AI.conclusion: 这种方法虽然可能增加用户误用的风险，但它展示了模型之间的某些转移性，并且在多种情境下具有广泛应用的可能性。

title: Beyond Clean Accuracy: The Practical Challenges and Benefits of Pixel-Based Language Models
summary: Pixel-based language models process rendered text without relying on a fixed subword vocabulary, offering a promising approach to noisy and multilingual inputs. However, their practical value depends on whether they can be reliably adapted to downstream tasks. To this end, we systematically examine this question through fine-tuning behavior, typographical robustness, and zero-shot crosslingual transfer. Under our tested settings, pixel-based models require longer training and broader labelled-data coverage than text-based models, while delayed learning and learning-rate-dependent failures make adaptation less reliable. Our analyses further suggest that task-relevant information is less readily accessible in pretrained pixel representations, placing greater demands on fine-tuning. Once successfully adapted, however, pixel-based models lose substantially less accuracy under typographical noise and achieve higher target-language accuracy than English-pretrained text-based counterparts on two crosslingual benchmarks, despite weaker clean English performance. Together, these findings reveal a central trade-off: replacing tokenization with rendering reduces sensitivity to corrupted and unfamiliar inputs, but shifts a central bottleneck to downstream adaptation.

AI.tldr: 像素基语言模型能够在无固定子词词汇表的情况下处理渲染文本，但其下游任务适用性依赖于能否可靠地进行微调。研究显示，这类模型需要更长的训练时间和更广的数据覆盖，学习率依赖问题会影响其适应性。尽管如此，它们在处理拼写错误方面表现较好，并且在跨语言测试中的目标语言准确性优于针对英文预训练的语言基模型。
AI.motivation: 研究像素基语言模型能否可靠适应下游任务，特别是在处理噪声和跨语言应用方面。
AI.method: 通过微调行为、字母排版稳健性和零样本跨语言迁移三个方面系统性地考察。
AI.result: 像素基模型需要更长时间的训练和更广泛的数据覆盖率，依赖学习率的失败模式使得其适应性可靠性较低。然而，在处理拼写错误方面表现较好，并且在跨语言测试中的目标语言准确性优于针对英文预训练的语言基模型。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现像素基模型在一定程度上减少对受损和不熟悉输入的敏感性，但也将主要瓶颈转移到下游适应过程。

title: Not Every User Says It All: Training Tool-Using Agents Beyond Ideal Simulated Users
summary: Tool-using agents are trained and evaluated almost exclusively with strong simulated users who state every detail clearly, yet real users are often weaker. We construct weak users by masking sentences of a simulated user's replies, holding the task and the user's knowledge fixed, and cross-evaluate agents trained with strong and weak users on tau2-bench and ToolWOZ. Weak users lower the success of every policy, and training with them does not help: no policy trained with weak users, through fixed masks, mixtures or a curriculum, serves weak users better than the strong-trained policy beyond run-to-run noise, and prompting the agent to ask more does not help either. We propose StaGPO (State-Grouped Policy Optimization): the agent writes what the task needs, what is missing and how it is being filled, and GRPO uses this state to compare turns of different rollouts that reach the same situation, assigning step-level credit. Within the standard recipe of a small SFT cold start followed by RL, StaGPO makes weak-user training useful: on ToolWOZ, the Qwen3.5-2B policy trained with weak users reaches 76.8% with weak users, the highest of any Qwen3.5-2B policy we trained, 4.8 points above GRPO and 2.8 above the strongest baseline; it is also 5.4 points above GRPO with strong users, and generalises to an unseen mask rate; trained with strong users instead, it serves weak users at least as well as GRPO trained with weak users. On tau2-bench it scores highest with weak users for both models, by a small margin for Qwen3.5-4B.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过构建弱用户并通过遮罩模拟用户回复来评估工具使用代理的性能，发现无论训练方法如何，都无法改善在弱用户上的表现。提出了一种名为StaGPO的新方法，可以在使用标准的小规模即时强化学习(SFT)冷启动后，通过RL策略改进弱用户的表现。该方法在ToolWOZ和tau2-bench上均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 研究发现当前使用的强模拟用户训练方法与实际用户表现不符，拟解决此问题。
AI.method: 研究者通过遮掩一个模拟用户的回复，创建了弱用户。评估了利用弱用户和强用户训练的不同策略，并提出了StaGPO（状态分组策略优化）来提升代理在弱用户表现。
AI.result: StaGPO使弱用户训练变得有用。即使使用强用户训练，StaGPO仍然优于GRPO，特别是在ToolWOZ数据集上。在tau2-bench上，两种模型都显示出StaGPO在弱用户上的得分最高。
AI.conclusion: StaGPO通过鼓励代理记录任务需求、缺失信息和填充过程，可以有用地利用训练数据。

title: Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Efficient Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Vision-Language Models(VLMs)have advanced Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) by enabling OCR-free, multi-vector representations. However, these models generate excessive tokens to preserve dense visual details, which severely limits retrieval scalability. Existing compression methods mitigate this overhead but rely on isolated heuristics that fail to balance token importance, semantic redundancy, and coverage capacity. We propose a visual token compression framework formulated as an Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) problem. Our approach unifies these three objectives into a single alternating optimization process. Furthermore, we theoretically show that minimizing the transport cost upper-bounds the MaxSim retrieval error, ensuring ranking stability. Extensive experiments on the ViDoRe V1 and V3 benchmarks demonstrate that our method preserves fine-grained document semantics and improves the efficiency-effectiveness trade-off over state-of-the-art base-lines. Code is available at https://github.com/shhhhhyy/Unbalanced-Optimal-Transport-for-EVDR.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于未平衡最优运输问题的视觉标记压缩框架，能够同时优化重要性、语义冗余和覆盖能力，从而提高视觉文档检索的效率和效果。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLMs）虽然提高了视觉文档检索（VDR）的性能，但生成过多的标记导致检索效率低下。现有压缩方法在这方面有所改善，但这些方法通常依赖孤立的启发式方法，不能很好地平衡标记的重要性、语义冗余和覆盖范围。
AI.method: 该框架将三个目标统一为一个交替优化过程，采用未平衡最优运输问题作为优化模型，从而实现视觉标记的有效压缩。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在保持文档细粒度语义的同时，相较于最先进的基线方法，在效率和效果之间提供了更好的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的方法通过压缩视觉标记，有效地提高了视觉文档检索的效率和效果，为该领域提供了新的解决方案。

title: What Matters for NVFP4 Training? A Comparative Study of Low-Precision Pretraining Recipes
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Resource-Adaptive Foundation Model Inference (AdaptFM), Seoul, South Korea
summary: Training large language models directly in 4-bit floating-point (FP) formats promises substantial improvements in throughput and energy efficiency. While some recipe design choices have been validated at scale, many promising approaches remain untested beyond small models and short token horizons, leaving open the question of which trends will hold. We present a systematic comparison of recent NVFP4 recipes at medium model scale, evaluating dense 8B and 30B-A3B MoE models trained for up to 1T tokens, with a focus on which ingredients are necessary for accuracy recovery. We propose a final recipe grounded in the principles behind established stable NVFP4 training at scale, incorporating state-of-the-art techniques such as unbiased gradient estimation with lower quantization error than stochastic rounding. To the best of our knowledge, this is the strongest FP4 training result demonstrated at this scale to date in loss gap to BF16. Through ablation studies, we find that: (i) each technique in the optimized recipe measurably improves loss trajectory, (ii) selective high-precision layers are necessary for recovering accuracy at scale, (iii) not all tensors in the backward pass benefit equally from de-biasing, leaving room to apply complementary error-reduction techniques to the remaining tensors.

AI.tldr: 该研究对近期的4位浮点(NVFP4)训练策略进行了系统比较，评估了8B和30B-A3B模型的训练效果，证明了优化策略可以在大模型中有效提升准确性和效率。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探索哪些策略和技术可以在大模型规模下仍然有效，以克服当前方法在这些模型上可能存在的局限。
AI.method: 该研究通过对不同NVFP4训练策略进行系统比较，评估了8B和30B-A3B模型的训练效果，特别关注哪些技术对于准确性的恢复是必要的。
AI.result: 研究发现了每种优化技术都显著改进了损失轨迹，部分精度层对于大规模模型的准确性恢复至关重要，并且在反向传播过程中并不是所有张量都同样受益于去偏。
AI.conclusion: 研究成果为4位浮点格式在大语言模型中的应用提供了新的策略，展示了比BF16损失差距更小的训练结果，从而增强了4位浮点格式的优势。

title: Who Speaks, Who Authorizes, Who Acts? Understanding Trust Boundaries in Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems exchange messages before acting through tools, but message delivery, signing authority, and tool-side enforcement are separate trust boundaries. We represent them as communication, authorization, and execution structures, and use the authority cut to characterize the smallest independently compromised signer coalition that can construct a policy-valid false-claim proof under stated assumptions. Controlled paired hidden-state studies reveal four distinctions. First, no fixed-message routing contrast across four models meets the prespecified large-effect criterion; when relays rewrite messages, executed false-state action rates vary by model and route configuration. Second, presented source-identity cues do not uniformly increase protected-action selection across three models. Third, on invalid-proof cases, Nemotron and Llama request protected actions in 52.1% and 54.2% of trials, respectively, yet a deterministic tool gate commits none: request-level and commitment-level safety readouts diverge. Finally, a separate single-model authorization check shows that a false claim with a policy-valid compromised-signer proof can pass the gate, since proof validity is not factual truth. These findings motivate evaluating delivered information, qualified authorization, model proposals, and committed actions separately.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过多代理架构中的消息传递、授权及执行结构，评估了信任边界的差异。研究发现了在消息路由、来源身份提示效果、无效证明请求和授权检查等方面的表现不同，提出了需要分别评估传递信息、资格授权、模型提议和承诺行动的必要性。
AI.motivation: 研究的动机是对多代理LLM系统中的信任边界进行详细的分析和测试，以理解它们之间的差异，并改进系统的安全性。
AI.method: 通过构建三种不同的模型进行控制配对隐状态研究，研究了固定消息路由、来源身份提示和无效证明请求的处理情况。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，没有一种固定的路由模型能够满足大效应标准；来源身份提示在三种模型中的效果不一致；在无效证明情况下，Nemotron和Llama分别请求保护措施52.1%和54.2%，但工具门却未进行任何承诺；虚假声称在拥有政策有效签名的证明时仍可以通过门检查。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，需要分别评估传递信息的准确性、授权的有效性、模型提案的有效性和承诺行动的真实性，以提高系统的安全性。

title: Trimodal Context-Aware Micro-Expression Recognition in Real-World Conversations: A Dataset and a Hierarchical Fusion Network
summary: Recognizing micro-expressions in real-world conversations is challenging, as these facial movements are brief and faint, and their interpretations are strongly dependent on the contextual circumstances of their occurrence. Most existing methods are de-contextualized, as they analyze isolated video clips while disregarding the semantic and acoustic cues in the surrounding dialogue that help explain the emergence of an expression. Decades of psychological studies have shown that social context exerts influences on facial behavior over two key dimensions: how an expression is interpreted and how strongly it is generated to begin with. However, existing micro-expression research rarely incorporates such contextual factors into its models. As an example, provocative utterances from an interlocutor may elicit suppressed negative affective reactions, which isolated silent clips are unable to account for. We propose TriCoME, a trimodal dataset consisting of visual, audio and text data sourced from real-world conversations. In this dataset, each micro-expression is paired with its concurrent utterance and preceding context. We further annotate the context based on conversational role to denote two categories: external stimuli from an interlocutor's utterance and internal background from the subject's own utterance. On this basis, we propose the Hierarchical Focusing Fusion Network (HFFNet), which aligns acoustic and semantic streams at fine granularity, compresses long dialogue sequences, modulates attention toward conversational roles via a context-type embedding, and routes each sample between visual-only and multimodal decisions based on visual confidence to prevent noisy context from degrading recognition performance.

AI.tldr: TriCoME是一个多模态数据集，包含视频、音频和文本数据，旨在通过引入对话场景中的上下文信息，提高微表情识别的准确性和鲁棒性。提出的HFFNet网络通过细粒度对齐声学和语义流、压缩长对话序列、根据上下文类型嵌入调整注意力，并基于视觉自信在仅视觉和多模态决策之间路由样本，以防止不相关信息降低识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有微表情识别方法通常不考虑对话的语境因素，导致在处理真实世界对话中的微表情时效果不佳。TriCoME数据集和HFFNet网络旨在改进这一点。
AI.method: HFFNet网络通过细粒度对齐声学和语义流、压缩长对话序列、根据上下文类型嵌入调整注意力，并基于视觉自信在仅视觉和多模态决策之间路由样本，以防止不相关信息降低识别性能。
AI.result: HFFNet网络在TriCoME数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效提高了微表情识别的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TriCoME数据集和HFFNet网络为微表情识别研究提供了一个新的基准和方法，强调了对话上下文信息的重要性。

title: FlashMap: Flow Map Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose a block of tokens that the target model verifies in one parallel pass. Autoregressive drafters generate this block one token at a time, whereas block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate it in one pass, making drafting faster. However, these diffusion drafters predict each token independently, ignoring dependencies between tokens in the block. We introduce FlashMap, a continuous flow drafter that conditions a flow map language model on the target model's hidden states and generates the whole block in one forward pass while capturing inter-token dependencies. On Qwen3-8B, FlashMap is faster than a matched DFlash baseline on every benchmark, with 7% higher average speedup and up to 6.1x lossless acceleration.

AI.tldr: FlashMap通过生成整个记忆块并捕捉令牌之间的依赖关系，可以在Qwen3-8B上比匹配的DFlash基准更快，平均加速7%，最高无损加速6.1倍。
AI.motivation: 现有的推测性解码加速大型语言模型推理，但由于其预测每个令牌独立地而非考虑令牌之间的依赖关系，导致效率低下。
AI.method: FlashMap采用连续流动的方法，根据目标模型的隐藏状态条件化流图语言模型，并在一次前向传递中生成整个候选块。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B上，FlashMap在所有基准测试中都比匹配的DFlash基准更快，平均加速7%，最高无损加速6.1倍。
AI.conclusion: FlashMap通过捕捉令牌之间的依赖关系，在牺牲少量无损性能的情况下显着提高了推理速度。

title: CME-SpectrumBench: Can LLMs Analyze Condensed Matter Spectral Data?
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are presently well assessed by expert-level mathematics and physics benchmarks which focus on theoretical, symbolic reasoning. However, we lack experimental benchmarks that evaluate data analysis in frontier research problems, a capability that future domain-specific foundation models must have. To this end, we present CME-SpectrumBench, an expert-designed benchmark consisting of 190 questions that measures how reliably frontier LLMs analyze research-level spectral scientific data in condensed matter experiments (CME). Using simulated CME spectral data, we prompt models to identify structures from 2D intensity arrays in the face of noise and limited instrumental resolution, a test of dense context reasoning. Models are scored by how accurately their numerical answers approach the ground truth. Under direct query, scores generally pale in comparison to handwritten code due to clear failure modes: models can find simple features but struggle to trace patterns or compute derived quantities, and performance typically degrades with increased data resolution and noise/convolution levels. LLM performance becomes comparable to handwritten code by allowing tool use (access to a Python interpreter) with/without ReAct prompting, in effect mapping questions onto agentic code generation problems. Our findings show that frontier models can serve as research assistants by interfacing with data through code, but still face difficulties processing information directly from large datasets - a key barrier future foundation models must overcome. The code and data are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jingene/CMESpectrumBench.

AI.tldr: CME-SpectrumBench 是一个用于评估大型语言模型在凝聚态实验中处理前沿光谱科学数据能力的基准，它发现模型在直接查询时表现不如手写代码，但在允许使用工具（如 Python 解释器）后，其表现可与手写代码相媲美。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏针对前沿研究问题的数据分析评估基准，而这是未来领域特定基础模型必需的能力。因此提出 CME-SpectrumBench，评估大型语言模型在处理凝聚态实验中的光谱科学数据分析能力。
AI.method: 该基准包括190个研究级别的问题，使用模拟的凝聚态实验光谱数据来评估模型识别2D强度数组中结构的能力，同时考虑噪声和有限仪器分辨率等因素，评估模型的准确度。
AI.result: 在直接查询时，模型的表现不如手写代码。它们能够在识别简单特征方面表现良好，但在追踪模式或计算衍生量方面有很大困难，且数据分辨率和噪声/卷积水平增加时，性能会下降。但在允许使用工具后，包括使用 Python 解释器和反应性提示，模型的性能可以与手写代码相媲美。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现，大型语言模型可以作为研究助手，通过代码与数据交互，但仍需克服从大数据集直接处理信息的困难，这是未来基础模型需要克服的关键障碍。

title: STLQ: Spatio-Topological Linkage Quantization for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
summary: Vector quantization is widely used for large-scale data compression and approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS). Multi-codebook quantization (MCQ) is a practical paradigm that represents database vectors with compact codes and supports efficient retrieval through asymmetric distance computation (ADC). However, existing shallow MCQs encode vectors independently within each inverted file (IVF) cluster, without exploiting local references. Therefore, we propose Spatio-Topological Linkage Quantization (STLQ), a topological shallow MCQ method that organizes each IVF cluster as a directed-forest with compact codes and scaling coefficients. Its basic encoding phase first quantizes vectors independently, while the linked encoding phase re-encodes relative residuals with respect to selected reconstructed parents, reusing local reconstruction information to obtain finer representations. The corresponding linked-ADC preserves linear scanning complexity. STLQ further compresses the scaling coefficients and directed-forest structure to control the additional topology overhead. Extensive experiments show that STLQ achieves higher recall than the evaluated shallow MCQs at comparable bit budgets, although at a higher offline construction cost. Meanwhile, it has a competitive recall-QPS tradeoff against deep MCQs. The code is available at https://github.com/ighxiy/STLQ.

AI.tldr: STLQ 提出了一种新的多码本量化方法，通过构建定向森林结构并利用局部重构信息，提高了召回率。
AI.motivation: 当前的多码本量化方法在成簇内部独立编码向量，未充分利用局部参考信息，STLQ 通过构建定向森林结构并重组相对余量，旨在提高召回率。
AI.method: STLQ 方法首先独立量化向量，然后通过重新编码相对余量与选定的重建父节点，利用局部重构信息获得更精细的表示，同时保持线性扫描复杂性。该方法进一步压缩了缩放系数和定向森林结构以控制额外的拓扑开销。
AI.result: 实验表明，STLQ 在相似比特预算下比现有浅层多码本量化方法具有更高的召回率，尽管构建成本较高，但在召回与查询每秒处理的点数之间具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: STLQ 提出了一种有效的多码本量化方法，能够高效地进行数据压缩和近似最近邻搜索。

title: Ask Less, Ask Better: Allocating User Attention in Proactive LLM Agents with Interruption Budgets
summary: LLM agents can ask clarifying questions to complete tasks, but answering each question demands users' time and effort. Existing evaluations typically measure this burden by counting questions, treating necessary and avoidable questions equally. We propose an evaluation protocol that distinguishes how often agents ask from how well they ask. An interruption budget limits the number of questions, while a user-attention cost charges extra for questions that are hard to read or not worth asking, as rated by a human-validated LLM judge. Beyond question counts, this cost captures perceived effort: on conversation pairs with the same number of questions, human annotators agreed with the cost on which conversation required more effort 75% of the time. Across eight LLMs and four customer-service domains, limiting agents to one to three questions reduces user-attention cost by 36-73% while keeping 86-94% of the task reward they earn with unlimited questions. At the same budget, reviewing each question against the memory of users' earlier answers cuts attention cost by another 13% with little reward loss and yields more valuable questions. Models also differ sharply in how well they ask: at the same user-attention cost, the most efficient models gain more than twice as much reward from their questions as the others. These results show that asking less and asking better are distinct goals, and that evaluations of proactive agents should measure both.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种评估LLM代理性能的新方法，通过设定讨论中断预算和用户注意力成本来区分代理提问的频率和质量，结果显示限制代理提问次数可以显著降低用户注意力成本，同时保持较高的任务奖励，不同模型在提问质量上存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 现有的评估方法在计算代理提问带来的负担时，通常简单地统计提问数量，没有区分必要的和不必要的提问。这促使研究者提出了一种新的评估框架，旨在衡量代理提问的频率和提问的质量。
AI.method: 该研究引入了一个包含中断预算和用户注意力成本的新评估协议，以评估代理提问的表现。同时，通过对比人类注释者与该成本的评价结果，以及不同LSTM代理的表现，在多个客户服务领域进行了实验。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，将代理提问限制在一到三个可以将用户注意力成本降低36-73%，同时保持86-94%的任务奖励。此外，当用户注意力成本相同的情况下，能有效提问的模型可以获取比其他模型多一倍以上的任务奖励。
AI.conclusion: 研究的结论是，提问的次数和提问的质量是不同的评估目标，代理的评估不应只关注提问的数量，还应关注提问的效果。

title: The Judge Can Debias Itself: Awareness and Self-Debiasing for Reliable LLM-as-a-Judge
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge systems are increasingly employed for automated evaluation, yet remain susceptible to systematic biases that undermine their reliability. We demonstrate that the judge can effectively debias itself without additional training. We propose two lightweight strategies: bias-aware prompting, which explicitly alerts the judge to potential target biases prior to evaluation, and self-debiasing, in which the judge critiques the initial judgment for bias influence. To broaden the evaluation scope, we introduce three novel benchmarks--authority bias (fabricated citations), confidence bias (assertive phrasing), and formatting bias (structured presentation)--and evaluate across seven bias types in total. Across three frontier models, self-debiasing improves performance in 20 out of 21 model-bias combinations with gains up to 15 percentage points, while bias-aware prompting also yields consistent improvements. The recent fine-tuned external critic, however, does not generalize as reliably to the newly-introduced bias types (degradation observed in 5 out of 9 cases). Our findings demonstrate that prompting a judge to reason about bias, either preemptively or retrospectively, is a robust and generalizable approach for enhancing evaluation integrity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级的自我去偏策略，通过在评估前添加提示和自我批判来减少系统性偏差，同时引入了三种新颖的基准测试以评估不同类型偏见的效果。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge系统在自动化评估中易受系统性偏见的影响，降低了其可靠性。文章旨在通过自我去偏策略提高评估的公正性和准确性。
AI.method: 作者提出了两种策略：偏见意识提示和自我去偏。偏见意识提示在评估前提醒法官注意潜在的目标偏见，自我去偏则是法官在初步判断后自我审视，检查是否存在偏见影响。此外，他们还引入了三种新的基准测试，以覆盖七种偏见类型。
AI.result: 两种策略在多个评估模型中均取得了一致的改进效果。特别是在三种前沿模型中，自我去偏策略在20种模型-偏见组合中提升了21%，最大提升幅度达到15个百分点。而近期微调的外部分析家则在对新引入的偏见类型中表现不稳定，有5个案例中观察到了性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，提示法官在评估前或评估后考虑偏见，是一种增强评估完整性并具有普遍适用性的方法。

title: Toward AI-Driven Phytoplankton Event Detection from Image Classification: Temporal Aggregation Under Domain Shift
summary: Imaging FlowCytobot (IFCB) systems generate large volumes of phytoplankton imagery that exceed the capacity of manual expert analysis. Although machine-learning approaches achieve high image-level classification performance, it remains unclear whether their predictions can provide ecologically meaningful temporal information for monitoring. This study investigates whether AI-derived phytoplankton classifications can reproduce temporal occurrence patterns and elevated-occurrence signals under realistic sampling and independent-domain transfer. A monitoring-oriented framework was developed using MedPlanktonSet and evaluated on an independent IFCB dataset from the Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute (SMHI). Eight biologically comparable taxa were selected as targets, while all remaining observations were retained as background to preserve the full image-stream denominator. Session-aware partitioning prevented temporal leakage, and alternative preprocessing strategies and convolutional neural network architectures were evaluated. Cross-domain experiments showed that preprocessing strongly affected generalisation. EfficientNet-B0 provided the strongest target-versus-background discrimination and was selected for temporal analysis. Despite residual image-level errors, AI-derived target-occurrence rates closely reproduced expert-derived signals after aggregation (mean absolute error = 0.0432, Pearson $r$ = 0.9696, Spearman $ρ$ = 0.9568). Agreement remained strong across multi-session windows, and elevated, strong, and persistent occurrence proxies were recovered in held-out testing. These results show that AI-based phytoplankton classification can support monitoring-relevant temporal indicators beyond image-level identification and support future operational early-warning development.

AI.tldr: AI方法在藻类分类中的应用能够生成与专家分析相似的生态学意义的时间信息，适用于监测和早期预警系统。
AI.motivation: 由于手动专家分析无法处理Imaging FlowCytobot (IFCB)系统产生的大量藻类图像数据，因此需开发基于AI的方法来提供具有生态学意义的时间信息以进行监测。
AI.method: 研究设计了一个监测导向的框架，使用MedPlanktonSet数据集进行模型训练，并在瑞典气象与水文研究所(IFCB)独立数据集上进行验证。评估了不同的预处理策略和卷积神经网络结构，并选择了EfficientNet-B0架构进行时间分析。
AI.result: EfficientNet-B0与背景图像的区分效果最明显，生成的AI目标出现率与专家分析的信号高度一致（平均绝对误差 = 0.0432，皮尔逊相关系数 r = 0.9696，斯皮尔曼相关系数 ρ = 0.9568）。即使存在图像级错误，这种一致性在多会话窗口中仍然保持，并且能够在保留测试中恢复出提升、强和持续出现的代理指标。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，基于AI的藻类分类可以生成在时间和生态学方面有意义的指标，超出单纯的图像级识别，同时支持未来的操作性早期预警系统的开发。

title: Toward a Universal Local Speech Feature Extractor Through Distillation
summary: Self-supervised speech models commonly consist of a set of convolutional neural network (CNN) layers used as a local feature extractor, followed by transformer layers. The CNN layers are computationally demanding, and are also similar across models and resemble the much simpler mel spectral features. We hypothesize that the CNN layers can be replaced by a simple, universal model. To test this hypothesis, we learn a two-layer feature extractor via distillation from one or more teacher models (HuBERT, data2vec, and WavLM). Experiments on SUPERB(-SG) benchmark tasks show that our model largely retains the performance of the teacher models and can also be used in an unseen model (wav2vec 2.0). Our feature extractor requires only 3% of the MACs of the CNNs, resulting in a $>$20% overall inference runtime reduction.

AI.tldr: 研究通过蒸馏方法将CNN层替换为两层特征提取器，保留了教师模型的性能，降低了20%以上的推理时间。
AI.motivation: 减少自监督语音模型中计算密集的CNN层，提高模型效率。
AI.method: 采用蒸馏方法学习由两层特征提取器组成的简易模型，使用了HuBERT、data2vec和WavLM作为教师模型。
AI.result: 新模型在SUPERB(-SG)基准任务上的性能接近教师模型，并在未见过的wav2vec 2.0模型中也适用，仅需原CNN层3%的MACs。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一个简易且高效的特征提取器，提升了模型的推理效率，同时保留了模型性能。

title: Continuous Ontology Assurance through External Resources -- An Ontology Engineering Method with a Case Study in Software Language Engineering
summary: Domain ontologies require review against knowledge recorded in evolving external resources. We propose COATER, a method that manages executable review components called arrows. Each arrow compares a scoped part of an ontology with a relevant resource and reports support or challenges to its axioms. Challenges may prompt proposals for completion, correction, or restructuring and become tasks for human or agent-assisted triage. Per-axiom coverage summarizes the assessments. We illustrate COATER with the FSL ontology in software language engineering (SLE): arrows review language coverage, language conceptualization, and software-engineering activities. An LLM-assisted linkage exercise increases compliance with a defined Wikipedia-linkage policy from 405 to 600 of 600 entities. A structured catalogue of SLE resources organizes review opportunities.

AI.tldr: COATER 方法通过箭头组件比较领域本体和外部资源，提出挑战并建议修改或重构，以增强本体的准确性和完整性。
AI.motivation: 随着知识的不断更新，领域本体需要定期审查以保持与最新知识的一致性。COATER 方法通过引入执行审查组件（箭头）来实现这一目标，确保本体能够准确反映最新的知识更新。
AI.method: COATER 方法中，每个箭头专注于比较本体的一个特定部分与相关资源，并报告支持或挑战其公理的情况。挑战可以触发修改或重构的建议，并为人工或代理辅助的优先级评估提供任务支持。每个公理的覆盖率总结了这些评估结果。
AI.result: 以软件语言工程（SLE）中的 FSL 本体为例展示了 COATER 方法。通过 LLM 辅助的链接练习，实现了本体与维基百科政策的完全合规，同时建立了一个结构化的 SLE 资源目录，提供审查机会。
AI.conclusion: COATER 方法提供了一种系统化的方式来审查和更新领域本体，提高了本体的质量和实用性。

title: VERDICT: Visual Extraction-Result Decoder with Integrated Confidence and Traceable Evidence
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Workshop on VLM4RWD
summary: Enterprises run schema-guided structured field extraction on documents with frontier multimodal models, and accuracy keeps improving as new models and systems arrive. Two things have not kept pace: the evidence for each extracted value, meaning the location of the document it was read from, and how far to trust the value and that evidence. Neither is a component of most extraction systems today, so we build them as a framework that attaches to an existing extractor and leaves it untouched. We present VERDICT, a plug-in framework that uses a small Vision--Language Model (VLM) to ground/localize the evidence once per document over a fixed external extractor's output, then calibrates value and evidence confidence. Fine-tuning the VLM for evidence localization substantially improves visual evidence quality and, more importantly, expands VERDICT's selective-prediction operating range. At a strict confidence threshold $0.80$, VERDICT with the fine-tuned VLM gives usable precision--coverage trade-offs for both value and evidence confidence across the in-distribution and out of distribution datasets, whereas the frozen setting often collapses to little or no coverage. Running an open-weight VLM for localization rather than a closed API makes its internal states available to the calibrator, and they are worth more than output log-probabilities: in-distribution AUROC rises from $0.730$ to $0.914$ for value confidence and from $0.681$ to $0.906$ for evidence confidence. This advantage does not survive a distribution shift. We show that the signal is displaced rather than destroyed, and that labeling roughly $120$ fields from the target dataset takes evidence confidence from $0.641$ to $0.905$ on one dataset and from $0.675$ to $0.829$ on the other.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了VERDICT框架，旨在改进提取结构化字段时的证据支持和信任度，通过细调Vision-Language模型来增强视觉证据的质量并扩展选择预测的操作范围。
AI.motivation: 当前的企业提取系统未能提供提取值及其证据的可靠证据位置和信任度，研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 研究者提出了一种插件框架VERDINCT，利用Vision-Language模型精调以定位和校准证据和证据置信度。通过调整模型的内部状态来获得更好的校准效果。
AI.result: 通过细调VLM，VERDICT在严格置信阈值0.80的情况下，能够为值和证据置信度提供适用的精确度-覆盖率折衷方案。当用于目标数据集的证据置信度从0.641提高到0.905，另一个数据集则从0.675提升到0.829。此外，由于信号未被破坏，该方法可以应用于新的数据分布。
AI.conclusion: 尽管VERDICT在原有的数据分布中表现出色，但它对分布变化的适应性较弱。

title: When Opposite Premises Translate Identically: A Source-Conditioned Diagnostic for Multilingual Commonsense Items
summary: Multilingual reasoning comparisons depend on translated premises preserving the relations in their English sources. Automatic translation scores can rank source-target pairs, but an acceptance decision alone cannot certify a counterfactual benchmark field. We test a source-contrast diagnostic for ACCORD premises: reverse the English polarity, translate both arms independently, count identical target outputs, and score each arm against its own source. Across 71 matched question identities at two containing-item depths, five target languages, and three translation checkpoints, Swahili has 63, 113, and 67 exact collisions among 710 pairs per checkpoint. At a human-reference-calibrated threshold, round-trip NLI passes both arms of 3 of the 113 NLLB-3.3B collisions, while LaBSE passes 78. Each collision proves at least one unfaithful translation, but does not identify its arm. These controlled measurements do not establish screening accuracy on spontaneous translation errors or a language-by-hop reasoning effect; the study has no native equivalence labels or answer-model evaluation.

AI.tldr: 研究通过使用源对比诊断方法测试多语言推理中翻译保真度，发现斯瓦希里语在不同翻译检查点下表现出较大差异，但未建立对自发翻译错误的筛选准确率或语言梯度推理效应。
AI.motivation: 为了确保多语言推理比较中翻译前提能够保留其英语来源的关系，研究者测试了一种源对比诊断方法，即通过反转英语极性、独立翻译两个环节的方法来验证翻译保真度。
AI.method: 研究者选择了71个匹配的问题身份，涉及两种包含项深度、五种目标语言和三个翻译检查点。将问题中的英语前提的极性反转，独立翻译两个环节，统计目标输出的完全吻合情况，并分别对每个环节的质量进行评估。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，斯瓦希里语在三个不同翻译检查点下分别有63, 113和67次完全吻合的情况，平均每轮次包含710对样本。经过人类参考校准的阈值，使用NLI来回翻译，分别有3个和78个样本通过各自原始环节的质量评估。
AI.conclusion: 这些控制测量并没有证明筛选方法对自发翻译错误的准确率，也无法确定不同语言在推理过程中的差异效应。该研究没有原生态等价标签或答案模型评估。

title: Screening LLM Judges Without Ground Truth: A Preliminary Evaluation of an AI Dental Hygiene Coach
summary: Evaluating a fine-tuned coaching model with expert graders is slow and expensive, and an LLM judge cannot be trusted without ground truth. We present a staged pipeline that screens candidate LLM judges and student models before expert review, using explicit decision rules at each stage: judge output audit, similarity with hosted judges, bias checks, and decision robustness. We demonstrate it on an AI dental hygiene coach. The case study uses synthetic, clinically unvalidated training and reference data to demonstrate the operation of the pipeline, rather than to establish the clinical performance of the resulting models. Two fine-tuned small language models (Granite-4.1-8B and Qwen3-8B), each trained at three data sizes, were scored on seven metrics by five judges (three local, two hosted). Two local judges, Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-31B-it, were not distinguishable from the agreement between the hosted judges on six of seven metrics by rank correlation, and Qwen3.8-27B was the most similar to the hosted judges overall. No judge met our criterion for favoring its own model family or training-data source. The student comparison did not separate the two models on any metric under the pipeline's rule, so the choice of Granite-4.1-8B, which led in 29 of 35 judge-by-metric cells, is a lean that depends partly on truncated Qwen3-8B outputs. The pipeline also surfaced problems that raw scores hid, including the truncated outputs and hallucination flags from one hosted judge that no other judge corroborated. No dental hygiene expert has graded these responses, so the findings are preliminary and the pipeline's final stage, anchoring to expert judgement, is proposed but not performed.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种分阶段的评估流程，用于筛选候选的LLM裁判和学生模型，并在网络训练数据未经临床验证的情况下，对AI牙科卫生教练进行了演示。研究结果显示，一些本地模型与托管模型在多个指标上没有显著差异，且评估流程揭示了一些隐藏的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的教练模型评估方法要么耗时昂贵，要么无法获取可信的评估结果。因此，本文提出了一个分阶段的评估流程，旨在高效、公正地评估AI牙科卫生教练模型。
AI.method: 通过使用明确的决策规则，该研究的设计了一个分阶段的评估流程，包括裁判输出审计、与托管裁判的相似性检查、偏见检查和决策稳健性。研究使用了合成且未经过临床验证的数据集，并对两个不同的小语言模型进行了评估。
AI.result: 该研究发现，两个本地模型在多项指标上与托管模型表现相近，其中一个本地模型整体上最接近托管模型。并且，评估流程揭示了一些隐藏的问题，如模型输出被截断和幻觉告警，这些问题在原始分数中没有显现出来。
AI.conclusion: 虽然研究没有最终进行由牙科卫生专家进行的评判，但评估流程有效揭示了模型的问题，并根据规则选择了表现更佳的模型。最终，该研究提出了一个分阶段的评估流程作为模型公平性评估的有效方法。

title: CrowdH-Edit: Reference-Guided Instruction-Based Synthetic Hajj Crowd Image Generation for Crowd Counting
summary: The scarcity of domain-specific annotated images remains a major limitation for developing computer-vision systems for Hajj crowd analysis. Existing crowd-counting datasets and unconstrained generative models do not capture Hajj-specific visual conditions, including sacred-site geometry, white-clothed pilgrim crowds, and indoor/outdoor illumination variation. This study presents CrowdH-Edit, a reference-guided, instruction-based framework for synthetic Hajj crowd-image generation. Real Hajj images provide structural references, while textual instructions guide changes in crowd conditions and illumination and help preserve the main scene layout. Stable Diffusion 2.1 and Stable Diffusion XL 1.0 with low-rank adaptation were evaluated as comparative baselines. Qwen Image Edit was used without additional training within a ComfyUI workflow and selected for final dataset construction. The workflow produced CrowdH-Edit, a cleaned pool of 6,122 synthetic images, from which 387 images were selected and annotated to construct CrowdH-Edit-Ann-387. Among the evaluated generation pipelines, Qwen Image Edit achieved the highest semantic-alignment score and the lowest distributional and perceptual distances. Downstream evaluation across five crowd-counting models showed that adding the annotated synthetic subset to real training data reduced mean absolute error for three models and root mean squared error for two. These findings indicate that reference-guided synthetic Hajj imagery can support crowd-counting training, although its benefits depend on the model and evaluation metric.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了CrowdH-Edit框架，利用参考指导和文本指令生成合成的朝圣人群图像，通过与现有生成模型的比较，Qwen Image Edit生成的图像在语义对齐和感知距离方面表现最佳，增强了朝圣人群计数模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 由于现有的人群计数数据集和生成模型无法准确捕捉朝圣的具体视觉条件，因此开发一个专门针对朝圣人群分析的计算机视觉系统面临挑战。
AI.method: CrowdH-Edit框架结合了真实朝圣图像作为结构参考，通过文本指令调整人群条件和光照效果，维持场景布局。评估了几种生成模型，选择了一种模型进行最终数据集构建。
AI.result: Qwen Image Edit在语义对齐和感知距离方面表现最好，将标注的合成子集添加到真实训练数据中，三个模型的均方误差和两个模型的均方根误差均有所降低。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，参考引导下的朝圣人群合成图像能够支持人群计数模型的训练，但其效果取决于模型和评估指标。

title: Which Long Documents Matter? A Controlled Study of Data Selection for Context Extension
summary: Natural long documents are widely used for context extension, but which selection pipelines are effective remains unclear. We conduct a controlled comparison on Qwen2.5-3B at 128K under matched 6B-token continued-training budgets. Random sampling of natural long documents (random-long) outperforms repacking at longer evaluation lengths. Within the same candidate pool, selecting documents with high LongPPL key-token density yields further gains, unlike the evaluated generic-quality and LLM-judge selectors. We introduce truncLongPPL to reduce scoring cost by computing key-token density over a truncated prefix. At 128K, scoring the first half of the reference span yields downstream performance close to full-span scoring with a measured $2.28\times$ end-to-end scoring speedup. Across three training seeds, truncLongPPL achieves the highest mean scores among evaluated pipelines, exceeding random-long by 4.54 points on validation HELMET and 3.28 on held-out RULER, with gains most consistent in retrieval. At a 256K target context, it gains 2.82 average RULER points over random-long on Qwen2.5-3B. In short/long mixed training across Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen3-8B, and OLMo~3-7B, it gains 1.47--7.31 average RULER points over random-long mixing, with seven-task short-context averages within 0.23 points of the corresponding baselines. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Qwen3-8B and OLMo~3-7B models trained with selected long documents outperform their random-long counterparts by 1.13--1.67 points on LongBench v2 and 0.62--1.44 points on MRCR.

AI.tldr: 研究通过Qwen2.5-3B模型在128K和256K长度下的评估，发现随机抽样长文档优于重新打包，并在高长PPL关键词密度中获得进一步收益。引入了truncLongPPL来计算关键词密度以降低评分成本。在128K时，仅评分参考段落前半部分即可接近全长评分的下游性能，且有2.28倍的端到端评分加速。truncLongPPL在三个训练种子下的评估管道中均获得了最高得分，优于随机长文档，在验证集和保留集上的成绩分别提高了4.54分和3.28分，特别是在检索任务中。在不同模型上的混合训练中，使用选择的长文档训练的模型在RULER任务上表现出更大优势。经过监督微调后，使用选定长文档训练的模型在LongBench v2和MRCR上相对于随机长文档也表现更优。
AI.motivation: 长文档在扩展上下文中的应用非常广泛，但有效的文档选择流程尚未明确。因此，本文旨在对比多种文档选择策略的效果，以寻找更有效的策略。
AI.method: 使用Qwen2.5-3B模型在128K和256K长度下进行控制实验，对比了随机抽样、重新打包、高长PPL关键词密度选择和普通质量及LLM评判选择器等方法，并引入了truncLongPPL方法来降低评分成本。
AI.result: 随机抽样长文档优于重新打包。高长PPL关键关键词密度的选择在相同候选文档池中获得进一步收益。引入了truncLongPPL方法，计算关键词密度并降低评分成本。在128K长度下，仅评价参考段落前半部分的性能接近全长评分的下游性能，并且具有2.28倍的端到端评分加速。truncLongPPL在三次训练种子下的评估中表现最佳，相对于随机抽取的长文档，在验证和保留集上的表现分别提高了4.54分和3.28分，特别是在检索任务中表现更佳。在各种模型混合训练中，truncLongPPL策略获得的RULER性能提升范围从1.47到7.31分，接近基准模型的七任务短语上下文平均误差在0.23分以内。经过监督微调后，使用选定长文档训练的模型在LongBench v2和MRCR上的表现优于随机选取长文档的模型。
AI.conclusion: truncLongPPL方法是一种有效的策略，能够显著提升基于Qwen2.5-3B模型文档选择任务的性能，特别是在检索任务中。通过这种方法，可以更快地对长文档进行评分，同时保持或提高模型的下游性能。

title: FlashRT-PAI: Fast Kernels Are Not Fast Pipelines for Physical AI Inference
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA), video-action (VA), and world action models (WAMs) form the backbone of modern physical AI systems, yet their real-time single-batch inference remains a defining bottleneck. Latency is dominated not by individual kernel computation, but by system-level overhead: thousands of short kernel launches, intermediate data movement across operator boundaries, and redundant recomputation across consecutive decisions. General-purpose graph compilers cannot address these costs, as they optimize individual calls in isolation and lack visibility into cross-call state semantics and global pipeline structure. We present FLASHRT-PAI, a low-latency inference engine built around model-hardware pipeline co-design rather than isolated kernel optimization. FLASHRT-PAI combines three core mechanisms: deep kernel fusion with launch overlap eliminates inter-operator boundaries and launch gaps; an execution contract formalizes the pipeline's stage DAG, update rates, and named buffers to enable cross-decision state reuse and selective refresh; and execution-state capsules enable fast snapshot, restore, and fork of persistent pipeline state. The system also supports drop-in acceleration of unmodified PyTorch models via parity- and latency-gated kernel replacement. Evaluation covers six policies on RTX 5090 and four on Jetson AGX Thor. At matched 16-bit precision, FLASHRT-PAI is 1.3-3.7x faster than official compiled paths. Combining pipeline co-design with reduced precision delivers 3.38-12.66x speedup over official eager implementations. In LIBERO-10, four-bit pi0.5 achieves 94.04% success on Thor and 93.32% on RTX 5090, compared with 92.4% for the measured official FP16 reference. FLASHRT-PAI is open source, distributed via Hugging Face Kernel Hub, and its opt-in pi0.5 kernels have been adopted into the LeRobot framework.

AI.tldr: FLASHRT-PAI 是一种低延迟推理引擎，通过模型-硬件管程协同设计减少系统级开销，提高推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的通用图编译器无法解决物理AI系统的实时单批推理中的延迟问题，因为它们无法进行跨操作状态语义和全局管道结构的优化。
AI.method: FLASHRT-PAI 采用深度内核融合与启动重叠、执行合同和执行状态胶囊等机制来减少跨操作符边界和启动延迟，支持基于精度的内核替换加速，并在模型未修改的情况下进行插件加速。
AI.result: 在RTX 5090和Jetson AGX Thor上，MATCHRT-PAI 以16位精度比官方编译路径快1.3-3.7倍，结合减少精度时，比官方急切实现快3.38-12.66倍。在LIBERO-10中，四比特pi0.5成功率达到94.04%和93.32%。
AI.conclusion: MATCHRT-PAI 开源，通过Hugging Face Kernel Hub分发，并将选通pi0.5内核引入LeRobot框架。

title: Functionalizing AI-Generated 3D Shapes via Interior Geometry Construction
summary: AI-based 3D generation models such as Hunyuan 3D and Meshy can produce visually appealing 3D shapes from an image or text prompt.However, they typically focus on an object's external appearance, often producing incomplete or implausible interior geometry. Consequently, the generated shapes are not guaranteed to be functionally valid, limiting their direct use in downstream applications such as simulation and fabrication. In this paper, we present a computational approach to functionalize AI-generated 3D shapes through interior geometry construction. Our key observations are that a part's functional role defines its interior geometry, and such geometry is often smooth, relatively simple, and closely related to the part's external shape. Inspired by these observations, we introduce an interior-aware part graph to encode information necessary for constructing interior geometry within an AI-generated 3D shape, and build the graph via VLM-based shape segmentation and graph attribute inference. Guided by the graph, we model the interior geometry of each part as a generalized cylinder and infer its parameters from the part's external geometry through an optimization. The resulting 3D shapes are functionally valid while preserving their AI-generated external appearance. We demonstrate our approach on a variety of AI-generated 3D shapes, including vessels, containers, and storage furniture, and fabricate selected examples for functional validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过内部几何构造使AI生成的3D形状功能化的计算方法，通过引入包含必要信息的内部几何感知零件图，并通过优化从零件的外部几何形状推断其参数来构建每个零件的内部几何形状。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成模型，如Hunyuan 3D和Meshy，虽能生成视觉上吸引人的3D形状，但通常仅关注对象的外部外观，导致内部几何不完整或不合理。因此，生成的形状在下游应用如仿真和制造中未确保功能有效性。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种使用内部几何感知零件图的计算方法。首先通过基于VLM的形状分割和图属性推理建立图，然后在图的指导下，将每个部分的内部几何建模为广义圆柱，通过优化从外部几何形状推断其参数。
AI.result: 通过此方法生成的3D形状在功能上有效，同时保留了AI生成的外部外观。并展示了这种方法在管道、容器、存储家具等AI生成的3D形状上的应用，并对部分实例进行了功能性验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法能够使基于AI生成的3D形状功能化，使这些形状更适用于实际应用场景。

title: Ben-Misandry: A Bengali Dataset and Late-Fusion Transformer Framework for Detecting Anti-Male Gender Hate
summary: Gender based hate speech research in Bengali has focused almost exclusively on misogyny, leaving anti male hate, or misandry, entirely unstudied for this language and creating a systematic blind spot in moderation systems trained to catch attacks on women but not on men. We introduce Ben-Misandry, the first Bengali misandry detection dataset: 5,000 comments across six taxonomy classes, including a novel category for mocking male emotional vulnerability with no direct analogue in existing misogyny taxonomies. The corpus is taxonomy-controlled synthetic data generated with GPT-4.1, spot-checked by four human reviewers on a 500-comment sample who confirmed the large majority of assigned labels; a full inter-annotator- agreement study is left to future work. We benchmark it with a classical pipeline (seven classifiers over four text representations) and a transformer pipeline (BanglaBERT, XLM-RoBERTa, and two fusion strategies). The best classical model, a linear SVM over character-level TF-IDF, reaches 91.8% accuracy; a late fusion ensemble averaging BanglaBERT and XLM-RoBERTa softmax outputs reaches 96.6% accuracy and macro ROC-AUC above 99%, nominally ahead of every single model and early fusion, though we have not run significance testing to confirm these margins are meaningful. We relate this to classifier combination theory, under which averaging encoders with decorrelated errors is expected to reduce variance, and corroborate the decision boundary with Shapley explanations that recover the same class- discriminative vocabulary found in our exploratory analysis, while noting this cannot rule out the model partly keying on synthetic-generation artifacts. Our results indicate misandry detection in Bengali is feasible and measurable on this synthetic corpus, offered as an initial public resource pending validation on real-world data.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个新的孟加拉语反男性仇恨言论检测数据集Ben-Misandry，包含5000条评论，涵盖六个分类，尤其是针对男性情感脆弱性的新类别。该数据集使用GPT-4生成，并通过人工审查。研究通过经典和变换器模型评估了该数据集的可行性，结果显示最好的模型能实现96.6%的准确率，但需进一步验证其在实际数据上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的孟加拉语仇恨言论研究主要集中在针对女性的恶意言论（即仇女言论），而忽略了针对男性的恶意言论（即仇男言论），这可能导致针对男性的仇恨言论在现有的内容过滤系统中未加处理。因此，作者提出了一种新的数据集Ben-Misandry, 旨在填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 作者使用GPT-4生成了一个包含5000条评论的数据集Ben-Misandry，这些评论被分成六个类别，包括一个新的对男性情感脆弱性的讽刺类别。然后，研究者使用一个经典的管道（七个分类器和四种文本表示）和一个变换器管道（包括BanglaBERT、XLM-RoBERTa和两种融合策略）对数据集进行了评估。此外，研究者还应用了分类组合理论，对模型进行了误差泛化性的分层分析。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，经典管道中的线性SVM模型在基于字符级别的TF-IDF表示时准确率达到91.8%，而融合BanglaBERT和XLM-RoBERTa输出的晚期融合模型达到了96.6%的准确率和宏ROC-AUC以上99%，表现亮眼；同时，Shapley值分析结果显示了该模型识别关键词的能力，但在实际应用中仍需进一步测试。
AI.conclusion: 在使用合成数据集的情况下，本研究证明了可以检测孟加拉语中的仇男言论，并提出了一个新的早期公共资源，希望未来的验证和测试能够在真实数据上进行。

title: DKnown-Jev: Fine-Tuning and Evaluation of a JEV-Style Model for Tasks Involving Normative Knowledge
summary: Tasks involving normative knowledge include concept interpretation, eligibility determination, procedure explanation, material requirements, and service-outcome assessment, all of which require rules and facts published, maintained, or recorded by authorized entities. Whether a candidate paragraph can answer a question therefore depends on applicability and answer completeness as well as topical relevance. We develop DKnown-Jev to classify the normative usability of candidate paragraphs into two classes. The 2B and 27B configurations are fine-tuned directly from the native Qwen3.5-2B and Qwen3.8-27B base models, respectively. The models combine question conditions, article metadata, and paragraph content, adopt the classes Answer Evidence (AE) and Non-answer Evidence (NE), and undergo domain adaptation using human-verified training data. Five configurations are evaluated on the same test set of 1,120 human-verified examples. DKnown-Jev 27B trained for one epoch achieves the highest accuracy of 98.75% and macro-F1 of 98.60%, exceeding Jev by 6.07 and 6.76 percentage points, respectively. DKnown-Jev 2B trained for one epoch achieves 92.86% accuracy and 92.18% macro-F1, the best aggregate results among the tested 2B configurations. Its gains over Jev are 0.18 and 0.33 percentage points on this test set, corresponding to only two additional correct predictions, which is insufficient to establish a stable advantage. The 27B one-epoch, 27B two-epoch, and 2B one-epoch configurations all exceed Jev on both metrics on this test set. Class-level analysis shows that the 27B two-epoch configuration has the highest AE recall, while the 27B one-epoch configuration has the highest NE recall. This study provides practical and empirical evidence for developing and applying candidate-scoring models to tasks involving normative knowledge.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了DKnown-Jev模型来评估候选段落的规范性可用性，通过细调Qwen3.5-2B和Qwen3.8-27B模型，在特定测试集上的表现优于现有模型Jev。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决涉及规范性知识的任务，如概念解释、资格判断等，需要评估段落是否适用且完整，并通过模型进行区分。
AI.method: 通过直接细调Qwen3.5-2B和Qwen3.8-27B模型来构建DKnown-Jev，模型结合了问题条件、文章元数据和段落内容，采用Answer Evidence (AE) 和 Non-answer Evidence (NE)两类，并使用人的验证数据进行领域适应。
AI.result: 在相同的1,120个人验证样本测试集上，DKnown-Jev 27B经过一轮训练达到98.75%的准确率和98.60%的宏观F1值，优于现有模型Jev 6.07和6.76个百分点。27B两轮训练和2B一轮训练配置在两个指标上均优于Jev。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，高质量的模型配置能够显著提高任务处理的准确性和效率，为未来相关政策性知识任务的模型开发提供了实践和实验证据。

title: Same Space or Not: Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence Through Cross-View Contradictions
summary: Spatial intelligence, the capacity to represent and reason about physical space, underlies embodied perception and real-world visual understanding. Existing benchmarks probe it through spatial relations, perspective-taking, and mental modeling. What remains underexamined is whether a model can maintain a coherent scene representation across views, since pairwise comparison alone cannot reveal which view departs from the truth. We thus introduce Same Space or Not (SSoN), a benchmark of cross-view contradiction resolution comprising 1,000 questions from seven indoor scene sources and six categories of controlled 3D edits. Each question presents three views of an unchanged scene and one view of an edited variant. Models must identify the inconsistent view and explain the contradiction without a designated trusted reference or a marked target. Our pipeline iteratively translates human review into generation constraints. Automated checks and exhaustive human validation screen out both trivial visual shortcuts and questions lacking sufficient evidence for a unique answer. Humans achieve 83.3% accuracy, compared with 39.7% for the strongest vision-language models (VLMs), falling to 34.9% when a valid visual explanation is also required. We investigate prompting, camera information, and 3D reconstruction as interventions. On a 100-question intervention set with a 24% baseline, prompting and 3D reconstruction remain below 50% answer accuracy, except when ground-truth camera information is supplied, which reaches 61% answer accuracy but only 48% True solve accuracy. On a held-out 201-question test set, Qwen2.5-VL-7B achieves 21.89% accuracy, 33.33% after answer-only fine-tuning, and 41.79% after fine-tuning on both rationales and answers. These results identify cross-view contradiction resolution as a substantial weakness of current VLMs that can be partly addressed by targeted supervision.

AI.tldr: 该研究引入了Same Space or Not (SSoN)基准，用于评估模型在不同视角下场景代表一致性推理能力，提出了跨视角矛盾解析这一任务。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要通过空间关系、视角理解和心理建模来评估空间智力，但未能充分考察模型是否能在不同视角间保持场景的一致性表示。因此，该研究提出SSoN基准，以解决这一问题。
AI.method: 该研究构建了一个包含7个室内场景来源和6种3D编辑类别的跨视角矛盾解析基准，每个问题展示三个未变场景视图和一个编辑变化的视图，模型需识别不一致视图并解释矛盾。
AI.result: 人类在该基准上达到了83.3%的准确率，而最强的视觉语言模型仅为39.7%，需要合理解释时更是降至34.9%。不同干预措施下的准确率参差不齐，但均未达到50%。此外，针对该任务进行了模型训练和调优，Qwen2.5-VL-7B的准确率从21.89%提升到41.79%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究强调了跨视角矛盾解析是当前视觉语言模型的重要局限，可通过针对性监督来一定程度上克服。

title: Beyond Recall Saturation: Scaling Hard-Negative Reranker Training for Industrial Legal Retrieval
summary: Industrial retrieval systems often improve quality by enlarging embedding candidate pools or adopting complex training pipelines. We show that, under a sufficiently large but practical candidate pool, embedding recall exhibits diminishing returns, motivating a closer examination of reranker quality. On Chinese legal retrieval benchmarks, embedding top-300 reaches a high-recall operating region, while relevant evidence may still be ranked below the output cutoff. We compare hard-negative strategies for reranker training, including embedding-mined, self-mined, and dynamic-negative variants, under aligned retrieval protocols that evaluate reranking after candidate retrieval. Among the evaluated staged configurations, an embedding-to-self-mined pipeline provides a favorable trade-off; additional dynamic stages do not improve all held-out metrics. The selected pipeline scales from a 0.6B to a 4B reranker. Relative to the native 4B reranker, the trained 4B Stage2 model improves reported metrics on the STARD and CSAID benchmarks and on an internal development set, and is preferred in 72.4\% of non-tied comparisons on 410 de-identified, reconstructed internal operational-query inputs in a latency-sensitive offline preference evaluation. These results support evaluating the retrieval and reranking stages separately when selecting an optimization target for industrial retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: 通过评估候选池和重排序器的效果，提出了一种嵌入式到自我挖掘管道方法，该方法在不增加计算成本的情况下提高了检索和重排序阶段的性能，在多个基准测试和实际用户查询中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 工业检索系统通常通过扩展嵌入候选池或采用复杂的训练管道来提高质量。研究发现，即使候选池相当大，嵌入召回也表现出递减的回报，因此需要更多关注重排序器的质量。
AI.method: 作者在中文法律检索基准上对比了不同负样本挖掘策略，包括嵌入挖掘、自我挖掘和动态负样本挖掘，设置了统一的重排序评估协议，评估了带有不同阶段配置的流水线。
AI.result: 初步的嵌入到自我挖掘流水线提供了良好的折衷方案，额外的动态阶段并未提升所有保留指标。从小型到大型重排序器，训练好的Stage2模型在多个基准测试和内部开发集中提高了报告的指标，并在延迟敏感的离线偏好评估中得到了72.4%的偏好。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果支持在选择工业检索系统的优化目标时，将检索和重排序阶段分开评估。

title: A Two-Stage Hybrid Framework for Inferring Air Trips from Mobile Location-based Service (LBS) Data under Incomplete Airport Sightings
summary: Mobile device location-based service (LBS) data provide large-scale spatiotemporal observations that can help airport planners understand air travelers' mobility patterns. However, airport sightings are often missing before or after flights, making strictly rule-based detection incomplete. This study develops a two-stage framework to infer U.S. domestic air trips from large-scale LBS data under incomplete airport sightings. Stage 1 uses heuristic rules to identify high-confidence air trips whose endpoints are observed at two distinct airports. Stage 2 addresses latent air trips with a probabilistic model that infers air routes using spatial proximity, temporal compatibility, and historical flight schedule information. Using January 2022 nationwide LBS data with nearly 10 million users and 131 million sightings, results are validated against T-100 Domestic Segment route benchmarks and a Stage 1 pseudo-ground-truth reference set. The framework increases air route coverage from 10.65% under Stage 1 to 50.60% and recovers nearly all top-1,000 benchmark routes. It improves Spearman rank correlation with T-100 route shares from 0.4490 to 0.7630 and reduces Jensen-Shannon divergence from 0.2808 to 0.2263. Stage 2 also recovers 92.2% of Stage 1 reference trips. This study formalizes three endpoint observation regimes for LBS-based air trip inference (airport-observed, semi-observed, and latent) and helps airport agencies identify domestic air travel patterns missed when airport sightings are incomplete.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种双阶段框架，从不完整的机场观测数据中推断美国国内航空旅行路线，利用启发式规则识别高可信度的航空旅行，并通过概率模型在第二阶段推断航线。
AI.motivation: 移动设备基于位置的服务（LBS）数据为机场规划者提供了理解空中旅行者移动模式的机会，但由于机场观测数据的不完整性，严格的规则检测可能不够准确。
AI.method: 第一阶段使用启发式规则识别端点在两个不同机场观察到的高可信度航空旅行；第二阶段使用概率模型，结合空间邻近性、时间兼容性和历史航班时刻表信息来推断潜在的航空航线。
AI.result: 该方法验证了2022年1月全国约10万名用户的近1.31亿次观测数据，通过与T-100国内航段基准路线进行比较，覆盖率从第一阶段的10.65%提高到50.60%，几乎恢复了前1,000条基准路线，Spearman等级相关性提高了0.3140，Jensen-Shannon散度降低了0.0545。
AI.conclusion: 双阶段框架成功地识别了不完整的机场观测数据中的航空行程，有助于机场机构发现缺失的空中旅行模式。

title: Generalizable fetal brain biometry via adaptive artificial intelligence
summary: Reliable fetal brain biometry on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for diagnosing congenital brain anomalies, but artificial intelligence models often lose accuracy under domain shifts. We developed BioTTA, a backbone-agnostic, source-free unsupervised test-time adaptation framework that adapts pretrained models online to individual unlabeled target volumes. This retrospective multicohort study included 394 reconstructed 3D fetal brain MRI volumes at 20-39 gestational weeks, with 11 biometric measurements annotated by radiologists. BioTTA was developed on single-center turbo spin-echo MRI and evaluated on three datasets representing cross-sequence, cross-center, and cross-nation shifts. Biometry accuracy was assessed using mean absolute error (MAE) and the percentage of correct measurements within 4 mm. A web-based reporting platform mapped measurements onto normative growth trajectories and was evaluated against radiologists in four multicenter disease cohorts covering germinal matrix-intraventricular hemorrhage, ventriculomegaly, and cerebellar abnormality. Across all three target datasets, BioTTA outperformed auto-SVRTK, source-only models, and FetalSynthGen, while matching models finetuned with target labels. MAEs ranged from 1.10 to 1.46 mm with a convolutional backbone and from 1.46 to 2.25 mm with a transformer backbone. Diagnostic accuracy ranged from 82.1% to 95.0%, comparable to a senior radiologist. BioTTA supports accurate, generalizable fetal brain biometry and standardized prenatal brain growth assessment across heterogeneous MRI sources.

AI.tldr: BioTTA是一种基于框架和无源的测试时自适应框架，能够在线适应未标记的目标体积，通过跨序列、跨中心和跨国家的数据集验证了其在胎儿大脑生物测量上的准确性和普适性。
AI.motivation: 现有的人工智能模型在面对域转移时，往往会导致准确率下降，影响胎儿大脑生物测量的准确性。
AI.method: BioTTA通过在单中心的 turbo spin-echo MRI 上开发，并在三个代表跨序列、跨中心和跨国家的数据库上进行评估，使用均方绝对误差（MAE）和4毫米以内的正确测量百分比作为评估指标。
AI.result: BioTTA在三个目标数据集上超过了 auto-SVRTK、源模型和 FetalSynthGen，并与使用目标标签进行微调的模型达到了相似的准确性。使用卷积神经网络的 MAE 范围在1.10到1.46毫米之间，使用变压器神经网络的 MAE 范围在1.46到2.25毫米之间。诊断准确性范围从82.1%到95.0%，与资深放射科医生相当。
AI.conclusion: BioTTA支持在异质性 MRI 源中准确、可泛化的胎儿大脑生物测量，促进了标准化的孕前大脑生长评估。

title: Write Once, Check Many: Reusable Ledgers for Post-Hoc Policy Compliance Auditing of Agent Trajectories
summary: Auditing LLM agents against policies is critical to ensure safety but requires rereading long trajectories once per policy. Can we instead record each trajectory once and reuse that record for policies not known in advance? We propose write once, check many, a framework in which a writer model converts each agent trajectory into a policy-independent ledger of the agent's actions and outcomes. A reader then checks each new policy against the ledger alone, without access to the original trajectory. On 900 trajectories from SHADE-Arena, $τ$-bench, and $τ^2$-bench, we show that a 12B reader of narrative ledgers can either match or in fact achieve higher AUC than the same 12B model reading full trajectories. On SHADE-Arena policies that combine several facts, our approach outperforms a 31B model reading the trajectory (.777 vs. .713 AUC). When checking eight SHADE-Arena policies separately, ledgers use about $5\times$ fewer tokens, including the cost of writing them. A deeper analysis shows that rule-based extraction performs better on some single-action policies, and ledgers can miss evidence in long tool outputs and message contents. Our results suggest that reusable, policy-independent records can make retrospective agent auditing more efficient and effective, and highlight important considerations in ledger design.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为“写一次，检查多次”的框架，该框架能够将agent的行为和结果转化为与策略无关的日志，供未知策略检查使用。结果显示，该方法在某些情况下能更高效地进行审计。
AI.motivation: 审计大型语言模型代理（LLM agents）需要多次查阅长时间的轨迹，这非常耗时。为了提高审计效率，研究人员提出了一个名为“写一次，检查多次”的新框架。
AI.method: 该框架包括两个模型：一个是写入模型，用于将代理轨迹转换为与策略无关的日志；另一个是阅读模型，用于根据日志检查未知策略。实验展示了如何使用阅读模型在多个基准数据集上验证策略。
AI.result: 研究团队在900个莎德竞技场（SHADE-Arena）、$\tau$-bench和$\tau^2$-bench等基准数据集上展示了方法的有效性。与原代理轨迹相比，叙事日志的阅读模型不仅能够达到相同的准确率，甚至在某些情况下还能优于原来的准确率。对于莎德竞技场结合多个事实的策略，该方法的AUC值优于31B模型的0.713，达到了0.777。此外，使用日志进行检查仅需消耗大约5倍的令牌数。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过创建策略无关的日志提高了代理审计的效率，但同时也指出了一些需要注意的问题，例如基于规则的提取在某些单行动策略上表现更好，以及日志可能会遗漏长时间工具输出和消息内容中的证据。

title: WAQS: Weight Absorption for Quadratic Probing and Affine Steering
summary: Activation steering provides a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for controlling large language model behavior. Existing methods, however, often face a trade-off between efficiency and expressiveness: fixed steering vectors incur negligible inference overhead but cannot adapt to the current model input, whereas input-dependent nonlinear interventions provide greater flexibility at additional runtime cost. We introduce \textbf{WAQS} (\textbf{W}eight \textbf{A}bsorption for \textbf{Q}uadratic probing and affine \textbf{S}teering), a framework that obtains state-dependent steering, without additional inference-time computation. WAQS models a concept with a quadratic probe, whose gradient yields an affine, activation-dependent steering direction. We show that this affine intervention can be folded exactly into adjacent linear transformations through an offline weight update. Moreover, we prove that quadratic functions form the maximal class of smooth concept scores whose gradient-based interventions are affine and therefore exactly absorbable into linear layers. Under a Gaussian representation model, our formulation admits an interpretation as the difference of class-conditional Mahalanobis pulls and naturally generalizes linear discriminant and difference-in-means steering. To scale to high-dimensional representations, we introduce a low-rank parameterization of the quadratic term. Across truthfulness, refusal, and sycophancy steering tasks, quadratic steering matches or improves upon constant linear steering while preserving model utility, with the absorbed implementation introducing no additional inference-time operations. Our results suggest that quadratic probes provide a practical middle ground between static linear steering and computationally expensive dynamic nonlinear interventions.

AI.tldr: WAQS框架通过二次探针和仿射激活方向的吸收，提供了一种在不增加推理时间开销的情况下实现状态依赖的激活引导的方法，从而填补了静态线性引导和计算成本高的动态非线性干预之间的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有的激活引导方法在效率和表达性之间存在权衡，固定向量引导几乎不增加推理时间成本，但无法适应当前模型输入，而输入相关的非线性干预虽然提供了更大的灵活性，但可能增加推理时间成本。因此，提出WAQS框架旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: WAQS框架通过使用二次探针，其梯度产生一个仿射、激活相关的引导方向来指导模型行为。该框架允许将这种仿射干预折叠到相邻的线性变换中，通过离线权重更新实现。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，二次引导方法在不增加推理时间操作的情况下，无论是真实性、拒绝还是奉承引导任务上，都与静态线性引导方法达到了相同或更好的效果，且保持了模型的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，二次探针为静态线性引导和计算成本高的动态非线性干预之间提供了一个实用的折中方案。

title: Geo-vision: Native-Resolution Geometry and Sampled Topology for Vehicle-Part Damage Classification
summary: Geo-vision classifies vehicle-part damage using a fixed representation combining appearance, multiscale geometry, orientation, and sampled digital topology. Connected components, holes, Euler characteristics, and spatial arrangement complement amplitude-sensitive pooling and a supervised tree classifier. We establish amplitude preservation, axial sign invariance, and conditional operator stability. Retrospective checkpoint evaluation on 55,303 crops from 4,916 source groups yields average precision 0.7577, exceeding 0.7458 for an ImageNet-pretrained frozen YOLO11n comparator on identical crops. The complete added structural block, comprising topology, occupancy, and component location, improves average precision by 0.00493 beyond appearance and geometry. Geo-vision uses no external encoder pretraining and has higher AP point estimates at every matched label budget. With approximately 25% fewer task labels, its AP point estimate exceeds full-data YOLO, although the adjusted interval includes zero. Complete serial CPU inference requires 26.98 ms per crop versus YOLO's 11.20 ms, with peak memory 185 versus 437 MiB. Independent external validation remains necessary.

AI.tldr: Geo-vision 使用固定表示结合外观、多尺度几何、方向和采样数字拓扑来分类车辆部件损坏，通过连接组件、孔洞、欧拉特征等增强了幅度敏感池化和监督树分类器，总体精度超过 ImageNet 预训练冻结的 YOLO11n 对比器。
AI.motivation: 为了在无需外部编码器预训练的情况下，提供一种有效且复杂的车辆部件损坏分类方法，克服现有方法可能存在的精度限制。
AI.method: Geo-vision 通过结合外观、多尺度几何、方向和采样数字拓扑等信息，使用连接组件、孔洞、欧拉特征等特征，并结合幅度敏感池化和监督树分类器进行分类。
AI.result: Geo-vision 在 55,303 个样本上实现了 0.7577 的平均精度，超过了 ImageNet 预训练冻结的 YOLO11n 对比器的 0.7458。同时，在每种标签预算匹配下，其平均精度点估计均高于全数据 YOLO。尽管标签数量减少了约 25%，其平均精度点估计仍超过了全数据 YOLO。
AI.conclusion: Geo-vision 增强结构部分显著提高了平均精度，独立外部验证仍需进行，同时提出了一个基于 CPU 的推理时间较长但内存使用较少的版本。

title: Modeling Discourse Profiles in Climate Misinformation Discourse
summary: Prior work on climate misinformation detection typically classifies individual comments or claims using text alone. This framing overlooks a key property of online climate discourse: misinformation is often produced, reinforced, and sustained through recurring rhetorical patterns that reappear across comments and threads. Using a large-scale TikTok climate discourse dataset, we construct discourse profiles by clustering climate-related comments into recurring rhetorical patterns. We then incorporate these profiles into fine-grained climate misinformation classifiers using a late-fusion architecture. Under video-disjoint evaluation across three training seeds, discourse-profile-aware models significantly improve macro-F1 over text-only baselines for bag-of-words, TF-IDF, and MPNet representations. RoBERTa-large exhibits a positive mean improvement but substantially greater variability, and the difference is not statistically significant. Beyond classification, our results show discourse profiles shape misinformation reception and propagation. Discourse-profile-conditioned language model agents exhibit misinformation acceptance patterns aligned with profile-level misinformation prevalence in ClimateDisc, and the relationship between misinformation prevalence and engagement persistence differs across dominant discourse profiles.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过利用 TikTok 上与气候相关的评论数据，识别出反复出现的修辞模式，并将其纳入细粒度的气候误导性信息分类模型中，从而显著提高了分类性能。
AI.motivation: 当前的气候误导性信息检测方法主要集中在单独评论或声明的文本分类上，未能充分考虑在线气候讨论的特定属性。本文提出的新方法为理解和应对这种现象提供了新的视角。
AI.method: 研究收集了大量TikTok上的气候讨论数据，并通过聚类方法识别出了重复出现的修辞模式，随后将这些模式应用到细粒度的气候误导性信息分类模型中。
AI.result: 在不共享视频的情况下，在三个不同的训练种子下评估，识别出的修辞模式显著提高了使用 BoW、TF-IDF 和 MPNet 表示的分类器性能。RoBERTa-large模型在平均改进方面表现出积极的趋势，但变异较大且提高的差异不具备统计学意义。此外，这些修辞模式还影响了误导性信息的接受度和传播。
AI.conclusion: 识别出的修辞模式不仅有助于提高误导性信息分类的准确性，还能揭示误导性信息对传播模式的影响，这为理解在线气候误导性信息的现象提供了洞察。

title: Beyond Next-Screen Prediction: The Decision Value of GUI World Models
summary: GUI world models are increasingly used to improve action selection by predicting the consequences of candidate actions, but it is unclear how much of the resulting gain comes from prediction itself rather than from the evaluator that interprets those predictions. We study this attribution problem through controlled interventions on GUI action selection. With candidates and predictions held fixed, lookahead gains can change with how the prediction is presented to the evaluator, so end-to-end gains cannot be attributed to prediction alone. We then introduce Direct Action Ranking (DAR), which learns from reference actions to score candidates without generating future screens, and compare it with a prediction-augmented variant under matched supervision. Predicted successors add no detectable ranking signal once evaluation is learned directly. Without retraining, DAR improves AndroidWorld task success by 5.8--16.4 points across three proposers, outperforms world-model lookahead, and transfers zero-shot to unseen apps, where every prediction-conditioned configuration falls below proposer confidence. These results suggest that GUI world models should be evaluated by their decision value, the incremental action-selection value of their predictions beyond a strong direct evaluator, rather than by prediction fidelity or end-to-end lookahead gain alone.

AI.tldr: 研究观察了GUI世界模型对未来屏幕预测在决策中的作用，并提出了一种直接行动评分（DAR）方法，该方法无需生成未来屏幕即可评分。实验结果显示，DAR在Android任务中表现出色，优于使用未来屏幕预测的方法，并且可以零样本适配未见过的应用程序。
AI.motivation: 探讨GUI世界模型的真正价值，区分预测本身的贡献和评价者的作用。通过对比基于预测和直接行动评分的方法，强调决策价值的重要性。
AI.method: 研究通过控制干预GUI动作选择，固定候选动作和预测，观察不同展示预测方式对策略效果的影响。引入了无需生成未来屏幕即可评分的Direct Action Ranking (DAR)，并与预测增益的方法进行了对比实验。
AI.result: DAR方法在所有实验中均优于预测增益的方法，特别是在未见过的应用程序上表现出色。发现预测所贡献的排名信号不足以支持其有效性。DAR直接评分方法在AndroidWorld任务上可以提高5.8到16.4分，而基于预测的方法没有显著提升了。
AI.conclusion: GUI世界模型应基于决策价值进行评估，即预测对强大的直接评估器的增量行动选择价值，而不仅仅是预测的准确性和端到端的预测增益。

title: IMPULSE: Push First, Then Predict in V-JEPA 2 Feature Space
summary: Latent world models such as V-JEPA 2 forecast in the feature space of a video encoder, but one look at an object does not reveal how hard it is to rotate, how much it bounces or how much it slides. People find out by trying: a few pokes reveal how an object responds. IMPULSE, named after the impulse response it infers, gives a predictor in frozen V-JEPA 2 feature space the same ability. A Bayesian contact memory summarizes three short calibration pushes, a predicted object pose carries it into the predictor, and a lightweight random-Fourier pose head lets the predictor use the pose. On 512 fresh objects, in a pre-specified held-out confirmation with models sealed before the data existed, the memory lowers the 1-second feature-forecast error by 11.6-12.8% relative to the same predictor without experience, for all 8 training seeds, with a 95% seed-and-object interval excluding zero. The gain also holds for 128 objects with out-of-range physics (11.7-14.0%), and the full extension beats a plain predictor by 15.5-16.6%. An information-ladder argument, exact for ideal predictors, shows that physics reaches the features only through motion, so we measure how much the pathway lets pose help. On fresh objects, the Fourier head roughly triples the gain of a perfect memory over plain pose tokens (2.8-3.2x). Raw push measurements fed through the same pathway give a similar gain, so the Bayesian summary is not required; it condenses the trials into eight interpretable numbers. The gain is absent at contact onset and grows afterwards.

AI.tldr: IMPROVE通过在静态特征空间中引入基于接触的记忆和轻量化姿态头，显著提高了物体运动预测的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频编码器在特征空间中的隐含世界模型无法直接反映物体的物理属性，例如旋转难度、弹跳程度和滑动程度。IMPROVE通过引入基于几个接触推力的学习记忆和轻量化姿态头部，增强了物体的物理特性预测能力。
AI.method: IMPROVE使用了一个贝叶斯接触记忆，总结了三个短暂的校准推力；预测的对象姿势将它导入预测器中；并使用轻量级的随机傅里叶姿态头让预测器利用这些姿势。
AI.result: 在512个新鲜物体上的预设保留验证中，记忆相比同一个预测器在无经验下的1秒特征预测误差降低11.6-12.8%。这一改进适用于具有超出范围物理特性的128个物体（11.7-14.0%的减少），而且还超过了仅依赖于原始预编码器的性能（15.5-16.6%的改进）。此外，在新的物体上，傅里叶头大约将完美的记忆相对于纯姿态令牌的收益提高了2.8-3.2倍。
AI.conclusion: IMPROVE通过使用轻量级的随机傅里叶姿态头和贝叶斯接触记忆，在视频编码特征空间中增强了物体运动预测的物理特性，显著提高预编码器的性能。

title: Vocal-Tract Acoustics, Aerodynamics, and Overlap-and-Add Synthesis in DYNARTmo
comment: 6 figures; ancillary Python reference implementation and word-transcription guide. No audio recordings or saved timelines
summary: This paper presents the acoustic and aerodynamic extension of DYNARTmo, a dynamic articulatory model for visualizing and synthesizing speech production. Gestural control trajectories determine vocal-tract geometry, which is converted into an acoustic tube with nasal branching and effective lateral passages. A lumped aerodynamic network relates prescribed glottal motion and pulmonary pressure to airflow and supraglottal pressure storage. Phonatory excitation, oral friction, and glottal aspiration are synthesized as separate contributions. Frame-specific acoustic responses are combined by overlap-and-add, preserving response tails beyond individual control frames. Three German words, ``Tasse'', ``Muse'', and ``Lade'', illustrate the coordination of articulation, pressure, flow, and acoustic sources across vowels, nasals, laterals, fricatives, and plosives. The implementation has been optimized by the author primarily for sound recognizability; independent perceptual evaluation remains outstanding, and fricative-noise naturalness requires further refinement. The model provides an inspectable, articulatorily controlled production plant for future neural simulations of babbling, imitation, and early word acquisition. Further work will improve acoustic realism, reduce empirical source corrections, and extend the sensory information available to developmental learning models.

AI.tldr: 该论文扩展了DYNARTmo动态发音模型，用于语音生成的可视化和合成，包括声学和气动学特性。该模型生成了可听觉验证的动态发音轨迹，特别关注辅音噪声的真实性和声学逼真度。
AI.motivation: 为了解决现有的发音模型在声学逼真度和语音生成上的问题，通过扩展DYNARTmo模型来更好地模拟语音产生的全过程，包括声学和气动学层面。
AI.method: 该方法通过生成性控制轨迹来决定声道几何形状，并将其转换为带有鼻腔分支和有效侧通道的声音管道。气动网络将预定的喉部运动和肺内压相关联，生成气流和亚声门压力存储。通过离散框架的声学响应组合，模拟了语音声学输出。
AI.result: 该结果通过三个德语词汇“Tasse”、“Muse”、“Lade”的演示，展示了在元音、鼻音、侧音、摩擦音和爆破音等方面的协调发音、压力、流速和声学来源。
AI.conclusion: 该模型提供了一个可检验且由发音器控制的生产装置，为未来神经模拟下的学步、模仿以及早期单词获取提供了可能性。进一步的工作将改善声学现实性，减少经验来源校正，并扩大发展学习模型可用的感官信息。

title: Train Locally, Learn Together: Distributed Multi-Agent Training via ADMM
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) can outperform individual language-model agents by combining specialized roles, diverse reasoning processes, and collaborative decision-making. However, collaborative MAS training is typically centralized, requiring a common trainer to aggregate role-local trajectories and learning signals and maintain model and optimization states. This motivates a distributed multi-agent learning paradigm in which agents improve system-level capabilities through role-local learning and decentralized communication, paving the way toward scalable, resilient, and self-organizing MAS. To this end, we introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first optimization-grounded framework for distributed MAS training based on consensus alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). We formulate collaborative MAS learning as a consensus-constrained finite-sum optimization problem, naturally lending itself to distributed optimization via ADMM. The proposed approach alternates role-local learning with inter-agent consensus using distributed communication protocols such as ring all-reduce, enabling joint optimization while keeping each agent's data and training state local. We evaluate our framework on distributed safety alignment and general reasoning tasks. Under compromised-agent settings, ADMM can reduce HarmBench attack success rate (ASR) by up to 26.4%, while achieving reasoning gains comparable to centralized training. These results show that distributed MAS training retains the benefits of centralized joint optimization without requiring a centralized trainer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于共识交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的分布式多智能体系统训练框架，能够在保证局部数据和训练状态的同时实现联合优化，有效提高了系统的安全性和推理能力。
AI.motivation: 传统的多智能体系统训练通常是集中的，需要一个共同的训练者来收集各个智能体的角色本地轨迹和学习信号，并维护模型和优化状态。这限制了系统的可扩展性和鲁棒性。因此，本文提出了一种分布式多智能体学习范式，通过本地学习和去中心化通信来提升系统级能力。
AI.method: 本文基于共识交替方向乘子法（ADMM），将合作多智能体学习构建成一个受共识约束的有限和优化问题。通过分布式通信协议（如环向所有减少），该方法交替进行角色本地学习与智能体间的共识，从而实现联合优化。
AI.result: 该框架在分布式安全对齐和普通推理任务上的评估表明，ADMM在被破坏的智能体设置下可将HarmBench攻击成功率降低26.4%，同时实现了与集中训练相当的推理收益。这表明分布式多智能体训练保留了集中联合优化的优点，无需集中的训练者。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于共识交替方向乘子法的分布式多智能体训练框架，不仅提升了系统的安全性和推理能力，还克服了集中式训练的局限，为实现大规模、自组织的多智能体系统提供了新的解决方案。

title: Learning When to Trust and Reobserve Sparse-Frame VideoQA from Temporal Sampling Perturbations
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Physical Understanding for Decision-Making (PhysUnderstand), Poster
summary: Sparse-frame video-language models can change their answers when only the sampling timestamps shift. Raw agreement exposes this problem, but it need not rank errors better than token confidence or identify which additional observation will repair an answer. We argue that answer risk and action value must be estimated separately.
