PhaseGuard+ probes a frozen VLM at controlled temporal offsets, predicts the reliability of the phase-vote answer, and predicts the example-wise correctness gain of a specific rescue action. The second score routes only examples expected to benefit from denser frames or a stronger VLM. Both predictors use lightweight models trained on public data; the VLMs remain frozen. We use 256 Perception Test videos for method development and evaluate on a disjoint 256-video test set comprising 554 Physics questions. For Qwen3-VL-8B, reliability AUROC rises from 68.0% with token softmax to 74.8% (+6.8 pp, 95% CI [2.6, 10.7] pp). Routing 30% of questions to Qwen3-VL-32B reaches 67.87% accuracy, compared with 63.66% for budget-matched random routing (+4.21 percentage points, CI [1.89, 6.40]). All four tested rescue pairs significantly outperform random routing. Temporal sensitivity becomes actionable when the system learns both whether an answer is unreliable and whether an available action is likely to fix it.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于受控时间偏移的PhaseGuard+方法，通过预测视频语言模型（VLM）答案的可靠性和特定补救行动带来的收益，从而提供更可靠和准确的答案。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频语言模型受到时间采样对答案影响的缺陷，而直接的可靠度评估无法有效识别哪些错误可以改进。
AI.method: 使用受控时间偏移的PhaseGuard+方法，首先预测通过补救操作的可靠性变化，然后选择性地使用更强的模型或更密集的时间帧。
AI.result: 该方法显著提升了Qwen3-VL-32B在物理问题上的准确率，并且与随机分配相比，所选问题组表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 该结论表明，通过分别评估答案风险和行动价值，在视频信息检索和任务执行中具有重要实际意义和应用潜力。

title: Backend-Frontend Converter: Component-Based Conversion of .NET Computational Models to TypeScript
summary: Computational models developed in .NET often need to run locally within web applications. We present Backend--Frontend Converter, an architecture for generating TypeScript implementations of component-based models. The converter maps components, connections, aliases, and formula trees to model-specific TypeScript code. Reusable runtime libraries provide numerical integration, data access, and state handling. We evaluate stored generated implementations through four orbital scenarios and a recorded trading-strategy comparison. Orbital calculations execute in a browser and are paired with C\# results by crossing event and timestamp; trading outputs are aligned by date. Analytic scheduler tests and deliberately perturbed outputs assess the validation procedure. Each orbital scenario produces 91 paired events with identical timestamps. Position and velocity differences remain below $(10^{-6}\)~km$ and $(10^{-9}\)~km/s$. All 20 analytic scheduler checks pass, and the comparator detects each of three prescribed state and time perturbations. The trading comparison contains 501 aligned daily records with matching indicator values, positions, and order events. The evaluated implementations preserve the compared outputs across the C#/TypeScript boundary. Component-specific generation and reusable execution libraries provide a practical route from supported .NET computational models to TypeScript applications.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种架构，用于将.NET中的组件式模型转换为TypeScript实现，通过四种轨道场景和回测策略比较评估了生成的TypeScript实现，验证了跨C#/TypeScript边界的输出一致性。
AI.motivation: 鉴于.NET开发的模型通常需要在本地Web应用中运行，本文提出的架构Backend--Frontend Converter旨在简化这一过程，通过生成TypeScript代码来实现.NET中的组件化模型。
AI.method: 该方法通过对组件、连接、别名和公式树进行映射，并利用可重用的运行时库，包括数值积分、数据访问和状态处理等功能，将.NET模型转换为TypeScript代码。
AI.result: 通过四种轨道场景和回测策略的比较，验证了生成的TypeScript实现的有效性。轨道计算在浏览器中执行，与C#结果的事件和时间戳进行匹配；回测输出与日期对齐。验证程序测试和故意引入的输出偏移证明了验证过程的可靠性。所有测试场景的偏差和状态时间偏移均满足预期标准。回测比较显示了501条记录的一致性，所有对比输出均保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过组件特定的生成和可重用的执行库，为.NET中的支持模型到TypeScript应用的桥梁提供了实用的方法，保证了C#和TypeScript间的输出一致性。

title: Is This Your Agent? Identity Watermarking for Agent Systems in Dynamic Environments
summary: Agent systems deployed in dynamic environments continuously update their memories, skills, and runtime configurations, leading to evolving trajectories and challenges for persistent identity authentication. Existing text and agent watermarking methods struggle to achieve stable watermark embedding under dynamic environments, while embedded watermarks may become difficult to recover due to environmental changes. This paper proposes DASMark, an identity watermarking framework for dynamic agent systems. DASMark introduces Action-Preserving Embedding (APE), which learns semantically similar but distinguishable decision-expression channels from diverse interaction trajectories to enable stable watermark embedding in dynamic systems. It further introduces Shift-Robust Recovery (SRR) to mitigate context-induced shifts and improve watermark recovery stability under dynamic environments. In dynamic settings, DASMark achieves 98.5% bit-decoding accuracy and maintains 95.2% accuracy under attack scenarios, while preserving task utility comparable to unwatermarked agents.

AI.tldr: DASMark 是一种针对动态代理系统的身份水印框架，通过 Action-Preserving Embedding 和 Shift-Robust Recovery 两种技术实现稳定的水印嵌入和恢复，即使在动态环境中也能保持高解码准确率和抗攻击能力，同时不影响任务效率。
AI.motivation: 现有文本和代理水印方法在动态环境中难以稳定嵌入和恢复水印，DASMark 针对动态代理系统的身份认证挑战提出了新的解决方案。
AI.method: DASMark 采用 Action-Preserving Embedding 和 Shift-Robust Recovery 两种技术。前者从多样化的交互轨迹中学习语义相似但可区分的决策表达通道，实现动态系统中稳定的水印嵌入。后者则减少了上下文引起的偏移，提高了watermark在动态环境下的恢复稳定性。
AI.result: DASMark 在动态设置中实现了 98.5% 的位解码准确率，并在攻击场景下保持 95.2% 的准确率，同时保持与未嵌入水印代理相当的任务效率。
AI.conclusion: DASMark 在动态代理系统中提供了稳定的身份认证解决方案，具有高准确性、强抗攻击能力和良好任务执行能力。

title: Spatio-Temporal Detection of Photovoltaic Systems on Industrial Building Rooftops Using Satellite Imagery and Machine Learning
summary: The global transition toward carbon-neutral energy systems is heavily dependent on the rapid deployment of solar photovoltaic (PV) infrastructure, yet the speed of this expansion has outpaced the ability of administrative registries to maintain accurate records. While high-resolution commercial imagery is often used for monitoring, its high cost and infrequent updates can create an information gap for grid operators, energy infrastructure developers and policymakers. This study addresses the lack of scalable monitoring for industrial-scale rooftop PV systems by developing a machine learning framework that utilizes open-access, multispectral Sentinel-2 satellite imagery. By integrating building geometries from OpenStreetMap with Sentinel-2 reflectance data, a Random Forest model was trained to identify the specific spectral signatures of PV modules. Moving beyond theoretical modeling, this work emphasizes practical implementation through the development of an interactive web-based prototype for on-demand site monitoring. The application enables users to retrieve up-to-date satellite observations and assess the presence of PV systems on industrial building rooftops. The tool incorporates quality metrics that inform users whether a prediction is supported by sufficient training data density or requires manual verification. This end-to-end framework demonstrates that open-source medium-resolution data can effectively bridge this monitoring gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用开源多光谱Sentinel-2卫星图像的机器学习框架，用于监测工业规模的屋顶光伏系统，通过集成OpenStreetMap建筑几何数据，作者训练了一个随机森林模型以识别太阳能电池板的独特光谱特征。
AI.motivation: 鉴于太阳能光伏基础设施的快速扩张，现有行政记录难以保持最新，商业高分辨率图像虽有用但成本高昂且更新频率低，作者旨在开发一种可扩展的监测方法，以填补此信息缺口。
AI.method: 作者采用了机器学习方法，特别是随机森林模型，结合多光谱Sentinel-2卫星图像和OpenStreetMap的建筑几何数据，来识别光伏模块的光谱特征，并开发了一个基于Web的交互式原型工具，提供实时卫星观测，用户可以评估工业建筑屋顶上是否存在光伏系统。
AI.result: 研究成果表明，开源的中分辨率数据可以有效地用于监测工业规模的屋顶光伏系统。系统能够实时提供卫星观测，并根据预测的质量指标提示是否存在需要手动验证的情况。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明，廉价且开源的卫星数据可以替代昂贵的商业图像，提供一种有效且具成本效益的光伏系统监测方法，有助于促进碳中和能源系统的发展。

title: EGIP: An Evidence-Grounded Interaction Protocol for Clinical Agents
summary: Interactive clinical agents acquire evidence through patient dialogue and diagnostic examinations, yet their performance also depends on how the interaction environment exposes information, available actions, and examination results. When these conditions are implicit or inconsistently controlled, final-answer accuracy can conflate diagnostic reasoning with the effects of the interaction protocol. We propose the \textbf{E}vidence-\textbf{G}rounded \textbf{I}nteraction \textbf{P}rotocol (EGIP), which enforces role-specific information boundaries, exposes diagnostic actions without revealing their results, retrieves examination results from stored clinical records, and organizes acquired evidence for final decision-making. By separating evidence acquisition from terminal prediction, EGIP enables different decision strategies to operate on the same observations. We evaluate EGIP across two clinical-agent frameworks, five datasets, and six language models. EGIP improves diagnostic accuracy over native baselines across all primary comparisons. A clinician review further shows that the proportion of automatically scored correct responses jointly judged evidence-supported rises from 10.20\% to 36.55\%. These findings support the effectiveness of EGIP as a unified interaction protocol for improving clinical-agent performance through controlled evidence access and acquisition.

AI.tldr: EGIP 证据引导交互协议通过控制证据的访问和获取，提高了临床代理的性能，尤其是在诊断准确性方面。
AI.motivation: 目前临床代理的性能不仅取决于其自身的推理能力，还受到交互环境因素的影响。现有框架下，交互过程中的证据暴露不明确或控制不一致会影响最终诊断结果的准确性。
AI.method: EGIP 设计了一个角色特定信息边界，不显示诊断行动的结果，从临床记录中检索检查结果，并组织获得的证据以供最终决策。这种方法将证据获取与最终预测隔离开来，使得不同的决策策略可以在相同的数据上运行。
AI.result: EGIP 在两个临床代理框架、五个数据集和六个语言模型上的评估表明，其在所有主要对比中的诊断准确率均超过了原生基线。进一步的临床评审结果显示，自动评分的正确响应中证据支持的比例从10.20%提高到36.55%。
AI.conclusion: EGIP 作为统一的交互协议，通过受控的证据访问和获取，有效地提高了临床代理的性能。

title: IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Improving every agent in an LLM-based multi-agent system can be prohibitively costly, making it important to identify which agent should be prioritized to achieve the greatest system-level gain with limited resources. Failure attribution can inform this decision, but an agent's responsibility for failures does not directly reveal the system-level gains achievable by improving it. We therefore introduce IF-MAP, an influence-function-inspired method for identifying agents with high potential for system-level improvement. For each agent, IF-MAP measures end-to-end loss changes under controlled semantic prompt perturbations, fits a regularized local response model in a low-dimensional prompt-embedding subspace, and uses the estimated response norm as a priority score. This black-box procedure requires no access to model parameters or gradients and produces agent priorities that can guide subsequent improvement effort. We evaluate IF-MAP across six multi-agent workflows spanning code generation, question answering, and mathematical reasoning, using the same priorities for prompt optimization and model upgrades. Optimizing the selected agents' prompts achieves a macro-average gain of 3.81 percentage points, compared with 1.85 for uniform agent selection. Across five target models, upgrading the selected agents yields macro-average gains of 7.62-16.42 percentage points, compared with 3.81-8.62 for uniform agent selection. Despite its probing overhead, IF-MAP reduces Qwen3-8B and DeepSeek-V3.2 token use by 74.2% and 35.2%, respectively, relative to optimizing every agent, and reduces target-model tokens by 63.6-64.9% relative to upgrading every agent. These results support the use of IF-MAP to identify promising agents and direct improvement effort toward greater end-to-end performance gains.

AI.tldr: IF-MAP 是一种新颖的方法，用于评估多智能体系统中每个智能体的改进潜力。通过控制语义提示扰动测量端到端损失变化，拟合正则化局部响应模型，并利用估计的响应范数作为优先级评分，IF-MAP 能够指导后续的改进工作，而无需访问模型参数或梯度。
AI.motivation: 在有限资源下，提高LLM多智能体系统中哪个智能体才能获得最大的系统级增益是一个挑战。IF-MAP 方法旨在通过评估每个智能体的改进潜力来优化资源分配问题。
AI.method: IF-MAP 方法首先对每个智能体进行端到端损失变化的测量，然后在其语义嵌入子空间中拟合一个正则化局部响应模型，并使用估计的响应范数作为优先级得分。这种方法不依赖于模型参数或梯度，提供了一种黑盒的操作方式。
AI.result: 在对六种包含代码生成、问答和数学推理的多智能体工作流进行评估后，优化选择的智能体的提示显示了显着的改进，总体上有3.81%的增益，而均匀选择智能体的改进为1.85%。升级选定智能体在目标模型上实现了7.62-16.42%的增益，而均匀升级所有智能体的增益为3.81-8.62%。相对于优化所有智能体，IF-MAP 将 Qwen3-8B 和 DeepSeek-V3.2 的令牌使用量减少了74.2% 和35.2%，并且相对于升级所有智能体，将目标模型令牌减少了63.6-64.9%。
AI.conclusion: IF-MAP 的结果支持将这种方法用于识别有可能带来显著最终端到端性能增益的智能体，并将改进 effort 向这些智能体倾斜。

title: Super-resolution as Spatial Downscaling: Coherence, Structure and Task Utility in Earth Observation
summary: Learned satellite super-resolution is commonly assessed by pixel fidelity and potential downlink savings, but these criteria do not establish whether the reconstructed field preserves spatial structure or supports reliable downstream analysis. We treat single-image super-resolution as a spatial downscaling problem and evaluate four lightweight networks, including our compact 0.36 million-parameter model, against interpolation using pixel metrics, directional variograms, spectral band correlation, codispersion and observation coherence. On 735 satellite tiles from 190 scenes, the networks differ by at most 0.03dB and outperform bicubic interpolation by $1.39-1.42$dB at $\times 2$. They recover about 30% of the spectral power above the observation's Nyquist frequency and, at $\times 4$, produce more isotropic fields than the reference (range anisotropy 0.59 against 0.49). Energy-based metrics can favour invented detail. Enforcing coherence reaches the quantisation limit, yet at least 99.7% of the remaining error lies in the observation operator's null space, which coherence cannot constrain. Under spatially blocked, paired evaluation with two backbones and a sharpening control, learned reconstruction changes land-use accuracy by $-1.0$ to $+3.1$ percentage points (significant in 7 of 24 comparisons) and building-change F1 by $-0.015$ to $+0.024$ (none significant) relative to bicubic interpolation, and amplifies spurious change between two observations of an unchanged scene by $1.3-1.5$ times where interpolation attenuates it. Full-resolution JPEG\,2000 matches or exceeds reduced-resolution transmission with reconstruction at every matched bitrate. Learned reconstruction is most useful when only low-resolution imagery is available, and its evaluation should combine pixel metrics with spatial structure, observation coherence and task-level tests under spatial validation.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了四种轻量级卫星超分辨率网络，发现它们在2倍增强时优于双三次插值1.39-1.42 dB，在4倍增强时产生的场比参考更为各向同性。尽管学习重建可能改变土地利用精度和建筑变化F1，但在实际场景中，全分辨率JPEG 2000与降分辨率传输具有相似效果。因此，评估这种重建应当结合像素度量、空间结构、观测相干性和基于任务的测试。
AI.motivation: 传统评估卫星超分辨率的方法主要依赖于像素保真度和潜在的下行链路节省，但这些标准并没有充分体现重建图像在保持空间结构和后续分析可靠性方面的能力。研究旨在填补这一空白，通过将单图像超分辨率问题视为空间降尺度问题，开发并评估多个轻量级模型。
AI.method: 研究团队开发并测试了四种轻量级网络，并通过与双三次插值、像素度量、方向变异图、光谱带相关性等多种方法进行了对比。评估基于735个卫星瓦片，覆盖190个场景。使用多个能量基于的度量标准进行综合评估。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，这四个网络在2倍增强时比双三次插值高出1.39-1.42 dB，在4倍增强时虽然与参考相比更为各向同性，但特定条件下仍然存在一些差异。然而，这些差异并不能完全反映空间结构的保持情况。尽管能量度量标准可能偏好虚构的细节，强制相位一致可以达到量化极限，但大多数剩余误差都存在于观测算子的零空间中，这一点无法通过强制相位一致性来控制。
AI.conclusion: 最终，研究强调了评估卫星超分辨率重建效果需要综合考量像素指标、空间结构、观测相关性以及具体任务测试。即使在仅使用低分辨率图像的情况下，学习重建也显示出显著优势，因此其评价应结合多方面标准。

title: From Stories to Features: Scaling Concept Vectors for AI Alignment & Interpretability
summary: We study feature vectors: directions in a language model's activation space that correspond to human-interpretable concepts, such as honesty or deception. Existing unsupervised methods like sparse autoencoders attempt to recover the whole feature space, often at the cost of feature quality and interpretability. We take a more pragmatic route: focusing on concepts relevant to AI safety and alignment, we generate synthetic concept-antagonist story pairs and use the difference of their mean model activations as a feature vector. We scale this approach to 1,036 alignment-relevant concepts using 2M synthetic stories across multiple languages and genres, which we publicly release. Across six models from three model families, our feature vectors reliably generalize to detecting their corresponding concepts in chat dialogues and web text. They form an interpretable geometry shared across models and can causally steer model behavior when injected into activations. We further use these features to analyze model representations during jailbreak attacks, mathematical and agentic reasoning. Our targeted feature construction thus offers a scalable route to studying concepts in language models, potentially extending to millions of features across arbitrary domains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了特征向量，即语言模型激活空间中可由人类解释的概念方向，如诚实或欺骗。为了提高特征质量和可解释性，作者通过生成合成概念对抗故事对，并使用它们的平均模型激活差异来构建特征向量，这种方法能够可靠地在多个模型和语言中泛化。此外，还利用这些特征对模型在脱域攻击、数学和代理推理中的表现进行了分析。
AI.motivation: 现有的无监督方法如稀疏自动编码器试图恢复整个特征空间，但常常牺牲特征的质量和可解释性。本文则采取了一种更务实的方法，专注于与AI安全和对齐相关的概念，通过生成合成概念对抗故事对并提取其平均模型激活差异来构建特征向量。
AI.method: 作者利用100多万个合成故事，跨越多种语言和类型，针对1000多个与对齐相关的概念生成特征向量。这些特征向量在六个不同模态的多种语言模型中都表现出了较好的识别效果，能够引导模型行为。
AI.result: 构建的特征向量能够可靠地检测对应的概念在对话和网络文本中的表现，并且形成了跨模型共享的可解释几何结构，可以用于引导模型行为和分析脱域攻击中的模型表示。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法为研究语言模型中的概念提供了一种可扩展的途径，未来或可应用于数百万个概念的不同领域研究中。

title: Bridging Exploration and Persona: Information-Directed Dueling for Test-Time Agent Personalization
summary: Effective test-time personalization requires LLM agents to adapt to query-dependent user preferences from lightweight interaction. We study persona selection with binary comparisons between candidate responses as the online signal. We present ID-TAP, a scalable, IDS-inspired neural dueling-bandit framework for large discrete persona spaces. ID-TAP combines a query-conditioned neural utility model with a lightweight Bradley-Terry explorer, and transfers comparison evidence across related queries through similarity-weighted warm starts. The neural model shares statistical strength across queries while preserving query-specific scores, and efficient BT updates score hypothetical challengers. Across seven user-conditioned generation benchmarks under reference- and model-based preference simulators, ID-TAP achieves the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated baselines within a fixed ten-round comparison budget. These results support information-directed challenger selection as an effective design for test-time persona adaptation.

AI.tldr: ID-TAP 是一种高效的在线信号驱动的神经网络双竞冠军策略，它能够在有限的查询比较预算内实现最佳的生成基准性能。
AI.motivation: 为了提高语言模型在测试时间的个性化能力，需要设计一种能够从轻量级交互中适应查询依赖的用户偏好方法。
AI.method: ID-TAP 结合了查询条件的神经效用模型和轻量级的 Bradley-Terry 探索者，通过相似性加权的预热传递比较证据。
AI.result: 在七个用户条件生成基准测试中，ID-TAP 在参考偏好模拟器和模型偏好模拟器下均表现最优。
AI.conclusion: 信息导向的挑战者选择是测试时间人物适应的有效设计。

title: How Much Can We Prune? Exploring the Performance Limits of Visual Token Pruning
summary: Visual token pruning is increasingly used to reduce the memory and inference costs of vision-language models. Existing work has largely focused on designing method-specific selectors and demonstrating incremental improvements over prior methods at selected token budgets. It remains unclear whether the resulting performance reflects an inherent limit of visual token pruning or the limitations of current token-selection algorithms. We take a complementary perspective and ask: \emph{how well can visual token pruning perform when offline search cost is not the primary constraint?} We formulate pruning for general image understanding as selecting, under a fixed budget, one shared visual-token subset that supports a broad distribution of questions about an image. We approximate this utility with a finite auxiliary QA set generated by a frontier VLM and optimize a teacher-forced answer-probability objective with the evaluated model frozen. Motivated by the conceptual monotonicity and diminishing returns of adding visual evidence, we construct nested subsets greedily and introduce \emph{QA mini-batch greedy} (QA-MBG), which estimates token marginal gains from randomly sampled QA components at each step. Empirically, QA-MBG is both cheaper and more effective than full greedy. With one frontier-VLM call and approximately $0.5$ H100 GPU-hours per image, it produces a nested subset trajectory covering keep ratios up to $0.3$. Across Qwen3-VL-4B and Gemma~4 E4B on $900$ images from nine benchmarks, we find significant headroom over evaluated pruning baselines on held-out QA and image-grounded long-form generation, while the searched subsets substantially narrow the gap to full-token inference.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过一种贪婪策略和小批量策略，即QA mini-batch greedy (QA-MBG)，生成图像理解的共享视觉子集，从而在较低的计算成本下实现高效 pruning。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要集中在设计特定的选择器和展示在选定标记预算上逐步改进的增量结果，但无法明确区分标记pruning的实际性能极限是否受到当前标记选择算法的约束。因此，本文研究如何在在线搜索成本不是一个主要约束时，标记pruning所能达到的最佳性能。
AI.method: 作者通过构建嵌套子集和引入QA mini-batch greedy (QA-MBG) 策略，优化带有教师强迫答案可能性目标的评估模型。这种方法利用了视觉证据添加的概念单调性和逐步回报，用随机抽取的QA部件估计标记的边际增益。该方法在较低成本下实现有效 pruning。
AI.result: 实验证明，QA-MBG不仅比完整贪婪策略更省成本，同时更有效。作者使用一个前沿VLM和约0.5个H100 GPU小时/张图像，生成了一个嵌套子集轨迹，涵盖保留比率高达0.3。在Qwen3-VL-4B和Gemma~4 E4B上，该方法在900个来自九个基准测试的图像上，在保留待验证问题和图像本领土壤长格式生成中，显著优于现有评估剪枝基线，同时搜索子集缩小了与完整标记推理的差距。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了在较低计算成本下优化图像理解的视觉标记pruning的有效性，并提供了在实际应用中的潜力。

title: Training with Ciphers to Enhance In-Context Terminology Learning For Translation from Rare Languages
summary: Fine-tuning LLMs with in-context examples (IC-Train) lets translation models adapt to new parallel data at deployment, but it is unclear whether they actually learn the translations of rare terms from those examples. We formalize this capability as in-context term learning (ICTL). We show that standard IC-Train develops this capability only weakly, and propose RareCipherFT, which strengthens it without any lexical resources. RareCipherFT pairs each training target with in-context examples that share a rare term with it. It then replaces that term with a character-shuffled cipher in both the context and the reference, so the term can only be recovered by copying from context. The ciphered fraction of training data is annealed to preserve translation quality. Across seven translation directions between English and Tamil, Assamese, Mizo, Nepali and Hausa, and four models from 1B to 7B parameters, RareCipherFT raises term recall over standard IC-Train by 5-15 absolute points without lowering COMET. Probes using synonyms, nonce words and controls for shared surface context show that these gains come from linking source terms to their in-context translations rather than from shortcuts.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了RareCipherFT方法，通过在训练样本中使用包含稀有术语的上下文示例，并对这些术语进行字符混淆加密处理，使得模型在翻译时不依赖于直接替换，从而显著提高了罕见术语的翻译召回率。
AI.motivation: 当前的LLM在基于上下文示例的微调技术中，对于罕见术语的翻译学习能力较弱，论文旨在提升模型在这种场景下的翻译效果。
AI.method: RareCipherFT方法将每个训练目标与共享同稀有术语的上下文示例配对，并用字符混淆的“密文”替换该术语，仅通过从上下文复制才能恢复。训练数据中的密文比例逐渐减少，以保持翻译质量。
AI.result: 在进行7个英-当地言翻译方向的实验中，使用不同参数量的4个模型，与其他方法相比，RareCipherFT提高了稀有术语的翻译召回率5-15个百分点，且COMET分数表现良好。
AI.conclusion: RareCipherFT通过增强罕见术语的翻译学习，证明了在微调过程中学习罕见术语翻译的有效性。

title: Trust the Edge, Doubt the Arrow: Auditing Validation Signals for Text-Mined Clinical Causal Knowledge Graphs
comment: Accepted at PRICAI 2026. 16 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables
summary: Clinical causal retrieval-augmented generation systems increasingly use knowledge graphs (KGs) mined from notes, yet extracted assertions remain candidates that require audit for patient-level EHR support and direction. We construct a directed candidate graph from 328,839 MIMIC-IV discharge summaries using LLM extraction and UMLS normalization, and evaluate three signals against SemMedDB: within-admission co-occurrence lift, cross-admission diagnosis-coding temporal precedence, and literature corroboration. Lift filters unsupported co-mentions and provides useful EHR support, but not causal proof. Coding order is a weak direction signal: among the 686 candidates where it commits, it reaches 54.2% agreement with SemMedDB, below the extractor's 69.4% on the same subset. Literature corroboration supplies independent direction evidence but covers only 30.4% of candidate relations. A MIMIC-III replication yields the same pattern: extractor direction remains stable (70.5%), whereas coding-order direction is near chance (50.9%). Thus, text-mined clinical causal candidate KGs are best treated as EHR-supported but direction-uncertain. In a leakage-controlled causal QA benchmark, lift-only retrieval achieves 35.7% accuracy; conservative causal demotion achieves 37.2% while reducing evidence-unsupported answers from 17.3% to 6.1% at fixed retrieval recall. We release code, aggregate summaries, and scripts to regenerate restricted outputs.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用MIMIC-IV数据库构建了一个包含328,839个出院总结的候选图，通过评估三种信号（同病房共现提升、跨病房诊断编码时间优先级、文献验证）来增强医学因果检索系统的性能。尽管编码顺序和文献验证提供了方向性提示，但不能完全证明因果关系，研究建议这些候选知识图应被视为受电子健康记录支持但方向不确定。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在提高临床因果检索系统的可靠性和准确性，特别关注候选因果关系的证据支持和方向性。
AI.method: 研究者从MIMIC-IV中提取了328,839个出院总结，并通过自然语言处理技术构建了一个候选图。评估方法包括同病房共现提升、跨病房诊断编码时间优先级、文献验证。
AI.result: 三种信号都未能完全证明因果关系：同病房共现提升有一定的支持作用，但不构成因果证明；编码顺序弱化了方向性，覆盖率较低；文献验证提供了独立方向证据，但覆盖面有限。此外，研究通过控制泄漏的因果推理基准测试，展示了简化证据不足的答案对系统性能的积极影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出结论，从临床文本中提取的因果候选知识图应该被视为受EHR支持但方向不确定的资源。

title: FrameScout: Scouting Query-Relevant Frames for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding requires VideoLLMs to answer queries about videos spanning tens of minutes to hours, but such long videos produce far more visual tokens than current VideoLLMs can process. To address this issue, keyframe selectors are proposed to select the most query-relevant frames by computing the similarity between frame and query embeddings. Existing selectors either encode frames independently without temporal context or process chunks in isolation with ranking objectives that are difficult to optimize. To alleviate those limitations, we propose FrameScout with two core designs: (i) a streaming selector architecture that leverages a sliding-window KV cache and successor aggregation to produce temporally-contextualized frame embeddings; (ii) a frame-query contrastive objective that aligns frame and query embeddings in a shared space, directly training the selector to distinguish relevant frames from irrelevant ones. Extensive experiments on three long-video benchmarks and six base VideoLLMs demonstrate that FrameScout consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Hubert-1102/FrameScout.

AI.tldr: .FrameScout 通过滑动窗口 KV 缓存和后继聚合生成具有时间上下文的帧嵌入，并通过帧-查询对比目标直接训练选择器，有效解决了长视频理解中的帧选择问题。
AI.motivation: 当前的视频大型语言模型（VideoLLM）难以处理长达数小时的长视频，因为它们产生的视觉标记过多。为了克服这一挑战，提出了关键帧选择器 Keyframe Selector，通过计算帧和查询嵌入之间的相似性来选择与查询最相关的帧。
AI.method: FrameScout 通过引入滑动窗口 KV 缓存和后继聚合机制来生成带有时间上下文的帧嵌入，并提出了一种帧-查询对比目标来直接训练选择器以区分相关帧和无关帧。
AI.result: 在三个长视频基准数据集上进行全面实验，并与六个基础 VideoLLM 模型进行比较，证明 FrameScout 一贯达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: FrameScout 在长视频理解中表现出色，并且其方法在生成时间上下文的帧嵌入和直接训练选择器以区分相关帧和无关帧方面进行了优化。

title: Safety Kernel: Mechanistic Alignment for Cross-Lingual Defense in LLMs
summary: The safety capabilities of large language models (LLMs) are highly uneven across different languages, often allowing cross-lingual attacks to bypass safety guardrails. Existing alignment methods predominantly rely on external alignment signals and provide limited insight into underlying neuron-level mechanisms, making it difficult to provide a unified internal target for cross-lingual safety interventions. To address this, we analyze cross-lingual safety behavior at the neuron level and identify a compact set of safety-related neurons shared across languages, termed the safety kernel (SK). Specifically, we first utilize multilingual parallel safe and unsafe prompts to compute safety contrast with activation responsiveness (SCAR) scores, identifying language-wise safety-neuron candidates from internal activation patterns. We then intersect the resulting language-wise safety-neuron sets to obtain the SK, and validate its functional relevance to cross-lingual safety behavior through activation suppression and activation-state transfer interventions. Finally, building on the SK coordinates, we introduce SK-Masked LoRA, which constrains LoRA adaptation to the feed-forward network (FFN) output dimensions corresponding to the SK, thereby focusing safety-related changes on the cross-lingually shared neuron coordinates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SK-Masked LoRA substantially reduces attack success rates across multiple languages, including languages excluded from SK discovery, while intervening on only a small fraction of internal neuron coordinates and producing generally limited changes in the model's general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过识别不同语言通用的安全内核(SK)，提出了SK-Masked LoRA方法，以减少跨语言攻击的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐方法在不同语言中的表现参差不齐，缺乏统一的内部目标来阻止跨语言攻击。
AI.method:
1. 使用多语言平行安全和不安全的提示来计算安全对比与反应活性（SCAR）得分，以识别语言内潜在的安全神经元候选；
2. 通过将各语言的安全神经元集合相交来确定安全内核（SK）；
3. 通过激活抑制和激活状态转移干预验证SK的功能相关性；
4. 针对SK构建SK-Masked LoRA方法，限制LoRA调整仅影响与SK对应的前馈神经网络（FFN）的输出维度，以局部调整与SK相关的神经元。
AI.result: 实验表明，SK-Masked LoRA能够在多种语言中显著降低攻击成功率，同时只干预少量内部神经元坐标，导致模型整体能力变化有限。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出的方法在保证模型功能的前提下，更有效地提升了大模型的跨语言安全防护机制。

title: MSCR: Jointly Balancing Utilization Across Modalities and Discovering Synergistic Information
summary: In multimodal learning, modality imbalance often lets one modality dominate optimization and keeps the model from fully exploiting cross-modal interactions. Balance-oriented methods such as the Multimodal Competition Regularizer (MCR) perform well by alleviating this imbalance during training. These dynamic balancing methods, however, mainly adjust modality contributions and do not consider how imbalance affects the formation of synergistic information during fusion. Synergy is a major source of multimodal advantage, because it is predictive gain that cannot be recovered from unimodal evidence alone. We propose the Multimodal Synergistic Competition Regularizer (MSCR), a fusion method that jointly promotes balanced modality utilization and the discovery of synergistic information. MSCR has two complementary objectives. An anti-dominance objective suppresses excessive unimodal influence and leaves room for synergistic information, and a synergy objective encourages the fused predictor to outperform a non-synergistic unimodal reference. An adaptive gate further concentrates the regularization on samples that need stronger collaborative modeling. Experiments on five benchmarks show that MSCR consistently improves performance over MCR and strengthens synergistic capability. It raises conditional recovery, the accuracy of the fused prediction on samples that the unimodal predictors misclassify, as well as the share of the model's output that InterSHAP attributes to cross-modal interactions. Its gain in conditional recovery persists when the fusion module is Transformer-based. Code is available at https://github.com/chenxinyu991-collab/MSCR.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种新的融合方法Multimodal Synergistic Competition Regularizer (MSCR)，它可以通过同时促进模态的平衡利用和协同信息的发现来改善多模态学习的表现。
AI.motivation: 传统的平衡导向方法如Multimodal Competition Regularizer (MCR) 在训练过程中缓解了模态不平衡的问题，但它们主要调整了模态贡献比例，而忽略了不平衡对融合过程中协同信息形成的影响。因此，作者提出了MSCR，旨在同时实现模态平衡利用和协同信息的发现。
AI.method: MSCR包括一个反主导目标和一个协同目标。反主导目标抑制过强的单一模态影响，留出空间以促进协同信息的存在。协同目标鼓励融合前兆超越单一模态的非协同参考。同时，一个自适应门控机制能够进一步将正则化集中在需要更强协同建模的样本上。
AI.result: 在五个基准上的实验表明，MSCR 在性能上优于MCR，并增强了协同能力。具体来说，它提高了条件恢复率（即，在单一模态预测器误分类样本上融合预测的准确性），并且增加了模型输出中可追溯到跨模态交互的份额。
AI.conclusion: MSCR 持续提高条件恢复率，并且在使用 Transformer 基础的融合模块时其性能优势仍然存在。这表明MSCR具有广泛的适用性，为多模态学习提供了新的改进方向。

title: SPELUNKA: A Framework for Finding Unanticipated Associations in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are the backbone of many state-of-the-art multimodal systems, but often encode spurious and harmful associations from their training data. While prior work focuses on removing known biases from VLMs, methods for discovering unanticipated associations for retrieval tasks remain underexplored. We introduce SPELUNKA, an automated, inference-time framework for finding unanticipated distributional biases for retrieval tasks in VLMs without pre-specified labeled subgroups, inference-time human supervision, or model fine-tuning. Given a concept of interest, SPELUNKA generates captions for related images, extracts relevant entities from captions, and selects semantically meaningful associations. A frequency-based detection rule then identifies spurious associations by measuring over- or under-representation of these attributes in a VLM's top-ranked outputs relative to their full dataset distribution. We evaluate SPELUNKA across four datasets, and find that it 1) successfully recovers both synthetic and naturally occurring spurious correlations, 2) achieves an average AUROC of 0.93 across four datasets in identifying images strongly associated with a query, and 3) outperforms baselines in finding features that are strongly associated with a given query.

AI.tldr: SPELUNKA 是一种在 VLM 中自动发现未预见到的检索任务偏差的框架，无需预设标记子组、推理时的人工监督或模型微调。它可以成功地识别合成和自然存在的虚假关联，并在四个数据集中达到0.93的平均AUROC。
AI.motivation: 当前研究着重于消除已知偏见，但对检索任务中的未预见关联发现仍有所忽视。SPELUNKA 的引入旨在填补这一空白，提供了一种自动化的方法，可以在不依赖预设标记子组、推理阶段的人工监督或模型微调的情况下，找到 VLM 中未预见的分布偏差。
AI.method: SPELUNKA 通过以下步骤工作：首先生成与概念相关的图像的标题；然后从这些标题中提取相关实体；接下来选择具有语义意义的关联。之后，通过频率检测规则来识别虚假关联。
AI.result: SPELUNKA 经过四个数据集的测试，成功地发现了合成和自然存在的虚假关联，并且其在四个数据集中使用AUROC指标进行图像与查询关联识别的性能达到了0.93，超过了其他基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SPELUNKA 为 VLM 中的检索任务偏差发现提供了一种有效的新方法，并展示了其在多场景下的优越性能，有助于促进更稳健的多模态系统的开发和应用。

title: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model
summary: We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure. The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference. Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion. We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.

AI.tldr: Muse Glimmer 是一个针对消费者硬件设计的开源30B参数因果语言模型，配备了感知编码器，能够进行多步推理、可靠工具使用及故障恢复，无需云基础设施。该模型能在单个 GPUs 上高效推理，并且在同类模型中达到最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 为了开发能够在消费者设备上本地运行的自主代理任务的高效且小型语言模型，解决现有的大型语言模型对于消费者硬件的计算要求过高，且依赖于云基础设施的问题。
AI.method: Muse Glimmer 通过整合多步推理、可靠工具使用和故障恢复等功能，将这些功能集成到一个模型中，该模型可以在消费者设备上进行本地运行，而无须依赖云基础设施。利用多语言数据进行训练，并采用约4位精度的量化方法进行高效的单GPU推理。
AI.result: Muse Glimmer 在自主代理基准测试中取得了卓越的性能，超越了同类模型，如Gemma4-31B和Qwen3.6-27B，在工具使用、多步规划和自主任务完成方面。
AI.conclusion: 通过开源 Muse Glimmer 模型，旨在促进能力强大且安全的本地 AI 代理的发展。

title: Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay
summary: Motivated by recursive self-improvement (RSI), we study how LLM agents can learn through external memory without updating model parameters. Extracting useful experience from a single attempt is difficult: flawed reasoning can produce success, while poor execution can obscure a sound strategy. Preserving its value over time is also difficult: our accumulation baseline without consolidation initially improves but eventually performs below a no-memory baseline. Our key idea is to compare attempts at the same task to identify reusable decisions and refine when they apply. We introduce Hippo, a memory framework inspired by selective hippocampal encoding and replay that learns from these comparisons when shortcomings are diagnosed. It compares the resulting experience with existing memory to merge overlaps and resolve conflicts through explicit applicability conditions. This allows prior guidance to be revised without storing every lesson as a separate entry. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified, WebArena, and Mind2Web show performance gains in all three settings and substantially fewer retained experiences than the accumulation baseline. The gains extend across the evaluated base models of varying capabilities, indicating that memory-based adaptation remains useful even for highly capable models.

AI.tldr: 研究了如何在不更新模型参数的情况下，通过外部记忆让LLM代理进行自我改进。引入了Hippo框架，通过比较不同尝试来识别可重用的决策，并在诊断不足时进行学习。该框架在实验中展示了性能提升，并且保留的经验比积累基线少得多。
AI.motivation: 传统的递归自我改进（RSI）要求更新模型参数，而更新参数可能会导致不可靠的结果。通过使用外部记忆，研究旨在开发一种更可靠且经济的方法来实现自我改进。
AI.method: Hippo框架通过比较相同任务的不同尝试来学习可重用的决策。它会比较新获得的经验与现有记忆之间的重叠，通过明确的应用条件来解决冲突。对于识别出决策不足的情况，Hippo会更新之前的指导，而不是存储每个教训作为独立的条目。
AI.result: Hippo框架在SWE-bench Verified、WebArena和Mind2Web上的实验中展示了性能提升，并且保留的经验数量比积累基线少得多。这些结果表明，基于记忆的适应对于能力较强的模型仍然非常重要。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了Hippo框架的有效性，并展示了基于外部记忆进行自我改进的潜力。这种新方法为LLM代理提供了更可靠和灵活的学习途径。

title: SituHOI: Scalable Capture of Scene-Situated Full-Body Human-Object Interaction
summary: Modeling human-object interaction (HOI) in real environments requires jointly representing whole-body motion, manipulated objects, and scene geometry, yet existing datasets trade off scalable capture against structured, scene-aligned supervision. We introduce SituHOI, a large-scale RGB-D dataset containing 18,429 annotated clips across 16 indoor rooms and approximately 86 hours of quality-screened activity. It pairs recordings from a single moving RGB-D camera with static scene scans, object geometry, language descriptions, and estimated human and object trajectories. Using the scans as persistent references, our pipeline combines camera localization and depth-based metric alignment with human mesh recovery, object tracking, and temporal refinement to register all geometric annotations in a shared floor-aligned frame. These data support FlexHOI-Bench, a goal-conditioned joint motion prediction benchmark with variable observation and prediction durations. Given observed histories, scene and object geometry, and a terminal object pose, models predict future human and object motion. We provide SharedHOI as a reference predictor and evaluate world-space accuracy and human-object coordination. On a MoCap subset, our pipeline reduces human G-MPJPE from 195.4 to 68.3 mm and object translation error from 43.0 to 28.7 mm. SharedHOI leads four adapted baselines on all three aggregate FlexHOI-Bench metrics. Data will be released upon acceptance. An anonymized code repository is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/iclr2027-anonymous-code-1DFB.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SituHOI数据集，这是一个大型的多视角RGB-D数据集，包含18,429个标注片段和约86小时的高质量活动，其中包含场景扫描、对象几何、语言描述以及估计的人体和对象轨迹。数据集支持可调观察和预测时长的条件联合运动预测基准FlexHOI-Bench。通过该数据集，模型可以预测未来的人体和物体运动。
AI.motivation: 现有的HOI数据集往往牺牲可扩展性来换取结构化、场景对齐的监督。本文提出了SituHOI数据集，以解决这一问题，实现大范围、多视角的高质量标注，旨在推动HOI研究的进步。
AI.method: 我们的方法通过将扫描作为持久性参考，将摄像头定位、深度基础度量对齐、人体网格恢复、对象跟踪及时间调节相结合，实现了几何注释在共享楼层对齐框架中的统一注册。
AI.result: 在MOCap子集上，我们的_pipeline将人体G-MPJPE从195.4 mm降低到68.3 mm，将物体位移误差从43.0 mm降低到28.7 mm。共享的预测器 SharedHOI 在所有三个综合 FlexHOI-Bench 指标上都超过了四个适应基线。
AI.conclusion: SituHOI数据集及其支持的FlexHOI-Bench基准为HOI中的目标条件联合运动预测提供了一个有竞争力的平台，有望促进该领域的发展。

title: What RL Brings to Reasoning: A Few Decisions the Base Model Would Not Make
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) substantially improves mathematical reasoning, but what it adds to the base model remains unclear. We investigate this through a sequence of generation-time interventions on Qwen3-4B-Base, measuring how much of its RL-trained counterpart's gain each intervention recovers on 120 AIME problems. Power sampling with the same 8,192-token output limit brings no gain beyond greedy decoding. Yet borrowing the RL model's token only where the two models' greedy choices differ, roughly 4% of generated positions, recovers 90.5% of the pass@1 gain, with similar recovery across three model pairs on MATH-500. We find that even a single opening token has a substantial effect: forcing the base model to begin with "Alright" recovers 35% of the RL gain. The opening alone is insufficient, however. Later replacements after the same opening add another 5.2 percentage points to pass@1, and the fixed rules we test for inserting reflective words such as "Wait" do not reproduce this benefit. Sparse replacement also retains much of the base model's diversity while staying close to the RL model at pass@1. At k=256, it solves 67.5% of the problems, significantly more than the RL model (61.4%) and a mixture of whole responses matched in pass@1 (61.45%). The comparison is at equal attempt counts rather than equal compute, since rl-replace consults both models at every decoding step. These results show that the opening can recover a meaningful part of the RL gain, but a larger contribution comes from later choices, which can be borrowed while retaining much of the base model's diversity. Code is available at https://github.com/CyrusZhang04/WhatRLBrings.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，在Qwen3-4B-Base模型上通过选择性和稀疏性的替换可以使模型恢复相当一部分基于强化学习（RL）训练版本的表现提升，主要贡献来自于模型后期的选择，同时保持了基础模型的多样性。
AI.motivation: 本研究旨在量化强化学习（RL）在数学推理中的贡献，并通过对比干预措施来探究其实现效果的具体来源。
AI.method: 研究通过在Qwen3-4B-Base上施加一系列生成时干预来分析其增强效果，具体包括相同输出长度限制下的贪婪解码、针对性的令牌借用以及稀疏替换等。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，相同输出长度约束下的贪婪解码无额外收益，而通过选择性借用和稀疏替换，可恢复约90.5%的基于目标奖励学习版本的表现提升。特定的起始词如
AI.conclusion: 研究结论指出，虽然起始词能显著提升性能，但显著贡献来自于模型后期的选择性借用，这种借可以保持基础模型的多样性且计算成本低。

title: MELD: Recursive Self-Improvement via Hierarchical Coordination for Multi-Agent Scientific Discovery
summary: Multi-agent scientific discovery with large language models raises a coupled learning problem: research assignments determine both which experiments are pursued and the experiences from which agents adapt. We introduce MELD, a unified hierarchical test-time training framework that jointly adapts a team-level Coordinator policy and agent-level individual Scientist policies within a single discovery process. The Coordinator generates a joint portfolio of search branches and research directives over a shared derivation tree, while Scientists develop hypotheses and execution plans implemented by a shared frozen Executor. Both levels receive alternating GRPO-style parameter updates under a shared smooth best-of-budget objective, allowing team organization and individual research behavior to co-evolve in a recursive self-improvement loop. Our analysis establishes objective alignment for the hierarchy, characterizes conditions for coordination gains over independent parallel discovery and the first-order benefit of private adaptation, and derives a finite-budget regret bound for adapted models. On 22 MLGym and MLE-bench tasks, MELD is best on 20 of them and achieves the highest aggregate normalized scores on MLGym, using a 4B backbone for coordination and research. Most baselines use proprietary Scientists, and all systems share one frozen Executor.

AI.tldr: MELD框架在大规模语言模型支持的多agent科学发现中，提出了联合适应团队级协调者策略和个体科学家策略的方法，通过共享的最优预算目标交替进行参数更新，在自我改进循环中实现团队组织与个体研究行为的共同进化。
AI.motivation: 现有的研究中，研究任务决定了实验方向和学习体验，增加了学习的复杂性。MELD框架旨在解决这一问题，通过协调者生成搜索分支和研究指令，科学家提出假设和执行计划，实现团队级和个体级策略的联合适应。
AI.method: 引入了MELD框架，该框架包含一个协调者，负责生成一个共享的搜索分支组合和研究指令树，并与科学家共同工作，科学家基于共享的冻结执行者提出和执行研究计划。两种级别的策略都根据共享的平滑最优预算目标，通过交替的GRPO样式参数更新来共同进化。
AI.result: MELD在22个MLGym和MLE-bench任务中表现最佳，且在MLGym任务上的累积标准化得分最高。大部分基线使用了私有的科学家，所有系统共用一个冻结的执行者。
AI.conclusion: MELD框架通过协调者和科学家的联合适应以及共享最优预算目标，展示了多agent科学发现中的团队组织和个体研究行为的共同进化。

title: Time-JEPA: Grounding Video World Models with Physical Time Series
summary: Video world models learn how visual environments evolve by predicting missing or future content. However, physical-state information can provide useful context for predicting how environments evolve. Prior work incorporates this information through different mechanisms: domain-specific physical laws can complicate multi-domain training, while supervision on individual frames or frame pairs gives limited attention to how physical state evolves over time. We introduce Time-JEPA, which fine-tunes a video world model using low-dimensional, temporally aligned physical time series as auxiliary supervision. Physical time series connect video representations with physical state at corresponding temporal positions, encouraging the model to preserve how physical state evolves. In multiple domains including autonomous driving, robot manipulation, and human motion, Time-JEPA improves current-state decoding, multi-horizon future-state prediction, and kinematic reconstruction over matched video-fine-tuned controls across both condition and state-variable distribution shifts. Multi-domain training provides aggregate gains over matched single-domain training in all three tasks. External evaluations further suggest that time-series supervision improves sensitivity to physical anomalies and the representation of physical interactions, including in unseen scenarios. Aggregate gains on a second video backbone indicate that the method can be applied to more backbones. These results suggest that physical time series help video world models better understand the physical world.

AI.tldr: Time-JEPA通过使用低维度、时间对齐的物理时间序列作为辅助监督来微调视频世界模型，从而提高当前状态解码、多时间步未来状态预测和动态重构，并且跨不同领域的训练能够获得综合收益。
AI.motivation: 当前视频世界模型缺乏物理状态信息，时间-JEPA旨在克服现有方法的局限性，通过引入低维度、时间对齐的物理时间序列辅助监督，使模型更好地捕捉和理解环境随时间的物理变化。
AI.method: Time-JEPA采用低维度、时间对齐的物理时间序列作为辅助监督，与视频进行微调，学习如何从视觉输入中预测物理状态的变化。
AI.result: 在自主驾驶、机器人操作和人体运动等多个领域，Time-JEPA在当前状态解码、多时间步未来状态预测和动态重构方面均优于匹配的仅通过视频进行微调的方法；跨多个领域的训练提供了一揽子改进；并且通过时间序列监督增强了对物理异常的敏感性和物理交互的表示，包括未见过的场景。
AI.conclusion: 时间-JEPA方法通过引入物理时间序列辅助监督，显著提升了视频世界模型在各种环境和场景下的性能，展示了其在理解物理世界的潜力。

title: Do Conversational Agents Need Explicit Memory? A Controlled Comparison with Raw-History Retrieval
summary:
Explicit memory systems transform conversation history into persistent representations intended to improve future access, often at substantial construction cost. Yet it remains unclear whether this added complexity yields better answer accuracy than retrieving directly from raw history. This study compares six state-of-the-art explicit memory systems with raw-history RAG on LongMemEval-S and BEAM-100K under original and controlled retrieval settings. We find only localized gains for particular question types and tight run-time context budgets, with no consistent advantage over strong raw-history RAG baselines. Oracle retrieval shows that some systems fail to preserve answer-supporting information during explicit memory construction, while others preserve it but fail to retrieve it effectively, despite construction costs reaching hours per conversation.
  Our findings suggest that while many existing memory systems for AI agents emphasize increasingly elaborate explicit memory construction, they are often evaluated without strong controlled comparisons to raw-history RAG and may underemphasize retrieval. Retrieval remains a major bottleneck when useful information is preserved, suggesting that improving access to existing information may be at least as important as constructing richer explicit memory.

AI.tldr: 研究通过对比多种先进的显式记忆系统与直接从原始历史数据中检索的方法，发现显式记忆系统的总体表现并不优于直接使用原始历史数据的方法，尤其是当涉及到特定类型的问题和严格的检索时间预算时。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在评估显式记忆系统在对话历史处理中的有效性，特别是在准确性方面，对比它们与直接使用原始对话数据检索方法的性能。
AI.method: 研究采用了六种先进的显式记忆系统，并将它们与直接从原始历史数据中进行检索的RAG方法进行了比较，测试了两种不同的检索设置（原始设置和控制设置），并在特定的数据集（LongMemEval-S和BEAM-100K）上进行了测试。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，虽然某些类型的提问和时间预算紧张的情况下，显式记忆系统有所改进，但整体上没有显著优于直接使用原始历史数据的方法。进一步的测试显示，部分系统在构建显式记忆时未能有效保留支持答案的信息，而另一些系统虽然保留了这些信息，但在检索时却不能很好地发挥作用。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，许多现有的记忆系统对于AI代理的重要性在于越来越复杂的显式记忆构建，但可能过度重视了这一点，并且在检索方面可能没有给予足够的重视。研究建议改善现有的信息访问可能是至少与构建更丰富的显式记忆一样重要的任务。

title: Learning to Compose: Recursive Self-Improvement of Shared Executable Stacks for Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Individually competent robot skills can fail when composed: tools may lack a required capability, completion signals may misrepresent physical progress, and one skill may leave a state that violates its successor's prerequisites. We introduce Recursia, a recursive self-improvement framework that treats the shared executable stack, rather than individual task programs, as the persistent unit of improvement. The stack integrates tools, skills with execution contracts, handoffs, and verifiers. Source-side execution traces guide failure attribution and the generation of missing tools or repairs to existing shared components. Generality checks, mechanism tests, and paired selection and regression gates determine which changes become the next parent. The resulting stack is frozen and reused through declarative task adapters, allowing source-derived changes to support new compositions without target-side code repair. Experiments cover LIBERO-Pro Long simulation and a physical Franka FR3 equipped with a Franka Hand. In simulation, Recursia improves success over ASPIRE by 5.8 percentage points under Pos perturbations and 15.1 points under Task perturbations. Across three physical compositional target tasks, it improves mean success over the Skill Document Only baseline by 40 percentage points. Analyses of constituent execution, candidate rejection, and inference drivers distinguish local mechanism improvements from complete task success and characterize the cost of feedback-conditioned orchestration. These results examine shared executable interfaces as a concrete mechanism for compositional transfer in robot programming.

AI.tldr: Recursia框架通过共享执行栈而不是个体任务程序作为持续改进的单元，显著提高了机器人组件技能组成的成功率，并通过实验证明其有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人技能组成存在缺陷，工具可能缺乏必要的功能，完成信号可能误导物理进度，以及一个技能可能留下违背后续技能先决条件的状态。为解决这些问题，作者提出了Recursia框架。
AI.method: Recursia框架采用共享执行栈作为改进的单元，集成工具、技能及其执行合同、传递和验证器。源端执行跟踪指导失败归因和生成缺失工具或修复现有共享组件。通用性检查、机制测试和配对选择与回归门确定哪些更改将成为下一代父代。结果堆栈被冻结并用于声明性任务适配器，允许源头衍生的变化为新的组合提供支持，而无需在目标侧进行代码修复。
AI.result: 在模拟环境中，Recursia在ASPIRE的基础上提高了5.8和15.1百分点的成功率，分别在Pos扰动和Task扰动下。在物理Franka FR3，带有Franka手的三种物理组合性目标任务中，它将成功率平均提高了40个百分点，相较于技能文档仅依赖的方法。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明共享可执行接口是机器人编程中组合传输的一种具体机制。

title: RL Teaches VLMs Where to Attend but Not How to Perceive
summary: Although reinforcement learning (RL) effectively trains Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents, the mechanisms behind these capability gains are poorly understood. Across four diverse agent environments, we investigate whether the task-success gains from multi-turn RL are accompanied by improved grounded visual question answering about the environment. To assess this, we design environment-specific grounded VQA tasks that reveal improvements in grounded visual understanding. Representational probing shows that vision-encoder probe accuracy remains relatively stable, while LLM-layer probe accuracy improves. Attention analysis further reveals that LLM layers pay more attention to visual tokens during RL training. To test whether increased attention to visual tokens contributes to VQA gains, we introduce a lightweight plug-and-play intervention using a fixed attention bias. Without updating model parameters or computing gradients, this intervention partially restores VQA gains on the untrained model. These results reveal better utilization of visual information as a key mechanism behind the gains from RL.

AI.tldr: 研究在四个不同环境中的多回合强化学习对视觉语言模型代理的视觉理解能力有正向影响，通过干预实验表明更好的视觉信息利用是其机制之一。
AI.motivation: 探索强化学习（RL）在训练视觉语言模型（VLM）方面的机制，特别关注任务成功改进是否伴随着对环境的更好理解。
AI.method: 设计针对特定环境的视觉问答任务，利用表征探针和注意力分析方法研究。
AI.result: 视觉编码器探针准确性保持稳定，语言模型层探针准确性提高；语言模型层在RL训练过程中更关注视觉标记；干预实验部分恢复未训练模型的视觉问答增益。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习提高了视觉信息的利用，这是其带来的视觉理解能力提升的关键机制之一。

title: When Do Repetition Loops Lock? Truncation Sampling, Bounded Penalties, and a Blind Spot in DRY
summary: Language models sometimes repeat verbatim until the generation limit. We study the exit rather than the entrance: given that a span has already been repeated $n$ times, when is escape still possible? Along the loop the context is deterministic, so loop survival under any sampler can be computed exactly from one forward pass. Pure sampling leaves a positive escape probability at every step; top-$p$ with threshold $π>1/2$ locks a position exactly when the continuation probability reaches $π$. A bounded penalty can leave a position locked; a penalty that outgrows the model's preference for the loop over unseen tokens guarantees escape under top-$p$. The same analysis predicts a blind spot in the widely deployed DRY sampler: its sequence breakers cap the penalty at $λb^{g-1-a}$ for loops whose longest breaker-free run has $g$ tokens. On eleven open models, 66\% of locked units with $g=6$ stay locked under DRY and 1\% with $g=8$. In free generation with llama.cpp, all 109 loops that survive DRY have $g\le 7$. We propose DRY-C, which adds a term that grows exponentially with the number of verbatim recurrences, up to its look-back window. With it, none of 720 structured-output generations looped to the length limit, and task completion stayed close to DRY's.

AI.tldr: 研究语言模型中重复生成的情况，提出了一种计算重复生成行为的方法，分析了不同采样策略下的逃逸概率，并针对广泛使用的DRY采样器提出改进方案DRY-C。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在生成过程中有时会重复相同的词组直到生成限制，现有采样技术（如纯采样、top-p采样等）对于重复生成行为的逃逸机制理解有限，试图通过修正采样器提高生成灵活性和多样性。
AI.method: 文章作者通过理论分析和实验对比，研究了在给定重复次数的情况下，语言模型是否能逃出重复生成的循环，提出了基于递增惩罚的策略，并在多种模型上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 作者发现纯采样和top-p采样存在逃逸概率，但DRY采样器对长循环有盲区。在实验中，DRY-C改进方案有效减少了循环生成的长度，保证了任务的完成率。
AI.conclusion: 文章提出了一种新的采样器D.R.Y.C.，能够有效减少重复生成的循环，提高模型生成的多样性和灵活性。

title: Pluralistic Alignment in Language Models: Objectives, Human References, and Preference Representations
summary: Pluralistic alignment aims to represent meaningful variation in human preferences rather than collapse heterogeneous judgments into a single target. Yet existing work often mixes three distinct questions: what pluralistic behavior a model should exhibit, whose preferences define the reference, and what evidence is sufficient to demonstrate success. We organize the literature around a two-layer taxonomy. Layer 1 distinguishes representing a range of human-supported viewpoints (Overton Pluralism), adapting faithfully to a specified perspective or preference condition (Steerable Pluralism), and matching the response distribution observed in a target population (Distributional Pluralism). Layer 2 distinguishes aggregate populations, countries and regions, and subgroups as human references. Preference representation, implementation mechanism, modality, and evidence quality are treated as cross-cutting design choices rather than additional forms of pluralism. We synthesize a protocol-bounded corpus of 70 works on pluralistic alignment and neighboring areas, using the objective-by-human-reference matrix to map existing approaches and identify underexplored combinations. The coded literature concentrates on Steerable Pluralism and Distributional Pluralism, while eligible Overton Pluralism work appears only at the aggregate-population level under our stated protocol. We then connect each objective to the evidence needed to support it, including perspective validity, conditional fidelity, distributional fidelity, support preservation, and uncertainty in subgroup estimates. Together, the taxonomy and evaluation framework clarify what current methods establish, where their claims exceed their evidence, and how future systems can represent disagreement without mistaking variation for faithful representation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个两层分类体系来区分不同类型的多元一致方法，包括覆盖范围（Overton Pluralism）、可导航性（Steerable Pluralism）和分布匹配（Distributional Pluralism）。此外，还探讨了实现机制、模态和证据质量作为跨切面设计选择。研究结果指出现有方法主要关注可导航性和分布匹配，而覆盖范围的工作主要集中在整体人群层面。本文还明确了每个目标所需的证据，包括视角有效性、条件忠实度、分布忠实度、支持保持和亚组估计的不确定性。
AI.motivation: 为了澄清当前的一致方法能证明什么、他们的主张超出现有证据的范围，以及未来的系统如何代表不同意见但不将变化误认为忠实代表，本文探讨了不同类型的一致性方法和设计选择。
AI.method: 通过建立一个两层分类体系，本文将现有的关于一致方法的工作分类为覆盖范围、可导航性和分布匹配，并利用目标和人类参考的矩阵来映射现有的方法并识别未开发的组合。此外，还研究了实现机制、模态和证据质量作为跨切面设计选择。
AI.result: 研究结果指出现有方法主要关注可导航性和分布匹配，而覆盖范围的工作主要集中在整体人群层面。文中还明确了每个目标所需的证据，包括视角有效性、条件忠实度、分布忠实度、支持保持和亚组估计的不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 本文不仅提出了一种分类体系，还建立了评估框架，以明确当前方法的能力和限制，指出未来的系统应该如何代表不同的意见而不会将变化误认为忠实代表。

title: Pretrained Features as Teachers, Not States: Compact Latent World Models for Visual Planning
summary: A key design choice in visual world models is what information the latent state is encouraged to preserve. Models that learn a latent space with only a latent-prediction objective adapt to environment dynamics, but the predictive objective alone admits collapsed solutions and provides no explicit constraint on the visual information retained by the latent. Models built directly on pretrained visual features inherit a strong visual prior, but tie prediction and planning to a frozen state space. We propose Anchor-WM, which instead uses pretrained visual features as a teacher for learning a compact latent state rather than as the world-model state itself. Anchor-WM learns this compact latent with action-conditioned dynamics, while distilling the dense DINO representations through a training-only distillation head. This encourages the compact latent to retain visual information captured by the pretrained representation while discouraging representational collapse. At inference, the DINO encoder and distillation head are discarded, allowing prediction and planning to operate entirely in the learned latent space. Anchor-WM achieves the best average success rate across the four evaluated environments while enabling substantially faster planning than world models operating directly on DINO patch features. These results show that pretrained visual features can effectively guide world-model learning without defining the state space used for prediction and planning.

AI.tldr: Anchor-WM 使用预训练视觉特征作为学习紧凑潜空间的老师，而不仅仅是作为世界模型的状态。通过条件动作动力学和通过训练唯一的蒸馏头提取密集的 DINO 表征，它鼓励紧凑的潜空间保留由预训练表示捕获的视觉信息，同时防止表示坍塌。这有助于提高预测和规划的速度。
AI.motivation: 当前的视觉世界模型存在不足，仅靠预测目标容易导致表示坍塌，缺乏对保留视觉信息的具体约束。而基于预训练视觉特征的方法，则将预测和规划绑定在冻结的状态空间中。因此，需要一种新的方法来有效地学习知识并指导世界模型的构建。
AI.method: Anchor-WM 使用预训练视觉特征作为指导，通过条件动作动力学和仅在训练过程中使用的蒸馏头抽取稠密的 DINO 表征，使得紧凑的潜空间能够保留预训练表示捕获的视觉信息，同时防止表示坍塌。
AI.result: Anchor-WM 在测试的四个环境中表现出最佳的平均成功率，并且比直接在 DINO 贴片特征上运行的世界模型具有更快速的规划。
AI.conclusion: 预训练的视觉特征能够有效地指导世界模型的学习，而无需定义用于预测和规划的状态空间。

title: DiffuPlan: Editable Planning State for Diffusion Language Model Agents
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) are emerging as an alternative to autoregressive (AR) language models, yet dLLM agents largely inherit an interaction protocol designed for AR generation: once intermediate state is written, later observations can only be incorporated by appending more text. This is a poor match to a defining capability of dLLMs -- reconstructing earlier text conditioned on context that appears both before and after it. We ask whether this capability can support a different agent-state paradigm in which intermediate planning state is directly revisable as evidence arrives. We introduce DiffuPlan, a diffusion search agent that maintains a single editable planning state and reconstructs only the affected steps when later evidence resolves an entity or changes the search route. To support variable-length revisions, we introduce Expansion-Partition Marginalization (EPM), which marginalizes over equivalent expansion paths. We further adapt diffusion trajectory RL to multi-turn search. Across four multi-hop QA benchmarks, DiffuPlan achieves 50.24 average F1, outperforming strong AR search agents. More importantly, under identical data and training, editable planning state improves the diffusion agent by 2.44 F1 versus only 0.47 for its AR source model. These results show that dLLMs need not imitate append-only AR agents: revising committed state is a distinct agentic advantage.

AI.tldr: DiffuPlan 利用扩散模型提供了一种新的交互模式，通过维护可编辑的规划状态和仅重新生成受影响的步骤，从而在多跳问答任务上优于传统的自回归语言模型。
AI.motivation: 传统的自回归语言模型在处理上下文关联强的文本生成任务时存在局限性，无法灵活地根据新信息更新早期生成的内容。扩散语言模型（dLLMs）具有基于上下文的局部重新生成能力，但现有互动机制未能充分利用这一特性。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的扩散搜索代理 DiffuPlan，通过维护单一可编辑的规划状态并仅在证据解决实体或改变搜索路径时重建受影响的步骤，引入了扩展-分区边缘化（EPM）来支持可变长度的修订。
AI.result: 在四个多跳问答基准测试中，DiffuPlan 达到了平均 F1 分数50.24，优于强大的自回归搜索代理。此外，在相同的训练和数据条件下，可编辑的规划状态使扩散代理获得了2.44 F1 分数的提升，而自回归模型仅提高了0.47。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，扩散语言模型无需模仿只能追加文本的自回归代理。可修订的预设状态为代理提供了独特的优势。

title: ConCI: A Controlled Counterfactual Benchmark for Contextual Integrity in LLMs
summary: Contextual integrity (CI) holds that the appropriateness of sharing personal information depends on the context of the information flow, not on the information alone. However, existing CI benchmarks often use independent scenarios that vary multiple CI parameters simultaneously and are dominated by inappropriate flows, making it unclear whether correct predictions reflect sensitivity to context or a general refusal tendency. We present ConCI, a controlled-counterfactual benchmark in which an anchor flow is paired with two counterfactuals that each modify a single CI parameter. The resulting triplet is scored jointly, with credit given only when all three flows are judged correctly. Built from six existing benchmarks, ConCI contains 1,592 flows in 556 triplets, is approximately label-balanced, and is validated by seven human annotators per flow. Across seven LLMs, many correct anchor predictions fail on at least one counterfactual, and even the strongest model errs on about a fifth of triplets. Furthermore, models perform near ceiling on inappropriate flows but weaker on appropriate ones, often continuing to judge a flow inappropriate even when a contextual change should make it appropriate. Larger models narrow this bias toward non-disclosure but do not eliminate it, and reasoning yields only modest gains.

AI.tldr: ConCI 是一个新的基准测试，通过将基准数据集中的每个锚定信息流与两个只改变一个情境完整性参数的反事实信息流配对来改善对情境感知的理解，从而评估模型在不同情境下预测个人数据分享的恰当性。
AI.motivation: 现有的情境完整性基准测试通常使用多个情境参数同时变化且倾向于不适当透露信息的场景，导致难以区分模型的敏感性是否真正基于情境感知。ConCI 旨在提供一个更控制的情境，让模型基于个别情境因素进行决策，从而提高对情境感知的理解。
AI.method: ConCI 由六个现有基准测试构建而成，包含1592个信息流和556个三元组，采用七名人标注者校验每个信息流，同时评估了七个不同的大型语言模型。
AI.result: 许多模型在锚定信息流的正确预测上存在偏差，无法正确判断反事实信息流，尤其是在适当的情境下，性能明显较弱。更大的模型虽然减少了一些这种披露偏差，但未能消除全部偏差，且推理能力仅有适度的提升。
AI.conclusion: ConCI 提供了一个更严格的测试环境，明确衡量模型的情境完整性评估能力，揭示了现有模型在某些情境下判断失误的问题，并提示在未来的工作中需进一步改进这一方面的能力。

title: BlenderWorld: Benchmarking Visual Agents for 3D Creation from Real-World References
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled them to act as autonomous agents, creating and editing 3D models via code or direct software manipulation. In practical workflows, these models must infer object shapes, materials, spatial layouts, and lighting from diverse references while strictly following instructions to reconstruct, modify, or design 3D content. However, existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of such open-ended requests across real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce BlenderWorld, the first comprehensive benchmark dedicated to evaluating frontier models on realistic 3D creation tasks. BlenderWorld comprises 223 tasks spanning architecture, products, natural environments, and scientific visualization, driven by text, image, video, and structured specification inputs. To rigorously assess these complex deliverables, we establish a unified evaluation protocol: we render the submitted Blender projects from multiple viewpoints and evaluate them against 2,651 task-specific binary rubrics alongside holistic visual quality scores. Benchmarking thirteen frontier models reveals that GPT-6-Astra achieves the highest overall fused score of 79.9, followed by Opus-5 (73.0) and GPT-5.6-Sol (67.7). Ultimately, our findings reveal a critical bottleneck: while current models can parse broad instructions, they still profoundly struggle with fine-grained 3D spatial coherence and accurate structural reproduction in Blender, leaving substantial headroom for future 3D-native agentics.

AI.tldr: 介绍了BlenderWorld，这是一个用于评估先进3D创作模型的基准，涵盖了多种类型的3D任务，并采用新的评估协议进行评价。
AI.motivation: 目前的基准测试未能充分涵盖实际工作流中关于开放式3D创作请求的能力，BlenderWorld旨在填补这一空白，提供一个全面的基准测试来评估模型。
AI.method: BlenderWorld包含223个任务，驱动文本、图像、视频和结构化规范输入。采用多视角渲染并与2,651个任务特异性二元评分类和整体视觉质量分数进行对比评估。
AI.result: 对十三个先进模型进行评估后，发现GPT-6-Astra的整体得分最高（79.9），其次是Opus-5（73.0），GPT-5.6-Sol（67.7）。模型在理解广泛指令方面表现良好，但在3D空间细化一致性及结构重建方面仍存在困难。
AI.conclusion: BlenderWorld揭示了当前3D智能代理面临的瓶颈，并提供了改进方向，特别是在3D空间细化一致性和结构准确再现方面的挑战。

title: PV-Decoding: Progressive Verification Decoding with Decode Gating for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an attractive alternative to autoregressive generation by updating multiple tokens in parallel, but their inference efficiency is still limited by the cost of safely committing tentative predictions. In particular, speculative decoding for dLLMs is challenging because speculative tokens within the same diffusion block may depend on one another, making aggressive acceptance prone to error propagation and strict verification computationally expensive. We present PV-Decoding, a confidence-driven speculative decoding framework with progressive verification for block diffusion inference. PV-Decoding partitions masked positions into directly decoded tokens, speculative tokens, and unresolved tokens using two confidence thresholds, and then verifies speculative tokens with progressively stronger policies, including single-batch, dual-batch, and multi-batch verification. This design exposes a practical accuracy--efficiency trade-off: weaker verification minimizes overhead, whereas stronger verification improves acceptance precision and robustness. Experiments on three diffusion language models across GSM8K, MBPP, and HumanEval show that PV-Decoding reduces sequential model forward passes (MFPs) by 8%--37% relative to confidence-based decoding, while keeping the largest observed accuracy drop to 1.3%. On Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K, PV-Decoding (1-batch) and PV-Decoding (2-batch) improve throughput by 7.0%--13.6% under the same hardware budget, whereas PV-Decoding (multi-batch) is slower under the current runtime. These results suggest that confidence-guided speculation with structured verification is a practical path toward efficient and reliable dLLM inference.

AI.tldr: PV-Decoding 提出了一种基于信心的推测性解码框架，通过分阶段验证推测性令牌，实现了 dLLM 推理的高效性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有的推测性解码方法在局部依赖明显的 dLLMs 中表现不佳，PV-Decoding 旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: PV-Decoding 通过设置两个信心阈值将隐藏的位置分为直接解码的令牌、推测性令牌和未解决的令牌，并使用逐步增强的验证策略来验证推测性令牌。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与基于信心的解码相比，PV-Decoding 在 GSM8K、MBPP 和 HumanEval 上分别减少了 8%-37% 的连续模型前向传递次数，并且最大的准确度下降不超过 1.3%。此外，PV-Decoding 在 Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K 上分别提升了 7.0%-13.6% 的吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: PV-Decoding 为 dLLM 知识推理提供了一种具有实用性和可靠性的方法。

title: $M^2Net$: Unifying Scale-Specific Structures and Prototype Decomposition for Spatial-Temporal Forecasting
summary: Spatial-temporal forecasting is pivotal for intelligent urban management yet remains challenging due to the intricate coupling of spatial dynamics and temporal non-stationarity. Existing approaches, while effective, often overlook two fundamental characteristics of real-world data: (1) Granularity-dependence, where dominant spatial correlations shift significantly across different time scales, and (2) Signal entanglement, where global common patterns are inextricably mixed with node-specific disturbances. In this paper, we propose a novel framework named $M^2Net$ (Multi-Scale Masked attention and Prototype network) to unify scale-specific structural learning and semantic decomposition. First, to capture the evolution of spatial dependencies, we introduce a Multi-Scale Masked attention mechanism. By downsampling temporal features into multiple resolutions, we dynamically generate scale-adaptive spatial masks, allowing the model to distinguish between micro-scale physical neighbors and macro-scale functional correlations. Second, to disentangle unique variations from shared trends, we propose a Prototype Residual Learning module. It retrieves global common patterns from a momentum-updated prototype bank and subtracts them from node representations, explicitly forcing the network to model the residual unique deviations. By integrating these two orthogonal views, i.e., structural multiscaling and semantic decomposition, our approach effectively isolates valid spatial-temporal signals from noise. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that $M^2Net$ outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on extensive empirical verifications.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为$M^2Net$的新框架，结合多尺度掩蔽注意力机制和原型残差学习模块，以识别有效的时空信号，实验证明其性能优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 针对现有方法在处理空间依赖性和时间非平稳性时存在的不足，如粒度依赖性和信号纠缠问题，提出了多尺度掩蔽注意力机制和原型残差学习模块，为智能城市管理和时空预测提供了改进方案。
AI.method: 通过引入多尺度掩蔽注意力机制，动态生成尺度适配的空间掩码，区分微尺度物理邻近和宏观尺度功能性关联。同时使用原型残差学习模块从全球共性模式中提取特征，并从节点表示中减去这些模式来突出独特的偏差。
AI.result: 在实际数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，$M^2Net$在各种时空预测任务上优于最新的基准模型。
AI.conclusion: $M^2Net$框架通过结合多尺度建模和语义分解，成功地从噪声中识别出有效的时空信号，提高了时空预测的准确性。

title: What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Fine-grained visual understanding requires distinguishing subtle differences in local attributes and spatial relations, yet remains challenging for existing vision-language models. Unified multimodal models (UMMs) offer a new opportunity through generation pathways that preserve rich visual information complementary to understanding. However, existing generation-assisted understanding methods mainly rely on generative supervision or explicit generation and have not systematically explored direct use of native generation-side representations. To address this gap, we systematically analyze what generation-side representations offer for fine-grained understanding, finding that they are more sensitive to fine-grained semantic changes, capture task-relevant changes missed by understanding-side representations, and depend on correct spatial organization for this advantage. Guided by these findings, we design GAFU, a post-training framework that unlocks native generation-side information for fine-grained understanding. It compresses generation-side visual representations into compact \(G\) tokens that preserve fine-grained visual details, enabling task-conditioned retrieval by the understanding pathway. Experiments show that GAFU consistently outperforms SFT baselines trained on the same data across diverse visual understanding tasks and UMM architectures, with maximum relative improvements of 20.00\%, 17.94\%, and 8.62\% on VStar-Bench, OmniSpatial, and VSR-Bench, respectively. Overall, GAFU converts complementary information from the generation pathway into gains in fine-grained visual understanding, providing an effective path toward synergy between generation and understanding in UMMs.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为GAFU的后训练框架，通过将生成路径的视觉表示压缩成紧凑的G标记，保留了细粒度视觉细节，使理解路径能够根据任务进行检索。实验表明，GAFU在多种视觉理解任务和UMM架构上显著优于基于SFT的基本模型，提升了细粒度视觉理解。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于生成的多模态模型在细粒度视觉理解方面表现不佳，主要原因在于缺乏对生成路径中原始生成侧表示的直接利用。
AI.method: GAFU框架通过生成路径压缩生成侧的视觉表示，将其转换为细粒度视觉细节，以支持理解和任务条件下的检索。
AI.result: GAFU在VStar-Bench, OmniSpatial, VSR-Bench等多种视觉理解任务和UMM架构上均表现出显著优于基于SFT的基本模型的结果，最大相对改进达到20.00%, 17.94%, 和8.62%。
AI.conclusion: GAFU通过将生成路径的视觉信息转化为细粒度理解和任务条件检索，展示了生成和理解在UMMs中的协同作用，提供了改善细粒度视觉理解的有效途径。

title: GLOSS-MT: Controllable Low-Resource Machine Translation with an Editable Dictionary
comment: 4 pages, 2 tables. Models: https://huggingface.co/ghanaopenai ; code: https://github.com/GhanaOpenAI/gloss-mt
summary: Adapting a pretrained machine translation (MT) model to new terminology usually requires new parallel data and another round of fine-tuning, which is costly for low-resource languages. We ask whether controllability can be added to MT, and the fine-tuning burden reduced, without degrading the pretrained model. GLOSS-MT looks up the source's noun phrases in an offline English-Twi dictionary, replaces every phrase found by its Twi translation in place, and fine-tunes a translation model once to translate these mixed inputs. We apply the same data and pipeline to NLLB-200 (600M, 1.3B, 3.3B), OPUS-MT en-tw and TranslateGemma 4B. On a document-level English-to-Asante Twi benchmark (84 documents, four domains), every fine-tune scores above its pretrained base in chrF2 (+2.85 to +5.48), and the three NLLB fine-tunes are the best open systems (50.12-50.80). A direct controllability test on human-translated Bible passages shows that the three fine-tunes tested write 79-97% of the dictionary terms, and that replacing every dictionary entry by a different term changes the output accordingly (70-97% of the new terms appear) with no retraining. We release the models, data and code.

AI.tldr: GLOSS-MT 利用一个离线的英语-图西语字典将源文中的名词短语直接替换成图西语翻译后进行一次微调，无需额外的平行数据，同时提升了多种模型在英语到阿桑特语翻译基准上的 chrF2 指标，并且通过直接的可控性测试验证了这种方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 提出了一个新方法，即 GLOSS-MT，旨在降低成本，减轻微调负担，同时不降低预训练模型的性能，使语言模型能够适应新术语，降低了低资源语言的处理难度。
AI.method: GLOSS-MT 方法在不依赖新增平行数据的情况下，通过查找源文档中的名词短语并在离线的英语-图西语词典中匹配，替换为图西语翻译，并对混合输入进行一次微调。这种方法被应用于 NLLB-200、OPUS-MT en-tw 和 TranslateGemma 4B 模型。
AI.result: 在英语到阿桑特语基准测试中，所有微调的模型均超越了预训练的基本模型。NLLB 的三种微调模型在开放系统中表现最佳。直接可控性测试表明，模型能够以 79-97% 的准确率使用字典中的术语，并且替换词典中的每个条目为不同的词会使输出相应地改变。
AI.conclusion: GLOSS-MT 方法为语言模型在无需额外平行数据的情况下适应新术语提供了一个有效的解决方案。这种方法表明，可以通过有限修改来增强模型的适应性，同时保持甚至提升模型的性能。

title: Axiomatic World Modeling for Physics Reasoning
summary: Recent research-level physics-reasoning benchmarks for LLMs reveal a failure mode that lies not in knowledge or execution, but in modeling the world being reasoned about. Models often silently alter given quantities, fabricate laws, or inject unstated assumptions to force a problem into familiar patterns, and then reason inside this corrupted world. We define this premise-level divergence as modeling drift: the gap between a model's internal axiomatic world model (AWM) and the true physical world specified in the problem. Although RLVR and PRM have yielded substantial gains in mathematics and code, their reward shapes do not directly supervise world modeling in axiomatic domains such as physics. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Axiomatic World Modeling (RLAWM), which optimizes the policy by penalizing divergence between its inferred axiomatic world model and the true physics world. RLAWM probes physics reasoning at two hierarchical levels (modeling and solving), each scored by a physically grounded reward. The modeling reward targets abstract knowledge formulation, evaluating whether the model captures the true axiomatic world before attempting calculation. The solving reward targets instantiated knowledge reasoning, checking whether the model's concrete derivation remains consistent with the axiomatic world. This two-level structure separates what world the model believes it is reasoning in from how it reasons within that world. The framework operates exclusively during training, with no extra cost during inference. RLAWM improves performance by up to +12.2 points on PhysReason and +5.2 on PHYSICS over the baseline. It also generalizes zero-shot across difficulty, source, and domain, with a 2.45x gain and +10 points over the strongest baseline on olympiad-level physics and math.

AI.tldr: RLAWM 提出了一种新的方法，通过优化策略以减少模型的内部公理世界模型与物理真实世界的偏差，从而提升物理推理问题的准确性和泛化能力。该方法能够在训练期间优化模型的空间表示，并在推理时保持一致性。
AI.motivation: 当前的物理推理基准显示，模型往往通过自我异化的方式解决不熟悉的问题，而不是基于物理世界的理解，这导致了性能下降。为了克服这一问题，作者提出了RLAWM框架，通过物理基础的激励直接监督模型世界的建模。
AI.method: RLAWM 试图通过双层奖励结构来解决这个问题，分别对模型的抽象知识构建和具体推理操作进行奖励/惩罚。它首先奖励能够正确表达物理世界的模型，其次奖励能够在该物理模型框架下的一致推理。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与现有 baseline 相比，RLAWM 在 PhysReason 和 PHYSICS 数据集上的表现分别提高了 12.2 和 5.2 个点，并在奥林匹克水平的物理和数学问题上实现了零样本泛化的显著改进，总体性能提高了 2.45 倍，且在不同难度和领域上具有更好的通用性。
AI.conclusion: RLAWM 作为一种增强物理推理理解的新方法，提供了一种有效的机制来监督和改进模型的公理化世界模型，从而提高了多领域物理推理任务的表现。其双层奖励结构不仅优化了推理效果，还显著提升了模型的泛化能力。

title: Single-Pass Decision Scores Enable Rapid Classification with Adjustable Thresholds in Medical Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: 29 pages (18 pages main text, 11 pages Supplementary Information), 5 figures, 3 tables
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) answer binary clinical questions with a yes or no token, leaving the decision threshold implicit and fixed. We derive a continuous score from a single forward pass by renormalizing the probabilities of the yes and no tokens, allowing the threshold to be adapted to clinical needs without retraining. We evaluated this approach with MedGemma and Gemma-3 (4B and 27B) on six medical imaging datasets. The default threshold was frequently misaligned with the task: for identifying normal chest radiographs, MedGemma-27B labeled every image as abnormal, whereas a validation-selected threshold yielded a sensitivity of 0.945 and a specificity of 0.696. Normalization achieved the highest AUROC on four of six datasets (CheXpert: 0.819 vs. 0.777 for raw and 0.743 for text-elicited probabilities), and a single decision required 53-79 ms on one GPU. This simple post-hoc method turns medical MLLMs into fast classifiers with adjustable operating points. Code: https://github.com/TruhnLab/llm-threshold-calibration

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个简单的方法，通过重新正则化医疗多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的Yes和No概率，实现连续得分输出，从而允许根据临床需求调整决策阈值。这种方法在多个医学成像数据集上表现出高AUROC，并且计算速度较快。
AI.motivation: 传统的MLLMs在回答临床二元问题时使用固定的决策阈值，这与实际临床需求可能不匹配。因此，作者提出了一种方法，通过重新正则化Yes和No的概率，提供一个连续得分输出，使阈值可以根据具体任务调整，提高模型在实际应用中的适应性和准确性。
AI.method: 该方法通过对单次前向传递得到的Yes和No的概率进行重新正则化，生成连续评分。实验评估了使用MedGemma和Gemma-3（4B和27B）在六个医学成像数据集上的性能。
AI.result: 实验表明，这种方法在四个数据集上实现了最高的AUROC。例如，在CheXpert数据集上，与原始概率相比，新的方法提高了0.072的AUROC。此外，每个决策仅需53-79毫秒，非常快速。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过重新正则化Yes和No的概率，使医疗MLLMs能够生成连续评分并根据具体任务调整决策阈值，这大大提高了模型的实际应用价值和适应性。

title: BanglaBBQ: A Bias Benchmark for Question Answering in the Bangladeshi Context
summary: This paper introduces BanglaBBQ, a question-answering bias benchmark designed to capture stereotypes grounded in the Bangladeshi context, in both Bangla and English. Following KoBBQ and PakBBQ, BanglaBBQ adapts the original Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ) by classifying its templates into three groups: directly translated (DT), modified to align target groups or contexts with Bangladesh (TM), and removed when deemed unsuitable for the Bangladeshi context (SR). This process retains 140 templates across six categories, comprising 76 DT and 64 TM templates. Five newly authored (NA) categories, based on stereotypes common in Bangladeshi society, are then added: marital status, age and political perception, regional origin, educational background, and mental-health status. Native Bangladeshi annotators judged all 466 newly authored templates, and 372 were retained because a strict majority of English annotators identified the intended target and rated the attitude as common enough. Each newly authored template is linked to a documented source and a verbatim quote from it. Each evaluated template also has a counter-stereotypical version of its disambiguated context. The dataset was evaluated using two open-weight models (Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B) and two closed models (GPT-4.1-mini and Gemini 2.5 Flash). All four lean towards the stereotyped person when the context is ambiguous, in both languages, and the effect of language differs by model, so English results do not predict behaviour in Bangla. On the adapted BBQ templates, both Qwen3 models are also less accurate when the context contradicts a stereotype than when it confirms it. On the newly authored templates, the closed models follow counter-stereotypical evidence almost perfectly, and all four models are more biased on the templates that annotators validated than on those they rejected.

AI.tldr: BanglaBBQ 是一个基于孟加拉语和英语的问答偏见基准，包含直接翻译、修改以符合孟加拉语境和删除的模板，以及新增加的基于孟加拉社会刻板印象的类目。经过验证的模板对带有模糊背景的情境倾向于刻板形象的回答，且语言对模型行为的影响不同。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在创建一个能够捕捉孟加拉文化底蕴中刻板印象的问答偏见基准，以提高自然语言处理模型对于多种文化和语境的敏感性和适应性。
AI.method: 通过分析原偏见基准（BBQ）的模板，将其分为直接翻译、调整以符合孟加拉语境和删除三类，并新增了基于孟加拉社会刻板印象的五大类。然后由孟加拉本地注释者对所有新模板进行评估，保留了大部分注释器认为合理的模板。每个模板都链接到其来源和引用，并提供反刻板版本。
AI.result: 使用开放模型和封闭模型进行评估时，所有模型在模糊背景的情境下倾向于刻板形象的回答，特别是在与刻板印象相悖的情境中表现更差。封闭模型遵循了反刻板数据，而开放模型的表现依赖于所使用的语言。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个针对特定文化背景设计的新基准，展示了不同语言和模型对刻板印象的处理方式，强调了文化差异和本地化注解的重要性。

title: HABIT-Bench: Evaluating Habit Induction from Longitudinal Weak Evidence in Agent Memory
summary: In long-term interactions with large language model (LLM) agents, users reveal habits through their choices and actions. These habits capture implicit user information that agents must infer across conversations. However, individual observations may provide only partial evidence about a habit or when it applies. Retaining past interactions alone does not ensure that agents can infer habits and apply them appropriately. We introduce HABIT-Bench to evaluate how well agent memory systems infer habits from weak evidence and apply them to later requests. We construct synthetic user histories from task-oriented dialogue data and controlled habit graphs. The histories span hundreds of sessions across food, finance, software, and travel. Four-choice tasks assess agents' ability to infer user habits and apply them appropriately. They include temporary exceptions, changes in habits, and suggestions that users have not accepted. Sampled tasks undergo independent human review. We evaluate eight memory methods with Qwen3-235B-A22B and GLM-5.3-Flash. The best-performing memory method achieves 33.61\% macro accuracy across the four domains. Performance remains limited even when annotated evidence is supplied directly.
