Such actions leave the success rate unchanged, and frontier models take the disproportionate branch there in up to 91% of decisive actions under implicit budgets. The most direct fix, a checker in the trajectory reward, reaches these forks only through fully proportionate trajectories, leaving 74% of GRPO groups with identical rewards and behavior unchanged. This motivates a rethink of where learning signals belong, namely where behavior diverges, which a behavioral checker can locate and the outcome cannot. Our method, ForkDPO, contrasts a proportionate and a disproportionate action at the same prefix, at silent forks on both sides of the required behavior. On a test set of unseen repositories, it lowers a 4B model's disproportionate behavior from 70.3% to 58.9%, against 67.7% for DPO at randomly chosen turns, establishing behavioral divergence as a learning signal for how agents act beyond whether they finish. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Astarojth/silent-forks.

AI.tldr: 该研究表明，在任务要求之外的防御性行为在决策点不会影响成功率，而前沿模型在隐式预算下的决定性行动中采取了不成比例的分支，高达91%。直接修复措施，即在轨迹奖励中的检查器，也能达到这些分叉点，但这仅适用于完全成比例的轨迹，其余74%的GRPO团队则不受影响。这促使我们重新思考学习信号的位置，即信号应存在于行为分歧处，而不仅仅是任务完成与否。所提出的方法ForkDPO对比了同一前缀下的成比例和不成比例动作，在隐形叉处两侧的任务要求之外。在测试集中，ForkDPO将4B模型的不成比例行为从70.3%降至58.9%，而随机选择的转折点则为67.7%，证明了行为分歧作为学习信号的重要性。
AI.motivation: 当前方法过分关注决定结果的回合来分配奖励信用，而忽略了任务要求之外的防御性行为。该研究旨在识别这些行为背后的信号，并在编程代理中实现改进。
AI.method: 通过后训练语言模型，研究在'沉默叉'（silent fork）处的防御性行为对结果没有影响。研究发现，即使模型在'沉默叉'处采取了不成比例的分支，其成功概率保持不变。利用此发现，研究者开发了一种新的算法ForkDPO，该算法通过对比同一前缀下的成比例和不成比例动作，在'沉默叉'两侧识别行为分歧，以重新分配学习信号。
AI.result: ForkDPO在未见过的代码库上的表现优于现有方法DPO。它将一个4B模型中不成比例行为的比例从70.3%降低到58.9%，而在随机选择的转折点处的DPO比例为67.7%。这表明学习行为分歧而非单纯的完成任务是改善代理行为的重要信号。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了在编程代理中识别并利用行为分歧作为学习信号的重要性。ForkDPO方法通过在'沉默叉'处识别和对比成比例与不成比例动作，显著降低了模型的不成比例行为，为代理编程领域的改进提供了新的思路。

title: SQuIREL: A Context-Relative Framework for Measuring Entity Richness in Wikidata
summary: Wikidata is a large, heterogeneous knowledge graph and applying data quality metrics requires context-specific approaches. The "richness" quality metric is currently under-researched and typically restricted to the ontology level, which fails to capture entity-specific structural depth. To address this gap, we introduce SQuIREL, a method that measures richness directly at the entity level using six dimensions: Semantic Specificity, Qualifier Density, Internal Connectivity, Reference Provenance, External Network Connectivity, and Linguistic Accessibility. These dimensions are kept disaggregated to preserve actionability for targeted editorial intervention. We apply this metric to two case studies of oil paintings (Brazilian vs. French) and writers (grouped by citizenship and gender) to demonstrate how it surfaces representational inequalities that may indicate systemic bias. Our metric successfully distinguishes between highly tailored and basic entity profiles, revealing nuances that raw counts and existing aggregate scores obscure. Specifically, it identifies structural imbalances, such as 48% of Brazilian paintings clustering as low-richness stubs against 0% in the French cohort, as well as intersectional patterns, including contrasting gender gaps between UK and Nigerian writers.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了SQuIREL方法，通过六个维度（语义特异性、限定符密度、内部连接性、引用来源、外部网络连接性和语言可访问性）直接在实体层面上衡量知识图谱Wikidata中实体的丰富度，从而揭示代表性的不平等和潜在的系统性偏差。
AI.motivation: 目前对“丰富度”质量指标的研究不足，现有方法主要关注于本体级别，忽视了实体特有的结构深度，因此需要更加细化的方法来测量实体层面上的知识丰富度。
AI.method: 研究提出了SQuIREL方法，通过六个具体维度（语义特异性、限定符密度、内部连接性、引用来源、外部网络连接性和语言可访问性）来进行实体层面的丰富度测量，并保持这些维度的分离以方便目标编辑干预。
AI.result: 研究在两种案例研究中（分别为巴西和法国的油画，以及不同国籍和性别背景的作家）应用了这一指标，成功区分了高定型和基础实体配置文件，并揭示了隐蔽的细微差别，如巴西和法国油画的结构性不平衡，以及不同国籍和性别作家中的交叉模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论表明，SQuIREL作为一个新的衡量丰富度的方法，能够有效地识别出代表性不平等和潜在系统性偏差，提出了新的视角来理解知识图谱Wikidata中的实体丰富性。

title: Precision Cotton Disease Management: Leveraging UAV Imagery and Custom YOLO Deep Learning Framework for Enhanced Detection
summary: Cotton sustains the textile economies of over 80 countries with an annual yield of 113 million bales, yet 30-60% of yield losses are still attributed to viral, bacterial, and fungal diseases that remain undetected until manual field scouting. To address this critical issue, the integration of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery with deep learning offers a scalable early-warning system; however, existing models suffer from low early-stage accuracy, poor transferability, and high computational cost. In this paper, we propose Cotton-Vision, a fully convolutional single-stage detector that synergizes three lightweight architectural innovations: Ghost Bottleneck modules for a 20% parameter reduction, Efficient Channel Attention (ECA) for adaptive feature recalibration, and Cross-Stage Partial (CSP) fusion for enriched gradient flow. The network is trained on a novel dataset collected across seven cotton fields in the Punjab province of Pakistan, comprising over 2,700 high-resolution drone images. Extensive data augmentation (rotation, shear, exposure, and saturation) expands the dataset to 11,704 training samples. On a held-out test set, Cotton-Vision achieves a precision of 97.7%, a recall of 77.7%, an mAP@50 of 85.6%, and an mAP@50-95 of 76.6%. These results represent a 10-20% improvement in precision, recall, and mAP over state-of-the-art baselines, including YOLOv5, YOLOv8, YOLOv11, YOLOv12, RT-DETR, and RF-DETR. Through a comprehensive ablation study, we demonstrate that each proposed architectural enhancement contributes to the model's superior performance, yielding a 12-16% mAP improvement over the baseline architecture. Our findings confirm that this synergy of lightweight and attention-based modules provides a robust, computationally viable solution for early cotton disease detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为Cotton-Vision的单阶段目标检测器，通过Ghost Bottleneck、ECA和CSP模块提高了模型性能，实现早期棉花疾病检测。
AI.motivation: 现有的无人机图像识别模型存在早期准确性低、迁移性差以及高计算成本的问题，为了克服这些挑战，该论文提出了一种集成先进技术的单阶段检测器。
AI.method: 该方法利用了Ghost Bottleneck、ECA（Efficient Channel Attention）和CSP（Cross-Stage Partial）三种轻量化架构创新，通过这些模块减少参数、改善特征适应性以及优化梯度流动。实验数据集由在巴基斯坦旁遮普省七个棉花田收集的2700多张高分辨率无人机图像组成，并通过数据增强技术扩展了样本容量。
AI.result: Cotton-Vision在测试集上实现了97.7%的高精度、77.7%的召回率、mAP@50 85.6%和mAP@50-95 76.6%的性能。相对最先进的baselines（如YOLOv5、YOLOv8等），Cotton-Vision在精度、召回率和mAP上分别提高了10-20%。并且系统性分析表明每个提议的架构增强都对模型的性能有提升作用，mAP相对基线架构提高了12-16%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了旨在提高棉花早期疾病检测能力的Cotton-Vision，通过实验证明了该模型的优越性能，为棉花无损管理提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: DeGMatch: Target-Aware Reasoning Data Selection via Deconfounded Gradient Matching
summary: Reasoning post-training on long trajectories has substantially improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but scaling such training to large datasets is increasingly expensive. We study target-aware reasoning data selection, where a small reference set specifies a target capability and guides the selection of training trajectories for specialization. We find that existing target-aware methods can exhibit limited target discrimination on long reasoning trajectories, while dominant population-level structure in candidate gradients can obscure finer target-dependent variation during gradient matching. To address these limitations, we introduce Deconfounded Gradient Matching (DeGMatch), which first constructs a target-relevance gate and then reranks candidates using model-specific gradients. DeGMatch centers gradients using the candidate-population mean and removes leading principal directions before target matching, reducing the influence of dominant population-level structure and improving target discrimination. Across mathematics, science, and code, DeGMatch outperforms strong heuristic, target-aware, and reasoning-specific data selection baselines, while remaining effective across selection budgets, model families, and scales. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/CHLee0801/degmatch.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种称为Deconfounded Gradient Matching（DeGMatch）的方法，该方法通过构建目标相关门控并在重新排序候选者时使用模型特定梯度来改进目标感知的数据选择。DeGMatch 减少了主要群体结构的影响，提高了目标区分度。
AI.motivation: 现有的目标感知方法在长时间推理轨迹上的目标区分能力有限。DeGMatch 通过消除主导的群体结构，改进了目标区分。
AI.method: DeGMatch 方法首先构建目标相关门控，然后使用模型特定梯度对候选者进行重新排序。它还通过使用候选群体的平均值来标准化梯度，并移除主成分方向。
AI.result: DeGMatch 在数学、科学和代码领域中优于多种基线方法，包括启发式、目标感知和专门针对推理的数据选择方法。该方法在不同的数据选择预算、模型家族和规模上均有效。
AI.conclusion: DeGMatch 改进了目标感知的数据选择方法，特别适用于大型语言模型的长期推理训练。

title: Neuro-Inspired Inhibitory Message Passing for Accurate and Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Multi-agent systems promise to solve problems by bringing together information beyond the reach of any individual agent. Retrieval and tool use can distribute this information across agents, making communication essential to collaboration. A central challenge is keeping crucial evidence visible in each agent's context as messages accumulate. Repeated information can crowd out rare, decisive evidence. Models of cortical circuits suggest a principle for addressing this imbalance: inhibition can selectively suppress shared inputs while preserving sensitivity to weaker signals. We adapt this principle into inhibitory message passing, a training-free communication router that cancels redundant evidence separately for each evidence sentence and receiver. Each round, it forwards evidence sentences restated in agents' messages, delivering each at most once to receivers whose own evidence lacks it and excluding the senders' reasoning and answers. Against standard message passing, accuracy in peer groups rose by 39-77 percentage points across three benchmarks, and tokens per run fell by 10-46%. Gains held across seven open models spanning four to thirty-two billion parameters and two commercial models, in groups up to sixty-four agents, and across multi-agent architectures including peer-to-peer, orchestrator-worker, and multilevel hierarchical organizations. These findings support a scalable design pattern for more accurate and token-efficient multi-agent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个无需训练的抑制性消息传递模型，它能够有效减少重复信息，使关键证据在多个智能体中保持可见，从而提高了多智能体系统的准确性并降低了消息量。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体系统需要有效管理信息传播，避免重要证据被反复信息淹没，提高协作效率。
AI.method: 该方法借鉴了皮层电路模型，采用抑制性消息传递机制，独立去除每个证据句对于每个接收者的冗余信息，仅传递未包含特定证据的智能体信息。
AI.result: 在三种基准测试中，该方法将准确性提高了39-77个百分点，并将每回合的消息量减少了10-46%。其效果在七个开放模型（涵盖4-320亿参数）、两个商用模型以及多达64个智能体的不同多智能体架构中都得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该研究指出了抑制性消息传递作为一种可扩展的设计模式，对于提高多智能体系统的准确性和降低通信成本具有重要意义。

title: PREEMPT: Proactive Robustness Evaluation under Editing for Media Protection Techniques
summary: Proactive image protection methods aim to defend visual content against unauthorized manipulation and generative misuse by embedding protective signals into images before release. Evaluating whether these protections remain effective under image editing is therefore critical. However, existing evaluations remain largely limited to one-shot edits, providing only a static view of robustness while overlooking its evolution under realistic multi-step editing workflows. To systematically characterize robustness dynamics under sequential editing across various protection paradigms, we introduce PREEMPT, a holistic evaluation framework. It evaluates protection robustness under both one-shot and sequential editing scenarios, covering image transformations, semantic edits, homogeneous and heterogeneous edit compositions. To enable consistent analysis across protection paradigms with different underlying objectives, PREEMPT normalizes task-specific effectiveness into protection survival trajectories and summarizes long-horizon robustness through trajectory-based diagnostics. Using this framework, we reveal that degradation behaviors remain hidden under conventional one-shot evaluation. Furthermore, perturbation- and watermark-based protection methods exhibit different failure modes, and the first semantic edit largely determines subsequent degradation trajectories. PREEMPT provides a standardized protocol for studying long-horizon robustness and offers new insights into the degradation dynamics of proactive image protection.

AI.tldr: PREEMPT框架系统地评估了多种保护范式在单次编辑和连续编辑场景下的防护稳健性，揭示了在传统单次编辑评估中隐藏的降解行为，推动了对主动图像保护的降级动力学的新见解。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法主要关注单一编辑，无法全面了解保护措施在实际多步骤编辑流程中的效果。因此，需要一个能系统评估不同保护范式在连续编辑场景下稳健性的框架。
AI.method: PREEMPT框架通过标准化任务特定效果，将其转化为保护生存轨迹，并通过轨迹诊断总结长周期稳健性。它覆盖了图像转换、语义编辑、同质与异质编辑组合作为评估场景。
AI.result: 研究发现，传统的单次编辑评估中隐藏着降解行为。基于扰动和水印的保护方法在降解模式上表现出不同，第一个语义编辑显著决定了后续降解路径。
AI.conclusion: PREEMPT框架为研究长期稳健性和揭示主动图像保护的降级动态提供了标准化协议，为评估和改进图像保护措施奠定了基础。

title: Rubrics Carry the Standard: Shapley Attribution for Checklist-Based LLM Judges
summary: Checklist rubrics applied by large language model (LLM) judges have become a standard instrument for evaluating open-ended outputs and for rewarding them during training. Two assumptions surround this practice: that leniency or strictness is a property of the judge model, and that a rubric can be improved by asking a model to review it. We test both in a controlled grading task with planted flaws and on two human-labeled datasets, SummEdits and RAGTruth. Holding the judge and the outputs fixed, rubric content moves the pass rate of correct outputs from 2% to 100%, whereas changing the judge model or the rendering of the same checks moves it by a few points. Model self-review then drifts the rubric toward the reviser's own standard: it adds requirements the task never stated and deletes checks that human labels had taught, with three reviser models and on all three datasets. To measure and control this, we show that under all-must-pass aggregation the Shapley value of each check has an exact closed form, which yields per-check catch credit, false-fail blame and unique catches in linear time. Attribution shows that self-review deletes the checks that do unique work and keeps the checks that cause false fails. A change-control gate that combines these quantities with a provenance freeze on label-derived checks holds nearly every drifting revision chain at its starting quality, with identical decisions under three judge models.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，检查表的内容会显著影响正确输出的通过率，而模型自我评审会倾向于删除执行独特任务的检查，并保留导致错误失败的检查。使用Shapley值方法，可有效衡量和控制这种自我评审带来的影响，并通过变更控制门来保持检查质量。
AI.motivation: 为了测试假设，即检查标准的利害性或严格性是评判者的属性，以及能否通过让模型自我评审检查标准来改进它，研究团队在受控的评分任务中进行了实验。
AI.method: 研究团队设计了一个包含种植缺陷的评分任务，并使用SummEdits和RAGTruth两个带有人类标签的数据集进行了实验。研究人员还展示了在所有必须通过聚合下Shapley值的精确闭式解，以及如何使用这一方法来衡量和控制自我评审带来的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现，检查表内容的变化对于提高正确输出的通过率至关重要，而模型自我评审会导致删除执行独特任务的检查，保留导致错误失败的检查。使用Shapley值方法，可以有效衡量这种影响，并通过变更控制门来保持检查质量。
AI.conclusion: 该研究认为，应使用Shapley值方法和变更控制门来评估和控制模型自我评审过程中检查标准的变化，以保持评分的一致性和准确性。

title: Where Natural Language Ends in Agents: Executable Skill Composition with MetaSkill
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Outstanding Paper Award at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Linguistic Principles for Foundation Models (LP4FM)
summary: Agent Skills express open-ended task knowledge in natural language, but composing them requires persistent execution order and upstream-output handoffs. We propose selective formalization at Skill boundaries: coordination relations with stable references and machine-checkable constraints become executable, while substantive task judgments remain within Skills. We introduce MetaSkill, a hybrid representation that preserves complete Skill packages and local instructions while making invocation dependencies and predecessor-text bindings executable through a directed acyclic graph (DAG) runtime. This interface supports explicit coordination without prescribing how each Skill performs its local task. Across 20 multi-Skill artifact tasks and two LLMs, we compare natural-language procedures, prompt-visible graphs, and MetaSkill derived from a common frozen plan per task, using the same designated Skill packages. Additional comparisons evaluate AgentSkillOS with the same available Skill packages as MetaSkill, as well as agent systems using their configured tools. Blinded artifact judgments yield favorable preference point estimates across all reported comparisons, with 95% task-bootstrap intervals excluding parity against Prompt Graph under DeepSeek-V4-Flash and OpenClaw under GLM-5.2. In audited GLM-5.2 execution traces, all planned nodes complete and all declared precedence constraints are satisfied. Together, these findings support MetaSkill as a practical interface for composing open-ended Skills, combining local linguistic flexibility with executable dependencies, explicit predecessor-text bindings, and auditable coordination. Code is available at: https://github.com/TokenRhythm/opensquilla/tree/paper/metaskill-lp4fm-2026

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种称为MetaSkill的混合表示方法，它在保持技能包完整性和局部指令的同时，通过有向无环图（DAG）运行时使调用依赖性和前驱文本绑定执行起来。实验表明MetaSkill在多个LLM上表现优于纯自然语言和图形提示方法。
AI.motivation: 在执行复合技能时，现有方法面临缺乏稳定引用和可验证约束的问题。MetaSkill通过在技能边界引入选择性形式化解决这些问题，同时保持技能的局部推理。这种新的表示方法旨在支持显式协调，但不规定每个技能的本地任务实现。
AI.method: 研究者通过设计一个基于方向无环图的执行框架来实现MetaSkill，以确保技能间的依赖关系和前驱文本绑定的可执行性。实验在20个复合技能任务上进行，比较了三种类型的提示方法：纯自然语言、提示可见的图和从共同冻结计划中派生的MetaSkill。此外，还比较了AgentSkillOS与MetaSkill在使用相同可用技能包时的表现，以及使用其配置工具的方法。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，MetaSkill在盲目的人工制品评估中优于其他方法，尤其是在使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash和OpenClaw时。在GLM-5.2的审计运行记录中，所有计划节点都完成了任务，所有声明的优先级约束都被满足。这些发现支持了MetaSkill作为一种实用接口的观点，它可以组合开放的任务技能，结合局部语言灵活性和可执行的依赖关系，明确的前驱文本绑定和可审计的协调。
AI.conclusion: MetaSkill提供了一种新的方式来调用和执行技能间的依赖关系和前驱文本绑定，展示了在LLM环境中有效性和实用性。未来可进一步研究适用于不同应用场景的优化和改进。

title: Landmark-Free and Scale-Blind Multi-View Registration of Preoperative Liver Models to Intraoperative Surfaces
summary: Augmented-reality guidance in laparoscopic liver resection requires aligning preoperative 3D liver models from CT/MRI with intraoperative surfaces. Monocular reconstruction in most cases cannot guarantee scale, albeit rigid-motion registration requires scale as an input. Our proposed framework ``SimCompose'' estimates the full similarity transformation $\Sim$, including scale, without relying on landmarks and applies the same transformation across multiple views with known relative geometry. However, reliable detection of registration failures remains challenging in surgical settings, where ground-truth alignment is generally unavailable. For this, we propose a geometry-based selector that evaluates candidate transformations without requiring ground truth. Large disagreement among these transformations is used to flag potentially unreliable registrations. Finally, we propose to use a non-rigid refinement based on a low-dimensional deformation model from Neo-Hookean simulations in the Simulation Open Framework Architecture (SOFA), without additional network training. SimCompose is trained exclusively on synthetic partial views. Its encoder processes point clouds normalised to a unit root-mean-square radius, without access to metric scale, and filters each view before multi-view fusion. Evaluation on unseen synthetic data (300 single-view pairs per run; 100 three-view registrations) shows that multi-view integration and candidate selection increase the success rate under stringent $\Sim$ accuracy criteria from 38.4% for a single-view, single-method configuration to 77%. Existing learning-based baselines do not satisfy these criteria even when provided with the exact scale. On five in-vivo patients with 92 keyframes, the rigid registration stage reduces surface error more than three-fold relative to learning-based baselines with external scale information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SimCompose的方法，通过估计相似性变换来实现虚拟现实指导下的腹腔镜肝脏切除手术中的肝脏模型与实际肝脏表面的对齐，即使在缺乏地标的情况下也是这样。这种方法在没有真实对齐参考的情况下检测到潜在不可靠的对齐，并使用低维变形模型进行非刚性细化。
AI.motivation: 在腹腔镜肝脏切除手术中精确地对齐术前CT/MRI肝脏模型与术中表面至关重要，但直视重建通常无法提供足够的尺度信息，而这对刚性配准是必需的。因此，提出SimCompose以估计包含尺度的全相似变换，并在多种具有已知相对几何关系的视角下应用相同的变换。
AI.method: SimCompose首先估计相似变换，包括具有单位均方根半径缩放的点云，它在合成不完整视图上进行训练。检测可能不可靠的配准基于候选变换间的大型分歧，采用基于几何的选择器，不需要真实的对齐参考。非刚性细化基于低维的非线性Hookean变形模型，无需额外的网络训练。
AI.result: 在未见过的合成数据上进行验证，表明多视角整合和候选选择能显著提高严格相似尺度准确度标准下的配准成功率，从单视角且单一方法配置的38.4%提高到77%。现有的基于学习的基线即使有精确的尺度信息也没有达到这些标准。对于五个在体患者的92帧关键帧，与基于学习的具有外部尺度信息的基线方法相比，刚性配准阶段将表面误差减少了三倍。
AI.conclusion: SimCompose通过估计包含尺度的全相似变换并在多个视角下应用，成功解决了腹腔镜肝脏切除手术中肝脏模型对齐问题，即使缺少真实对齐参考。

title: A Measurement Perspective on Benchmarking LLM-Generated Text Detectors using Item Response Theory
summary: Benchmarking large language model (LLM)-generated text detectors commonly relies on aggregate detector-level metrics such as accuracy, F1 score, and AUC. Although useful for summarizing overall performance, these metrics provide limited insight into how benchmark composition shapes detector comparisons or which texts distinguish detectors with different response profiles. We propose a measurement-based benchmarking framework for jointly characterizing benchmark heterogeneity and detector behavior using multidimensional item response theory (IRT). By treating benchmark texts as measurement items and detectors as respondents, the framework estimates text-level discrimination and difficulty-location parameters alongside multidimensional detector abilities. We apply the framework to a benchmark of 32K human-written and machine-generated texts across four domains, evaluated by 14 detectors. The estimated IRT item-parameter space reveals distinct but overlapping human-machine distributions, with substantial variation across domains and text lengths. The human-machine label shows the strongest multivariate association with this space, while domain and text length further contribute to benchmark heterogeneity. Detector ability profiles reveal multidimensional and domain-dependent response patterns that are not fully reflected in aggregate performance rankings. As a practical application, clustering texts in the estimated IRT space yields a compact subset of 2,088 texts (6.5\% of the full 32K benchmark) that largely preserves the comparative detector-performance patterns observed on the full benchmark. Overall, the proposed framework provides a principled and interpretable methodology for benchmarking heterogeneous detection technologies while jointly characterizing the measurement properties of the texts used for their evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于测量的基准测试框架，利用多维项目反应理论（IRT）联合表征基准异质性和检测器行为，揭示了不同类型文本和领域间的复杂差异。
AI.motivation: 目前基准测试主要依赖汇总的检测器级指标，如准确率、F1值和AUC，这些指标虽能概况总体性能，但不提供基准组成如何影响检测器比较或哪些文本能区分不同响应模式的检测器的详细信息。
AI.method: 该研究利用多维项目反应理论（IRT），将基准文本视为测量项目，检测器视为响应者，从而估计文本级的区分度和难度位置参数，以及多维度检测器的能力。
AI.result: 该框架应用于包含4个领域内32K条人工和机器生成文本的基准测试，通过14个检测器评估。IRT项目的参数空间揭示了截然不同但部分重叠的人类-机器分布，并且不同领域和文本长度之间存在显著差异。另外，文本在IRT空间中的聚类结果显示，一小部分（约占32K基准的6.5%）文本能够保留完整基准上的检测器性能模式。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的框架提供了一种规范且可解释的方法，用于联合表征用于评估异质检测技术的基准测试的测量属性，同时也可作为一种实用应用以简化基准测试。

title: Can LLM Agents Resolve Service Failures? Simulating Multi-Turn Complaint Handling under Information Asymmetry
summary: LLM agents are widely adopted in service chatbots for rule-guided support and information access, yet emotionally demanding complaint handling still relies heavily on human agents. We introduce ServiceBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark dedicated to complaint handling, with 2,500 scenarios spanning 184 complaint categories and five service industries. We propose Asymmetric Progressive Complaint Simulation (APCS) to simulate realistic complaint handling, together with a justice-based evaluation framework. Our experiments reveal that even capable LLM agents struggle to handle complaints effectively. They lack the ability to proactively gather information and strategically guide conversations toward resolution, often resorting to premature compensation. We further show that targeted post-training with SFT and DPO substantially improves these capabilities, enabling a smaller model to match or surpass much larger models on several outcomes.

AI.tldr: ServiceBench 是首个专注于投诉处理的基准，包含广泛投诉类别和行业的场景。通过 APCS 模拟真实投诉处理，并采用正义为基础的评估框架。实验表明即便是强大的 LLM 代理在处理投诉方面也存在明显不足，但经过特定后训练可以显著提升其能力。
AI.motivation: 目前的情感密集型投诉处理主要依赖于人类代理，文章旨在提供一个专门针对投诉处理的基准平台 ServiceBench，以推动相关技术的发展。
AI.method: 文章提出了 Asymmetric Progressive Complaint Simulation (APCS)，一种模拟真实投诉处理的方法，并且提供了正义为基础的评价框架。通过这个基准，研究了 LLM 在投诉处理中的表现，并验证了特定后训练技术的有效性。
AI.result: 研究发现，即便是功能强大的 LLM 代理在处理投诉时也存在不足，特别是在信息搜集和对话引导方面。但是经过特定的样本后训练 (SFT) 和动态精准优化 (DPO) 方法，可以显著改善这些不足。
AI.conclusion: 文章揭示了现有的 LLM 技术在投诉处理方面的局限性，并提供了改进方法，特别是如何通过后训练提升其在实际投诉处理中的应用价值。

title: Ghost Attack: Using 19th-Century Illusions to Fool 21st-Century Biometrics
comment: Accepted to WACV (Winter Conference on Applications for Computer Vision) 2027
summary: While the Pepper's Ghost illusion is a 19th-century optical technique, we found that this forgotten gimmick exposes vulnerabilities in modern face recognition systems. This paper introduces the 'Ghost Attack': a physical attack that repurposes this classic illusion using low-cost, free-space hardware and a transparent medium to project high-resolution facial data into physical 3D space. We show in the paper that despite relying on centuries-old optical principles, this new attack type simultaneously breaks three components of modern facial recognition systems (FRS): (a) the face matcher, (b) the presentation attack detection module, and (c) the morphing attack detection component, resulting in high impersonation success rates against state-of-the-art algorithms without triggering presentation or morphing defenses. These findings reveal a significant blind spot in current biometric systems, which fail to account for transparent projections and evolving physical attack vectors. To support further research, we are offering the dataset of face images of 100 identities, re-captured with and without 'ghost' projections as a new benchmark representing a novel attack for face recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为'幽灵攻击'的新物理攻击，利用经典的光学幻象技术，低成本地破坏了现代人脸识别系统的三大组件，包括面部匹配器、伪造检测模块和形态攻击检测，展示了目前生物识别系统的重大漏洞。
AI.motivation: 随着新攻击技术的发展，研究人员注意到现代人脸识别系统可能存在的缺陷，特别是对于使用光学原理的透明投影攻击。为了填补这一研究空白，作者揭示了这一已遗忘的光学技术如何被重新利用来挑战当前人脸识别系统的安全性。
AI.method: 利用19世纪的光学原则，作者利用幽灵攻击，通过低成本的免费空间硬件和透明介质将高清面部数据投影到物理3D空间。该方法涉及光学幻影的重建和投影技术，以模拟真实面部图像。此外，作者还提供了一个包含100个身份的脸部图像集，既原始也经过‘幽灵’投影处理，作为测试新型攻击的方法。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，幽灵攻击成功突破了现代人脸识别系统中的面部匹配器、伪造检测模块和形态攻击检测模块，即使攻击者不触发现有的反伪造和反形态攻击的防御机制。因此，这种攻击导致了高冒充成功率，这表明现代人脸识别系统对于透明投影存在盲点。
AI.conclusion: 研究者提出了全面的安全性挑战，揭示了现代人脸识别系统中的一种新威胁，并为其提供了新的测试基准。这将促进进一步的研究，以增强人工智能系统的安全性，特别是在处理透明介质的攻击方面。

title: The World as Viewed by 136 Countries: An Open, Curated, Annotated, and Multilingual Dataset of 118 Million State Media Articles
summary: State media outlets often project their governments' narratives to target both domestic and foreign audiences. Because this content is plentiful and free to access, it appears widely in the web corpora that large language models (LLMs) are trained on and that retrieval systems draw from. However, the prevalence of state media in these corpora and its potential influence on LLM outputs remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce WorldStateMedia, an open dataset of 118 million state media articles from 136 countries in 114 languages. We extract these articles from existing pretraining corpora and annotate each outlet with level of state control from State Media Monitor. Using WorldStateMedia to audit these corpora, we find that, in English web crawls, the share of state media pages from editorially controlled (vs. independent) outlets rose from 39% in 2013 to 93% in 2025. In several low-resource languages, state media make up a substantial share of all web data, such as 17.8% for Uyghur and 7.8% for Belarusian. To characterize the differing narratives of news outlets, we compare Russian and Ukrainian state media in English and in their native languages, revealing asymmetric topical focus and opposing framings of contested issues such as Crimea. Furthermore, in a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) experiment on territorial disputes, retrieving a country's state media shifts model answers toward that country's claims, most strongly for English-language (foreign-targeted) media. We release WorldStateMedia to support multilingual, cross-national insights on state media at https://huggingface.co/collections/manestay/worldstatemedia

AI.tldr: 本研究通过WorldStateMedia数据集分析了政府媒体在大型语言模型训练语料库中的占比和影响，发现这些媒体在某些语种的网络数据中占有显著比例，且其内容偏向性会引导模型产出更符合该国立场的回答。
AI.motivation: 鉴于政府媒体对国内和国际舆论有重大影响，且其内容常出现在用来训练大型语言模型的数据集中，本研究旨在探索其潜在影响，特别是在多语言环境下。
AI.method: 研究团队构建了包含11800万条政府媒体文章的WorldStateMedia数据集，覆盖136个国家和地区，共114种语言。通过对比不同控制层级的媒体在英语和本土语言中的文章，分析各媒体在特定争议问题上的焦点差异，并在涉及领土争议的检索增强生成实验中测试了语言模型的偏斜。
AI.result: 研究发现，在2013年至2025年间，英语网页上来自编辑控制型媒体的文章比例从39%上升到93%，特别是在一些低资源语言中，政府媒体占的比例更高。进一步的实验显示，在针对特定国家生成答案时，检索该国的政府媒体内容会使模型倾向于支持该国的立场。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了政府媒体在大型语言模型训练数据中占比及其潜在影响的重要性。作者呼吁更好地考虑多语言和多国家背景下的政府媒体影响，以便更准确地分析和生成多语言数据集。

title: Toward Collective Model Intelligence: Characterizing and Coordinating Models
summary: Independently developed AI models accumulate diverse and complementary capabilities, but a growing model collection does not automatically realize Collective AI. Addressing this gap requires understanding model capabilities with limited evaluation, organizing complementary models to collaborate on diverse tasks, and executing model calls efficiently under resource constraints. We present a systematic approach to pursuing Collective Model Intelligence through three connected components. First, Model Eval constructs evidence-based capability profiles by combining query-level performance estimation with cross-domain prediction, reducing the need for exhaustive evaluation. Second, Mio (Models in One) organizes complementary model candidates and supports task-conditioned, cost-aware selection and collaboration as task requirements evolve. Third, Mos (Model Serving OS) separates model selection from execution and provides endpoint scheduling and shared model deployment and distribution. Experiments show lower capability-estimation errors under limited evaluation. Across nine public benchmarks, Mio 1.0 Lite achieves the highest average score and lowest average cost among compared methods, with per-request costs 73.7-97.5% lower than those of the best-scoring alternatives. A prewarmed shared cache accelerates model-file retrieval by up to 23.3 times. This work lays a foundation for Collective Model Intelligence by characterizing and coordinating the diverse capabilities of an expanding model universe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种系统方法，以实现集体模型智能，主要通过构建基于查询级别的性能评估、优化模型的协作选择和执行，来克服模型集合不自动实现集体AI的问题。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在解决独立开发的AI模型虽然具有不同的功能，但缺乏一种有效的方法来实现它们的集体智能问题。
AI.method: 本文提出的方法包括：Model Eval通过结合查询级性能估计和跨域预测，构建证据基础的能力概况，减少全面评估的需求；Mio（Models in One）组织互补模型，支持任务条件下的成本感知选择和协作；Mos（Model Serving OS）分离模型选择和执行过程，提供端点调度和共享模型部署。
AI.result: 实验表明，在有限的评估下，能力估计的误差较低。Mio 1.0 Lite在九个公开基准中平均得分最高且平均成本最低，每次请求的成本比最佳得分的替代方案低73.7%到97.5%。预热的共享缓存可将模型文件检索加速23.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 本文的工作为基础了集体模型智能，通过表征和协调不断扩大的模型宇宙的多样化能力，提供了理论和技术基础。

title: ULIFLOW: Unified Latent Human-Object Interaction Flow
summary: Text-conditioned 3D human--object interaction (HOI) generation remains challenging because individually plausible human and object motions do not necessarily form a coherent interaction. We argue that a key limitation lies in conventional skeleton-based representations, which compactly describe body kinematics while leaving surface-level interaction geometry largely implicit, often requiring additional contact-specific regularizers. We propose ULIFlow, a framework that explicitly models continuous human--object relations within a unified latent space. To this end, we derive continuous marker--object relations from sparse body-surface markers and treat them as an explicit interaction modality alongside human motion and object dynamics. A Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) autoencoder is then designed to jointly model these heterogeneous streams while preserving their modality-specific structures. Importantly, we let the relation stream directly participate in human and object reconstruction, encouraging the shared latent representation to preserve both individual dynamics and the interaction geometry that coordinates them. To further achieve variable-length generation, we introduce a blockwise Flow Forcing scheme with global sequence-progress conditioning, enabling progressive continuation from fixed-length training windows while maintaining consistent long-horizon dynamics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ULIFlow consistently outperforms prior work in overall generation quality and human--object coordination, while preserving coherent interactions over requested durations beyond the training horizon.

AI.tldr: ULIFlow通过引入连续的人-物关系流和混合的Transformer自编码器，在统一的潜在空间中显式建模人-物的连续交互关系，从而提升3D人体-物体交互生成的质量，确保交互的连贯性。
AI.motivation: 当前的3D人体-物体交互生成方法存在个体连贯动作不一定形成合理交互的问题，提出了ULIFlow框架以应对这一挑战。
AI.method: ULIFlow框架包括从稀疏体表标记推导连续的人-物关系流，并通过混合Transformer自编码器联合建模人运动、物动态和人-物关系流，同时引入块式流动激励方案以实现变长度生成。
AI.result: ULIFlow在整体生成质量和人-物协调性方面优于先前方法，能够产生连贯的交互效果，持续超过训练时间窗口。
AI.conclusion: ULIFlow提出了新的方法来显著改善3D人体-物体交互生成的效果，通过强化交互几何和动态的一致性产生自然连贯的交互。

title: When Does Better Acceptance Pay? A Controlled Study of Speculative Decoding
summary: The throughput gains of speculative decoding depend on the trade-off between acceptance length and execution latency. We ask when additional acceptance is worth the cost of obtaining it. We establish a comparison protocol spanning training, inference, and evaluation, remeasuring released checkpoints and retraining six drafter recipes on shared target-generated data across ten benchmarks and two target models. Alignment changes the picture: gaps that appear large in published comparisons shrink substantially under shared training and inference conditions. This narrowing motivates two deeper questions: how is acceptance improved at different costs, and when do these gains improve throughput? We find that acceptance can be improved through nearly free objective and context changes or more expensive token-to-token conditioning. DCore illustrates the former route as a strong baseline with little additional measured drafting overhead. The payoff is conditional: task uncertainty and serving conditions affect acceptance returns, execution costs, and the preferred drafter and budget. These findings inform future drafter design and deployment choices.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了推测解码的吞吐量增益取决于接受长度和执行延迟之间的权衡。通过统一的训练、推理和评估协议，评估了在共享数据和模型上的表现，发现接受度改善在成本不同的情况下可以通过目标和上下文变化或更昂贵的令牌到令牌条件实现。研究表明，接受度的改善具有条件性，且与任务不确定性、服务条件等有关。
AI.motivation: 研究引入了一个新的比较协议，旨在缩小不同研究之间在公共数据和模型下的表现差距，促使进一步探索接受度改善的途径及其对吞吐量的影响。
AI.method: 研究通过统一的训练、推理和评估协议来重新测量已发布的检查点并重新训练六个草稿食谱，比较了在共享目标生成数据下的不同基准和两个目标模型的表现。
AI.result: 研究成果表明接受度改善可以通过几乎免费的目标和上下文变化或更昂贵的令牌到令牌条件实现，DCore 作为这个路径上的强基线表现出较小的额外草稿代价测量开销。然而，接受度的收益取决于任务不确定性和服务条件等因素。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现对于未来的草稿设计和部署选择具有指导意义，提示我们需根据具体任务和环境条件优化接受度和执行成本。

title: Are We Evaluating VLM Token Pruning Right? Looking Beyond Accuracy and Token Count
summary: Visual token pruning aims to reduce inference cost while preserving the capabilities of the original VLM. Yet existing evaluations rely on aggregate task accuracy and retained token count as proxies for pruning quality and actual efficiency. We reveal two limitations: 1) Aggregate accuracy can obscure whether a pruning method truly identifies critical visual tokens; many examples remain solvable under arbitrary token removal and models can exploit textual shortcuts when visual evidence is degraded. 2) Retained token count is an unreliable proxy for efficiency, as identical token budgets can incur different end-to-end costs depending on where and how pruning is performed. Consequently, comparisons based on aggregate accuracy and retained token counts fail to recover the global performance-efficiency Pareto frontier across methods. We introduce PAA-Bench, a plug-and-play evaluation framework for existing benchmarks, to evaluate whether pruning succeeds through meaningful token selection and whether this success translates into real speedup. To determine when token choice actually matters, we propose Random-Pass@k to measure how often an example remains correct under random pruning, enabling comprehensive evaluation across different levels of selection difficulty. To compare efficiency fairly, we introduce Preservation-Constrained Speedup (PCS) to report the maximum end-to-end speedup each method achieves under a shared preservation target. Experiments across 8 methods, 3 VLM backbones, and 9 benchmarks show that stronger token compression does not necessarily yield greater speedup, method differences widen on examples where token selection matters, and efficiency rankings change with the preservation target.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出PAA-Bench，旨在通过有效评估剪枝方法的实际效率而非依赖于聚合准确度和保留标记数来克服现有评估的局限性，从而揭示不同方法在不同选择难度下的性能效率前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有评价方法主要依赖于聚合任务准确率和保留标记数量来评估剪枝质量及实际效率，但这两者存在局限性。因此，需要一种新的评价框架来准确评估剪枝的性能与效率。
AI.method: 研究引入了PAA-Bench框架，通过衡量有意义的标记选择和这种选择如何转化为实际加速来评估剪枝成功情况。此外，研究还提出了Random-Pass@k和Preservation-Constrained Speedup (PCS)来更全面地评估效率。
AI.result: 实验表明，更强的标记压缩并不一定带来更大的加速，不同的方法在需要标记选择的事情上表现出更大的差异，并且效率排名会根据保留目标的变化而改变。
AI.conclusion: 剪枝后的视觉标记选择的实际效能远比传统度量标准复杂，PAA-Bench框架能够为未来的研究提供更加准确的评估标准。

title: CRISP: Progressive Illumination Curriculum for Recurrent Low-Light Video Enhancement with Semantic Priors
summary: Low-light video enhancement requires the recovery of brightness, color, and fine spatial structures while preserving temporal coherence in the presence of noise and motion. Existing methods often struggle to balance these objectives, particularly in severely degraded regions. This paper presents CRISP, a recurrent framework trained using a progressive illumination curriculum. Its two-frame recurrent architecture propagates information across successive frames to exploit temporal context beyond the immediate input pair. During training, supervision progressively transitions from intermediate targets interpolated between the low-light input and the reference to the full reference, gradually increasing the required brightness and color correction. This curriculum stabilizes recurrent training without introducing additional inference cost and yields the largest performance improvement among the components evaluated in the ablation study. To further support structural reconstruction, the framework optionally incorporates frozen DINOv3 semantic features through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN)-style modulation, without fine-tuning the foundation model. Experiments on DID and BVI-RLV demonstrate that CRISP achieves the highest PSNR on DID and the highest SSIM on BVI-RLV among the evaluated methods, while maintaining computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: CRISP是一种递归框架，通过采用渐进光照课程进行训练，能够在低光环境下增强视频的亮度、色彩和精细空间结构，同时保持时间连贯性。
AI.motivation: 低光照视频增强需要恢复亮度、色彩和精细的空间结构，同时防止噪声和运动的干扰。现有方法在严重降级区域难以平衡这些目标。CRISP框架旨在通过采用递归结构和渐进光照课程来改进这一过程。
AI.method: CRISP框架具有两帧递归架构，可以在连续帧之间传播信息，利用超越即时输入对的时间上下文。框架支持通过自适应层归一化(AdaLN)风格的调制来融合固定DINOv3语义特征，提高结构重建的支持。课程训练从中间目标逐渐过渡到完整的参考目标，增加亮度和色彩矫正的要求。
AI.result: CRISP框架在DID和BVI-RLV数据集上分别实现了最高的PSNR和SSIM，且保持了计算效率。
AI.conclusion: CRISP通过递归框架和渐进光照课程，在处理低光照下的视频增强时表现优异，并提高了结构重建能力。

title: One Head Away from Language Confusion: Single Attention Heads Across Model Families
summary: Large language models sometimes reply in an unexpected language, a failure known as language confusion. We ablate individual attention heads in 12 model checkpoints spanning seven model series, using FLORES-200 continuations in five languages and Language Confusion Benchmark (LCB) chat replies. In ten models, zeroing one head causes substantially more departures from the expected language than zeroing any other head in its layer; its LCB pass-rate drop persists, though reduced, under mean ablation. Seven heads move 8.0 to 51.5 percent of all FLORES continuations out of the prompt's language, versus at most 1.4 percent for other same-layer heads; the other three mainly affect explicitly requested languages. These seven heads matter less in base models given plain text. In two models, replacing the values a head reads at the requested-language name with another language's mean makes replies fail and shifts some into that language, unlike a random change of equal size. Replacing a head's output with another language's mean redirects 84 to 99 percent of scored non-English monolingual LCB replies into that language in five models. Yet the requested language's mean improves crosslingual replies beyond every control head only in the two Gemma models, whose baselines are low. Code and results are available in the public repository at https://github.com/christian-hoang-04/anonymous-release.

AI.tldr: 研究人员通过消除12个模型检查点中特定的注意头部，研究语言混淆现象。发现某些头部对多语言的延续生成有显著影响，而在纯文本基础上这些头部的影响降低。通过替换头部的值或输出可以改变模型的回复语言。
AI.motivation: 研究语言模型在跨语言交流中如何变得混淆，以及特定注意头对这种现象的影响。
AI.method: 通过FLORES-200和Language Confusion Benchmark测试，针对12个模型系列的12个检查点进行消融研究，评估特定注意头部对语言混淆的影响。
AI.result: 在10个模型中，某些特定注意头部对语言输出的影响最大。七个多头的值替换为另一语言的均值可以显著改变模型的回复语言，但在基础模型中这种影响会降低。特定头部的输出替换为另一语言的均值可以使非英语单一语言的LCB回复中94%以上转换为请求的语言。
AI.conclusion: 尽管某些头部可能对语言输出有显著影响，但在纯文本基础上这种影响会减弱。这些发现对于理解和减轻大型语言模型中的语言混淆现象具有重要意义。

title: ReTRACE: Feedback-Guided LLM Agent in a Chemistry Harness for Retrosynthesis Planning
summary: Computer-aided retrosynthesis has advanced through single-step prediction, tree search and route scoring, but complex targets still require judgement over the whole route, where stereochemistry, functional-group compatibility, cost and greenness interact. Here we present \textbf{\mbox{ReTRACE}} (\textbf{RE}trosynthesis with \textbf{T}ool-orchestrated \textbf{R}easoning \textbf{A}nd \textbf{C}ontext-aware \textbf{E}vidence), an agent that places a large language model (LLM) in a chemistry harness that integrates molecular tools, complementary single-step prediction engines, a purchasable starting-material library, a route memory and a multi-criterion route evaluator. Routes are judged by a new metric that combines programmatic checks with adversarial LLM review, and its verdicts are compared with a synthetic chemist's. The agent learns continually from evaluator feedback during search, diagnosing weak routes and backtracking to revise them. With Claude Opus 4.8, at least one of the top 10 routes proposed by ReTRACE passed the audit for 87.4\%, 95.0\% and 86.7\% of targets on the three benchmarks. Two prospective wet-lab syntheses show that ReTRACE route proposals can be converted into executable procedures after expert revision.

AI.tldr: ReTRACE 是一种基于大型语言模型 (LLM) 的反合成分析代理，它结合了多种化学工具和评估机制，能够在多个基准测试中提出通过审核的反合成路线，并且经过专家修订后可以在实验室中执行。
AI.motivation: 随着计算机辅助反合成分析技术的进步，单步预测、树搜索和路径评分已实现，但复杂的目标物仍需要在整条合成路径上做出判断，考虑立体化学、官能团兼容性、成本和绿色环保等因素。ReTRACE 旨在提供一种能够综合多种因素，提出并验证反合成路线的新型代理。
AI.method: ReTRACE 将 LLM 放入化学框架中，整合了分子工具、单步预测引擎、可购买的起始原料库、路线记忆以及多准则路线评估器。通过结合程序检查和对抗 LLM 审核的新指标，ReTRACE 能够判断路线的有效性，并不断从评估者的反馈中学习，修正弱路线。
AI.result: 使用 Claude Opus 4.8 作为 LLM，ReTRACE 在三个基准测试中提出的前 10 条反合成路径中有至少一条通过了审核的比例分别为 87.4%、95.0% 和 86.7%。此外，两个实验室合成实验表明，通过专家修订后，ReTRACE 的建议路线能够转化为可执行的操作流程。
AI.conclusion: ReTRACE 这种基于 LLM 的合成代理展示了其在复杂目标合成路线优化中的潜力，有望在实际的实验室合成中发挥重要作用。

title: Hexagonal Basis Projectors for Model-Based Iterative CT Reconstruction
summary: Image representation affects both the forward model and quantitative feature recovery in model-based iterative CT reconstruction. For isotropically bandlimited signals, the hexagonal lattice is the most sampling-efficient lattice in two dimensions, with greater directional isotropy and a larger alias-free bandwidth than the Cartesian grid at equal density. We develop constant and linear hexagonal projectors for two-dimensional fan-beam CT using box spline calculus. Both bases form a partition of unity on common coefficient centers; the linear tent also reproduces affine functions. We derive analytic ray footprints and effective detector-blur expressions and implement efficient GPU forward and backprojection. On simulated FORBILD data, the linear model improves on Cartesian and hexagonal pixels, with its best noisy-data accuracy at the coarser resolution. Real-world 2DeteCT comparisons use high-dose, high-resolution Cartesian reconstructions as pseudo ground truth and show competitive image and feature agreement. These results establish a practical hexagonal representation for quantitative CT.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了六边形晶格在基于模型的迭代CT重建中的应用，发现其在保留方向的各向同性及较高的无混叠带宽方面优于笛卡尔网格，能够提高定量CT图像和特征的恢复精度。
AI.motivation: 为了优化CT重建图像的质量与准确性，尤其是在保持定量特征恢复的同时减少伪影。
AI.method: 研究通过使用六边形网格而非传统笛卡尔网格来进行CT重建，开发了针对二维圆锥束CT的六边形投影因子，并进行了解析推导和实际图像重建。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，基于六边形的重建模型在模拟数据和实际CT扫描数据中的表现优于笛卡尔模型，尤其是在较粗糙分辨率下的噪声数据中。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，六边形网格能够有效提高定量CT图像的质量和特征恢复的准确性，是一种实际可行的选择。

title: P2N: Reusing Deep Representations for Greater Effective Depth
summary: Mathematical problem solving and autonomous agents are increasingly important applications of language models, demanding stronger reasoning capabilities. Computational depth is a key resource for such reasoning, but adding model layers increases both training and inference costs, while test-time scaling incurs substantial additional inference computation. We introduce P2N (Previous to Next), which reuses the previous token's deep representations, already available during generation, to increase effective computational depth with negligible decoding overhead. Specifically, P2N adds the previous token's deep hidden state to the current token's shallow representation, allowing subsequent layers to build on previously completed deep computation. This recurrence extends effective computational depth across tokens, while introducing only a single vector addition per decoding step. We train the recurrence using parallel Jacobi updates restricted to a middle-layer core. Experiments with Qwen-style models show that, at 1.5B parameters, P2N improves GSM8K accuracy by over 10 percentage points under both zero-shot and few-shot prompting, with nearly unchanged decoding latency. The benefits also extend to language modeling and average performance on general downstream benchmarks. on general downstream benchmarks.

AI.tldr: P2N通过重用先前标记的深层表示来增加有效的计算深度，而几乎不增加解码开销，从而提升了大规模语言模型在数学问题解决等任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 随着大规模语言模型在数学问题解决和自主代理等领域的应用增加，这些应用要求较强的推理能力。然而，增加模型层会导致训练和推理成本上升，并在测试时增加大量的额外推理计算。因此，需要一种方法以较低成本增加有效的计算深度。
AI.method: P2N方法通过对生成过程中已经可用的先前标记的深层表示进行重用，实现了在不增加显著解码延迟的情况下提升有效的计算深度。具体来说，P2N将先前标记的深层隐藏状态添加到当前标记的浅层表示中，使后续层能够基于早前完成的深层计算来构建。
AI.result: 实验表明，使用Qwen风格的模型，在1.5B参数下，P2N在GSM8K数据集上的准确性提高了超过10个百分点，同时几乎保持了不变的解码延迟。此外，P2N也带来了语言建模和通用下游基准上的性能改进。
AI.conclusion: P2N方法在不显著提高推理成本的情况下实现了一种有效提升大规模语言模型推理能力的方法，为这些模型在需要强推理能力的任务中提供了潜在的改进途径。

title: DialogMem: Evaluating Dialogue-Grounded Embodied Memory in 3D Environments
summary: Embodied agents in human-centered environments require memory that integrates what they observe with what humans tell them over time. However, existing embodied memories are built primarily from visual experience, leaving open how dialogue with humans can be grounded in the objects encountered throughout that experience. We introduce DialogMem, a two-phase benchmark in which agents build memory from time-aligned streams of posed RGB-D observations and dialogue, and later use it for instance-level object navigation and question answering (QA). DialogMem provides 142 episodes across 27 real-world 3D scenes, with 14,193 QA pairs and 11,890 navigation instructions. We evaluate nine memory representations within a unified framework of memory formation, evidence retrieval, and reasoning for task outputs. In experiments, appending dialogue to visual memory at evaluation time substantially improves QA but yields negligible navigation gains, suggesting that relevant dialogue is present in memory but not grounded to specific objects. Controlled diagnostics show that navigation improves with link quality but falls short of ground-truth object-level memory even under perfect linking. Retrieving the correct object entry and recovering its spatial location remain further bottlenecks. These results identify three bottlenecks for dialogue-grounded embodied memory: grounding and organizing dialogue at object-level entries during formation, retrieving the correct entry, and localizing it accurately.

AI.tldr: 该研究介绍了DialogMem基准，一种结合RGB-D观察和对话建立物体级记忆的方法，用于物体导航和问答。发现构建对话相关记忆、提取正确的记忆项和准确定位仍然是关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前的嵌入式记忆主要基于视觉经验，但未能很好地将人类对话与所遇物体关联起来。因此，研究引入了一个结合对话的新基准，以提高基于对话的嵌入式记忆的性能。
AI.method: 该研究制定了一个两阶段的框架，其中包括构建自时间对齐的RGB-D观察和对话的记忆，并使用这些记忆进行物体级导航和问答。研究人员评估了九种记忆表示方法，并探索了提高记忆有效性的策略。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，将对话信息附加到视觉记忆中显著提高了问答性能，但对导航改进不大。这表明对话信息存在于记忆中，但尚未与具体物体关联。通过控制诊断发现，导航效果随链接质量提高，但在完美链接下仍落后于真实物体级别的记忆。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了基于对话的嵌入式记忆的三个关键瓶颈：将对话信息与具体物体关联、找回正确的记忆项和精确定位。

title: PACE-Mem: Prefix-Aware Complementary Evidence for Multimodal Agents
summary: As multimodal agents accumulate experience, their long-term memories contain many similar observations of recurring scenes, actions, and entities. Answer quality depends on the evidence retrieved from these memories into the model's context. However, query-relevant memories may contain overlapping information, and a fixed retrieval depth may return too little or too much evidence for a given question. To address these challenges, we propose PACE-Mem, Prefix-Aware Complementary Evidence, which constructs a complementary evidence sequence and determines its length from the same selection trajectory. For structured memories, query-guided pooling combines records within each clip to obtain relevance scores and representations. Using these relevance scores and representations, maximal marginal relevance (MMR) selection balances query relevance against overlap with previously selected evidence. From the resulting score trajectory, a prefix-length selection algorithm determines retrieval depth by comparing length-normalized adjacent declines, accounting for both score changes and the amount of evidence accumulated. PACE-Mem is a training-free, plug-in retrieval method for clip-based agent memory systems, leaving memory construction and answer generation unchanged. Across three long-video benchmarks and two agent frameworks, PACE-Mem improves question-answering accuracy by an average of 1.6% over Adaptive-k, the strongest baseline at comparable mean retrieval depths. Further analysis reveals that jointly adding and removing evidence is associated with larger net accuracy gains than either change alone.

AI.tldr: PACE-Mem 提出了一种用于剪辑式代理记忆系统的检索方法，通过构建互补证据序列并确定其长度，以提高问题回答准确性。
AI.motivation: 解决累积经验导致的记忆中有重叠信息以及固定检索深度可能不适合所有查询的问题。
AI.method: 使用 Prefix-Aware Complementary Evidence 方法，结合查询引导聚合和最大边际相关性选择来平衡相关性和重叠。
AI.result: 在三个长视频基准和两个代理框架上，PACE-Mem 的问题回答准确性平均提高了 1.6%，超过 Adaptive-k 的最强基线。
AI.conclusion: PACE-Mem 作为一种无需训练的插件检索方法，适用于剪辑式代理记忆系统，且对记忆构建和答案生成无影响。

title: Dual-Slot: From Serial Loops to Parallel Slots in Language Models
summary: Looped language models increase computational depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to improve model quality without adding parameters. However, sequential dependencies between loop iterations increase autoregressive decoding latency. We introduce Dual-Slot, an architecture that reorganizes serial looped computation into parallel latent and prediction slots. Rather than waiting for the current token's latent computation to finish, the prediction slot combines the previous token's deep latent state with the current representation, while the latent slot produces a state for the next decoding step. This shifts the latent dependency across adjacent tokens, replacing two sequential module invocations with a single paired invocation while preserving standard autoregressive generation. To preserve token-level parallelism during training, we use a small number of Jacobi iterations to refine latent states across the sequence in parallel. Experiments on Qwen-style dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models show consistent improvements in language modeling and average downstream accuracy. On the 1B dense model, Dual-Slot reduces Pile validation perplexity from 7.25 to 7.00 and improves average five-shot accuracy across nine task configurations by 2.26 percentage points. After supervised fine-tuning, it improves zero-shot GSM8K accuracy by 5.83 and 3.49 percentage points for the 1B dense and A0.6B MoE models, respectively. Across the evaluated batch sizes, Dual-Slot retains 93.1-96.5% of vanilla decoding throughput for the dense model and 98.1-99.6% for the MoE model.

AI.tldr: Dual-Slot 架构通过重新组织循环计算为并行的潜在状态槽和预测槽，减少了循环依赖性，优化了解码延迟，同时保持了标准的自回归生成过程。实验结果表明，该架构可以提高语言建模和下游任务的准确性，且在不同模型规模和批量大小下保持了较高的解码吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 目前的循环语言模型通过重复应用共享层增强了计算深度，但这也增加了顺序依赖性，导致自回归解码延迟增加。为解决这一问题，研究提出了 Dual-Slot 架构，旨在减少计算延迟和提升模型性能。
AI.method: Dual-Slot 架构通过将序列循环计算重构成并行的潜在状态槽和预测槽，使预测槽在潜在槽计算完成前就开始处理当前令牌。同时，使用少量的雅可比迭代来在序列中并行细化潜在状态，以保持训练中的令牌级并行性。
AI.result: 在 Qwen 风格的密集聚合（Dense）和混合专家（MoE）模型上，Dual-Slot 架构展示了语言建模和平均下游准确性的一致改进。具体的，1B 大小的 Dense 模型的 Pile 验证困惑度从 7.25 下降到 7.00，五个任务配置下的平均五-shot 准确率提高了 2.26 个百分点。经过监督微调后，Dual-Slot 在零样本 GSM8K 准确率上分别提升了 5.83 和 3.49 个百分点，对于 1B 大小的 Dense 和 A0.6B 大小的 MoE 模型。在不同批量大小下，Dual-Slot 分别保持了 93.1-96.5% 和 98.1-99.6% 的 vanilla 解码吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: Dual-Slot 架构在提升模型性能的同时，有效地减少了自回归解码延迟，且在多种模型规模和批量大小下具有较好的解码吞吐量。

title: IndustrialCAD-1400: Benchmarking Detailed Industrial Assemblies from Text
summary: Industrial assemblies require more than a recognizable shape: functional parts, interfaces, dimensions and service features must satisfy a detailed request together. We introduce IndustrialCAD-1400, a text-to-CAD benchmark for this industrial setting. Its 1,400 requests combine 400 equipment categories across 40 domains with 250 four-case design families. Family requests specify a median of 17 named component or configuration roles and six explicit numeric targets; controlled variants test whether dimensions change while shared structure is retained. Task construction draws on documented manufacturer information, owner specifications and engineering guidance. Models generate geometry programs from requests, and a common Blender environment executes them to produce scenes, optional measurements, and standardized views for evaluation. A request assessment of front, isometric, and top views measures visible component, arrangement, and interface fulfillment without requiring a single reference geometry. Five stratified panels preserve complete families while covering the benchmark exactly once, enabling balanced comparisons and separating industrial breadth from controlled numerical responsiveness. In conclusion, IndustrialCAD-1400 extends text-to-CAD from recognizable part geometry to industrial assembly synthesis under joint component, interface, spatial, and numerical specifications.

AI.tldr: IndustrialCAD-1400 是一个包含 1400 个工业装配请求的基准测试，涉及 400 种设备类别、40 个领域和 250 个设计家族，旨在将文本请求转换为 CAD 场景，重点关注部件、接口、空间和数值规范的综合合成。
AI.motivation: 目前的 CAD 基准测试主要关注识别和创建可区分的部分几何形状，而工业装配则需要满足更复杂的功能性要求，包括尺寸、服务功能和接口要求。为了应对这些需求，作者提出了 IndustrialCAD-1400 以此为工业装配的合成提出了挑战。
AI.method: IndustrialCAD-1400 通过结合详细的任务构造、模型生成以及统一的执行环境来生成场景并测量可视部件、排列和接口的实现。该方法采用了多层次筛选，确保了对不同特性的工业宽度和计算数字响应能力进行平衡比较。
AI.result: 该基准测试成功地合成了一大批包含复杂机械部件和高精度尺寸要求的工业装配实例，展示了从文本请求到实际场景的完整转换过程，并且能够评估组件、布局和接口的设计满意度。
AI.conclusion: IndustrialCAD-1400 的引入使得 CAD 技术可以在工业装配领域得到更广泛的应用，克服了传统 CAD 基准测试的局限性，旨在推动基于文本请求的多参数多维度装配合成技术的发展。

title: Learning from the Right Regions: Class-Conditioned Explanation Guidance for Medical Imaging
comment: Submitted to the Explainable and Trustworthy AI for Clinical Decision Support Systems Workshop, IEEE BIBM 2026
summary: Deep neural networks can achieve strong predictive performance in medical imaging while relying on regions unrelated to the predicted finding. Explanation-guided learning can address this problem, but multi-label classification introduces a key challenge: multiple abnormalities may coexist in an image, requiring each prediction to align with its corresponding spatial evidence. We propose a class-conditioned explanation-guided learning framework that constructs a separate explanation for each positive class and penalizes evidence outside its class-specific annotated regions. We instantiate the framework using Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) and evaluate it on 14 abnormalities using EfficientNet-B1, ViT-B/16, ViT-B/32, and Swin-B. Explanation guidance substantially improves annotation alignment across all architectures: All-Saliency Precision increases from 0.140 to 0.625, 0.052 to 0.551, 0.060 to 0.403, and 0.095 to 0.570, respectively. These improvements are accompanied by smaller, architecture-dependent changes in classification performance. Our results show that class-conditioned explanation guidance can substantially improve where multi-label classifiers concentrate their explanatory evidence while largely preserving predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种类条件的指导解释框架，通过为每个正类构建单独的解释，来解决多标签分类中的问题，从而提高注释匹配度。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于深度神经网络的医疗影像预测模型往往会依赖于与预测结果无关的区域，而指导学习可以通过解释来改进这一问题。
AI.method: 研究提出了一种基于Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM)的类条件解释指导框架，为每个正类单独构建一个解释，并惩罚超出其特定标注区域的证据。
AI.result: 研究成果在不同架构下提高了注释对齐度（All-Saliency Precision），同时在分类性能上仅有较小的、架构相关的变化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在多标签分类中能够显著提高解释证据的聚集性，同时几乎保持了预测性能。

title: Beyond Factual Accuracy: A Benchmark for Evaluating Perspective Alignment in LLMs
summary: Large Language Models often generate factually correct responses that fail to maintain user-requested perspectives, blending multiple perspectives and forcing users to filter through unwanted information---a perspective control failure that factual accuracy metrics cannot detect. We introduce PerspectiveBench, a benchmark quantifying perspective alignment by constructing scenarios where multiple valid reasoning paths coexist, and propose the Perspective Alignment Score (PAS) to measure adherence to specified perspectives. Experiments reveal that state-of-the-art models successfully include target content but fail to exclude non-requested perspectives. Providing documents through RAG improves factual grounding but does not resolve perspective drift, as models prioritize comprehensive coverage over strict user constraints. Code and data are available at https://github.com/sunghoon014/PerspectiveBench.

AI.tldr: 该研究引入了PerspectiveBench基准测试，评估大型语言模型在保持用户指定视角方面的能力，发现尽管模型能够包含所需内容，但在排除非请求视角方面存在缺陷。提供文档通过RAG可以增强事实准确性，但不能解决视角偏移问题。
AI.motivation: 当前的评估方法无法检测到语言模型在信息呈现上的偏差，即事实正确但未遵守用户视角，因此需要一个新的基准测试来专门评估此问题。
AI.method: 研究设计了PerspectiveBench基准测试，包含多种合理的推理路径的场景，同时引入了Perspective Alignment Score (PAS)来度量模型对特定视角的遵循程度。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，最先进的模型能够引入目标内容，但无法完全排除非请求的视角信息。即使利用RAG技术增强了事实准确性，模型依然倾向于全面覆盖信息而非严格执行用户限制。
AI.conclusion: 这项研究揭示了大型语言模型在视角控制方面存在的局限性，并提出了一个有效的评估工具来弥补当前评估方法的不足。

title: Medical Fine-Tuning Reshapes, Not Reduces, Patient-Facing AI Risk: A Rubric-Based, LLM-Judge Evaluation Framework
summary: Patient-facing medical question answering with large language models (LLMs) is moving from research demonstrations to production deployments, yet evaluation remains anchored on factual correctness. Factuality is necessary but not sufficient: a response can be factually grounded and still issue a directive that, if acted on, would harm the patient. We introduce a risk-sensitive evaluation framework that scores responses by the presence and severity of six categories of risk-bearing language (treatment directives, contraindications, dosage expressions, urgency-triage cues, high-alert medication mentions, and overconfident assertions), anchored on published clinical harm taxonomies. Severity is classified by a three-judge LLM ensemble. We apply this framework to six 7-9B instruction-tuned models, three general (Mistral-7B, Phi-3.5-mini, Llama-3.1-8B) and three medically adapted (BioMistral-7B, OpenBioLLM-Llama3-8B, Med42-Llama3-8B), on 200 real patient questions from the K-QA benchmark. Two findings emerge. First, ensemble risk-bearing language is statistically independent of factual hallucination rate (pooled Spearman $ρ= -0.065$, $n = 300$, 95% CI $[-0.18, +0.05]$; distance correlation $= 0.10$, independence test $p = 0.24$). Second, medical fine-tuning does not reduce aggregate risk but reshapes it: continued-pretraining adaptations (BioMistral, OpenBioLLM) consistently suppress high-alert medication mentions while amplifying overconfident assertions, whereas clinical instruction-tuning (Med42) suppresses dosing only, without amplifying overconfidence. Per-category Krippendorff $α$ is fair to good for the four linguistically anchored categories (0.53-0.71) and low for the two clinical-judgment-dependent categories (0.19, 0.31), indicating where automatic safety evaluation is and is not yet reliable. We release the rubric, judge prompts, and evaluation code.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种风险敏感的评估框架，用于评估大型语言模型对患者问题的回答，涵盖六种风险语言类别，并应用到六个预训练及医学调整的模型上，发现医学微调不能降低总体风险，而是重新分布了风险。
AI.motivation: 现有评估主要关注事实准确性，但大型语言模型对患者的具体指导可能带来潜在风险。因此引入了一种新的评价框架，关注风险语言识别和严重性评估。
AI.method: 研究采用了六种大型语言模型，包括三种通用模型和三种医学调整模型，对来自K-QA基准的200个实际患者问题进行了评估。风险语言的严重性由三个法官组成的LLM小组评估。
AI.result: 评估发现，风险语言的风险评分与事实性幻觉率无关；医学微调并未降低总体风险，而是改变了风险分布：持续预训练调整降低高危药品提及时而增加自信断言；临床指令调整减少给药，但未增加自信。
AI.conclusion: 该研究的评分标准、法官提示及评估代码已发布，旨在增强自动安全性评估的可靠性。

title: Spatons: Spatiotonally Localized Building Blocks for Efficient XR Predistortion
summary: We present Spatons, a family of compositional, spatially localized neural operators for computationally efficient XR (extended reality) predistortion and distortion compensation. XR displays (AR, VR, and MR) suffer from spatial (e.g., geometric) and tonal (e.g., colour) distortions. Frames can be pre-distorted so that the projected image looks as intended. Distortions vary with manufacturing tolerances and projection systems, motivating programmable compensation. Untethered, battery-operated XR systems also require low energy and latency. A Spaton is a hybrid patch-to-pixel block combining tiny Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) with fixed-function interpolation. Using Spatons, we build programmable, computationally efficient pipelines for varied distortion scenarios. On the full spatiotonal Scenario 5, Sequential-5' matches CompenNet++ in SSIM (0.944 vs. 0.944) and closely matches its PSNR (27.5 vs. 27.7 dB), with substantially lower complexity. We demonstrate a flexible Spaton solution with 6 times fewer FLOPs and 106 times fewer parameters than CompenNet++, and 4-10 times fewer memory transfers than UNet++. We characterize software implementations and analytical hardware estimates, including optimizations across target XR platforms. The distortions considered are drawn mostly from see-through, near-eye displays, where the spatial light path governs local intensity and spectral response. This early systems-level exploration uses closed-form differentiable distortions and one real projector-camera capture set for training and evaluation, rather than through-the-optics measurements. Testing on a wider range of real XR devices remains future work. Chromatic dispersion (color fringes) remains the main artifact where Spatons trail monolithic baselines.

AI.tldr: Spatons 是一种用于 XR 显示器预测矫正和失真补偿的高效组分，通过结合小 MLP 和固定功能插值提高计算效率。
AI.motivation: XR 显示器（AR、VR 和 MR）存在几何和色调失真，需要低能耗和低延迟的可编程校正。
AI.method: Spatons 使用 hybrid patch-to-pixel 块结合了小型多层感知机（MLPs）和固定功能插值，构建了适应不同失真情况的计算高效管道。
AI.result: 在 Scenario 5 上，Spatons 的 SSIM 与 CompenNet++ 相当（0.944 对 0.944），PSNR 接近 CompenNet++（27.5 对 27.7 dB），同时复杂度较低。与 CompenNet++ 相比，Spatons 的 FLOPs 减少了 6 倍，参数减少了 106 倍，内存传输减少了 4-10 倍。软件实现和硬件估计表现出优化。
AI.conclusion: Spatons 为 XR 显示器提供了一种有效的预测矫正方案，特别适用于基于相光路径的近眼全透明显示器，但色散（色场）仍然是主要的视觉残留。

title: Deep Fusion Memory: A Chunk-Level Parametric Memory for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models need effective ways to acquire and use external knowledge beyond what they retain from pretraining. Continued pretraining risks catastrophic forgetting, while retrieval at inference time can add substantial overhead. External parametric memory avoids online retrieval, but constructing its training data requires extensive offline search, and output-level interpolation provides only shallow fusion. We introduce Deep Fusion Memory (DFM), a parametric memory architecture that reduces this construction workload and incorporates learned memory into intermediate hidden states. A causal memory predictor learns to generate memory from the preceding context, using retrieved chunk embeddings from the corpus as supervision. The predicted memory is shared across tokens within each chunk and fused into their hidden states through gated cross-attention. Memory prediction and fusion are trained end to end with the backbone frozen, and inference requires no explicit retrieval. Compared with existing parametric memory approaches, which often construct token-level memory targets, DFM requires $32\times$ fewer retrieval queries and $2048\times$ fewer retrieved items to construct its training data. Across six QA tasks, DFM performs better over the strongest baseline by 12.71% on Mistral-7B-v0.3 and 11.19% on Qwen3-8B-Base. Beyond QA, domain adaptation yields average gains of 6.51 and 4.38 points over Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Deep Fusion Memory (DFM) 的参数记忆架构，减少了构建训练数据的工作量，并将记忆融入到中间隐藏状态中。
AI.motivation: 为了解决大型语言模型在继续预训练中面临灾难性遗忘的问题，以及检索式方法在推理时增加的额外开销。
AI.method: DFM采用了一种因果记忆预测器来生成记忆，该预测器从前文语境中检索到的语块嵌入中获取监督，并将生成的记忆融入到隐藏状态中进行加权融合。
AI.result: 与现有的参数记忆方法相比，DFM在训练数据构建上减少了检索查询次数和检索项的数量。在六个问答任务中，DFM比最强基线分别提高了12.71%和11.19%。此外，在跨领域适应上，DFM分别获得了6.51和4.38分的平均提升。
AI.conclusion: DFM通过压缩训练数据的构建工作量和提高模型性能，为解决语言模型的知识管理和利用提出了新的方案。

title: Teaching Code Agents to Ask Without Leaking Private Code
comment: 10 pages of main text, 33 pages in total with references and appendix, 4 figures, 5 tables
summary: Local coding agents can extend their reach by consulting a stronger cloud model. Such consultations, however, often expose the repository's private identifiers, file paths, and source code. Host-side masking hides recognized identifiers but leaves the surrounding code and the agent's phrasing unchanged, while training for less disclosure risks suppressing consultation or producing questions too vague to answer. We propose utility-verified abstraction (UVA), which teaches the agent to describe private entities by their role and type while retaining the technical details an expert needs. From solved repair trajectories, we rewrite each question into this form and keep the rewrite only if it discloses fewer private entities and the repair, replayed from the same execution state with the repair trajectories. Across two benchmarks, the trained agent consults more often than before training. On repository-level issue repair, it solves 37.6% of issues, against 25.3% for the same model working alone, a gain from the training as a whole rather than from consultation alone. Its questions disclose 3.7-fold fewer private entities and 1.4-fold less verbatim code than the untrained agent's questions to the same expert.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为UVA的方法，通过训练代码代理以角色和类型描述私有实体来保护隐私，同时保留专家所需的详细技术信息。结果显示，训练后的代理在修复问题时展示了显著的改进。
AI.motivation: 由于本地代码代理咨询强大的云模型时会暴露仓库的私有标识符、文件路径和源代码，研究旨在保护隐私并提高咨询效率，同时确保技术细节的完整性。
AI.method: UVA（Utility-Verified Abstraction）方法通过引入角色和类型来描述私有的实体，并通过基于修复轨迹的重写机制来验证其实用性。
AI.result: 在两个基准测试中，训练后的代理在解决问题上表现出色。与单独工作的同一模型相比，解决比例从25.3%提高到37.6%，并且其问题中暴露的私有实体数量减少了3.7倍，直接引用的代码减少了1.4倍。
AI.conclusion: UVA方法证明了在保护隐私的同时，仍能有效提升代码代理的性能，是一种有效的提高代码代理咨询效率的方案。

title: ZeroDSS: Semantic Segmentation from Class Names Alone
summary: Semantic segmentation depends heavily on real images with pixel-level annotations, making dense supervision a major obstacle to deployment in new domains. We study task-specific data-free semantic segmentation, where training uses generic pretrained generative priors but has access to no target-domain images, masks, or captions--only a predefined category set. We introduce Zero-Data Semantic Segmentation (ZeroDSS), a feedback-driven approach that treats synthetic supervision as an adaptively controllable training distribution rather than a direct surrogate for real data. ZeroDSS constructs a semantically structured prompt distribution through LLM-guided compositional generation and adaptive class rebalancing, then converts the prompts into image-mask pairs using diffusion attention. Its feedback-driven distribution refinement consists of a two-phase closed-loop training procedure with a single loop-back step. In Phase I, a segmenter is trained using confidence-weighted supervision and dual-scale consistency. In Phase II, model feedback is used to adaptively target underperforming categories and refine diffusion-derived masks using model predictions. After this refined initial training, a teacher-student framework is utilized in the final phase to iteratively improve the fused supervision and segmenter through exponential moving average (EMA) updates. Using synthetic training data only, ZeroDSS achieves 35.0% mIoU on MS COCO with DeepLabV3, and 66.3% and 63.5% mIoU on PASCAL VOC with DeepLabV3 and Mask2Former, respectively. These results show that explicitly constructing and iteratively refining the synthetic supervision distribution can substantially reduce the synthetic-to-real gap in dense prediction.

AI.tldr: ZeroDSS 使用合成数据进行无数据标注的语义分割，通过 LLM 指导的组合生成和自适应类别重新平衡构造语义结构化的提示分布，并通过扩散注意力将其转换为图像-掩膜对。其反馈驱动的分布精炼包括两阶段闭环训练过程，最终通过教师-学生框架进一步优化融合监督和分割器。
AI.motivation: 研究任务特定的数据无标签语义分割方法，减少对密集标注的真实图像的依赖，适用于新领域的部署。
AI.method: ZeroDSS 通过 LLM 指导的组合生成和自适应类别重新平衡生成语义结构化的提示分布，使用扩散注意力将提示转换为图像-掩膜对。通过两阶段闭环训练过程（包含模型反馈和自适应类别调整），并在最终阶段使用教师-学生框架进行优化。
AI.result: 使用合成训练数据时，ZeroDSS 在 MS COCO 上达到 35.0% 的 mIoU，DeepLabV3；在 PASCAL VOC 上分别达到 66.3% 和 63.5% mIoU，使用 DeepLabV3 和 Mask2Former。结果显示了通过构造和细化合成监督分布来显著减少合成到真实数据的差距的效果。
AI.conclusion: ZeroDSS 能够实现无目标数据的语义分割，通过迭代精炼合成监督分布，显著减少合成数据与真实图像之间的差距。

title: Generation-Heavy Hybrid Machine Translation
comment: Dissertation submitted to the Faculty of the Graduate School of the University of Maryland at College Park in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the degree of Doctor of Philosophy 2003
summary:
The state of the art techniques in Machine Translation (MT) require large amounts of symmetric resources from source and target languages. This is true regardless of whether the approach is Transfer or Interlingua, Symbolic or Statistical. Symmetry within these approaches is necessary to ensure quality, robustness and retargetability. In reality, such symmetry, whether it is in terms of structural transfer lexicons, interlingual dictionaries or parallel corpora, is a major bottleneck in developing any MT system.
  This dissertation presents an approach to MT that addresses the lack of symmetry by exploiting symbolic and statistical target language resources in source-poor/target-rich language pairs. This approach is called Generation-Heavy Hybrid Machine Translation (GHMT). Expected source language resources include a syntactic parser and a simple one-to-many translation dictionary. No transfer rules or complex interlingual representations are used. Rich target language symbolic resources are used to overgenerate multiple structural variations from a target-glossed syntactic dependency representation of source language sentences. Statistical target-language resource are then used to select amongst the overgenerated translations. The source-target asymmetry of systems developed in this approach makes them more easily retargetable to new source languages.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Generation-Heavy Hybrid Machine Translation（GHMT）方法，该方法利用目标语言的符号和统计资源来弥补源语言资源的不足，在源语言贫乏/目标语言丰富的语言对中开发更易于重新目标化的机器翻译系统。
AI.motivation: 传统的MT方法需要大量的对称资源，造成了在资源稀缺的语言对上进行翻译的巨大挑战。文章提出GHMT方法来缓解这种不对称性问题。
AI.method: 作者提出的GHMT方法，仅使用简单的源语言词典和语法规则，依赖丰富目标语言符号资源进行句子结构的过度生成，并使用目标语言的统计信息进行最佳选择。
AI.result: 该方法能够更易于将系统重新目标化至新的源语言，同时能够有效利用目标语言资源。
AI.conclusion: GHMT方法克服了传统机器翻译中的对称资源瓶颈，提出了一种在开发过程中更具灵活性的方法，特别是对于目标语言资源丰富而源语言资源贫乏的语言对而言。

title: Pattern-Driven Evaluation of LLM Code Optimization: Isolating Compiler-Transcendent Semantic Reasoning
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Published at the AI Measurement Science Workshop at COLM 2026
summary: Existing evaluations of LLM-based code optimization primarily measure end-to-end speedup, obscuring whether a model actually performs the intended optimization. For compiled languages, this is especially problematic: observed gains may reflect transformations already recoverable by modern optimizing compilers rather than optimization behavior attributable to the model itself. We present PatternBench, a benchmark for studying compiler-transcendent optimization, i.e., performance improvements that remain after aggressive compiler optimization. PatternBench targets residual optimization opportunities across seven classes of transformations and pairs runtime evaluation with an AST-based optimization faithfulness analysis that verifies whether the intended optimization is realized in the generated program. Experiments with frontier, open-weight, and fine-tuned models show that runtime speedup alone provides an incomplete account of optimization capability. Optimization faithfulness is strongly associated with realized speedup, and fine-tuning improves both faithfulness and optimization effectiveness. These results suggest that evaluation of LLM-based code optimization should measure not only performance outcomes, but also whether the target transformation was successfully executed.

AI.tldr: PatternBench 是一个基准，用于研究独立于编译器的代码优化，强调不仅评估性能改进，还要验证优化行为是否由模型本身执行。
AI.motivation: 现有的针对大语言模型（LLM）代码优化的评估主要关注端到端的速度提升，这可能会模糊掉模型是否实际执行了预期的优化。尤其是在编译语言中，观察到的改进可能是现代优化编译器已能恢复的，而不是模型本身执行的优化。
AI.method: PatternBench 利用一种基于抽象语法树（AST）的优化行为一致性验证方法，与运行时评估相结合，来研究七类转换中的残余优化机会。
AI.result: 实验表明，仅依靠运行时速度提升不能全面反映优化能力；优化行为的一致性与实现的性能改进高度相关，微调能提高一致性并增强优化效果。
AI.conclusion: 因此，LLM 基于的代码优化评估应衡量不仅性能结果，还要确保目标转换是否成功执行。

title: S3D-Mosaic: Subgradient-Guided Cross-Band Structure Transfer for Spectral Demosaicing
summary: Multispectral filter array (MSFA) imaging enables snapshot spectral acquisition, but its per-band sparse sampling causes severe spatial aliasing. Although missing spatial structures can be inferred across bands, wavelength-dependent contrast variations make direct cross-band transfer unreliable. Existing model-based methods lack explicit magnitude-invariant mechanisms, and learning-based methods require layout-specific training or per-image tuning, limiting generalization. To address these issues, we propose S3D-Mosaic, a model-based spectral demosaicing method built upon a subgradient-guided cross-band structure transfer framework. We first establish a subgradient-guided regularization framework with a generalized cosine-similarity interpretation, providing a convex mechanism for magnitude-invariant information transfer. Then we design a compact Directional Sparse Equivariant Difference Convolution (DSE-DConv) for band-level extraction of orientation-selective, high-frequency structure features at low computational cost. Instantiating the framework with DSE-DConv on spectrally adjacent bands yields a cross-band self-structure similarity regularizer for spectral demosaicing, which we optimize via a dual-scan ADMM algorithm that decouples the bidirectional dependency while propagating magnitude-robust structural information across bands. With DSE-DConv's two parameters trained once via self-supervision, S3D-Mosaic outperforms state-of-the-art unsupervised methods on CAVE and NTIRE 2022, and generalizes robustly to varying MSFA layouts, pan-mosaic fusion, and real-world UAV data with fixed reconstruction hyperparameters. The source code is available at \url{https://github.com/bestwishes43/S3D-Mosaic}.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于子梯度引导的跨带结构转移框架的模型方法S3D-Mosaic，通过设计低计算成本的方向稀疏等变差分卷积(DSE-DConv)，并在光谱相邻带之间实例化该框架来实现光谱去马赛克，该方法在各种数据集上优于现有方法，并且具有泛化的潜力。
AI.motivation: 传统的光谱去马赛克方法面临光谱带稀疏采样导致的空间混叠严重、跨带转移精度低等问题，而学习方法则需要特定布局或图像调优，限制了泛化能力。因此，研究提出S3D-Mosaic方法，通过一个子梯度引导的跨带结构转移框架，引入了光谱不变机制。
AI.method: S3D-Mosaic通过构建一个子梯度引导正则化框架，提供了一个凸机制的光谱不变信息传输。还设计了低计算成本的方向稀疏等变差分卷积(DSE-DConv)，在光谱相邻带之间实现跨带自我结构相似性正则化。
AI.result: 实验表明，S3D-Mosaic在多种数据集上优于现有方法，并且对于不同的MSFA布局、多带融合和真实世界无人机数据具有鲁棒的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出的S3D-Mosaic方法提供了一种新的光谱去马赛克策略，通过结合理论建模和低计算复杂度的卷积设计，克服了传统方法和学习方法的限制，展现了良好的性能和广泛的适应性。

title: Behave Like Experts: Fusing Data with Semantic Knowledge for Effective and Efficient Semantic Map Construction
summary: Semantic map models (SMMs) construct a graph that reflects conceptual similarity by comparing cross-lingual form-meaning mappings. Experts build such models not only by obeying the data constraint, i.e., the connectivity hypothesis, which states that conceptual nodes belonging to the same form must be connected, but also by incorporating their prior semantic knowledge. Current automatic methods ignore this knowledge, which harms both accuracy and efficiency by enlarging the search space of candidate graphs. In this paper, we fuse the distributional semantic knowledge hidden in the internal representations of language models into a top-down, data-driven algorithm. This expert-like behavior re-sorts the candidates in a huge search space, guided by conceptual semantics similarity. Experiments on a self-collected benchmark of 10 datasets and comprehensive metrics show that our method builds SMMs both effectively and efficiently.

AI.tldr: 本研究将语言模型的分布语义知识融入自顶向下的数据驱动算法中，有效且高效地构建了语义映射模型。
AI.motivation: 当前自动方法忽略了专家在构建语义映射模型时利用的语义知识，这损害了准确性和效率。
AI.method: 将语言模型内部表示中的分布语义知识与专家推理相结合，提出了一种自顶向下的数据驱动算法。
AI.result: 在自收集的10个数据集基准上，通过全面的评估指标，本方法成功地构建了语义映射模型。
AI.conclusion: 该方法既有效又高效地构建了语义映射模型，缩小了候选图形搜索空间，并提高了模型性能。

title: Bellman Language Models: Solving the Recurring Decisions of LLM Agents
summary:
A general observation in agentic workflows, especially bounded ones, is that the decision space of the LLM, when we separate a decision from generation, starts approaching saturation: the agent meets the same states again and again, and after enough conversations it stops meeting new ones. LLMs generally don't treat these decisions as an optimization problem and instead re-derive them from their context/prompt on every turn. We show that treating decision making within reasonable bounds as an optimization problem, solving it once, and reusing the solved decisions can often make an agent faster, cheaper and more reliable. Our approach, which we call Discretize, Then Decide, starts from data such as the workflow's own logs or, when none exists, runs of the LLM agent itself. It reads each conversation into discrete states and estimates the probability of each outcome and the cost of each move, until no new states appear and the probabilities stop changing. It then solves the resulting Markov decision process. The solution runs as a controller around the model, sending moves whose content is fixed in the state, such as a tool call or a templated reply, and any state it hasn't seen is sent back to the LLM. We call an LLM run this way a Bellman language model (BLM), after Richard Bellman's equation for the best move in each state.
  On $τ^2$-bench telecom, the controller with no model solves 79% of tasks. As a BLM, Qwen3.8-27B, an open model, goes from 29% to 96% with 93% fewer model calls. For Claude Opus 5.5, which solves 96% of tasks on its own, running it as a BLM cuts model calls and cost per task by about 98% and lets it solve 2 more tasks. On InventoryBench, the solved policy with no model beats every published method. Where the hard part is writing content rather than choosing moves, such as resolving SymPy issues, few decisions can be solved in advance, and a BLM helps little.

title: BodyBridge: Grounded Body Layers for Sim-to-Real Translation of Vulnerable Road Users
summary: Simulation-to-real driving video diffusion models can translate photorealistic scenes, but they typically represent pedestrians and cyclists, vulnerable road users (VRUs), as generic object classes. This is insufficient for vulnerable road users whose safety-relevant appearance depends on articulated pose and identity. We present BodyBridge and Grounded Body Layers (GBL), a simulator-derived, pixel-aligned representation that combines scene geometry, canonical per-pixel body correspondence, and exact VRU masks. GBL provides explicit articulation to the video diffusion model, emphasizes VRU regions during control-branch post-training, and supports additive composition with scene-geometry control at inference. It also enables per-joint evaluation of generated VRUs and a failure taxonomy for identity errors. On CARLA-to-real translation, BodyBridge improves near-range PCK@0.5 by 22% over the released depth-conditioned baseline. Replacing normal-map body control with canonical correspondence reduces body flips by 18%, while composition reduces near-range facing flips by 27%.
