These results show that explicit body grounding complements scene-level control and improves pose-faithful VRU generation. All code, data, and model checkpoints will be made publicly available to support reproducible, pedestrian-aware autonomous driving research.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，通过在视频扩散模型中引入人体标注和精确的VRU遮罩，BodyBridge和Grounded Body Layers能够显著提高脆弱道路使用者（VRU）生成的精度和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有的模拟到真实驾驶视频扩散模型在表示VRU时过于抽象，未能充分反映其安全相关外观的多变化特性，如肢体动作和身份。这促使我们开发BodyBridge和Grounded Body Layers来提高VRU的识别与生成。
AI.method: 该方法通过模拟器提取人体标注和精确的VRU遮罩，结合场景几何信息，实现像素对齐的人体结构表示。通过这种方式，在视频扩散模型中引入了显式的人体结构信息，增强了控制分支训练后的VRU区域强调，支持在推断时的场景几何控制的添加剂组成。
AI.result: 在CARLA到真实的转换实验中，与发布的深度条件基线相比，BodyBridge提高了近距PCK@0.5值22%。使用基本的对应关系代替法线图人体控制，减少了18%的身体翻转现象，而组成方法减少了27%的近距正面翻转现象。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现，显式人体标注的引入提升了场景级别控制的互补性，显著改善了肢体一致的VRU生成。这种方法不仅有效，而且所有代码、数据和模型检查点都将公开，支持可重复的行人感知自动驾驶研究。

title: Memories That Outlive Their Reasons: Dependency-Tethered Memory for Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: Agents now act on the Web, publishing packages, models and datasets through registry APIs, and remembering past verifications spares them the work. But a verdict rests on premises. When a signing key is revoked, everything built on it stops passing, yet the advisory names only the key, and the old verdicts of its dependents may never share a retrieval window with it. This non-locality of invalidation turns memory into a liability: in long simulated chats, an agent reading a memory of atomic facts publishes 62% of the objects whose failure lies upstream, each backed by a record that was true when written. Yet derivation is local even when invalidation is not. Tether records, at write time, the exact versions each verdict derives from, and at read time withdraws any verdict whose support has failed anywhere in the store; the agent reads the same fields as before. On Fallout, a generator of versioned worlds with hypothesis-blind simulated histories shared by every memory, Tether publishes 0.3% of upstream-failing objects across three domains when relations are stated with their verdicts, with 37% fewer verification calls than checking everything. A-Mem and Graphiti re-verify most candidates (0.83-0.86 checks per candidate), which limits their savings, yet publish 9% of upstream-failing objects; Mem0 relies on memory more and publishes 42%. Flushing every verdict on any failure is as safe as Tether but costs 32% more checks. The gain over fact memory holds with three open-weight backbones and against a whole-store window. These gains depend on capturing dependencies: when relations arrive in sessions apart from their verdicts, Tether's downstream unsafe publication rate rises to 9.4-22.1%, and a weak writer that misses edges loses safety in the same way.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了一种名为Tether的方法，通过记录每个验证结果的具体版本，可以在验证失效率更高时减少验证调用，而不会牺牲安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有系统在撤销签名密钥后，基于该密钥的旧判断可能无法共享相同的检索窗口，导致依赖过时数据的问题。文章旨在提供一种新的方法来解决这个问题。
AI.method: Tether方法在写入时记录每个验证结果的具体版本，在读取时撤销任何支持已失败的验证结果。
AI.result: 在Fallout上进行的实验中，Tether在三个领域中只发布了0.3%的上游失败对象，并减少了37%的验证调用。对于不同的开放权重架构和整个存储窗口，Tether的方法也有效。
AI.conclusion: Tether方法通过避免使用过时的数据来提高效率并节省验证次数，同时保持安全性。

title: The One-Pixel of Reasoning: One Truthful Relation Is Enough to Mislead LLM Agents
summary: Can one sentence manipulate an agent's belief by targeting a single implicit warrant linking evidence to a conclusion? In this paper, we introduce the one-relation attack (ORA), a novel cognitive attack on this inferential relation. ORA localizes a critical implicit warrant and performs a one-relation intervention using a single source-grounded sentence that qualifies this warrant and steers the agent toward an incorrect belief. Across eighteen models on biomedical inference and vulnerability detection, best-of-$10 attacks overturn initially correct answers at mean rates of 54.9% for proprietary and 80.0% for open-weight models. Attacks also transfer without victim feedback, and paired controls support the roles of targeting and qualification. Moreover, successful sentences can pass source-support checks and evade identification, and multi-agent debate raises team error from 50.0% to 59.5% in our balanced stress test. These findings establish implicit warrants as a cognitive attack surface for manipulating agents' beliefs.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过引入‘单一关系攻击’（ORA），展示了如何通过针对关键的隐含主张来操纵代理的信念。这种攻击能够在没有反馈的情况下转移，且成功率在10次攻击中最高达80.0%，并能提高团队犯错率。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在探索认知攻击的一个新方向，即通过干预关键的隐含主张来操纵代理的信念，特别是在医疗推理和漏洞检测等领域的模型。
AI.method: 研究设计了‘单一关系攻击’（ORA），通过向模型提供一个特定的、经过资格认定的单句干预，以改变模型的推理基础。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，对于10次攻击中的最佳模型，原始正确答案被推翻的平均比例为54.9%，对于开源权重模型，这一比例最高可达到80.0%。此外，这种攻击还可以在没有受害者反馈的情况下转移，且通过配对对照实验证明了攻击的目标性和作用。
AI.conclusion: 本文的研究发现为隐含主张充当了认知攻击的切入点，展示了其在操纵代理信念方面的潜力。这一发现可能对未来的模型安全性和对抗性研究具有重要意义。

title: Do 3D Large Language Models Really Use 3D Evidence?
summary: Recent 3D Large Language Models (3D-LLMs) have shown strong performance on scene question answering with extensive post-training. Yet, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate how 3D-LLMs respond to referential ambiguity, insufficient scene evidence, or false presuppositions, obscuring whether their responses are grounded in 3D evidence. In this work, we introduce UNICORNS, a benchmark for evaluating the reliability of 3D-LLM responses across four evidence conditions. UNICORNS contains 11,387 questions across 557 ScanNet scans, covering eight challenge categories alongside answerable controls. A response passes only if it satisfies the required response behavior and contains no scene claim unsupported by the available evidence. Evaluation of six open-sourced 3D-LLMs reveals a pronounced performance gap: even the strongest zero-shot model achieves 61.22% accuracy on answerable controls, but only 40.94% across the eight challenge categories. To address this gap, we further propose HORN, an obligation-aware post-training method combining group-relative task rewards, leaf-conditioned obligation rewards, and supervised control replay. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HORN reaches $75.1 \pm 1.0\%$ across the challenge categories and $77.2 \pm 0.8\%$ overall, outperforming all baselines without degrading answerable-control accuracy. Our findings enable a systematic evaluation and improvement of evidence-grounded 3D reasoning for 3D-LLMs (code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/unicorns-6B38/).

AI.tldr: UNICORNS是一个基准，用于评估3D大语言模型对四种证据条件的响应可靠性。通过评估提出的一种新的后训练方法HORN，表明HORN在各种挑战类别和总体上均表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D大型语言模型基准很少评估模型对参考歧义、缺乏场景证据或虚假预设的处理能力，因此该研究旨在提供一个综合基准UNICORNS来解决这个问题。
AI.method: 该研究设计了UNICORNS基准，包含多种复杂场景和挑战类别，以及对应的控制问题。此外，还提出了一种新的后训练方法HORN，结合了组相对任务奖励，叶条件义务奖励和监督控制回放。
AI.result: 六个开源3D大型语言模型的评价显示了显著的性能差距，而HORN方法在挑战类别上达到了75.1% ± 1.0%的准确率，在总体上达到77.2% ± 0.8%，并且未损害可回答控制问题的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果显示，HORN方法有效地提升了3D大语言模型的场景推理能力，为提高3D大语言模型的证据支撑场景推理提供了重要思路。

title: MemBubble: Benchmarking How Agent Memory Shapes LLM Response Diversity
summary: Memory serves as the core component of LLM-based agents, enabling personalized responses via extracting and using user preferences from past interactions. However, its use may reduce response diversity, thereby narrowing the range of information available to users. Existing evaluations rely largely on synthetic interactions and cover few memory systems, leaving the effects of memory on response diversity insufficiently evaluated in real-world scenarios. We introduce MemBubble, a benchmark of 1000 instances built on preferences extracted from real user-assistant conversations. To measure the extent to which memory concentrates response distributions, we construct test queries in scenarios distinct from user preferences while preserving topical relevance through shared preference categories. Across multiple LLMs and memory mechanisms, entropy decreases by 34.7% on average compared with directly providing the full interaction history, highlighting the important role of memory processing in diversity loss. We also explore simple user-side interventions and changes in information availability but find that these do not effectively close the diversity gap. Our findings highlight the need to consider preserving diversity and user access to information alongside improvements in personalization when designing and using agent memory systems.

AI.tldr: 介绍了一个名为MemBubble的记忆基准测试，其中包含从真实用户助手对话中提取偏好的1000个实例。研究发现，与直接提供完整交互历史相比，记忆处理导致熵值平均减少34.7%，表明记忆在多样性损失中的作用很重要。尽管尝试了一些用户干预，但仍然难以恢复多样性。
AI.motivation: 当前的记忆系统评估主要依赖于合成的交互场景，而真实世界中的多样性影响评估不足。因此需要引入一个基于真实用户数据的基准测试来评估记忆对响应多样性的影响。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含1000个实例的MemBubble基准测试，这些实例基于从真实用户助手对话中提取的偏好。通过构建与用户偏好不同的场景来测试模型的响应多样性。
AI.result: 在多个LLM和记忆机制下，熵值平均减少了34.7%，表明记忆在导致多样性损失中扮演重要角色。虽然进行了用户干预，但未能有效缩小多样性差距。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调，在设计和使用基于代理的记忆系统时，需要平衡个性化改进与保护多样性及用户信息访问之间的关系。

title: HybridResearcher: Bridging the Structured-Unstructured Boundary for Deep Research Agents
summary: While LLM agents are increasingly capable of gathering and synthesizing evidence from a single homogeneous source, such as structured tables or unstructured data, real-world analytical questions frequently span heterogeneous sources. For example, answering one enterprise question may require both a result computed over an internal database and evidence found on the web. Recent evaluations on benchmarks like HybridDeepResearch show that even frontier agents struggle when evidence must cross this boundary. While these benchmarks have exposed the limitation, methodologies to explicitly teach cross-source reasoning remain absent. To address this, we introduce HybridResearcher, a 4B agent trained to bridge evidence across the structured and unstructured boundary. To build it, we synthesize cross-source bridge trajectories by starting with validated single-source tasks-such as existing text-to-SQL or web search queries-and fabricating the missing source around a bridge entity drawn from the seed's own output. We retain a sample only when strict construction gates confirm that neither side alone suffices, ensuring the data requires true cross-source interdependence. Finally, we train on this curated dataset using supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. Evaluated on the existing HybridDeepResearch benchmark, HybridResearcher improves over our base model, Qwen3.5-4B, by 30.0 points pass@8 and surpasses the far larger Qwen3.5-397B-A17B by 8.3 points, while also improving over its base model on established, held-out single-source benchmarks (BrowseComp and BrowseComp-Plus), demonstrating that this complex cross-source reasoning can be taught directly to small models without triggering catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为HybridResearcher的4B规模的LLM，旨在跨结构化和非结构化数据源进行证据合成。通过将单源任务扩展为多源任务，并使用监督微调和强化学习进行训练，HybridResearcher在HybridDeepResearch基准测试中表现出色，优于多个大型模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM在处理单一来源数据时表现良好，但在面对跨来源分析问题时却显得力不从心。因此，作者希望开发一种方法，使模型能够理解和处理不同来源的数据，以更好地回答复杂问题。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种合成跨源桥梁轨迹的方法，从经过验证的单源任务出发，补充关于桥梁实体的信息，并仅保留需要真正跨源依存的数据。接着使用监督微调和强化学习训练模型。
AI.result: HybridResearcher在评估基准HybridDeepResearch上超过基模型Qwen3.5-4B 30.0 点的pass@8，超越更大型的Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 8.3 点。同时，在已有的单一来源基准测试上也有所改进，表明小型模型能够学习复杂的跨源推理而不发生灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: HybridResearcher展现了在跨源问题上的优越性能，证明了跨源推理可以直接教授给小规模模型，为复杂数据处理提供了新的思路。

title: HumanSkill-4D: Training-Free Language Querying of Animatable Gaussian Avatars in Space and Time
comment: 29 pages, 14 figures, 16 tables. Project page: https://jjunsss.github.io/HumanSkill-4D/
summary: We introduce avatar referring segmentation, which selects regions of animatable Gaussian avatars from language queries. A query can also specify a pose or motion to select matching intervals. This lets users interact with avatars for local editing and motion inspection. However, making these selections with existing language Gaussian splatting methods poses two challenges: adjacent parts and garments are hard to separate and may be referred to indirectly (region ambiguity), while fine-grained motions can look alike in RGB (motion ambiguity). We address these challenges with HumanSkill-4D, a training-free framework that shares a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and geometric operators across avatars. For each avatar, a semantic memory links body-part and garment categories to persistent Gaussian regions and appearance descriptions. The MLLM uses category names and descriptions to select categories by appearance, relation, or function. To find matching intervals, it composes operators into programs that check query conditions on driving joint trajectories stored in a motion memory. These category choices and operator outputs make selections traceable, while composing or adding operators supports new motion conditions. To evaluate this task, we introduce three human-annotated benchmarks and show that HumanSkill-4D outperforms the baselines in part segmentation and 3D and 4D referring segmentation, with compact memories and only minutes of setup per avatar.

AI.tldr: 该研究介绍了avatar referring segmentation，一种通过语言查询选择可动画化高斯avatar的区域的方法，以及一种名为HumanSkill-4D的训练-free框架，以应对区域和运动模糊等挑战，该框架使用多模态大规模语言模型和几何操作符实现。
AI.motivation: 通过引入avatar referring segmentation，用户能够通过语言与avatar进行交互，进行局部编辑和运动检验，但现有技术中存在的区域模糊和运动模糊问题使得这一任务变得复杂。
AI.method: 研究提出了一种名为HumanSkill-4D的训练-free框架，框架中包含一个共享的多模态大规模语言模型（MLLM）和几何操作符。为每个avatar创建了一个语义记忆来链接身体部分和服装类别到持续的高斯区域及外观描述，并使用MLLM通过外观、关系或功能选择类别，通过结合具有驱动关节轨迹检查查询条件的运算符程序，解决选择中的模糊性。
AI.result: 研究表明，与基准相比，HumanSkill-4D在部分分割和3D、4D引用分割方面表现出色，同时具有紧凑的内存和每个avatar仅需几分钟的设置时间。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了该框架的有效性，并指出通过使用共享语言模型和几何操作符，能够有选择性地编辑avatar的特定区域并处理复杂的运动输入。

title: TIRE: Top-Down Formula Instantiation with Reliable Execution for Physics Problem Synthesis
summary: Advancing physics reasoning in large language models requires scalable training data that connect physical laws, concrete problem scenarios, and verifiable numerical answers. Expert-designed problems offer top-down control over physical laws, conditions, and scenarios, but require costly human effort. LLM-based synthesis from texts scales efficiently, but model-generated answers and assessments leave supervision vulnerable to hallucinations. We introduce TIRE, a framework for Top-Down Formula Instantiation with Reliable Execution that brings knowledge-driven problem construction to large-scale data generation. Top-down instantiation uses reusable physical formulas and their applicability conditions to control the physical relations and numerical configurations of generated problems. Reliable execution establishes reference answers before problem generation, providing a common numerical foundation for problem construction and teacher distillation. Together, these mechanisms combine control over problem content with execution-grounded supervision for both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Using TIRE, we construct TIRE-19k, spanning nine subfields of physics. Across 3 backbone LLMs and 4 benchmarks, TIRE-19k outperforms 5 representative datasets with equal amounts of SFT data, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.86 percentage points on average. Further GRPO raises Qwen3-8B's average accuracy by 1.52 percentage points over its TIRE-19k SFT checkpoint. These results demonstrate the value of generating physics training data from explicit physical knowledge with reliable execution.

AI.tldr: TIRE框架通过自上而下的公式实例化和可靠的执行机制，结合了知识驱动的问题构造与执行验证监督，生成大量高质量的物理训练数据，提升了语言模型的物理推理能力。
AI.motivation: 为大语言模型集成可扩展的物理训练数据，解决现有方法需要大量人力成本和存在幻觉的问题。
AI.method: 引入TIRE框架，通过重用物理公式及其适用条件进行自上而下的实例化，确保物理关系和数字配置，引入可靠的执行机制在生成问题之前建立参考答案，为问题生成和教师提炼提供共同的数字基础。
AI.result: TIRE生成了涵盖九个物理子领域的TIRE-19k数据集，在三个主干大模型和四个基准测试中，TIRE-19k超过5个代表性数据集，平均提高2.86个百分点，进一步的GRPO实验表明Qwen3-8B模型在一个新数据集上还提高了1.52个百分点。
AI.conclusion: TIRE框架有效整合了知识驱动的问题构造与执行验证监督，显著提高了物理训练数据的质量，对提升大语言模型的物理推理能力具有重要作用。

title: A Cross-Domain Evaluation of Prompting Techniques for Large Language Models
comment: Published in the IEEE Proceedings of the 3rd International Conference on Foundation and Large Language Models (FLLM 2026), Barcelona, Spain, November 17-20, 2026
summary: Prompt engineering has become a central mechanism for guiding the behavior of Large Language Models (LLMs) across a wide range of reasoning and language understanding tasks [1], [2]. However, existing studies frequently evaluate prompting techniques using different LLMs, datasets, or task settings, making direct comparisons across methods and domains difficult [3]. Consequently, in this paper we present a controlled cross-domain evaluation of Zero-Shot prompting, Few-Shot prompting, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and automatic prompt optimization based on a PE2-inspired optimization pipeline [4]-[6]. All experiments were conducted with the same LLM and evaluated on six benchmark datasets covering arithmetic reasoning, logical reasoning, commonsense reasoning, and factual verification. The results show that no prompting strategy consistently outperforms the others across all domains, and pairwise statistical comparisons of the highest-performing configurations revealed no significant differences. RAG achieves the highest overall average accuracy of 78.33% when 300 examples are available for retrieval, while Few-Shot Prompting achieves comparatively high accuracies across several structured reasoning tasks. Zero-Shot Prompting remains competitive on tasks with self-contained inputs, whereas the PE2-inspired optimization approach produces stable but not systematically superior results compared to the other evaluated prompting techniques. Furthermore, increasing the number of task-specific examples does not consistently improve performance across prompting techniques, indicating strong domain and task dependency. These findings suggest that prompting techniques should be selected adaptively based on task characteristics rather than treated as universally applicable optimization strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制实验环境对零样本提示、 Few样本提示、检索增强生成（RAG）以及基于PE2启发式优化的自动提示优化方法进行了跨领域评估，使用相同的LLM和六项基准数据集进行实验，结果显示没有一种提示策略能在所有领域中始终表现最佳，提示技术应根据任务特性进行选择而非被视为通用优化策略。
AI.motivation: 现有研究中，提示技术评估常常使用不同的LLM、数据集或任务设置，这使得直接比较各种方法和领域变得困难。本文旨在提供一个更可控和跨领域的评估，以更好地理解和选择提示技术。
AI.method: 实验使用同一种LLM并在六种基准数据集上进行，数据集涉及算术推理、逻辑推理、常识推理和事实验证。评估了零样本提示、Few样本提示、检索增强生成（RAG）以及基于PE2启发式优化的自动提示优化四种提示方法。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，没有一种提示技术能在所有领域中表现最佳；RAG方法在有300个示例时获得最高平均准确率78.33%，Few样本提示在多个结构化推理任务中表现较高；零样本提示在有自我包含输入的任务中表现不错；PE2启发式优化方法的性能稳定但不如其他提示技术优秀，增加特定任务的示例并不一定能提升性能，表明提示技术对领域和任务存在强依赖。
AI.conclusion: 提示技术的选择应考虑任务特性，而不能视为一种普遍适用的优化策略。

title: O-SCD++: Replay-Free Online Scene Change Detection via Recursive Evidence Fusion
summary: Online scene change detection requires an agent to detect what has changed in a previously mapped environment while it is still on site, observing from unconstrained viewpoints and without access to future observations. This causal setting is strictly harder than its offline counterpart, and online methods have consistently trailed offline accuracy. O-SCD closed that gap by treating change as a persistent property of a 3D Gaussian splatting map of the reference scene, surpassing the strongest offline methods in change detection accuracy while operating at over 10 frames per second. O-SCD optimizes a change field over the Gaussians of the reference map, refitting it to all past cue maps at every frame, a step that consumes more than half of the per-frame budget and forces accuracy to be traded against speed. We present a replay-free formulation that eliminates this trade-off. Because the reference map stays fixed, rendering the change field is a linear operation. Each new observation can therefore be carried onto the map's Gaussians directly, by a single backward pass of the renderer, which reduces multi-view fusion to an exact two-scalar recursion per Gaussian. Past observations are never stored or revisited. The self-supervised objective that O-SCD minimizes by descent also determines the decision threshold exactly, by sorting, yielding a label-free per-frame cutoff whose margin provides a selective-prediction signal. On PASLCD, our method improves mean intersection over union from 0.489 to 0.575 and throughput from 11.8 to 25.6 frames per second, even exceeding O-SCD's offline result while remaining strictly causal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需回放的新方法，这种方法通过直接更新环境的3D高斯点云地图来检测场景变化，极大地提高了检测准确率和处理速度。
AI.motivation: 在线场景变化检测需要系统检测变化而不依赖于未来的观测数据，这比离线设置更为复杂。现有在线方法在准确率上往往落后于离线方法。因此，需要一种能同时提高准确率和处理速度的方法来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 该方法通过对固定不变的参考映射上的高斯点进行单向更新来检测场景变化，实现了一种无需回放的线性操作，从而在保证准确率的前提下显著提升了处理速度。
AI.result: 在PASLCD数据集上，新方法将平均交并比（IoU）提高了8.6个百分点，并将处理速度从每秒11.8帧提高到25.6帧，甚至超过了一部分离线方法的结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过直接更新固定不变的3D高斯点云映射来检测场景变化，消除了准确率与速度之间的权衡，从而提高了场景变化检测的效率和准确率。

title: Morpheus: a fully local, defense-in-depth de-identification engine for Greek clinical text - a benchmark evaluation
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables; supplementary material appended. Benchmark corpus: doi:10.5281/zenodo.22824894
summary: Background and Objective: Clinical free text cannot leave the hospital without de-identification, yet no de-identification system or benchmark exists for Greek clinical text. We evaluated Morpheus, a fully local de-identification pipeline for Greek clinical documents, on 500 synthetic discharge summaries. Methods: The notes (300 cardiac surgery, 100 cardiology, 100 nephrology) were generated by a frontier large language model (Gemini 3.1 Pro) constrained to authentic Greek hospital document layouts. Notes were pre-annotated at generation; two clinicians then independently reviewed and corrected every note, blinded to each other, with disagreements arbitrated. Primary outcomes were recall over must-redact identifiers and over-redaction of clinical content, measured over must-survive probes. Secondary outcomes: residual leaks flagged by an independent egress-review layer, processing time and reproducibility. Results: Inter-annotator agreement was F1 = 0.998. The de-identification rate was 96.59% (7,666/7,937 identifier instances; 95% CI 96.16-96.96): 98.49% for direct and 93.42% for quasi-identifiers. No patient's own complete identifier survived in any note; of 271 residual instances, 199 (73.4%) concerned institutional identity, chiefly the hospital letterhead. The over-redaction rate was 2.82% (190/6,747 probes; 95% CI 2.45-3.24). The egress guard flagged 2 of 271 residuals, both complete telephone numbers. Two independent runs gave identical verdicts. Conclusions: A fully local, deterministic pipeline removed 98.5% of direct patient identifiers from Greek clinical text while altering under 3% of protected clinical content; most residuals concerned the institution, not the patient. To our knowledge this is the first benchmark evaluation of clinical-text de-identification for Greek and the first quantified evaluation of an independent egress-guard layer.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了一款名为Morpheus的希腊临床文本脱敏工具，以500份合成了心脏病外科、心脏病学和腎病学三位医生记录的病历摘要进行了测试，结果显示，该工具去除了98.5%的直接患者标识符，对医疗内容的误删率为2.82%，且大多数残留信息与机构相关。
AI.motivation: 由于临床自由文本在离开医院前需要脱敏，但希腊尚未有完善的脱敏系统和基准测试。因此，研究人员开发了一款针对希腊临床文档的本地脱敏管道Morpheus，并对其进行基准测试。
AI.method: 研究人员使用了一款前沿的大型语言模型Gemini 3.1 Pro创建了300份心脏病外科，100份心脏病学和100份腎病学的合成病历摘要。这些笔记在生成时进行了预注释，并由两名盲视的临床医生独立审查和修正，并通过独立的退出审核层进行残余泄露检测。
AI.result: 跨注释者的一致性为F1 = 0.998。Morpheus脱敏率为96.59%（7,666/7,937标识实例；95% CI 96.16-96.96），直接标识符清除率为98.49%，准标识符清除率为93.42%。未发现患者的完整标识符存在，271个残留实例中有199个（73.4%）与机构身份有关。误删率为2.82%（6,747个探针中的190个），独立退出防护层发现2个完整的电话号码。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，Morpheus脱敏工具可从希腊临床文本中去除98.5%的直接患者标识符，对保护的临床内容影响很小，且大多数残留信息与机构相关，而非患者个人。这是首次对希腊临床文本脱敏进行基准测试，并且首次提供了独立退出防护层的定量评估。

title: Means-Ends Analysis Helps LLMs Plan in Continuous-State Domains
summary: LLM planning research has traditionally focused on discrete-state domains, where actions form a finite, enumerable set. Existing LLM planning frameworks largely assume actions are enumerable, modeling planning as a search process over candidate actions. However, in continuous-state domains, where actions form a continuum and cannot be enumerated, this assumption breaks down. We find a remedy in Newell and Simon's Means-Ends Analysis (MEA), a general problem-solving technique rooted in heuristics from human psychology. We develop Medaka, an MEA-inspired structured prompting framework that encourages recursive goal decomposition, algebraic derivation, and per-step state tracking. To evaluate native LLM planning abilities in continuous-state domains, we develop Liquidworld, a systematic testbed on liquid mixing. On Liquidworld, Medaka can improve performance across model families, suggesting that classical means-ends analysis elicits LLM-native reasoning abilities that are helpful for continuous-state planning.

AI.tldr: 本文填补了LLM在连续状态领域规划中的空白，通过借鉴MEB的思想，提出了Medaka框架，该框架在液体制备的测试集上优于其他模型。
AI.motivation: 传统的LLM规划研究主要集中在离散状态领域，但连续状态领域由于不可枚举的动作存在，现有框架无法有效解决。
AI.method: 作者借鉴Newell和Simon的MEB思想，设计了Medaka框架，实现递归目标分解、代数推导和每步骤状态跟踪。
AI.result: 在作者构建的Liquidworld测试集上，基于Medaka的模型比其他模型表现出更好的性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，经典的MEB方法能促使LLM展现出适用于连续状态域规划的内在推理能力。

title: Unifying Amplitude-Phase Coupling and Reliable Endogenous Priors for Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Frequency-domain methods have shown strong potential for low-light image enhancement (LLIE) because they can effectively regulate global illumination. However, most existing methods assume that amplitude and phase can be restored independently, while overlooking their inherent spectral coupling. This artificial decoupling often leads to information inconsistency and structural distortions. To address this issue, we propose a frequency-spatial framework that jointly models spectral interaction and reliable prior guidance. We first empirically analyze the coupling between amplitude and phase and develop an Amplitude-Phase Adaptive Compensation Fusion (APACF) module. Instead of enforcing a hard separation between the two components, APACF enables their bidirectional interaction, resulting in spectrally coherent restoration. In addition, directly extracting priors from raw low-light inputs is unreliable, since severe noise and underexposure destroy critical visual content. To alleviate this problem, we introduce an Endogenous Reliability Prior (ERP). Specifically, we treat an intermediate result, preliminarily restored in the frequency domain and already close to the ground-truth illumination, as a high-fidelity source for extracting complementary pseudo-infrared and gradient cues. Based on ERP, we further design a Dual-Modal Guided Refinement Network (DGRN) to inject these purified structural cues into the decoder, thereby recovering missing fine textures more accurately. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently surpasses existing methods in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. Our code is available at https://github.com/bywlzts/Amplitude-Phase-Coupling-Net.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种频率-空间框架，该框架通过联合建模光谱交互和可靠的先验引导来优化低光图像增强。引入了Amplitude-Phase Adaptive Compensation Fusion模块和Endogenous Reliability Prior，以及Dual-Modal Guided Refinement Network，以提高图像的光谱一致性、减少噪声干扰，并恢复更精细的纹理。
AI.motivation: 现有频率域方法假设幅度和相位可以独立恢复，忽视了它们的固有光谱关联，导致信息不一致和结构失真。为此，该研究旨在建立一个频率-空间框架，以克服独立光谱重建的问题。
AI.method: 该研究提出了一种频率-空间框架，包括一个Amplitude-Phase Adaptive Compensation Fusion模块，用于光谱交互适应性补偿融合；一个Endogenous Reliability Prior模块，用于提取中间结果中的互补伪红外和梯度线索；以及一个Dual-Modal Guided Refinement Network，用于将净化的结构线索注入解码器，以恢复更精细的纹理。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在基准数据集中的性能达到了最先进的水平，并且在定量和定性指标上都优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的方法在低光图像增强方面取得了显著成果，为后续研究提供了新的思路。

title: Do LLMs Reproduce the Age Gap in Loneliness? Evaluating Survey Simulation against European Survey Data
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often used to simulate survey respondents, but matching survey averages does not establish accurate demographic differences. We test whether LLM outputs reproduce within-country age gaps in loneliness using the 2022 EU Loneliness Survey, comparing adults aged 18-34 and 65 or older in France, Italy, Poland, and Sweden. We evaluate simulation with and without age information and direct distribution estimation against a probability-based sample, with a non-probability sensitivity reference. Both human samples show higher mean loneliness among younger adults. Under age-specified simulation with standard response-option order, Mistral Small 4 and GPT-5.6 Terra reverse this ordering under all three prompt framings in three and two countries, respectively, mainly by overestimating older-adult means. DeepSeek V4 Flash preserves the ordering everywhere but underestimates both group means, with errors largely cancelling in France and Italy. Against the probability-based reference, direct estimation has lower absolute age-gap error than simulation for Mistral and Terra in every country. For DeepSeek, simulation has lower gap error but direct estimation has lower group-mean error; these comparisons depend on low-validity older-adult simulation cells. Evaluating LLM outputs as proxies for age groups within countries therefore requires checking both group means and their contrast against human survey data.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过比较大规模语言模型（LLMs）生成输出与实际人类调查数据，评估了模型在模拟不同年龄段孤独感方面的准确性。研究发现，模型在特定情况下会反转年龄组之间的孤独感差异，且在某些情况下，直接估计结果比模拟结果更准确。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在评估大规模语言模型生成的模拟结果是否能准确反映真实世界中的年龄差异，特别是关于孤独感的研究，以识别模型的局限性和改进方向。
AI.method: 研究采用了2022年欧盟孤独感调查的数据，针对不同年龄段的受访者进行了比较分析。采用人类样本和概率抽样进行对比验证。
AI.result: 研究发现，有人类年龄信息的模拟结果与无年龄信息的模拟结果对比，以及模型直接估计的结果，在不同国家的表现各异。模型在特定情况下会放大或缩小特定年龄段的孤独感估评估结果，直接估计的结果在部分国家的年龄差异估计上比模拟结果更准确。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论强调，在将大规模语言模型作为国家内部不同年龄组的代理时，需要同时检查每个年龄组的平均值及其在人类调查数据中的对比情况。

title: LowNet: Looped Wavelet Neural Networks with 24 Learnable Parameters for Solving Poisson Equations
summary: Poisson equations frequently appear in various fields, such as mathematics, physics and informatics. Solving Poisson equation, however, is challenging. Traditional methods are not data-specific, although have high certainty. They require a large number of iterations due to the CFL numerical stability. In contrast, deep learning methods are data-driven and more efficient, but require accurate training data and suffer from heavy computation. To tackle these issues, we propose a wavelet-inspired Poisson solver with 24 trainable scalars. The proposed network has several advantages. First, it is compact. It has four independent $5\times5$ kernels, each represented by six parameters, leading to 24 scalars in total. Such compact format can be deployed on most devices. Second, thanks to the loop design, it achieves higher accuracy than previous methods. A residual loop reuses the wavelet block without increasing its parameters. Numerical experiments confirm that such loop indeed improves the solving accuracy. On 10000 images, one, two, and three loops of the wavelet block lead to PSNRs of $47.27$, $74.14$, and $100.74$ dB, respectively. Third, the proposed method is computationally fast. Thanks to the wavelet transform, the proposed method has linear computation complexity, leading to high computation performance. In short, we propose a novel looped wavelet neural network with compactness, accuracy and efficiency for solving Poisson equations. Our method can be applied in various fields, such as computational fluid dynamics, image reconstruction, biomedical engineering, electromagnetic field simulation.

AI.tldr: 文章提出了一种基于小波的新型循环网络方法，用于解决泊松方程。该方法具有紧凑性、高精度和高效性，适用于计算流体动力学、图像重建、生物医学工程和电磁场模拟等领域。
AI.motivation: 传统的泊松方程求解方法存在迭代次数多、计算复杂等问题，而基于小波的深度学习方法虽然较为高效，但需要精确的训练数据并且计算量大。因此，本文提出了结合小波和循环机制的新网络结构，以拓宽应用范围并改善性能。
AI.method: 本文提出的小波启发式网络中，每个小波块有四个独立的$5 	imes 5$卷积核，每个卷积核由六个参数表示，总共24个可训练标量。方法采用循环设计，通过残差循环机制重复使用小波块，不增加参数数量，同时提高了精度。此外，该方法利用小波变换以提高计算效率。
AI.result: 通过实验验证了所提出方法的有效性，使用包含10000张图像的数据集，分别使用一个、两个和三个小波块循环得到的峰值信噪比（PSNR）分别为$47.27$ dB、$74.14$ dB和$100.74$ dB。此外，由于利用了小波变换，该方法具有线性计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的小波启发式网络提高了泊松方程求解的精度、效率和泛化能力，展现了在多种科学和工程技术中的应用潜力。

title: RiSE: Residual Subspace Expert for Generalizable Text-Centric Image Forgery Localization
summary: As AI-assisted image editing becomes increasingly prevalent, Text-Centric Image Forgery Localization (TFL) is essential for protecting trust in financial and legal records. However, we observe that existing TFL detectors predominantly rely on Full-Parameter Fine-Tuning (FPFT) and fail to generalize to unseen forgery types because FPFT can induce low-rank feature collapse and overfit training artifacts. Meanwhile, prior detectors capture diverse forgery traces with a single unified representation, making subtle traces entangled and difficult to learn. To address these challenges, we propose RiSE, a Residual Subspace Expert model that preserves pre-trained priors by freezing principal SVD components and adapting only the residual subspaces with a ViT-only segmentor to avoid feature collapse. RiSE introduces forgery-aware residual experts, where each expert is trained independently on a training subset with a particular forgery type, and we show that cross-domain localization performance improves consistently as more experts are added. At inference, we introduce Latent Perturbation Confidence (LPC), which selects the most confident expert by analytically computing the latent-perturbed output. LPC enables efficient confidence estimation with a single forward pass, avoiding repeated forward passes on perturbed samples and improving expert selection. By training on synthetic forgery data, RiSE with 1 expert outperforms prior methods on real-world forgery images by 20.4% while reducing training steps by 10 times. Scaling the number of experts to 9 yields a 35.8% gain. RiSE remains effective with DCT feature, even when the majority of the parameters is frozen with RGB-only pretraining. Code: https://github.com/KahimWong/RiSE.

AI.tldr: RiSE是一种基于残差子空间专家的模型，通过冻结主奇异值分解成分并仅适应残差子空间来避免特征坍塌，同时引入伪造感知的残差专家和潜扰置信度（LPC），提高了伪造检测的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前的Text-Centric Image Forgery Localization (TFL)检测器主要依赖于全参数微调（FPFT），这可能导致特征塌陷和过拟合。RiSE模型通过保留预训练先验并只微调残差子空间来解决这些挑战。
AI.method: RiSE模型使用残差子空间专家，通过ViT-only分割器适应残差子空间，同时引入伪造感知的残差专家和潜扰置信度（LPC）。模型在合成伪造数据上进行训练，并在推理时通过LPC选择最自信的专家。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，RiSE在现实伪造图像上训练，使用单个专家时比现有方法高出20.4%，训练步骤减少10倍。扩展专家数量至9个时，性能提升35.8%。即使大部分参数被冻结，使用DCT特征时RiSE依然有效。
AI.conclusion: RiSE为Text-Centric Image Forgery Localization任务提供了一种有效的方法，能够更好地泛化到未见过的伪造类型，同时提高了伪造定位的效率。

title: Legal Guidance in the Wild: How Users Seek Legal Help in Real-World LLM Conversations
comment: 12 pages, 6 tables. Accepted for publication at JURIX 2026, Toulouse, France. This is the preprint version. Code and data available at: https://github.com/Amir-Mohseni/Legal-Guidance-in-the-Wild
summary: People ask conversational AI models about their legal rights, obligations, procedures, and personal situations that may have legal consequences. To study this behavior, we first need to distinguish requests for legal guidance from other legally themed discussions and unrelated conversations. We contribute a multi-axis taxonomy of legal queries capturing whether legal guidance is sought, how a request is formulated, and which legal domains it concerns; apply it to 2,122 naturally occurring WildChat-1M conversations; and create a human-reviewed gold evaluation set of 200 conversations. All annotations, model checkpoints, and evaluation code are publicly available. In this enriched sample, 71.1% of conversations containing legal content seek personalized or practical guidance. Rights-and-options advice is the most common primary request type among legal-content conversations, and 25.3% of guidance-positive conversations span multiple legal topics. The gold evaluation set supports a two-stage comparison of ModernBERT-base and ModernBERT-large against a TF-IDF cascade. Our framework supports large-scale studies of legal guidance in conversational AI, and the public release of the annotated data facilitates reproducible research and future model development.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个多维度的法律查询分类体系，并应用于2122次真实对话中，其中71.1%的对话寻求个性化或实用指导，主要请求类型为权利和选项建议，且25.3%的对话涉及多个法律主题。该研究还提供了黄金评价集以比较不同模型，并公开了标注数据以促进模型发展。
AI.motivation: 为了更好地理解和分析人们在对话式AI模型中对法律问题的寻求情况，研究人员需要区分法律咨询请求与其他法律相关讨论和无关对话。本研究旨在建立一种分类体系，以便更深入地分析用户的法律查询。
AI.method: 研究者开发并应用了一种多轴分类法于真实的2122次聊天记录中，并创建了200个由人工审查的黄金评价集。通过与TF-IDF方法的比较，研究了不同大小的ModernBERT模型在法律指导中的表现。
AI.result: 结果表明，在包含法律内容的对话中，71.1%的对话寻求个性化或实用指导。权利和选项建议是最常见的主要请求类型，25.3%的对话涵盖了多个法律主题。黄金评价集支持ModernBERT-base和ModernBERT-large与TF-IDF方法的两阶段比较。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为大规模的对话式AI中的法律指导研究提供了框架，并公开的标注数据将有助于未来的模型开发和研究的可重复性。

title: MemPrice: Online Memory Allocation via Adaptive Pricing for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents face a fundamental allocation problem as interaction histories grow: which information to retain, how much context to devote to it, and at what granularity. Existing memory mechanisms largely focus on relevance, retrieval, or compression, leaving this allocation trade-off implicit. We introduce MemPrice, which treats active context as a shared resource and dynamically allocates it across memories and representation levels. MemPrice turns accumulated memory pressure into an adaptive price on context, encouraging detail only when its estimated retention value justifies the additional footprint. This pressure persists across memory refreshes, allowing the contents of memory to evolve while preserving long-run control over context usage. We show that irreversible compression can force linear worst-case regret against hindsight following its own memory trajectory, and introduce a same-state benchmark to evaluate allocation on MemPrice's realized memory states. MemPrice enforces the hard context budget at every round and regulates long-run occupancy through adaptive pricing, without prior knowledge of the interaction horizon. Under priced-frontier regularity, its average allocation-regret bound against this benchmark vanishes when accumulated estimation error is sublinear. We evaluate the framework under matched memory budgets on LongMemEval, LoCoMo, AppWorld, and WebShop across three foundation models, spanning both query-blind memory construction and goal-directed agent context management.

AI.tldr: MemPrice 是一种新的内存管理机制，它将活跃上下文视为共享资源，并动态地在不同记忆和表示级别之间分配。这种机制通过适应性定价鼓励在估计保留值合理时才增加细节化，从而在长期控制上下文使用方面发挥关键作用。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆机制主要关注相关性、检索或压缩，而忽略了如何在交互历史增长时进行信息保留在细节上的权衡。MemPrice 引入了一种全新的方法来动态分配上下文，以解决这一问题。
AI.method: MemPrice 将活跃上下文视为共享资源，并通过动态定价机制来分配上下文。它使用了适应性定价来限制上下文的使用，并且在内存刷新后保持压力，从而使得内存内容可以演变同时长期控制上下文的使用。
AI.result: 研究发现，MemPrice 可以避免因不可逆压缩导致的线性最坏情况下后悔。通过与 same-state 基准比较，研究展示了 MemPrice 的性能。此外，MemPrice 与三种基础模型一起，在 LongMemEval、LoCoMo、AppWorld 和 WebShop 上进行了评估，证明了其在匹配内存预算下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 这一研究结果显示，MemPrice 能够有效地管理长期纵向环境中的上下文使用，而不需要先验了解交互时长，从而实现长期的控制。

title: Investigating Length Bias and Robustness in LVLMs for Multiple-Choice Question Answering
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate strong performance on multiple-choice question answering (MCQA), yet their reliability under biased conditions remains underexplored. We investigate length bias, the systematic preference for longer answer options, through controlled benchmarks spanning fine-grained visual domains. LVLMs consistently favor longer options even when visually inconsistent, with accuracy dropping 2--38\% when correct answers are shorter and increasing 1--70\% when longer. This bias persists across model scales. Through layer-wise mechanistic analysis, we reveal that length bias emerges from late-layer suppression of visual evidence in favor of language-side length priors. Blurry-image experiments show that bias intensifies when visual evidence weakens, while abstention tests reveal that LVLMs struggle to refuse incorrect predictions. We propose and evaluate multiple inference-time mitigation strategies; while these provide partial improvements, none achieves deployable bias mitigation without relying on oracle information unavailable at inference time. These results underscore that inference-time interventions are insufficient, pointing to the need for architectural solutions and bias-aware training.

AI.tldr: LVLMs在多项选择题上表现出色，但对有偏情况的可靠性尚未充分研究。研究发现，这些模型倾向于选择较长的答案选项，这会影响其准确性。
AI.motivation: 探索大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在有偏情况下的可靠性，特别是在多项选择题回答中，系统性偏好较长的答案选项。
AI.method: 通过精细视觉领域控制基准测试，从层级机制分析中揭示模型偏向的来源。
AI.result: LVLMs倾向于选择较长的答案选项，即使视觉证据与之不符。这在不同模型规模中保持一致。当视觉证据较弱时，这种偏见加剧，并且模型难以拒绝错误的预测。
AI.conclusion: 建议并评估了多种推理时缓解策略，但这些策略单独使用时效果有限，没有一种可以在不依赖推理时间难以获取的先验信息的情况下有效减轻偏见。研究指出了需要结构化解决方案和有偏见意识的训练方向。

title: Concept Representations in Vector Space: Toward an Interdisciplinary Study of Meaning Variation
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. Companion paper to arXiv:2610.15496. Code: https://github.com/simon-josef/conrep
summary: An increasing number of disciplines recognize the explanatory potential of meaning-bearing mental structures through which individuals interpret the world and guide their behavior. Concept representations constitute a core class of these structures, emerging from individuals' experiences with concept referents and encoding and organizing their understanding of them. Recognizing a private level of meaning, where concepts are not objectively defined by rules in the world but constitute subjective structures in individuals' minds, raises a fundamental question: do different individuals actually mean the same thing when they invoke the same concept? As latent structures, concept representations are difficult to access and model empirically. The present study introduces a measurement framework that makes such representations empirically accessible through textual traces elicited under standardized conditions. Using transformer-based sentence embeddings, the framework maps standardized responses elicited for concepts into a high-dimensional shared vector space, opening concept representations to the systematic analysis of interindividual variation. It develops three analytical avenues: (1) comparing representational sharedness across concepts, (2) identifying variables that correlate with representational variation, and (3) examining how focal actors or subpopulations deviate from a reference population. Each avenue is illustrated through an empirical proof-of-concept drawing on a large-scale free-association dataset. Together, the demonstrations show how researchers from across disciplines can move from a research question and data source to analysis and interpretation. An accompanying GitHub repository provides a ready-to-use implementation of the framework for existing and custom datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种新的测量框架，通过标准化条件下激发的文本痕迹来使概念表征变得可访问。利用基于转换器的句子嵌入，该框架将标准化激发的概念映射到高维度的共享向量空间，通过三个分析途径来分析个体间概念表征的差异：（1）概念表征共享性比较，（2）识别与表征变化相关的变量，（3）检查关键个体或亚群体与参考群体的区别。通过大规模的自由联想数据集进行了实证研究证实了框架的有效性。
AI.motivation: 探讨相同概念在不同个体内心含义的差异，以及如何通过文本痕迹量化这些差异。
AI.method: 使用基于转换器的句子嵌入技术将概念响应标准化后映射到高维度的共享向量空间，从而分析概念表征的个体间差异。
AI.result: 通过标准化的条件激发的自由联想数据集，在实证研究中展示了这个新的测量框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为不同学科提供了从研究问题和数据源至分析和解释的新途径，并提供了使用该方法进行现有及自定义数据集分析的 GitHub 存储库。

title: Revealing what benchmark scores hide: Jointly measuring the breadth and reliability of LLM capabilities using accessibility profiles
comment: 26 pages total, 10 pages main text, 18 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/kazemf78/access-eval
summary: Language model benchmarks assign each question a single outcome from one fixed wording, even though the same underlying request can be expressed in many equivalent ways. We argue that the quantity of interest should therefore not be correctness on one wording, but the accessibility of an inquiry, which we define as the probability that a model succeeds across meaning-preserving formulations. The distribution of accessibility across inquiries reveals a structure that accuracy and existing best-, worst-, or average-case prompt scores collapse: how broadly a model's capabilities extend across inquiries and how dependably those capabilities can be elicited. Two models can have the same average performance while one succeeds across more inquiries unreliably and the other succeeds across fewer inquiries but more consistently, leading to opposite preferences depending on whether the task allows multiple retries until one success or when repeated consistent success is required. Across six benchmarks and more than twenty models, this tradeoff is common: for about half of the model pairs with nearly equal mean accessibility, which model looks better depends on whether one success across five formulations is enough or all five must succeed, quantities we call Access@5 and Reliable@5, respectively. For some pairs the two measures diverge significantly, by up to 10 points in opposite directions. Accessibility also reveals that scaling, reasoning, and prompt optimization can redistribute capability across inquiries in ways aggregate accuracy obscures, sometimes broadening the set of inquiries a model can succeed on while making success on them less repeatable. Accessibility turns formulation sensitivity from a nuisance into a measurable property of capability, distinguishing what a model can sometimes succeed on from what users can actually depend on.

AI.tldr: 该研究指出，当前语言模型基准难以全面评估模型的能力，因为它们仅关注单一表述的正确性，而忽视了不同表述下模型的总体可用性。通过定义模型的‘可访问性’为在保留意思的情况下，模型成功的概率，作者展示了各种模型在不同表述上的表现差异显著，甚至在平均性能相似的情况下也是如此。这也揭示了扩展性和推理能力可以重新分配模型在不同请求中的能力，而这种重新分配在整体准确率上是不明显的。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型基准主要关注单一表述上的正确性，忽视了不同表述下的整体可用性。研究者认为有必要重新定义评估模型能力的标准，通过引入‘可访问性’这一概念，来更全面地评估模型表现。
AI.method: 作者基于‘可访问性’这一概念，重新设计评估模型的方法，通过多种表述下的概率来评估模型在不同任务上的表现。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，不同模型在不同表述下的性能差异明显，即使平均性能相似的情况也不例外。此外，扩展性和推理能力可以重新分配模型在不同请求中的能力，这在整体准确率上是不明显的，但通过可访问性的评估可以清晰揭示。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了当前语言模型基准评估不足的问题，通过引入‘可访问性’这一新的评估维度，可以更全面地评估模型在不同请求上的表现，也使得评估更加透明和准确。

title: SAP-Depth: Scene-Adaptive Probability Framework for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation remains challenging due to the loss of fine-grained details and limited adaptability to varying scene structures. In this paper, we propose SAP-Depth, a novel architecture based on Scene-Adaptive Probabilistic. Unlike traditional methods, we introduce a Dynamic Bins mechanism powered by a Learnable Parameter Predictor, which adaptively estimates scene-specific depth distributions conditioned on the input image context. Furthermore, a Bin-wise Probability Distribution Decoder is designed to effectively fuse multi-scale representations to predict dense depth probability distributions, significantly enhancing boundary sharpness and structural recovery. Through the collaborative coupling of these proposed modules, our model achieves dynamic prediction of scene-specific depth distributions. Extensive experiments on the KITTI dataset show that SAP-Depth outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in accuracy, particularly in its ability to better preserve complex edge details. Further, tests on the Make3D dataset validate the model's excellent generalization capability and robustness.

AI.tldr: SAP-Depth 提出了一种基于场景自适应概率的新架构，通过动态bins机制和多尺度表示融合预测稠密深度概率分布，从而在复杂边缘细节保留和泛化能力上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的单目深度估计方法在保留细节和适应不同场景结构方面效果有限。
AI.method: 提出了SAP-Depth架构，引入了动态bins机制和BIN-wise概率分布解码器，通过输入图像上下文自适应地估计场景特定的深度分布。
AI.result: 在Kitti数据集上的实验表明，SAP-Depth 在精度上超越了现有方法，尤其在保留复杂边缘细节方面效果更好。Make3D数据集上的测试验证了该模型的泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SAP-Depth 通过协作耦合这些模块，实现了场景特定深度分布的动态预测。

title: Reranking Answers of Large Language Models with Knowledge Graphs
comment: 37 pages. Accepted for the Semantic Web journal (tracking no. 4075-5289); not published. https://www.semantic-web-journal.net/content/reranking-answers-large-language-models-knowledge-graphs-1
summary: Answering natural language questions over knowledge graph data is challenging due to the vast number of facts, which can be difficult to process and navigate. One potential solution for this issue is to use mined subgraphs related to the query, although this process still requires extracting these subgraphs. This research presents a solution for extracting subgraphs related to entity candidates from a question-and-answer set, which can be obtained by inferring a large language model by calculating the shortest paths between entities. The proposed approaches detail various features that can be extracted from the subgraphs and reranking models to select the most probable answers from a list of candidates. Experiments were conducted on Wikidata to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approaches. This involved enumerating all the main feature types that can be extracted from mined subgraphs and a detailed analysis of the proposed features and reranking method combinations. In addition, a public web application that provides a useful web tool for studying the graph space between question and answer entities has been developed to work with subgraphs. This includes visualization of the extracted subgraph and automatic generation of natural language text to describe it.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种从问答数据集推断实体候选相关子图的方法，通过计算实体间的最短路径，并提出多种特征提取方法和重新排名模型选择最可能的答案。实验在Wikidata上进行，分析了可从中提取的各种特征类型以及重新排名方法的组合。
AI.motivation: 自然语言问答在知识图谱数据上的应用面临挑战，因为知识图谱拥有大量事实，难以处理和导航。为了解决此问题，本文提出通过推断大型语言模型计算实体间的最短路径得到实体候选相关子图的方法，以此简化问题处理，提高搜索效率。
AI.method: 首先，通过大语言模型推断实体间最短路径，筛选出相关的实体候选子图；其次，研究提取子图中的多种特征；最后，采用重新排名模型从候选中挑选最可能的答案。
AI.result: 在Wikidata上的实验详细分析了可从中提取的各种特征类型及重新排名方法的组合效果；开发了一个可视化工具，辅助对实体间子图空间的研究。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，提取特征和重新排名模型有效地改善了实体间子图的表达和问题解答的质量，增强了在知识图谱中处理自然语言问题的能力。

title: CoworkEnv: Synthesizing Training Environments for Long-Horizon Cowork Agents
summary: AI coworkers must coordinate tools, communicate across turns, and act on changing workspace state while respecting workflow constraints. Constructing training experience for these capabilities requires coherent requests, service records, tool interfaces, and grading checks. We present CoworkEnv, a capability-guided framework for synthesizing executable training environments for AI coworkers. Workflow requirements guide task construction, and programmatic validation with feedback repair checks generated specifications and grading behavior. Teacher executions yield curated demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while student interactions provide rollouts and rewards for reinforcement learning (RL). Using these resources, we train compact PocketWorker models. For Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, SFT raises the mean score from 46.6 to 64.1 on Claw-Eval, including a 31.9-point gain on Multi-turn tasks. An SFT-only extension to ClawMark demonstrates applicability across coworker benchmarks. We further compare RL training dynamics across configurations that vary reward processing and credit assignment. Improving training rewards provide preliminary evidence that the constructed environments support policy optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了CoworkEnv，一种指导能力的框架，用于合成可执行的AI同事训练环境。通过教师执行和学生交互，分别用于监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）的示例和奖励得到收集。这些资源用于训练紧凑的PocketWorker模型。SFT显著提高了Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct在Claw-Eval上的表现，尤其是在多轮任务中。
AI.motivation: 由于AI同事需要与其他工具协调，跨轮次沟通，并且考虑到工作空间的变化状态，我们构建了CoworkEnv框架，该框架能够合成可执行的训练环境，以提高AI同事的能力。
AI.method: 使用CoworkEnv框架来指导任务构建，结合程序验证，生成规格和评估行为。教师执行生成监督微调示例，而学生交互生成强化学习的奖励。将资源用于训练紧凑的PocketWorker模型，并通过比较不同奖励处理和信用分配的配置来分析强化学习训练的动力学。
AI.result: 通过监督微调（SFT），Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct的表现从46.6提升到了64.1，在Claw-Eval上取得了显著的进步。进一步的实验表明，在不同奖励处理和信用分配配置下，强化学习的训练表现出不同的动力学，改善训练奖励为政策优化提供了初步证据。
AI.conclusion: CoworkEnv框架展示了其在不同AI同事基准测试中的普适性，并提供了通过调整奖励和信用分配策略来优化强化学习的基本证据。

title: MOMO: Human Motion from Moving Sounds
summary: Human responses to sound depend not only on its semantic content, but also on the evolving spatial relationship between source and listener, conveyed through spatial audio and its temporal dynamics. Modeling human reactions to such dynamic spatial audio is important for character animation, human behavior analysis, and robotics. As of yet, existing audio-driven motion generation methods primarily focus on non-spatial or static acoustic conditions, leaving this important problem largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we formulate the novel task of dynamic spatial-audio-driven human motion generation and introduce two motion-captured datasets. We introduce the Dynamic Spatial Audio and Motion dataset (DySAM) as the first dataset and benchmark for this task, providing synchronized binaural audio, 3D human motions, and moving sound source trajectories. Given the importance of dynamic spatial cues of sound sources, we further provide the Dynamic Spatial Audio Localization dataset (DySAL), an auxiliary binaural localization dataset that pairs diverse acoustic events with head poses and moving source trajectories to support spatial audio perception. For benchmarking, we propose MOMO for human Motion generation from Moving Sounds, a diffusion-based framework guided by three coupled principles: localization, understanding, and generation. MOMO performs localization by estimating head-centric spatial direction cues of the moving source directly from raw binaural audio, avoiding reliance on ground-truth source coordinates. It performs understanding by extracting frame-wise audio-content representations, and performs generation by conditioning motion diffusion on both semantic features and dynamic spatial cues. Experiments show that MOMO outperforms existing baselines in motion fidelity, audio-motion alignment, and physical plausibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了动态空间音频驱动的人体运动生成任务，并引入了两个数据集DySAM和DySAL，以及基于扩散模型的MOMO框架，该框架通过空间定位、音频内容理解和运动生成三个耦合原则来生成人体运动。
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动的运动生成方法主要关注非空间或静态声学条件，这忽略了动态空间听觉线索对人类反应的重要影响。因此，本文旨在通过建立基于动态空间音频的数据集和模型来更好地模拟人类对实时动态声音的反应。
AI.method: 本文采用了一个基于扩散模型的MOMO框架，该框架包含三个关键步骤：空间定位、音频内容理解和运动生成。MOMO通过直接从原始双耳录音中估计头部中心的空间方向线索来进行空间定位；通过提取帧级音频内容表示来做音频内容理解；通过运动扩散过程同时条件于语义特征和动态空间线索来进行运动生成。
AI.result: 实验表明，MOMO在运动保真度、音频-运动对齐和物理可实现性方面优于现有基准。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法和数据集对于研究人类对动态空间声音的反应、动作动画以及机器人技术具有重要意义。

title: Acharya 2.0: An AI Tutor for Self-Learning Subjects in Hindi
summary: Text processing is crucial for low-resource languages as it enables the development of tools and technologies that bridge the digital divide and provide equitable access to information and services. By empowering low-resource languages with robust text processing, we can preserve linguistic diversity, enhance education, improve communi- cation, and foster inclusivity in a rapidly digitizing world. Due to the lack of sufficient annotated datasets and lin- guistic resources, it is challenging to develop accurate and reliable language technologies for these low-resource languages. Large Language Models (LLMs) have attracted sig- nificant attention with their performance and the value they produce. However, with the ever-evolving language, adapting LLMs for a specific task is time-consuming and resource-intensive. Thus, Retrieval-Augmented Genera- tion (RAG) has overcome this limitation by augmenting LLMs with external knowledge, thereby improving their efficiency and extensive task-specific adaptation. Most applications of the RAG technique have been limited to English and has seen limited application in In- dic languages. This paper introduces the RAG-powered AI-Tutor application, Acharya 2.0, designed to produce academic assistance to Hindi-speaking students. The client-server-based web application integrates many fea- tures to support students in accessing and interacting with educational content.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了一种使用RAG技术为印地语学生提供学术辅导的AI-Tutor应用，旨在通过增强语言模型解决低资源语言（如印地语）处理中的难题。
AI.motivation: 随着数字化进程的加速，为低资源语言（如印度的印地语）提供强大的文本处理能力变得尤为重要。缺乏足够的标注数据和语言资源使得开发准确可靠的语言技术难度大。然而，传统的语言模型受制于特定任务长时间的适配需求。 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) 技术通过引入外部知识，提高了语言模型的效率和特定任务的适应性。
AI.method: 该论文提出了一种基于RAG的AI-Tutor应用——Acharya 2.0，为印地语学生提供学术辅导。该应用基于客户端-服务器架构，集成了多种功能以支持学生访问和互动教育资源。
AI.result: 通过Acharya 2.0，提供了对印地语学生更有针对性的帮助，展示了RAG技术在低资源语言中的应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究强调了RAG技术在低资源语言环境中的优势，并展示了其在印度印地语教育领域的应用效果，为进一步推广RAG技术用于其他低资源语言提供了新视角。

title: Towards Human-AI Complementarity for AI Safety
summary: Safely overseeing AI is increasingly challenging for the humans doing it, as they must evaluate longer and more complex outputs with every new model generation. To mitigate this challenge, we could leverage complementarity: where humans and models make different mistakes, combining their judgements could yield an oversight signal stronger than either produces alone. We study this opportunity in realistic, safety-relevant settings, contributing the largest known suite of such tasks (3,957 instances across 8 datasets and 6 domains) as well as a platform and data pipeline for measuring human, AI, and human-AI performance on matched items. We collected 35,613 judgements from 416 human raters, finding a considerable opportunity for a complementarity effect. We also found that with the assistance methods we tested, human raters corrected the AI's errors less often, even when overall human accuracy rose, and the hybridisation methods we tested added little over the better single source on average. While complementarity is an important and feasible engineering target for safe oversight, achieving it remains an open challenge for future work.

AI.tldr: 研究通过利用人类和AI模型之间的互补性来增强安全监督的效果，尽管存在一些挑战，但仍发现这种互补性能够在某些方面有效提高准确性。
AI.motivation: 随着AI模型生成更长、更复杂的输出，人类监督者面临的挑战日益增加。因此，研究者提出利用人类和AI之间的互补性来提高安全监督的效能。
AI.method: 研究者构建了包含3,957个任务实例的数据集，并开发了评估平台和数据管道来测量人类、AI以及人类与AI合作的表现。对人类评分者进行了35,613次评价，测试了多种辅助方法。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，人类和AI之间的互补性在某些情况下可以显著提高准确性。然而，尽管人类评分者的准确性有所提高，但它们纠正AI错误的机会却较少。测试的组合方法在总体上通常没有优于单一来源。
AI.conclusion: 尽管互补性是安全监督的重要且可行的目标，但要实现这一目标仍然是未来工作的一项挑战。

title: VisConf: Quality-Aware Consensus for Best-of-N in Vision-Language Model Reasoning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: VLM4RWD. 20 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/VisConf-VLM-BoN/
summary: Best-of-N methods improve text-only LLM reasoning by sampling multiple trajectories before selecting an answer. For Vision-Language Models (VLMs), answer frequency and model confidence alone can be insufficient, as sampled generations also vary in their engagement with the visual input. We find that distributional confidence and visual attention are complementary indicators of rollout quality. Each is limited on its own, while trajectories that show strong signals in both are more likely to be correct. Motivated by this, we introduce VisConf, a rollout-quality score that multiplicatively combines visual engagement with candidate-calibrated Self-Certainty, penalizing rollouts that are weak in either signal. We incorporate Rank-Weighted Consensus (RWC), a tuning-free aggregation rule that converts within-question VisConf ranks into answer-level vote weights. Across three VLMs on MathVista, MMMU-Pro, and MMStar, VisConf with RWC consistently outperforms strong BoN baselines. Our analysis shows particularly large gains when correct trajectories are present but underrepresented in the candidate pool.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个用于视觉语言模型（VLMs）的 rollout 质量评估方法 VisConf，它结合了视觉关注和候选者的可信度，其与 Rank-Weighted Consensus (RWC) 结合使用，能够在多个 VLMs 上显著超越强最优选择基线。
AI.motivation: 当前的 Best-of-N 方法在 VLMs 上的效果可能不理想，因为这些方法仅依赖于答案的频率和模型的置信度，而忽视了视觉输入的参与度。因此，亟需一种更全面的评估方法来提高 VLMs 的推理质量。
AI.method: 该方法引入了 VisConf，它是通过将候选者的自信心（calibrated Self-Certainty）与视觉参与度（visual attention）进行乘法组合而成的。此外，还结合了 Rank-Weighted Consensus (RWC)，这是一种无需调参的聚合规则，可以将问题内 VisConf 排序转换为答案级别的投票权重。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用 VisConf 和 RWC 的方法在 MathVista、MMMU-Pro 和 MMStar 三个 VLMs 上都比强大的最优选择基线表现得更好，尤其是在正确路径存在但未能充分代表候选池时，效果尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，将视觉参与度和候选者自信心结合的 VisConf 方法是评估 VLMs 卷积质量的有力工具，并且通过与 RWC 的结合可以提高模型的整体推理能力。

title: A Thousand Faces: A Persuasion Benchmark with Experience-Grounded Persuadees Informed by Psychology and Pragmatics
summary: People can express the same beliefs and desires yet need different reasons to change their minds. What makes an argument relevant depends on how those views arose: experiences shape what a person finds credible, what matters to them, and what could prompt reconsideration. These personal grounds may also be expressed indirectly, through contextual clues in conversation. Benchmarks that specify beliefs and desires without these connections can reward arguments that match a description while overlooking whether they address the person's reasons. We introduce A Thousand Faces (ATF-Persu), with 1,000 personas across 200 topics and nine domains. Drawing on personality and attitude theories and conversational implicature, we construct five personas per factual context, linking experiences to judgments, expression, and grounds for revision. Evaluations show lower persuasion success than three comparison benchmarks under their respective protocols. Complete backgrounds yield broader use of supplied personal grounds and higher persona faithfulness than simplified specifications; blinded reviewers also rate ATF-Persu above CToMPersu on identifiable personal reasons, their influence on responses, and contextual expression. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Slandes/ATF-Persu.

AI.tldr: 该研究介绍了A Thousand Faces (ATF-Persu)数据集，包含1000个个性化角色，旨在评估不同人物的个性化理由对说服效果的影响。
AI.motivation: 动机在于指出传统基准无法捕捉到个人背景和体验对说服的核心作用，并通过建立一个包含各种个性化角色的数据集来填补这个空白。
AI.method: 研究者基于人格理论、态度理论和会话含意，为每个事实情境创建五个个性化角色，将经历与判断、表达和修正原因联系起来，设计了A Thousand Faces (ATF-Persu)数据集。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，ATF-Persu相比三个对照基准在各自的测试协议下，说服成功率较低；具有完整背景的个性化理由比简化描述更有助于广泛使用，并提高了角色的忠实度；盲评审也对ATF-Persu给予了较高评价。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了个性化理由在说服中的重要性，并指出未来工作将探索更具复杂性的多智能体系统。

title: CorrectRTL: Boost RTL Generation Quality Through Automated Self-Correction with Instruction Decomposition
comment: This paper is accepted by ICCAD'26
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong promise in specification-to-RTL generation. Among the explorations, the self-correction paradigm has significantly advanced LLM-based RTL generation. However, two challenges limit further progress. Existing benchmarks are saturated by advanced LLMs, leaving little room to evaluate the agentic self-correction framework. The monolithic self-correction paradigm rewrites the entire design at once, where LLMs are susceptible to error confusion and corruption of originally correct code. To address the benchmark challenge, we contribute ScaleBench, a more challenging benchmark of 200 complex RTL designs. To address the challenge in methodology, we propose CorrectRTL, an agentic framework that realizes a new decompose-then-correct paradigm, in which the LLM agent explicitly decouples scaffold construction from detailed implementation. CorrectRTL contributes three core techniques: (1)~\emph{Structure-oriented decomposition}, (2)~\emph{Snippet-based RAG}, and (3)~\emph{SVA-based self-correction}. On ScaleBench, CorrectRTL improves Pass@1 from 20.5% to 49.0% (+28.5%). On VerilogEval, CorrectRTL achieves up to 96.1% Pass@1, demonstrating consistent improvements across both simple and complex designs.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个更具挑战性的基准ScaleBench，并开发了CorrectRTL框架，以改善大型语言模型在自动生成RTL代码中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基准已经被先进的LLMs饱和，难以区分LLM的性能，而现有的自校正方法在纠正错误时容易混淆和破坏正确代码。
AI.method: 研究提出了ScaleBench用于挑战现有的LLM，并开发了一个名为CorrectRTL的新框架，其中包括结构导向分解、基于片段的RAG和SVA自校正三种关键技术。
AI.result: 在ScaleBench上，CorrectRTL将Pass@1从20.5%提高到49.0%，在VerilogEval上实现了高达96.1%的Pass@1，显示出在简单和复杂设计中的一致改进。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为LLM生成RTL代码的改进做出了贡献，通过具有挑战性的基准和创新的技术方法增强了LLM的可靠性和适用性。

title: An Optical Music Recognition Tool for String Quartets
comment: 3 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Extended abstract for the Late-Breaking/Demo Session of ISMIR 2025, Daejeon, South Korea
summary: This paper presents an optical music recognition (OMR) system tailored for PDF scores of string quartet pieces. The approach begins with a SegNet-based segmentation model to localize musical regions, followed by convolutional neural networks and image processing techniques to classify and extract musical symbols. To improve rhythmic precision, dynamic programming methods enforce time signature constraints and explicitly handle tuplets. Evaluation using a longest common subsequence metric across multiple feature matrices demonstrates robust accuracy in recognizing pitch, onset, duration, and accidentals on a benchmark dataset. Code and data are available at https://github.com/lattellie/25-omr.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于PDF弦乐四重奏乐谱的光学音乐识别系统，采用SegNet进行分割并结合卷积神经网络和图像处理技术识别音符，通过动态规划优化节奏精确度。
AI.motivation: 提供了一种专为弦乐四重奏PDF乐谱设计的光学音乐识别方案，系统地解决音乐符号识别的挑战。
AI.method: 该系统首先使用SegNet模型进行分割，然后通过卷积神经网络和图像处理技术进行分类与提取，最后利用动态规划方法优化节奏。
AI.result: 该方法在基准数据集上的表现稳健，能够准确识别音高、起始时间、持续时间和变调符号。
AI.conclusion: 该研究呈现的一种光学音乐识别系统在识别弦乐四重奏PDF乐谱中的音乐符号方面表现出色，并提供开源代码和数据。

title: Calibration-Free Early Stopping for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via E-processes
summary: Reasoning large language models (LLMs) benefit from test-time scaling, motivating adaptive policies that spend tokens when they help and stop early otherwise. Existing rules halt when a confidence or stability signal crosses a threshold, but such thresholds rarely transfer across models and datasets, and validation-calibrated rules lose their guarantee under shifts in test-time horizon or signal dynamics. We reframe adaptive stopping as sequential evidence accumulation along the reasoning trajectory rather than threshold calibration on held-out data. Our framework runs two e-processes on a shared per-chunk signal: a commit stream tracks the signal's position relative to its slow trend, and an abstain stream tracks its signed velocity, making the two anti-correlated by construction. Under signal-level nulls on the per-chunk increments, Ville's inequality yields an anytime-valid signal-level false-alarm bound at user-specified significance levels, with no held-out calibration. Across various model--dataset combinations, the framework matches or exceeds calibration-based stopping on the token--accuracy Pareto front using zero calibration data, and the same significance level transfers unchanged across cells where calibration becomes infeasible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的自适应停止策略，不依赖于保留出的数据集进行阈值校准，而是从信号累积的角度出发，通过Ville不等式为用户自定义的显著性水平提供了即时有效的错误警报边界。
AI.motivation: 现有的针对LLMs的适应性停止策略通常依赖于保留出的数据集进行阈值校准，但这种策略难以在不同模型和数据集之间通用，也无法保证在测试时长或信号动态发生变化时的有效性。
AI.method: 本文采用一种基于信号累积的自适应停止策略，运行两个过程：commit stream跟踪信号相对于其慢趋势的位置，abstain stream则跟踪信号的加速度，这两个过程的关联性由Ville不等式确保。
AI.result: 在各种模型-数据集组合下，本文提出的方法能够达到或超越基于校准的停止策略在token-准确率帕累托前沿的表现，不需要任何保留出的数据集进行校准，且相同显著性水平在不校准的情况下的表现是稳定的。
AI.conclusion: 本文的方法为适应性停止策略提供了一种新的视角，能够在多种场景下达到或超越现有的方法，为进一步研究提供了有价值的基础。

title: VLA-Rolling: Fewer Denoising Steps, Better Control via Adaptive Action Reuse
summary: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models generate an action chunk by iteratively denoising Gaussian noise, but typically execute only a short prefix before replanning with updated observations. Under this receding-horizon paradigm, the unexecuted remainder---the action tail---is discarded, and the next chunk is regenerated from fresh noise. We show that this discarded tail retains transferable denoising progress: action-tail initialization can match or outperform a native 10-step Gaussian baseline using fewer denoising steps. However, the optimal denoising budget varies substantially across samples, indicating that tail reuse should be adapted to the updated environment. Based on this observation, we introduce VLA-Rolling, a lightweight inference framework that reuses action tails through three stages: action-tail inheritance, per-action confidence estimation, and confidence-guided refinement through renoising and denoising budget allocation, while the underlying VLA remains frozen. Across $π_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, X-VLA, and MolmoAct2 on LIBERO, MetaWorld, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, VLA-Rolling reduces action-chunk inference cost in all 16 model--benchmark pairs, achieving up to a $1.48\times$ speedup, while improving success rate in 14 pairs by up to $15.08$ percentage points. These results show that action tails are not merely discarded predictions, but reusable intermediate states that enable more efficient and accurate VLA inference. These results demonstrate that the action tail can support the generation of better actions with fewer denoising steps. Our project is available at https://chenbao123ww.github.io/VLA-Rolling/.

AI.tldr: VLA-Rolling 提出了一种重新利用动作尾巴的轻量级推理框架，显著提高了基于 VLA 的动作生成效率，减少了推理成本，并在多个基准上提高了成功率。
AI.motivation: 经典的 VLA 模型在每次迭代中仅执行短的动作前缀，余下的动作尾巴则被丢弃，造成了资源的浪费。文章提出了 VLA-Rolling 框架，通过重用动作尾巴来提升模型的效率。
AI.method: VLA-Rolling 通过三个阶段来重用动作尾巴：动作尾巴继承、动作执行自信度估计以及根据自信度进行重噪和预算调整。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，VLA-Rolling 实现了显著的性能提升，包括行动块推理成本最多降低了 1.48 倍，以及在 14 个基准上成功概率提高了15.08 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，动作尾巴不仅可被丢弃的动作残余，而是可以被重用的中间状态，有助于更高效的 VLA 推理过程。

title: Contrastive Hypergraph Source-free Domain Adaptive Object Detection in Adverse Weather Conditions--Extended Version
comment: 20 pages. An extended version of "Contrastive Hypergraph Source-free Domain Adaptive Object Detection in Adverse Weather Conditions" accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Adverse weather conditions such as fog, rain, snow, and low illumination introduce structured visibility degradations that severely impair object detectors trained on clear-weather data. When source data are inaccessible due to privacy or trans- mission constraints, source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) becomes necessary. However, existing SFDA methods based on pairwise contrastive learning struggle to capture high-order semantics and often suffer from agreement collapse under severe corruption. We propose REUNION, a hypergraph-guided SFDA framework for object detection in adverse weather conditions. REUNION constructs a contrastive hypergraph over target-domain object proposals, encoding high-order relations through intra-image context, weather-aware grouping, prototype-based semantic anchors, and uncertainty-aware connections between reliable and low-confidence instances. To effectively exploit these structured relations, we introduce a group-wise Hyper-InfoNCE objective that optimizes representations at the hyperedge level, enabling semantic information to propagate from confident proposals to corrupted or low-contrast instances. Experiments with diverse benchmarks demonstrate that REUNION effectively mitigates domain shifts and achieves state-of-the-art performance in SFDA settings.

AI.tldr: REUNION 提出了一种基于超图的无源域适应框架，用于恶劣天气条件下的目标检测，通过构建对比超图，引入分组的 Hyper-InfoNCE 目标优化表示，从而抑制域偏移并实现最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的无源域适应方法难以捕捉到高阶语义，并且在严重破坏下易发生一致性崩溃。因此需要一种新的框架来处理恶劣天气条件下的目标检测问题。
AI.method: REUNION 引入了超图作为骨架，构造对比超图，利用图像内的上下文信息、天气感知分组、原型语义锚点以及不确定性感知的可靠性和低置信度实例间连接，同时设计了分组的 Hyper-InfoNCE 目标来优化超边水平的表示。
AI.result: REUNION 在多个基准测试中证明了其在无源域适应设置下的有效性和优越性，能够有效地缓解域偏移问题，实现优越的检测性能。
AI.conclusion: REUNION 通过创新的框架和方法解决了恶劣天气条件下的目标检测挑战，为无源域适应领域提供了新的思路和解决方案。

title: Hidden Cartographer: Hidden State Guided Data Selection for Dual Budgeted Instruction Tuning
summary: Given the high cost of expert annotation and limited fine-tuning resources, effective data selection from large unlabeled pools under strict budgets has become a crucial step in adapting LLMs to specialized domains. Existing label-dependent methods risk distorted selection when using pseudo-labels, while traditional active learning methods do not explicitly characterize instruction-tuning dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose Hidden Cartographer (HC), a two-stage framework that uses hidden states to guide annotation and exact training dynamics to select the final training subset. The first stage is Progressive Candidate Expansion, which utilizes the proxy to iteratively select top unlabeled candidates for expert annotation, merging them to recompute training dynamics and update the proxy until the annotation budget is exhausted; the second stage is Exact Cartography Pruning, which ranks these annotated candidates by their exact dynamics scores to isolate a compact subset under the final training budget. Experiments across the medical, legal, and financial domains demonstrate that HC achieves the highest average accuracy among all budgeted baselines, requiring annotation for only 20--30% of the original pool and fine-tuning on just 10--15%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个称为隐藏制图师（Hidden Cartographer, HC）的两阶段框架，旨在高效地从大量未标记数据中选择训练样本，以适应特定领域的大语言模型（LLMs）。该方法利用隐藏状态进行标注指导，并通过精确的训练动力学挑选最终的训练子集，显著提高了预算内标签训练和微调的效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的标注依赖方法在使用伪标签时容易产生偏差，而传统的主动学习方法未能充分捕捉指令微调过程中的动态变化。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了一种新颖的两阶段方法隐制图师（HC），以提高适应特定领域LLMs的数据选择效率。
AI.method: 该方法分两阶段进行：第一阶段，逐步候选扩展（Progressive Candidate Expansion），通过迭代选择顶级未标注候选样本，并将它们合并以重新计算训练动态并更新代理，直至用尽标注预算；第二阶段，精确测绘修剪（Exact Cartography Pruning），根据精确的动态评分对这些标注候选样本进行排名，从而选出在最终预算内的紧凑训练子集。
AI.result: 实验证明，隐制图师（HC）方法在医疗、法律和金融等领域的预算内表现最佳，只需对原数据池的20-30%进行标注，而在训练和微调时只需使用不到10-15%的数据。
AI.conclusion: 本文的方法为在有限预算内高效且准确地选择和利用数据，以适应特定领域的大语言模型提供了一种有效的解决方案。

title: SteadyThought: Mitigating LLM Under-Thinking via Thought-Level Preference Optimization
summary: Flexible switching between reasoning trajectories (i.e., thought switching) has significantly enhanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). However, existing models often switch excessively yet fail to sustain promising reasoning thoughts, a phenomenon termed "under-thinking". While recent efforts suppress switching to mitigate this, such over-correction may discard valuable trajectories. To address this challenge, we propose Steady Thought (ST), a novel thought-level preference optimization framework. ST formalizes under-thinking as a preference issue at switching points, forcing single-path continuations from identified points to yield high-quality reasoning. Then, ST performs thought-level preference optimization by treating the newly generated response as preferred and the original one as dis-preferred. Experiments across multiple models and datasets show that ST effectively reduces token consumption, achieving reductions of up to 63.8%, while maintaining strong reasoning accuracy. Further analysis suggests that ST helps models acquire a generalizable ability to reduce redundant switching across domains and languages. Code is available at https://github.com/MIRALab-USTC/SteadyThought.

AI.tldr: 通过引入Steady Thought（ST）框架，该研究解决了大型推理模型在推理过程中出现的过度切换和下思考题现象，实现了高质推理同时降低了63.8%的标记消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在推理过程中常出现过度切换的问题，这可能导致有价值的想法被忽略。由于过度抑制切换可能导致重要推理路径的遗漏，因此需要开发一种方式以平衡低频切换带来的高质推理输出。
AI.method: ST框架首先将下思考题作为一个切换点上的偏好问题进行形式化，促使模型在确定点之后仅沿单一路径继续推理；接着运用新的生成回应作为首选，原始回应作为不选来实现对推理路径的优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，ST框架成功减少了标记使用量，并且保持了强大的推理准确度，具有跨模型和数据集的一致性。
AI.conclusion: ST框架为复杂推理场景提供了提高推理质量同时降低资源消耗的有效解决方案，并有助于模型获得跨领域和语言的减小冗余切换的能力。

title: Write Once, Query Many: Evolving Compact Reusable Memory for Long Videos
summary: Long videos often exceed the context capacity of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), while agentic search repeats costly video processing and grounding for each query. Reusable memory can amortize this cost, but must preserve information for questions unknown during construction. We propose Video-EMem, an evolvable video memory harness built on time-anchored perceptual observations. This representation combines compact free-form text with sparse images to preserve semantic content and complementary visual details across temporal scales, supporting temporal navigation without a fixed semantic schema. A Writer encodes each video once by consolidating overlapping multiscale observations, and a Reader retrieves and organizes evidence solely from the resulting memory. With the underlying models frozen, we evolve their workflows and operators using distinct feedback: query-independent source fidelity and coverage for the Writer, and QA failures in evidence localization and utilization for the Reader. Experiments support this separation for generalization beyond development queries, with our evolution strategy improving average accuracy by 7.2% over the unevolved harness. While reducing storage by about 99.86% on average relative to raw videos, Video-EMem improves Qwen3-VL-30B by an average of 2.6% across three long-video QA benchmarks over direct input of 2,048 frames. Using the same o3 answer model as the state-of-the-art agentic method, it improves average accuracy by 2.5% with lower per-query latency.

AI.tldr: Video-EMem 提出了一种可伸缩的视频记忆系统，通过结合紧凑的自由形式文本和稀疏图像来保留时间尺度上的语义内容和视觉细节，减少存储并提高多模态大语言模型在长视频问答任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型难以处理长视频，且每次查询的视频处理和语义关联成本高昂。视频-EMem 旨在降低这种成本并改善长视频问答的整体性能。
AI.method: Video-EMem 通过一种基于时间锚定的感知观察构建可复用的记忆系统，结合文本和图像来保留长视频的语义信息和视觉细节。该系统包含一次编码的 Writer 模型和一次检索的 Reader 模型，两者分别通过不同的反馈机制进行优化。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，视频-EMem 模型在三个长视频问答基准测试中相比直接输入 2048 帧视频提高了 2.6% 的平均准确性，同时减少了约 99.86% 的存储空间。与基于代理的方法相比，在相同的回答模型下，其准确率提高了 2.5%，而查询级别的延迟更低。
AI.conclusion: Video-EMem 提供了一种有效的方法来处理长视频的多模态大语言模型问题，通过智能的表示法和优化策略显著提高了性能表现和效率。

title: SPARC: Spoken Profile Authorship Recognition Corpus
summary: Speech anonymization has focused on the acoustic signal, leaving open how much speaker information the transcribed words themselves retain. In this work, we study pairwise speaker and demographic-attribute verification from transcribed speech. We introduce SPARC (Spoken Profile Authorship Recognition Corpus), a benchmark built from two podcast corpora comprising over 12,500 speakers, 1.5M quality-filtered utterances, and speaker-level inferred or source-provided labels for sex, age, and accent, and evaluate five attribution models and three LLMs on identity- and attribute-verification trials with episode- and metadata-based topic proxies. LLM adversaries distinguish same-speaker pairs from text alone. Attribute-label agreement is harder to verify, but LLMs perform sex- and accent-label verification above chance. Finally, releasing only short probe texts (50 words) degrades the strongest adversaries the most, offering a partial reduction in observed linkage.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了从转录语音中提取说话人和人口统计属性的方法，并提出了一种新的数据集SPARC，评估了五种归属模型和三种LLM在性别、年龄和口音标签验证上的表现。
AI.motivation: 鉴于传统的匿名化方法主要针对语音信号，本文旨在探讨转录语音中保留的说话人信息，以及从转录语音中验证说话人和人口统计属性的可行性。
AI.method: 本文构建了一个新的基准数据集SPARC，基于两个播客数据集，包含超过12,500个说话人，150万条高质量过滤的语音片段，对于性别、年龄和口音有说话人级的标签，或来源提供的标签。此外，还评估了五种归属模型和三个LLM，进行了身份和属性验证试验，使用了节目的和元数据主题作为代理。
AI.result: LLM能够仅通过文本来区分同一说话人的配对。性别和口音标签的验证更加困难，但LLM在这些标签的验证中仍然优于随机猜测。只释放短的探针文本（50个单词）可以带来一定程度的链接减少。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，从转录语音中识别说话人的信息是可能的，尽管性别和口音的标签验证仍具有挑战性。限制发布的探针文本长度可以在一定程度上减轻这种风险。

title: One Skill Takes Over: Clashing Agent Skills and a One-File Fix
summary: Agent Skills are instruction files that tell a coding agent how to do one job. Users install skills from many authors, so two skills for the same job can be active at the same time. We ask what a model does when both skill files are in its context: does it combine their compatible rules, or follow one skill and drop the other? We build SkillClash, 16 pairs of same-job skills in which code checks every rule and a reference output shows the best result that can be reached. On seven models from five families, from 4B open models to Qwen3-235B and GPT-4.1, a skill's rules are followed 93 to 99% of the time when it is loaded alone and 61 to 62% when a same-job skill is loaded next to it. Most outputs show takeover: every rule that only one skill asks for is followed, and every rule that only the other skill asks for is dropped. The worked examples inside the skills drive this. When each skill file instead ends with one example that follows both skills, takeover falls to 1 to 15% on the six models we tested. Telling the model which skill has priority does not bring the dropped skill back, and telling it to apply both skills brings the dropped skill back only on the two strong models and leaves the interacting rules broken. One merged skill file written by the strongest model we used, Claude Opus 5.5, lets all seven models follow 96 to 99% of the achievable rules. Most of its gain over a plain list of both skills' rules comes from its one worked example, and such an example helps only when it is correct. Code and data: https://github.com/prazmara/skillclash

AI.tldr: 研究分析了同一任务技能文件并存时，模型如何处理，结果表明大多数情况下模型会选择跟随一个技能并忽略另一个，仅在每个技能文件结束处增加一个遵循两者实例后此现象减少。
AI.motivation: 探讨在存在互相冲突的任务技能文件时，模型的执行策略，以优化模型在多技能环境下的表现。
AI.method: 构建了一个包括16对类似任务技能文件的SkillClash测试集，每个文件包含所有规则的检查和参考性能输出，测试了七种来自不同模型家族的大小模型。
AI.result: 大部分模型在加载单个技能时遵守约93%到99%的规则，而在加载同任务技能旁则仅为61%到62%。多数输出显示了技能的‘接管’现象，只有一个技能的规则被执行。而在每个技能文件末尾添加一个遵循两者实例后，这种现象减少至1%到15%。告诉模型哪个技能优先级更高没有影响，让模型同时应用两个技能只会使最强的两个模型表现好转，而规则相互作用的部分依然失效。
AI.conclusion: 研究指出，模型偏好执行指定任务的单一技能，即使存在冲突的同任务技能文件。为了优化模型的表现，需要为每个文件提供正确的例子，使得模型能够按照单一技能执行大多数规则。但对于规则交互的情况，当前的模型无法处理。

title: Cross-polarization pairing for label-free few-shot thin-section classification
summary: Few-shot classifiers of rock thin sections are meta-trained on many rock types that a petrographer has identified slide by slide, and this identification is the costly step that new collections lack.
