We study few-shot recognition of unseen rock types when no training slide is identified, and the only information available is what the microscope records anyway: which slide an image comes from, and whether it was taken in plane-polarized (PPL) or cross-polarized (XPL) light. We first show why generic unsupervised pseudo-tasks fit this setting poorly: the positives they find without labels are either wrong or near-duplicates of the anchor, so they teach the model little. Polarized-light microscopy provides positives that avoid both problems. The PPL and XPL views of one field show the same grains, so they are correct by construction, yet they look very different. We propose cross-polarization pairing (XPP), which treats each slide as a pseudo-class and pairs its PPL and XPL views of the same field location, so that matching must rely on grain shape and texture rather than on colour. On the Nanjing University collection of 108 rock types, with support and query images taken from different slides, XPP is the best label-free method on average over three random splits, and matches a supervised model trained on 78 identified rock types. Controls show that colour augmentation and other acquisition positives do not reproduce the gain. We also show that the image-level protocol of earlier work is saturated, and propose a cross-slide protocol in its place.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型的无标签岩石薄片分类方法，该方法利用偏光显微镜的PPL和XPL图像配对，并通过交叉滑块协议有效提高了分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的岩石薄片分类方法需要大量的标注，本文通过利用偏光显微镜的独特特性，提供了无需标签即可用于新颖岩石类型识别的方法，从而解决了新收集样本的一大难题。
AI.method: 本文的方法主要包括两个部分：1. 利用偏光显微镜的PPL和XPL图像配对（XPP），将同一滑片的PPL和XPL视图配对，依赖粒度形状和纹理进行匹配而非颜色；2. 推荐交叉滑块协议代替图像级协议。
AI.result: 在南京大学收集的108种岩石类型的测试上，XPP方法是平均而言最好的无标签方法，即使当支持和查询图像取自不同滑片时，也与在78种已识别岩石类型上训练的监督模型匹配。实验证明，颜色增强等其他数据采集的正增强并不能复制这种增益。
AI.conclusion: 该研究不仅提供了一种无标签的岩石薄片分类方法，还提出了一个交叉滑块协议，这对基于图像级别的协议有所超越，并证实了利用偏光特性对分类性能的提升潜力。

title: Atoms, Not Knowledge: What Production-Scale Addressed-Memory Writes Deposit
summary: Deterministic hash-addressed conditional memory permits local post-hoc knowledge injection. Extending arXiv:2610.21553's bounded-feasibility audit rejecting under-specified generality claims with repaired probes and training-dose/capacity axes, we give, to our knowledge, the first production-scale write-content verdict. We test 124M-7B self-trained/publicly pretrained beds, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8 (176.95B; 320,001,536 FP8 rows), and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Write coverage requires a sufficiently trained backbone prior, full-width readout, trainable gates; undertrained-bed intervention confirms a threshold, not a slope. At fixed budget, coverage falls from 98% (50 facts) to 12.7% (1,000); table size is not binding. Two-hop composition does not exceed the independent single-hop baseline (26% observed vs 25% expected; 15% lexical-distortion floor). Synergy remains absent across dose/load in two independent bed families. A 28-percentage-point in-context gap (given vs recalled intermediates) localizes failure to retrieval-for-reasoning, not gate access. Writes are independently retrievable, precisely addressable, reversible atoms, not composable into reasoning. A layered protocol, the first, to our knowledge, to cover compositionality in behavioral memory evaluation, separates baseline, synergy and distortion floor. Any addressed/key-value memory must report coverage, synergy ratio and distortion rate before deployment claims. Composition must be system-orchestrated; multi-constraint queries should explicitly chain written atoms. In-context controls show given intermediate entities are exploited at twice the implicit rate. Production load fits exponential interference ($R^2=0.98$); its mechanism, between budget dilution and write interference, remains open. All numbers are recomputed from archived raw logs/JSON; a fresh 52-target production rerun gives 52/52, exactly matching archived baselines.

AI.tldr: 该研究展示了第一个生产规模的写内容裁决，通过自训练/公共预训练的模型、Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash测试，发现了覆盖范围、协同效应和数据干扰之间的关系，需利用分层协议来评估行为性记忆的组成性，并强调了在部署前报告覆盖范围、协同效应比值和数据干扰率的重要性。
AI.motivation: 为了验证基于内容的写操作在自训练和公共预训练模型中的表现，并提供了一种新的方法来评估这些模型的行为。
AI.method: 该研究利用了大量已训练的模型进行实验，包括自训练的模型和公开预训练的模型，通过控制变量（如训练剂量和模型尺寸）来研究它们对写内容的影响。此外，研究还采用了一种新的分层协议来评估模型的行为。
AI.result: 研究发现，模型在训练不充分的情况下会出现一定的覆盖范围下降，但表格大小不是限制因素。两跳组成未超过单跳基线，且未发现剂量/负载间的协同效应。在上下文控制中，给定的中间实体被利用的频率是隐含频率的两倍。研究还展示了生产负载按指数干扰模型（$R^2=0.98$）波动。
AI.conclusion: 该研究强调在模型部署前必须报告覆盖范围、协同效应比值和数据干扰率。并且在系统中需组织组成操作，并明确链式写入的原子。

title: DAGLoop: Aligning Method Design with Experimental Feedback in Automated AI Research
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to ICLR 2027. Code: https://github.com/deng34567/DAGLoop
summary: Automated AI research agents aim to improve machine learning methods by iteratively proposing, implementing, and evaluating candidate methods. Existing work uses the outcome of each evaluation to determine how the next candidate should be revised for performance improvement. However, a candidate often combines multiple design decisions, and its overall outcome alone does not reveal which decisions produced their expected effects, whether their required conditions were satisfied, or which decisions should be retained or revised. Inspired by ablation studies in the machine learning community, we propose DAGLoop to test the expected effect of a design decision by comparing implementations with and without that decision while preserving the other decisions it requires. Specifically, DAGLoop translates each design decision's rationale into a testable expectation and pairs it with a targeted experiment, forming an experimental specification for assessing the expected effect under its required conditions. Using these specifications, we formulate ablation planning as the construction of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) from the candidate method's design: nodes associate decisions with tests, and edges encode dependencies. The DAG specifies which decisions each experiment must retain and supports joint tests when an expected effect requires several decisions to act together. Outcomes are recorded with the tested decisions, expectations, and conditions to form structured research memory. This memory guides the agent in retaining experimentally supported decisions, revising unsupported ones, and planning further experiments when the evidence is unresolved. Experiments on dozens of research tasks demonstrate substantial performance improvements achieved by DAGLoop across diverse executable research settings. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/deng34567/DAGLoop.

AI.tldr: DAGLoop 自动化 AI 研究代理通过构建包含多个设计决策及其依赖关系的有向无环图(DAG)，并结合实验规范来评估每个决策的效果，旨在提高机器学习方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化研究代理仅通过整体性能评估来调整候选方法，但未能识别出具体哪个决策产生了预期效果或者哪些决策需要保留或调整。DAGLoop 通过引入类似机器学习领域中的消融研究方法来解决这一问题。
AI.method: DAGLoop 的方法包括将每个设计决策转化为可测试的期望，并与针对该决策的实验配对，形成评估所需条件下的效果的实验规范。通过形成从候选方法设计中构建的有向无环图(DAG)，指定每个实验必须保留的决策，以及当预期效果需要多个决策共同作用时的支持联合测试。
AI.result: 实验表明，DAGLoop 能够在多种执行研究环境中实现显著的性能改进。
AI.conclusion: DAGLoop 提供了一种新的方法来评估机器学习方法中的设计决策，有助于提高研究代理的效率和效果。

title: Scene-Adaptive VLA: Efficient Autonomous Driving via Dynamic Layer Routing
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for autonomous driving. However, the massive parameter scale of VLAs strains onboard computational resources during real-time inference. This directly increases energy consumption and limits vehicle battery range, making it critical to minimize computational overhead without compromising driving capability and explainability. Current research on efficient VLA-based driving focuses on sequential adaptation (\textit{e.g.}, Chain-of-Thought and token adjustment), leaving structural adaptation underexplored despite parameter redundancy across dynamic driving scenes. To address this gap, we propose Scene-Adaptive VLA, an efficient framework leveraging dynamic layer routing to adjust active parameters based on real-time scenes. Inspired by the temporal continuity of scenes and model predictive uncertainty, our approach characterizes model-perceived scene complexity via frame-level temporal scene variations and decision deviations. To uncover latent scene-to-parameter correspondences, we encode this characterization into scene-aware tokens, alongside two specialized queries. A budget-conditioned layer routing mechanism evaluates these refined queries to allocate a budget that determines the active parameter ratio and subsequently selects appropriate layer combinations. The entire framework is optimized end-to-end. Extensive evaluations on the Bench2Drive benchmark show that when adapted to a state-of-the-art VLA model, our approach significantly reduces inference-time computational overhead by 53.5\% with negligible degradation in driving and language capabilities. Code is available at https:github.com/yang-luvu/Scene-Adaptive-VLA.

AI.tldr: Scene-Adaptive VLA通过动态层路由调整实时场景中的活跃参数，减少推理过程中的计算开销，同时保持驾驶和语言能力。
AI.motivation: 针对Vision-Language-Action (VLA)模型在自动驾驶中面临的计算资源限制问题，提出一种基于场景适配的框架，通过合理分配活性参数来降低能耗，延长车辆电池使用寿命。
AI.method: 基于场景感知的动态层路由机制，结合场景连续性和模型预测不确定性，开发了场景感知的token，并通过预算条件下的层路由机制，实现对参数的精确控制。
AI.result: 实验表明，与现有VLA模型相比，场景适配的VLA模型在保持驾驶和语言功能的同时，推理时间的计算开销降低了53.5%。
AI.conclusion: 场景适配的VLA模型提供了一种有效的解决方案，能够在保证驾驶性能和解释性的同时，显著降低计算负担。

title: Where and Why Search-Augmented LLMs Fail When Reasoning over Rapidly Evolving Knowledge
summary: As the world changes, new information is published while older records remain online. This complicates reasoning for large language models (LLMs), which must retrieve evidence and resolve conflicts to determine which information remains valid. Existing evaluations treat information seeking as a black box, revealing little about where and why LLMs fail. To address this gap, we introduce TREK, a suite of three components: TREKTRACE is a plug-and-play framework that attributes failures to specific stages of retrieval and reasoning. We apply it to TREKBENCH-WILD, a meta-benchmark of real-world questions that require complex reasoning over rapidly evolving knowledge. Surprisingly, the main bottleneck is post-retrieval reasoning rather than retrieval: frontier models are often misled by conflicting evidence even after retrieving all the information needed to answer. To study this bottleneck, we build TREKBENCH-CTRL, a controlled benchmark with distractors spanning temporality, relevance, and trustworthiness, and show that benchmarks dominated by outdated distractors substantially underestimate task difficulty. Together, TREK provides a testbed for diagnosing and improving reasoning over rapidly evolving knowledge.

AI.tldr: TREK 是一个用于诊断语言模型在处理快速变化知识时推理失败原因的套件，包括一个可插入框架 TREKTRACE 以及两个基准 TREKBENCH-WILD 和 TREKBENCH-CTRL，揭示了后检索推理是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有的评估方法缺乏对语言模型失败原因的深入分析，因此需要一个能够诊断和改善语言模型在处理快速变化知识时推理方法的工具。
AI.method: 该论文提出了 TREK 套件，其中包括一个可插入框架 TIFF 和两个基准测试集 TREKBENCH-WILD 和 TREKBENCH-CTRL。TREKTRACE 用于将错误归因于特定的检索和推理阶段，而 TREKBENCH-CTRL 则包含干扰问题，这些问题跨越时间、相关性和可信度，以展示老化的干扰物低估任务难度的情况。
AI.result: 结果表明，后检索推理是主要瓶颈，即使在检索到所有必要信息后，模型也可能受到矛盾证据的误导。TREKBENCH-CTRL 显示老化干扰物会严重低估任务难度。
AI.conclusion: TREK 提供了一个测试平台，用于诊断和改进对快速变化知识的推理，并揭示了现有的基准测试集在评估语言模型性能方面存在的问题。

title: Toward Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enterprise Retail Workflows over Heterogeneous Data Sources
summary: Enterprise retail workflows require agents to chain evidence across heterogeneous sources, from structured product and order records to unstructured inquiries and reviews, yet existing agentic RAG benchmarks rarely capture this challenge. To enable controlled evaluation of such workflows, we introduce RetailBridge, a compositional retail benchmark built from persona-driven simulations. Its questions are constructed by linking entities and intermediate answers across heterogeneous sources, requiring agents to identify the relevant sources, carry evidence between them, and produce a grounded answer. To systematically evaluate LLMs on these retail workflows, we develop RetailRAG, a retail-aware framework equipped with auto-schema briefing, source-routed plan chaining, and diagnostic plan revision. RetailRAG consistently outperforms existing agentic RAG baselines across all evaluation axes, serving as a strong reference system for assessing LLM agents on retail workflows. On RetailBridge, evaluating ten LLM backbones with RetailRAG reveals multi-source chaining as the dominant bottleneck across providers and model scales, suggesting that reliable retail agents require explicit cross-source orchestration rather than scaling alone. Code and data are publicly available at \url{https://github.com/DISL-Lab/RetailBridge}.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了RetailBridge，一个基于情景驱动的零售基准，旨在评估企业零售工作流中的代理能力。RetailRAG是一个零售感知框架，可评估语言模型在多源证据链路上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的代理检索与生成（RAG）基准很少涵盖企业零售工作流中从结构化到非结构化数据的证据链挑战。RetailBridge利用情景驱动的模拟构建来确保评估的可控性。
AI.method: RetailBridge通过将实体和中间答案链接到不同的数据源来构建问题，使代理能够识别相关数据源、跨越数据源搬运证据，并生成一个基于事实的答案。RetailRAG则通过自动模式填充、基于路径的数据源引导计划链和诊断计划修订，来系统地评估语言模型。
AI.result: RetailRAG在所有评估维度上都优于现有的代理RAG基线。实验表明，多源证据链路是大多数供应商和模型规格中面临的主要瓶颈，强调了多源协同调控的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出结论，为了在零售工作中有效使用语言模型，需要明确的跨源协调机制，而不是仅依赖模型规模的扩大。RetailBridge和RetailRAG为评估零售工作流中的语言模型提供了重要工具。

title: Dynamic self-ensemble on multi-exit residual vision transformer for small-data image classification
summary: Vision Transformer (ViT) has garnered increased attention for image classification in recent years. However, ViT is notorious for its data-hungry problem as it achieves high-performance results when only trained on large-size datasets. In this paper, we study how ViT specifically works on small-scale datasets with limited data where the availability of image data is often constrained in practice, especially in fields such as medical imaging. To mitigate the issue, we designed a multi-stage residual ViT, dubbed ReSEViT, with the self-ensemble method to utilize multi-level information from intermediate features. Due to the complex decision boundaries for classifications, relying on a single classifier can lead to prediction errors. Hence, we propose a new learning method for ViT, named self-ensemble learning, which ensembles multi-stage classifiers in a single model. Our self-ensemble comprises a novel approach, Dynamic Learner Selection (DLS), to adaptively select the importance of different stages. ReSEViT incorporates residual token embeddings which is a ResNet-like block to model effective local structures alongside with transformer blocks in each stage. The integration of residual tokens and self-ensemble learning into a multi-stage ViT highlights the reduction in redundancy, prediction error and variance while maintaining an efficient model size for small-scale image datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Vision Transformer（ViT）在小规模数据集上表现不佳的问题，并提出了ReSEViT，包含多阶段残差ViT和自我集合学习来降低冗余、预测误差和方差，同时保持高效的模型大小。
AI.motivation: 当前ViT主要针对大规模数据集，但实际场景中，如医学影像，可用的图像数据有限。本文通过自我集合学习和多阶段残差ViT解决这一问题，以便VIT能够处理小规模数据。
AI.method: 该方法提出了一种新的ViT变体——ReSEViT，引入了多阶段自我集合学习（self-ensemble learning）和动态学习者选择（DLS）来加强不同阶段的重要性，同时加入了残差token以更好地捕捉局部结构。
AI.result: 实验表明ReSEViT在小数据集上较ViT有了显著改进，展示了一种有效的解决方案来缓解ViT对大规模数据集的依赖问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入多阶段残差ViT和自我集合学习，ReSEViT能够有效地减轻ViT在小数据集上的训练难度，保持了良好的预测 accuracy 同时缩小了模型大小。

title: Aligning Cultural Behaviors in Arabic Language Models via Preferences
summary: Arabic LLMs have improved rapidly, but aligning them with country-specific cultural behavioral preferences remains underexplored. Previous work has focused primarily on instruction-tuning for factual knowledge, overlooking nuanced cultural behaviors. We propose ArabPref, which to our knowledge is the first large-scale pan-Arab preference data set for the alignment of cultural behavior conditioned on the country. Our contribution includes two resources in English and Modern Standard Arabic: a culturally grounded preference dataset for training and evaluation, and a multiple-choice benchmark designed to assess culturally aligned behavior across nations. All test data are validated by native speakers to ensure authenticity. To optimize cultural alignment, we experiment with post-training methods across multilingual and Arabic-centric language models, evaluating performance on both generation tasks and our cultural multiple-choice benchmark. By releasing an evaluation benchmark, we provide a foundation for systematically studying and improving culturally aligned behavior in language models.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为ArabPref的大规模阿拉伯偏好数据集，旨在针对不同国家的文化行为进行语言模型的对齐调整。该数据集包含了文化背景下的偏好数据和多选题基准测试，以评估跨国家的文化对齐行为。通过在多语言和阿拉伯中心的语言模型上进行后训练方法实验，旨在优化文化对齐。
AI.motivation: 当前，阿拉伯预训练语言模型虽然取得了显著进步，但在与国家特定文化行为偏好对齐方面仍有不足。鉴于此，研究者提出了ArabPref数据集和多选题基准测试，以弥补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 研究者设计了ArabPref数据集，集成了英语和现代标准阿拉伯语两种版本。同时构建了一个多选题基准测试，用于评估跨国家的文化对齐行为。通过在多种语言模型上进行后训练方法的实验，来优化文化对齐效果。
AI.result: 研究中使用ArabPref数据集和多选题基准测试评估了语言模型的文化对齐效果，并展示了在不同语言模型上使用后训练方法进行文化对齐改进的效果。
AI.conclusion: ArabPref数据集和多选题基准测试将为系统地研究和改进语言模型的文化对齐行为提供基础，并提出了一种后训练方法来优化文化对齐。

title: Explore or Confirm? LLM Agents Misallocate Measurements Under Noise
comment: 38 pages, 12 figures. Code, data and environment: https://github.com/Xstendyl/wellocate
summary: As model reasoning gets cheaper, the physical experiment becomes the slow and costly step in discovery. Each experiment returns a noisy reading: a high value can mean a good candidate or a lucky draw. With a fixed budget, an AI agent must keep choosing between exploring a new candidate and confirming a promising one by re-testing it. We measure that choice in Wellocate, a simulated assay campaign with known true values. It is built on a generated landscape and on two real protein datasets, GB1 and PhoQ, scrambled so no model can answer from memory. We test five language models as minimal agents, with no tools and no memory beyond the history in each prompt. They misallocate in both directions. Three over-confirm, spending most of the budget re-testing. On the generated landscape one under-confirms, trusting single readings, and there every model ends with a worse final pick than a basic scripted strategy. Each failure has its own cause. The over-confirmers run short of new candidates worth trying: a list of untried candidates cuts their re-testing and, on real protein data, makes two of them pick much better. A running summary of their readings or a description of the landscape changes it by at most five percentage points. For the under-confirmer, re-testing its top candidates in a final round, replayed on its own campaigns, recovers only about a quarter of what it loses by picking the wrong candidate. This suggests confirmation has to run through the whole campaign. We release Wellocate as a benchmark and reinforcement-learning environment with frozen splits and scripted baselines. With it, anyone can measure how an agent splits its budget before trusting it with real experiments, and train agents to split it better. Code, data and the environment are available at https://github.com/Xstendyl/wellocate.

AI.tldr: 此研究表明，在模拟实验和真实蛋白质数据集上，五种语言模型作为最小代理，无法有效地平衡探索与验证的选择，在验证上过度或不足，导致最终选择不如基础策略。Wellocate作为基准和强化学习环境被释放，以帮助测量和改进代理的预算分配。
AI.motivation: 随着模型推理的成本降低，物理实验成为发现过程中的昂贵步骤。为了探索有限预算下如何作出探索与验证的有效选择，作者设计了Wellocate环境。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个包含已知真实值的模拟实验框架Wellocate，并在其中测试了五种语言模型。框架基于生成的景观和真实蛋白质数据集（GB1和PhoQ）构建，使模型无法依赖记忆。模型按指令进行最小代理测试，没有额外工具或记忆。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，这些模型在验证策略上出现偏移，导致最终选择不如基础策略。具体表现为一些模型过度验证，另一些则不够验证。对于生成的景观数据，一个模型过度依赖单一读数，而真实蛋白质数据中，过度验证的模型和平衡的好模型能显著提高选择质量。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，确认策略需要贯穿整个实验过程。作者建议通过Wellocate基准和环境进一步测试和改进代理的预算分配策略。

title: SCOPE-VSR: A Broad-Coverage Training Dataset for Video Super-Resolution
summary: Open-domain video super-resolution (VSR) requires temporally coherent details across widely varying scenes and subjects. However, existing training datasets are often semantically imbalanced and insufficiently diverse. We address this data bottleneck with a structured curation pipeline for open-domain VSR, SCOPE. In this pipeline, we combine task-oriented video selection with hierarchical semantic rebalancing. Applying this pipeline to a large-scale collection of data sources, we construct the SCOPE-VSR dataset for training and SCOPE-test for testing. SCOPE-VSR has approximately 27k videos and provides balanced and diverse coverage of various real-world scenarios and subjects. We further develop GraCo-VSR, a novel framework for one-step video restoration. GraCo-VSR adopts a reliability-aware design with explicit supervision to reduce degradation-induced distortions in motion and texture guidance, allowing the model to benefit more effectively from the diverse training content in SCOPE-VSR. Evaluations show that our model achieves strong reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality. Our code is available at: https://github.com/gyliao2768/SCOPE-VSR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SCOPE数据集和GraCo-VSR框架，以解决开放域视频超分辨中的数据瓶颈问题，实现了更优的重建保真度和感知质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的开放域视频超分辨率数据集存在语义不平衡和多样性不足的问题，影响模型的性能。
AI.method: 本文通过提出SCOPE数据集收集方法和GraCo-VSR框架来解决数据瓶颈问题。SCOPE数据集通过任务导向的视频选择和层次语义重新平衡构建，GraCo-VSR框架采用一个可靠性的设计，以减少运动和纹理指导中的退化引起的失真。
AI.result: GraCo-VSR框架在开放域视频超分辨率中表现出较强的重建保真度和感知质量。
AI.conclusion: 本文为开放域视频超分辨率问题提供了新的数据集和框架，实验结果表明其有效性和优越性。

title: From Unverifiable Domain Text to Cross-Lingual RLVR via Code-Switched Task Synthesis
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) can improve reasoning in large language models, but specialized non-English domains expose a data mismatch. Raw English domain text is often available, while target-language RLVR tasks with verifiable rewards are scarce. We introduce code-switched task synthesis for cross-lingual RLVR, a data-centric approach that derives target-language and code-switched RLVR task variants from otherwise unverifiable English domain text. Using fill-in-the-middle multiple-choice QA as a seed task format, we synthesize automatically verifiable tasks from domain passages and reshape them into cross-lingual variants. These variants preserve the same evidence-answer relation but change how English and target-language evidence are presented during RLVR. On Korean medical benchmarks and cybersecurity benchmarks across four target languages, code-switched training outperforms matched monolingual and bilingual-mixture baselines on average target-language performance while maintaining comparable English performance. Additional analyses provide evidence of better target-language input understanding and stronger cross-lingual alignment in both model outputs and internal representations. These results suggest that code-switched training helps target-language inputs access domain reasoning learned more strongly in English.

AI.tldr: 通过将填空式多项选择问答任务从英文领域文本转变为跨语言的可验证任务，研究者提出了代码切换任务合成方法来解决语言模型的多语言学习问题。该方法在多个跨语言基准测试中表现优于单语和双语混合基准。
AI.motivation: 当前的RLVR方法在非英语专业领域上表现出数据不匹配的问题，研究者希望通过引入代码切换任务合成来克服这个问题。
AI.method: 研究者采用代码切换任务合成方法，利用给定的未验证的英文领域文本，自动合成可验证的目标语言和代码切换RLVR任务。这些任务在形式上保持一致，但在呈现证据和目标语言的表达上有所不同。
AI.result: 在韩语医学和网络安全基准测试中，代码切换的训练在目标语言上的表现优于单语和双语混合基准，同时保持了英语的相似表现。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，代码切换训练有助于更好地理解目标语言输入并加强跨语言对齐，这可能是因为在英语中更牢固地学习了领域推理知识。

title: Spectral Adaptive Graph Transformer for Efficient and Scalable Traffic Forecasting
summary: Traffic forecasting models based on spectral graph convolution offer an interpretable account of how information is mixed between sensors, but they rely on an eigendecomposition of the graph Laplacian. It costs cubic time, is fixed by the road network, and provides a symmetric operator that cannot represent the directed propagation of traffic congestion. Attention-based spatio-temporal transformers remove these limitations but generate a dense sensor-by-sensor attention map at each layer and time step, so memory, rather than accuracy, becomes the binding constraint on large networks. We introduce the spectral adaptive graph transformer, whose spatial operator is learned rather than derived from the Laplacian, directed rather than symmetric, and conditioned on the current traffic state rather than a static state, at a cost linear in the number of sensors. A sparse road graph diffusion branch provides the strictly local propagation that a low-rank operator cannot express, and a zero-initialized gate learns the balance between the two. Before spatial mixing, a unit-mean-gain frequency-bin attention module reweights each sensor's short-term periodicities according to its identity and current context. Across six public benchmarks spanning 170 to 1843 sensors, evaluated over three random seeds, the proposed model attains the lowest error of any single end-to-end model on one benchmark and remains competitive with the strongest current attention models on the others, while using about a quarter of their memory and training about twice as fast.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于光谱自适应图变换的交通流预测模型，该模型能够兼顾解析性和高效性。通过学习非对称的空间操作符和考虑实时交通状态，该模型在多个基准测试中表现出色，同时具有较低的内存使用和较快的训练速度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于光谱图卷积的模型虽然具有高解析性，但存在计算复杂度高、对静态道路网络固定的和无法捕捉交通流的有向传播等问题。而注意力基时空变换模型虽然解决了这些问题，但因每次层和时间步生成密集的传感器间注意力映射，导致内存消耗成为性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的光谱适应性图变换方法。该方法通过学习非对称的空间操作符和条件依赖于当前交通状态的操作符，从而减少计算复杂度。同时引入了稀疏道路图扩散分支和单位均值增益频率-bin注意力模块，该模块根据时间和上下文信息对每种传感器进行短周期性的加权。
AI.result: 在六个公开基准测试中，覆盖了170至1843个传感器，通过三个随机种子实现评估，所提出模型在其中一个基准模型中达到最低的误差，与其他最强的当前注意力模型在其他基准模型竞争中保持竞争力，同时内存使用大约减少了四分之三，训练速度提高了两倍。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了一个新的基于光谱自适应图变换的方法来解决交通流预测问题，该方法能够有效平衡解释性和高效性之间的关系，且在多个公开数据集上达到了显著的效果。

title: IntriAdapt: Generalizable Intrinsic-Guided Test-Time Adaptation for Metric Geometry Estimation
summary: Recovering metric 3D geometry from images is fundamentally ill-posed due to perspective projection ambiguity. Current geometry models incorporate supplied or predicted intrinsics during inference, but do not use them to supervise model adaptation. To refine these predictions, test-time adaptation (TTA) typically relies on external depth measurements. In this paper, we instead use camera intrinsics as an output-side geometric verifier. Comparing the point cloud's viewing rays with those defined by the known intrinsics yields a direct measure of geometric inconsistency. We propose \textit{IntriAdapt}, a TTA framework that minimizes this closed-form geometric residual. By optimizing a lightweight LoRA adapter on a frozen geometry foundation model, our method aligns the prediction with the specific camera model without depth sensors or external priors. We further extend this approach to video sequences, demonstrating that adapting a short sequence generalizes to other sequences captured by the same camera. The adapted model processes held-out images in a feed-forward pass, without repeating optimization for each frame. Experiments on ten single-image and seven sequence benchmarks across multiple base models show that \textit{IntriAdapt} consistently outperforms both unadapted and oracle-intrinsics baselines in metric accuracy and relative geometry.

AI.tldr: IntriAdapt 是一种通过优化轻量级 LoRA 适配器直接利用已知相机内参进行模型适应的方法，适用于图像和视频序列的3D几何恢复，并显著提高准确性。
AI.motivation: 方法的动机在于解决从图像中恢复3D几何的难题，特别是当深度传感器不可用或不切实际时，提供一种新的测试时间适应策略。
AI.method: IntriAdapt 使用已知的相机内参作为几何验证器，通过对比由当前点云视图射线与由内参定义的射线之间的几何不一致性来最小化这种直接的几何残差。优化适用于冻结的几何基础模型的轻量级 LoRA 适配器。
AI.result: IntriAdapt 在多个单图像和序列基准测试中表现出色，相比未适应模型和具有理想内参的基线模型，在度量准确性和相对几何结构上获得了显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一个有效的测试时间适应框架 IntriAdapt，该框架直接利用相机内参作为几何验证器，并且表明可用于单帧和视频序列的3D几何恢复，无需深度传感器或外部先验知识。

title: Towards Figurative Language Understanding in Moroccan Darija: An Evaluation of Large Language Models
summary: Figurative language remains a major challenge for Machine Translation (MT) systems, as the intended meaning of such expressions often goes beyond literal translation. Although recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) improved the translation of Arabic dialects, benchmark resources for evaluating figurative language translation in Moroccan Darija remain scarce. To this end, we introduce the Moroccan Darija Figurative Language Corpus (MDFC), a benchmark dataset for MT and multiple-choice question (MCQ) selection covering idioms, metaphors, and proverbs. Using MDFC, we evaluate 19 open- and closed-weight language models and MT systems at both the expression and contextual levels under zero-shot and six-shot settings. We also conduct layer-wise similarity-based probing to determine how model representations distinguish figurative from literal meanings. Our findings reveal that closed-weight models achieve the strongest translation performance, while the benefits of contextual information vary across models and tasks. Differences between translation performance and MCQ accuracy highlight the distinction between generating an appropriate figurative translation and recognizing the intended meaning among candidate translations.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的摩洛哥德里贾隐喻语言语料库（MDFC），用于评估机器翻译和多项选择题（MCQ）选择系统的隐喻翻译性能。研究发现，闭权重模型在翻译性能上表现最佳，但上下文信息对不同模型的影响不同。翻译性能与MCQ准确率之间的差异反映了生成合适隐喻翻译与识别候选翻译中的预期意思之间的区别。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏评价阿拉伯方言隐喻翻译的标准资源，机器翻译系统在隐喻表达上的表现仍存在挑战。
AI.method: 研究开发了一个包含惯用语、比喻和谚语的摩洛哥德里贾隐喻语言语料库，并评估了19种开放和闭合权重语言模型和翻译系统的性能。同时，通过逐层相似性探究模型如何区分比喻和字面意义。
AI.result: 闭权重模型在翻译任务上的表现最佳，但不同模型对上下文信息的利用程度不同。翻译表现与MCQ准确性之间的差异表明，生成合适的隐喻翻译与在候选翻译中识别预期的意思是不同的。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了隐喻语言翻译的复杂性及不同模型的性能特点，为进一步改进机器翻译系统的隐喻处理能力提供了指导。

title: Memory, Know Your PLACE: Governing Lifecycle State and Query-Time Eligibility in Persistent-Memory Agents
summary: Persistent memory turns prior interactions into durable agent state, but existing systems provide limited control over whether that state remains valid and whether it should influence a later query. We argue that reliable memory requires governance over both state formation and query-time influence. We introduce PLACE, a factorized governance layer that adds write-side state certification and read-side authorization to a memory backend. A factorial evaluation on Mem0 with Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B isolates the contribution of each mechanism. Results show that write-side governance substantially improves lifecycle state correctness, while read-side governance eliminates measured causal leakage from ineligible memory in the state-correct setting. Their combination achieves the strongest joint performance while preserving query-relevant support. These findings show that reliable persistent memory requires explicit control over both maintained state and query-time information influence.

AI.tldr: 该研究引入了PLACE，一种因子化的治理层，为持久性内存添加了写侧状态认证和读侧授权。研究通过因子化评估发现，写侧治理显著改善了生命周期状态的正确性，而读侧治理则在状态正确的情况下消除了不可用内存对查询结果的因果泄漏。两者的结合实现了最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 现有系统对持久记忆状态的持久性与后续查询的影响控制不足，这影响了持久记忆的可靠性。研究指出，可靠持久记忆需要对状态形成和查询时影响的治理。
AI.method: 研究引入了名为PLACE的因素化治理层，结合Mem0与Qwen2.5-3B及Qwen2.5-7B进行因子化评估，分别测试了写侧治理与读侧治理的效果。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，写侧治理显著提高了状态的生命周期正确性，同时在状态正确的情况下，读侧治理成功消除了不可用内存对查询结果的因果泄漏。两者的结合在保持查询相关信息支持的情况下实现了最强的联合性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究认为，可靠的持久化内存需要明确控制持久状态与其在查询中的信息影响。PLACE提供了有效的方法来实现这一点。

title: Beyond Geometric Closure: Measuring and Diagnosing Mechanical Consistency in Visual Dynamics
comment: 34 pages, including supplementary material; 16 figures and 38 tables
summary: Visual accuracy leaves open whether predicted motion obeys dynamics. We introduce a framework for measuring and diagnosing mechanical consistency in visual dynamics. An independent SI audit of rigid closed chains separates geometric admissibility, reaction-free actuator effort, and work--energy balance. Continuous scoring measures progress against fixed engineering targets, while reference replay quantifies measurement error. With three seeds per setting, we evaluate KeyCLD and CON across 343 planar assemblies at 64/256 pixels and V-JEPA + AC and LingBot-VA on 100 shared spatial test assemblies. CON reduces image MSE by 37.6%/37.2% relative to persistence, yet neither planar model attains valid native geometry. At 256 pixels, calibrated RGB replay places forecast errors far above measurement error. With exact states, KeyCLD preserves geometry and RK4 training raises its score from 52.65 to 64.30. In both spatial pathways, CAD/IK reconstruction restores geometry while mean actuator residuals exceed five times the engineering targets. The interventions distinguish gains in visual prediction and geometric admissibility from remaining force and energy errors.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种框架来衡量和诊断视觉动态中的机械一致性，通过独立的SI审计、连续评分和参考重放来评估不同模型的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉预测模型可能在遵循物理动力学方面存在问题，因此需要一种机制来精确地评估模型的机械一致性和提供改进的指导。
AI.method: 论文通过引入特定的评估框架，使用独立的SI审计来分离几何可行性和工作-能量平衡，使用连续评分来衡量对固定工程目标的进展，并通过参考重放量化测量误差。不同模型在不同的装配体上进行评估。
AI.result: 尽管CON模型在图像MSE上分别相对于坚持提高了37.6%和37.2%，但它和另一平面模型均未能达到有效的原始几何形状。在256像素时，RGB回放的校准使得预测误差远高于测量误差。在直接给定真实状态的情况下，KeyCLD能够保持几何形状且使用RK4训练提高了其得分。在两种空间路径中，CAD/IK重建恢复了几何形状，但平均执行器残差超过工程目标的五倍。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了现有视觉预测模型在几何可行性方面仍存在的问题，并强调了机械一致性的改进对于实际应用的重要性。

title: Mixture-of-Memories: Low-Overhead Language Modeling with Modular Knowledge Injection
summary: Large language models store substantial factual knowledge in their parameters, yet this knowledge is difficult to control, update, and reliably elicit at inference time. Existing memory-augmented approaches typically rely on a single auxiliary mechanism, such as retrieval, parameter updates, or neural memory, and therefore apply the same form of correction to tokens with very different knowledge demands. We propose Mixture-of-Memories (MoM), a memory-augmented language modeling framework that separates routed neural memory from writable factual memory. MoM combines a frozen base LM with two neural memory experts: a latent memory that provides low-latency hidden-state corrections and a lexical memory that provides a token-space knowledge pathway. A lightweight Budget Router sets per-token mixture weights from uncertainty and disagreement features, replacing the fixed interpolation of prior memory modules. For post-hoc updates, an external explicit memory stays outside the router, because a router trained before facts are written learns to down-weight it; new facts are appended without retraining any component and used only when an answer-level gate accepts the retrieved fact. Experiments across language modeling, factual QA, update analysis, and efficiency show that MoM improves both predictive accuracy and updateability while retaining low inference overhead.

AI.tldr: MoM 提出了一种新的记忆增强语言模型框架，通过分离路由神经记忆和可写事实记忆，以及引入轻量级的预算路由器动态调整权重，以提高预测准确性和更新能力，同时保持低推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有的记忆增强方法通常依赖单一辅助机制，难以根据不同知识需求进行灵活校正。MoM 提出了多记忆机制 (Mixture-of-Memories) 的概念，旨在更有效地处理语言模型中的知识存储和更新问题。
AI.method: MoM 框架将固定的基本语言模型与两个神经记忆专家相结合：一个潜忆记忆提供低延迟的隐藏态修正，另一个词汇记忆提供词空间知识通道。引入轻量级的预算路由器根据不确定性与分歧特征设定每词混合权重。对于事后更新，外部明确记忆保持在外路由器之外，通过答案级门控机制引入新的事实。
AI.result: 实验表明，MoM 框架在语言建模、事实问答、更新分析和效率方面都取得了显著的改进，提高了预测准确性和更新能力，同时保持了低的推理开销。
AI.conclusion: MoM 提出了一种创新且有效的记忆增强语言模型方法，通过明确区分不同类型的记忆机制，并通过灵活的路由器机制管理混合权重，证明了其在多方面性能的提升潜力。

title: Dialogue Generation for Conversational Recommendation Using User Search Interactions and Knowledge Graphs
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, The 3rd Workshop on Evaluating and Applying Recommender Systems with Large Language Models (EARL) at The 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Large-scale conversational recommendation datasets typically require manual dialogue construction or annotation. We propose SearCl, which automatically generates conversational recommendation dialogues grounded in user search and click behaviors. SearCl segments user interactions into query sessions and derives each recommendation target from content selected after a search query. A configurable probabilistic state machine controls the dialogue flow, while two LLM agents acting as the seeker and recommender generate utterances according to turn-level constraints. To support recommendation, the recommender is provided with knowledge graphs constructed from metadata about the content items used in each dialogue, capturing their attributes and relationships. Using SearCl, we generate 3,538 dialogues from content search and click interaction data, covering 1,731 unique target items. Under an LLM-as-a-judge protocol, the resulting dialogues achieve higher quality scores than dialogues from existing benchmarks. These results demonstrate that SearCl enables controllable and knowledge-grounded dataset construction without human annotations.

AI.tldr: SearCl自动化生成基于用户搜索和点击行为的会话推荐对话，无需人工标注。生成了3,538个对话，涵盖1,731个目标项目，质量评分超过现有基准。
AI.motivation: 简化大规模对话推荐数据集的构建过程，减少人工标注的费用和时间。
AI.method: 利用用户搜索和点击行为，将这些行为分段为查询会话，并从搜索后的选定内容中推导出每个推荐目标。配置可变概率状态机控制对话流程，两个LLM代理分别作为寻求者和推荐者生成满足回合级约束的回应。
AI.result: SearCl生成了3,538个对话，包括1,731个不同的目标物品。使用LLM作为评判标准的对话质量，优于现有基准。
AI.conclusion: SearCl展示了无需人工注释即可实现可控且知识依据的对话数据集生成。

title: Spectral-Aware Proposal Enhancement for Diffusion-Based Multispectral UAV Multi-Object Tracking
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters. 5 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Author accepted version
summary: Multispectral UAV multi-object tracking (MOT) with oriented bounding boxes remains challenging due to small targets, cluttered backgrounds, and unstable inter-frame associations. Although diffusion-based MOT provides an effective iterative proposal refinement paradigm, existing diffusion-based trackers lack dedicated designs for exploiting multispectral cues in proposal initialization and confidence calibration, limiting tracking robustness in complex UAV scenarios. This letter proposes DSATrack, a diffusion-guided spectral-aware tracking framework for multispectral UAV MOT. Specifically, a lightweight spectral encoder injects multispectral information into the RPN branch through feature fusion, enabling the RPN head to generate high-quality object-aware proposals. These proposals are then injected into the initial proposal set to provide reliable spatial priors for diffusion refinement. Furthermore, a spectral-saliency confidence modulation strategy recalibrates refined tracking confidence according to local multispectral saliency contrast before score thresholding, enhancing spectrally reliable candidates while suppressing unreliable ones. Without modifying the original diffusion refinement head, DSATrack improves both proposal quality and post-refinement candidate selection. Experiments on the MMOT benchmark demonstrate that DSATrack outperforms the adapted DiffusionTrack baseline by 4.6 HOTA, 9.0 MOTA, and 7.7 IDF1 points, showing its effectiveness for multispectral UAV MOT.

AI.tldr: DSATrack 通过融合多光谱信息提高了小型目标在复杂背景下的多目标跟踪的鲁棒性，显著提升了HOTA, MOTA 和 IDF1指标。
AI.motivation: 现有的多光谱无人机多目标跟踪技术在处理小目标、复杂背景及帧间配对不稳定性方面存在局限，为此提出了一种融合多光谱信息的DSATrack框架以提升跟踪性能。
AI.method: DSATrack 在特征融合中引入了轻量级光谱编码器，并利用该编码器生成高质量的、以对象为意识的提案。同时，通过光谱显著性置信度调整策略，根据局部光谱显著性对比调校跟踪置信度，从而提高可信的候选目标而抑制不可靠的候选目标，从而提升了跟踪的有效性。
AI.result: 在 MMOT 基准测试中，DSATrack 较 DiffusionTrack 基准系统在 HOTA、MOTA 和 IDF1 指标上分别提升了 4.6、9.0 和 7.7 分。
AI.conclusion: DSATrack 通过引入多光谱信息显著提升了无人机多目标跟踪的鲁棒性和准确度，特别是适用于多光谱场景。

title: RARE: Reinforcement Learning with Adaptive Rubric Evolution for Open-Ended Generation
summary: Verifiable rewards have advanced reinforcement learning in mathematics and code. However, many valuable open-ended tasks share three properties: no automatic verifier of overall quality, multiple requirements to satisfy jointly, and multiple valid responses to each query. Training therefore needs feedback on requirement satisfaction across different valid responses. Rubric-based reinforcement learning provides this feedback by aggregating scores from explicit criteria. As learning progresses unevenly, some criteria become fully satisfied and lose discrimination while others remain informative. Dynamic methods revise shared rubrics or select evolving criteria to restore discrimination, but may also change useful criteria. To address this, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Adaptive Rubric Evolution (RARE). The core idea is to use current policy feedback to guide both which criteria change and what their replacements assess. Sample-level updates replace criteria fully satisfied across current outputs with checks of remaining quality differences, retaining all other criteria and scores. Within this rule, we compare rewarding desirable qualities with penalizing observed flaws. Video script generation exemplifies these properties and supports content production. Its demands for coherent, executable narratives under constraints make it a challenging testbed. Targeting flaws performs best across three video types with a mean gain of 3.82 points over matched static rubrics. Model and human preferences support these gains. Improvements also extend to writing and general generation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 研究提出了一种新的强化学习方法，RARE，用于具有多个未自动验证质量标准的任务中。该方法通过适应性校準评估标准来确保保持鉴别能力，从而改进了视频脚本生成等复杂任务。
AI.motivation: 许多具有挑战性的开放任务涉及多个未自动验证的质量标准，且需要满足这些标准的任务表现得难以进行精确评估和反馈。传统的静态评估标准无法适应学习过程中的变化，可能导致评估标准变得不实用。因此，提出了一个动态调整评估标准的方法来提高模型性能。
AI.method: RARE算法通过利用当前策略的反馈来指导哪些评估标准需要变化以及变化后的新标准应该评估什么。具体而言，当某些标准被完全满足时，RARE会用检查剩余质量差异的新标准来替换它们。这确保了评估标准随着学习的进行而保持有效的评估。
AI.result: 在视频脚本生成任务中，RARE方法比静态评估标准提高了3.82分，且在多种类型的视频脚本生成任务中都有显著的改进。此外，该方法还能应用于其他写作和生成任务。
AI.conclusion: RARE通过适应性调整评估标准来提高强化学习在具有多个未自动验证质量标准的任务中的表现。这种方法特别适用于那些需要满足多个目标且难以评估的领域。

title: BrandEval: A Two-Track Multi-Agent Benchmark for Risk-Sensitive LLM Crisis Communication
summary: Evaluating LLMs for crisis communication requires more than judging isolated responses, because public feedback and competitor actions can reshape trust over time. Existing benchmarks remain largely static and single-turn, offering limited evidence about long-horizon risk-sensitive communication. We introduce \textbf{BrandEval}, a two-track benchmark for product-crisis communication, focusing on public brand responses to product-related safety, quality, service, and trust incidents. BrandEval-Static evaluates stakeholder-aware strategic analysis, while BrandEval-Dynamic stress-tests response policies in \textbf{BrandPolis}, a controlled multi-agent sandbox with consumer feedback, competitor responses, and trust-risk trajectories. We also construct \textbf{BrandSRD}, a Chinese crisis-response dataset, and instantiate a reference Strategic Agent using \textbf{Strategic Rationale (SR)}. Across proprietary and open-source models, we find that static strategic quality is informative but incomplete: it aligns with some end-state outcomes but does not reliably predict volatility and delayed recovery; dynamic stress tests further expose tail-risk failures under manipulative or weakly grounded policies. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/htgan-ai/BrandEval.

AI.tldr: BrandEval 是一个旨在评估大语言模型在危机沟通中的长期策略质量的双轨基准，涵盖静态和动态评估。BrandSRD 是一个中文危机响应数据集，Strategic Rationale (SR) 被用于实现参考战略代理。研究表明，尽管静态评估可以提供一些参考，但在应对操纵性或基础薄弱的政策时，动态评估能更好地揭示潜在风险。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试主要关注孤立的响应，未能充分考虑到公众反馈和竞品回应对信任的影响，因此需要一个更全面的基准来评估长期风险敏感的沟通策略。
AI.method: BrandEval 包括静态和动态评估两种方法。静态通过 BrandEval-Static 来评估利益相关者意识下的战略分析，动态通过 BrandEval-Dynamic 在 BrandPolis 控制的多代理沙盒中测试应对策略，考虑了消费者反馈、竞品回应和信任风险轨迹。
AI.result: 研究表明，虽然静态评估能够提供一些关于最终结果的质量信息，但它们不能可靠地预测波动性和延迟恢复。动态评估在面对操纵性或基础薄弱策略时更能揭示尾端风险。
AI.conclusion: BrandEval 的开发强调了理解长期沟通策略的重要性和评估方法的重要性，为未来的研究提供了新的视角和工具。

title: Modeling Uncertainty Propagation in 3D Morphable Models
summary: We study the problem of mapping parameter-space variance of a 3D Morphable Model (3DMM) to per-vertex variance. Traditionally, per-vertex variance has been used to visually interpret the learnt parameter uncertainty. However, mapping parameter-space variance to per-vertex using sampling or error propagation is computationally expensive. We address this limitation with Closed-form Local Uncertainty Estimation (CLUE), which transforms the parameter-space distribution of 3DMMs to per-vertex through a closed-form approximation. CLUE emerges from applying the law of total variance to the 3DMM formulation and is modular, computationally inexpensive, and accurate. Subsequently, we study integrating CLUE for in-the-wild human mesh recovery training and inference. We note that CLUE uses the geometry of the mesh as an inductive bias when predicting the variance, leading to improved accuracy. Through extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments, we show that when used in training, CLUE (1) outpeforms probabilistic and deterministic baselines on metrics evaluating joints, mesh and uncertainty, and (2) has the highest uncertainty-to-error spearman correlation, with applications including data mining and interpretable uncertainty. Finally, we share SAM 3D Body (CLUE) which augments the regressor with high resolution uncertainty maps. We make our code available at https://github.com/vita-epfl/CLUE

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CLUE的方法，将3D Morphable Model（3DMM）的参数空间方差直接转换到每个顶点，以解决传统方法使用采样或误差传播计算顶点方差的计算成本问题。通过使用三角网格的几何结构作为先验，CLUE在人体网格恢复的训练和推理中表现出色，特别是在不确定性与误差的相关性方面。
AI.motivation: 传统的顶点变异计算方法通过采样或误差传播计算，计算量较大。CLUE通过闭式近似实现了参数空间方差到每个顶点的直接转换，解决了计算成本问题。
AI.method: CLUE方法采用闭式近似将3DMM参数空间分布转换为每个顶点，基于3DMM的公式应用总量方差法则。它将网格几何结构作为预测变异的引导，具有模块化、计算简单且准确的特点。
AI.result: 实验证明，与概率性和确定性基线相比，CLUE在关节、网格和不确定性指标评估中表现更优；与基线相比，CLUE具有最高的不确定性与误差的斯皮尔曼相关性，具有数据挖掘和可解释性不确定性应用。CLUE增加了 regressor 的高分辨率不确定性图，整体提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: CLUE不仅解决了传统方法的计算难题，还通过引入网格几何先验从而提高了人体网格恢复任务中的准确性。这项技术被集成用于人体网格恢复的任务中，并证实了其在实际应用中的有效性。

title: Design Considerations in Low-Resource Archival OCR: A Case Study in Lakota
summary: Building and expanding access to digital archives supports language reclamation and creates lasting resources for community revitalization. Designing effective tools to support these efforts requires taking into account the community-, language-, and document-specific context. We investigate how small ($\leq$3B) vision-language models (VLMs) can be adapted as optical character recognition (OCR) tools for Lakota, a North American Indigenous language. In addition to benchmarking modeling approaches, we inspect four practical facets of low-resource archival OCR that arise in previous work and conversations with community members: constrained training budgets, segmentation noise, scan degradation, and orthographic variance. We demonstrate that fine-tuning VLMs for OCR post-correction on 35 pages of transcribed data decreases character error rate (CER) from 17.1 to 3.9\% on a bilingual corpus, and find that training only with nine pages increases CER by only 1.1\% over this. However, evaluating under realistic automatic segmentation nearly doubles the CER of the best-performing models, stressing the importance of taking realistic use cases into account. We hope this work encourages future research on developing language technologies grounded in the workflows and constraints of ongoing revitalization efforts.

AI.tldr: 通过使用小型视觉-语言模型（VLMs）进行光学字符识别（OCR）工具的适应性训练，研究探讨了低资源档案OCR中的四个实际层面：受限的训练预算、切分噪声、扫描退化和书写差异，结果表明，对35页转录数据进行后处理微调可将字符错误率从17.1%降至3.9%，但在现实自动切分评估下，最好的模型表现亦劣化了。
AI.motivation: 为了支持北美洲原住民语言Lakota的语言复兴，研究探讨了如何利用小型视觉-语言模型（VLMs）作为OCR工具，并针对低资源档案OCR存在的四个重要问题（受限的训练预算、切分噪声、扫描退化和书写差异）提出了改进方案。
AI.method: 研究通过对VLMs进行后处理微调的方法，结合Lakota语言的特殊性，改进了低资源档案OCR的表现。实验包括微调后的性能评估和在不同条件下的测试。
AI.result: 结果显示，对35页转录数据进行后处理微调后的VLMs可以将字符错误率（CER）显著降低至3.9%，相较于仅使用9页数据训练，CER仅增加1.1%，但在现实自动切分评估中，最好的模型表现被显著削弱。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了考虑实际使用场景在开发语言技术中的重要性，并鼓励未来的研究继续关注这些技术在正在进行的语言复兴工作流程中的应用限制。

title: Bridging Concepts: Multi-Agent Reasoning over Scientific Concept Graphs for High-Impact Research Prediction
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, The 3rd Workshop on Knowledge-Enhanced Information Retrieval (KEIR) at The 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Within a research community, new topics often emerge when previously unconnected concepts are first studied together. We construct scientific concept graphs (SCGs)--domain knowledge graphs whose nodes are fine-grained research concepts extracted from paper text by LLMs and whose edges capture their co-occurrence in papers--and study the task of forecasting high-impact concept pairs, i.e., discovering concept pairs that are currently unconnected but will have high impact when connected. To this end, we introduce new benchmark datasets constructed from CIKM, KDD, and SIGIR conference papers, with varied prediction settings, including impact forecasting for emerging concepts unseen during training. We propose MiroGraph, a Multi-agent reasoning framework with scientific concept Graphs, in which a feature designer agent designs predictive features for a given concept pair from structural, semantic, and trend perspectives, and then three LLM agents compute the actual feature values from the enclosing subgraph of the concept pair. Using these feature values, a classifier designer agent constructs a classifier that predicts the final impact labels. MiroGraph outperforms various impact forecasting and temporal link prediction methods.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了科学概念图（SCGs），旨在预测具有高影响力的未连接概念对。通过多智能体框架MiroGraph，该研究提出了一个自动设计预测特征的过程，并使用这些特征来预测概念对的最终影响标签。
AI.motivation: 在研究领域内，新的主题往往通过将以前互不相关的概念首次共同研究而出现。该研究通过构建科学概念图（SCGs）来探索这一现象，以预测具有高影响力的未连接概念对。
AI.method: 该研究利用大型语言模型（LLMs）从论文文本中提取细粒度的研究概念，并通过科科学概念图表示它们的相关性。为进一步提高预测准确性，研究提出了一个多代理推理框架（MiroGraph），该框架包括特征设计师代理、三个LLM代理（用于计算特征值）和分类器设计师代理。
AI.result: MiroGraph框架在多种预测设置中表现优异，特别是在新兴概念的预测上，证明了其在高影响概念对预测方面的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为识别可能导致重大进展的未连接概念对提供了一种新的方法，并在实证研究中证明了该方法的有效性。

title: Knowledge Diversion: A Novel Paradigm for Pre-training Decomposable Image Generation Models
summary: Large-scale pre-trained models have become foundational to modern machine learning, yet conventional pre-training objectives primarily optimize source-domain performance without explicitly considering downstream requirements. Consequently, transferable and task-specific knowledge remains entangled within a shared parameter space, limiting selective knowledge reuse and efficient downstream adaptation. This limitation is particularly consequential for image-generation models, which must accommodate diverse conditions and domains. To address this challenge, we introduce Knowledge Diversion (KDiv), a condition-aware pre-training paradigm for learning inherently decomposable generative models. Before pre-training, KDiv factorizes randomly initialized weights into rank-one Knowledge Units, which are organized into learngenes and tailors. During pre-training, continuous condition-aware routing consolidates knowledge shared across conditions in learngenes while directing condition-dependent variations to tailors. This structured organization enables learngenes to capture transferable generative priors and tailors to develop condition-specific expertise, allowing the resulting model to be selectively recombined for diverse downstream conditions. Extensive experiments across class-, text-, and image-conditioned generation demonstrate that KDiv consistently matches or surpasses dense baselines at comparable pre-training cost and achieves the strongest average downstream performance with a trainable parameter budget comparable to low-rank adaptation methods.

AI.tldr: 引入Knowledge Diversion (KDiv)，一种条件感知的预训练范式，可以减少学习生成模型的共享参数空间，促进知识的转移和适应。
AI.motivation: 传统的预训练主要优化源领域性能，未考虑下游需求，导致生成模型难以适应多变的条件和领域。
AI.method: KDiv 在预训练前拆分随机初始化权重为秩一的知识单元并进行组织，预训练时通过条件感知的路由机制，将通用知识集中于learngenes，条件依赖变化置于tailors，以实现知识转移和适应。
AI.result: 跨类别、文本和图像条件生成的实验显示，KDiv 在与密集基线相似的预训练成本下能与之比肩或超越，并且在训练参数预算可控的情况下，展现出最强的下游性能。
AI.conclusion: KDiv 为学习可分解的生成模型提供了有效方法，提高模型在多变条件和领域下的适应能力。

title: Quality-Controlled Reply and Summary Data for Post-Training Small Language Models in AI Call-Screening Agents
summary: Small language models have improved to the point where a phone can plausibly screen its own calls, answering on an absent owner's behalf without sending call content off the device, a privacy-respecting alternative to cloud call handling. Realizing that promise takes a model that can do two things well: reply within the owner's authority during the call, and afterward tell the owner what happened and what needs attention. Released small models do neither reliably - they raise unwarranted alarms about ordinary callers and write summaries that drop material conditions or report a caller's claims as fact - and real calls supply no reference replies or summaries to learn from. We construct supervision for both tasks from synthetic calls under an information-boundary constraint: a caller writer works from a private scenario brief, a reply writer sees only the conversation up to the current turn, and a summary writer sees the completed transcript. Separate model-based reviews of the full dialogue and the summary decide which calls enter training, yielding a corpus of 3,395 calls with 15,102 targets (11,707 reply, 3,395 summary). Training a single shared LoRA adapter on both tasks, we evaluate six models (0.6-4B parameters) before and after adaptation on 192 held-out calls. Reply qualification rises from 21-54% to 94-97% and summary qualification from 0-6% to 43-72%; all twelve paired gains (six models x two tasks) have bootstrap intervals above zero, and the summary gains hold in every source family. Because one model both screened the training data and scored the outputs, these rates measure agreement with that evaluator's standard rather than human acceptance, which a planned human study will test. After adaptation, coherence and naturalness failures nearly vanish, leaving grounding and usefulness - faithfully tracking who said what, under which conditions - as the remaining challenge.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用合成电话建立监督以改进小语言模型在电话中的表现，提升了回复和总结的准确性。
AI.motivation: 当前小型语言模型在真实电话场景中的表现尚不理想，存在误报和总结不完整的问题，因此需要改进。
AI.method: 研究团队采用合成电话数据和技术边界约束，分别训练回复和总结任务。采用单个LoRA适配器对两个任务进行训练，并对多个模型进行了评估。
AI.result: 在合成电话的基础上，六种不同参数量的模型在响应和总结上的合格率有了显著提升。尤其是响应的合格率达到了94%-97%，总结的合格率达到了43%-72%。另外，模型在一致性与自然度方面的表现也有了极大改善。
AI.conclusion: 改进后的模型在处理电话对话中的回复与总结方面取得了显著效果，但仍需解决模型在某些特定条件下的描述不够准确的问题。未来将进行人类接受度测试。

title: Aligning Language Models with Indigenous Community Cosmovision through Constitutional AI
comment: In preparation for the Dossier "Linguistics in AI and AI in Linguistics" of the journal TextoLivre
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are predominantly trained on corpora that reflect Western, anglophone worldviews. This asymmetry is not neutral: when a model answers questions about territory, community authority, or the relationship with nature, it does so from assumptions that may be alien to the communities using the system. This paper presents a system for aligning language models with the ethical principles of Indigenous communities in Latin America. Drawing on interviews with five Indigenous leaders and defenders, we built an operational cultural constitution grounded in an Indigenous cosmovision, with 12 principles. On this basis, we implemented a Constitutional AI (CAI) pipeline in two phases: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO). The base models were Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. With only 24 preference pairs, improvements were modest but detectable in intergenerational transmission, linguistic caution, and consultation and consent. Qualitative analysis reveals that the SFT phase was responsible for the primary shift in alignment, while DPO refined specific categories. The system was deployed in a conversational interface with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that allows communities to feed the knowledge base, turning alignment into a participatory cycle. We argue the architecture is functional and will scale qualitatively once the corpus is expanded and computing constraints are resolved. The work constitutes a first iteration of an epistemic justice mechanism for value alignment in the Global South.

AI.tldr: 该研究旨在通过调整语言模型使其与拉丁美洲土著社区的伦理原则相一致，以解决现有语言模型中存在的文化偏见问题。通过与五位土著领导人和捍卫者的访谈，构建了一个基于土著宇宙观的操作性文化宪法，并实现了基于宪法的人工智能（CAI）管道，包括监督微调和直接偏好优化两阶段。该系统被部署在一个具有检索增强生成功能的对话界面中，使社区能够更新知识库。研究结果表明，监督微调是主要的调整阶段，而直接偏好优化则进行了细化调整。
AI.motivation: 基于对现有大型语言模型中文化偏见的反思，该论文试图构建一个功能性的机制，确保拉丁美洲土著社区的价值观在人工智能系统中得到体现，维护并尊重地方文化和土著知识。
AI.method: 通过与土著领导人和捍卫者的访谈，研究者构建了一个基于土著宇宙观的文化宪法，并实现了监督微调和直接偏好优化的CAI管道。基线模型为Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct。
AI.result: 该系统的实施虽然仅基于24对偏好配对，但它在代际传承性、语言审慎性以及咨询和同意方面表现出改善，这是通过定量和定性分析得出的结论。特别是在监督微调阶段，系统显示出主要的调整效果，而直接偏好优化阶段则进一步完善了特定类别。
AI.conclusion: 研究团队认为，该系统架构在理论上是可行的，但由于数据集规模限制和计算资源制约，系统的潜力和规模尚未完全实现。然而，该工作被认为是为全球南方地区的人工智能价值观校准提供了一个初步的、具有重要意义的机制。

title: From Views to Worlds: Active Exploration over 3D Worlds for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in 2D visual understanding tasks, yet the passive view-centric perception paradigm limits their capacity for 3D spatial reasoning. Such reasoning often requires actively acquiring spatial evidence beyond the currently visible views, such as camera poses and cross-view spatial relationships, to infer 3D relationships that are not explicitly represented in 2D images. However, existing methods either lack active exploration or merely provide additional views during inference, without explicitly acquiring such spatial evidence beyond 2D images. In this paper, we propose View-to-World (V2W), an active exploration framework that enables VLMs to actively explore 3D worlds and lifts VLMs from passive view-centric perception to active world-centric spatial reasoning. Given a spatial reasoning task with multi-view images, V2W first reconstructs an explicit 3D world with geometry, camera poses, and language-grounded semantics, and exposes it to VLMs through visual and linguistic interfaces. Through multi-turn interaction with these interfaces, VLMs iteratively acquire spatial evidence from the constructed 3D world, enabling active world-centric spatial reasoning. V2W can be integrated with existing VLMs in a training-free manner and can be further enhanced by optimizing the exploration policy via reinforcement learning. Experiments on spatial mental modeling benchmarks demonstrate that V2W substantially improves VLM baselines in the training-free setting and achieves state-of-the-art performance with the learned exploration policy, highlighting the importance of active exploration for spatial intelligence. Project page: \url{https://fangzhou2000.github.io/projects/v2w}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为View-to-World (V2W) 的框架，旨在改进Vision-Language模型在三维空间推理中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的Vision-Language模型在三维空间推理能力上有所不足，因为它们依赖于当前可见视图，缺少对三维空间的主动探索。
AI.method: V2W框架通过构建一个包含几何、相机姿态和语义的地观点及世界模型，并结合视觉和语言接口与VLM进行多轮交互，从而让VLM能够主动探索三维世界。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，V2W框架在无需训练的情况下显著改善了VLM的基础性能，并在学习探索策略后达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: V2W框架强调了主动探索在空间智能中的重要性，并可通过强化学习优化探索策略。

title: DiaLong: Benchmarking Reminiscence in Long-Context Dialogues
comment: 17 pages. Work conducted in 2023 at Johns Hopkins University
summary: How well can transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) retain and recall memories in long contexts of dialogue? LLMs are known to forget long-range factual information in their context, yet the field lacks a comprehensive benchmark to quantitatively assess these shortcomings. We present DiaLong, a long-context dialogue dataset and accompanying memory task that standardizes evaluation in this space. It consists of 100 unique conversations created by humans and then augmented with LLMs, extending beyond lengths found in existing datasets. Our selected memory task is fact recall: classify 40 candidate facts about a dialogue as true or false. This task directly probes the model's ability to actively retain and retrieve information, serving as a critical measure of memory within extended conversational contexts. In testing both the latest LLMs and proposed memory enhancements on DiaLong, we demonstrate that more work needs to be done to enable LLMs with better memory performance. By enhancing memory capabilities, LLMs can improve in maintaining coherence, relevance, and human-like interaction over extended conversation. Improving these capabilities will help LLMs fulfill diverse user needs and expectations in various conversational scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了DiaLong数据集及其记忆任务，专门用于评估大型语言模型在长时间对话中的记忆保留与召回能力。结果显示现有模型仍有待提升。
AI.motivation: 现有大型语言模型虽然在语言生成上表现出色，但在处理长对话情境下记忆相关信息方面仍存在不足，因此需要一个标准的评估基准来评估这些缺陷。
AI.method: 研究人员创建了一个包含100个独特对话的人类和AI增强数据集，并设计了一个事实回忆任务来直接测试模型在长对话中的记忆保留与召回性能。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，尽管最新的大型语言模型在记忆任务上有所提升，但仍需进一步增强记忆能力，以提高长时间对话中的相关性、一致性和人性化互动。
AI.conclusion: 通过提升记忆能力，大型语言模型将更好地满足各种对话场景下用户多样化的需求和期望。

title: Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering
summary: Agentic knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires large language models (LLMs) to solve complex questions through multi-turn interactions with a knowledge graph (KG). Outcome-supervised reinforcement learning derives verifiable outcome rewards from final answers but uniformly assigns each rollout's outcome-level advantage to all policy-generated tokens, creating a trajectory-to-operation mismatch since KG operations within a rollout can have varying effects on the search process and final answer. To address this, we propose Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation (OACR), which employs a training-only KG-state outcome model to estimate outcome-reward changes between adjacent KG search states and converts them into operation credit, from which token-wise weights are derived. These multiplicative weights reallocate token-level update magnitudes while preserving the sign of the outcome-level advantage at every generated token. Across three benchmarks, OACR achieves stronger overall performance than existing KGQA methods while using fewer inference-time LLM calls and tokens.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation (OACR) 的方法，通过在训练过程中使用知识图状态的结果模型来重新分配操作信用，从而更准确地更新每个词元的重要性权重，这种方法在三个基准测试中都优于现有方法，并减少了推理时对大语言模型的调用次数和词元数量。
AI.motivation: 传统的方法通过最终答案来监督学习，并且按照每个 rollout 的最终奖励均匀分配给所有生成的词元，从而在知识图搜索过程中各操作的影响被混淆。为了改进这一点，该研究提出了 OACR 方法来解决这个对齐问题。
AI.method: OACR 采用了一个仅用于训练的知识图状态结果模型来估计相邻知识图搜索状态之间的结果奖励变化，并将其转换为操作信用，从而产生根据操作影响重新加权的生成词元权重。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试中，OACR 方法显著优于现有的知识图问题回答（KGQA）方法，同时减少了推理过程中的大语言模型调用次数和词元数量。
AI.conclusion: OACR 方法通过重新分配操作信用来改进 KGQA 任务中的强化学习过程，不仅提高了性能，还优化了推理过程中的资源使用。

title: MESS: Multi-Exposure Sequence Synthesis for Generalizable Image Enhancement
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code and data are available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/MESS
summary: Despite the significant progress in image enhancement under adverse illuminations, such as low-light image enhancement, exposure correction, and backlit image enhancement, existing models show limited generalizability to different scenarios. A major bottleneck lies in the lack of large-scale and diverse training data, as these tasks typically rely on manually captured, precisely aligned image pairs that are expensive to scale up. Although synthetic data have been explored as an alternative, existing synthesis methods are limited in modeling complex adverse illumination conditions and camera imaging pipelines. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework to synthesize realistic training pairs for generalizable image enhancement in the wild. Specifically, we first derive multi-exposure sequences (MES) from high-bit RAW images by rendering them under different exposure settings through an emulated ISP pipeline. Using these RAW-derived MES as supervision, we train a diffusion-based RGB-to-MES generator to synthesize plausible exposure sequences from a single 8-bit RGB image, extending the synthesis pipeline from limited RAW collections to large-scale in-the-wild RGB data. For each source image, we randomly sample one synthesized exposure variant as the degraded input and use the original high-quality RGB image as the target. With the proposed MES Synthesis (MESS) approach, we construct a dataset of 500K training pairs and train a lightweight network, which demonstrates significantly better generalization performance than existing models across various image enhancement tasks. Code and data are available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/MESS.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的框架，通过合成多曝光序列（MES）来生成适应不同场景的图像增强训练对，该框架从高位 RAW 图像中生成 MES，训练了一个基于扩散的 RGB 到 MES 生成器，提高了现有模型在各种图像增强任务中的泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图像增强模型在不同场景下的泛化能力有限，主要原因是没有大规模和多样化的训练数据，以及合成数据方法在模拟复杂环境和相机成像过程中的局限性。
AI.method: 通过从高位 RAW 图像中生成多曝光序列（MES），并使用这些序列训练了一个基于扩散的 RGB 到 MES 生成器，为大规模在野 RGB 数据生成合适的曝光序列，从而构建了一个 500K 的训练数据集。
AI.result: 使用提出的 MES 合成方法（MESS）构建了一个 500K 更新的数据集，并训练了一个轻量级网络，其在各种图像增强任务中的泛化性能显著优于现有模型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的方法有效地解决了现有问题，通过大规模合成训练数据提高了图像增强任务的泛化能力。

title: Self-Distillation for Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised fine-tuning treats the expert demonstration or gold response as a one-hot target, suppressing valid alternative continuations that the model would otherwise assign probability to. We propose Gold-Conditioned Distillation (GCD), a method that turns expert demonstrations into model-native supervision. GCD uses one model as both teacher and student: the teacher conditions on a prompt containing the gold response in context, the student conditions on the original prompt as at inference, and the student is trained to minimize the forward KL divergence to the teacher's next-token distribution at each gold response token. This lets the model use its prior knowledge to teach itself the new task: correctness is anchored by the gold response, while the soft target preserves plausible alternatives. Across various training tasks on Qwen and Llama models, GCD improves new-task accuracy over SFT and generally reduces degradation on general benchmarks.

AI.tldr: GCD 提出了一种通过条件蒸馏将专家演示转换为模型本地监督的方法，以提高新任务的准确性。
AI.motivation: 当前监督微调方法将专家演示或黄金响应视为一热目标，抑制了模型原本应分配概率的有效替代延续，GCD 提出的方法旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: GCD 方法采用同一模型作为教师和学生。教师条件在包含黄金响应的提示上下文中，学生在推理时条件在原始提示上，学生通过最小化每个黄金响应标记向前 KL 散度来进行训练。
AI.result: GCD 方法在 Qwen 和 Llama 模型的各种训练任务中提高了新任务的准确性，并一般减少了对通用基准的性能下降。
AI.conclusion: GCD 方法提供了一种有效的学习新任务的方法，不仅提高了准确性，还保持了模型的灵活性，避免了过于僵化。

title: When Form Changes but Logic Doesn't: Building Logic-invariant LLMs through Logical Structure
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether this performance reflects an understanding of underlying logical structure or a reliance on shallow semantic cues. A key indicator of such understanding is whether models treat logically equivalent inputs consistently, producing the same predictions despite differences in expression. Through systematic evaluation on curated data, we show that even strong LLMs often fail this test: they do not consistently preserve predictions across logically equivalent inputs and generalize poorly to unseen logical forms. To address this limitation, we propose LoGIcal STructure-guided reasoning (LoGIST), a framework that guides LLM reasoning with explicit logical structure. LoGIST maps each input instance to a decision diagram, a directed acyclic graph that captures the underlying logical structure, and encodes this graph into a logical embedding that conditions the LLM's reasoning process. Across multiple training settings, LoGIST reduces inconsistency under logical equivalence and improves generalization to unseen logical forms, suggesting that logical invariance is a useful target for building more robust and generalizable logical reasoning in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，尽管大语言模型在各种推理任务中表现出色，但它们往往不能一致地处理逻辑等价输入，这表明其推理可能依赖于表面语义而非深层逻辑结构。为此，提出了一种名为LoGIST的方法，通过将输入映射到决策图并嵌入逻辑结构来改进语言模型的逻辑推理能力。
AI.motivation: 研究指出，现有大语言模型在逻辑推理任务中的表现主要依赖于表面的语义线索，而非深入理解逻辑结构。为了克服这一局限性，提出了LoGIST框架，以增强模型在逻辑推理方面的表现。
AI.method: LoGIST通过将每个输入映射到一个决策图，并将该图的逻辑结构编码为一种嵌入，从而引导LSTM等大语言模型遵循显式的逻辑结构来进行推理。这种方法通过多组训练设置验证了其在减少逻辑等价输入不一致性并提高对未见逻辑形式的泛化能力方面的有效性。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，LoGIST能够减少逻辑等价输入间的预测不一致性，并提高对未见逻辑形式的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论，逻辑不变性是构建更强大和更具通用性的逻辑推理能力的有用目标，提出的LoGIST框架为实现这一目标提供了一种方法。

title: Geometry-Aware Interpolation for Inverse Problems
summary: Recovering missing visual information from incomplete or degraded images remains a challenging problem, particularly when spatial variations and complex image structures affect reconstruction accuracy. Although Spatial Transformer Networks (STNs) facilitate spatial feature alignment, their reliance on conventional linear or bilinear interpolation limits their ability to capture the underlying geometric characteristics of image data. Furthermore, interpolation based on a restricted set of neighbouring pixels can introduce inconsistencies in gradient propagation, potentially affecting optimisation stability. To address these limitations, we propose a Geometry-Aware Interpolation Network (GAIN), a variational autoencoder-based framework that incorporates manifold geometry into spatial transformation and image reconstruction. Rather than estimating pixel intensities solely from fixed spatial neighbours, GAIN exploits the local tangent structure of the data manifold to construct geometry-informed intensity approximations. An entropy-based regularisation mechanism further guides the estimation of spatial transformation parameters, promoting more adaptive interpolation. In addition, a convolutional normalisation strategy is introduced to regulate the magnitude of non-zero activations and improve gradient stability during training. Extensive experiments on challenging image completion and classification benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of GAIN in improving predictive accuracy while reducing computational cost compared with existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种几何感知插值网络(GAIN)来解决视觉信息从不完整或降级图像中恢复的问题。GAIN 使用变分自编码器框架结合流形几何进行空间变换和图像重建，通过利用数据流形的局部切空间结构来构建几何指导的强度近似，引入熵正则化机制和卷积归一化策略来增强预测准确性和减少计算开销。
AI.motivation: 针对由于空间变化和复杂图像结构导致的重构精度低的痛点，为了提升视觉信息恢复的准确性和稳定性，提出了 GAIN。
AI.method: GAIN是一种结合变分自编码器的几何感知插值网络，通过引入局部切空间结构的估计和熵正则化机制，以及卷积归一化策略，改进了传统的空间变换网络。
AI.result: GAIN在多个挑战性的图像补全和分类基准测试中表现出更高的预测准确性和更低的计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，GAIN在提高预测准确性和降低成本方面表现出色。

title: Where Are Language-Specific Features Represented in Multilingual LLMs? Everywhere
summary: Previous work has argued that multilingual LLMs encode language-specific features most strongly in their initial and final layers, implying that intermediate layers support language-agnostic representations. This paper reconsiders this finding by performing four different experiments: three that undertake a fine-grained analysis of representations of Portuguese and Spanish, two closely related languages, and one large-scale language identification experiment that covers over 200 languages. The results of these experiments challenge the strict separation between language-specific and language-agnostic layers in multilingual LLMs, using Llama 3.2 1B as a test case. By analyzing and manipulating contextual sentence embeddings, we demonstrate that language identity remains strongly recoverable throughout the model rather than being restricted to initial and final layers. Moreover, we find that the model tends to classify ambiguous strings as closer to Spanish than to Portuguese, revealing a skew in model behavior that differs from human judgments.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过多语言实验挑战了关于多语言LLM的先前观点，即语言特定特征主要集中在初始和最终层，而中间层为语言通用表示。研究发现，语言身份在模型的整个过程中仍高度可恢复，而不只限于初始和最终层。此外，实验发现模型对某些字符串的分类偏向西班牙语，这一倾向与人类判断不同。
AI.motivation: 研究者为挑战关于多语言LLM的广泛接受观点，即它们的语言特定特征主要集中在最开始和最末层，而中间层用于生成语言通用的表示。
AI.method: 通过利用Llama 3.2 1B模型执行了四个实验。三个实验对葡萄牙语和西班牙语（两种密切相关的语言）的表示进行了细粒度分析，而一个实验则覆盖了超过200种语言。通过分析和操纵上下文句子嵌入，发现语言身份在整个模型中都保持高度可回收。
AI.result: 实验结果挑战了语言特定和语言通用层之间的严格分离。语言身份在模型的整个过程中高度可恢复，而不仅仅局限于初始和最终层。此外，研究发现模型对于某些字符串的分类表现出偏向西班牙语的倾向，这与人类判断产生了不同。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，LLM模型中存在支持语言通用表征的中间层，而不是仅在最开始和最末层集中于语言特定特征。这种发现可能有助于深入理解多语言LLM的内部机制。

title: Stepwise Reasoning Verification: Don't Generate, Classify!
summary: Verifying the reasoning of large language models is increasingly important as they are applied to complex mathematical and scientific problems. Existing work focuses on large decoder models and reports mixed results for generative and discriminative verifiers, leaving unclear which paradigm is more effective and whether large models are necessary. In this work, we cast stepwise verification as a natural language inference task: the problem and partial solution prefix form the premise, while the next reasoning step serves as the hypothesis to be classified as entailed or non-entailed. This formulation enables error localisation at individual reasoning steps and direct comparison of encoder classification, decoder classification, and decoder verdict generation across model scales and annotation budgets. Across five reasoning datasets, a 0.15B encoder classifier outperforms most generative verifiers with up to 4B parameters. On identical decoder backbones, classification outperforms generation from 0.5B to 4B parameters and matches it on the strongest 7B backbone---reaching comparable performance with roughly one tenth as many annotated problems. Our findings establish classification as a parameter- and data-efficient approach to stepwise verification and show that strong verification does not require large generative decoders.

AI.tldr: 验证大语言模型的推理能力已成为应用到复杂数学和科学问题的关键，研究通过自然语言推理任务的框架，发现编码器分类器在多种模型规模和注释预算下表现优于生成验证器，表明强验证不一定需要大型生成解码器。
AI.motivation: 由于大语言模型正被应用于复杂的数学和科学问题，验证其推理能力变得越来越重要。现有研究集中于大型解码器模型，但不同验证方式的效果存在差异，且没有明确指出哪种验证方式更为有效，以及大模型是否是必要条件。
AI.method: 将步骤验证转化为自然语言推理任务，通过问题及其部分解决方案前缀作为前提，下一个推理步骤作为假设进行分类判断（包含或不包含）。实验中使用了五个推理数据集进行对比，涉及不同模型规模和注释预算条件下的表现。
AI.result: 在五个推理数据集测试中，0.15亿参数的编码器分类器在大多数情况下优于最大至4亿参数的生成验证器。对于相同大小的解码器基础模型，在0.5亿到4亿参数范围内，分类优于生成，并且在最强大的7亿参数模型上达到了相似的性能，只需大约十分之一的注释问题数量。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，分类方法在参数量和注释预算上更为高效，证实了步骤验证的有效性，并暗示了强大的验证功能不一定依赖于大型生成解码器。

title: Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation
summary: High-quality image editing requires precise modification of target regions while preserving the content of unrelated regions. Existing editing models produce flattened outputs that limit precise local manipulation and layer reuse, while decomposition methods typically optimize layer recovery separately from instruction-driven editing. To this end, we introduce LayerEditor, a unified framework that couples instruction-guided image editing with controllable generation of reusable RGBA layers. At its core, In-Context RGB-Alpha Token Modeling jointly represents the edited canvas and an ordered sequence of RGB-Alpha layers within a single token sequence, enabling semantic edits and explicit control over individual layer content. To retain the pretrained model's editing capability during adaptation to layered outputs, we propose Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation, which transfers its editing prior to both the edited canvas and the image composed from the predicted layers. To support training and evaluation, we construct LayerEditor-100K, a large-scale paired image-editing dataset with ordered RGBA layer annotations, and introduce dedicated benchmarks for layered editing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayerEditor maintains strong editing fidelity while generating accurate RGBA layers, supporting both flexible layer-level manipulation and multi-layer decomposition.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为LayerEditor的统一框架，结合了指令引导的图像编辑和可控制生成的可重用RGBA层，通过In-Context RGB-Alpha Token Modeling和Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation方法实现了精确的局部修改和图层重用。实验验证了其在保持编辑保真度的同时生成准确的RGBA图层，支持灵活的图层级操作和多层分解。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像编辑模型和分解方法无法同时提供精细的局部修改能力和图层重用。因此，研究人员提出了LayerEditor框架，旨在结合指令指导和图层控制，改进图像编辑的灵活度和保真度。
AI.method: LayerEditor采用In-Context RGB-Alpha Token Modeling对编辑画布和有序RGB-Alpha图层进行联合表示，提高语义编辑能力和对单个图层内容的控制。同时，提出了Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation方法，在适应多层输出时保留预训练模型的编辑能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，LayerEditor在保持编辑保真度的同时生成准确的RGBA图层，支持灵活的图层级操作和多层分解。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种创新的图像编辑框架，显著改进了现有的编辑和分解方法，为图像编辑领域带来了新的可能。

title: EmotiQ: A Quantum Residual Specialist Framework for Text Emotion Classification
summary: Emotion classification from text is challenging because many affective states are distinguished by subtle linguistic signals and semantically overlapping boundaries. We investigate whether compact quantum modules can serve as targeted residual specialists that assist traditional classifiers on difficult emotion decisions. We introduce EmotiQ, a residual specialist framework for text emotion classification using a frozen transformer classifier as the primary decision maker, identifies challenging emotion boundaries from validation behavior, and trains boundary specialists, including quantum encodings, data re-uploading specialists, prototype and fidelity specialists, and kernel-based specialists. Specialists are permitted to intervene only when they satisfy validation-based admission criteria. We evaluate the framework across six text emotion classification datasets and establish traditional model baselines. Experimental results show that the admitted EmotiQ policy improves mean macro-F1 metrics over the baseline, and achieves positive gains on five of six datasets. Among the quantum components, ZZ interaction feature maps are the most consistently effective, yielding a mean macro-F1 improvement of +0.0030 and positive gains on four datasets. These findings suggest that current quantum NLP methods can be deployed as residual specialists that provide localized improvements under strong classical supervision.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种使用紧凑型量子模块作为传统分类器的辅助手段进行情感分类的方法，通过引入EmotiQ框架，在六种文本情感分类数据集上取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 文本情感分类面临的挑战在于情感状态之间存在微妙的语言信号和语义重叠边界，因此需要一种能够辅助传统分类器作出困难决策的技术。
AI.method: 该方法使用了一个冻结的transformer分类器作为主要决策者，并从验证行为中识别情感决策的难点，然后训练边界专家，包括量子编码、数据再上传专家、原型和忠实度专家以及基于核专家。这些专家仅在满足验证基准准入标准时才进行干预。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，EmotiQ框架在六个文本情感分类数据集上提高了平均宏观F1分数，并且在五个数据集上取得积极收益。ZZ相互作用特征映射在量子组件中表现最为一致有效，平均宏观F1提高了0.0030。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，当前的量子NLP方法可以在强大经典监督下作为局部改进的残差专家进行部署。

title: System X: An LLM Decision Model That Replies from Its Own KV Cache
summary: Decision models return probabilities over supplied options, but a deployed agent may also need to reply in words. The present study introduces System X, a large language model (LLM) decision model that adds a text-reply option to the LLM-as-Jev readout. When this option wins, or confidence is low, the same model continues from the decision's key-value (KV) cache, avoiding a repeated prompt prefill. Qwen3-0.6B has been fine-tuned with LoRA on Reason-9k and Bitext reply rows. JevBench accuracy shows no statistically significant change (55.4% to 54.5%, p=0.87), while expected calibration error falls from 0.292 to 0.169. Held-out Bitext routing accuracy reaches 98.3%. Cache reuse saves 15-37% of latency on an Apple M4 Pro, with token-identical replies in the FP32 demonstration cases. Scoring options on copies of the prompt cache matches full-sequence scoring to within 1.4e-6 in probability. Adding dialogue, industry and complaint data (System X+) improves support-task results but lowers IFEval accuracy from 55.5% to 45.0%. System X v4 uses Qwen3-1.7B, rebalanced data and teacher-rewritten reply targets. Against its base LLM, JevBench accuracy rises from 55.0% to 61.0% (p=0.04), with no statistically significant IFEval change (p=0.71). A matched latency test on unadapted Qwen3-1.7B saves 17-39%. One LLM judge prefers v4 replies to an unadapted 1.7B second call (31 to 11 pairs, p=0.003); the other's preference is not significant. These reply comparisons also differ in prompts and generation limits. State conflicts and unsupported reply details remain failure modes. Further studies with several seeds, human raters and real support data are recommended.

AI.tldr: 该研究引入了System X，一个添加了文本回复选项的大语言模型决策模型，并通过实验展示了其在准确性和计算效率上的改进。
AI.motivation: 当前决策模型仅返回概率，而部署的代理可能需要以文字形式回答。为解决这一问题，作者开发了System X，以改进现有模型的响应方式。
AI.method: 作者使用了大语言模型Qwen3-0.6B对其进行了微调，并在JevBench和Bitext任务上进行了验证。还对该模型进行了多次迭代以优化性能。
AI.result: System X的JevBench准确率从55.4%提升到61.0%，节省了17-39%的延迟时间。在某些特定任务上，新版本的System X表现更好，但通用性略有下降。
AI.conclusion: 该模型在某些特定任务上表现优异，但仍有改进空间，未来研究将涵盖使用多个随机种子、人类评定者和真实支持数据的进一步实验。

title: CorrFlow: Self-Correcting Flow Matching
summary: Flow-matching models generate samples through iterative velocity predictions, but typically do not revisit these predictions using the intermediate representations that produced them. We introduce CorrFlow, a self-correcting flow-matching framework that reuses this information through a lightweight refiner. Under rectified-flow interpolation, the error of the one-step clean prediction equals the realized velocity residual scaled by the noise level. Motivated by this identity, the refiner learns to predict residual corrections from the base model's clean prediction, conditioning, noise level and hidden states from the same forward pass. The correction is added to the base velocity before each sampling update, so subsequent predictions are made from the corrected state. This requires no additional base-model evaluations and only one lightweight refiner evaluation per step.
