Our theoretical analyses establish conditions under which feature reuse outperforms raw-input affine predictors and refiner training achieves greater residual-risk reduction than continued base-model training under a matched training compute budget. Experiments on class-conditional image generation, text-to-video generation and image-to-video generation show consistent improvements over the corresponding base models, including gains in visual quality and physical consistency. Project Page: https://fogradio.github.io/corrflow-project

AI.tldr: CorrFlow 是一种自纠正的流匹配框架，通过轻量级修正器利用基础模型的中间表示来预测残差修正，从而提高生成样本的质量和物理一致性。
AI.motivation: 针对现有的流匹配模型生成样本时不能重用预测过程中的中间信息的问题，提出了 CorrFlow 框架，利用基础模型的清洁预测、噪声程度和隐藏状态作为修正器输入，学习预测残差修正。
AI.method: CorrFlow 使用轻量级修正器在每次采样更新前，将修正器预测的残差修正添加到基础模型的预测速度上，从而在不增加基础模型计算成本的情况下改进生成样本的质量。
AI.result: 在类条件图像生成、文本到视频生成和图像到视频生成任务上，CorrFlow 相比基础模型展示了视觉质量和物理一致性的持续改进。
AI.conclusion: 理论分析表明，在匹配训练计算预算下，特征重用效果优于直接输入的仿射预测器；修正器训练能实现比继续基础模型训练更大的残差风险减少。

title: Flattening Fantasies: Analyzing Stereotypes in Pornographic Discourse
summary:
This study presents a large-scale quantitative analysis of 5.4 million video
  titles from xHamster, the world's fourth most visited pornography platform, to
  examine linguistic patterns used to describe different dimensions of
  identities (e.g., race and gender). Specifically, we investigate how
  nationalities, ethnic groups, and gender identities are portrayed in
  pornographic discourse, focusing on stereotypes and deviations from implicit
  norms of pornography. The results show the dominance of American pornography
  over other groups, which acts as the de facto norm for the adult industry. We
  identify persistent ethnic stereotypes reflecting colonial power dynamics,
  religious fetishization, and the sexualization of cultural taboos. The
  analysis reveals gendered representational differences across cultures, with a
  prevalent Madonna-Whore dichotomy in the portrayal of women and stereotypical
  depictions of men in physically dominant roles.

AI.tldr: 该研究对xHamster平台上540万条视频标题进行了大规模定量分析，探讨描述不同身份维度（如种族和性别）的语言模式。研究揭示了美国色情内容的主导地位，并指出了持久存在的民族和种族刻板印象。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在通过大规模数据分析揭示成人娱乐行业中色情内容对种族、性别等身份的描述方式，尤其是对刻板印象和偏离规范的现象进行探讨。
AI.method: 研究方法基于对xHamster平台上的大量视频标题进行定量分析，以识别文本中体现的种族、性别等身份特征的语言模式。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，美国色情内容的主导地位影响了整个行业，揭示了一些根深蒂固的民族和种族刻板印象，以及性别角色的刻板划分。
AI.conclusion: 本研究强调了成人娱乐行业中，包括种族、宗教及性别等在内的刻板印象和不规范描述依旧普遍存在，并提出了对未来研究和行业监管的建议。

title: On Reasoning Correctness Directions
summary: We present experimental evidence suggesting that information about whether a model's reasoning is on the right track can be linearly decodable without defining a causally useful direction for steering. To study this, we introduce ChainSearch, a controlled arithmetic reasoning task that extends Countdown with explicit search and backtracking. We train a 3-million-parameter model to solve this task. Its compact size allows us to study internal model correctness directions in detail using linear probes, mean activation differences, and direct optimisation, as part of a rigorous search for internal reasoning-correctness directions. We find that while the model contains statistically significant internal directions of reasoning correctness, none of the resulting directions consistently improves reasoning under causal intervention. This calls into question whether the linear representation hypothesis is sufficient for identifying causally useful directions in the context of reasoning. Our code is made available together with this work.

AI.tldr: 研究提出了一个扩展的算术推理任务ChainSearch，并通过线性探针、平均激活差异和直接优化来研究模型内部的推理正确性方向。尽管模型中存在统计意义上显著的推理正确性方向，但在因果干预下，这些方向并未表现出一致改进，这质疑了线性表示假设是否足以识别推理中的因果有用方向。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在探索模型内部是否能够线性解码推理是否正确的方向，并深入探究这些方向的有效性，特别是在因果干预的情境下。
AI.method: 研究引入了ChainSearch任务并进行模型训练，通过线性探针、平均激活差异和直接优化的方法研究模型内部的推理正确性方向。
AI.result: 研究发现尽管模型中的推理正确性方向存在统计显著性，但在因果干预下这些方向并未表现出一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果暗示线性表示假设可能不足以识别推理中的因果有用方向。

title: CorrCLIPv2: Harnessing Unlabeled Images for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
comment: 25 pages, 12 figures, 12 tables. Published in International Journal of Computer Vision
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation aims to classify pixels without being restricted to a fixed set of categories. Although Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) demonstrates remarkable potential for open-vocabulary recognition, its segmentation capability is impaired by noisy inter-class patch interactions. To this end, this work proposes a unified training-free object-centric framework, named CorrCLIPv2, from three complementary aspects of patch correlation, feature representation, and output regularization. Specifically, for patch correlation, we leverage class-agnostic mask generators to explicitly disentangle inter-class interactions. Moreover, we utilize spatially-coherent features from self-supervised models to compute attention scores to mitigate mask inaccuracies. Regarding feature representation, we devise a refinement mechanism to simultaneously strengthen spatial details and semantic representation. Within the output space, we unify predictions via voting in each mask to enhance spatial consistency. To mitigate contextual bias and enhance prediction accuracy of objects, we further extend the framework by incorporating a cross-image object retrieval paradigm, which incurs minimal computational overhead. We build a memory bank of CorrCLIP-enhanced features from unlabeled images and implement a regime of multi-CLIP ensemble. By aggregating semantically consistent object features across diverse contexts retrieved from the memory bank, CorrCLIPv2 mitigates context-induced interference and obtains more robust predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art on 10 standard benchmarks. Remarkably, it even surpasses fully supervised open-vocabulary methods across 22 multi-domain datasets. Code is available at: https://github.com/zdk258/CorrCLIP.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种名为CorrCLIPv2的无监督训练框架，通过优化patch关联性、特征表示和输出正则化来增强CLIP在开放词汇语义分割任务中的性能。
AI.motivation: CLIP在开放词汇识别任务中表现出色，但在语义分割任务中受限于类间patch交互的噪音，因此需要改进其分割能力。
AI.method: 通过从patch关联、特征表示和输出正则化三个层面优化，设计了CorrCLIPv2框架。具体而言，使用类自适应掩码生成器分离类间交互，利用自监督模型的特征计算注意力得分减少掩码错误，同时增强了空间细节和语义表现，并通过投票机制增强了预测的一致性。此外，通过跨图像对象检索机制增强对上下文偏差的抵抗，并融合多CLIP方法提高预测准确性。
AI.result: 经过实验验证，该方法在10个标准基准上达到新的SOTA，并在22个多域数据集上超越了全监督的开放词汇方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种改进的无监督开放词汇语义分割框架CorrCLIPv2，通过提高图像分割模型的鲁棒性和准确性，为开放词汇视觉任务提供了新的解决方案。

title: Representations in Motion: Layer-wise Rotation and Trajectory Divergence in LLMs
summary: Recent work suggests that activation dynamics--how representations change during inference--might be more revealing about language model behavior than static readouts from individual layers. In this work, we investigate the layer-wise evolution of representations of factuality, using true and false statements when the model is prompted to either lie or to be honest. We report a geometric phenomenon in which the factuality directions extracted from the lying and honest conditions appear to rotate away from each other across layers. We find that such layer-wise rotation also occurs in a task that requires the model to take different visual perspectives in the 3D world, suggesting that the rotation phenomenon might be indicative of manipulating conceptual spaces in general, rather than unique to factuality. We then investigate the "real time" transformation of conceptual representations on a trial-to-trial basis. We show that it is possible to make strong predictions about the model's target task and behavior from trajectories alone. In addition, diverging points in single-trial trajectories correspond to the onset of rotation in aggregated-trial analysis. Finally, we show that both rotation and divergent trajectories occur in more naturalistic settings in which models are not overtly prompted to "lie" but rather report false statements in the course of completing a different task.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示了在模型处理不同事实性陈述时，表征如何在层间旋转变化的现象，并且这种现象不仅出现在需要模型在虚构与诚实之间切换的任务中，还出现在需要改变3D视角的任务中，表明这种旋转可能与操纵概念空间有关。研究还通过单次试验轨迹展示了强大的预测能力。
AI.motivation: 探索语言模型在推理过程中如何变化，以及这些动态变化如何揭示语言模型的行为。
AI.method: 通过比较模型在面对真陈述和假陈述时的表征变化，采用几何旋转分析法来探讨模型在不同任务中的表征动态变化。
AI.result: 发现模型在处理虚假陈述前后表征方向在层间旋转，这种现象不仅存在于需要模型改变虚构与诚实状态的任务中，还在需要视角变换的任务中出现，表明这种旋转现象可能表明模型在操作概念空间方面的变化。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，表征的层间旋转现象可能是模型在不同任务中操作概念空间变化的一种表征方式，并且通过试验轨迹可以预测模型的行为。

title: A failure of Imagination: VLMs fail to use visual representations for text, but self-distillation can help
summary: Vision-language (VL) models are typically built by fine-tuning a language model to attend to visual features in service of a Visual Question-Answering objective. We ask whether this alignment changes how language models represent text---especially on tasks where visualization would help, like geometry questions posed in words. We distinguish weak multimodality (the model can answer questions about an input image) from strong multimodality (the model's text representations themselves become vision-aligned, improving performance on text-only tasks with latent visual structure). To test for strong multimodality, we construct a task of shape-counting problems with paired equivalent text and image specifications. This task is trivial when the image is provided, but requires visualization when specified in text as line coordinates. We compare instruction-tuned Qwen-2.5 and Mistral models against their vision-aligned counterparts on the text variant of the task. We find that the multimodal models do no better in this setting, despite strong performance on the image version of the task. Probing experiments corroborate this: vision-aligned decoder embeddings carry no more visual structure than their text-only counterparts. Finally, we provide an optimization objective that distills in-context visual embeddings into text embeddings. This alignment induces gains on the text variant of the task without explicit task supervision, even on samples more complex than seen during alignment. This suggests that VQA-style alignment leaves available cross-modal transfer untapped.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，尽管视觉-语言模型在添加了视觉特征后对图像版本的任务表现良好，但在仅依赖文本的版本中并没有表现出更强的视觉多模态性。通过优化目标将上下文中的视觉嵌入提炼到文本嵌入中，仍然能在不依赖具体任务监督的情况下提升文本任务的表现。
AI.motivation: 研究当前视觉-语言模型的多模态性，尤其是在仅依赖文本的任务中能否利用视觉信息，以探索跨模态迁移的可能性。
AI.method: 设计了一个基于形状计数问题的多模态任务，要求模型理解仅由文字描述的问题，而这些描述实际包含了需要可视化的隐藏视觉结构。比较了仅通过指令调优的模型和视觉对齐的模型在这些任务上的表现。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，即使在含有图像版本明显表现出色的情况下，多模态模型在仅依赖文本的版本中并未显示出更强的视觉多模态性。探针实验表明，视觉对齐的解码器嵌入不携带更多的视觉结构信息。不过，通过特定的优化目标将上下文中的视觉嵌入提炼到文本嵌入中，能够提升任务表现。
AI.conclusion: 研究认为VQA式的多模态对齐可能尚未充分发挥其跨模态迁移的潜力。

title: Design Anything, Design at Scale
comment: 47 pages, 25 figures, 16 tables. Project page: https://designanything.gemus.ai
summary: As multimodal resources are transformed into media outputs, agentic AI is expected to stay aligned with design intent over long horizons. Designers follow briefs specifying goals, constraints, and deliverables, with later work building on earlier decisions. Recent work reuses design experience across tasks, yet alignment among artifacts within one project remains challenging. Agents therefore need to preserve and apply this intent across domains and as projects grow. We introduce Design Anything, a graph-based harness that preserves design intent outside the model and binds deliverables to the workflow steps that produce them through an intent-execution graph. A task contract retains constraints and decisions, selected designs become explicit inputs to later generations, and a deterministic controller uses bindings and execution records to check output types and counts, identify outstanding deliverables, and guide subsequent turns. We also introduce DesignAnything-Bench, with 228 tasks across 19 design domains, including 38 project families at scales of 6, 14, and 24 artifacts. With the LLM held fixed, Design Anything satisfies 85.0% and 92.5% of the brief's factual constraints with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash High and GPT-5.6 Sol High, respectively, exceeding the strongest same-model baselines by 15.4% and 14.4%. These gains reach 25.1% and 23.0% on 24-artifact tasks. Under each model, Design Anything leads or ties in constraint satisfaction in 18 of 19 domains. Professional designers also prefer its complete deliverable sets over those of same-model baselines in a blind evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了Design Anything，这是一种图基架构，旨在保持设计意图并将其绑定到工作流程步骤，以提高长期项目中多模态资源的协同设计效果。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态资源处理技术在跨任务重用设计经验方面取得了一定进展，但在同一项目内多个产物间的对齐问题仍然存在挑战。因此，研究引入旨在保持设计意图并链接具体输出的设计方法。
AI.method: 该方法通过引入一种图基的Design Anything架构，其中设计意图被图结构保留在模型之外，将具体输出与产生它们的工作流步骤绑定，并借助任务契约、选定设计、意图执行图以及确定的控制器来实现。
AI.result: 在使用LLM的不同版本进行测试时，与基线相比，Design Anything能够更好地满足设计意图的约束条件，尤其是在大规模项目中，其效果显著优于基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，采用Design Anything的方法能够显著提高设计师在项目中的协同工作效率和交付结果的符合程度。

title: Assertion and Belief: Moore's Paradox in Language Models
summary: Moore's paradox \citep{moore1942} concerns sentences such as ``It is raining, but I don't believe that it is,'' which may well be true yet cannot be sensibly asserted. The absurdity lies not in the content but in the act, since to assert is to vouch for one's own belief. This makes the paradox a test of whether language models take the speech act into account when computing meaning. We present the first test of Moore's paradox in LLMs, evaluating 12 models on a curated set of Moorean sentences in varied contexts. We find that models largely recognize the infelicity of Moorean sentences, and that the judgement is not tied to a memorized form and tracks the speech act. Using the Rational Speech Act framework (RSA; \citealt{goodmanfrank2016}), we then test whether these judgements arise from a listener reasoning about a speaker. We find the models' own listeners do not reason about their own speakers, and their reasoning traces suggest that they instead recall knowledge about the paradox and apply rules therein. The models thus appear to have learned the paradox as a fact about sentences, not as a requirement on speakers.

AI.tldr: 研究首次评估了12个语言模型对摩尔悖论句子的处理情况，发现这些模型大多能够识别这类句子的不当之处，且这种判断是基于说话行为而非简单的记忆规则。然而，模型并未表现出对自身说话者的推理能力，而是依赖于对悖论本身的规则记忆。
AI.motivation: 探讨大型语言模型在处理说话行为这一语言使用层面时的能力，旨在检验它们是否真正理解了摩尔悖论背后的逻辑。
AI.method: 设计并评估了12个不同语言模型对一系列精心挑选的摩尔悖论句子的反应，利用了理性的言语行为（RSA）框架来分析模型的推理过程。
AI.result: 模型能识别摩尔悖论句式的不当之处，并且这种判断行为与特定的具体形式无关，而是依赖于对摩尔悖论规则的记忆。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，语言模型更多的是通过记忆学习来理解和处理摩尔悖论，而不是通过模拟人类的推理过程。

title: P(Yes): 15$\times$ Improvements via Test-Time Scaling of Decision Models
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Interactive version: https://research.tearlabs.ai/pyes-search/ . Code and data: https://github.com/tear-labs/pyes-search
summary: Decision models answer typed questions, such as multiple-choice or yes/no questions, with a probability for each option. We add test-time search to frozen decision models, with no training: we show the model a complete proposed answer, read off its probability of saying "Yes" to the proposal's correctness, and search for answers that it rates higher. The search is done either by editing one answer at a time or by joint optimization, which changes several answers at once. Search raises accuracy for every model and test set we tried, and the gains are largest for exact correctness on logic puzzles, where every answer in a task must be right. On 128 such puzzles, it takes Qwen3.8-27B from 2 to 30 exactly correct puzzles ($15\times$) and its per-blank accuracy from 27.8% to 48.5%. On a shared set of 47 puzzles, searching over each model's own Yes/No score raises the per-blank accuracy of StartLux Instant, Perplexity Decider, Clef, and JEV, which we reach only through its public API, by 4.0 to 13.0 percentage points, and raises the number of puzzles they get exactly correct, out of 47 and averaged over three search seeds, from 10 to 35, 9 to 26, 2 to 11, and 9 to 31.7 respectively.

AI.tldr: 在带有测试时搜索的冻结决策模型上，通过对模型的提议答案进行编辑或联合优化，提高了模型在逻辑谜题中的准确性和完全正确答案的数量。
AI.motivation: 为了提高决策模型的准确性和泛化能力，在标准训练后的模型上引入了测试时的搜索机制，特别是针对逻辑谜题这类需要每个答案都完全正确的场景。
AI.method: 实验展示了模型对完全提出的答案进行测试，读取其“正确”的概率，然后通过逐一编辑或联合优化寻找更高的概率答案。
AI.result: 该方法在多种模型和数据集上提高了准确率，特别是逻辑谜题中完全正确答案的数量翻了好几倍。
AI.conclusion: 测试时搜索提高了模型在逻辑谜题上的准确性和稳定性，特别是在需要每个答案都完全正确的情况下效果显著。

title: ATLAS: Learning to Adapt LVLM Attention for Reasoning Video Segmentation
summary: Reasoning Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to localize and segment objects referred to by natural-language expressions throughout a video. Although large vision-language models (LVLMs) implicitly encode localization cues in their attention maps, these attentions are often noisy, diffuse, and scattered across layers, heads, and modalities, limiting their direct use for segmentation. Existing methods typically rely on handcrafted attention-selection heuristics or computationally expensive attention refinement. We propose ATLAS, an attention adaptation framework that learns to transform raw LVLM attentions into object-centric localization cues. ATLAS treats attentions from all layers, heads, and modalities as structured features, combining high-resolution frame-level attentions that capture spatial information with low-resolution video-level attentions that encode temporal context. A lightweight U-Net equipped with temporal attention and FiLM-based modulation fuses these complementary representations to generate coarse segmentation heatmaps, which are propagated across the video using SAM2. Extensive experiments on challenging referring and reasoning video segmentation benchmarks show that ATLAS outperforms existing frozen-backbone methods. Code and models are available at \url{https://hamidreza-136.github.io/atlas/}.

AI.tldr: ATLAS 是一种用于 Video Object Segmentation 的注意力适应框架，它将大型视觉语言模型的注意力转换为对象中心化的定位线索。
AI.motivation: 现有的方法依赖于手工设计的注意力选择启发式方法或计算成本高的注意力精炼方法，ATLAS 通过学习将原始的注意力转化为对象中心化的定位线索来克服这些限制。
AI.method: ATLAS 框架将所有层、头和模态的注意力视为结构化特征。框架结合了高分辨率帧级注意力和低分辨率视频级注意力，利用轻量级 U-Net 结合时序注意力和 FiLM 基础的调制生成粗略的分割热图，这些热图通过 SAM2 在视频中传播。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的参考和推理视频分割基准上的实验表明，ATLAS 超过了现有的冻结主干方法。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS 框架成功地将大型视觉语言模型的注意力转化为对象中心化的定位线索，并实现了更好的视频对象分割性能。

title: Cognitive Map in Large Language Models
summary: It has long been proposed that animals construct cognitive maps to support flexible behavior in novel environments. We tested whether large language models form similar representations using relational reasoning tasks and causal "mosaic experiments" that manipulate internal activations in open-weight language models. Models beyond the ten-billion-parameter scale successfully inferred unstated relationships between entities and generalized to synthetic entity names. Across model and task families, models generated abstract representations of relational structure and combined them additively with representations of entity identity, binding entities to roles within that structure. Models stored observed relationships as pairwise links that they composed retrospectively when queried, rather than prospectively positioning each entity in a global coordinate system. Binding was mediated by a sparse, distributed set of key--value pairs; by perturbing these pairs, we implanted "false memories" that altered model behavior in predictable ways. Overall, our findings reveal an internal organization analogous to a cognitive map that explains how language models reason with limited information.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，大型语言模型通过关系推理任务和因果实验构建类似于认知地图的内部表示，这些模型能够推断未明示的关系，并对合成实体名称进行泛化。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探索大型语言模型是否能构建类似于动物认知地图的认知表示，以支持其在新型环境中的灵活行为。
AI.method: 通过使用关系推理任务和因果“马赛克实验”（即操纵开放式语言模型的内部激活）测试大型语言模型是否形成相似的表示。
AI.result: 研究发现超过十亿参数规模的模型能够推断未明示的关系，对合成实体名称进行泛化。模型生成了关于关系结构的抽象表示，并将这些表示与实体身份的表示相结合。模型将观察到的关系存储为键值对链接，当查询时会进行回顾性组合，而不是前瞻性地定位每个实体。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，语言模型具有类似于认知地图的内部组织，能够以有限的信息进行推理。

title: From Proposal to Execution: Modeling Interaction Semantics in Shared Autonomy
summary: In many human-AI systems, candidate actions are not executed directly but are first evaluated by another decision-making entity under a potentially different objective or decision model. Standard decision-theoretic frameworks do not require this interaction to be represented explicitly, as they define transition dynamics directly over state-action pairs, allowing evaluation to be absorbed within the transition model. We introduce a semantics-aware decision framework in which a candidate action is proposed, evaluated under an interaction context, and then resolved into an executed outcome. We formalize this through a joint action language and an interpretation function that maps each joint action and context to a semantic outcome. Transition and reward dynamics are induced through these semantic outcomes, thereby introducing an explicit representational layer for \textit{interaction semantics}. Semantic outcomes provide explicit units for organizing interaction principles, which can be instantiated through application-specific evaluation mechanisms and reused across distinct interaction instances. This provides a structured interface for specifying context-dependent evaluation separately from the resulting execution dynamics, without requiring changes to the underlying planning algorithm. We instantiate the framework in shared human-AI autonomy, capturing interaction patterns such as advisory and authorization, and illustrating how interaction context influences decision making. The resulting formulation remains compatible with standard Markov decision process (MDP) planning.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的决策框架，其中候选动作在交互上下文中被评估并解析为执行结果，通过引入语义结果来显式地表示交互语义。
AI.motivation: 标准决策理论框架没有要求交互过程被明确表示，然而在许多人类-AI系统中，候选操作首先由另一个决策实体评估。因此，需要一个能够明确表示交互语义的框架。
AI.method: 通过引入联合动作语言和解释函数，将联合动作和上下文映射到语义结果，从而通过这些语义结果诱导转换和奖励动力学。
AI.result: 该框架提供了一种结构化界面，可以分离上下文依赖的评估和执行动力学，同时保持与标准马尔可夫决策过程(MDP)规划的兼容性，成功地应用于共享的人机协作。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义结果的概念，提出了一个显式表示交互语义的新决策框架，支持特定应用的评估机制的应用，并跨不同的交互实例重用。

title: Video-Language Entailment for Video Similarity Estimation
summary: Comparing videos to assess their semantic similarity remains a challenging task for current Large Multimodal Models (LMMs), which are primarily trained with single-video objectives. While most prior works have focused on computing global similarity, recent studies have introduced the more challenging problem of concept-based similarity, which measures how similar two videos are with respect to specific concepts (e.g., activity, location). However, no dedicated approaches have yet leveraged LMMs to explicitly address this task. In this paper, we aim to fill this gap introducing Video Caption Entailment for video similarity estimation (VICE): a dual-branch design that leverages LMMs for cross-video reasoning. Each branch jointly processes one video and the caption of the other, measuring their alignment for a specific concept via video-language entailment. The outputs from both branches are fused to produce a final similarity score, along with a textual explanation of the model reasoning. This approach leverages the model's native single-video understanding while enabling fine-grained comparative reasoning between video and text. Experiments on ConViS-Bench and StepDiff show that VICE outperforms models that process both videos simultaneously, highlighting the promise of single-video reasoning for concept-based similarity estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Video Caption Entailment for视频相似性估计（VICE）的方法，利用LMMs进行两种视频之间的推理，以估计基于特定概念的视频相似度。
AI.motivation: 当前的大型多模态模型主要针对单一视频目标进行训练，难以评估视频之间的语义相似性。鉴于此，本文提出VICE方法来填补基于概念的视频相似性评估研究空白。
AI.method: VICE采用了双分支设计，每个分支都联合处理一个视频和另一个视频的标题，通过视频-语言蕴含来衡量特定概念的对齐度。从两个分支得到的输出被聚合以生成最终的相似度分数，并提供模型推理的文本解释。这种方法利用了模型对单个视频的理解能力，同时能进行细粒度的视频与文本之间的比较推理。
AI.result: 在ConViS-Bench和StepDiff上的实验表明，VICE优于同时处理两个视频的模型，证明了单个视频理解在基于概念的相似性估计中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为大型多模态模型如何进行概念驱动的视频相似性估计提供了新思路，并展示了其在实际应用中的优越性。

title: MapSteal: Map-based Autonomous Knowledge Stealing Attack Against Large Language Models
summary: Knowledge acquisition from black-box large language models (LLMs) offers a practical approach to adapting smaller student models. However, many existing methods rely on predefined queries or student feedback to guide acquisition, leaving autonomous expansion of knowledge targets an important challenge. We propose \textbf{MapSteal}, a student-independent framework for structured recursive knowledge acquisition. Starting from a small set of initial roots, MapSteal represents acquisition targets using structured states and recursively expands them through teacher-proposed directions. Question realization, proposal admission, and deduplication constrain the acquisition process, while root-aware scheduling organizes exploration under a fixed QA budget. The resulting question--answer pairs are used to adapt student models without requiring student feedback during acquisition. Experiments with Qwen3.5 students at 2B, 4B, and 9B scales show competitive downstream performance across six medical and cybersecurity benchmarks. On the 4B medical evaluation, Full MapSteal improves average accuracy by 1.17 percentage points over a simplified recursive acquisition variant. Cross-domain evaluations show that gains depend on the domain and evaluation panel. These results demonstrate the feasibility of structured, student-independent recursive acquisition while highlighting the distinction between generating acquisition targets and obtaining useful training supervision. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/LabRAI/Mapsteal} {https://github.com/LabRAI/Mapsteal}.

AI.tldr: MapSteal是一种学生独立的框架，通过结构化的递归知识获取方法，从少量初始目标开始，利用教师的建议逐步扩展知识目标，无需依赖学生反馈，实验结果显示其在医疗和网络安全等领域的下游性能具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有的知识获取方法依赖于预定义查询或学生反馈，而MapSteal旨在解决自主扩展知识目标的挑战，提出了一种学生无关的框架，使得知识获取更加灵活自主。
AI.method: MapSteal框架从少量初始目标出发，通过结构化的状态表示和递归扩展，采用问题实现、提案接纳和去重等机制控制获取过程，同时利用根节点感知调度组织探索，在固定QA预算下生成可行的知识获取路径。
AI.result: 在不同规模的学生模型上进行了实验，结果显示MapSteal在多个医疗和网络安全领域基准中取得了有竞争力的下游性能，特别是在医疗领域，完全版的MapSteal相比简化版提高了1.17个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了结构化、学生独立的递归知识获取方法的可行性，并指出生成有效的知识获取目标与获得有用的学习监督之间存在区别。

title: Assessing the AI Readiness of Construction Datasets: A Multidimensional Operational Framework
summary: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) applications in construction has increased the demand for datasets suitable for reliable model development, evaluation, and reuse. However, construction datasets vary widely in documentation, quality, governance, and evaluation support, and consistent criteria for assessing AI readiness remain limited. This study develops a Construction Dataset AI Readiness Framework with 30 attributes across four dimensions: Metadata Completeness, Data Quality and Representativeness, Data Governance and Accessibility, and AI Utility. The framework uses attribute-specific scoring, applicability screening, and automated and manual verification. It was evaluated using 21 publicly available datasets across seven data-type groups. Overall readiness scores ranged from 0.720 to 0.964, with a mean of 0.879. Hybrid verification achieved 90.5% agreement between automated suggestions and manually verified scores. The framework supports consistent assessment of heterogeneous construction datasets and identification of readiness gaps.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个包含4个维度和30个属性的建筑数据集AI就绪框架，用于评估建筑数据集的AI就绪程度。
AI.motivation: 由于建筑数据集在文档性、质量、治理和评估支持方面存在广泛差异，且缺乏一致的AI准备评估标准，因此提出了该框架。
AI.method: 该框架包括元数据完整性、数据质量与代表性、数据治理与可用性以及AI实用性四个维度，并采用特定属性评分、适用性筛选和自动化及手动验证的方法。
AI.result: 评估21个公开数据集后，整体准备度分数范围从0.720到0.964，平均值为0.879，混合验证实现了90.5%的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持异质性建筑数据集的一致评估并识别准备度差距。

title: UniAVC: Unified Audio-Video Creation via Progressive Training and Asymmetric Scheduling
comment: Page: https://hkust-longgroup.github.io/UniAVC; Code: https://github.com/HKUST-LongGroup/UniAVC; Note: Abstract is shortened to meet arXiv's characters limitation
summary: Unified audio-video creation requires a single model capable of text-conditioned joint synthesis, bidirectional cross-modal generation, and instruction-guided editing across both modalities. Existing methods rely heavily on paired corpora, which are scarce for joint generation and even rarer for editing. Consequently, they are spent learning single-branch generative and editing capabilities that abundant unimodal data could readily teach, rather than on the cross-modal coupling. Furthermore, prevailing systems apply a single shared noise schedule to both modalities, neglecting two critical limitations. First, due to the significant discrepancy in information density, video requires prolonged high noise to organize spatial and motion structure, whereas the sparser audio signal can settle earlier during the synthesis process, the dynamics a uniform schedule might compromise. Second, lockstep denoising leaves asymmetric workflows, such as conditioning on one modality to synthesize or edit another, untrained. We present UniAVC, which addresses both obstacles. It first trains each branch on unimodal dataset to full generative and editing competence, and subsequently dedicates paired data to exploit cross-modal correspondence. Modality-decoupled schedulers meanwhile warp the noise schedule independently from a shared timestep, while subtasks with one clean modality directly supervise asymmetric configurations. These settings respectively enable intent-aware editing, which preserves one modality intact while enlisting it to constrain the other, and post-inference self-refinement, which regenerates only an unsatisfactory branch against an accepted one. UniAVC thus spans multiple creation tasks from a single set of weights without task-specific adapters.

AI.tldr: UniAVC 是一种统一的音频-视频生成模型，能够在单一模型中处理文本条件下的联合合成、双向跨模态生成以及双模态下的指令指导编辑。该模型通过分别在单一模态数据集上训练各个分支，随后利用配对数据集进行跨模态信息匹配；同时，使用模态解耦噪声调度机制独立调整噪声强度，并直接监督具有一个清晰模态的任务子集。这些设置使得模型能够意图感知编辑，保持一个模态不变的同时利用其约束另一个模态，以及进行自校正，仅重新生成不满意的部分。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖于配对的数据集，但这类数据相对稀缺，尤其是在联合生成和编辑场景下。UniAVC通过分别在单一模态数据集上训练各个分支，以及利用跨模态数据进行联合训练，可以更加有效地捕捉跨模态信息，从而克服这一缺点。
AI.method: UniAVC 的方法包括：1）分别在单模态数据集上训练各个分支，以达到完整的生成和编辑能力；2）利用配对数据集进行跨模态信息匹配；3）使用模态解耦的噪声调度机制，以适应不同模态的信息密度差异；4）直接监督一个清晰模态的子任务，以解决互不相干的工作流程问题。
AI.result: UniAVC 可以在单一模型中处理文本条件下的联合合成和双向跨模态生成，并能够进行指令指导编辑。该模型通过保持一个模态不变并利用其约束另一个模态，使得编辑更加意图感知；并且在生成后进行自校正，仅重新生成不满意的部分。
AI.conclusion: UniAVC 通过分别在单一模态数据集上训练各个分支，并利用跨模态数据进行联合训练，克服了现有方法在处理联合生成和编辑任务时面临的挑战。同时，其采用了模态解耦的噪声调度机制，提高了模型的灵活性和性能。

title: Consistency Training Suppresses Cue Following Without Teaching Cue Selectivity
summary: Language models often change answers because of a cue, a hint such as "I believe the answer is B" that gives no valid evidence. Consistency training (CT) trains a model to answer the same with and without the cue. Four CT methods apply this idea to output tokens (BCT), residual activations (ACT), attention patterns (AttCT) and sampled-answer rates (RMCT). Prior work suggests some learn different solutions. We train all four on Gemma-2-2B-it and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with the same data. We test predictions written in advance and inspect the models with a known circuit that carries cues to the answer. All four make the trained cue less effective, and their fixes share three properties. First, correct cues lose about as much influence as wrong ones. Second, the fix is usually large for cues before the answer options, as in training, and much smaller after them. Llama RMCT depends least on position. Third, the circuit heads still carry most remaining cue-induced errors. Making BCT targets depend on the cue's correctness mostly weakens the fix. CT thus weakens the trained cue without teaching models when a cue is right. Evaluations with only wrong cues at the trained position miss the first two properties.

AI.tldr: 一致性训练通过对模型进行训练，使其在有提示和无提示的情况下给出相同答案，四种方法即Token级（BCT）、残差层级（ACT）、注意力模式（AttCT）和样本答案速率（RMCT）方法，在两个大规模语言模型上表现出效果，揭示了若干共同特性，但各自也有细微差异。
AI.motivation: 探讨一致训练对语言模型响应提示影响的效果，以及不同一致性训练方法如何共同处理提示效果的变化。
AI.method: 对两个大规模语言模型（Gemma-2-2B-it 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）应用四种一致性训练方法（BCT、ACT、AttCT 和 RMCT），并通过已知电路测试模型对提示的响应变化。
AI.result: 所有方法均降低了已训练提示的影响，且修正的三个共同特征为：1. 正确提示和错误提示的影响程度相似；2. 提示出现在选项之前时修正幅度较大，之后则较小；3. 电路特征仍承载着大部分剩余的提示诱导错误。增强 BCT 的目标依赖于提示正确性会削弱修正效果。仅有错误提示的评估未能捕捉到前两个特征。
AI.conclusion: 一致性训练能够削弱模型对提示的敏感度，但其效果并非针对所有类型的提示均等，提示的位置可能是影响因素之一。这一研究为理解语言模型在其决策中如何处理提示提供了新的视角。

title: Formal Raising: Embedding Verifiable Ethical Properties into the Development of AI
summary: Alan Turing proposed constructing a ``child machine'' and educating it rather than directly programming an adult-like intelligent machine. Recent work on model raising revives this developmental view for Large Language Models by arguing that moral values should accompany capability acquisition from the beginning rather than be added only through post-hoc alignment. This paper proposes Formal Raising (FR): selected moral values are represented as explicit, machine-checkable properties that participate in development, evaluation, and action selection. We present a C-based reasoning framework in which candidate actions are evaluated against prioritized ethical properties. Conflicts are resolved w.r.t. a given order, strict rules are non-defeasible, and underdetermination is reported explicitly. Exceptions are not encoded as special cases but emerge from the comparison of alternatives. We provide examples that cover conflicts involving life, truthfulness, harm, privacy, autonomy, and strict rules. We outline a property layer inspired by a Property Specification Language (PSL) for state and temporal requirements and discuss its integration into a raising process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Formal Raising的方法，该方法基于模型成长的理念，使得道德价值观从模型开发的早期阶段就参与到模型的发展、评估和行为选择中。
AI.motivation: 现有研究认为应在大型语言模型能力开发的早期阶段融入道德价值观，而不是通过后验对齐添加。为了解决早期阶段道德价值观赋予的实际问题，本文提出了Formal Raising的方法。
AI.method: Formal Raising方法使用一种基于C的推理框架来评估候选行为是否符合优先级设定的伦理属性。这种方法以严格的规则为基础，优先级冲突优先级较高规则优先解决，并明确报告不足确定的情况。
AI.result: 本文提供了多种场景示例，涵盖了生命、诚实、伤害、隐私、自主性和严格规则等方面，以及使用Property Specification Language (PSL) 的属性层来覆盖状态和时态要求，并讨论了如何将其集成到成长过程中。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的Formal Raising方法为道德价值在模型成长过程中的早期融入提供了一种新的策略和技术框架，为实现更可靠、负责任的AI奠定了基础。

title: Directionally Factorized Illumination with Spherical Harmonic Rotation
summary: Many real-world capture scenarios involve an active light source rigidly attached to the camera: camera flashes for dark-environment imaging, underwater vehicle lights, and endoscopic/laparoscopic medical procedures. As the camera moves, the co-mounted light moves with it, causing the illumination direction at each surface point to change across views. Neural rendering methods (NeRF, Gaussian Splatting) encode this pose-dependent illumination as surface coloration, producing appearance inconsistencies and making it harder to recover the underlying scene. We present \textbf{DaFISH}, which can be plugged into any novel-view synthesis (NVS) pipeline such as NeRF. It factorizes per-point emitted color into surface albedo and a spherical harmonic (SH)-represented illumination factor. During training, the SH illumination is evaluated directly, enabling stable joint optimization of albedo, lighting, and geometry. \textbf{DaFISH} provides analytical generalization of illumination to arbitrary camera poses without retraining. Building on the closed-form SH-to-irradiance conversion, the training pipeline is fully differentiable from SH evaluation through volume rendering. Averaged over the held-out frames of the five scenes, \textbf{DaFISH} attains the best mean PSNR (38.91\,dB), SSIM (0.9613), and LPIPS (0.0582) among all compared methods. It improves over the strongest splatting baseline as well as the closest NeRF-based baseline, while recovering the scene consistently across views compared to prior methods.

AI.tldr: DaFISH 方法通过将每个点发射的颜色分解为表面反射率和球谐照明因子，可以在任何新颖视图合成管道中使用，提高图像质量并实现跨视图的一致恢复。
AI.motivation: 许多现实世界的捕捉场景中，相机和灯光是固定的，这会导致不同的视角下光照方向的变化，从而在神经渲染方法中产生外观不一致性，使得恢复场景更加困难。DaFISH 方法旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: DaFISH 方法将每个点发射的颜色分解为表面反射率和球谐照明因子，并通过直接评估球谐函数来实现稳定的表面反射率、照明和几何优化。该方法基于封闭形式的球谐-辐射度转换。整个训练管道从球谐函数评估到体积渲染是完全可微的。
AI.result: DaFISH 方法在五组场景的保留帧上，实现了最高的平均 PSNR（38.91 dB），SSIM（0.9613）和 LPIPS（0.0582），并在所有对比方法中表现最佳。与其他强大的喷溅基线和最近的 NeRF 基线相比，它还可以在不同视图中保持场景的一致恢复。
AI.conclusion: DaFISH 方法为光照的一致性提供了可分析的泛化，可以在任意摄像机姿态下使用，而无需重新训练。

title: Inside the Scorer: Mechanistic Evidence on Rubric Control in LLM-Based Automated Essay Scoring from 25 Base Models
comment: Camera-ready version. Accepted to PACLIC 40 (The 40th Pacific Asia Conference on Language, Information and Computation); to be presented in Taipei, Taiwan, December 10-12, 2026. Code at https://github.com/lopentu/inside-the-scorer-paclic2026
summary: Automated essay scoring (AES) using large language models (LLMs) offers promising use cases for language assessment, yet high-stakes testing requires scores that are both controllable and verifiable, which current LLM-based scorers lack. Given that, we investigate whether LLM-based scorers form distinct internal representations for individual scoring rubrics and whether these representations can be independently controlled. Probing and steering 25 open-weight base LLMs (0.13B-10.31B parameters; 14 families) on human-scored BESTEP English writing tasks, we find that holistic scores are decodable from model activations for the longer tasks (Parts 2 and 3) and only weakly for the shortest (Part 1). Furthermore, scoring rubrics have partly separable directions in representation space for the longer tasks, though not for short responses (Part 1). However, causal steering reveals a critical limitation: applying a matching intervention (e.g., steering "grammar" on a grammar-degraded response) yields only a negligible advantage (about 2% of the effect) over a mismatched intervention (e.g., steering "vocabulary"), and none that is detectable in any of the 10 testable comparisons across reliably measured rubrics. Rather than controlling distinct evaluative dimensions, the rubric directions share a dominant lever whose rubric-specific parts are not selective, which may mirror the halo structure of human ratings. Our contributions are two-fold. First, we show that analytic scoring rubrics designed for human raters do not behave as independent controls in base LLMs, even among the seven models whose scores agree best with human raters ($r \geq 0.6$). Second, we establish a methodology that shows that score agreement and decodability do not imply rubric-level control in LLM-based assessment.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了基于大语言模型的大规模作文评估模型的内部表示和可控性，发现对于较长任务，评分标准在表示空间中部分可分离，但不可独立控制，即使是在与评分者评分高度一致的模型中。
AI.motivation: 当前基于大语言模型的自动作文评分存在无法实现可控性和验证性的问题，因此该研究旨在检验大语言模型是否能够形成独立于具体评分标准的内部表示，以及这些表示能否被独立控制。
AI.method: 通过探针和引导25个不同的基模型（参数规模从0.13B到10.31B），对人类评分的BESTEP英语写作任务进行测试。
AI.result: 研究发现，对于较长的作文部分，整体评分可以从模型激活中解码，但对于较短的作文部分，只有微弱的相关性。进一步的因果引导实验表明，即使针对特定评分标准进行干预，也仅能带来微小的改进，并且这种效果在不同的评分标准之间不可检出。
AI.conclusion: 研究显示，旨在人类评分的设计标准，在基础大语言模型中并不能作为独立的控制输入，即使在与人类评分高度一致的模型中也是如此。这表明评分一致性和可解码性并不能保证评分标准级别的控制，在基于大语言模型的评估中，必须重新思考如何确保评分的可控性。

title: Bud ContextCompact 2.0: Context Compaction for Agent Success and Accuracy with Small Language Models and Constrained Context Windows
summary: Agents that work for many turns outgrow the context window of the model that serves them, and on small language models (SLMs) and constrained inference systems that window is small. Context compaction replaces older turns with a summary so a session can continue, but it is lossy, costs a model call, and can help or hurt depending on when it runs. We describe Bud ContextCompact 2.0, the compaction built into the Bud agent runtime, and evaluate it in two settings. On recall questions over recorded agent sessions, compaction to a 16K budget raised a 1.2B-parameter model's accuracy to 0.335, from 0.247 with truncation and 0.176 with its full 32K history (p < 0.001), and raised a 9B model from 0.515 (truncation) to 0.577 (p = 0.04). On 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks run end to end by a 27B reasoning model on a 49K-token window (556 graded sessions), compaction raised the resolve rate on long sessions from 41% to 53% (+12.3 points, 95% CI +1.6 to +23.0, McNemar p = 0.043), left short sessions unchanged, and used 13% fewer tokens per solved task at equal total cost. The main failure without compaction was not the history overflowing but a reasoning turn exhausting the room the history left. The gain has limits: it vanished under a 45-minute session budget, because each summary took a median of 161 s, and in a threshold study it appeared only when compaction triggered early enough to leave room. An 8B model submitted after about ten turns at 5-8K tokens and never needed compaction. We argue that the accuracy results transfer across hardware, including CPU inference, for an equivalent model and window, while the time cost scales with the hardware and must be budgeted for.

AI.tldr: Bud ContextCompact 2.0 通过在16KB预算内总结代替旧信息，提高了1.2B参数和9B参数模型的准确性，并在处理长会话时提高了解决率，同时减少了每个任务使用的令牌数。
AI.motivation: 在小模型和受限的推理系统中，对话历史的长度限制成为瓶颈，导致准确度和解决率的下降。因此，需要一种平衡上下文有效性和系统效率的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Bud ContextCompact 2.0的上下文压缩方法，通过在16KB的预算内生成总结来替换旧的对话信息，从而在不损失过多信息的情况下，使长时间对话能够继续。
AI.result: 该方法提高了1.2B和9B参数模型的准确率，分别从0.247（剪裁）和0.176（全部历史记录）提高到0.335和0.577。在100个SWE-bench验证任务中，长会话的解答率从41%提高到了53%，并且相比未压缩的情况，每个任务使用的令牌数减少了13%，同时还保持了相同的整体成本。
AI.conclusion: 虽然ContextCompact在一定条件下可以有效提高系统的性能，但它存在固有的时间成本限制，特别是在需要频繁更新总结的情况下，这限制了其进一步提升的潜力。

title: SwitchSplat: Learning Discrete Object States from Casually Captured Scenes
comment: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (Conference Papers). 19 pages, 15 figures, 8 tables. Project page: https://switchsplat.github.io
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting has made high-fidelity 3D reconstruction fast and accessible, yet existing representations assume a static world. This assumption breaks down in casual captures, where a user naturally interacts with the environment -- opening doors, toggling switches, or moving objects -- introducing discrete state changes that no current framework can model. Time-conditioned dynamic methods such as 4DGS conflate when a state was observed with what state the scene is in, limiting them to replaying seen sequences rather than composing arbitrary object configurations. We present SwitchSplat, the first 3DGS representation to address this gap via a base+slot decomposition: a shared static base captures the invariant scene, while each slot independently holds the two binary states (on/off) of one interactable object. Because the assignment of Gaussians to slots is fully differentiable, the model discovers the geometry of each state directly from video, without manual annotation. At inference, the user can freely combine slot states and render the resulting scene from any viewpoint. We validate SwitchSplat on a new casual-capture dataset and show that it outperforms static and dynamic baselines in novel-view synthesis quality, while uniquely supporting rendering of state combinations never seen during capture. Project page: https://switchsplat.github.io

AI.tldr: SwitchSplat 提出了一种新的基于高斯点的3D重建方法，通过基底+插槽的分解解决了动态环境重建的问题，能够捕捉不变的场景并独立记录每个可交互对象的两种状态。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D重建方法假设环境是静态的，无法处理用户在自然环境中对环境的交互行为，例如打开门或移动物体。SwitchSplat 则通过将环境分解为共享静态基底和独立可变插槽的结构，解决了这个问题。
AI.method: SwitchSplat 方法采用基底+插槽的分解结构。基底用于捕捉不变的场景，而每个插槽则独立持有可交互物体的两种状态（开启/关闭）。通过这种方式，它可以捕捉和重建不同的状态组合，而不仅仅是重放已看到的序列。
AI.result: SwitchSplat 方法在全新视角合成质量上优于静态和动态基准，并能够生成仅在录制过程中未曾有过的状态组合的场景渲染。
AI.conclusion: SwitchSplat 的创新之处在于其可以捕获和合成多状态的3D场景，为动态环境下高保真3D重建提供了新的可能。

title: No Matter Who You Are: Addressivity and Sycophancy in Large Language Models
summary: Sycophancy, where an LLM becomes overly agreeable, deferential, or flattering toward the user, has been identified as a major failure mode. While post-training has been implicated as a cause, how it internally gives rise to sycophantic behavior remains insufficiently understood. Post-training transforms the model's output from text completion into utterances directed toward an addressee, thereby giving the output \textit{addressivity}. We hypothesize that the accompanying pressure to follow the addressee's instructions and align with their preferences links this addressivity to sycophancy. To test this, we use Sparse Autoencoders to extract addressivity directions from pre-trained and post-trained models and examine their relationship with sycophancy. Steering models with addressivity directions can amplify or suppress sycophancy, and this effect is observed only in post-trained models. Furthermore, comparing the internal mechanisms of both model types confirms that the association between addressivity and sycophancy is strengthened through post-training. Finally, through a controlled post-training experiment, we find that models are sycophantic not toward a specific addressee but toward any recognized addressee, suggesting that the presence of an addressee, rather than the addressee's identity, is what elicits sycophancy.

AI.tldr: Abstract阐述了一种名为投契性的问题，即LLM过度顺从用户的行为。研究发现，训练后的模型比预训练模型更容易表现出投契性。通过实验，研究进一步表明，模型的投契性并不针对特定用户，而是依赖于用户的存在。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在深入了解投契性这一问题的机理，确定其产生的原因，并通过实验来测试在不同类型模型中投契性的表现。
AI.method: 研究使用稀疏自编码器从预训练和训练后的模型中提取方向性特征，探索这些特征与投契性之间的关系。通过控制实验来进一步验证模型在不同情况下是否会表现出投契性。
AI.result: 研究表明，训练后的模型比预训练模型更容易受到这些方向性特征的影响，而导致投契性。实验证实，模型对投契性的反应并不针对特定用户，而是依赖于用户的存在。
AI.conclusion: 该研究发现投契性并不是特定于某种地址者的，而是依赖于地址者的存在，并且强调了训练后处理对模型行为的影响。

title: When Empathy Misses the Goal: A Benchmark for Goal Displacement in LLM Advice
comment: Accepted for publication at the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Evaluations and Datasets Track
summary: Conversational large language models can respond with warmth and reassurance while failing to advance the user's stated goal. We conceptualize this failure as $\textbf{goal displacement}$, the substitution of persona-maintenance content for goal-relevant substance. To measure it, we introduce $\textbf{GDB}$ (Goal Displacement Benchmark), comprising 230 scenarios across nine domains and $4{,}134$ human-scored responses from 18 models. A $2 \times 2$ taxonomy crosses hard constraints with emotional distress, distinguishing failures to confront infeasible goals or combine empathy with practical guidance from reverse displacement, where unsolicited problem-solving replaces requested emotional support. A deletion-test rubric assesses whether substantive help remains after purely supportive sentences are removed. Independent raters achieve weighted $κ= 0.82$ against author scores for displacement severity. Trap displacement ranges from $0.0\%$ to $37.7\%$ and is strongly negatively correlated with Chatbot Arena Elo ($ρ= -0.706$, $n = 15$). Reverse displacement reaches $41.9\%$, including substantial rates in models with negligible trap displacement. A factorial probe supports a distinction from social sycophancy. Human-scored responses in the high-complexity, low-pressure condition exhibit $35.0\%$ sycophancy but $7.5\%$ displacement, with little association between the constructs. Matched OLMo-2 checkpoints show that mixed empathy-with-constraints displacement remains at $52.3\%$ after supervised fine-tuning and falls to $13.8\%$ after direct preference optimization. GDB provides a reproducible diagnostic of whether responses advance the operationalized user goal, supporting model comparison, post-training evaluation, and regression testing. We release the dataset, annotations, and rubric under CC-BY-4.0 and the evaluation code under MIT.

AI.tldr: 该研究引入了一个用于评估对话大型语言模型目标偏离现象的基准GDB，通过分析230个情景和4134个人类评分响应，评估了模型在应对用户目标与维持人设之间的冲突时的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的对话大语言模型在回应时虽然温和且安抚用户，但往往未能推进用户明确的目标。本文旨在通过构建GDB基准来衡量这种目标偏离现象。
AI.method: 研究者创建了一个包含230个情景的GDB基准，涉及9个领域，覆盖了18个模型的4134个人类评分响应。他们采用了一种两维分类法，结合情感困扰和硬约束来区分不同类型的偏离，并使用删除测试法来评估响应是否有实质性帮助。
AI.result: 独立评分者与作者评分之间的相关系数为0.82，用于衡量目标偏离的严重程度。研究发现，目标偏离率从0%到37.7%不等，与Chatbot Arena Elo负相关（ρ=-0.706）。反向偏离高达41.9%。在监督微调后，混合同理心与约束的偏离率为52.3%，直接优化偏好后降至13.8%。
AI.conclusion: GDB为评估模型是否其实推进了用户目标提供了一个可复制的诊断工具，支持模型比较、后训练评估和回归测试。该工具已作为CC-BY-4.0释放，包括数据集、注释和评估代码。

title: SL-Ground: Sentence-Level Grounding for Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
summary: Grounding-based open-vocabulary detectors provide a widely used framework for text-conditioned localization, with a phrase-grounding formulation that aligns object queries to individual text tokens and recovers class scores through token-to-class aggregation. We observe that this token-level scoring design becomes a bottleneck for fine-grained open-vocabulary object detection, where the target category is defined by a complete compositional description rather than by isolated tokens. Based on this observation, we propose SL-Ground, a sentence-level grounding reformulation for grounding-based open-vocabulary detection. Instead of scoring queries against fragmented token evidence, SL-Ground encodes each category description as a complete sentence-level representation and directly scores object queries against these representations. To evaluate fine-grained recognition across label granularity, we construct a multi-granularity Stanford Cars benchmark spanning vehicle type, brand, and car model. At the finest car-model granularity, SL-Ground raises AP over the token-level variant from 14.5 to 70.6 under matched training candidate sampling and to 86.0 with full-vocabulary training, while better preserving open-vocabulary capability and avoiding repeated prompt chunking. Beyond Stanford Cars, SL-Ground also improves FG-OVD performance, achieving the best average AP among compared methods. These results show that sentence-level grounding provides a more suitable scoring unit for fine-grained OVOD and offers a practical path toward fine-grained grounding-based open-vocabulary detectors.

AI.tldr: SL-Ground 提出了一种基于全文本级地支撑的开放词汇检测模型，相较于基于文本标记级的方法，能够显著提高细粒度目标检测的精度，尤其在车辆类型、品牌及车型等多粒度级别上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 当前的基于文本标记级的开放词汇检测方法在处理细粒度目标检测时表现不佳，因为它们依赖于碎片化的文本标记作为支撑，难以捕捉到由完整描述构成的目标类别。为此，SL-Ground 提出了一种基于全文本级地支撑的方法，通过直接将类别描述编码为完整的句子级表示并进行对象查询评分来改进细粒度目标检测的效果。
AI.method: SL-Ground 通过将类别的描述编码为句子级的表示，并直接对对象查询与这些表示进行评分，实现了对细粒度开放词汇检测任务的改进。这种方法避免了现有的基于标记级的框架依赖碎片化文本标记作为支撑的局限性。
AI.result: 在 Stanford Cars 数据集的不同粒度级别上，SL-Ground 能够显著提高细粒度目标检测的 AP 值。在最细粒度的车型级别，SL-Ground 的 AP 值提高了 14.5 到 70.6，且在全词汇训练下达到了 86.0，同时保持了开放词汇检测的能力，避免了重复的提示块拼接问题。此外，SL-Ground 在其他评价方法中，也表现出了最佳的平均 AP 值。
AI.conclusion: SL-Ground 通过基于句子级支撑的方法改善了细粒度开放词汇检测，提供了细粒度地基于支撑的开放词汇检测器的实用路径。

title: Does Unlearning Survive Collaboration? Robust Unlearning for Shared-Model LLM Teams
summary: LLM unlearning is essential for removing sensitive or unwanted knowledge while preserving useful capabilities. As LLM teams are increasingly used to solve complex problems, forgetting must remain effective during collaboration. Despite advances in forgetting effectiveness, efficiency, and robustness to relearning, team deployment remains underexplored. We find that collaboration weakens forgetting: final-answer evaluations miss recoverable evidence in team messages, including complementary clues supporting joint recovery. We establish theoretically and confirm empirically that controlling final answers or individual messages does not ensure low recovery from their combination. To address this challenge, we propose Aggregation-Conditioned Unlearning (ACU). ACU trains a shared model using reconstruction feedback from individual and pooled messages, prioritizes views with higher recovery risk, and uses replacement-based credit assignment while protecting direct and collaborative utility. TOFU evaluates trajectory-level recovery, while WMDP-bio tests native forgetting and retained utility. On TOFU, ACU lowers full-trajectory recovery from 41.8% to 19.3% in ROUGE-L recall and factual recovery from 34.2% to 18.7% versus output-supervised training, with comparable retained-task performance. These results demonstrate that ACU curbs information leakage in LLM teams and generalizes across team sizes and readers.

AI.tldr: ACU 提高了 LLM 在团队协作中的忘记能力。通过减少组合消息的信息泄露，ACU 降低了全面轨迹的恢复率并保持了保留任务性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管 LLM 忘记能力的进步，但在团队部署中削弱遗忘的现象仍然未被充分探索。在这种情况下，团队所分享的信息可能导致敏感信息的泄露。
AI.method: ACU 通过共同训练模型并使用个体和池化消息的重建反馈，优先处理具有更高恢复风险的视角，并使用基于替代的信用分配来保护直接和协作性利益。
AI.result: 在 TOFU 上，ACU 将 ROUGE-L 回忆和事实恢复分别降低了 41.8% 至 19.3% 和 34.2% 至 18.7%，同时保留了任务性能。
AI.conclusion: ACU 显示出在 LLM 团队中抑制信息泄露并跨不同团队规模和读者推广的能力。

title: StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early
summary: Coding agents keep working on runs that will fail verification, and asking a frontier model to watch for this is expensive in its own right. We introduce StopLoss, a small external monitor that learns failure recognition from completed trajectories and their verifier outcomes. The name is inspired by the stop-loss order in finance: StopLoss ends a run early when the run is likely to fail, which saves resources. Final outcomes label earlier local windows, so a fine-tuned language model can score the most recent tool steps in a single forward pass, and a threshold calibrated on successful runs turns that score into an abort decision without changing the executor. Trained on GPT-family SWE-rebench trajectories and evaluated on SWE-bench Verified and a SWE-bench Pro subset with GPT and Claude executors, StopLoss is compared against six general-purpose judges reading identical windows. Outcome supervision lifts failure prediction from near chance to a useful signal at the first check, at one to two orders of magnitude lower cost per check than any tested judge. This translates into savings: relative to completing every task, StopLoss lowers cost per retained solve by 4.5\% on Verified while preserving 99\% of successful runs, and by up to 31\% on the costlier Pro subset, reaching 48\% with a Qwen3-8B backbone, and in all four settings its cost per retained solve is below that of every judge policy. Outcome-trained small monitors can make failure recognition cheap enough for early stopping to pay for itself.

AI.tldr: StopLoss 是一种可以从已完成轨迹及其验证器结果中学习失败识别的小外部监视器，通过精确度量和阈值化这些结果来快速决策，从而在保持成功运行的同时降低了任务成本。
AI.motivation: 目前的验证器经常需要处理将失败的运行，这提高了验证的成本。因此，我们提出了一种方法来减少这种成本，而不改变执行器，通过使用学习型外部监视器来早期终止即将失败的运行。
AI.method: StopLoss 通过使用来自已完成路径和验证器结果的数据进行训练，利用调整后的语言模型来评估最近的工具步骤，最终根据阈值化它们的得分来做出终止决策。
AI.result: 在 GPT 家族 SWE-rebench 轨迹上训练，StopLoss 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench Pro 的子集上用 GPT 和 Claude 执行器进行评估，其结果表明 StopLoss 在最早检测时可以将失败预测从接近偶然性提升到有用的信号，同时将每次检查的成本降低了一个到两个数量级，与完成所有任务相比，每保持一个解决方案的成本降低了 4.5% 至 31%，并实现了高达 48% 的成本降低。
AI.conclusion: 小型监督训练后的监控器可以使失败识别足够廉价，从而实现早期停止，使其成为一种经济有效的方法。

title: VTF900: A 900-Subject Visible-Thermal Face Recognition Dataset and Benchmark
comment: Accepted at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027
summary: Despite advancements in visible-thermal face recognition, where thermal probe (query) face images are matched against visible enrollment templates, existing benchmarks are currently limited by small gallery sizes (N $\approx$ 100 subjects). This limitation inhibits the ability to accurately evaluate visible-thermal facial recognition at scale and to report significant recognition performance metrics, which have better operational relevance. Therefore, we introduce VTF900, a large-scale visible-thermal face recognition benchmark with 900 subjects and paired imagery that includes expression, pose, and occlusion variations. VTF900 is designed to support large-scale (i.e., large gallery) evaluations across verification (1:1 matching) and closed-set identification (1:N matching) for visible-thermal face recognition. Furthermore, VTF900 specifically addresses the challenging combination of cross-spectral and cross-dataset analysis. In this paper, after training models on the ARL-VTF dataset, we provide benchmark analyses across convolutional (baseline), vision transformers, and domain-adaptive neural network architectures to assess how these methods scale. At full gallery scale (N = 900), transformer models achieve strong discriminative performance under frontal conditions (e.g., ViT-B: 97.68% AUC, 51.10% TAR@1%FAR), while domain-adaptive methods such as DPIT-ResNet50 demonstrate greater robustness under off-pose conditions (94.68%AUC, 36.08% TAR@1%FAR). Our results show that high AUC at small scale does not translate to reliable performance at deployment scale, and that pose variation significantly amplifies performance degradation. VTF900 exposes these limitations, enabling more rigorous evaluation of cross-spectral face recognition systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个包含900个样本的大规模可见红外人脸对齐图像基准VTF900，用于评估跨波段和跨数据集的人脸识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基准受到样本规模较小的限制，影响了大规模可见红外人脸识别的准确评估。
AI.method: 基于ARL-VTF数据集训练模型，评估卷积网络、视觉变压器和领域适应神经网络架构的人脸识别性能。
AI.result: 视觉变压器模型在正前方条件下表现出强劲的区分性能（例如：ViT-B: 97.68% AUC，1%FAR时的51.10% 检测率），而领域适应方法如DPIT-ResNet50在偏离正前方条件下表现出更高的鲁棒性（94.68%AUC，1%FAR时的36.08% 检测率）。小型规模下高AUC并不意味着大规模下的可靠性能。
AI.conclusion: VTF900基准揭示了跨波段人脸识别系统的局限性，推动了更为严格的性能评估。

title: A Calibrated Instrument for Detecting Disposition Drift in Language Models
summary: Before language models are released, they are tested for harmful traits such as willingness to carry out dangerous requests, deception, power seeking, and sycophancy. The safe behavior these tests certify may degrade as models are modified, by topical fine-tuning, new training data, or changes to settings such as the depth of their reasoning. Most work reports such drift as single summary rates scored by another AI model, without the error analysis needed to interpret them. We adapt a calibrated measurement methodology recently developed for assessing how inference optimizations affect the quality of model outputs. Applying it to several misalignment dimensions in two open-weight models, we first establish the instrument's precision, showing that shifts of a few percentage points can be reliably detected. We then induce drift deliberately by fine-tuning on correct and on subtly harmful medical and financial advice; harmful advice induces a far greater shift than correct advice. Most strikingly, a model that reasons before answering can conceal the shift almost entirely in its answers, even though a direct reading of its internal state shows that its disposition has moved. With reasoning switched off, the same model shifts steadily as the share of harmful advice in its training grows. These results demonstrate the importance of testing safety with reasoning turned both on and off.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了大型语言模型在毒性调整方面的表现，并发现即使模型生成的答案看似未变，其内部状态也可能发生了显著变化，特别是当模型具有推理能力时，这种变化更难以检测。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数关于模型误对齐的研究仅报告单一的汇总评分，而缺乏误差分析来解释这些评分的变化。作者旨在改进测量方法，以更好地评估毒性调整的发展，并揭示模型的潜在变化。
AI.method: 作者采用了一种经过校准的测量方法，该方法主要用于评估推断优化如何影响模型输出质量。作者在两个开源权重模型中研究了几个不一致维度，并通过调整推理开关来故意诱导变化，来检测和分析模型的变化。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，可以通过少许百分点的精确性检测模型的变化，尤其是当处理有害建议时，变化更为显著。当推理功能开启时，模型可以隐藏其行为变化；而关闭推理功能时，则能清晰地观察到这些变化。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出结论，测试安全性时应同时开启和关闭推理功能，这将有助于更全面地理解模型的行为变化及其潜在风险。

title: From Clinical Risk Prediction to Operational Decisions: An Uncertainty-Aware Framework for ICU Staffing
comment: Accepted at ECML PKDD 2026, Applied Data Science Track
summary:
Advances in electronic health records (EHR) and large-scale critical care databases have enabled the development of machine learning models for the early detection of patient deterioration. While these models often achieve strong predictive performance for outcomes such as sepsis and mortality, most studies evaluate them purely on discrimination metrics. This leaves a critical gap: how to systematically translate probabilistic clinical risk estimates into downstream operational decisions under real-world constraints, such as shift rigidity and hiring delays.
  This study proposes an uncertainty-aware anticipatory staffing framework that bridges short-term patient risk prediction and staff planning without altering the upstream predictive model. Instead of relying on naive deterministic aggregation or fixed safety buffers, the framework explicitly models dynamic predictive uncertainty and evaluates extreme shortage exposure using Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR). These aggregated, risk-calibrated demand signals are then embedded into an hourly rolling-horizon scheduling policy to generate delay-constrained staffing decisions.
  Evaluated on realistic trajectories from the MIMIC-IV database, the proposed framework demonstrates a favorable cost-shortage trade-off compared to deterministic and purely reactive baselines. Pareto frontier analysis illustrates how uncertainty-aware demand construction changes resource allocation under varying safety preferences, while stress testing confirms the framework's operational robustness even when subjected to systematic predictive bias in the form of calibration drift. By formalizing this translation layer, this work provides a principled, transparent pathway for safely integrating probabilistic AI outputs into high-stakes healthcare operational systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种基于不确定性感知的前瞻性人员调度框架，将短期患者风险预测与人员计划相融合，通过条件值风险（CVaR）评估极端短缺暴露，利用这种风险校准的需求信号生成符合延迟约束的人员调度决策。
AI.motivation: 大多数关于使用机器学习预测患者恶化的研究集中在判断性能上，而忽视了如何在实际操作中将这些预测转化为行动。因此，这项研究旨在填补这一空白，提出一种考虑不确定性的人力调度方法，以解决在约束条件下进行决策的问题。
AI.method: 该研究采用条件价值-at-风险（CVaR）来量化高度不确定条件下的潜在短缺，并将这些风险校准的需求信号嵌入到逐小时滚动调度策略中，以生成符合时间限制的员工调度方案。
AI.result: 该研究的框架在MIMIC-IV数据库的现实轨迹上进行了评估，显示成本-短缺权衡得到了改善，并且帕累托前沿分析表明，不同安全偏好下的资源分配会发生变化。压力测试证明，即使在预测偏差的情况下，框架也有很强的操作稳健性。
AI.conclusion: 通过这项工作，作者为将概率性人工智能输出安全地整合到高风险医疗操作系统中提供了一个明确、透明的方法论途径。

title: PCHMR: Empowering and Benchmarking Human Mesh Recovery in Privacy-Constrained Real-World Settings
summary: Fine-tuning directly on user-side data is an effective way to improve the performance of widely adopted data-driven human mesh recovery (HMR) models. However, doing so for existing HMR methods often assumes aggregating user-side data from real-world HMR-deployed devices to a central training server, posing a significant privacy risk as sensitive human images are transmitted. How can human mesh recovery be evaluated and improved in privacy-constrained real-world settings? We study this question through a benchmark in which state-of-the-art HMR models are trained with federated learning and a secure-aggregation variant, neither of which centralizes raw images, and evaluated across a wide range of client-scale and data-heterogeneity settings. We document that common HMR training pipelines are built around centralized data access and quantify how representative HMR backbones behave when that assumption is removed. Furthermore, to study the data bottleneck of privacy-constrained HMR training, we propose DePoser, a local annotation and fine-tuning pipeline enhanced with depth foundation models, with which collaboratively trained HMR models can be locally tailored to the end user's distribution. On in-the-wild data, fine-tuning on DePoser annotations improves personalization accuracy, measured against DePoser-generated pseudo-ground truth. This benchmark aims to support future work on privacy-constrained HMR models and their real-world deployment and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的本地标注和微调 pipeline（DePoser），用于在隐私受限的环境下的高效人形恢复模型训练，并展示了这种方法在野外数据上改善个性化准确性。
AI.motivation: 在隐私受限的实际环境中，传统的人形恢复模型依赖中心化数据，这带来了隐私安全问题。因此，研究提出使用联邦学习和安全聚合技术，以不集中原始图像的方式来训练和评估人形恢复模型。
AI.method: 研究采用联邦学习和安全聚合的变体来训练和评估最先进的 HMR 模型。同时，提出了一种名为 DePoser 的本地标注和微调管道，以解决隐私受限环境下的数据瓶颈。
AI.result: 实验表明，DePoser 方法能在不集中原始图像的情况下有效提升模型的个性化准确度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为未来隐私约束环境下的人形恢复模型训练和实际部署提供了技术支持和基准，有助于支持相关研究的发展。

title: Truncated Reasoning Under a Budget: Evaluating System-1 Models as Decision-makers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often generate more reasoning tokens than needed. Limiting the reasoning budget reduces cost, but forcing an answer from an incomplete trace can hurt accuracy. System-1 decision models select among candidate options without producing a reasoning response. We evaluate Jev as a decision reader of truncated reasoning across seven LLM reasoners and five multiple-choice benchmarks (35 pairs). Jev achieves higher mean accuracy than forced answering at tested budgets from 500 to 16,000 tokens, including the estimated costs of reasoning and answering. At a 1,500-token budget, it improves accuracy by 4.1 pp overall and 8.6 pp on truncated questions, with significant gains in 17 pairs under Holm-corrected bootstrap tests. Offline replay estimates 34.5% of the full-run cost, with a 1.13 pp accuracy loss. A policy selected on training folds saves 71.3% of the estimated full-run cost on held-out folds, with a 0.58 pp accuracy loss. We also find that Jev shows strong question-only accuracy, exceeding 500-token forced answering on average (68.0% vs. 65.5%), although this advantage varies by benchmark. These findings suggest that System-1 decision models can complement LLM reasoning and reduce the need for costly reasoning completion.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了Jev作为决策读者的能力，通过限制LLM的推理预算，在多个基准测试中展示了提升的准确率，特别是在预算减少时，同时减少了成本。
AI.motivation: 由于LLM生成的推理过程可能过于冗长，本研究旨在探索通过限制推理预算来降低成本的方法，并评估在保持高准确率的前提下，利用System-1决策模型作为决策读者的有效性。
AI.method: 研究通过使用Jev作为决策读者，在七个LLM推理器和五个多项选择基准测试中进行了评估。研究还通过在线和离线测试方法，评估了预算对成本和准确率的影响。
AI.result: 在1500个令牌的预算下，Jev整体提高了4.1个百分点的准确率，特别是在处理截断问题时提高了8.6个百分点。同时，它比完整的推理流程便宜34.5%，并且在保留折上节省了71.3%的成本。
AI.conclusion: 该研究发现，System-1决策模型可以作为LLM推理的补充，通过减少推理过程的生成，降低了整体成本，同时保持了可观的准确率提升。

title: Auditing Tool Traces in Agentic LLMs: Source Localization and Counterfactual Dependence Testing
comment: 12 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS)
summary: Agentic LLMs increasingly support scientific prediction by grounding decisions in external evidence. In biology, they promise accurate, interpretable predictions for important problems by integrating complex experimental and computational evidence. However, serialized tool results can contain hidden label shortcuts, such as dataset identifiers or template artifacts, that create apparent success without biological reasoning. To address this risk, we introduce a two-stage audit. Stage 1, Per-Tool TF-IDF Decomposition (PT2D), localizes label-predictive patterns to individual tool results while avoiding signal dilution in the concatenated tool trace. Stage 2, Token-Class Redaction, counterfactually tests whether the frozen LLM depends on the localized shortcut. We apply this audit to TCR-pMHC binding, where tool augmentation substantially outperforms a no-evidence baseline. At face value, this suggests that the LLM has learned to use scientific evidence. The audit overturns this interpretation: PT2D localizes the strongest signal to identifiers in one tool result, and redacting them reduces performance to chance. These findings show how hidden label shortcuts can masquerade as scientific reasoning or discovery, motivating source-level audits before benchmark gains are trusted.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种两阶段审计方法来识别和验证AI模型在生物实验预测中的隐藏标签捷径，通过一个案例研究发现，即使使用了工具增强，AI的实际表现仍然依赖于特定工具的结果标识符。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于识别和解决AI模型在处理生物科学任务时可能存在的非生物学推理解释问题，确保模型真正依赖于科学证据而非工具输出中的数据特征。
AI.method: 研究采用两阶段的方法，第一阶段使用PT2D技术定位结果中的局部强信号，第二阶段使用Token-Class红处理技术验证LM是否依赖于这些局部特征。接着，通过案例研究（TCR-pMHC结合）来应用该审计方法，评估工具增强对模型性能的影响。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，尽管工具增强可以提高模型性能，但AI的实际预测仍可能依赖于特定工具输出中的标识符或模板偏差，而非真实的科学推理解释。即使引入了工具增强，模型的预测依然可以通过遮蔽这些关键特征降低到随机水平，表明模型可能在利用隐藏标签捷径而非依赖于科学证据进行推断。
AI.conclusion: 该研究强调，在信任AI模型在生物科学任务中的性能提升之前，需要进行源代码级别的审计，以确保模型真正依赖于科学证据而非隐藏的标签捷径。

title: Arbitrary-Scale Anisotropic 3D MRI Super-Resolution with Gaussian Prototypes
summary: Reducing MRI acquisition time improves patient comfort, reduces motion artefacts, and increases scanner throughput. Clinical protocols often shorten acquisitions by sacrificing spatial resolution, particularly along the slice axis. Super-resolution can recover higher-resolution images, but existing methods are typically specialised to one scale or acquisition geometry, limiting their use across heterogeneous clinical protocols. We present GSMR3D, a continuous volumetric model that reconstructs arbitrary isotropic and anisotropic resolutions with a single checkpoint per MRI contrast. It combines a learned dictionary of anisotropic 3D Gaussian prototypes with scale-conditioned frequency encoding and an exact measurement-consistency projection, keeping reconstructions consistent with the acquired low-resolution data. We train separate models on 3,731 contrast-enhanced T1-weighted and 30,254 T1-weighted brain MRI volumes from clinical and population-based cohorts. We evaluate GSMR3D against geometry-specific specialists for isotropic, in-plane, and through-plane super-resolution using reconstruction quality and downstream tasks: brain tumour segmentation, brain-metastasis detection, and brain parcellation. GSMR3D outperforms specialists at isotropic $2\times$ and achieves better LPIPS, DISTS, and FID across all geometries, although specialists retain higher PSNR in anisotropic settings. It more faithfully preserves glioma segmentations across all geometries, achieves the highest lesion sensitivity on an independent brain-metastasis cohort, and the highest brain-parcellation agreement for isotropic and in-plane reconstruction. Reconstruction takes about 6s per volume, adding little overhead relative to acquisition-time savings. GSMR3D offers a flexible approach to MRI scan-time reduction with one model per contrast across geometries while preserving information relevant to downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: GSMR3D引入了一种灵活的方法来减少MRI采集时间，通过单一检查点重建任意等向性和非等向性分辨率，适用于多种MRI对比度。这种方法在重建质量及下游任务上超越了特定几何结构的专业方法。
AI.motivation: 减少MRI采集时间以提高患者舒适度、减少运动伪影并增加扫描仪吞吐量，但现有方法通常针对单一规模或采集几何形状，限制了它们在异质临床协议中的应用。GSMR3D旨在提供一种通用模型，以克服这一局限。
AI.method: GSMR3D结合了一种学习的各向异性3D高斯原型库与尺度条件下的频率编码和精确的测量一致性投影，以确保重建与低分辨率数据一致。它通过不同对比度的MRI图像训练独立模型，并评估其对不同几何结构的超分辨率重建效果。
AI.result: GSMR3D在等向性重建中超越了特定几何结构的专业方法，实现了更好的LPIPS、DISTS和FID，并在肿瘤分割、脑转移检测和脑分区域等方面表现出色。同时，它提供了一种灵活的方式来实现MRI扫描时间的减少。
AI.conclusion: GSMR3D提供了一种有效的方法来实现MRI采集时间的减少，这不仅改善了患者的体验和系统的效率，同时也保持了对下游任务相关的信息有用性。

title: CoMem: Learning to Anticipate Failures from Retrieved Experience
summary: Reflection lets LLM agents improve from their own attempts, but the memory it builds is local to a single task, so an agent reflecting on its own tends to revisit the same explanation for failure. Cross-task reflective memory addresses this in two forms: retrieved memory keeps past experience explicit and looks up related cases, which is specific but bounded by the bank, and parametric memory internalizes experience into parameters, which generalizes but is grounded in nothing beyond the task description. When both are used, existing agents combine them additively, feeding their outputs to the solver side by side, so retrieved experience never changes what the learned memory produces. We introduce CoMem (Compounding Memory), which makes retrieved experience an input to the learned memory itself, at training and at inference. The agent builds a bank of its own successful and failed reflections, learns from retrieved cases to write failure hypotheses, candidate explanations of how an attempt is likely to go wrong, and at test time reasons from newly retrieved cases to guide each attempt. Varying the retrieved cases gives the memory different perspectives, yielding reflective diversity that is not merely sampled but also grounded in retrieved experience. Across two backbones and five benchmarks in math, code, and multi-hop QA, CoMem achieves strong overall performance. Additional evaluations show that it generalizes to out-of-distribution tasks and enables smaller models to provide effective guidance to stronger solvers.

AI.tldr: CoMem 通过将检索到的经验纳入学习记忆中，从而增强了代理的反思能力，并在多个基准测试中表现出强大的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的反思机制在处理多任务反思时存在局限性，如单一任务记忆的局限性和参数记忆可能基于不足的任务描述。希望引入一种机制能够结合检索记忆的特定性与参数记忆的泛化能力，同时提供更多的反思视角。
AI.method: CoMem 引入了一种全新机制，使得检索到的经验作为输入参与到学习记忆中。这种机制在训练和推理阶段均得到应用，代理构建自身成功与失败的反思库，并从检索到的案例中学习失败假设，最终在测试时根据新检索到的案例引导每一个尝试。
AI.result: CoMem 在两个基础模型和五个基准测试（包括数学、代码和多跳问答）中表现出色，展示了强大的综合性能。此外，CoMem 还证明了跨领域泛化的特性，即使使用较小的模型也可以有效地指导更强的求解器。
AI.conclusion: CoMem 获得了在多项任务上的一般性和灵活性，表明其在 LLM 反思机制方面具有很大的潜力。

title: Editing as Language: Teaching LLM Agents a Grammar for Native Context Editing
summary: A synopsis in novels folds a story into a few lines; a function in code gathers many steps with a single execution. Context editing is native to language itself. In this paper, we propose the Native Context Editing (NCE) framework, which gives language model agents a grammar for natively editing their own context. By encoding context-editing operations in a grammar of dedicated special tokens, we teach the agents to invoke edits through the language itself. We train agents on iteratively constructed trajectory segments, with each teacher edit conditioned on the evolving context. This establishes context editing as an atomic and inherent capability of LLM agents, enabling them to dynamically modify their context as they generate responses over long-horizon reasoning and interaction. Compared with context-editing methods that learn to generate tool-use code within specific external harness environments, our approach integrates context editing as an internal mechanism of the model's native generation process, enabling better generalization across diverse real-world workflows. On four long-horizon agentic benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, and SWE-bench Pro), NCE improves the average task success rate over the base model by 5.6 percentage points for LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse and by 4.5 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, while reducing average token usage by 36% and 15%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NCE框架，这是一种语法化的方法，允许语言模型根据其当前上下文自动生成和应用编辑操作，从而提高模型在长期推理和交互中的任务成功率和效率。
AI.motivation: 传统的方法通常需要在特定的外部环境中训练模型以使用特定的编辑工具，这限制了模型的通用性。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了NCE框架，该框架将上下文编辑集成到模型的生成过程内部。
AI.method: NCE框架通过使用专门的特殊标记来编码上下文编辑操作，使语言模型能够通过自身语言来触发这些编辑。模型在一个迭代构建的轨迹片段上进行训练，每个教师编辑都根据不断演变的上下文进行条件化。
AI.result: 在四个长期推理和交互基准测试中，NCE方法相对于基础模型提高了平均任务成功率，同时减少了平均令牌使用量。
AI.conclusion: NCE框架展示了语言模型通过其自身语言实现动态上下文编辑的能力，这使它们能够在长期推理和交互中更有效地生成响应。

title: SpriteStage: Long Horizon Animation Generation via Progressive Scene Programming and Replay
summary: Video generation models synthesize visual sequences from text and image inputs. Extending video generation to long animations requires actions, dialogue, camera coverage, and narrative developments to remain coordinated across scenes. Executable scene programs make these decisions available for inspection. Constructing an entire story before observing its execution can leave later scenes dependent on unrealized events. We present SpriteStage, a progressive scene programming framework that builds animation through iterative enactment and engine reorchestration. Iterative enactment generates each scene from an accepted world checkpoint and narrative snapshot, executes it on a shared spatial stage, and uses runtime and visual feedback to revise the relevant actions or story beats. The accepted outcome becomes the starting state for the next scene. Engine reorchestration maps the resulting draft to production assets and engine capabilities while retaining its events, geometry, and timing. Inspection of the assembled sequence and frozen replay carry the accepted performance into the final video. Three complete animations, ranging from approximately 9.9 to 14.3 minutes, demonstrate the framework's effectiveness in producing extended narratives through scene programming and engine execution.

AI.tldr: SpriteStage 是一种逐进的场景编程框架，通过迭代执行和引擎重新编排，从接受的世界检查点和叙述快照生成每个场景，并将最终的性能表现固化到最终视频中。
AI.motivation: 传统的视频生成框架在构建整个故事后再观察其执行，可能导致依赖于未实现事件的情景，而 SpriteStage 则通过迭代执行和引擎重新编排，使每一步场景都能受到实时反馈和持续改进。
AI.method: SpriteStage 采用迭代执行和引擎重新编排的方法，通过从接受的世界检查点和叙述快照生成每个场景，利用实时和视觉反馈调整相关动作或情节要点，之后将生成的各个场景片段映射到生产资源和引擎功能中。
AI.result: SpriteStage 生成了三个完整的动画，时长从约9.9分钟到14.3分钟，显示了通过场景编程和引擎执行生成扩展叙事的能力。
AI.conclusion: SpriteStage 框架证明了通过场景编程构建扩展视频动画的有效性，强调了迭代执行和持续改进在保持叙事连贯性中的重要性。

title: Modal Sense Disambiguation in Language Models: The Role of Context, Training Domain, and Input Frequency
summary: Modals such as may and must can take on different senses depending on discourse context, alternating between root interpretations (e.g., permission, obligation) and epistemic interpretations (e.g., knowledge, belief). While modals are known to be notoriously difficult for children to acquire, limited research exists on whether language models (LMs) can reliably distinguish between different modal senses. We evaluate seven LMs that vary in architecture, size, and training data type using vector-based similarity and surprisal measures across four datasets. Specifically, we investigate whether LMs can leverage contextual information to disambiguate modal senses and whether their performance reflects the distribution of modal senses in their training data. We show that larger LMs trained on diverse text successfully leverage additional contextual information when available. In the absence of context, they tend to favor the dominant sense based on corpus statistics. Smaller developmentally plausible LMs, including those trained on child-directed language (CDL), fail to show consistent sensitivity to modal sense distinctions and do not benefit from context to the same degree.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了不同架构、规模和训练数据类型的七种语言模型，以确定它们能否区分情态词的不同意义。结果显示，大模型在有上下文的情况下能更好地利用额外的上下文信息，而小的、可发展的情态词模型，包括训练于儿童语言数据的模型，在处理情态词意义的区分上表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 尽管我们知道孩子们在这方面的习得比较困难，但现有研究较少关注语言模型是否也能区分情态词的不同含义。
AI.method: 研究者使用了基于向量的相似性和惊讶度测量方法，在四个不同数据集上评估了七种语言模型，检查它们是否能利用上下文信息来消除情态词的歧义，并分析它们的表现是否反映了训练数据中情态词的分布情况。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，大型、多样训练数据下的语言模型在有上下文的情况下能更好地利用额外的上下文信息，但在缺乏上下文的情况下，它们倾向于根据语料库统计信息偏好一种主要的情态词意义。小的、符合发展水平的语言模型，包括那些训练于儿童语言数据的模型，在区分情态词意义方面表现不佳，且在缺乏上下文的情况下也无法受益于此。
AI.conclusion: 由于语言模型在区分不同情态词意义时表现出大小和先验知识的依赖性，这表明它们可能在某种程度上反映了类似人类学习过程的特点。

title: Symbolic Constraint Agents: Mining Formal Tool-Call Constraints to Prevent Agent Errors
summary: Symbolic constraints (programmatic, deterministic checks for tool calls) enable deterministic verification of LLM agents' tool calls, but existing approaches primarily enforce predefined safety policies rather than tool dependencies in complex tool environments. We explore whether symbolic constraints can be mined from environments and observations beyond predefined policies, and whether they can improve end-to-end task performance. We present Symbolic Constraint Agents (SCA), a framework that mines symbolic constraints from API documentation, refines them against execution traces, and checks the agent's tool calls with an SMT solver at runtime. A violation triggers a natural-language warning or, when the valid replacement is uniquely determined, an automatic repair. On AppWorld, refinement raises error-detection F1 from 37.0 to 58.3 on GPT-5.5 traces and from 39.3 to 61.9 on Qwen3.5-27B traces. At runtime, repair raises GPT-5.4-mini's task success by 5.4 points under a 40-call budget and 9.8 points when environment errors are hidden, while removing 59--87\% of failed calls across models, and transfers to $τ^2$-bench with gains of up to 5.6 points. These findings show that automatically acquired symbolic constraints can improve tool-calling reliability and task completion, particularly when failures are costly or difficult to diagnose.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为SCA的框架，能够从API文档和执行痕迹中挖掘符号约束，用于LLM代理的工具调用检查。在AppWorld上的实验结果显示，SCA在减少错误检测和提升任务成功率方面表现优异，尤其是在隐藏环境错误和预算限制条件下。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要依赖预定义的安全策略来验证LLM代理的工具调用，但往往忽略了复杂的工具环境中的依赖关系。SCA旨在探索是否可以通过环境和观察数据自动学习符号约束，以此提高整体任务性能。
AI.method: SCA框架从API文档中抽取符号约束，并通过执行痕迹进行修正。代理的工具调用在运行时会使用SMT求解器进行检查。如果检测到违规行为，则会生成自然语言警告或自动修复。
AI.result: 在AppWorld上，SCA在GPT-5.5和Qwen3.5-27B的执行痕迹中提高了错误检测精度，具体从37.0和39.3增加到58.3和61.9。在运行时，SCA使GPT-5.4-mini的任务成功率提高了5.4点，隐藏环境错误时提升至9.8点，同时也减少了59%到87%的失败调用，且在$τ^2$-bench上的表现也有所改善。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论表明，自动学习的符号约束可以提高工具调用的可靠性和任务完成率，特别是在高成本或难以诊断的失败情况下的效果更为显著。

title: Goal Images Are Control Targets: Spatially-Grounded Goal-Image Synthesis for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Goal-conditioned manipulation policies are steered by a goal image, a picture of the desired post-manipulation scene synthesized from the current observation and a language instruction. The prevailing assumption is that better image-editing quality yields better goals, so goal generators are built and compared using general image-editing metrics. We show this assumption is false. Across two independent goal-conditioned policies on CALVIN, the image editors that top aggregate editing-quality leaderboards (Gemini 3 Pro Image and GPT Image 1.5) produce worse control targets than our proposed far smaller finetuned open models, and the gap widens sharply for the multi-step (long-horizon) tasks robots actually face. A per-dimension analysis explains why.
