Downstream policy success is governed almost entirely by manipulation adherence (selecting the right object and the right final state; Spearman $ρ\approx 0.9$ with success), while photorealism and aesthetic fidelity, precisely where large proprietary editors excel, are uncorrelated with success ($ρ\approx 0$). This dissociation holds on both CALVIN and the real-world-aligned SIMPLER-Bridge benchmark. We then present SGE-Goal, a spatially-grounded decomposed editing framework that predicts initial and final 2D edit-region masks before goal-image synthesis. SGE-Goal turns open base models (FLUX.1 Kontext, FLUX.2 klein) into the strongest goal generators we evaluate on CALVIN, and second only to Gemini 3 Pro Image on SIMPLER-Bridge. Base models fine-tuned with SGE-Goal also hold up under chaining far better than the best proprietary editor, sustaining roughly seven times the success rate at the longest (five-step) chains. We release code, datasets, checkpoints, and a human-aligned diagnostic evaluator. Our results argue that goal generators must be selected by downstream utility, not by editing-quality leaderboards.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，用于指导机械臂操作的目标图像编辑质量并不是越高越好。一个新提出的解构编辑框架（SGE-Goal）能够更有效地生成目标图像，特别是在长期任务中表现更佳。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数研究倾向于通过编辑质量指标来评估和设计目标生成器，但这一方法可能并不是选择目标生成器的最佳依据。研究者通过两个独立的机械臂操作策略在CALVIN上的实验，以及与实际环境更接近的SIMPLER-Bridge基准测试，提出了新的观察结论。
AI.method: 研究团队将基于开放模型的目标生成器与编辑质量领先的专有编辑器进行对比，并通过分析不同维度的表现来解释它们与机械臂操作成功的关系。进一步地，他们开发了一个新框架（SGE-Goal），结合空间定位编辑，以预测初始和最终的编辑区域掩码，从而改进目标图像的生成能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，尽管现有专有编辑器在编辑质量上优于开放模型，但它们在机械臂操作中产生的目标图像控制目标并不如新的开放模型所生成的目标图像有效。新的框架（SGE-Goal）能够显著提升基线模型在目标生成方面的表现，尤其是在处理多步（长时间）任务时效果更为显著。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调，目标生成器应当依据其下游操作的成功率进行选择，而不仅仅是依据编辑质量的指标。提出的SGE-Goal框架展示了使用开放模型结合空间定位编辑来提高目标生成效率的方法，具备在长序列任务中维持高成功率的潜力。

title: Diffusion Language Models Change Speed Across Tasks and Languages
summary: Diffusion language models can write several tokens in one forward pass, and they decide during generation how many passes to spend. Two outputs of the same token length can therefore vary a lot in cost. To understand the underlying factors of this cost variation, we analyze two diffusion models across 10 tasks. We find that the number of forward passes per token depends heavily on the task. Text copied or lightly edited from the input is cheap, while open-ended writing is costly. In DiffusionGemma, generating a token for story writing requires more than three times as many forward passes as for grammar correction. Two output properties explain much of this gap: how much of it is new relative to the input, and how rare its words are within the task. The same holds within a single response when thinking is involved. The final answer is cheap when it repeats the model's reasoning trace and costly when it adds something new. In multilingual generation, we find that highly tokenized languages also require more passes per token, adding to the cost they already pay with more tokens. Finally, cost tracks correctness: on the same math problem, wrong answers take more passes per token than correct ones, and weighting candidate answers by decoding speed beats majority voting by up to 4.2 points at no extra cost. Taken together, our results show that diffusion's computational advantage depends on how much of the output is already determined, while its decoding effort offers a practical signal for making inference more efficient and reliable.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析两个扩散模型在10个任务中的表现，探讨了生成文本成本变异的驱动因素。结果表明，与输入相关的文本成本较低，而创造性的写作和新词语较多的任务则成本更高。该研究还发现，计算上的优势取决于输出中已确定的内容量，并提出了解码努力为提高推理效率和可靠性提供了一个实用信号。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在生成过程中可以自行决定投入的计算资源，但不同内容的成本差异较大。本文旨在理解这些差异背后的因素，以提高这些模型在实际应用中的效率。
AI.method: 研究通过分析两个扩散模型（具体模型未在摘要中提及）在多种任务中的表现来考察生成文本的成本因素。
AI.result: 研究发现，与输入相关（如复制或轻微编辑）的文本成本较低，而创造性写作或含有更罕见词语的任务则成本更高。具体而言，类似于讲故事的任务成本是语法纠正任务的三倍以上。研究还发现，生成内容的新鲜度以及词汇的罕见性是成本差异的重要原因。在多语言生成任务中，高分词化语言也显示出更高的成本。此外，错误答案需要更多的计算资源，而根据解码速度加权候选答案的评分系统比多数投票制更有效，且无需额外成本。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论表明，扩散模型的计算优势取决于输出中已确定的内容量，其解码努力为提高推理效率和可靠性提供了一个实用信号。

title: Narrow Decision Models: A System-1 Architecture for Calibrated, Typed Decisions
comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. A first training on real documents is summarized; full results on real data in production are left to a companion paper
summary: System One models, introduced with TypeSafe's Jev, answer typed questions about a state with calibrated probabilities instead of generated text: choosing among options described in natural language (Choice), placing the state on an ordered scale (Score), or judging a yes/no statement (Noul). Jev is general-purpose: one set of weights, served as an API and adapted to a domain only through the request. We study the other end of the design space. A Narrow Decision Model (NDM) offers the same interface but is trained for the decisions of one organization, is small enough to run on its own infrastructure, and has an open architecture whose properties can be stated and tested. The state can be any text or structured record about which decisions are made; our running case is the routing of court communications. The architecture serializes a request as a prefix tree (the state, then each question, then each option) and runs a bidirectional encoder under a block attention mask with logical positions, so that each answer is, by construction, invariant to the order of its options and independent of the other questions asked. Routing through an organization chart is a composition of Choice decisions with an explicit "none of these" option. We describe training with proper scoring rules through a curriculum, calibration and abstention, decisions composed by rubrics, and a protocol that accepts or rejects the mechanism before held-out data is opened. A minimal validation on public and fictitious data shows that the invariances hold to rounding in a trained model, that a small instance routes on organization charts it has never seen well above lexical retrieval, and that, at equal compute, the block architecture reaches a lower loss than a pairwise cross-encoder. A first instance trained on real legal documents agrees with the LLM classifier in production on 91% of held-out documents.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为Narrow Decision Model (NDM)的新架构，旨在解决特定组织内的决策问题。NDM通过一个基于选择、打分和判断类型问题的串行请求处理流程，利用双向编码器和逻辑位置注意力掩码，确保答案的顺序不变性和独立性。通过一个渐进式训练方法，NDM在验证实验中表现出对组织架构的出色适应能力。
AI.motivation: 当前的System One模型(Jev)过于通用，面向广泛的用户和场景。本文探讨了一个新的Narrow Decision Model (NDM)，旨在为特定组织提供解决决策问题的专有模型。
AI.method: NDM通过一种特殊的结构化请求处理流程，利用双向编码器和逻辑位置注意力掩码，确保答案的顺序不变性和独立性。在训练阶段，使用了曲率评分规则、校准与例外处理、基于评分规则的决策组合和一个在非公开数据集上验证模型的协议。
AI.result: 在实际验证实验中，NDM在组织架构上表现出出色的能力，其性能略高于词序检索。同时，该模型的架构设计相比线对线交叉编码器具有更低的损失率，在相同的计算资源下提供了更好的性能。
AI.conclusion: 论文介绍了NDM模型，并展示了其在实际中的潜力。通过对特定组织的决策问题进行专有训练，NDM表现出强大的适应性，并在实际验证中显示了优秀的性能和设计优势。

title: Multi-Speed Field Evaluation of a Semi-Autonomous Precision Sprayer for Weed Control in Vegetable Crops
summary: Machine vision-guided precision spraying is promising for sustainable vegetable production by enabling site-specific weed targeting, reducing herbicide application while protecting crop yield and quality. However, the effects of operating speed of sprayer systems on the integrated detection-tracking-actuation pipeline remain insufficiently characterized under field conditions. This study evaluated a semi-autonomous, tractor-based spraying system for targeted weed control in radish and quantified performance across three operating speeds. A five-season dataset comprising 10,599 images and 84,311 annotated instances across seven classes was curated for model development. A YOLOv11-medium model was integrated with ByteTrack tracking and a customized 12-nozzle sprayer on a semi-autonomous electric tractor. Field trials were conducted at 0.13, 0.27, and 0.45 m/s (i.e., 0.3, 0.6, and 1.0 mph) to characterize speed-dependent changes in weed detection, targeting, actuation, and crop damage. At the lowest speed of 0.13 m/s, the system achieved 94.6% mAP@50 and 93.2% recall for weed and crop detection. However, increasing platform speed substantially reduced system performance, with weed hit rate declining from 78.3% to 35.0% and crop contact rates increasing from 20.1% to 28.7%. Consequently, the system did not meet predefined commercial-viability thresholds. These results demonstrate that practical deployment requires improvements beyond weed detection alone, particularly coordinated improvements in motion-robust plant perception, spray-timing compensation, and crop-adjacent actuation precision. The identified performance bottlenecks provide specific engineering targets for advancing vision-guided precision spraying toward practical, high-speed vegetable weed management. The software programs developed in this study have been made publicly available to support future precision weeding research.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过评估不同速度下用于萝卜机械化除草的半自主系统，建立了包含10,599张图像和84,311个标注实例的5季数据集，结果表明提高平台速度会显著降低系统性能，需改进运动稳健的植物感知、喷洒时机校正和作物旁精准喷雾以实现高效除草。
AI.motivation: 评估机器视觉引导的精准喷雾系统在田间条件下的性能，尤其是不同喷雾速度对杂草检测、定位和喷施效率的影响。
AI.method: 研究人员使用YOLOv11-medium模型结合ByteTrack跟踪，与一个带有12个喷嘴的半自主电动拖拉机配套。通过在三种不同速度（0.13、0.27和0.45 m/s）下进行实地试验，来研究速度对系统性能的影响。
AI.result: 在最低速度0.13 m/s时，系统达到了94.6%的mAP@50和93.2%的召回率，但随着平台速度增加，杂草检测命中率下降到35.0%，作物接触率上升到28.7%。该系统未达到商用地可持续发展的性能标准。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果指出，除草喷雾技术的实际部署需要超越单纯的杂草检测，还需要在运动稳健的植物感知、喷洒时机校准以及作物附近喷雾精度方面进行综合改进。

title: Where RL Breaks: Localizing and Repairing Failures via Targeted Continued Pretraining
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is widely used to improve reasoning in language models, yet growing evidence suggests that it mostly sharpens what the base model can already do. This raises a practical question: when RL fails, what is the base model missing? We look inside the RL policy's own rollouts and find that failures are localized: whether a rollout fails is strongly predicted by a small set of characteristic n-grams, ranging from reflection phrases such as "let's recheck" to specific operations such as "the inverse of A". These failures persist throughout RL training, although they are not beyond the model's reach: other sampled answers to the same question are often correct. Building on this observation, we use the failure $n$-grams to retrieve text from the pretraining corpus and continue pretraining the base model on it before RL. The resulting corpus has only 35M tokens, 3--4 orders of magnitude smaller than typical mid-training. We evaluate this approach on OLMo2 and Qwen3 models trained with RL on (1) GSM8K; (2) a mixture of math, commonsense, and knowledge questions; and (3) general math and science reasoning. Despite its size, the corpus yields consistent gains: our approach outperforms continued pretraining on the same amount of text sampled from the pretraining corpus across 10 out of 11 settings, including by $2.0$ points on GSM8K when inserted before mid-training. The retrieved text also transfers across model families: text retrieved for OLMo2-1B's failures improves Qwen3-4B on the mixture by $1.9$ points over the same baseline. Together, our results suggest that where RL fails is a cheap and effective signal for selecting pretraining data.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现RLVR在提升语言模型推理能力时存在局限，通常只是强化了原有能力而非突破原有限制。研究者通过分析RLVR失败的原因，发现某些特定的文本片段会导致失败，并利用这些片段进行模型预训练，取得了显著的效果。
AI.motivation: 为了提升利用强化学习增强奖励（RLVR）方法在语言模型上的推理能力，并应对RLVR在强化原有能力基础上未能产生突破的问题。
AI.method: 研究者通过分析RLVR训练过程中的失败rollout，识别出与失败相关的特征n-gram，然后从预训练语料中检索这些特征n-gram，再利用这些片段对基础模型进行预训练，最终评估模型性能的变化。
AI.result: 这种方法仅使用了35M个词的语料库（相比中训练典型预训练语料的3-4个数量级更小），在多个模型和任务设置上取得了显著提升，尤其是在GSM8K任务中表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，可以通过识别RLVR训练中的失败原因，选择高效的预训练数据，从而提高模型的推理能力。

title: Learning Which Device to Call: Online Tool Grounding for LLM Agents in IoT
summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) gives large language model (LLM) agents access to physical observations, but one requested capability is usually offered by several devices, and the agent's plan does not say which one to call. Existing work retrieves relevant tools and checks plan feasibility, without learning which eligible device returns a useful observation. Unlike previous works, we study online tool grounding: binding an already specified tool call to one physical endpoint under service cost and device participation constraints. We propose a framework that learns which physical device should execute each agent-issued call. It formulates selection as a contextual bandit problem and combines adaptive context partitions with hierarchical endpoint trees, so that execution feedback is reused across related requests and devices. Selection balances task success against service cost while respecting device capability, authorization, battery reserves, and availability. Gaussian reward aggregation provides an optional mechanism for protecting individual feedback values. Theoretical results establish a finite-horizon regret bound and differential privacy for released reward statistics under fixed, reward-independent assignments. In a simulated loading-dock workload, the proposed router achieves higher step success and better cost-adjusted service, at lower simulated device energy and latency, than nearest-device, advertised-quality, UCB1, and LinUCB selection.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种框架来解决在线工具接地问题，即为已指定的工具调用绑定一个物理端点，同时考虑服务成本和服务设备的限制。该框架通过将选择问题形式化为上下文多臂老虎机问题，并结合自适应上下文分区和分层端点树，提高任务成功率并减少成本和能耗。
AI.motivation: 物联网使大语言模型代理可以访问物理观察，但一项请求能力可能由多个设备提供。现有工作只能检索相关工具并检查计划可行性，而不了解哪个设备能提供有用的信息。因此，研究提出了一种在线工具接地的方法，以更有效地执行任务。
AI.method: 该方法将设备选择问题建模为上下文多臂老虎机问题，利用自适应上下文分区技术和分层端点树，可以重新利用执行反馈并将执行和服务成本的因素纳入其中。此外，它还提供了一种基于高斯奖励聚合的机制来保护个体反馈值。
AI.result: 在仿真装载码头工作中，提出的方法比最近设备选择、公告质量选择、UCB1和LinUCB在更高成功步数和更好的成本调整服务方面表现出更优性能，而且实际消耗的设备能源和延迟也更低。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过结合自适应上下文分区和分层端点树，证明了其在多个方面的优势，并通过理论结果证明了其在有界遗憾和差分隐私等方面的性能。

title: Predicting Individual Differences in Lipreading From Eye-Tracking and Pupillometry During Silent Visual Speech
comment: Submitted to the Journal of Speech, Language, and Hearing Research. 5 figures, 2 tables
summary: Lipreading ability varies widely, including among people who are hard of hearing. Although mouth-directed attention is linked to speechreading outcomes, it remains unclear how much lipreading skill can be inferred from viewing behavior and which signals carry this information. We examine whether individual differences in lipreading ability are reflected in viewing behavior during silent speech and quantify the contributions of gaze dynamics, pupil-linked signals, and spatial viewing allocation. We introduce the Lipreading Perception Study (LiPS) dataset and a tracker-independent preprocessing pipeline that synchronizes SR Research EyeLink gaze and pupil recordings with the stimuli. Twenty-four adults (age 32 $\pm$ 10 years) completed a four-alternative forced-choice silent lipreading task. An extreme-groups protocol yielded 18 participants labeled as stronger or weaker lipreaders. Each participant-trial included four aligned views: lip-region images, frame-level gaze, pupil summaries, and spatial viewing proportions. A four-branch neural network with cross-modal attention predicted labels using participant-disjoint splits and systematic ablations. The full model reached accuracy 0.680 $\pm$ 0.040 across five folds, outperforming naive fusion baselines in accuracy. The pupil and viewing-summary branch was most informative: removing it caused the largest degradation (0.618 accuracy, 0.623 AUC), while it alone achieved 0.675 accuracy. The lip-image stream contributed little to participant-level discrimination. Individual differences in lipreading are reflected in pupil-linked and frame-level gaze signals rather than in how much time a viewer spends looking at the mouth. Synchronized gaze and pupillary measures may provide objective markers of visual speech perception, warranting investigation in larger, clinically diverse populations. LiPS provides a resource for extending this work.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，唇读能力的个体差异主要反映在瞳孔活动和帧级注视信号中，而不仅仅是注视持续时间。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探讨个体差异的唇读能力如何反映在无声唇读行为中的视点行为，并量化瞳孔动态、瞳孔相关信号和空间视点分配的贡献。
AI.method: 研究人员引入了唇读感知研究（LiPS）数据集，并开发了一个无需追踪器的预处理管道，以同步 SR Research EyeLink 眼动和瞳孔记录与刺激。参与者完成了四项选择无声唇读任务，并使用四个分支神经网络分析任务的不同方面。
AI.result: 在五折验证中，全模型的准确性达到 0.680 ± 0.040，表明瞳孔和帧级注视分支是最具信息量的，移除它们会导致性能大幅下降。与注视时间相比，个体的唇读能力更多地体现在瞳孔活动和帧级注视信号中。
AI.conclusion: 研究成果表明同步的眼动和瞳孔测量可能提供客观的视觉语音感知指标，并建议在未来的研究中在更大、临床多样的群体中进一步探索这些指标。

title: Measurement Validity and Representation Dynamics of Confidence Signals in Large Language Models
summary: Whether a language model "knows what it knows" matters for trustworthy deployment and for deciding when it should abstain. Prior work usually measures this through one channel: verbalized confidence, a linear probe on hidden states, or agreement among sampled answers (semantic entropy), and often treats these as interchangeable. We compare all three in a pre-registered audit of five Qwen2.5 models (0.5B-7B, including a base/instruct pair at 7B) on factual retrieval (PopQA, SimpleQA) and multi-step reasoning (GSM8K, MATH). First, probes trained on prefill states to predict whether sampled answers will disagree become informative earlier for retrieval (about 7% of layer depth on average) than for reasoning (about 28%). The pre-registered five-layer test supported this only marginally; a finer 21-layer follow-up, designed after those results, supports it more clearly. In most retrieval cells, however, a prompt-only TF-IDF classifier matches the probe, so the early signal may reflect surface features of the question. Second, verbalized confidence is unstable: slightly different prompt templates yield scores that barely correlate. Third, Expected Calibration Error is misleading: verbal confidence looks well calibrated because it clusters near the base rate while discriminating poorly, whereas sampling agreement has worse ECE but about twice the resolution. Of five pre-registered hypotheses, two were falsified, one was partly supported, one was not supported, and one could not be tested because the base model's verbal confidence was degenerate.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了三种不同的方法来评估语言模型是否认识到自身知识的有效性，发现不同模型层次结构对检索和多步推理任务的辨别能力不同，且不同评估方法之间存在相当大的不一致和误导性。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于评估语言模型是否可靠，以及模型在何时应避免回答。传统的评估方法如表征信心、隐藏状态上的线性探针或样本答案的语义熵，这些方法可能在某些方面存在局限性，因此研究提出并比较了这三种方法在五个不同规模Qwen2.5模型上的效果。
AI.method: 研究采用了预注册审查的方法，对五个不同规模的Qwen2.5模型（从0.5B到7B，包括一组7B的基础模型和指令模型对）进行了事实检索（PopQA, SimpleQA）和多步推理（GSM8K, MATH）任务的测试。
AI.result: 结果显示，对于检索任务与推理任务，不同模型的预测能力存在显著差异；表征信心不稳定；预期校准误差并不如采样一致性来得直接。研究还发现，早期的信号可能更多地反映了问题的表面特征而非深层理解。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论指出，当前的不同评估方法之间存在一定差异和不一致，未来的研究需要更全面的评估标准来确保模型的可信度和可靠性。

title: Design and Cross-Domain Evaluation of an Agent Execution Harness
comment: 25 pages, 11 figures, including references and appendices
summary: Completing complex tasks with language-model agents requires coordinating planning, execution, and review so the final result addresses the user's original objective. We present an agent execution harness that keeps the original objective separate from a revisable plan and an execution record. A planner assigns scoped tasks, workers produce outputs and artifacts, and a reviewer examines results against the original request before submitting or requesting additional work. Reusable domain-specific instructions guide these roles and are refined during construction using task inputs and execution trajectories, without official grading feedback. We evaluate complete harness configurations across terminal tasks, clinical responses, application building, and scientific questions. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, the harness passes 83 of 89 instances (93.26%); on HealthBench Professional, a Fable-configured system achieves a length-adjusted rubric score of 69.63 across 525 tasks. In a 53-task paired HealthBench comparison, the Fable-configured harness achieves an aggregate score 19.89 points higher than direct completion, despite a $-1.46$-point median task-level change; mean inference cost rises from \$0.29 to \$2.13 per task. We combine these outcomes with latency, documented instruction revisions, and reviewer decisions. Evaluating outcomes alongside execution trajectories and resource use clarifies how coordination supports task completion, where it introduces regressions, and at what cost.

AI.tldr: 该研究介绍了一种代理执行框架，该框架将原始目标与可修订的计划和执行记录分开，通过规划者、工人和审查者的协作来完成复杂的任务。该框架在多种任务上进行了评估，展示了其在临床响应、应用程序构建和科学问题上的性能。
AI.motivation: 复杂任务使用语言模型代理需要通过计划、执行和审查协调工作，以确保最终结果符合用户原始目标。为此，该研究提出了一个代理执行框架，通过分离原始目标、可修订计划和执行记录，以及规划者、工人和审查者的协作，更好地实现用户需求。
AI.method: 该研究通过执行框架在多个领域的任务评估，包括终端任务、临床响应、应用程序构建和科学问题。通过这种方法，研究人员能够验证框架在不同场景下的有效性和性能。
AI.result: 该研究在Terminal-Bench 2.1的89个实例中成功完成了83个（93.26%），在HealthBench Professional上Fable配置的系统实现了长度调整后的评分69.63，在53项健康基准配对测试中，Fable配置的执行框架的综合得分比直接完成高出19.89点，尽管每个任务的中位数评分降低了1.46点。此外，通过将结果与执行轨迹和资源使用情况一起评估，可以清楚地看到协调如何支持任务完成，引入的缺陷以及成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过执行该框架，可以在不同领域中高效地完成复杂的任务，特别是在临床响应、应用程序构建和科学问题上。结合执行轨迹和资源使用情况的评估，增强了对框架性能的理解。

title: Stable Signer V3: 4D Deformable Primitive Splatting Is All You Need for Sign Language Production
summary: We present Stable Signer V3, an interactive high-resolution sign language avatar system built on 4D Deformable Primitive Splatting. It addresses three limitations of existing avatars: restricted facial expression, inaccurate identity-specific body deformation, and loss of fine appearance details. Shared Face Primitive Splatting adds transferable superquadric primitives for richer expression control; Test-Time Body Primitive Splatting learns an identity-specific virtual muscle layer for more faithful motion; and Test-Time Tunneling Super-Resolution uses TunnelingNet to recover identity-specific high-resolution details. Both test-time modules are optimized once per signer identity; inference then runs entirely from the stored identity parameters. Together, they reduce facial geometry error by 71.4%, body-boundary error by 35.1% across ten identities, and high-resolution RGB reconstruction error by 24.2% on held-out evaluations, while retaining interactive streaming.

AI.tldr: Stable Signer V3 是一个通过 4D 可变形基础体散射技术构建的交互式高分辨率手语角色系统，解决了现有角色系统的三个局限，即表情限制、身份特定身体变形不准确和细节丢失。
AI.motivation: 现有的手语角色系统存在表情控制有限、特定身份的身体变形不准确以及细节丢失的问题，Stable Signer V3 旨在解决这些问题，以实现更丰富、更准确和更细腻的手语表达。
AI.method: Stable Signer V3 采用了共享面部基础体散射技术、测试时身体基础体散射和测试时隧道超分辨率技术来增强表情控制、实现身份特定的身体变形以及恢复高分辨率细节。
AI.result: Stable Signer V3 在保持交互流媒体的同时，减少了面部几何误差71.4%，身体边界误差35.1%（10个身份的综合结果），以及高分辨率RGB重建误差24.2%（在外的数据验证中）。
AI.conclusion: Stable Signer V3 通过改进的手语角色系统显著提高了手语表达的丰富度、准确性和细节性，为手语交流技术的进步做出了积极贡献。

title: Arabic Financial NLP
summary: Financial communication connects numerical accounts of economic activity with explanations of performance, responsibility and future expectations. Arabic financial natural language processing offers methods for studying these connections across corporate reports, market disclosures, journalism and banking interactions. Its contribution to digital humanities depends on retaining the relationship between a computational representation and the document from which it was made. This chapter follows that relationship from source collection and Arabic text processing to the analysis of vocabulary, evaluation, entities, causal attribution and multilingual reporting. It then examines what financial summaries and retrieval-grounded answers preserve or lose, and how dialectal intent detection changes the perspective from institutions speaking to institutions listening. Published Arabic resources are discussed in relation to the questions they were designed to answer, with a distinction between financial pretraining corpora, annotated datasets and evaluation benchmarks. A running constructed example connects the methodological discussion without presenting illustrative analysis as empirical findings. The chapter argues for an account of Arabic financial NLP in which linguistic context, documentary provenance and interpretive judgement remain part of the evidence throughout the analytical process.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了基于阿拉伯语的金融自然语言处理的方法及其在数字人文科学中的应用，涵盖文本处理、词汇分析、实体识别、因果归因及多语言报告等方面。
AI.motivation: 为了揭示阿拉伯语财务报告中财务业绩、责任和未来预期的解释之间的关系，并将其与文本来源联系起来，以服务于数字人文研究。
AI.method: 从数据收集、阿拉伯语文本处理、词汇分析、实体识别、因果归因及多语言报告等方面的方法入手，构建了一个综合性分析框架。
AI.result: 论文指出了财务摘要和基于检索的回答所保存或丢失的内容，并讨论了方言意图检测如何改变从机构对机构的视角。
AI.conclusion: 论文强调了在阿拉伯语财务NLP中保持语言上下文、文档来源和解释性判断的重要性，以确保分析过程中证据的完整性。

title: The Forward/Inverse Duality of Controlled Emergence:A Computational Design Program from Explanation to Engineering
summary: The macroscopic capabilities of intelligent systems arise from the local interactions of many simple units. When such systems are deployed in the real world, their behaviour must nevertheless be constrained, leaving designers caught between releasing adaptability and preventing loss of control, yet without formal tools to resolve the dilemma. This paper proposes a unified research program for controlled emergence that restates this tension as a pair of dual problems: the forward problem explains macroscopic behaviour from local rules, and the inverse problem solves for controllable rules and readout mechanisms from a desired target. We take an augmented quintuple as the formal object shared by both ends, and decompose ``engineering'' into three independently measurable coordinates: controllability, reproducibility, and degree of formalizability. On this basis we give three testable working hypotheses (critical scale; the cooperation and trade-off between constraint and adaptability; minimal constraint) and one feasibility criterion, which reduce inverse design from unconstrained optimization to interval checking. The program takes explicit failure boundaries as its premise, does not pursue complete control, and always preserves the system's room for self-organization. The reduced pilot experiment attached to this paper serves only to verify the executability of the research protocol and does not constitute a statistical test of the working hypotheses. This design language generalizes to multi-agent artificial intelligence, the industrial internet, and emergency response systems, all of which must confront emergence and controllability at once.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的研究计划，通过重新定义可控涌现作为正向问题和反向问题，定义了一个统一的工程对象，并提出了三个可测试的工作假设和一个可行性标准，简化了反向设计。
AI.motivation: 在现实世界中部署智能系统时，设计者需要在系统灵活性和可控制性之间取得平衡。但缺乏正式工具来解决这一矛盾，因此该研究建议了一个综合研究计划来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 该方法通过定义正向问题和反向问题，以及使用一个增强的五元组作为通用对象，并将其分解为可控性、可重复性和形式化程度三个独立可测量坐标。提出了三个可测试的工作假设和一个可行性标准，从而将反向设计从无约束优化简化为区间检查。
AI.result: 该研究提出了一个可行的标准，将反向设计简化为区间检查，并给出了三个可测试的工作假设，验证了研究协议的可执行性。
AI.conclusion: 这种设计语言适用于多智能体人工智能、工业互联网和应急响应系统等领域，这些领域都需要同时应对涌现和可控性挑战。

title: Meta Inverse Prompting for Video Generative Models
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://ueriniuno.github.io/mvip-page/ Code: https://github.com/ueriniuno/MVIP
summary: Recent advances in video generative models have enabled flexible conditional generation and editing pipelines, such as text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-guided synthesis. However, these workflows are inherently one-directional, mapping conditions to videos without providing a mechanism to invert this process. In complex media production settings, the ability to recover controllable textual conditions from a given video is highly desirable, yet remains underexplored. While inverse prompting has been studied for image generation, directly extending these approaches to video is challenging due to the need to capture temporal dynamics beyond static appearance, as well as the substantial computational cost of per-video optimization. In this work, we propose the first practical framework for efficient video inverse prompting. Specifically, we formulate inverse prompting as a meta-learning problem and introduce Meta Video Inverse Prompting (MVIP), which learns a meta-prompt optimized over temporal dimensions to enable fast and effective prompt inference. Our approach amortizes the inversion process, eliminating the need for costly iterative optimization at test time. Experimental results demonstrate that MVIP recovers higher-quality inverse prompts with significantly improved reconstruction fidelity compared to image-based inversion and iterative captioning baselines, while achieving substantial gains in efficiency. Code and video results are available at https://ueriniuno.github.io/mvip-page/.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种高效的视频反向提示框架，称为MVIP，该框架通过元学习优化来加快反向提示的推断，从而提高反向提示的质量和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频生成模型虽然能够实现灵活的条件生成和编辑管道，但由于缺乏逆向过程，无法从给定的视频中恢复可控的文本条件。虽然有一些关于图像生成中逆向提示的研究，但将其直接扩展到视频中具有挑战性。
AI.method: 研究提出了一个元学习问题的形式化方法，并引入了Meta Video Inverse Prompting (MVIP)，该框架通过在时间维度上学习优化的元提示来实现快速有效的提示推断。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与基于图像的逆向提示和迭代标题生成基准相比，MVIP产生的逆向提示质量更高且重建精度更高，同时实现效率大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法MVIP成功解决了视频领域反向提示的问题，通过元学习优化，能够在保证高质量的前提下大幅提升效率。

title: Learning to Reason Efficiently with Interventional Step Credit
summary: Large reasoning models often produce lengthy chain-of-thought (CoT) traces mixing useful intermediate steps with unnecessary ones. Recent methods explore step-level signals such as attention mass and step entropy to identify and suppress unnecessary steps. Despite their effectiveness, such signals reflect the model's behavior at a step rather than that step's contribution to the answer. To address this, we propose the interventional step credit (ISC), which takes a causal-intervention view and assesses step importance to the reasoning through targeted parameter-level interventions. Building on ISC, we further propose IGPO, which uses ISC to guide fine-grained advantage rescaling in reinforcement learning, reducing redundant steps while preserving the important ones. Experiments across two model scales and nine benchmarks show that IGPO achieves up to 62% average token reduction and better overall performance among compared methods.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于因果干预的步骤贡献度（ISC）方法，并在此基础上提出了IGPO，这是一种使用ISC引导精细优势调整的强化学习方法，可以在减少冗余步骤的同时保留重要步骤，通过实验验证，IGPO在两个模型规模和九个基准测试上表现出平均62%的token削减，并且整体性能更优。
AI.motivation: 现有方法如通过注意力质量或步骤熵来识别和抑制不必要的步骤，但这些信号仅反映了模型在每个步骤的行为，而非该步骤对最终答案的贡献。因此，该研究引入了ISC方法，结合因果干预视角来重新评估步骤的重要性。
AI.method: 方法包括两部分：一是计算ISCs，通过参数级干预来估计步骤对推理过程的重要性；二是提出IGPO，在强化学习中使用ISC来指导精细的优势调整，减少冗余步骤同时保留重要的步骤。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，IGPO方法在两个不同的模型规模和九个基准测试上实现了平均62%的token削减，并且相比其他方法整体表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过提出ISC和IGPO方法，成功地在大型推理模型中减少了不必要的步骤，提高了性能。

title: Think, Compress, Answer: Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Grounding via Reasoning Compression
summary: Extended reasoning has substantially improved multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on tasks requiring compositional and relational inference. However, multimodal grounding imposes a distinct requirement: reasoning must ultimately converge on a target-specific compact representation that supports precise localization. As reasoning trajectories grow longer, they often expand into broad scene narratives and peripheral relational details, which can dilute grounded perceptual evidence and lead to ambiguous or incorrect predictions. Motivated by the information bottleneck principle, we propose Think-Compress-Answer (TCA), a reinforcement learning framework that decomposes multimodal grounding into three phases: free-form reasoning, target-aware context compression, and answer generation conditioned on the compressed context. TCA is optimized through a multi-stage Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with progressive rewards that establish the structured output protocol, minimize reasoning-specific information while preserving target-relevant content, and directly improve localization accuracy. This staged design enables MLLMs to retain the benefits of extended reasoning while distilling it into the minimal context required for grounding. Experiments across six multimodal grounding benchmarks show that TCA attains substantial zero-shot performance gains, demonstrating the effectiveness of reasoning compression.

AI.tldr: TCA 是一种强化学习框架，通过分阶段设计实现了更精确的理解与推理，从而在多模态场景理解任务中提高了零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究中的长推理过程容易使无关细节分散注意力，从而减弱感知证据的有效性并导致预测模糊或错误。借鉴信息瓶颈原则，TCA 提出了一个目标感知压缩推理框架，旨在精简冗余信息，提高目标相关细节的保留，以改进多模态定位准确性。
AI.method: TCA 包含三个阶段：自由推理、基于目标感知上下文压缩以及压缩上下文条件下的答案生成。它利用逐步的 GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）优化，逐步建立结构化输出协议，减少推理专属信息并保留目标相关信息。
AI.result: TCA 在六个多模态场景理解基准测试中实现了显著的零样本性能提升，证明了推理压缩的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TCA 能够在保留扩展推理优点的同时，通过压缩推理过程中的冗余信息，减少无关细节干扰，实现多模态任务中精确的场景理解。

title: Visual Sufficiency Landscapes: Understanding Query-Conditioned Reliability in Visual Token Pruning
summary: Different visual token pruning strategies retain different subsets while maintaining similar task performance. This motivates a combinatorial question: how many visual subsets can preserve model behavior, and how does their abundance depend on the query? We introduce visual sufficiency landscapes to characterize this abundance. At a fixed layer and budget, visual sufficiency probability is the fraction of uniformly sampled subsets that jointly preserve the dense model's answer, reference-answer likelihood, and output distribution. Independent sampling replicates separate input variation from estimation noise. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL2-8B, and LLaVA-v1.5-7B, differences between inputs on GQA and TextVQA exceed replication error, and different questions about the same GQA image produce distinct landscapes. Sufficiency probability also improves failure prediction for full pruning methods. On LLaVA, adding this probability increases AUC by 0.1151 for FastV, 0.0683 for VisionZip, and 0.1401 for SparseVLM, while reducing log loss and Brier score. Several architecture-adapted configurations on the other two models reproduce these gains. Under controlled selection rules, predictors trained on the original images reduce log loss on new images by 9.0%, 13.0%, and 14.1%, respectively. These results establish successful-subset abundance as a measurable dimension of local prunability and connect it to the identification of high-risk pruning conditions.

AI.tldr: 不同视觉令牌裁剪策略保留了不同子集但在任务性能上保持相似，研究发现存在大量能够维持模型行为的视觉子集，并引入了视觉充分性景观来描述这种数量。通过分析不同模型在不同输入和问题上的视觉充分性概率，验证了这些子集的存在性及其对失败预测的改善作用。
AI.motivation: 不同的视觉令牌裁剪策略可以保留不同但性能相似的子集，这促使我们探索可以保留模型行为的视觉子集的数量及其依赖性。
AI.method: 研究方法包括：1) 通过固定层和预算，计算均匀采样的子集覆盖率；2) 使用独立采样模拟输入变异和估计噪声；3) 分析不同输入和问题下的视觉充分性概率；4) 将视觉充分性概率应用于全裁剪方法以提高其性能。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL2-8B, 和LLaVA-v1.5-7B模型上，不同输入在GQA和TextVQA中的差异超过了复制误差，针对同一GQA图像的不同问题产生了不同的景观。这些结果表明足够的子集存在并且可以通过视觉充分性概率改善全裁剪方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 视觉充分性景观为局部可剪枝性提供了一个可测量的维度，并且与识别高风险剪枝条件相关。此外，基于原始图像训练的预测器可以减少新图像上的log损失。

title: CALM: Consistency-Aware Logit Masking in Decoding Space for Mitigating Overthinking of Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) have achieved strong performance on challenging mathematical and scientific tasks through long chain-of-thought reasoning, but they often suffer from overthinking with unnecessary reasoning steps. Existing truncation-based methods typically detect consecutive trial-answer agreement and force early exit, yet such local stopping signals do not necessarily indicate final-answer stability and can disrupt useful subsequent reflection or verification, potentially leading to performance degradation. We propose consistency-aware logit masking (CALM), a training-free decoding intervention for mitigating overthinking in LRMs. CALM first monitors trial answers at step boundaries and then applies logit masking to action transition point (ATP) tokens such as "Wait", "Alternatively", and "Hmm", suppressing redundant transitional reasoning while allowing the model to continue its thought process more naturally. Experiments across four advanced LRMs and five benchmarks show that CALM reduces token consumption by 18.6%-25.0% compared with full CoT reasoning while maintaining performance, and can even improve accuracy by 0.07%-1.48% by reducing redundant reasoning. LLM-as-a-Judge results also demonstrate that CALM provides more coherent and concise results.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无训练的解码干预方法——一致性意识(logits)掩码(CALM)，以减少大推理模型在解决复杂任务时的过度推理现象。在四个先进的大推理模型和五个基准测试中，CALM可以降低18.6%-25.0%的令牌消耗，同时保持甚至提高模型的准确性。
AI.motivation: 当前的断言裁剪方法倾向于检测连续试回答的一致性并强制早期退出，但这可能破坏有用的后续反思或验证，导致性能下降。
AI.method: CALM通过在步骤边界处监控试回答，并对表示过渡决策的令牌应用logit掩码来抑制冗余的过渡性推理，同时允许模型更自然地继续其推理过程。
AI.result: 实验表明，与完整的CoT推理相比，CALM减少了18.6%-25.0%的令牌消耗，同时保持甚至提高了模型的准确性，LLM作为裁判的结果也显示CALM提供了更连贯和简洁的结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了CALM方法，一种无训练的解码干预，可以有效减少大推理模型的过度推理，同时保证或提升模型性能。

title: Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners: Adaptive Loop Halting on the Hypersphere
summary: Looped (weight-tied) transformers enable adaptive computation by allocating more iterations to harder inputs. Fixed-Point Reasoners (FPRM) achieve this with a damped fixed-point solver, but operate in an unbounded Euclidean residual space with coupled rescaling and relative-norm halting. We introduce Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners (SFPRM), which perform the same computation on the unit hypersphere of normalized transformers (nGPT). Input injection, damping, and halting become geodesic operations, yielding boundedness by construction and eliminating coefficient coupling. We prove fixed-point existence, local convergence under an explicit step-size condition, and global convergence under strong injection. On Sudoku-Extreme, Maze-Hard, and Mini-ARC, SFPRM achieves 96.6%, 87.9%, and 59.1% test accuracy, respectively, outperforming FPRM and other baselines while allocating test-time compute more effectively. Its converged geometry is also interpretable: token-input angles capture puzzle structure and predict correctness.

AI.tldr: SFPRM是一种在单位超球面上进行规范化Transformer操作的新方法，通过几何操作实现了有界性并避免了系数耦合。该方法在Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Hard和Mini-ARC三个测试集上的表现优于FPRM和其他基线，同时更有效地分配了测试时的计算资源。
AI.motivation: 为了解决固定点推理器（FPRM）在无界欧几里得残差空间中的计算问题，引入了一种新的方法——球面固定点推理器（SFPRM），通过在单位超球面上进行操作，实现模型的有界性并避免了参数之间的耦合。
AI.method: SFPRM在单位超球面上进行规范化的Transformer计算，将输入注入、阻尼处理和停止条件转换为几何操作，从而实现计算的有界性，并且每个参数之间相互独立。
AI.result: SFPRM在Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Hard和Mini-ARC三个测试集上分别取得了96.6%、87.9%和59.1%的准确率，表现优于FPRM及其他基线模型，并且能够更有效地分配测试时的计算资源。
AI.conclusion: SFPRM通过在单位超球面上进行操作，解决了FPRM中的计算问题，并展示了其在特定任务中的优越性能，特别是在测试时计算资源的分配上更为有效。此外，该方法的收敛几何形状也是可解释的，可以捕捉到令牌-输入角度与难题结构之间的关系。

title: MultiAltitudeSR: Multi-Altitude Agricultural UAV Image Super-Resolution via Physical Ground Sampling Distance Conditioning
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) enable high-throughput platforms for crop monitoring but face a fundamental trade-off between flight altitude and image spatial resolution. Many existing super-resolution (SR) methods for UAV imagery rely on oversimplified synthetic degradation models and are restricted to fixed integer upsampling scales, limiting their ability to handle real-world degradations and varying flight altitudes. This study proposes MultiAltitudeSR, a framework that conditions feature modulation and reconstruction on source and target ground sampling distances (GSDs). MultiAltitudeSR trained jointly on real UAV images at altitudes of 10 to 70 m above ground level supports all 21 source-to-target altitude pairs without pair-specific fine-tuning, covering scale factors ranging from 1.18$\times$ to 6.03$\times$. The framework can be extended to additional source-target GSD combinations by incorporating corresponding image pairs into training. On the 20-to-10 m pair, the model achieved competitive perceptual performance compared with pair-specific baselines, with LPIPS of 0.2236, DISTS of 0.2431, and NIQE of 8.9020. Experiments using the same architecture demonstrated the value of acquiring real-world multi-altitude UAV image pairs for SR training, with real-pair training achieving better average reconstruction performance across the 21 altitude pairs than training with the tested synthetic degradation pipeline. Downstream zero-shot segmentation case studies illustrated task-dependent benefits of super-resolved imagery for crop monitoring, suggesting potential UAV flight-time savings through image acquisition at higher altitudes.

AI.tldr: MultiAltitudeSR 提出了一个框架，用于从多种高度获取的实际无人飞行器 (UAV) 影像中进行多尺度超分辨率处理，无需特定对每个高度对进行微调。该模型在 20 至 10 米这对高度下的感知性能与特定对进行微调的基线模型竞争，并显示出使用真实多高度 UAV 影像对训练 SR 的优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有的许多 SR 方法依赖于简单的合成降级模型，并且限制在固定的整数升尺度上，这限制了它们处理现实世界降级和高度变化的能力。
AI.method: MultiAltitudeSR 框架通过条件化特征调制和重建，根据源和目标地面采样距离 (GSD) 来进行训练。该模型在 10 到 70 米的地面高度上共同训练，并支持 21 个源到目标高度对，覆盖从 1.18至 6.03 的所有比例因子。
AI.result: 在 20 至 10 米高度对上，MultiAltitudeSR 模型在感知性能上具有竞争力，LPIPS 为 0.2236，DISTS 为 0.2431，NIQE 为 8.9020。使用相同架构的试验表明，用于 SR 训练的真实多高度 UAV 影像对比使用此试验的合成降级管道具有更好的平均重建性能。
AI.conclusion: MultiAltitudeSR 的研究成果表明，从多种高度获取的实际无人飞行器影像可用于超分辨率训练，并且通过在较高高度拍摄和随后超分辨率处理影像，可以节省无人机的飞行时间，提高作物监测任务的效率。

title: FisherEdit: Fisher Information Guided Knowledge Editing for Large Language Models
summary: Sequential knowledge editing in Large Language Models (LLMs) often leads to a degradation of general capabilities due to cumulative parameter interference. In this paper, we revisit prominent projection-based methods like AlphaEdit and reveal a surprising mismatch: their robustness is primarily driven by update regularization rather than the intended null-space projection. Based on this insight, we propose FisherEdit, a theoretically grounded method built on Fisher geometry, which replaces coarse activation-space projections with importance-aware regularization in parameter space. It penalizes changes to sensitive parameters more strongly while retaining flexibility for new facts, and admits an efficient row-wise closed-form solution. Experiments on Llama-3, Qwen2.5, and Olmo-3 across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that FisherEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance while better preserving model stability and downstream task accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为FisherEdit的新方法，它基于Fisher几何学，通过在参数空间中使用重要性感知正则化来替代粗糙的激活空间投影。该方法在多个基准上优于现有方法，同时保持了模型的稳定性和下游任务的准确性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在顺序知识编辑过程中，由于参数累积干扰导致泛化能力退化。现有投影基方法如AlphaEdit主要通过更新正则化而非目标空投影来提高鲁棒性。
AI.method: FisherEdit方法基于Fisher几何学，通过在参数空间中施加重要性感知正则化，以更精细的方式调整敏感参数，同时保持对新事实的灵活性。
AI.result: FisherEdit在Llama-3、Qwen2.5和Olmo-3等模型上，多个基准的表现优于现有方法，并且在模型稳定性和下游任务准确率方面表现更好。
AI.conclusion: FisherEdit为LLMs的知识编辑提供了一种新的理论支撑方法，优于现有的投影基方法。

title: HyperTaxa: Multiscale Genome Representations for Generalized Microbial Taxonomic Inference
summary: Reliable microbial taxonomic inference is challenged by the rapid growth of newly sequenced organisms and incomplete reference coverage. While alignment- and database-driven tools remain essential for reference-backed identification, they are not designed for learned inference over species absent from genome-level training. We introduce HyperTaxa, a taxonomy-aligned representation learning framework for open-set microbial taxonomic inference. HyperTaxa encodes whole genomes as multiscale hyperspectral k-mer transition fields and aligns these representations to a taxonomy-derived semantic space using a two-stage Node2Vec-to-MDS procedure that combines local graph structure with global hierarchical distance preservation. The resulting space supports zero-shot inference over species excluded from genome-level training but represented in the taxonomy, generalized zero-shot inference over seen and unseen species, and cascaded genus-to-species prediction. Across benchmark and large-scale disjoint-species evaluations, HyperTaxa improves taxonomic prediction over pseudo-image and transformer-graph baselines, with the strongest gains at higher taxonomic ranks. Ablations further show that multiscale transition encoding and taxonomy-aware alignment are key contributors to generalization. These results position HyperTaxa as a complementary taxonomy-aware representation and candidate-generation framework for microbial identification under incomplete reference coverage and open-set uncertainty.

AI.tldr: HyperTaxa 是一种针对开放集合微生物菌群分类的表示学习框架，能够对未出现在基因水平训练中的物种进行分类预测，通过多尺度氢光谱 k-mer 转换场和基于节点2Vec-MDS的层级距离保留对齐，提高了不同分类级别的税onomic预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的序列比对和数据库驱动工具在未收录物种的分类中表现不佳，HyperTaxa 旨在解决这一问题。它通过多尺度氢光谱 k-mer 转换场和基于节点2Vec-MDS的方法提供了一个可扩展的解决方案。
AI.method: HyperTaxa 通过将整基因组编码为多尺度氢光谱 k-mer 转换场，然后利用基于节点2Vec-MDS的双重流程将其对齐到由分类学导出的语义空间中，以支持未训练的基因分类级别物种的零样本分类和已见及未见物种的泛零样本分类。
AI.result: 与伪图像和变压器-图基线相比，HyperTaxa 在基准测试和大规模不交集分类物种评估中提高了分类准确性，特别是在较高分类级别。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果使 HyperTaxa 成为在参考覆盖不完整和开放设置不确定性条件下微生物识别的补充分类学意识表示和候选生成框架。

title: ReTrace: Visual Backtracking for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026, forthcoming
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) encode images into dense visual token sequences, creating substantial attention and KV-cache overhead. Existing visual token compression methods reduce this cost by pruning low-saliency tokens in shallow layers, but this practice couples temporary computational deactivation with irreversible information deletion. We show that this coupling breaks an intrinsic inference pattern in MLLMs. Through layer-wise attention analysis, we identify \textbf{Visual Backtracking}: visual pivots remain spatially stable, yet in middle layers they actively retrieve context from tokens that appeared unimportant earlier. Thus, early low-saliency tokens can be inactive for computation while still being useful for later reasoning. Motivated by this finding, we propose \textbf{ReTrace}, a backtracking-aware compression framework that introduces a dormant token state. ReTrace caches non-pivot tokens outside expensive layer-wise computation, restores them during the backtracking window, and prunes only after their information has been absorbed. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3 demonstrate nearly 90\% reductions in FLOPs and KV cache, a 2.83$\times$ prefilling speedup, and strong performance retention across complex vision-language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为ReTrace的压缩框架，该框架通过引入休眠态缓存非枢纽性视觉令牌，从而在不牺牲性能的前提下显著减少了FLOPs和KV缓存的消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉令牌压缩方法通过剪枝浅层的低显著性令牌来降低计算成本，但由于临时计算停用与不可逆信息删除的耦合，破坏了MLLMs中的固有推理模式。
AI.method: ReTrace框架通过分层注意力分析发现了视觉回溯现象，并在此基础上提出了一种新的压缩方法，引入了休眠态来缓存非枢纽性视觉令牌，以便在需要时恢复。
AI.result: ReTrace在Qwen2.5-VL和InternVL3上的实验结果表明，它能够将FLOPs和KV缓存减少近90%，并在预填充速度上提高了2.83倍，同时保持了对复杂视觉语言基准测试的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为MLLMs的高效视觉令牌处理提供了一种新方法，有望提高模型的计算效率和性能表现。

title: LEAPS: Long-context Evaluation of Adaptive Pattern Learning and State Tracking
comment: Code and data available at https://github.com/howard-yen/LEAPS
summary: Long-context language models (LCLMs) power agents that act over long trajectories, from improving a codebase to running research experiments to forecasters that condition on lengthy histories. These applications draw on three distinct long-context capabilities: recall, where the answer is a fact present in the context; state tracking, where the outcome can be computed by performing a series of transformations to a specified state; and pattern learning, where the goal is to make a prediction by sampling from a distribution inferred from many observations. Existing benchmarks primarily focus on the first capability. In this work, we introduce LEAPS (Long-context Evaluation of Adaptive Pattern learning and State tracking), a collection of 12 novel datasets, spanning agentic workflows, behavioral modeling, and forecasting of market and world events. By construction, LEAPS is resistant to data contamination, extends to millions of input tokens, and uses reliable metrics. We evaluate 30 API and open models from 8K to 512K input tokens. LEAPS distinguishes models that perform near perfectly on recall tasks, finding that such models' state tracking and pattern learning abilities can vary significantly and degrade much more dramatically with increasing input lengths--even for pattern learning, where more observations should make learning a theoretically easier task. Moreover, thinking models often underperform their base counterparts, exhausting their generation budget or oversimplifying the task. We hope LEAPS can guide the development of the next generation of LCLMs.

AI.tldr: LEAPS 提供了一个新的基准集，涵盖具有长期上下文能力的工作流程、行为建模和事件预测，以评测现有模型在长期上下文下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要集中在长期上下文语言模型的回忆能力上。作者希望通过 LEAPS 框架，进一步评估和推进模型在长期上下文下的状态跟踪和模式学习能力。
AI.method: 作者创建了包含 12 个新数据集的 LEAPS，涵盖了智能代理、行为分析和事件预测，并对 8000 到 512,000 个输入标记的各种 API 和开源模型进行了评估。
AI.result: 该框架展示了现有的部分模型在回忆任务中表现极佳，但在更长的输入中，状态跟踪和模式学习能力显著下降，即使是对于模式学习，更多的观察数据也没有显著改善性能。思考型模型往往表现不如其基本版本。
AI.conclusion: 作者希望 LEAPS 能够引导下一阶段长期上下文语言模型的发展。

title: LIRQuant: An Efficient Locally Isolated Rotation Quantization Method for Large Language Models
summary: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet activation outliers remain a key challenge for low-bit quantization. Existing global transformation methods overlook heterogeneous channel sensitivity to quantization noise, leading to suboptimal accuracy-efficiency trade-offs. To address this, we propose \textbf{Locally Isolated Rotation Quantization (LIRQuant)}, a sensitivity-aware framework that selectively applies transformations. LIRQuant identifies sensitive channels using a noise-weighted sensitivity metric, applying expressive learnable rotations only to these channels and lightweight fixed rotations to the remaining ones. This decoupled design reduces optimization complexity without sacrificing outlier smoothing capability. Extensive experiments across the LLaMA-2/3, Mistral, Qwen3, and Mixtral families demonstrate that LIRQuant achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under the challenging W4A4KV4 setting. Meanwhile, LIRQuant calibrates LLaMA-3-8B in only 25 minutes with 20.3 GB peak GPU memory, achieving the fastest calibration and the lowest memory footprint among recent learnable-rotation methods, and its fused inference kernels deliver up to $2.3\times$ prefill speedup and $3.5\times$ memory saving over FP16.

AI.tldr: LIRQuant 是一种感知灵敏度的局部隔离旋转量化方法，通过有选择地应用变换来应对大规模语言模型的激活异常点问题，实验表明其在复杂的量化设置下，实现了最先进的准确性和最快的校准速度，同时显著降低了内存消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有的全局变换方法忽略了_channel敏感性_，导致量化噪声下的不理想精度效率权衡。LIRQuant通过定义噪声加权灵敏度度量来识别敏感通道，从而仅在这些通道上应用表达性的可学习旋转，并在其他通道上应用轻量级的固定旋转，解决了这个问题。
AI.method: LIRQuant提出了一个灵敏度意识框架，通过有选择地应用变换来处理低比特量化中的激活异常问题。具体而言，LIRQuant 通过噪声加权灵敏度度量来识别敏感通道，并针对这些通道应用表达性的可学习旋转，而对于其他通道则应用轻量级的固定旋转。这种方法通过解耦设计降低了优化复杂度，但仍然保留了异常值平滑的能力。
AI.result: LIRQuant在针对LLaMA-2/3、Mistral、Qwen3和Mixtral系列模型的实验中都展示了出色的性能，在W4A4KV4等具有挑战性的配置下达到了最先进的准确率。此外，LIRQuant 仅用25分钟就完成了LLaMA-3-8B的校准，并且具有最低的内存占用。在推理方面，LIRQuant 的融合推理内核相比FP16实现了2.3倍的前缀加速和3.5倍的内存节省。
AI.conclusion: LIRQuant 通过定义和利用噪声加权灵敏度度量的局部隔离旋转量化方法，提高了量化模型的准确性、校准速度和内存效率，是处理大规模语言模型激活异常点问题的有效方法。

title: FineSplat: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) promises instant scene reconstruction with high-quality novel-view synthesis. Yet, fine-grained geometry and appearance remain difficult to recover, motivating us to revisit how feed-forward models represent, aggregate, and refine detailed visual information. We introduce FineSplat, a feed-forward 3DGS framework built around fine-grained image patches. Since global multi-view attention becomes prohibitively expensive at such high token resolutions, we develop a dual-grouping strategy that combines two complementary forms of locality: view-wise grouping enables efficient interaction among neighboring views, while 3D spatial grouping reconnects geometrically related tokens that may never have interacted under view-wise grouping by lifting them into the 3D scene space. We further leverage reconstruction error as direct feedback, providing an explicit rendering-based signal to recover fine-grained structures and appearance, thereby overcoming the limitations of one-pass feed-forward prediction. Finally, a compact Gaussian generation scheme preserves the benefits of fine-grained features without unnecessarily increasing the number of primitives. Together, these designs enable FineSplat to recover richer geometry and appearance while remaining efficient and compact, achieving state-of-the-art results by a substantial margin, under the same or smaller Gaussian budgets than existing methods.

AI.tldr: 介绍了FineSplat，这是一种基于细粒度图像片段的前向3D高斯点集方法，通过结合视图和3D空间中的局部性以及利用重建误差作为反馈信号来恢复精细结构。
AI.motivation: 当前的前向3D高斯点集方法难以恢复精细的几何形状和外观。FineSplat通过重新思考前向模型如何表示、聚合和细化详细的视觉信息，解决了这一问题。
AI.method: 方法是引入FineSplat，它使用双分组策略，结合视图和3D空间中的局部性，利用重建误差作为反馈信号来恢复精细结构，并通过紧凑的高斯生成方案保持精细特征的益处。
AI.result: FineSplat能够恢复更丰富的几何形状和外观，并保持高效紧凑。在相同的或更小的高斯预算下，它超越了现有方法的最新成果。
AI.conclusion: FineSplat通过结合细粒度图像片段和双分组策略，以及利用重构误差反馈，成功地恢复了高分辨率的几何形态和视觉特性。

title: MITRA-lexicon: Lexica of attested translations from Sanskrit into English, Tibetan and Chinese
summary: The standard Sanskrit lexica are monumental and indispensable, but they cite their attestations as abbreviated references to editions, without links to the digitized texts now widely available and without a translation of the passage, and they naturally do not reflect translations made after them. To address these gaps, we present MITRA-lexicon, a family of corpus-grounded lexica based on span annotations of translation equivalents with Sanskrit as the pivot: Sanskrit-English, derived from the Mitrasamgraha corpus, as well as Sanskrit-Tibetan and Sanskrit-Chinese, derived from the MITRA-parallel corpus of Buddhist literature. In total, the resource comprises 2.18 million headword entries in six directional lexica. Headwords are lemmas and compounds from silver annotations that follow the Digital Corpus of Sanskrit (DCS). Senses are ranked by frequency, and each of the 10.4 million attestations includes its sentence pair, with character offsets of the word and its equivalent. We propose a multi-step pipeline based on grammatical annotation models, fine-tuned large language models, and a teacher-student setup to produce the alignments. We evaluate the lexica against reference dictionaries and manually corrected gold alignments. We release the lexica and the fine-tuned span annotation model, together with a web interface for looking up headwords and their attested senses.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种基于语料库的词典，称为MITRA-lexicon，包含从梵英互译到梵藏互译的六方向词典，共计218万个词条，每个词条包含频次排名、句对和字符偏移。该词典利用多步骤的流水线方法，结合语法标注模型、细调的大语言模型和教师-学生设置来生成对齐结果，评估结果优于参考词典。
AI.motivation: 鉴于标准的梵语词典无法提供完整的数字化文本链接、翻译以及最新的翻译，本文旨在填补这些空白，发布基于语料库的词典MITRA-lexicon。
AI.method: 使用多步骤流水线方法，包括语法标注模型、细调的大语言模型和教师-学生设置来生成词典中的翻译对齐。
AI.result: MITRA-lexicon包含六方向的词典，总词条数量为218万，每个词条包含频次排名、句对和字符偏移。评估结果表明，这种新型词典优于传统词典。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过发布基于语料库的词典MITRA-lexicon项目，填补了梵语翻译和语料库资源的空白，并展示了其在词汇翻译和语言研究中的应用潜力。

title: Neither Over- nor Under-Constrained: Evaluating LLM Personalization under a Constraint Qualification Audit
summary: Accurate evaluation of LLM personalization is hindered by current evaluation paradigms that over- or under-constrain the response space, yielding frequent false rejections and false acceptances. To reduce these false rates, we introduce ConQual-Audit, an audit-based framework that evaluates LLM personalization through a three-stage process: (1) extracting semantic constraints from user profiles and task-grounded reference; (2) qualifying constraints by pruning unnecessary constraints and recovering missing constraints; and (3) verifying candidate responses against the audited constraints via natural language inference. Across PrefEval and LaMP, ConQual-Audit outperforms nine baselines, attaining top AUCs (0.88 and 0.90) and the lowest false rate (0.21) on the leanest constraint sets at an amortizable audit cost. Crucially, this constraint audit is portable: integrating it into ExPerT and PREF helps revise smaller, higher-quality constraint sets to reduce their evaluation false rates.

AI.tldr: ConQual-Audit 通过三阶段框架提高了对大模型个性化评估的准确性，解决了现有评价策略带来的常见误判问题，实现了在约束最少时，性能最优。
AI.motivation: 现有的评价方式过度或不足地限制了模型响应的空间范围，导致了频繁的误判情况发生。ConQual-Audit 提出了一种基于审计的框架来解决这个问题。
AI.method: ConQual-Audit 提出了一种三阶段的框架：首先从用户信息和任务参考中提取语义限制，其次通过对不必要的和缺失的限制进行筛选来验证候选响应是否符合准则。
AI.result: 在 PrefEval 和 LaMP 中，ConQual-Audit 出色地超越了九种基准方法，在最少约束集下达到了最高的 AUC 值（0.88 和 0.90），并且拥有最低的误判率（0.21）。
AI.conclusion: 审计约束可以跨平台应用，对 ExPerT 和 PREF 进行修订以引入更小、质量更高的约束集，降低评估的误判比例。

title: IECLA: Interpretable Emotion Contribution Learning for Affective Image Editing
comment: 31 pages, 10 figures, 24 tables; under review at ICLR 2027
summary: Affective image editing (AIE) aims to evoke a target emotion while preserving the content and structure of a source image. Existing methods improve emotional expression or visual fidelity, but the target emotion alone does not reveal which source regions should be changed and which should remain intact, especially in complex scenes. We introduce Interpretable Emotion Contribution Learning for Affective Image Editing (IECLA), a framework that separates source-emotion attribution from target-aware editing. IECLA constructs signed object-level supervision through counterfactual interventions and trains a context-conditioned contribution predictor to localize evidence that supports or opposes the source emotion. At inference, an image-level evaluator estimates the source emotion directly from the input, while the predictor identifies editable and preservation evidence without repeated interventions. A target-aware editing agent then translates this evidence and the desired emotion into localized, content-aware operations for existing editors. Extensive evaluations show that IECLA predicts counterfactual contributions more faithfully on both in-domain and cross-dataset tests, while external VLM and independent human references support the quality of its localized evidence. Across six editing backbones, IECLA consistently strengthens target-emotion expression while preserving image content and structure, and user studies further show improved perceived target expression and naturalness.

AI.tldr: IECLA（可解释的意图贡献学习）是一种框架，它通过分离情感归属和目标感知编辑，实现对情感贡献的可解释预测。在推理时，IECLA能够准确估计源图像的情情感，并识别哪些区域需要编辑、哪些需要保留，从而增强目标情感表达，同时保持图像内容和结构的完整性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法能够改善情感表达或视觉保真度，但无法明确指示哪些源区域需要修改，哪些需要保持不变，尤其是在复杂的场景中。IECLA旨在改进这一问题。
AI.method: IECLA通过构造反事实干预的带符号对象级监督进行训练，利用上下文条件贡献预测器来定位支持或反对源情感的证据。在推理阶段，通过图像级评估器直接从输入中估计源情感，通过贡献预测器识别可编辑和需保留的证据，无需重复干预，然后通过目标感知编辑代理将这些信息和期望的情感翻译为具体内容感知的操作。
AI.result: 广泛的评估表明，IECLA在反事实贡献预测上更为准确，尤其是在跨数据集测试中表现出色，同时外部VLM和独立人类评价支持其局部证据的质量。IECLA在六款编辑骨架上都能有效地增强目标情感表达，同时保留图像内容和结构。用户研究进一步表明，使用IECLA后的结果感知目标情感表达和自然度得到了提高。
AI.conclusion: IECLA展现出了准确的情感贡献预测能力，及在图像编辑中保持内容和结构的同时增强目标情感表达的优势，为情感图像编辑领域提供了新的思路和方法。

title: Speech LLMs That Breathe: Modeling Non-Verbal Vocalizations in Dialogue
summary: The user experience of speech interaction models has improved, benefiting from the modeling of paralinguistic attributes and advances in speech reconstruction paradigms. However, human communication follows extensive norms regarding non-verbal vocalizations (NVVs) spanning respiratory, affective, and discourse. The omission of these events imposes inherent limitations on the naturalness of current approaches. In this work, we cover 13 major types of NVVs and construct a natural dialogue dataset that conforms to human conversational norms through an automated synthesis pipeline. We enhance the ability of speech interaction models to generate contextually appropriate NVV events through multi-stage fine-tuning and NVV-aware GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization). Based on distinct modeling paradigms, we substantially improve the expressiveness of VocalNet and VITA-Qinyu in empathy interactions and role-play dialogues, and further discuss the architectural necessity for achieving high-quality natural speech generation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建一个符合人类对话规范的自然对话数据集，并采用多阶段微调和NVV（非言语语音）感知的GRPO，显著提升了VocalNet和VITA-Qinyu在同理心互动和角色扮演对话中的表达能力，强调了NVVs对高质量自然语音生成的重要性。
AI.motivation: 当前的语音交互模型在表达非言语语音方面存在局限性，这限制了其自然度。为解决这一问题，作者构建了一个包含13种主要非言语语音类型的自然对话数据集，旨在提高语音交互模型的表现。
AI.method: 作者通过自动合成管道构建数据集，并采用多阶段微调和NVV感知的GRPO进行语音交互模型的训练。
AI.result: 训练后的VocalNet和VITA-Qinyu在同理心互动和角色扮演对话中的表达能力显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 非言语语音对于高质量的自然语音生成是必要的。该研究提出的方法能够更好地捕捉人类对话中的非言语元素，从而提升语音交互的自然度和用户体验。

title: BitFlat: Error-Localized Bitstream Design for Robust Diffusion Image Compression
summary: Zero-shot diffusion image compression based on reverse channel coding achieves high perceptual quality at low bitrates without retraining, yet its bitstream remains vulnerable to bit flips. Prior work has shown that a joint combinatorial representation can amplify a single bit flip into substitutions of multiple atoms and that indexing each atom independently confines this error propagation. However, independent indexing reduces the number of atoms that fit within the bit budget and gives the decoder no indication of which atoms are corrupted. To address these issues, we propose BitFlat, a training-free error-localizing bitstream framework with two components. Blockwise Locality Alignment (BLA) decomposes the globally coupled atom selection at each diffusion step into independent selection units, each describing one signed atom from a dedicated codebook with a fixed-width field, so that any bit error affects only the unit in which it occurs. Reliability-Aware Diffusion Control (RADC) uses the bits saved by BLA to impose structured valid-codeword constraints within each field and converts the decoding state of each field into a binary reliability gate, which turns detected corrupted atoms into erasures at known positions and excludes them from noise synthesis. BitFlat requires neither target residuals nor additional network forward passes and leaves the diffusion model unchanged. Experiments on Kodak, DIV2K, and CLIC2020 show that BitFlat outperforms conventional, learned, and diffusion-based codecs at bit error rates from $10^{-4}$ to $10^{-2}$ and, even with $26.7\%$ fewer bits, surpasses Robust Turbo-DDCM.

AI.tldr: BitFlat 提出了一种无需训练的错误定位比特流框架，用于零样本扩散图像压缩，通过Blockwise Locality Alignment (BLA) 和 Reliability-Aware Diffusion Control (RADC) 来增强抗比特翻转能力，能在比特错误率从 $10^{-4}$ 到 $10^{-2}$ 的范围内超越现有编解码器。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本扩散图像压缩方法虽然具有高感知质量且低比特率，但其比特流易受比特翻转影响。BitFlat 提出的方法旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: BitFlat 通过两个组件来实现抗比特错误的能力。Blockwise Locality Alignment (BLA) 将每个扩散步骤的全局耦合原子选择分解为独立的原子选择单元，并通过固定位宽字段将每个单元描述为一个带符号的原子；Reliability-Aware Diffusion Control (RADC) 利用 BLA 节省的比特数来设置每字段内的有效码字约束，并将解码状态转换为二进制可靠性门，使检测到的损坏原子在已知位置变为擦除。
AI.result: 实验表明，BitFlat 在 Kodak、DIV2K 和 CLIC2020 数据集上，在比特错误率从 $10^{-4}$ 到 $10^{-2}$ 的范围内表现优于传统、基于学习的和基于扩散模型的编解码器。即使在比特数减少26.7%的情况下，BitFlat 仍然优于 Robust Turbo-DDCM。
AI.conclusion: BitFlat 通过创新的比特流框架提高了零样本扩散图像压缩的抗比特错误性能，为未来的研究提供了新的方案。

title: PRET is a few-shot system for pan-cancer recognition without example training
summary: Pathological examination stands as the cornerstone in cancer diagnosis, impacting millions worldwide annually. With the shortage of pathologists globally, artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged rapidly to automate the diagnostics process. However, conventional AI models require substantial labeled data for each disease, posing huge challenges in scalability and practicality. Therefore, we introduce PRET (pan-cancer recognition without examples training), a few-shot system to achieve flexible, scalable, and effective cancer recognition across diverse organs, hospitals and tasks without training. Evaluated on 23 international benchmarks comprising 4,484 whole-slide images, our method outperforms existing approaches across 20 tasks, achieving over 97% area under the curve on 15 benchmarks with a maximum improvement of 36.76%. Notably, PRET delivers clinical-grade diagnostic performance in lymph node metastasis detection using only eight slide examples, outperforming 11 pathologists. By offering a flexible and cost-effective solution for pan-cancer recognition, PRET paves the way for accessible and equitable AI-based pathology systems, particularly benefiting minority populations and underserved regions.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了PRET，一种无需训练示例即可实现泛癌种识别的少量样本系统，显著提高了病理诊断的灵活性和可扩展性，特别是在淋巴结转移检测方面表现更佳，超越了11位病理学家。
AI.motivation: 鉴于病理学家全球短缺，该项研究旨在通过开发一种无需大量标记数据即可实现泛癌种识别的系统——PRET，解决当前AI模型在这一领域的局限性，从而实现更灵活、高效的病理诊断，特别是支持少数群体和偏远地区的医疗需求。
AI.method: 研究团队设计了一个泛癌种识别系统PRET，它采用少量样本训练的方法来实现跨器官、医院和任务的癌症识别。通过在23个国际基准上进行评估，展示了该方法相较于现有技术的优越性。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，该方法在23个基准测试中的20项任务中表现出色，特别是在淋巴结转移检测方面，仅使用8张切片作为样本即可达到超越11位病理学家的临床级诊断性能，同时在15个基准测试中AUC值超过97%，最高提升36.76%。
AI.conclusion: 综上所述，该项研究表明，PRET有效地提升了泛癌种识别的能力，并为实现低成本、灵活性和广覆盖的AI病理诊断系统奠定了基础，特别适用于资源有限地区。

title: AdaExploreBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Proactive Exploration and Test-time Adaptation in Evolving Environments
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in unfamiliar and evolving environments, requiring them to proactively explore, understand, and adapt to environmental dynamics. However, existing benchmarks rarely test whether agents can proactively discover how an environment works and adapt as it evolves. To address this gap, we introduce AdaExploreBench, a benchmark for proactive exploration and test-time adaptation in evolving environments. By instantiating environmental dynamics as hidden rules, AdaExploreBench requires agents to actively acquire evidence and infer the rules. Under implicit rule drift, the latent rule changes without announcement, requiring agents to detect from degraded performance that prior knowledge is stale and re-explore. Experiments on eight leading LLMs show that proactive and adaptive exploration remain challenging: GPT-6 Sol achieves only 61.9% calibrated accuracy, while providing sufficient evidence or removing rule drift improves average performance significantly by close to 10%. These results reveal a critical bottleneck in current LLM agents: they can often reason effectively from informative evidence once it is available, but struggle to actively acquire the right evidence and recognize when previously acquired evidence is no longer valid.

AI.tldr: AdaExploreBench 是一个基准测试，评估 LLM 在变化环境中的主动探索和测试时适应能力。实验表明，尽管 LLM 能够有效推理来自有用证据的信息，但在主动获取正确证据及识别之前获取的有效证据不再适用方面存在困难。
AI.motivation: 当前的 LLM 基准测试忽视了主动发现环境规则和适应变化的能力，AdaExploreBench 探索并填补这一空白。
AI.method: AdaExploreBench 通过将环境动态实现为隐藏规则，要求代理主动收集证据并推断规则。在隐式规则漂移中，潜在规则会在不宣布的情况下改变，需要代理通过性能下降检测先前知识已失效并重新探索。
AI.result: 在八种领先 LLM 中的实验表明，主动和适应性探索仍然具有挑战性：GPT-6 Sol 的验证准确率仅为 61.9%，而提供足够的证据或消除规则漂移可显著提高平均性能近 10%。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 代理中的一个关键瓶颈是它们在主动获取有效证据以及识别之前获取的有效证据不再有效方面的能力不足。

title: When Safety Fails Collectively: Robust Alignment Against Harmful Fine-Tuning via Joint Weight Perturbations
summary: Harmful fine-tuning can rapidly erode the safety alignment of large language models, creating substantial risks when aligned models are adapted to downstream tasks. Existing alignment-stage defenses use harmful examples and simulated harmful perturbations during safety alignment to prepare models for later harmful fine-tuning, yet the collective effects of harmful weight perturbations remain underexplored. We identify a collective failure pattern: disjoint parts of a harmful perturbation have limited effects in isolation, but their joint application increases the model's harmfulness beyond the sum of their individual effects. Guided by this observation, we propose Joint Weight Perturbations (JWP), an alignment-stage defense that masks different parts of a harmful perturbation estimated from the current model and trains the model to respond safely in the resulting states. This exposes the model to different combinations of harmful perturbations and reduces its sensitivity to their accumulation during subsequent harmful fine-tuning. Experiments across downstream tasks and model families show that JWP offers stronger resistance to harmful fine-tuning than prior defenses while largely preserving task performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了有害权重扰动的联合失败模式，提出了一种名为联合权重扰动（JWP）的防御方法，在安全对齐阶段中通过掩蔽模型中不同的有害扰动部分，训练模型对这些状态作出安全响应，从而提升模型对后续有害微调的抵抗力。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全对齐防御方法依赖于有害示例和模拟的有害扰动，但它们在应对有害权重扰动的联合效应方面存在不足。研究揭示了有害权重扰动的联合失败模式，并提出了JWP以增强模型的安全性。
AI.method: JWP方法涉及识别有害权重扰动，并提出一种防御策略来减少模型在不同联合扰动下的敏感性。
AI.result: 实验表明，JWP方法可以有效提高模型对有害微调的抵抗能力，同时保持任务性能。
AI.conclusion: JWP在多个下游任务和模型家族中展示了优于现有防御方法的效果，被视为提升大型语言模型安全性的有效策略。

title: MoWE: Spatially Adaptive Mixture-of-Wavelet-Experts Pooling for Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation
summary: We present Mixture-of-Wavelet-Experts (MoWE), a spatially adaptive routing mechanism that replaces max-pooling and strided convolutions in U-Net architectures for ultrasound lesion segmentation. Standard pooling operations suppress high-frequency spatial details, including potential boundary cues in speckled regions. Recent frequency-domain methods preserve some of these details, but a single wavelet family applies the same spectral bias across the image. MoWE instead uses a context-aware router to assign local regions to fixed wavelet families according to local texture and global feature context. The decoder reuses the encoder's spatial routing maps during the inverse transform. Learnable channel-wise gates rescale the high-frequency subbands before reconstruction. We evaluate MoWE with U-Net on four ultrasound lesion benchmarks (BUSI, TN3K, UDIAT, BUS-UCLM) and one cardiac dataset (CAMUS), and with nnU-Net on BUSI. On BUSI, MoWE improves U-Net Dice from 72.59\% to 74.55\% and reduces HD95 from 47.01 to 43.49\,px. With nnU-Net, MoWE improves Dice from 80.18\% to 81.97\% and reduces ASSD from 20.07 to 17.25\,px. On U-Net, MoWE reduces trainable parameters by 6.4\%.

AI.tldr: 文章提出了MoWE，一种基于小波专家的自适应路由机制，替代了UNet架构中的最大池化和步进卷积，从而提高超声病变分割的Dice分数和降低误差值。
AI.motivation: 现有的池化操作会抑制高频空间细节，特别是在点状区域，而最新的频率域方法虽然能保留部分细节，但单一的小波家族会在图像上产生相同的频谱偏置。MoWE利用上下文感知路由器，根据局部纹理和全局特征上下文将局部区域分配给固定的小波家族。
AI.method: MoWE机制使用可学习的通道门控将高频子带在重建前进行重新缩放，并保持解码器在逆变换期间重用编码器的空域路由图。
AI.result: MoWE在BUSI、TN3K、UDIAT、BUS-UCLM这四个超声病变基准数据集以及CAMUS心脏数据集上，分别提高了Dice分数和降低了HD95及ASSD值，同时也减少了UNet中的训练参数数量。
AI.conclusion: MoWE在多种数据集上的实验证明了其在超声病变分割中的优越性能，能够更准确地识别病变边界。

title: TempoMoE: Identifying and Steering Fast-Slow Thinking Experts for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reasoning models rely on long chain-of-thought (CoT) for complex tasks, yet often overthink easy inputs, increasing token cost and latency, and sometimes degrading accuracy. Existing methods optimize reasoning length during training or impose external control at inference, but leave the underlying reasoning mechanism a black box. We find that fast and slow thinking exhibit distinct expert-routing patterns: holding the input fixed and varying only the prompted reasoning tempo produces stable routing shifts. Suppressing slow-thinking experts shortens the reasoning chain, whereas suppressing fast-thinking experts lengthens it, providing causal evidence that these experts influence reasoning depth. Based on this finding, we propose TempoMoE, a training-free, two-stage framework. It identifies fast- and slow-thinking experts via tempo-contrastive routing analysis and redistributes routing weights within the original top-k set according to sample difficulty. It amplifies fast-thinking experts and suppresses slow-thinking experts on easy inputs and reverses this adjustment on hard ones, enabling difficulty-adaptive control over reasoning depth. We evaluate TempoMoE on Kimi-VL, Qwen3-VL, and ERNIE-4.5-VL across six benchmarks. Compared with Vanilla, TempoMoE consistently improves accuracy while reducing output tokens, with accuracy gains of up to 2.6 points and token reductions of up to 35.4%.

AI.tldr: TempoMoE是一个不需要训练的两阶段框架，通过对比不同节奏的专家路由分析，针对输入难度调整专家权重，从而自适应地控制推理深度，提高模型效率。
AI.motivation: 目前的多模态混合专家推理模型在处理复杂任务时容易过度思考简单输入，增加计算成本和延迟，减小模型效率。
AI.method: TempoMoE框架通过对比不同节奏的专家路由分析，确定快慢思维的专家，并根据样本难度重新分配专家权重。在简单输入中增强快思维专家，抑制慢思维专家；在困难输入中执行相反的操作。
AI.result: 在Kimi-VL，Qwen3-VL，和ERNIE-4.5-VL上的六项基准测试中，与Vanilla模型相比，TempoMoE持续提高了准确率并减少了输出令牌，最高分别提升了2.6个点和达到了35.4%的令牌减少。
AI.conclusion: TempoMoE通过自适应控制推理深度，提供了改进多模态混合专家推理模型性能的新方法。

title: ToolOPD: Credit-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Tool-Use Agents
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) enhances the capabilities of small language agents by providing dense, token-level supervision from a teacher model on student-generated trajectories. However, standard OPD implicitly assumes that credit is uniformly distributed across long-horizon trajectories, assigning the same strength of teacher supervision to different actions. Through credit-distribution analysis and outcome-reversal counterfactual experiments, we find that trajectory credit is concentrated on a small number of critical actions. Moreover, even when the trajectory is held fixed, reversing only the final outcome substantially changes the credit assigned to multiple interaction turns. These findings show that the uniform-credit assumption fails to identify critical decisions and ultimately degrades the model's reasoning accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose ToolOPD, an outcome-aware on-policy distillation framework designed for long-horizon tool use. ToolOPD first summarizes each completed trajectory and its outcome into a reusable hindsight skill. It then measures how this skill changes the teacher's probability of each student action token and converts the change into outcome-aware credit. The resulting credit preserves supervision that supports successful decisions or discourages failed ones, while suppressing irrelevant and conflicting signals. ToolOPD uses these credits to reweight the action-level distillation loss and jointly optimizes it with reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across multiple long-horizon tool interaction benchmarks demonstrate that ToolOPD significantly outperforms existing reinforcement learning and self-distillation baselines.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的方法ToolOPD，通过重视与任务成功或失败相关联的反馈，解决了标准在线蒸馏方法中信用分配均匀的问题，从而提高了模型的决策准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统在线蒸馏方法假定所有动作在长期轨迹中的信用分布均匀，但实验证明这种假设忽视了关键决策的重要性，影响了模型的理解能力。
AI.method: ToolOPD框架首先将每个已完成轨迹及其结果总结为可重复使用的回顾技能，然后测量这种技能对每项学生动作的老师概率变化，并将这种变化转换成与结果相关联的信用。根据这些信用对动作级蒸馏损失进行重新加权，并与强化学习联合优化。
AI.result: 在多个长期工具交互基准测试中，ToolOPD显著优于现有的强化学习和自蒸馏基线。
AI.conclusion: ToolOPD通过提出一种新的操作级损失加权策略，显著提高了长周期工具使用任务中语言代理的决策准确性和效率。

title: MoCKEFA: Model-Conditioned Keyframe Extraction and Fair Attribution for Video Model Explanation
summary: We show that a video can be represented with just a few keyframes without sacrificing a given model's belief about the video. Our method is the first of its kind that extracts these keyframes conditioned on the model's prediction, which is massively helpful for building explainable video models. We then fairly distribute the importance of the video to the model among the keyframes with game theoretically fair Shapley values. Through qualitative and quantitative experiments, we show that keyframe attribution is superior to the traditional frame attribution. Further, we conduct preliminary exploration on highlighting the important changes among the frames by looking at the differences between adjacent keyframes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的方法，可以从视频中提取关键帧，同时确保模型对视频的信念不受影响，这有助于构建可解释的视频模型。
AI.motivation: 传统的视频模型难以解释，本文旨在通过提取关键帧来提高模型的可解释性。
AI.method: 该方法从模型预测的角度提取关键帧，并使用博弈论公平的Shapley值分配帧的重要性。
AI.result: 通过定性和定量实验，该方法的关键帧归因优于传统的帧归因。此外，还对相邻关键帧之间的差异进行了初步探索，以突出帧间的重要变化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了基于关键帧的视频表示的有效性和优越性，为进一步的视频建模工作提供了新的视角。

title: Scaling Synthetic Pre-training Data and Evaluation for Indic LLMs
comment: 44 pages, 5 figures. Includes appendices and references
summary: Building capable language models for India requires scalable multilingual data and robust evaluation. We introduce Nemotron-Pretraining-Indic-v1, a synthetic pretraining corpus of approximately 2.83 trillion tokens covering all 22 scheduled Indian languages in native script and twelve in romanized form. It is the largest openly released Indic pretraining corpus. Using our GPU-accelerated pipeline, we translate curated English documents, assess translation quality, and repair low-quality outputs while preserving technical content and document structure and maintaining source traceability. Through continued-pretraining experiments across twelve languages, we show that combining our synthetic corpus with natural Indic text improves knowledge and reasoning over a public-corpus baseline. Additional experiments show how data volume, script coverage, and Indic training share affect English performance. We also introduce the Indic-LLM-Eval-Suite, a multilingual benchmark suite for evaluating Indic language models across chat, instruction following, reasoning, knowledge, code, and translation. The suite combines existing Indic benchmarks with task-aware translations of English benchmarks, using automated quality assessment, targeted correction, and native-speaker review in a human-in-the-loop pipeline. We use the suite to comprehensively benchmark contemporary open-weight Indic and multilingual models across capabilities and languages, revealing substantial variation across tasks and languages. Together, these resources provide a scalable foundation for developing and evaluating more capable Indic language models.

AI.tldr: 论文介绍了Nemotron-Pretraining-Indic-v1，这是一个合成预训练语料库，包含约2.83万亿个标记，涵盖了印度22种官方语言的本土书法和12种罗马化形式。通过GPU加速的流水线，对英语文档进行翻译、质量评估和错误校正，同时保留了技术内容和文档结构，并保持了源可追溯性。实验表明，将合成语料库与自然语言数据结合使用可以提高语言模型的知识和推理能力。此外，论文还介绍了Indic-LLM-Eval-Suite，这是一个多语言基准套件，用于评估印度语模型跨聊天、指令遵循、推理、知识、代码和翻译的能力。
AI.motivation: 当前印度语模型面临的挑战在于缺乏可扩展的多语言数据和一致的评估方法。因此，本文旨在提供一个大规模的合成预训练语料库（Nemotron-Pretraining-Indic-v1）和一个经过改进的评估工具（Indic-LLM-Eval-Suite），以促进印度语模型的研究和发展。
AI.method: 作者采用GPU加速的管道流程，处理并翻译了大量英文文档，确保在翻译过程中保留了技术细节并维持源可追溯性。通过与已有的公开数据集进行持续的预训练实验，本文研究了合成语料库在不同任务和不同大小的数据集中的有效性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，将合成语料库与自然语料结合使用可以显著提高印度语模型的知识和推理能力。同时，作者使用Indic-LLM-Eval-Suite建立了全面的基准测试，揭示了现有模型在不同任务和不同语言上的性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 本文的资源为开发和评估更强大和多语言的印度语模型提供了可扩展的基础。未来的研究可以通过充分利用这些资源进一步改进印度语模型的性能。

title: CVaR-RMD: CVaR Selection Pressure for Robust Metaheuristic Discovery
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code: https://github.com/BeyondHeaven/CVaR-RMD
summary: Large language models have recently been used to discover heuristics through iterative program search, offering a promising approach to automated algorithm design. However, candidates selected by average performance may degrade across instance families, random seeds, and problem scales because mean-based objectives can obscure rare but severe failures. We propose CVaR-RMD, a risk-sensitive evolutionary framework that uses an LLM to mutate executable heuristic programs and ranks candidates by empirical conditional value-at-risk over heterogeneous evaluation conditions. Across three combinatorial optimization domains, CVaR-based selection improves upper-tail performance and reduces failure rates while maintaining competitive mean performance. These gains persist on larger unseen instances and independently curated within-domain benchmarks

AI.tldr: CVaR-RMD 使用 LLM 生成可执行的启发式程序，并基于经验条件值-at-风险在不同的评估条件下进行排名，从而改善优化领域的上尾性能并降低失败率。
AI.motivation: 现有的算法设计方法在实例家族、随机种子和问题规模变化时，通过平均性能选择的候选算法可能出现性能下降，因为基于均值的目标可能掩盖了罕见但严重的故障。CVaR-RMD 提出了一种风险敏感的进化框架，旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: CVaR-RMD 采用了一种将 LLM 用于可执行启发式程序的变异策略，并利用经验条件值-at-风险衡量候选程序在多个不一致性评估条件下表现的稳健性。
AI.result: 在三个组合优化领域中，基于 CVaR 的选择显著提高了上尾性能，并降低了失败率，同时保持了与竞争性均值性能相当的表现。这些改进在更大的未知实例和跨领域的基准测试中仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，CVaR-RMD 是一种有效的自动化算法设计方法，能够在稳健性和均值性能之间取得平衡，尤其在面对复杂和多样化的优化问题时表现出色。

title: Sufficient Frame Subsets for Video Understanding
summary: Understanding when during a video a model makes its critical observations is essential for interpreting video-understanding systems. However, existing attribution methods often spread evidence diffusely across near-duplicate frames. We introduce Sufficient Frame Subsets: compact sets of frames in which all other frames are masked, yet each subset independently preserves the model's prediction. We evaluate our method on two complementary benchmarks, UCF101 and Something-Something v2, using both CNN- and transformer-based architectures. Our results show that the proposed algorithm identifies highly compact and effective frame subsets for explaining model decisions. We also find that models capable of relying on a greater number of sufficient frame subsets tend to perform better, possibly because they are more robust, consistent with prior research. Finally, the extracted frame subsets help us analyze model failure cases, reveal which aspects of a video the model has learned to emphasize, and identify opportunities for improving future training procedures.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了Sufficient Frame Subsets方法，能够从视频中提取出关键帧子集，这些子集能够独立保持模型的预测，且比现有方法更具浓缩性和有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有归因方法将证据分散在近似重复的帧中，影响了对视频理解系统的解释。论文旨在找到一种方法，能够在不牺牲模型预测的前提下，更加精准地捕捉关键帧。
AI.method: 研究开发了Sufficient Frame Subsets方法，通过训练模型生成紧凑的帧子集，在这些子集中的帧能单独保留原始模型的预测结果。评估了此方法在UCF101和Something-Something v2上的表现。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能够在多个基准测试上找到更小且有效的帧子集。此外，能够使用更多足够帧子集的模型表现更好，这表明它们可能更具鲁棒性和一致性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果不仅有助于解析模型决定，还提供了分析模型失败案例、识别视频重点方面和改进未来训练程序的机会。
