title: Accelerated Drift of Scientific Prose in the LLM Era: Evidence from an Interrupted Time-Series Analysis
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 22 pages, including references and appendices
summary: Every scientific text is embedded in the writing norms of its time: it reflects earlier publications while also shaping the texts that follow. The growing use of LLM-based writing tools introduces a new factor in this evolving system, but the linguistic changes coinciding with their emergence remain insufficiently understood. We investigate whether the trajectories of scientific-preprint writing changed in rate or direction after conversational LLMs became publicly accessible, using the release of ChatGPT in November 2022 as the observational breakpoint. We compare pre- and post-2022 trajectories across vocabulary, punctuation, readability, and syntax in abstracts from arXiv's artificial intelligence, statistics, and quantitative biology categories and from medRxiv. Using interrupted time-series regression, we find substantial post-2022 changes across multiple feature families and research domains, including increases in average word length, reduced formula-based readability, and declines in maximum dependency-tree depth and sentence-level depth variation. Individual features follow different dynamics: some lexical markers accelerate persistently, while others rise and then recede. Our findings show that isolated marker frequencies capture only part of the shift: changes in the rate, direction, and structure of linguistic trajectories provide complementary evidence of broader post-2022 change in scientific-preprint writing. More broadly, these findings motivate monitoring scientific writing as a multidimensional, evolving system rather than through a fixed set of LLM-associated markers.

AI.tldr: 研究发现2022年后科学预发布写作在词汇、标点、可读性和句法方面出现了显著变化，强调需要从多个维度监控科学写作的变化。
AI.motivation: 作者认为，随着对话型LLM的普及，科学写作规范发生了变化，但这些变化的原因和影响尚未得到充分理解。
AI.method: 使用中断时间序列回归分析了2022年之前和之后的学术预发布论文（来自arXiv的人工智能、统计学和定量生物学类别，以及medRxiv）的词汇、标点、可读性和句法特征的变化。
AI.result: 研究发现多个特征在2022年后出现显著变化，包括平均词长增加、基于公式的可读性降低、最大依赖树深度和句子深度变异下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，单一标记频率的变化只能部分反映这种变化，而速率、方向和结构的变化提供了更广泛的证据，表明科学预发布写作在2022年后发生了变化。

title: From Black Box to Controller: Inference-Time Steering of LLM via Feature Amplification
summary: Inference-time steering is crucial for deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world applications, where they must flexibly adjust behavior preferences. For instance, a model should dynamically adjust its caution level based on the risk of the scenario. This requirement introduces a challenge: modulating the intensity of LLM preferences. Prompt engineering can require task-specific prompt design, while fine-tuning requires additional optimization and data. These requirements can make repeated behavioral adjustments costly. To address this, we introduce NeuroSteer, a plug-and-play framework that enables flexible, quantitative adjustment of LLM preferences at inference time. NeuroSteer employs a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) as its controller. Comparing neuron activation frequencies between positive and negative examples isolates "feature neurons" that correspond to target preferences such as politeness and positive sentiment. During inference, the activations of selected SAE features are amplified in the latent representations to steer the output distribution. Users can adjust the strength of this steering on a per-scenario or per-user basis, granting the LLM fine-grained, quantifiable trait modulation. Our experiments show that NeuroSteer can alter sentiment, toxicity, stance, and politeness at inference time. It achieves higher target-direction steering scores than the compared baselines in several settings, with task- and strength-dependent trade-offs in generation quality.

AI.tldr: NeuroSteer 是一个插件式框架，允许在推理时灵活地调整大型语言模型 (LLMs) 的偏好强度，通过稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 控制，能够在多种特性如情感、毒性、立场和礼貌方面实现定向调节。
AI.motivation: 在真实世界的应用中，LLMs 需要根据情境动态调整行为偏好，这要求能够实时调节模型偏好强度，但目前的方法如任务特定提示设计和微调可能成本较高。
AI.method: NeuroSteer 使用稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 作为控制器，通过比较正负样例之间神经元激活频率来识别与目标特征（如礼貌和正面情绪）对应的“特征神经元”。通过放大这些特征的激活，在推理时引导输出分布。
AI.result: 实验表明 NeuroSteer 能在推理时改变情感、毒性、立场和礼貌，相较于基线方法，在多个场景下实现了更高的目标导向调节得分，但存在依赖于任务和调整强度的生成质量的权衡。
AI.conclusion: NeuroSteer 提供了一种灵活且量化的机制来调整 LLM 的偏好，有望提高模型在真实应用场景中的适应性和多样性。

title: Think Visually Across Space and Time: Grounded Reasoning for Video Segmentation
summary: Video Reasoning Segmentation (VRS) requires a model to identify an implicitly described target and predict its pixel-level mask trajectory, while resolving the spatial relations and temporal events that determine the answer. Text-only Chain-of-Thought (CoT) can explain a target choice without making the underlying visual references explicit, leaving a \emph{video reference gap} between linguistic inference and the evidence distributed across frames. We introduce \textbf{Temporal Chain of Video Primitives (TCoVP)}, a spatiotemporally grounded form of Video CoT that organizes query-relevant observations into a chronological reasoning chain. Each primitive associates an entity reference with temporal support and timestamped spatial evidence, and the chain interleaves these references with language to guide reasoning about which entity is relevant, when the queried event holds, and where its evidence appears. The selected target primitives then provide box prompts and temporal support for video mask prediction. We construct TCoVP-SFT-15k and TCoVP-RL-13k to learn this representation through supervised fine-tuning and chain-aligned reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments across five VRS benchmarks and three model backbones demonstrate the strong performance of TCoVP, highlighting the effectiveness of organizing spatial and temporal evidence within the reasoning process. All models and code will be publicly released. Project page: \url{https://victor-wjw.github.io/TCoVP/}

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Temporal Chain of Video Primitives (TCoVP) 方法，这是一种时空定位的视频推理链，为视频推理分割任务提供了一个新的视角。TCoVP 方法通过时空相关的原始实体引用将查询相关的观察组织成一个时间顺序的推理链，促使模型解释视频内容时能够更好地利用时空信息，从而有效解决视频参考间隙问题。该方法在多种视频推理分割基准上表现出强大的性能，并且公开提供了代码和模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的Text-only Chain-of-Thought方法由于未能明确表达视觉参考，在语言推理和分布在帧中的证据之间存在数据缺口，导致在视频推理分割任务中难以有效捕捉时空关系。为了克服这一缺陷，该论文提出了TCoVP方法，旨在改善模型对时空信息的利用，以更准确地解决目标跟踪等问题。
AI.method: 该方法基于观察的时间顺序组织推理链，每个原始实体引用都关联了时间支持和带有时间戳的时空证据，通过这些引用与语言的交错，引导模型推理哪些实体是相关联的，何时事件发生以及证据在哪里显现。这种方法被设计为在监督微调和链对齐的强化学习中学习时空证据的组织形式。
AI.result: TCoVP 方法在多个VRS基准上展示了强大的性能，经验证明，相较于现有的方法，它能够更好地利用时空证据来提高目标跟踪和视频推理分割的效果。此外，该方法也得到了来自不同模型 backbone 的支持，进一步证实其有效性和普适性。
AI.conclusion: 文章提出了TCoVP方法解决视频推理分割任务中的时空数据组织问题，并通过广泛的实验验证了其优越性。这一方法不仅能够显著提升视频中的目标跟踪和推理能力，也为未来的研究提供了新的思路和工具。所有模型和代码都已经公开，以便其他研究人员能进一步测试和改进。

title: Balance-Aware Pivot Selection for Parallel Diffusion LLM Decoding
summary: Diffusion language models enable parallel token generation, offering a promising alternative to sequential autoregressive decoding. Existing acceleration methods use predictive confidence to enable parallel token commitment while preserving generation quality. However, confidence-based selection prioritizes reliable token predictions without explicitly considering how token positions shape the remaining decoding schedule. Moreover, such ordering does not always reflect inter-token dependencies, suggesting that confidence need not be the sole criterion for token selection. Motivated by this limitation, we propose Balance-Aware Pivot Decoding (BPD), which favors central pivots within contiguous masked intervals and decodes the selected positions in parallel. Balanced pivots yield logarithmic decoding depth in the interval length. Our practical method accounts for model uncertainty by combining confidence-based prefilling with confidence-thresholded center selection. We evaluate the resulting quality-efficiency tradeoff on LLaDA and Dream across five mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction-following benchmarks. Our implementation is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DLM_random_pivot-EE62/

AI.tldr: 提出了Balance-Aware Pivot Decoding (BPD)方法，该方法在连续屏蔽区间内偏向中心枢轴进行并行解码，减少了解码深度，并结合了基于置信度的预填充和阈值内中心选择，以提高效率和质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的加速方法主要依赖于预测置信度进行解码，但忽略了token位置对剩余解码调度的影响，以及token间的依赖关系。
AI.method: BPD方法优先选择连续屏蔽区间内的中心枢轴进行并行解码，通过结合置信度预填充和阈值中心选择，平衡了解码的质量和效率。
AI.result: BPD方法在LLaDA和Dream上，在数学推理、代码生成和指令跟随基准测试中表现出高质量和高效率。
AI.conclusion: BPD方法提供了一种有效提高扩散语言模型并行解码质量和效率的新策略。

title: Whose Credential Is It? How Owner Attribution in Agent MemoryShapes Cross-User Account Misuse
summary: Shared long-term memory lets an LLM agent serving one user inadvertently retrieve another user's credentials, but it is unclear when such exposure leads to actual harm. We introduce a three-stage audit that separates three events: a foreign credential reaches the prompt (exposure), the agent acts with it (behavior), and the other user's account changes (state). In AppWorld, a store that mixes 763 past logins from all users retrieves another user's credential for 84.7 percent of required apps, yet agents rarely act on it. Misuse appears in a stress test where memory lacks the user's own credential and presents a single foreign one as the user's record: seven agents then use it in 80 to 94 percent of runs and change the victim's account in up to 43 percent, sometimes passing the official check. Naming the owner before or inside each credential line prevents most of this: with all else fixed, misuse falls from 92 to 1 of 305 paired runs, also with name-free usernames, though owner-bound notes cost 3 to 5 successful tasks per model on clean memory. A wrongly written owner largely restores misuse; trailing owner tags and added safety instructions help only some models. Agent memory should consistently record whose credential it stores, and evaluations should measure behavior, not only exposure.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种三阶段审计方法来检测LLM代理是否泄露了另一个用户的凭据，并通过实验评估了不同方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 为了防止共享长期记忆导致的LLM代理无意中检索另一个用户的凭据，并评估这种暴露是否会导致实际危害。
AI.method: 研究设计了一个三阶段流程来区分凭证泄露(暴露)、代理行为和目标用户的状态变化。通过在混合用户过去的登录记录中模拟所需的应用测试评估内存泄露的可能性，并在不同情况下测试代理的行为变化。
AI.result: 在AppWorld平台下，763个过往登录记录的混合使用导致了84.7%的应用需要使用其他用户凭据，但代理很少主动使用这些凭据。在压力测试中，当代理记忆中缺乏用户自身凭证并仅展示单一外来的凭证作为用户记录时，有7个代理在80-94%的运行中使用了它，并在43%的运行中更改了受害者的账户，有时甚至通过了官方的验证。去除每个凭据记录前或内的用户名可以显著降低这种滥用行为，但也可能影响模型的成功任务数量。不正确的所有者信息、尾随所有者标记和额外的安全指令并未对所有模型产生显著帮助。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，代理内存应准确记录存储的凭证所属用户，评估应不仅测量暴露，还应考察代理的行为。

title: LC-TSRNet: A Land-Cover-Guided Two-Stage Network for Annual MODIS Surface Reflectance Time Series Reconstruction
summary: MODIS surface reflectance (SR) products often suffer from data gaps due to cloud contamination and sensor malfunctions, limiting their applications in long-term and large-scale studies. Most existing methods rely on cloud-free observations from optical time series or introduce SAR time series as auxiliary information. However, due to the coarse spatial resolution of MODIS, cloud-free reference images are difficult to obtain, and SAR imagery is not well matched to the spatial resolution of MODIS, making it difficult to provide effective prior constraints. To address these issues, this study proposes LC-TSRNet for seamless reconstruction of annual MODIS SR products. In the first stage, an annual land cover map is introduced as prior knowledge, and CSPM is designed by leveraging the spectral similarity within identical land cover types, thereby providing prior spectral constraints for missing regions. In the second stage, to address large-area, persistent, and overlapping gaps in MODIS imagery, SMRM is designed to adaptively exploit and integrate multi-scale spatiotemporal contextual information. Meanwhile, to address the limited collaborative utilization of spatio-temporal-spectral information, 3DAM is designed to impose cross-dimensional joint constraints. Considering the lack of publicly available MODIS sample datasets, this study constructs the AIRMOD-TSR dataset. Extensive experimental results show that LC-TSRNet outperforms the comparison methods and achieves better reconstruction accuracy and spectral fidelity. Under the spatially adjacent scenario, LC-TSRNet improves PSNR by 0.56 dB and reduces SAM by 0.13°. The vegetation monitoring application further verifies the practical value of the reconstructed SR time series.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种LC-TSRNet方法，旨在无缝重建年度的MODIS表面反照率产品，通过引入年度土地覆盖图作为先验知识，并利用多尺度时空上下文信息和三维联合约束来填补云和传感器故障造成的数据缺失。
AI.motivation: MODIS表面反照率产品常因云覆盖和传感器问题存在数据缺失，影响长期和大规模研究。现有的方法多数依赖多光谱云清除数据或辅助雷达图像，但这些方法存在获取困难等问题。
AI.method: LC-TSRNet包含两个阶段：首先利用年度土地覆盖图提供光谱约束；其次设计了SMRM利用多尺度时空上下文信息填补空白，并通过3DAM结合时空光谱信息。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，LC-TSRNet在云相邻场景中提高了0.56 dB的PSNR并降低了0.13°的SAM，植被监测应用验证了重建时间序列的实际价值。
AI.conclusion: LC-TSRNet在处理MODIS表面反照率数据缺失方面表现出色，为长期监测研究提供了可靠的数据支持。

title: Honeyed Words, Hidden Daggers: Benchmarking and Training LLMs to See Through Mock Politeness
summary: The Chinese idiom "kou mi fu jian" ("honeyed words, hidden daggers") names speech that is polite in form but hostile in function. We present ZhenhuanBench, a 1,592-item benchmark built from expert commentary on Empresses in the Palace, covering speaker intent, emotion-language mismatch, and per-listener uptake. Text-only evaluation covers 34 LLMs. GPT-6 Astra leads the leaderboard at 73.48% overall, while its listener-reaction score is 58.37%. The annotations also supply supervised traces and string-verifiable training rewards. With 338 gold traces, an 8B model outperforms teacher distillation on identical items. Subsequent RL saturates, and chance correction reduces the estimated recoverable performance gap by a factor of 7.5. Our CPR-GRPO loop (Compress-Probe-Replenish) uses this estimate to weight gold supervision, reaching 67.0 on public multiple-choice tasks and 74.5 under the training-matched hidden protocol. Without target-task training, CPR outperforms Base, SFT, and GRPO across six Chinese and English pragmatic and sarcasm evaluations. On three external datasets, training with CPR yields higher mean Macro-F1 than SFT and GRPO.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了ZhenhuanBench基准数据集，包含1,592个包含专家对中国宫女传记中语言意图、情感与听者反应的评价。文本评估了34个大语言模型，结果显示GPT-6 Astra在线听者反应上达到58.37%。CPR-GRPO循环在公共多项选择任务上获得67.0，在培训相符的隐藏协议下获得74.5。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在解决中国特色的“蜜语藏刀（kou mi fu jian）”语言现象，即表面礼貌而实际充满敌意的话语。通过构建基准，评估大语言模型处理这种含混语义的能力。
AI.method: 研究构建了ZhenhuanBench基准数据集，包括专家对“宫女传记”中对话内容的注释，涵盖说话者的意图、情感与语言不符以及不同听者的接受情况。研究采用仅文本评估的方法，评估了34个大语言模型的表现。
AI.result: GPT-6 Astra在总体得分上领先，为73.48%，在线听者反应得分为58.37%。此外，CPR-GRPO循环在公共多项选择任务上达到了67.0的得分，而在培训相符的隐藏协议下则达到了74.5。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，通过这种方法，大语言模型能够更好地理解和处理含混语言，特别是在处理与含混语言相关的情感与意图匹配方面表现出色。

title: PFedQFT: Personalized Federated Quantum-Inspired Fine-Tuning for Medical Large Language Models
summary: Medical data remain fragmented across institutional silos because of privacy, governance, and ownership constraints. Federated learning enables medical institutions to adapt large language models (LLMs) collaboratively without transferring raw records. However, independently parameterized low-rank adapters incur repeated parameter and communication costs across Transformer projections, while uniform aggregation may limit adaptation to heterogeneous institutional data. We propose PFedQFT, a quantum-inspired framework for personalized federated fine-tuning with a compact shared adapter. Specifically, PFedQFT constructs reusable orthonormal adaptation bases from compact skew-symmetric generators using a truncated matrix-exponential approximation followed by QR orthonormalization. Compatible projections reuse these bases, while a globally shared full core preserves the flexibility of each projection. Each client further maintains a lightweight private residual operator, whose directions are learned globally and whose coefficients remain local. Experiments on seven public medical tasks and multiple LLM backbones show substantial reductions in trainable parameters and per-round adapter upload volume, with competitive predictive performance on most tasks.

AI.tldr: PFedQFT 提出了一种基于量子启发的个性化联邦微调框架，通过构建可复用的正交化适应基底和共享核心，减少训练参数和每轮适配上传体积，同时保持预测性能。
AI.motivation: 解决联邦学习中参数重复、通信成本高以及适应异质机构数据的能力受限问题。
AI.method: 通过使用矩阵指数近似和 QR 正交化来构建可复用的正交化适应基底，并设计了一个全局共享的核心来保持灵活性。
AI.result: 在七个公开医疗任务和多个大型语言模型上进行实验，显示了可训练参数和每轮适配上传体积都显著减少，并且在大多数任务上具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PFedQFT 显著降低了联邦学习的资源消耗，并且在保持或提升预测性能的同时提供了更好的个性化适应能力。

title: HullProbe: Measuring Interventional Part Reliance in Maritime Vessel Classifiers
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027 (Evaluation & Dataset Track). 20 pages including supplementary material, 12 figures, 15 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/fossil-ai/HullProbe
summary: Recognizing a vessel's type from an image supports maritime surveillance and sanctions monitoring, but a classifier can reach high accuracy by leaning on the generic hull instead of the more distinctive superstructure, and is then fooled when a vessel is re-hulled or occluded. De-biasing methods claim to remove such reliance, yet the field certifies them with worst-group accuracy, a proxy that needs group labels and only infers reliance from accuracy. We measure the reliance directly. HullProbe swaps a registered anatomical part of a vessel for another instance's and reads how much that part drives the decision, using a same-class swap to control for compositing artifacts. Because a surface vessel is a hull and a superstructure arranged along one axis, its parts form a 2x3 grid whose 2^6 = 64 swaps we evaluate exhaustively, and a single Walsh transform returns each part's interventional influence and its interaction spectrum. On planted shortcuts, where the true reliance is known, the measure tracks worst-group accuracy (r = -0.94 over 45 configurations), and replacing its learned segmenter with human annotations changes the hull-share by less than the audit's resolution. On the 26 vessel types of MARVEL, the classifier places about 46% of its corrected sensitivity on the generic hull yet follows the superstructure when the two conflict, and the group-label-free de-biasers available there do not detectably reduce the hull's share. The findings hold across three architectures and a second maritime dataset, and the method extends to fine-grained vehicle recognition on Stanford Cars.

AI.tldr: 研究直接测量了船舶分类器对于船体和上层建筑之间依赖性的敏感性。通过HullProbe方法，该研究在多种测试场景下验证了这一敏感性，发现即使是缺乏群体标签的数据集，现有去偏方法也无法显著降低对于船体的依赖。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在解决在船舶识别领域，分类器过度依赖于通用船体而忽视上层建筑特征的问题。现有的去偏方法依赖于群体准确率作为代理指标，无法直接衡量分类器的依赖性。
AI.method: 研究开发了HullProbe方法，通过替换船舶的解剖部件来评估每个部分对分类决策的影响。该方法利用同一类船舶的样本替换，并采用Walsh变换来计算交互谱，从而实现对分类器依赖性的直接测量。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，尽管在多个实验场景下，目标依赖性与群体准确率高度相关，但现有的去偏方法在MARVEL数据集中未能显著减少分类器对通用船体的依赖性。此外，该方法在斯坦福车辆数据集中也得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 直接测量分类器依赖性的方法对于提高船舶识别系统的公正性具有重要意义，研究结果表明现有去偏方法虽有局限性，但仍需改进以更好地减少对特定部件的依赖。

title: DeepSEA: A Multilingual Evaluation Benchmark for Southeast Asia
comment: For the codebase and dataset, see https://github.com/google-research/deep-sea
summary: While language models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, their performance remains disproportionately skewed towards high-resource languages. This disparity is particularly acute for the 700 million inhabitants of Southeast Asia, where vast linguistic diversity remains under-represented in existing benchmarks, often suffering from limited language coverage or narrow task scopes. To address this, we introduce DeepSEA, a comprehensive benchmark constructed from established datasets through professional human translation into 12 Southeast Asian languages, spanning both high-resource (e.g., Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese) and low-resource (e.g., Burmese, Khmer, Lao) tiers across five distinct tasks: mathematical reasoning, scientific reasoning, question answering, abstractive summarization, and machine translation. Extensive evaluation of frontier proprietary and open-weights models reveals that while frontier models like Gemini-3.7-Flash maintain robustness across resource tiers, smaller models face severe performance degradation on low-resource languages. Crucially, models perform better in reasoning and summarization when pivoted through English rather than target languages, exposing a critical dependency on English representations, especially for low-resource languages. Beyond these observations, we provide a cross-lingual error analysis and a cross-script tokenizer fertility analysis. We hope these findings shed light on the development of next-generation inclusive multilingual models.

AI.tldr: DeepSEA 是一个全面的跨语言基准测试集，涵盖12种东南亚语言，通过专业人工翻译建立，旨在弥补高资源和低资源语言之间的性能差距。研究表明，最新的模型在低资源语言上的表现不如高级模型，且依赖于通过英语而非目标语言的推理，这一发现强调了未来多语言模型开发的包容性。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在解决语言模型在东南亚地区语言覆盖率不足的问题，特别是在高资源和低资源语言之间的性能差距。
AI.method: DeepSEA 由建立在多个数据集基础上，通过专业的机器翻译成12种东南亚语言，涵盖5种不同的任务：数学推理、科学推理、问答、抽取出理概括和机器翻译。
AI.result: 结果显示，最先进的模型在不同资源水平的语言上表现稳定，而较小的模型在低资源语言上的性能显著下降；模型在推理和总结时倾向于通过英语而不是目标语言进行推理，这强调了英语在语言建模中的作用。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现，为了提高低资源语言的语言模型性能，必须重视这些依赖关系，并促进更公平的模型发展，以包括更多的语言，特别是低资源语言。

title: Fine-Grained Units, Flat Decisions: Hierarchical Micro-Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Models
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures. Zukang Xu and Xinpei Gao contributed equally. Corresponding author: Dawei Yang
summary: Micro-expert pruning reduces the capacity of mixture-of-experts (MoE) models by removing coupled channels within routed experts. However, finer pruning granularity alone does not guarantee the preservation of downstream capabilities, as similar language-modeling perplexity can accompany substantially different task performance. We revisit micro-expert mask construction as two distinct decisions: allocating retained capacity across experts and selecting channels within that capacity. We propose UC-RAMP, a two-stage post-training pruning framework that explicitly separates these decisions. CAPE uses cross-domain calibration evidence to redistribute expert widths under an exact layer-wise budget, while RAMP refines channel composition at fixed widths through one-out, one-in exchanges guided by a channel-interaction surrogate. Across three MoE models at 25% and 50% routed-expert channel pruning, UC-RAMP achieves the highest ten-task mean accuracy among evaluated pruning methods in five of six settings. At 50% pruning, it outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 8.19, 3.96, and 6.14 percentage points across the three models, respectively. In a single-A100 deployment at 25% pruning, UC-RAMP reduces measured time to first token by 19.7--23.9% and time per output token by 20.2--22.3% relative to the unpruned model. The code is available at https://github.com/xzktx003/UC_RAMP.

AI.tldr: UC-RAMP 是一种两阶段后训练精简框架，通过分离容量分配和通道选择两个决策，提升了混合专家模型在不同任务上的性能和效率。
AI.motivation: 当前微专家剪枝方法未能有效保持下游能力，UC-RAMP 针对这一问题提出了两阶段裁剪框架。
AI.method: UC-RAMP 通过 CAPE 和 RAMP 两个阶段执行精简操作，CAPE 基于跨领域校准证据重新分配专家宽度，RAMP 则通过固定宽度下的通道交换优化通道组成。
AI.result: 实验结果表明 UC-RAMP 在 25% 和 50% 专家通道剪枝下均实现了最高的多任务平均精度，在三项模型中的表现优于所有参评方法，并且在单块 A100 部署下的剪枝效率也明显提高。
AI.conclusion: UC-RAMP 通过有效分离微专家容量分配和通道选择的决策，显著提高了剪枝后模型的性能和效率。

title: Reflection-Guided Dynamics Rectification for Text-to-Image Generation
comment: This paper is 20 pages long, including the appendices, and contains 10 figures. Interactive demos, code, and the dataset are available on the project page: https://mair-lab-hust.github.io/RGDR/
summary: Fine-grained rectification of existing generations under a limited additional budget remains a key problem in test-time optimization (TTO) for image generation. As for prior approaches, they could identify residual errors, but could not directly ensure that the model acts on the feedback during reasoning. Such errors stem from multiple sources, such as the initial noise or text prompt, and ultimately induce an execution gap of failing to handle potential deviations along the trajectory generating. However, classic models generally cannot remedy this gap. To narrow it, we propose Reflection-Guided Dynamics Rectification (RGDR), which turns reflections on completed outputs into corrective interventions on the process of sampling dynamics at the trajectory level. Specifically, RGDR could impact every sampling step by adapting to instantaneous intervention. Moreover, RGDR generates flexible candidates while adjudicating between them and the reference. As experiments show, rectification from RGDR starts from the existing base trajectory and reflection, and RGDR is substantially more effective than former trajectory exploration. Under matched budgets for additional image generation, RGDR's gain in the cross-model average final checklist score over the reference is $1.51\times$ that of TIR prompt refinement and $1.81\times$ that of Dynamic CFG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为RGDR的方法，用于在有限预算下对现有生成进行精细校正。它通过在采样过程中的即时干预，使反射指导下的动态校正能够影响每个采样步骤，从而更有效地处理轨迹偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有方法无法直接确保模型在推理过程中应用反馈，导致模型在处理偏离轨迹时出现问题。经典模型通常无法弥补这一差距。
AI.method: RGDR方法将已完成输出的反射转化为在轨迹级别对采样动态过程的纠正干预。具体来说，它通过适应即时干预来影响每一个采样步骤，并生成灵活的候选方案进行选择。
AI.result: 实验表明，RGDR在交叉模型平均最终检查表得分上比TIR提示微调和动态CFG分别提高了1.51倍和1.81倍。
AI.conclusion: RGDR能够显著提高图像生成质量，特别是在有限预算下对现有生成进行精细校正方面表现突出。

title: VISAGENT: An Agent-Based End-to-End Voice Interaction System
summary: Voice-based public services have evolved from manual switchboards to intelligent platforms to meet modern user needs. However, current systems remain constrained by rigid menu-driven interaction, fragmented vertical services, and limited extensibility. To address these issues, we present VISAGENT, an agent-based end-to-end voice interaction system for large-scale public services that integrates end-to-end speech interaction, hierarchical agent routing, a scalable voice-agent marketplace, and user memory support. The system replaces menu-driven workflows with natural speech and dynamically dispatches user requests to either a general conversational model or specialized domain agents via a two-level routing paradigm that achieves sub-second intent-to-agent selection over hundreds of agents. User memory informs preference-aware agent selection and supplies relevant preferences and context to selected agents, supporting personalized task execution and reducing the need for users to repeat previously provided information. A voice-agent registration mechanism converts task agents into conversational entities, enabling dynamic onboarding and ecosystem-level extensibility. We validate VISAGENT through a real-world deployment in China's 114 hotline across multiple service domains. Experimental results demonstrate low-latency full-duplex interaction, robust routing scalability, and competitive speech naturalness. More broadly, this work advocates a shift from isolated voice assistants toward agent-centric conversational infrastructures, providing a general blueprint for building extensible voice-agent systems in public services and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了VISAGENT，一种端到端的基于代理的大型公共服务语音交互系统，该系统整合了端到端语音交互、分层代理路由、可扩展的语音代理市场和用户记忆支持。它提供了比传统菜单驱动流程更自然的交互方式，并通过两层路由机制实现了数百个代理的秒级意图到代理的匹配。
AI.motivation: 当前的语音服务平台受限于传统菜单驱动交互、服务垂直分割和扩展性限制。因此，本文旨在开发一种新的代理驱动的端到端语音交互系统，旨在改进这些限制。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种分层代理路由和用户记忆支持的两层路由机制，通过将任务代理注册为交互实体，实现动态注册和生态系统扩展。
AI.result: 本文通过在中国114热线的多领域实际部署，验证了VISAGENT的低延迟双向交互、路由可扩展性以及语音自然度。
AI.conclusion: 本文的工作提倡从孤立的语音助手向以代理为中心的对话基础设施的转变，为建筑可扩展的语音代理系统提供了蓝图。

title: TimelineAgent: An LLM-based Framework for Query-Centric Event Timeline Extraction Across Multiple Documents
summary: Query-centric cross-document event timeline extraction aims to construct event timelines from multiple documents under diverse query focuses. The task is very challenging due to the heterogeneous event modeling and reasoning requirements arising from both the intrinsic complexity of cross-document timeline construction and the diversity of query focuses. In this paper, we propose TimelineAgent, an LLM-based multi-agent framework featuring a multi-stage reasoning workflow, where heterogeneous event features are organized into reusable skills and orchestrated through a goal-oriented protocol. To facilitate evaluation, we construct a benchmark covering diverse query focuses. Experimental results show that TimelineAgent consistently outperforms existing methods, offering a practical framework for complex real-world timeline construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LLM的多代理框架TimelineAgent，用于跨文档事件时间轴提取，能够根据多样化的查询重点构建事件时间轴。实验证明，该框架在多种查询场景下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 跨文档事件时间轴提取任务复杂且挑战性高，因为它涉及到异构事件建模和推理需求，这些需求源于多文档时间轴构建的固有复杂性和查询重点的多样性。
AI.method: TimelineAgent是一个多代理框架，利用一个多阶段的推理工作流。它将异构事件特征组织成可重用的能力，并通过目标导向的协议进行协调。
AI.result: 该论文提出的方法在构建复杂的现实世界时间轴方面提供了一个实用框架，并在实验中展示了对该方法的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 研究为事件时间轴的跨文档提取提供了一种有效的方法，并为评价此类技术提供了一个涵盖多种查询焦点的基准。

title: Image Dehazing as In-Context Tabular Inference
summary: Image dehazing is traditionally addressed through handcrafted physical priors or task-specific deep learning models, often requiring carefully designed architectures or extensive model training. Recent advances in tabular foundation models (TFMs), however, offer an alternative learning paradigm in which continuous relationships can be inferred directly from contextual examples without task-specific model training. Motivated by this capability, this paper investigates whether single-image dehazing can be effectively reformulated as an in-context tabular regression problem and introduces DehazeTab, a framework that estimates atmospheric transmission from structured image-patch representations. Specifically, overlapping patches extracted from hazy images are transformed into tabular samples using handcrafted haze-related descriptors, pretrained visual embeddings, or their hybrid combinations, while corresponding transmission patches are summarized as scalar regression targets. A pretrained TFM then performs in-context regression using labeled reference patches to predict transmission values for unseen images without any further fine-tuning. These predictions are spatially aggregated into a transmission map, refined through guided filtering, and incorporated into the atmospheric scattering model to recover haze-free images. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate competitive restoration performance and reveal that physically motivated handcrafted features can outperform pretrained visual embeddings, while hybrid representations offer complementary benefits. Further analyses examine the effects of feature representations, patch selection, and contextual reference configurations on restoration quality. Beyond image dehazing, the findings highlight the potential of TFMs as an alternative paradigm for addressing low-level vision tasks through structured and in-context inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的单图像去雾方法DehazeTab，通过将图像块转化为表格样本并利用预训练的表格基础模型进行上下文回归来估计大气透射率，从而恢复出无雾图像。
AI.motivation: 研究是否可以将单图像去雾问题重新定义为基于结构化的图像块表示的上下文表回归问题，利用预训练的表格基础模型进行模型训练和预测，而不需要对模型进行进一步微调。
AI.method: 首先，从含有雾霾的图像中提取重叠的图像块，并将其转化为表格样本。这些样本利用预训练视图嵌入、手工构建的雾相关描述符或它们的混合表示进行描述。然后，预训练的表格基础模型根据带有标签的参考块在上下文中进行回归，以预测未见过图像的透射率值。这些预测值被空间聚合为透射率图，通过引导滤波进行细化，并与大气散射模型结合以恢复无雾图像。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在恢复性能上表现出竞争性，并揭示了物理上合理的手工构建的特征可以优于预训练视图嵌入，而混合表示提供了互补的优势。此外，还分析了特征表示、图像块选择和上下文参考配置对恢复质量的影响。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明表格基础模型作为低层次视觉任务的替代范式在结构化和上下文推理中的潜力，超越了传统的基于特定任务的深度学习模型和手工构建的先验知识。

title: Conditional information Retrieval for Longitudinal Survey Harmonisation
summary: Identifying conceptually equivalent questions across different surveys is a challenging information retrieval task where surface-level textual similarity is insufficient. Two questions may be lexically similar yet assess entirely different sociological sub-concepts, or lexically different yet conceptually equivalent. We introduce a conditional information retrieval framework that addresses this by decomposing the task into two steps: concept extraction, which identifies the underlying sociological concept of a survey question using a fine-tuned generative model, and concept-aware retrieval, which augments question representations with the extracted concept as an explicit conditioning signal for finer-grained alignment. To reflect the realistic data scarcity conditions of specialised social science annotation, we use CLOSER as a case study. Our framework consistently outperforms baselines by 2-3 points in both MAP and Recall. We further analyse fine-tuning strategies including SFT, DPO, and dynamic DPO, finding that SFT delivers the most stable gains while dynamic DPO interacts differently with instruction-tuned versus distilled reasoning backbones. Finally, we demonstrate that a model fine-tuned on a general social science thesaurus (ELSST) transfers robustly to task-specific survey data, offering a practical solution under data scarcity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用概念提取和概念感知检索的条件信息检索框架，通过细粒度对齐解决了不同调查问卷中概念上等价问题。该方法在CLOSER数据集上优于基线，并探究了不同微调策略的效果。
AI.motivation: 为了解决表面文本相似度不足以识别不同调查问卷中概念上等同的问题，寻找更准确的方法来对齐问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个两个步骤的条件信息检索框架，首先通过一个微调的生成模型提取概念，然后将提取的概念作为明确定义的条件信号增强问题表示，实现更好的对齐。
AI.result: 该框架在CLOSER数据集的MAP和召回率上优于基线模型2-3个百分点。此外，通过微调策略（如SFT，DPO和动态DPO）的分析，作者发现SFT提供了最稳定的改进，而动态DPO与指令调优和蒸馏推理模型的互动不同。
AI.conclusion: 根据一般社会科学同义词库（ELSST）微调的模型可以在特定调查数据上实现稳健的转移，提出了一种有效的解决方案，特别是在数据稀缺情况下。

title: ActTime: Action-Conditioned World Modeling for Time Series
summary: Time-series models increasingly condition on known future inputs. In controlled systems, some of these inputs are actions that can be changed, compared, and optimized before execution. A model must therefore do more than predict the realized future: it must predict how outcomes change under different actions from the same observed history and support reliable comparison of candidate plans. We introduce ActTime, an action-conditioned world model for time series. Over the observed history, ActTime updates variable-specific latent states through an action-conditioned transition and corrects them using observations. It then rolls the same transition forward under candidate actions to generate future trajectories. Training uses only factual trajectories, without paired alternative-action outcomes or planning supervision. We construct a simulator-grounded evaluation suite across building energy, traffic, greenhouse climate, and inventory management, covering factual prediction, intervention-effect prediction, offline decision making, and closed-loop planning. ActTime ranks first in 12 of 16 domain-task settings. Across eight methods, the mean pairwise model-ranking reversal rate is 17.8% between factual prediction and intervention fidelity, and rises to 28.4% between intervention fidelity and decision ranking. These results show that factual accuracy, intervention fidelity, and decision quality are related but not interchangeable.

AI.tldr: ActTime 是一种针对时间序列的动作条件世界模型，它能够预测不同动作在相同历史观测下的结果变化，进而支持计划的可靠比较。该模型在多个领域的模拟器测试中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 在受控系统中，可以调整并优化未来的时间序列输入（如系统动作），因此需要能够预测不同操作下结果变化的模型，以进行可靠的计划比较和优化。
AI.method: ActTime 通过将动作条件下的状态变化与观察结果相结合进行预测。在观察历史中，它调整变量特定的潜在状态，并在此基础上考虑候选动作的过渡来生成未来轨迹。模型通过事实时间序列进行训练，无需配对的动作结果或规划监督。
AI.result: 在建筑能耗、交通、温室气候和库存管理等多个领域的模拟器测试中，ActTime 在16个领域任务设置中有12个排名第一。通过模型排名的变化率分析，表明事实精度、干预精度和决策质量之间存在关联，但不是相互替换的。
AI.conclusion: ActTime 提供了一种有效的方法来提升对动作条件下的时间序列预测准确性和计划决策质量，显示出在多个应用领域的良好性能。

title: PLANE: Plug-and-Play Fine-Grained Visual Experts for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) commonly suffer from hallucinations, which appear as fabricating non-existent objects or outputting incorrect attributes and spatial relationships in images. Previous works empirically indicate that CLIP-style vision encoders tend to focus on primary objects while ignoring image details, which is one of the causes of hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose plug-and-play fine-grained visual experts (PLANE) comprising two components: LoRA visual experts operating on CLIP for multi-aspect image encoding, and an instruction-aware gate network for adaptive image feature fusion. During training, we construct a fine-grained image-caption pairs dataset, where images are described from three aspects: objects, attributes, and relations between objects. Image-caption pairs from different aspects are used to train the three fine-grained LoRA experts respectively. Aiming at comprehensively evaluate our method's capabilities, we manually annotate a fine-grained hallucination evaluation benchmark for LVLMs which is GPT4-independent during evaluation phase (GIFT). We conduct experiments both on popular hallucination evaluation benchmarks and GIFT. The results show that our method effectively reduces hallucinations across models of different types and sizes while introducing minimal inference latency. Compared to advanced baselines, our model also demonstrates superior performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PLANE，一种用于LVLM的插件式细粒度视觉专家模型。PLANE包括两个组件：用于多方面图像编码的LoRA视觉专家和指令感知门网络。实验表明，该方法能有效地减少模型生成的幻觉，同时引入的推理延迟较小。此外，作者还构建了一个细粒度幻觉评估基准GIFT，该基准独立于GPT4，在多个基准测试中的表现优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: LVLMs存在幻觉问题，即生成图像中的非真实物体或错误属性。为解决这一问题，作者提出了一种插件式细粒度视觉专家模型PLANE，旨在提高LVLM的生成准确性。
AI.method: PLANE由两个部分组成：LoRA视觉专家和指令感知门网络。LoRA视觉专家可以针对物体、属性和物体间关系进行细粒度图像编码，而指令感知门网络则用于适应性地融合图像特征。训练数据包括从三个角度描述的细粒度图像-描述对。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，PLANE能够有效地减少各种类型和规模模型中的幻觉，同时在多个基准测试中表现出更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 作者展示了PLANE的有效性，该模型在幻觉生成上的改善体现了其对细粒度图像处理的优势。此外，还提供了一个细粒度幻觉评估基准GIFT以促进LVLM的研究。

title: Reading Time Modeling with Pixel-Based Language Models
summary: Tokenization-free, pixel-based language models (PLMs) have recently been proposed as an alternative to conventional token-based language models (TLMs), typically motivated by practical considerations, e.g., the flexibility to support new languages or vocabularies. Nevertheless, PLMs also have the potential to serve as infrastructure for computational (psycho)linguistics, where tokenization has been a source of bias in estimating information-theoretic values, such as surprisal, and has pushed the bottom-up visual orthographic features outside the scope. In this study, we first integrate PLMs into the modeling of naturalistic human reading and, in particular, examine their use to estimate next-word predictability, which can also integrate orthographic and parafoveal information. Our results demonstrate that next-word prediction difficulty, computed in pixel space, has strong predictive power for gaze duration and word skipping behavior across various languages. In particular, their advantage is complementary to existing token-level surprisal and entropy estimates. Cross-lingual analyses with script variations also clarify their distinctive visual processing biases, facilitating research into how bottom-up visual information is incrementally integrated into expectation-based reading.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用基于像素的语言模型（PLMs）进行自然阅读建模，特别是在估计下一个词的预测性方面，通过计算像素空间中的预测难度，发现对于不同的语言，其可以有效预测注视时间和单词跳过行为，并且表现出与现有基于token的惊讶度和熵估计互补的优势。
AI.motivation: 鉴于令牌化在计算（心理）语言学中的潜在偏差，尤其是对信息理论值如惊讶度的估计，研究通过引入基于像素的语言模型（PLMs），旨在提供一种新的方法来估算下一个词的可预测性，同时整合视觉正交特征和 parafoveal 信息。
AI.method: 研究通过对自然阅读建模，特别是利用PLMs估算下一个词的预测难度，并且通过跨语言分析不同的书写系统变化来检测它们独特的视觉处理偏见，从而如何逐步整合基于视觉的期望阅读信息。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，像素空间中的下一个词预测难度能够有效地预测跨语言下的注视时间和单词跳过行为，且其优势与现有的基于token的惊讶度和熵估计形成了互补。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了PLMs在自然阅读建模中的优势，尤其是在估计下一个词的预测性方面，为理解基于视觉信息的渐进性预期阅读提供了新的见解。

title: TRACE: Tracking Multimodal Clinical Trajectories for Inpatient Risk Prediction
summary: Accurate inpatient risk prediction requires modeling heterogeneous clinical evidence that accumulates irregularly over time. This challenge spans in-hospital mortality, prolonged length of stay, and readmission, each with task-specific observation windows. Existing multimodal approaches combine structured health record data, chest x-rays, and clinical text, but primarily focus on modality fusion or missing-modality compensation, with limited attention to temporal trajectories over an admission. We propose TRACE (TRAjectory modeling of multimodal Clinical Events), a daily-scale framework organizing clinical events into day-level trajectories, separating day-invariant global context from day-specific local events drawn from EHR data, chest x-rays, radiology reports, and discharge summaries. The trajectory is encoded using temporal attention, allowing unavailable modalities to emit no tokens. A phenotype-guided contrastive objective further organizes admissions under heterogeneous disease distributions. Across cohorts from MIMIC-IV, eICU, and MIMIC-III comprising nearly 180,000 total stays, we evaluate TRACE on mortality, length of stay, and readmission prediction. TRACE achieves the highest AUROC across all nine dataset-task settings and the highest ACC in eight, outperforming baselines. Ablation studies validate our attention masks and contrastive learning, while trajectory-level attribution localizes risk-associated hospital days and modalities.

AI.tldr: TRACE通过每天的时间尺度框架，将临床事件组织成日级轨迹，并利用时间注意力机制编码，能够处理多模态数据，同时关注住院过程中的时间轨迹。在MIMIC-IV、eICU和MIMIC-III数据集上的实验证明了TRACE在死亡率、住院时间预测和再入院预测中的优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要关注模态融合或缺失模态补偿，而缺乏对住院期间时间轨迹的关注。本文旨在提出一个能够处理异质临床证据并捕捉时间轨迹的新框架。
AI.method: TRACE基于每天的时间尺度框架，将临床事件组织成日级轨迹，并利用时间注意力机制编码。该方法能够处理多模态数据，分离日不变的全局上下文与日特定的地方事件。进一步使用基于表型的对比性目标将住院病人归类到异质疾病分布中。
AI.result: TRACE在合并MODIC-IV、eICU和MODIC-III数据集中对死亡率、住院时间和再入院预测的所有九个数据集任务设置中均达到了最高的AUROC，并在八个任务中取得了最高的ACC，超越了基准。
AI.conclusion: 通过实验证明，TRACE在住院风险预测任务中表现出优越性能，尤其在处理异质临床数据的时间轨迹方面。此外，通过消融研究证明了注意力掩码和对比学习的有效性，并通过轨迹级归因定位了风险相关医院日和模态。

title: Map2Vid: Embodied Navigation Video Generation with Human-Friendly Motion Control
summary: Controllable video generation has recently achieved impressive visual quality, yet existing control paradigms remain poorly suited to embodied navigation. Text prompts are spatially ambiguous, while camera-trajectory control relies on low-level motion specifications that are unintuitive for human users and difficult to manipulate. In this work, we introduce Map2Vid, a novel task that reformulates embodied navigation video generation as a BEV-map-to-video synthesis problem, together with a large-scale benchmark for systematic evaluation. By using BEV maps, which provide a visual representation of global scene layout and intended navigation routes, Map2Vid enables human-friendly navigation video generation. To support this task, we construct a dedicated dataset with over 100K navigation sequences across 61 indoor scenes, each paired with egocentric videos, BEV maps, camera trajectories and language instructions. We further develop a unified framework that integrates multiple control signals, together with a curriculum training strategy that progressively weakens non-map inputs, enabling flexible inference under both full conditioning and map-only input. Extensive experiments across multiple foundation generation models demonstrate that controllable navigation video generation via BEV map is a viable and promising direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Map2Vid的新任务，将具有BEV地图的引导式导航视频生成重新定义为一种从BEV地图生成视频的问题，并构建了一个大规模的基准测试数据集。通过使用BEV地图，该任务能够生成人类友好的导航视频。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于文本提示和基于相机轨迹控制的导航视频生成方法存在缺陷，具体表现为文本提示的地理位置信息不明确，而基于低级运动控制的方法高度专业技术化且难以操作。为解决这些问题，作者提出了Map2Vid任务。
AI.method: Map2Vid通过引入BEV地图（鸟瞰图地图），结合人体工学的导航视频生成方法。作者构建了一个数据集包含超过100000个导航序列，以及与每个序列对应的第一视角视频、BEV地图、相机轨迹以及语言指令。此外，作者开发了一个多控制信号的统一框架，并结合了一个逐步削弱非地图输入的梯度训练策略。
AI.result: 广泛的实验证明，通过BEV地图进行可控制导航视频生成是可行且有前景的方向。
AI.conclusion: Map2Vid通过提出新的任务和数据集，为未来导航视频生成的研究提供了新的方向。

title: VEILED-SH: Vulnerability Expression through Indirect Language Evaluation Dataset (Self-Harm)
comment: Content warning: this paper discusses suicide, self-harm, and distressing language
summary: AI systems may miss indirect, culturally situated distress or provide support mismatched to the application context. Existing benchmarks do not jointly address cultural variation, application context, and practitioner disagreement. We introduce VEILED-SH, a benchmark and construction methodology for evaluating single-turn responses to indirect expressions of suicide, self-harm, and distress. Its 10,003 prompts span counselor chat, forum posts, platform search, and triage, drawing on Singapore-grounded sources and public datasets. An expert-validated multi-label taxonomy distinguishes intent, communicative function, and response behavior. Six automated profiles, individually calibrated to three peer-support practitioners and three clinicians, retain separate reference policies for proxy-alignment scoring. Evaluating five systems on a coverage-enriched sample reveals variation in proxy alignment across profile-generated reference policies, even for the same system responses.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了VEILED-SH基准，用于评估针对隐性自杀、自伤和心理压力表达的单轮响应。该基准涵盖了咨询聊天、论坛帖子、平台搜索和紧急处理等多种应用场景，涉及多元文化背景。研究结果揭示了不同自动化配置（针对同伴支持工作者和临床医生）下的代理对齐差异。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准测试没有同时处理文化差异、应用场景和实践者的分歧问题，因此作者希望通过VEILED-SH基准来提供一个更加全面的评估框架，以改进AI系统在处理心理支持任务时的文化适应性和场景匹配性。
AI.method: VEILED-SH基准包括10,003个涵盖多种情境的提示，利用新加坡本地数据来源和公共数据集。它采用专家验证的多标签分类体系来区分意图、沟通功能和回应行为。每个自动化配置都针对不同的同行支持工作者和临床医生进行了个性化校准，并保留独立的参考策略，以便进行代理对齐评分。
AI.result: 通过评估五个系统在扩展覆盖范围样本上的表现，研究发现即使对于相同的系统响应，不同自动化配置的代理对齐也存在显著差异。这一结果揭示了当前AI系统在理解和回应隐性心理危机方面仍存在局限。
AI.conclusion: VEILED-SH基准和评价方法为后续研究提供了一个全面的框架，有助于提升AI系统的文化适应性和应用场景适配性，未来还可以根据这一框架进一步优化系统性能。

title: EvalRx: Agentic Diagnosis and Verified Repair of Foundation Models
comment: 23 pages. Technical report. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/evalvitals/evalrx
summary: Model evaluation reveals where models fail, but rarely why or whether a proposed fix genuinely works. We introduce EvalRx, an open-source agentic framework for statistically grounded model diagnosis and repair. EvalRx discovers systematic failure modes, explores candidate mechanisms, formulates falsifiable hypotheses, and verifies them by executing frozen, pre-specified tests before using supported diagnoses to guide tiered repair. Candidate repairs are validated against the unchanged model and promoted only when they improve the target behavior without unacceptable regression. Across language, vision-language, and audio-language settings spanning Gemini, Qwen, Gemma, and Nemotron, EvalRx improves performance in all 12 evaluated model family-modality combinations, with gains ranging from +1.4 to +10.9 percentage points (+5.8 points on average). These results show that model evaluation can serve not only to measure failures, but to support an auditable process for diagnosing and repairing them.

AI.tldr: EvalRx 是一个开放源代码的框架，用于统计意义上的模型诊断和修复。它能够发现模型系统的失败模式，探索候选机制，生成可验证的假设，并通过执行预定义的测试来验证这些假设。最终引导分层修复以提高目标行为，而不带来不可接受的退化。
AI.motivation: 目前的模型评估方法不能揭示模型为何失败或是否提出的修复真正有效。EvalRx 的引入旨在提供一个统计学基础的支持诊断和修复模型的过程。
AI.method: EvalRx 通过探索性失败模式，提出可验证假设，执行预定义的测试来验证假设，最终使用诊断结果指导分层的修复过程，确保修复的改进超过了不可接受的退化。
AI.result: 在语言、视觉语言和音频语言设置下，EvalRx 覆盖了 Gemini, Qwen, Gemma, 以及 Nemotron 等模型家族-模态组合，实现了所有 12 种评估的性能提升，增幅从 +1.4% 到 +10.9% 不等，平均增幅为 +5.8%。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果显示，模型评估不仅可以测量失败，还可以支持一个可审计的诊断和修复过程，从而改进模型性能。

title: Evaluating Cloud and Self-Hosted OCR Systems for Arabic, English, and French Documents: Bounding Box Detection, Text Recognition, and Mathematical Expression Recognition
summary: Choosing an OCR system for a multilingual archive requires balancing accuracy against deployment constraints. This study compares cloud and self-hosted systems on three tasks: bounding box detection on 48 Arabic, English, and French pages, text recognition on 315 pages across nine document types, and mathematical expression recognition on 83 English and Arabic samples. Detection was assessed by page-level visual grades, text by character error rate (CER) against a Gemini-generated reference transcription, and mathematics by scores against known answers. Main estimates are accompanied by 95% intervals and paired comparisons. Google Document AI and Surya produced Good line boxes on 47 of 48 (98%) and 46 of 48 (96%) pages. Datalab, Azure Document Intelligence, and Document AI had mean CERs of 0.145-0.152, with no difference detected in unadjusted paired comparisons. Surya had the lowest mean CER among self-hosted systems (0.199). No mathematical test had a statistically clear leader. Strict checks showed that near-perfect page scores could conceal a replaced Arabic variable or Eastern Arabic digits rewritten in Western form. Reliable evaluation therefore requires uncertainty estimates, structural checks, and notation-specific tests in addition to aggregate recognition scores.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较云和自托管的OCR系统，在多语种档案的边界框识别、文本识别和数学表达式识别三个任务上进行评估，强调了可靠的评估需要不确定性估计、结构检查和特定符号测试，而不仅仅是综合识别分数。
AI.motivation: 研究的主要动机在于提供一种平衡OCR系统准确性与部署限制的方法，特别是在多语种档案管理中。
AI.method: 研究使用了三种边界框检测任务、三种类型文档的文本识别任务以及两种语种的数学表达式识别任务来评估OCR系统的性能，包括Google Document AI、Datalab、Azure Document Intelligence以及Surya等系统。
AI.result: 在边界框检测方面，Google Document AI和Surya表现出色；在文本识别方面，Surya在自托管系统中具有最低的字符错误率；数学表达式识别任务没有明显的领导者；严格的检查显示，近乎完美的页面得分可能隐藏了某些替换或重新书写的符号。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论指出，可靠评价OCR系统需要结合不确定性估计、结构检查及特定符号测试，而非仅仅依赖综合识别分数。

title: Rethinking BPE: Merge Selection as Model Selection
summary: Subword tokenization methods such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) are a core component of modern language models; yet, tokenizer capacity remains typically determined by a fixed merge budget, chosen heuristically. Since larger vocabularies increase memory usage and computational cost, selecting compact and effective token inventories is essential for efficient language modeling. We study the optimization of a BPE merge budget as a statistical model selection problem and investigate information-theoretic criteria for \emph{computing optimal merge sets} directly from corpus statistics. To further improve the merge selection in limited data conditions, we augment the BPE training corpora with synthetic texts generated from the original data, providing estimates for the unigram and bigram distributions. Experiments across multiple corpora and downstream tasks show that using a principled vocabulary selection technique reduces model size, with little degradation in performance. We further observe that synthetic data can yield better tokenizers, especially in low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 研究了BPE合并预算的优化，提出通过统计模型选择和信息论准则直接从语料统计计算最优合并集的方法，并通过合成文本改进合并选择，以减少模型大小并提高性能，尤其是在低资源环境中。
AI.motivation: 现有BPE分词方法依赖于固定且通常未经验证的合并预算，这导致了内存使用量和计算成本的增加。因此，作者旨在更高效地优化BPE合并预算，探索统计模型选择和信息论准则来直接从语料库统计信息中计算最优合并集。
AI.method: 首先，作者将BPE合并预算优化视为统计模型选择问题，然后探索了信息论准则来直接从语料库统计信息中计算最优合并集。其次，为了在数据有限的情况下进一步改进合并选择，作者利用从原有数据生成的合成文本增广BPE训练语料库，提供一元和二元分布估计。
AI.result: 实验结果证明，通过这种方法选择词汇表可以减少模型大小并降低数据集相关的依赖性，性能下降可以忽略不计。特别地，在低资源条件下，合成数据可以使分词器效果更好。
AI.conclusion: 基于此研究，可以更加科学地优化BPE分词方法，并在各个下游任务中减少模型大小，同时保持甚至改进性能，尤其在资源有限的环境中。

title: From Trace to Fix: Residual Task State in Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Recovering from failures in long-horizon, stateful language agents is challenging because the action introducing a defect, the symptom exposing it, and the persistent state requiring repair frequently diverge. Existing methods largely focus on retrospective failure attribution, leaving sequential diagnosis and state repair poorly integrated under constrained budgets. We introduce TRACE-FIX, a unified recovery framework centered on versioned residual task state. Trace transforms execution logs into a structured dependency-linked ledger, prioritizing unresolved task requirements rather than salient surface errors. Fix formulates recovery as budgeted planning over admissible actions, incorporating outcome forecasting and explicit repair-reserve constraints to prevent premature budget exhaustion. To rigorously decouple localization accuracy from downstream repair capability, we present LongH-Debug, evaluating root-cause attribution, verified-fault recovery, and end-to-end closed-loop execution independently. Our empirical analysis demonstrates that structured residual tracking substantially improves causal localization over raw-trace baselines, while budget-aware sequential planning converts verified fault signals into more reliable task recovery without destructive trial-and-error. Code is available at https://github.com/toffeecat/tracedp.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为TRACE-FIX的统一体恢复框架，通过版本化的残余任务状态来解决长期作业中复杂故障恢复的问题。该框架包括一种称之为Trace的工具，用于转换执行日志为结构化依赖链，以及一种称为Fix的工具，负责以预算感知的规划方式来执行恢复操作，保证不会过早耗尽预算。通过LongH-Debug实验，证明了这种结构化剩余跟踪方法在因果定位上的优势，避免了破坏性试验。
AI.motivation: 现有的方法主要集中于失败回溯，而缺乏有序诊断和状态修复的集成。为此，研究提出了一种新的框架，旨在改善在受限预算下进行的长期作业中故障恢复的问题。
AI.method: 该方法的核心在于一种版本化的残余任务状态跟踪策略，名为Trace，它可以将执行日志转化为一个结构化的依赖链，从而优先处理未解决的任务需求而非表面错误。另一部分是Fix函数，它通过预算感知的规划来进行恢复操作，这种方法不仅能够预测结果还能设置修复预留预算来防止失效。
AI.result: 通过LongH-Debug实验，研究展示了结构化的残余跟踪在因果定位上的优势，能够提高故障问题的根本原因的识别能力，同时在预算感知的顺序规划下，能够更加可靠地进行任务恢复，避免了破坏性的试错过程。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的方法通过提高故障定位的准确性和恢复操作的可靠性，为长期作业中的自愈系统提供了新的解决方案。

title: GeoV2V: Geometry-Grounded Video Diffusion Model for Driving Scene Generation
comment: Published at ECCV 2026. Author accepted manuscript. Project page: https://xiyuche.github.io/GeoV2V/
summary: Novel view synthesis under trajectory changes is essential for autonomous driving simulation, yet existing methods struggle to generate consistent videos when extrapolating to unseen viewpoints such as lane shifts. Reconstruction-based approaches maintain geometric consistency but degrade in visual quality under large viewpoint changes, while reconstruct-then-restore methods often produce visually plausible frames yet suffer from geometric and temporal inconsistencies. We present GeoV2V, a geometry-grounded video-to-video diffusion framework that synthesizes temporally coherent driving videos along novel trajectories by integrating LiDAR and depth-derived geometric priors with full-video conditioning in the Wan 2.1 backbone. A key challenge in learning cross-lane transformations is the lack of synchronized multi-trajectory supervision in real-world datasets. To address this, we also introduce Para4D, a synthetic dataset capturing synchronized multi-lane driving videos within dynamic scenes, which provides explicit supervision for lane-shift generation and serves as a strong training prior for geometry-consistent view synthesis. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and Para4D demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in visual quality, geometric consistency, and robustness to complex lighting dynamics under large trajectory shifts. Project page: https://xiyuche.github.io/GeoV2V/

AI.tldr: GeoV2V 是一种几何导向的视频到视频扩散框架，结合 LiDAR 和深度衍生的几何先验，通过 Wan 2.1 骨干网在新轨迹上合成时空一致的驾驶视频。Para4D 是一个合成数据集，用于同步多车道驾驶视频，提供车道变换的明确监督，增强了几何一致性视图合成。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理未见视角（如车道变换）时，难以生成一致的视频。重建方法在大视角变化下视觉质量下降，重建后再修复方法则会导致几何和时间不一致。
AI.method: GeoV2V 使用 Wan 2.1 骨干网结合 LiDAR 和深度衍生的几何先验，通过全视频条件化生成时空一致的驾驶视频。通过 Para4D 数据集提供车道变换的明确监督，增强几何一致性视图合成。
AI.result: 在 Waymo、nuScenes 和 Para4D 上的实验表明，GeoV2V 在视觉质量、几何一致性以及对复杂照明动态的鲁棒性方面达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: GeoV2V 通过结合几何先验和全视频条件化在新轨迹上生成高质的驾驶视频，并通过 Para4D 数据集提供车道变换的明确监督，提升了几何一致的视图合成效果。

title: Heartbeat Thinking: Speculative Reasoning and Tool Execution While Listening in Realtime Voice Agents
summary: Tool-using voice agents often leave users waiting after speech ends, even when actionable information arrives earlier in the request. Speculative approaches begin work during speech, but chunk-bounded or interrupt-on-update generation can truncate a tool call before its arguments are complete. This couples computation time to speech updates, limiting useful work completed in advance. We introduce Heartbeat Thinking, which handles updated input through new Thinker invocations while allowing ongoing invocations and dispatched tools to finish. Periodic invocations read the latest partial transcript and a shared record of completed reasoning and tool results. These results help resolve missing arguments and initiate dependent calls, allowing preparation to progress across speech updates. Across SpeechFCEval, FDBench v3, and AudioCRAG, Heartbeat improves aggregate speculative tool coverage or retrieval reuse over a SHANKS-style windowed baseline, with benchmark-dependent effects on final task quality. On FDBench v3, it increases tool coverage by 16 percentage points and reduces mean final-response latency by 36.4\%. The results show that heartbeat thinking paradigm preserving ongoing computation during speech can turn listening time into reusable preparation for faster and more capable voice-agent responses.

AI.tldr: Heartbeat Thinking通过周期性地处理更新输入，允许正在进行的调用和已派遣的工具完成其工作，从而提高工具覆盖率和最终响应速度。
AI.motivation: 现有的推测性方法在语音结束前就开始工作，但由于分块限制或中断更新生成可能导致工具调用在完成参数之前被截断，限制了提前完成的工作量。
AI.method: Heartbeat Thinking引入了一种新的方法，通过新实例化Thinker来处理更新输入，同时允许正在进行的调用和已派遣的工具完成其工作。
AI.result: Heartbeat Thinking在SpeechFCEval、FDBench v3和AudioCRAG基准测试中提高了推测工具覆盖率或检索重用，并在FDBench v3基准测试中将工具覆盖率提高了16个百分点，最终响应延迟降低了36.4%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，Heartbeat Thinking能够在语音期间保持持续的计算，将倾听时间转化为可重用的准备，从而加快并提高基于语音的代理响应的效率和能力。

title: Standing on the Shoulders of Giants: Enhancing LLM Agents for Automated Fact-Checking with Human Expert Skills
summary: Automated fact-checking (AFC) systems powered by large language model (LLM) agents still face challenges in evidence retrieval and claim verification. Existing approaches improve their capabilities through computationally costly post-training or human-in-the-loop feedback that is difficult to scale. To transfer professional fact-checking expertise to LLM agents efficiently, we distill publicly available guidelines published by Agence France-Presse (AFP) Fact Check into a reusable, modular Professional Fact-Checking Skill (PFC-Skill). We then present SkillCheck, the first AFC system that gives LLM agents dynamic access to PFC-Skill to guide evidence retrieval and claim verification at inference time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SkillCheck improves upon skill-free DEFAME baselines across multiple LLM backbones, with gains of 2.2--4.8 pp. in Accuracy and 1.5--6.3 pp. in Macro-F1 on the AVeriTeC benchmark. Notably, SkillCheck with GPT-4o-Mini exceeds DEFAME with GPT-4o by 3.4 pp. in Accuracy while cutting inference cost by roughly 61%. The performance gains also extend to open-web retrieval. Ablations show that incorporating the skill during evidence retrieval provides most of the gains, while incorporation into both stages yields the best overall performance. Case studies show that PFC-Skill enables more targeted search and closer scrutiny of evidence. To conclude, our work shows that LLM agents can "stand on the shoulders of giants" by drawing on the best practices of professional fact-checkers, substantially enhancing AFC performance without extra training or continuous human supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为SkillCheck的新架构，通过将AFP事实核查指南中的专业知识以PFC-Skill的形式集成到LLM代理中，显著提高了自动事实核查系统的性能，尤其在证据检索和声明验证方面。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动事实核查系统在证据检索和声明验证方面仍面临挑战。本文通过将AFP事实核查专家的经验转化为PFC-Skill，旨在提升LLM代理的自动事实核查能力。
AI.method: 该研究提取了AFR/AFP发布的事实核查指南，并将其转化为模块化的PFC-Skill，设计了名为SkillCheck的新系统，允许LLM代理在推理时访问PFC-Skill以辅助证据检索和声明验证。
AI.result: 与无能力基线DEFAME相比，SkillCheck在多个LLM骨干模型上表现出了显著的性能提升，准确率提高了2.2-4.8个百分点，宏F1分数提高了1.5-6.3个百分点。使用GPT-4o-Mini的SkillCheck比使用GPT-4o的DEFAME在准确率上提高了3.4个百分点，同时减少了约61%的推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过集成PFC-Skill，LLM代理能够利用专业人士的最佳实践，显著提升自动事实核查系统的性能，而无需额外训练或持续的人工监督。

title: Visual Scaffolding: Toward Native Multimodal Reasoning
summary: The success of chain-of-thought (CoT) in complex reasoning can be attributed to a textual scaffolding effect: explicit intermediate results can be examined, reused, and composed to support subsequent reasoning, much as scaffolding supports a building under construction. However, mainstream multimodal LLMs lack an equivalent scaffold for visual distinctions that are difficult to express in concise verbal descriptions. We therefore ask: Can native visual representations become first-class citizens alongside language, providing a visual scaffold for reasoning? We define native multimodal reasoning as reasoning in which native visual representations and language jointly carry reusable intermediate states. As a concrete implementation, the visual scaffolding mechanism we proposed lets the MLLM autonomously initiate a retrieval action at any reasoning step. A lightweight retriever selects native visual features, which are then incorporated directly into the evolving CoT and remain available to subsequent steps. To evaluate this mechanism under controlled visual demands, we introduce NMR-Bench, comprising Burden Counting and Path Tracing. With 88M added parameters (approximately 2%) on Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking, our model achieves 66.43% and 72.50% accuracy, respectively, surpassing the evaluated GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro baselines. Controlled interventions show that changing selected visual content affects task accuracy and can redirect subsequent visual selection even when intervening text is held fixed. These findings show that native visual states can function as intermediate reasoning material and point toward reusable scaffolds for additional modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入视觉支撑机制，允许多模态LLM自主在推理步骤中启动检索动作，选取可视化特征并直接融入递进的CoT中，从而显著提高了在特定视觉任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 主流多模态LLM缺乏能够支持复杂视觉推理的可视化支架，本文提出了一个让可视化表示作为与语言并列的第一级公民的设想，并通过NMR-Bench评测模型在特定视觉任务中的表现。
AI.method: 本文定义了原生多模态推理，其中语言和可视化特征共同承载可复用的中间状态。通过引入一个轻量级的检索器，选取原生视觉特征并直接融入当前的CoT，以提高多模态推理能力。
AI.result: 本文在Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking上增加了约2%的参数量（88M），并在NMR-Bench中的Burden Counting和Path Tracing任务中分别达到了66.43%和72.50%的准确率，超越了GPT-5.5和Gemini 3.1 Pro等基准模型，且干预实验证明改变可视化内容能够影响任务准确性和后续的视觉选择。
AI.conclusion: 本文的研究结果表明，原生的视觉状态能够作为推理过程中的中间材料，为其他模态提供了重复使用的支架，这为多模态推理能力的提升开辟了新的道路。

title: Shaping the Document, Not the Model: Optimized Suffixes for Context Following
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 18 tables. Project page: https://context-gcg.github.io
summary: When a user supplies a document and wants the answer drawn from it, a language model is expected to follow it even when it contradicts its parametric knowledge. Prior work has focused on making the model rely on context by steering activations, contrasting logits during decoding, or instructing it in plain language. We ask whether the document alone, with no instruction written into it and no access to the model at inference time, is enough. We optimize a document suffix by discrete token search, starting from the answer to a single question and extending the objective to a set of passages, to multi-hop questions that follow from the planted fact, and to later turns of a conversation. On counterfactual passages that contradict parametric knowledge of the model, the suffix flips nearly all items the model resists across three instruction-tuned model families, in most settings outperforms the decoding baseline and the strongest instruction we could write, and matches activation steering. Controls show that the suffix largely acts through the passage rather than injecting the answer, and a single suffix per model transfers to unseen passages. Each extended objective carries the effect to its target, so the objective, not only the document, sets how far the effect reaches.

AI.tldr: 研究人员优化了一个文档后缀，通过离散令牌搜索，使其能够在不提供额外指令的情况下，与模型参数知识矛盾的文档部分对模型产生影响，显著改进了模型对问题的回答。
AI.motivation: 当前研究旨在解决在用户提供一份文档，希望模型从文档中得出答案时，即使这些答案与模型原有的参数化知识相冲突，模型仍能遵循文档的问题。之前的工作主要集中在通过引导模型激活、对比解码过程中的输出概率或直接用自然语言进行指令传递上，但这种方法在某些情况下效果有限。
AI.method: 研究人员通过优化文档的后缀，使用离散令牌搜索的方法，从答案开始，逐步扩展目标到一系列相关段落和需要跳跃推理的问题，以及对话中的后续部分。这种方法对于与模型原有知识矛盾的段落表现出显著的效果，能够在多数测试环境下优于直接解码基线和最强的指令。
AI.result: 优化后的文档后缀能够几乎逆转模拟能够抵抗的所有项目，对于三个不同指令调优的模型系列，在大多数情况下能够超越直接解码基线和最强的手写指令，并且与模型参数激活控制进行了比较，效果相当。实验证明，文档后缀的作用主要是通过对段落的影响，并且不同的模型可以使用相同的后缀对未见过的段落产生效果。每个增强的目标都有助于将效果传递到其目标位置。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论表明，优化后的文档后缀即使在不提供额外指令和不触碰模型推理过程的情况下，也能有效引导模型遵循文档中的信息，特别是与模型原有知识相悖的部分。这意味着优化的目标设置比单纯依赖文档本身更能决定效果的范围和深度。

title: OpenSaC: A Python Library for Search as Code in Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep research agents investigate complex questions through iterative search, source examination, and evidence synthesis. A conventional workflow alternates reasoning with individual search and reading actions. Search as Code introduces a new paradigm: agents write programs that compose search, source reading, reranking, model calls, and local processing, returning selected observations for further reasoning. To support this workflow in existing coding agents, we present OpenSaC, an open-source Python library with a companion Search as Code skill. Configurable capability interfaces let agents combine these operations while retaining evidence for inspection and reuse. Compared with standard Codex using its built-in web search, the OpenSaC configuration uses less execution time and fewer model tokens on BrowseComp and WideSearch, with higher accuracy on BrowseComp and slightly lower row F1 on WideSearch. We aim to lower the barrier to adopting Search as Code and provide an open foundation for community development and transparent research on deep research agents.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为Search as Code的新范式，通过编写程序进行迭代的搜索、源代码分析和证据合成。OpenSaC是一个开源库，支持该范式，并在特定任务上显示了更好的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前的研究流程依赖于单独的搜索和阅读行为来交替进行推理，这使得收集详细证据变得困难。为了改进这一过程，研究引入了一种新的搜索模式，使代理可以编写高效的程序来完成搜索、阅读和模型调用等一系列任务，从而提高研究的效率和准确性。
AI.method: 研究人员基于现有编程代理的基础，开发了一个名为OpenSaC的新库，该库包含一个名为Search as Code的新技能。他们使用一个名为Codex的现成工具进行对比实验，展示了新方法在特定任务上的性能优势。
AI.result: 与常规使用内置网络搜索的Codex工具相比，使用OpenSaC配置在两个任务（BrowseComp和WideSearch）上都显示了更快的执行时间和更少的模型令牌使用量，且在Accuracy上表现更好，在WideSearch上的row F1略低。
AI.conclusion: 本研究旨在提高使用Search as Code范式的易用性，并为社区提供了一个开放平台，以促进透明研究和深研代理的发展。

title: Persistent Representational Misalignment Induces Vision-Language Model Failures
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) fail at some tasks that are simple for humans---but why? We hypothesize that many such failures stem from VLMs' difficulties translating between vision and language representations, a misalignment the Platonic Representation Hypothesis predicts should disappear with scale. This paper is composed of two parts: in the first, we show that existing vision and language representations are linearly unalignable. This misalignment is an inherent property of the data and hence expected to persist regardless of either scale or the alignment's complexity. In the second, we demonstrate how this misalignment both leads to a predictably induced generalization failure and correlates with existing failure modes, where more representationally aligned VLM backbones accordingly exhibit fewer failures. Overall, these results imply representations will not become aligned simply given sufficient scale, providing evidence against a strong version of the Platonic Representation Hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过两部分研究，揭示了现有视觉和语言表示之间存在线性不可对齐的固有问题，这将阻碍VLM随着规模增大而自动对齐。研究结果提供了反对柏拉图代表假设的强版本的证据。
AI.motivation: 该研究针对视觉语言模型在某些任务上表现不佳的问题，提出了一种新的观点来解释这些失败的原因，并评估了大规模模型对于克服这种不可对齐问题的潜力。
AI.method: 第一部分，研究团队通过量化现有视觉和语言表示之间的不可对齐性来展示其特性；第二部分，通过对比不同对齐程度的视觉语言模型的表现来验证不可对齐性与模型失败之间的关联。
AI.result: 研究证明，现有视觉和语言表示之间的不可对齐性是数据固有的，并且这种不一致性不随模型规模增加或对齐复杂度的变化而消失。同时，代表更对齐的视觉语言模型表现出较少的失败。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，大规模训练并不足以使视觉语言模型的表示自动对齐，因此强烈反对柏拉图代表假设的强版本。这表明在该领域需要探索新的方法来处理这些不可对齐问题。

title: Answering While You Type: Optimizing Time-to-Answer with Streaming Generation
summary: Work on efficient large-language-model inference has concentrated almost entirely on reducing the cost of decoding once a request is complete. The quantity a user experiences, however, is the interval between submitting a request and receiving a usable response, and that interval can be shortened without making decoding itself faster. While a request is being composed it is already partially specified, yet conventional deployments begin no computation until submission. We propose and study streaming generation, a decoding regime in which the model begins producing a response from an incomplete request and revises it as the remaining input arrives, so that only a small residue of the answer remains to be computed once the request is submitted. We evaluate the regime on autoregressive and diffusion language models, characterise the conditions under which it reduces user-visible latency, and analyse the mechanism responsible.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为流式生成的解码模式，该模式可以在请求未完全提交时就开始生成响应，并随着剩余输入的到来不断调整响应内容，从而减少用户的可见延迟。该研究在自回归和扩散语言模型上进行了评估，并分析了减少可见延迟的条件和机制。
AI.motivation: 传统的语言模型推理方式在用户提交请求后才会开始计算，而流式生成则允许模型在请求部分完成时就开始生成响应，从而减少用户等待时间。
AI.method: 研究通过在自回归和扩散语言模型上进行了流式生成的实现和测试，并分析了不同条件下该方法的效果。
AI.result: 结果显示，在某些情况下流式生成可以显著减少用户的可见延迟，特别是在模型需要处理大量输入的情况下。
AI.conclusion: 流式生成是一种有效的提高用户可见响应速度的方法，尤其是在请求输入较长的情况下。

title: Can LLM User-Proxies Stand In for Humans in Reliance Measurement? Replicating Rel-A.I. with Simulated Users
summary: Can language-model user proxies reproduce human reliance on an AI answer across contexts? Published simulated-user studies do not establish validity for this partial-answer decision, and Rel-A.I.'s released human record omits trial-level choices. We audit its 90 printed questions and 15 domain-by-marker reliance rates using sampled decisions and counterbalanced A/B probabilities from open models through 72B parameters. A matched crossover varies the printed agent specialty within each question, separating question content, label averages, and their interaction. Mistral Small's strong-marker math-minus-law label marginal is -0.4 percentage points, yet matching the agent label to the question domain raises reliance by 13.3 points on average across the five domains. The best A/B proxy has 22.5-point absolute-rate error and 8.3-point domain-effect error against the human table. A two-sample independent-binomial human replication has 3.5-point expected domain-effect error under the stated working model. The interaction is model dependent, and inference layout changes identical-prompt probabilities. This single-study audit does not establish proxy validity for human effect sizes or general directional screening.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过审计Rel-A.I.的90个打印问题及其详细依赖率，发现即便代理角色在每个问题中都适应特定内容，代理标签与问题领域的一致性仍然提高了13.3个百分点的依赖率。尽管如此，这套研究体系并未充分证明代理对人类影响大小的有效性或通用方向性筛选能力。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在评估语言模型的人类代理在不同情境下的决策模拟与人类行为的相似性，尤其是在AI答案部分依赖上的表现。
AI.method: 研究采用匹配交叉方法，对比了不同参数量的机器模型（包括72B参数）的表现，并通过样本决策和反平衡A/B概率来评估。
AI.result: 调研结果表明，尽管模型在特定情境下表现接近实际 humans 的决策，但整体上其未能充分达到验证人类影响大小或通用筛选方向的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 这项单一研究未能完全证明语言模型代理的可代理性，特别是在人类行为大小和方向性筛选方面的有效性。

title: Large-Scale Biomedical RAG: Corpus Scaling, Document Representation, and Efficiency Trade-offs
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, plus 11 pages of supplementary material. Preprint submitted to Elsevier. Code: https://github.com/hitz-zentroa/biomedical-rag-scaling and https://github.com/hitz-zentroa/qa-to-mcqa
summary: We present a controlled, large-scale evaluation of how corpus scale, document representation, and reranking affect the effectiveness and efficiency of biomedical Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Retrieval collections were progressively expanded while retaining the relevant source documents, enabling consistent comparisons across corpus sizes. We compared abstract, flat full-text, and hierarchical full-text representations across first-stage retrieval, reranking, and end-to-end multiple-choice question answering. Configurations selected on development data were evaluated on five external biomedical benchmarks and a held-out test set, while retrieval latency and index storage were measured to quantify operational cost. Performance patterns observed with small or controlled collections did not consistently persist as collections grew, and the usefulness of reranking depended on the corpus and retrieval setting. RAG improved three of four model configurations across the external benchmarks, with mean gains of up to 9.6 percentage points, and improved all four configurations on the held-out test set by 10.2-30.3 points. Abstract retrieval performed best when reference evidence was abstract-aligned, whereas full-text representations were generally more effective when richer evidence was needed. Hierarchical representation matched or outperformed flat full-text retrieval in most end-to-end comparisons while requiring 67% fewer indexed units and 44-56% less storage. These findings show that corpus scale should be treated as an explicit evaluation variable in biomedical RAG, and that the most appropriate design depends on evidence format, model behavior, and operational constraints.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过逐步扩展语料库规模并保持相关源文档，对RAG系统的有效性与效率进行了控制下的大规模评估。研究结果表明，RAG能够在四种模型配置中有助于提高生物医学问答结果，并且需要的存储空间更少。
AI.motivation: 评估语料库规模、文档表示方式以及重排序对生物医学RAG系统的有效性和效率的影响，寻求最合适的系统设计。
AI.method: 研究通过保持相关源文档的方式逐步扩展语料库规模，比较了摘要、扁平全文和层次化全文表示在第一次检索、重排序和端到端多选题回答中的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现不同大小的语料库表现模式随规模增长并不一致。重排序依赖于语料库和检索设置。RAG系统在四个模型配置中均有所改善，提高了外部基准测试的平均得分9.6个百分点，在保留测试集中则提高了10.2-30.3个百分点。在更需丰富证据的情况下，全文表示更有效；在需要引用对齐的摘要中，摘要检索表现最好。层次化表示在大多数端到端对比中表现或优于扁平全文检索，且所需索引单元少67%，存储减少44-56%。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现表明，语料库规模应该被视为生物医学RAG系统评估中的一个显式变量，并且最合适的系统设计取决于证据格式、模型行为和操作约束。

title: SAR: Learning Global Item-Space Matching and Geometry-Aware Placement Ranking for Buffered Online 3D Bin Packing
summary: Online 3D bin packing with a bounded buffer requires irreversible item-selection and placement decisions under limited knowledge of future arrivals. Feasibility alone is insufficient, as feasible actions can produce different residual-space structures and subsequent packing opportunities. A central architectural question is how to allocate spatial reasoning between item selection and placement evaluation. We propose Spatial Affordance Retrieval (SAR), a novel learning-based framework that coordinates global item-space matching with geometry-aware placement ranking. A voxel-token spatial encoder represents 3D container occupancy, enabling a picker to match buffered items to the residual space without requiring item-specific placement proposals as inputs. After item selection, a loader ranks feasible rotation-position candidates using candidate geometry, local geometric features (LGF), and inter-candidate comparison, without directly accessing global spatial tokens. The feasible candidate set connects the two stages, which are jointly optimized under a shared long-horizon packing return. On the Random, JD, and SF datasets, the best SAR variants improve utilization over the strongest evaluated online baselines by 0.96-4.20 percentage points under the no-buffer setting (K=1). With a buffer (K=5), the best utilization rates across SAR variants reach 93.55%, 91.04%, and 90.41%, respectively. Ablations support the complementary roles of global item-space matching and geometry-aware placement evaluation, counterfactual analysis suggests that learned item selection favors greater future packing potential, and experiments demonstrate compatibility with multiple candidate generators.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为Spatial Affordance Retrieval (SAR)的新颖学习框架，用于在线处理3D存储空间分配问题。SAR通过全局空间匹配和几何感知放置评估来协调，支持高效利用存储空间。在不同数据集上，SAR的性能优于现有在线基线，尤其是在有缓冲区的情况下表现尤为突出。
AI.motivation: 在线3D存储分配问题涉及到不可逆的决策，仅保证可行性是不足的。SAR旨在通过协调全球空间匹配与几何感知放置评估，提高利用效率。
AI.method: SAR使用体素标记的空间编码器来表示3D容器的占用情况，允许拣货者根据缓冲区中的物品直接匹配剩余空间，不需要每个物品的具体放置提案。之后，使用候选几何特征（LGF）、局部几何特征和候选间比较对可行的旋转-位置候选进行排名。两阶段通过共享长期包装回报共同优化。
AI.result: SAR在随机、JD和SF数据集上的表现优于最强的在线基线，无缓冲区（K=1）下利用率提升0.96-4.20个百分点。有缓冲区时，SAR在不同数据集上的最佳利用率分别达到93.55%、91.04%和90.41%。
AI.conclusion: 通过空间匹配和几何感知放置评估的协调，SAR能够有效提高在线3D存储空间的利用率。

title: GeoART: Geometry-Aware Refinement via Test-Time Scaling for Camera-Conditioned Video Diffusion
summary: Camera-conditioned video diffusion models often suffer from inaccurate camera control and geometric inconsisten- cies because camera constraints and estimated geometry are only weakly enforced during denoising. Existing reme- dies often require costly geometry-aware fine-tuning or ad- ditional 3D supervision. We introduce GeoART, a training- free self-refinement framework that improves camera con- trollability through geometry-aware test-time scaling. At selected denoising steps, GeoART generates multiple can- didates within the Predict-and-Perturb cycle and eval- uates them using a geometry prior, without directly modify- ing the denoising trajectory. A confidence gate suppresses unreliable geometric evidence, while rank-calibrated prob- abilistic selection combines score magnitude and relative rank to choose the next refinement state. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in camera controlla- bility, multi-view consistency, and visual quality over exist- ing sampling and self-refinement methods, without training or modifying the pretrained video diffusion model

AI.tldr: GeoART是一种无需训练的自我精炼框架，通过几何感知的测试时间缩放提高相机可控性。它在去噪步骤中生成多个候选并使用几何先验评估，同时加入置信门控和排名校准的概率选择策略来选择下一个精炼状态。
AI.motivation: 现有的去噪方法常常导致相机控制不准确和几何不一致的问题，而这些方法往往需要进行几何感知的微调或额外的3D监督，费用昂贵。为了改善这些问题，提出了GeoART框架。
AI.method: 在去噪过程中选择特定步骤生成多个候选方案，并使用几何先验进行评估，而不直接修改去噪轨迹。引入了置信门控来抑制不可靠的几何证据，并通过带排名校准的概率选择来结合评分大小和相对排名来选择下一个精炼状态。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，GeoART方法在相机可控性、多视图一致性和视觉质量方面优于现有的采样和自我精炼方法，同时无需对预训练的视频扩散模型进行训练或修改。
AI.conclusion: GeoART提供了一种有效的解决方案，用于提高基于相机条件的视频扩散模型的相机可控性和几何一致性，无需额外的训练或修改模型。

title: Bridged Self-Distillation for On-Policy Learning
summary: On-policy distillation can transfer the reasoning capabilities of a strong teacher to a smaller student. However, distillation from a stronger teacher model faces two mismatches: its solutions may be difficult for a smaller student to imitate, and its token-level probabilities may be incompatible with, or even unavailable to, the student. Existing methods handle these settings through different forms of supervision. To this end, we propose Bridged Self-Distillation (BSD), a unified framework for distilling from any teacher that provides reasoning traces. The model to be distilled from, termed the external teacher, first provides a reasoning trace as privileged context, which can be generated in an offline fashion. The student generates rollouts without this context, while a copy of the student conditioned on it, serving as the self-teacher, scores the same rollouts in the student's own token space. BSD uses the resulting token-level guidance to adjust updates on unsuccessful rollouts, with a verifier providing the outcome signal. As the external teacher is queried only to produce text, the same training procedure applies to all teacher scenarios: shared-tokenizer, cross-tokenizer, and closed API teachers. Across these scenarios, BSD improves over the base model and outperforms baselines tailored to each scenario, offering a novel and unified pathway for distillation. Code is available: https://github.com/TUMLegalTech/Bridged-Self-Distillation

AI.tldr: Bridged Self-Distillation (BSD) 是一种统一框架，可以从具有推理痕迹的任何教师模型中学到推理能力，改善了与小型学生之间的匹配问题，并能应用于不同的教师场景。
AI.motivation: 解决强教师模型和小型学生之间的匹配问题，改善推理能力转移。BSD 可以从多种类型的教师模型中学习，包括共享分词器、交叉分词器和封闭 API 教师。
AI.method: BSD 借助外部教师提供推理痕迹，使用自我教师评估学生的策略，并使用结果对学生的不成功策略进行调整，同时使用验证器提供结果信号，确保学生能够优化自身的策略。
AI.result: BSD 在不同的教师场景中均优于基础模型和针对特定场景优化的基准，提供了一种新颖且统一的转移学习路径。
AI.conclusion: BSD 提出了一种从具有推理痕迹的教师模型中统一学习推理能力的方法，能够适应不同类型的教学环境，并展现出在改进学生推理能力方面的潜力。

title: When to Stop Asking: Factor Coverage Bias and LLM Determinability Judgments with Underspecified Information in Medicine
summary: Clinical decision-making often begins with underspecified information and requires not only gathering missing information but also knowing when to stop. This calls for judging determinability (whether the available information is sufficient for a decision) by considering whether missing information could change the conclusion, not simply the amount of available decision-relevant information. Reliance on this amount as a cue for determinability, which we term \textit{factor coverage bias}, could undermine the trustworthiness of large language models (LLMs) through premature conclusions or excessive information gathering, such as unnecessary invasive tests. Yet whether LLMs exhibit this bias remains insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we construct a controlled pairwise benchmark in which LLMs identify the determinable case within each determinable--undeterminable pair. We add a decision-relevant factor to either side while keeping each case's determinability unchanged, and similarly add irrelevant text to distinguish this bias from context-length effects. Adding a relevant factor made LLMs more likely to select the augmented case as determinable even when it remained undeterminable, an effect that persisted with increased reasoning effort, while adding irrelevant text made them less likely to select the augmented case, an effect that reasoning substantially reduced. These findings identify factor coverage bias as a failure mode distinct from context-length effects and a potential risk to LLM trustworthiness. Our work provides an evaluation framework for LLM trustworthiness under underspecification.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，大型语言模型在决策时存在一种被称为‘因素覆盖偏差’的倾向，即过于依赖已有的相关信息做出决策，而忽视需要进一步收集的信息，这可能削弱模型的可信度。研究通过构建一个控制实验来考察这一偏差，发现模型面对相关因素时更容易判定为可确定的信息，但面对无关因素时则更谨慎。
AI.motivation: 为了解决大型语言模型可能因依赖已有的相关信息而提早得出结论或过度收集信息的问题，研究者构建了一个受控基准测试，以评估模型在信息不充分的情况下是否会出现这种偏差。
AI.method: 研究者设计了一个双模式基准测试，通过增加相关或无关信息来考察模型的决策倾向。在每个可确定与不确定的配对案例中，增加一个与决策相关或无关的因素。
