AI.result: 研究结果显示，当增加相关因素时，模型更倾向于判断为可确定的情况，即使情况仍处于不确定状态。然而，当增加无关因素时，模型更倾向于保持谨慎态度。此外，随着推理努力的增加，模型受到相关因素影响的程度更大。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现大型语言模型存在“因素覆盖偏差”，这是评估模型在信息不足情况下的可信度的一种新型失败模式，这提示我们需要更好的方法来确保模型在面对不确定信息时生成可信的结论。

title: Holo4D: Holistic 4D Reconstruction as Geometric Control for Video Diffusion
summary: Synthesizing a monocular video from a new camera trajectory requires preserving the observed scene geometry and motion while completing regions that become newly visible. Feed-forward 4D reconstructors recover the structure of the observed scene, whereas video diffusion models provide a generative prior for completing unseen content. We introduce Holo4D, a video reshooting framework that uses reconstructed 3D trajectories as a holistic source-view 4D scaffold. We project these trajectories into the requested views and encode their geometry and source appearance to guide a pretrained video diffusion model. Together with the source video and target cameras, the scaffold grounds generation in reconstructed observations while leaving unsupported regions to the generative prior. Experiments demonstrate the value of trajectory-based conditioning for camera control and novel-view synthesis. The framework accommodates different 4D reconstructors without retraining the video generator, allowing it to benefit from future advances in source reconstruction. More details can be found in our project page.

AI.tldr: Holo4D 是一种视频重新拍摄框架，使用重建的 3D 轨迹作为整体 4D 支架，将几何形状和源视图外观编码以引导预训练的视频扩散模型，实现从新相机轨迹生成单目视频。
AI.motivation: 实现从新相机轨迹生成单目视频，需要保留观察到的场景几何结构和运动，同时填补新出现的区域。传统的前馈 4D 重建器可以恢复观察到的场景结构，而视频扩散模型则可以提供完成未见内容的生成先验。Holo4D 旨在结合这两种方法，提高生成质量和新视角合成效果。
AI.method: Holo4D 通过构建一个基于重建的 3D 轨迹的 4D 支架，将其投影到所需视图中，编码几何结构和源视图外观，并利用此信息引导预训练的视频扩散模型进行生成。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于轨迹的条件对于相机控制和新视角合成有很高的价值。该框架允许视频生成器从不同类型的 4D 重建器中受益，而无需重新训练。这使其能够适应未来 4D 重建技术的进步。
AI.conclusion: Holo4D 提供了一个有效的方法，通过整合重建的 3D 轨迹和视频扩散模型，实现了从新路径生成单目视频，大大提升了生成质量和新视角合成效果。

title: How Benchmark Graph Construction Shapes Multi-Hop KG Navigation: A Controlled Audit of PathQuestion and PathQuestion-Large
comment: 17 pages. PQ/PQL reconstruction code available at https://github.com/HalcyonSolutions/PathQuestion-Family
summary: Multi-hop knowledge-graph question answering (KGQA) benchmarks are often treated as fixed language-and-reasoning tasks, but for navigation-based methods, difficulty also depends on the graph in which those tasks are instantiated. This makes graph construction a consequential but often entangled part of the navigation task. To isolate this effect, we audit PathQuestion (PQ) and PathQuestion-Large (PQL) as graph-navigation benchmarks under a controlled intervention: we hold questions, topic entities, released answers, released path annotations, and family-level splits fixed while replacing each released task-filtered graph with the larger source KG distributed with the benchmark. Source restoration expands the effective navigation search space and graph-consistent answer and path multiplicity while sharply reducing unguided reachability to released answers. We evaluate whether these structural changes persist across navigation policies using structural references, frozen small-language-model navigation policies, and trained MINERVA policies. Across both frozen and trained policies, restoration substantially reduces released-answer accuracy and trajectory fidelity, while graph-consistent evaluation recovers only part of the loss. These results show that benchmark graph construction is part of the navigation task specification rather than merely an implementation detail and can materially shape measured behavior even when the released QA task is held fixed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制实验环境来评估图构建对于路径知识图谱问答导航任务的影响，结果显示图构建是任务规范的一部分，不能被忽视。
AI.motivation: 现有的多跳知识图谱问答基准往往被视为固定的语言和推理任务，但导航方法的难度还取决于任务所在的图。通过固定其他因素，用更大的源KG替换基准中的图，研究了图构建对任务的影响。
AI.method: 作者固定问题，主题实体，已发布的答案和路径注释以及家庭级别划分，替换基准中发布的任务过滤图。然后评估结构变化如何在冻结和训练过的导航策略中表现。
AI.result: 恢复源图显著减少了发布的答案准确性及路径的准确性，但图一致性评估只能部分恢复损失。这表明，基准图构建是导航任务规范的一部分，即使发布的QA任务保持不变，也会影响测量的行为。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了在评估多跳知识图谱问答导航任务时，图构建的重要性不仅限于实施细节，而是任务设计的关键因素。

title: When Retrieval Partially Conflicts with Skills: Understanding Procedural Hallucination in Language Models
summary: Language models increasingly use skills that provide reusable instructions and procedures for task execution. After a relevant skill has been selected, the model may need to apply its governing procedure together with retrieved task context. When the retrieved context is useful but contains cues that violate the skill, the model must retain compatible information while rejecting the conflicting cues. We study failures in which the model adopts such cues and produces a retrieval-supported but skill-invalid answer, which we call procedural hallucination. We introduce SourceClash, a matched benchmark with 1,271 bundles and 6,355 prompts across ten procedural domains. Each bundle fixes the task, skill specification, and answer space while varying the relation between the skill and retrieval. Across nine models, valid-answer rates average 25.7% under conflicting retrieval, compared with 78.2% and 72.8% under two supportive retrieval settings. Mechanistic analysis of open-weight models shows that the answer-preference difference typically reaches its maximum shortly after generation begins. Residual replacement moves the model toward valid answers, while attention decomposition attributes most of the repair to value vectors. Intervention at the identified value pathway also improves final answer validity. These results characterize how partly conflicting retrieval changes skill-guided generation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了语言模型在使用技能执行任务时，面对与技能相冲突的检索信息时产生错误答案的现象，并提出了一种新的基准测试SourceClash，展示了模型在不同检索条件下的表现差异。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型越来越依赖可重用的任务执行指令和程序，当检索到的信息部分冲突时，模型需要决定保留哪些信息，哪些需要被忽略。这一研究旨在揭示模型在处理这类冲突时可能产生的问题，并提出可能的改进方法。
AI.method: 研究者通过构建一个名为SourceClash的新基准测试，包含来自十个领域共1,271个任务和6,355个提示，分析了九种不同的语言模型在不同检索条件下的表现差异。并通过机制分析，识别出了模型在生成过程中依赖的价值路径，以及如何通过干预改进模型的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现，在存在冲突检索的情况下，模型的有效答案率仅为25.7%，而当检索支持不冲突或部分支持时，有效答案率分别提升到了78.2%和72.8%。模型生成的答案偏好差异通常会在生成开始后达到最大值，通过替换残差可以引导模型生成更有效的答案，而注意力分解显示最主要是价值向量在修复答案中发挥了作用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了语言模型在面对技能与检索信息冲突时的局限性，并提出通过干预价值向量等方式可以改善其生成的有效性。这些发现有助于未来改进语言模型在任务执行中的表现。

title: Learning Lane-Structured Conditioning Fields for Online HD Mapping
summary: High-definition maps provide critical structural information for downstream autonomous driving tasks. Recent methods increasingly rely on external priors to improve prediction accuracy and robustness. Yet, existing prior representations expose a trade-off: dense rasters are easy to integrate but ignore certain map geometric properties, while sparse vectors preserve geometric structure but require dedicated encoders and are difficult to plug into existing architectures. Moreover, external priors can be inaccurate, costly to acquire, or difficult to maintain, motivating a structural representation that can provide geometric guidance while remaining learnable and broadly applicable. We address this limitation with the Lane Field, a dense BEV-aligned geometric representation that encodes local lane structure at each spatial location and can be either predicted from onboard observations or constructed from external map priors. Building on this representation, we introduce a plug-and-play framework that enhances online HD mapping through two complementary mechanisms: BEV feature modulation, which injects lane-structured cues into latent BEV features, and deformable attention guidance, which steers query sampling toward the underlying lane geometry. We primarily evaluate our method on OpenLane-V2, showing that conditioning BEV features and guiding deformable attention with local lane geometry enables our framework to consistently improve existing methods and achieve state-of-the-art performance on lane segment perception. Project page: https://andberto.github.io/LaneField/

AI.tldr: Lane Field 提供了一种既能够提供几何线索又能够保持学习性的密集 BEV 对齐几何表示，该表示可以从车载观测或外部地图先验中预测或构建。利用该表示，作者提出了一种插件式框架，通过 BEV 特征调制和变形注意引导来增强在线高精度地图构建。
AI.motivation: 当前方法越来越多地依赖外部先验来提高预测准确性和鲁棒性，但现有先验表示存在权衡：密集栅格易于整合但忽略某些地图几何属性，而稀疏向量保留几何结构但需要专用编码器且难以集成到现有架构中。此外，外部先验可能不准确，昂贵且难以维护，因此需要一种既能提供几何指导又能保持可学习性和广泛应用性的结构表示。
AI.method: Lane Field 是一种在每个空间位置编码局部车道结构的密集 BEV 对齐几何表示。作者提出了一种插件式框架，通过 BEV 特征调制注入车道结构线索，并通过变形注意引导引导查询采样以 underlying 车道几何。
AI.result: 作者的研究方法在 OpenLane-V2 上得到验证，表明用局部车道几何条件和引导变形注意可以持续改进现有方法，达到车道段感知的最新性能。
AI.conclusion: Lane Field 框架和其插件特性为在线高精度地图构建提供了一种新型范式，同时它展示了通过编码局部车道结构线索来改善车道识别和地图构建的可能性。

title: Expert L2 English Speech Evaluation on a Gaming PC: Accuracy, Fluency, and Prosody with XLS-R, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus
comment: 19 pages, including appendices. Code and trained weights: https://github.com/cburst/oollim
summary: oollim is a locally executable system for evaluating L2 English pronunciation accuracy, fluency, and prosody on a consumer computer. The system combines pretrained XLS-R, XEUS, and PhoneticXeus representations with reference-text features and ridge regressions trained on SpeechOcean762, the Korean Learners' L2 Speech Corpus (English), J-AESOP, and their combinations. On 305 independently held-out recordings assessed by three expert raters, several ridge configurations substantially outperform archived Azure API scores obtained in January 2026 in both Spearman correlation and quadratic weighted kappa across all three constructs. These results support expert speech evaluation on consumer hardware using pretrained representations and construct-specific regressions, without neural-model fine-tuning or calibration on the private evaluation data.

AI.tldr: oollim 是一个可在消费者计算机上本地执行的系统，用于评估二语英语发音准确性、流利度和语调，通过结合预训练的 XLS-R、XEUS 和 PhoneticXeus 表示、参考文本特征和针对 SpeechOcean762 等数据集训练的岭回归模型，实现了比2026年1月存档的Azure API分数更佳的性能。
AI.motivation: 随着在线英语学习和教学需求的增长，评估二语英语发音质量的需求增加，但由于专业评估成本和技术挑战，传统的评估方法难以普及。因此，为了提供更广泛和经济高效的评估工具，开发了一个可以在消费级硬件上执行的系统。
AI.method: 系统结合了预训练的 XLS-R、XEUS 和 PhoneticXeus 表示、参考文本特征，并使用针对多个数据集训练的岭回归模型。
AI.result: 在305个由三位专家评估的独立录音中，多种岭回归配置在皮尔逊相关系数和二次加权卡帕系数上均优于2026年1月存档的Azure API分数，显示出在消费者硬件上进行专家级语音评估的可能性。
AI.conclusion: 无需对神经模型进行微调或在私有评估数据上进行校准，该系统便能在消费级硬件上实现专家级别的语音评估。

title: FrontierRefactor: Benchmarking Multi-Scale Performance-Oriented Codebase Refactoring
summary: Autonomous codebase refactoring requires coding agents to restructure working software while strictly preserving externally observable behavior and prioritizing execution performance and compute efficiency over stylistic preference. Existing benchmarks: refactoring benchmarks assess functional correctness while overlooking runtime regressions, whereas code performance benchmarks target isolated micro-kernels that ignore codebase-scale complexity. We observe that refactoring scale is governed by the scope of the observable contract, the caller-visible interface fixing behavioral invariants while freeing private implementations for optimization. Building on this insight, we introduce FrontierRefactor, a benchmark of 60 qualified engineering tasks spanning four scales, from computational kernels to full repositories, across in-place optimization and cross-language rewriting. Evaluating frontier coding agents through a reference-free cascaded protocol across 1,080 execution runs reveals that correctness and speedup are largely decoupled: 41.2% of submissions satisfy functional equivalence yet fail to deliver verified performance improvements, with 19.3% suffering performance regressions and 21.9% trapped in measurement noise. Refactoring paradigms reveal orthogonal engineering bottlenecks: while cross-language rewrites gain speedups from native compilation after passing functional checks, agents struggle with contract fidelity, with pass rates dropping from 65.0% on modules to 32.6% at package scale; conversely, in-place optimization reliably preserves behavioral contracts at 86.5% but rarely achieves acceleration without physical performance profiling. Trajectory analysis shows that agents fall victim to uncalibrated micro-benchmarking illusions, an operational blind spot that multi-turn execution-timing feedback directly resolves, raising strict success from 16.0% to 40.0%.

AI.tldr: 研究提出了FrontierRefactor基准，包含跨规模的60个工程任务，评估自动化重构代码的功能完整性和性能加速效果，结果显示功能性保证和性能加速间存在解耦现象，不同规模任务的重构策略存在差异。
AI.motivation: 现有的重构基准和代码性能基准存在不足，研究旨在评估自动化重构代码在解决实际工程问题中的性能，以及识别不同规模重构任务中的工程瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出了一个包含60个重构任务的新基准FrontierRefactor，涵盖了从计算内核到整个仓库的不同规模，并使用一个无参考的级联评估协议进行评估。
AI.result: 评估结果表明功能性验证和性能加速之间存在一定解耦，具体来说，41.2%的提交在函数等价性上满足要求但未能实现性能验证改进，19.3%的提交经历了性能倒退，21.9%的提交则被测量噪音困在了内。对于跨语言重构，功能性检查通过后可以从本地编译中获得加速，但对于合同的一致性，通过率从模块级别上的65.0%降至包级别上的32.6%。相反，就地优化方案保持了行为合同的可靠性（86.5%），但通常需要物理性能分析才能加速。
AI.conclusion: 自动化重构在性能基准上的表现表明存在两种不同的工程瓶颈：跨语言重构可以从本地编译中获益，但合同一致性显得尤为重要；而就地优化则需要物理性能分析的支持以实现加速。研究表明，多轮执行时间反馈可以直接解决操作盲点，能显著提高成功比率。

title: The Explainability Illusion: Must ViTs Exhibit Patch-Decoding Interpretability?
summary: Transformers are widely assumed to exhibit token-decoding explainability. In particular, in vision transformer (ViT) classifiers, decoding individual patch tokens has become a common diagnostic tool due to its tendency to yield human-interpretable outputs. In light of the increasing popularity of this approach, an important question is whether token-decoding explainability is an inherent property of transformers that should be expected to hold across architectures, scales, and training objectives, or merely an artifact of some implicit bias. In this paper we systematically study token-decoding explainability across diverse ViT settings, spanning architectures, scales, and training objectives, using both controlled experiments and real-world models. We find that while some models indeed exhibit aligned and interpretable token decodings, others exhibit either inverted explainability maps or a complete lack of correlation with the image semantics. As we show, these tendencies toward different explainability behaviors are not intrinsic to the architecture and can vary arbitrarily with changes in the optimization landscape. We provide theoretical support for these observations by demonstrating a setting where a single fixed toy transformer architecture can provably implement the optimal classification rule in multiple ways, which differ in their patch-decoding explainability patterns. Our results show that token-decoding explainability is not an inherent property of trained transformers, but rather an outcome contingent on the problem setting and thus should not be a-priori assumed to hold. Code can be found in https://ronensc.github.io/Explainability-Illusion/ .

AI.tldr: 本研究考察了Transformer中的token-decoding可解释性，并通过不同架构、规模和训练目标实验发现，这种可解释性不是固定的，而是依问题设置变化的。
AI.motivation: 该研究为了回答token-decoding可解释性是Transformer固有的特性还是训练条件的结果，通过系统研究Vision Transformers在不同设置下的行为来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 本研究使用了控制实验和实际模型，考察了Transformers在不同架构、规模和训练目标下的token-decoding可解释性。
AI.result: 研究发现，一些模型确实具有一致、可解释的token解码，但也发现了反向解释性模式或与图像语义完全无关的现象。这些可解释性行为趋势并非由架构决定，而是优化场景的变化导致。
AI.conclusion: 本研究表明，token-decoding可解释性不是Transformer的固有特性，而是依问题设置的变化而变化的结果，因此不应事前假设其存在性。

title: Co-Evolving Policy and Reward for Code Generation: A Mechanistic Study of Single-Adapter Drift
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is particularly well suited to code generation because generated programs can be objectively evaluated through execution. Execution also provides behavioral information that can be reused as additional supervision. The Synergistic Policy and Reward Co-Evolving Framework (SPARK), originally proposed for reasoning tasks, exploits this idea by recycling training rollouts and their evaluation results to train a model not only to generate solutions but also to evaluate and improve them. We investigate whether this policy-reward co-evolution approach transfers effectively to code generation and whether execution-grounded reflection provides an additional source of self-improvement. We compare SPARK-style rollout recycling with execution-only Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct. Our results do not support either hypothesis under the configuration tested. Although co-evolution improves training performance, these gains do not generalize to held-out problems. Compared at the same stage of training, rollout recycling produces roughly 34x greater KL divergence from the reference policy than execution-only GRPO. Over training, trained tokens per GRPO sequence fall from 185 to 86 as training pass rate increases, while held-out performance declines or fails to sustain early gains. We characterize these patterns as single-adapter policy drift: the shared trainable parameters increasingly depart from pretrained code-generation behavior without corresponding gains in generalization. The results show that higher training reward alone is not evidence of generalizable code self-improvement and highlight the importance of held-out evaluation and drift diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了SPARK框架在代码生成任务中的应用效果，发现政策和奖励的协同进化方法在验证配置中未能有效转移，执行导向的反思也不能作为额外的自我改进来源。训练期间，回收的模拟轨迹产生的KL散度显著高于仅执行的GRPO策略，且模型性能早期提升未能保持。
AI.motivation: 研究者试图确认SPARK框架是否适用于代码生成任务，并探讨执行反馈对模型自我改进的影响。
AI.method: 研究者使用Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct模型，对比了SPARK风格的回收模拟轨迹策略与仅基于执行的Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)方法。
AI.result: 经过训练后的模型通过回收模拟轨迹策略与仅执行策略相比，模型性能没有显著提升，甚至在一些阶段反而下降。训练期间，模型的参数逐渐偏离了预训练行为，但泛化性能没有提高。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，仅依赖训练奖励提高并不能证明代码自我改进的可泛化性，强调了保留出的评估和漂移诊断的重要性。

title: Not Every Rollout Needs Distillation: Correctness-Filtered On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) supervises student-generated trajectories with a reference-conditioned version of the same base model. We ask whether every trajectory supplies distinct supervision that warrants its distillation cost. Gradient measurements on Qwen3-1.7B at initialization reveal that correct and incorrect responses have similar individual gradient magnitudes, but incorrect responses have approximately three times the coherent gradient share. Their estimated population-mean directions also largely overlap. A signal--noise model fitted at a small group size tracks alignment at larger group sizes without refitting. Motivated by these measurements, we introduce correctness-filtered OPSD (C-OPSD), which generates one response per problem and distills only a subset of incorrect responses. Removing unselected rows before both distillation forwards avoids their teacher/student forward and student backward work. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25, C-OPSD achieves on-par performance with full OPSD. In a measured micro-batch-size-four implementation, executed rows decrease by approximately 68%, and with retained rows packed into full micro-batches, training takes about 40% less time while rollout generation remains unchanged. Together, the measurements and training results connect outcome-conditioned supervision redundancy to more compute-efficient distillation.

AI.tldr: C-OPSD通过仅对部分错误响应进行蒸馏，减少了计算量，同时保持了与全OPSD相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 全OPSD方法对学生生成的每一个轨迹都进行蒸馏，但测量结果显示正确和错误的响应在梯度分布上有明显的冗余。因此，提出了C-OPSD方法，仅对部分错误响应进行蒸馏，以减少计算量，同时保持性能。
AI.method: C-OPSD通过过滤正确响应，只对错误响应进行蒸馏。在前向传递和反向传递过程中，不使用未选择的行，减少不必要的计算负载。在实测优化后，C-OPSD在不同模型和数据集上的表现与全OPSD相当。
AI.result: 在不同的模型和数据集上，C-OPSD的性能与全OPSD相当。使用优化后的微批处理大小为4的小型实施，未选择的行减少了约68%，使用保留的行填充完整的微批处理后，训练时间减少了约40%，而回放生成保持不变。
AI.conclusion: C-OPSD方法通过过滤正确响应仅对错误响应进行蒸馏，减少了计算需求，提高了计算效率，且仍然保持与全OPSD相当的性能。

title: MotionShift: Environment-Compatible Motion Transfer via Planner-Evaluator Synergistic Adaptation
summary: Existing motion transfer methods excel at exact, rigid motion replication from reference videos to target scenes, whereas they often fail to account for the compatibility between the transferred motion and the target scene environment in accordance with physical laws. In this work, we propose MotionShift, a novel motion transfer framework that achieves high-fidelity motion transfer while ensuring physical compatibility with the target scene. In particular, we design a planner--evaluator iterative motion adaptation mechanism, in which a Large Language Model (LLM) acts as the planner to generate motion trajectories by leveraging its strong semantic reasoning capabilities, while a Vision-Language Model (VLM) serves as the evaluator to rectify the motion based on its superior visual perception and scene understanding. Through this planner--evaluator synergistic reasoning process, the motion is adapted to the target scene in a training-free manner. The adapted motion is then used as a generative condition for an image-to-video (I2V) model to render videos in the target scene. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MotionShift achieves high-fidelity and physically compatible motion transfer across diverse and complex scenes. Moreover, we show that MotionShift can be readily integrated into existing trajectory-conditioned I2V models, endowing them with realistic motion transfer capabilities.

AI.tldr: MotionShift 是一种新的运动转移框架，它通过规划者-评估者迭代机制确保运动与目标场景物理兼容的同时实现高保真运动转移。
AI.motivation: 现有的运动转移方法擅长精确地从参考视频中复制刚性运动到目标场景，但往往忽视了所转移的运动与目标场景环境之间的物理兼容性。因此，MotionShift 研究提出了一种新型框架，旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: MotionShift 设计了规划者-评估者迭代运动适应机制，其中大语言模型 (LLM) 作为规划者利用其强大的语义推理能力生成运动轨迹，视景语言模型 (VLM) 作为评估者基于其优秀的视觉感知和场景理解能力纠正运动。通过规划者-评估者的协同推理过程，运动以无需训练的方式适应目标场景。之后，适应后的运动作为生成条件传递给图像到视频 (I2V) 模型以在目标场景中渲染视频。
AI.result: 大量的实验表明，MotionShift 能够在多种复杂场景下实现高保真且物理兼容的运动转移。
AI.conclusion: 此外，研究证明 MotionShift 可以很容易地集成到现有的轨迹条件 I2V 模型中，为现有的 I2V 模型增添了现实运动转移的能力。

title: Self-Consistency of Entity Sets and Citations in a Deep Research System under Repeated Prompting
summary: Deep research agents (DRA) are commonly used for open-ended synthesis tasks where closed-world QA benchmarks are poorly suited to characterize relevant aspects of performance. We study the self-consistency of one commercial deep research system under repeated identical prompting, representing each report with the set of named entities it mentions, categorised by a custom schema, and the set of citations it retrieves. Across repeated runs of a single open-ended cybersecurity related prompt, we quantify pairwise overlap to characterize how stable the retrieved and synthesized output structure is under repeated identical prompts. In ten runs, the pairwise entity Jaccard results in a median of 0.12 and the pairwise citation Jaccard is below 0.02, with discovery curves that do not visibly saturate. The magnitude and structure of (dis)agreement between entity sets varies by entity class, which suggests that self-consistency in a DRA is better understood as a function of the underlying entity space than as a stable property of the system.

AI.tldr: 研究了一个商业深度研究系统的自我一致性，通过重复相同提示下的命名实体和引用集合作比较，发现一致性较低且结构不稳定。
AI.motivation: 探讨DRA在开放任务中的自我一致性问题，特别是在网络安全领域，因为传统的QA基准可能不适用于此类任务。
AI.method: 使用自定义的实体分类和引用集合作报告，通过重复运行同一开放性网络安全提示来量化实体和引用集的重叠。
AI.result: 在十次运行中，实体Jaccard相似度的中位数为0.12，引用Jaccard相似度低于0.02，且发现曲线没有明显饱和。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，DRA的（不）一致性是由底层实体空间决定的，而不是系统本身的一个稳定属性。

title: A Cue's Hidden Price: Auditing Seller Influence on AI Shoppers
summary: Large language models are increasingly asked to shop on a user's behalf, which lets seller-controlled content such as badges, endorsements, and framing steer what they recommend. That poses the question at the core of generative engine optimization (GEO): not whether seller content shifts an agent's choice, but how much. The usual gauge of that influence, how often a cue wins the choice, has a blind spot: once a cue is strong enough to be picked almost every time, the choice rate can no longer show how much stronger one cue is than another. We introduce price-equivalent (PE) auditing, which removes this ceiling by pricing the cue in money. In a counterbalanced, position-controlled forced choice, we raise the cued product's price until it is chosen only half the time, and report that premium as the cue's price-equivalent: a formally defined, policy-conditioned parity threshold that makes very different cues comparable. Priced this way, cues that look equally strong at equal price differ by a wide margin, so choice-rate audits substantially under-resolve seller influence. We run the audit over 113,472 trials, seven models across families, and two product categories. To our knowledge, we also run the first price-equivalent audit of a decision-native model, Jev, which outputs a choice probability directly instead of generating text; strikingly, its profile is unlike any text model we tested, resisting most cues yet remaining susceptible to the strongest social-proof claims. We release the stimuli, logs, and code as a benchmark that reports each model's cue-price profile rather than a single score, giving developers and auditors a common, reproducible way to measure how content moves AI shopping agents.

AI.tldr: 该研究引入了价格等效（PE）审计，通过定价线索来消除选择率审计中的天花板效应，以便更准确地评估卖家内容对AI购物代理决策的影响。研究在多种模型和类别上进行了测试，发现不同类型的模型对于线索的反应存在显著差异，特别是在一个名为Jev的决策原生模型上观察到了特别的特点。
AI.motivation: 文章的动机在于解决生成式引擎优化（GEO）中的核心问题：卖家内容如何影响AI购物代理的决策。传统的选择率审计存在天花板效应，不足以准确比较不同强度的线索效果。
AI.method: 研究采用了一种新颖的方法，即价格等效审计，通过在保证选择率约50%的情况下定价线索，从而消除天花板效应。研究设置了对冲设计、位置控制的强制选择实验，并且在多个模型和类别上进行了广泛的测试。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，不同类型的AI模型对于线索的响应显著不同，特别是Jev模型（一个输出选择概率的决策原生模型）显示出特别的特点，表现为对大多数线索的抵抗，但仍然对最强的社会性证明主张敏感。实验在113,472次试运行中进行了测试，涉及七种模型和两个产品类别。
AI.conclusion: 研究推动了公平性评估的方法论，强调了使用价格等效审计来衡量和比较各种模型对卖家内容的响应，以及为了开发者和审计者提供了一个可复现的标准和基准，以便更好地理解内容如何影响AI购物代理的选择。

title: SENRI: Understanding the Space-Event Nexus in Real-Life Videos
summary: Human memories are organized in a way that connects events with their corresponding spatial contexts. An AI assistant should also be able to memorize and recall the nexus of events and spaces. Thus we introduce SENRI, a task that studies this space--event connection in long, continuous real-life egocentric video. It contains six task types in two directions: Event$\rightarrow$Space, which recovers spatial knowledge from event cues, and Space$\rightarrow$Event, which retrieves events from regions and trajectories. To evaluate this, we build SENRI-Bench, containing 500 manually annotated multiple-choice questions over 10 uninterrupted self-recorded videos with around 25.3 hours of content. Also, we evaluate three typical long video understanding paradigms: direct perception, evidence seeking, and persistent memory. The task remains challenging across all three paradigms, highlighting substantial room for improvement. Then we show two representative failure modes of existing memory methods and address these evidence gaps with SENRI-Agent, a controller that uses Target-Guided Visual Check (TGVC) to propose local visual check tasks for parallel verifiers and integrate the reports into a working memory to help with reasoning. Built upon existing memory systems, SENRI-Agent improves the performance of existing baselines without modifying their stored memories. We hope SENRI will provide valuable insights into how real-life egocentric understanding should be evaluated, reveal the gaps in existing approaches, and offer a possible direction for improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为SENRI的任务，用于研究事件与空间之间的联系。该任务通过视听材料进行，并提出了两种方向的任务。为评估表现，作者构建了SENRI-Bench，包括对多个连续记录视频进行标注的问题集。同时，作者提出了一个使用目标引导视觉检查（TGVC）的代理模型（SENRI-Agent），并发现了现有的记忆方法中的一些缺陷。
AI.motivation: 人类的记忆将事件与其对应的地理位置关联起来，人工智能助手应具备类似的能力。因此，本文通过研究真实生活中自我拍摄的连续视频来建立一个名为SENRI的任务，以提高AI的理解能力，并为现有方法的改进提供可能的方向。
AI.method: 研究人员提出了多类型任务，分为Event$ightarrow$Space和Space$ightarrow$Event两个方向。通过 MANUAL ANNOTATION 建立了SENRI-Bench，并使用三个典型的长期视频理解范式进行评估。同时，他们提出了SENRI-Agent模型，通过采用目标引导的视觉检查（TGVC）和多验证器来改进现有基线的表现。
AI.result: 建立的SENRI-Bench适用于多个连续记录的视频，涵盖了大约25.3小时的内容。三个典型的长期视频理解和评价范式在SENRI中均表现出挑战性。SENRI-Agent在改进现有基线的性能方面发挥了作用，同时仍保留了现有记忆系统的原始数据。
AI.conclusion: 本文研究了一个新的任务SENRI，旨在通过连续的自我录制视频来评估事件和空间之间的联系。研究人员提出了一个名为SENRI-Bench的基准测试，以更好地理解真实的自我中心学习，并展示了一个称为SENRI-Agent的代理模型来改善现有方法。

title: Governing the Rule Space. Ruliology, Computational Irreducibility and Anticipatory Governance of Quantum Technologies
comment: English translation of an article originally published in Italian in Rivista della Corte dei conti, no. 4 (2026), pp. 27 - 41. Published with the journal's permission
summary: The regulation of emerging technologies is often conceived as a strategy of catching up, because legislators arrive too late. Yet gathering signals, constructing scenarios and adapting rules to an anticipated future are fundamental tasks for those entrusted with governance, including the governance of rules themselves. The literature on so-called future law has already shown that anticipation means building institutional capabilities rather than predicting outcomes precisely (anticipatory governance). Taking this premise as its starting point, this article proposes to understand regulation as an exploration of the transformations that may occur. The Ruliological Framework for Anticipatory Regulation distinguishes rules, transformations and trajectories, assessing alternatives and possible developments. Within this approach, computational irreducibility is adopted conditionally, not as a demonstrated property of legal systems. The Quantum Europe Strategy provides a case study and further grounds for reflection.

AI.tldr: 文章提出了一个前瞻治理框架，用于评估规则、变化和轨迹的潜在发展，强调在治理规则本身时需要构建机构能力，而不是精确预测结果。以量子欧洲策略作为案例研究。
AI.motivation: 鉴于立法者往往反应迟缓，作者主张需要以构建机构能力而非精确预测结果为导向，从前瞻性治理的角度来监管潜在的变化。
AI.method: 提出了一个名为Ruliological的框架，该框架区分规则、变化和轨迹，并探讨了合规不可约性的条件采用方式。
AI.result: 该框架通过案例研究量子欧洲策略提供了一个应用实例，深化了对未来法律的理解。
AI.conclusion: 前瞻治理框架为理解和制定应对未来科技变化的政策提供了新的视角和工具。

title: MASIF: Implicit Failures for Process Observability in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) can complete a task despite local execution errors that are corrected, bypassed, or carried forward without individually determining its outcome. We call these implicit failures (IFs) and study them as signals for process observability beyond final task outcome. Across 1,828 traces from nine MAS-benchmark configurations, IFs occur in 54.3% of successful and 75.2% of failed traces. We develop taxonomies of error types and subsequent absorption mechanisms, supported by human and cross-model annotation audits. Counterfactual replay further probes how repairing an IF changes the final outcome. To examine the practical value of IFs, we evaluate IF-based best-of-N trace selection against existing process reward models, and introduce a novel RL algorithm, IF-GRPO, that uses IF costs to refine preferences among successful trajectories in GRPO. Experiments show that IF-GRPO exhibits some gains in accuracy and process metrics. Importantly, it exposes trade-offs between task performance, IF count and cost, and token-normalized IF density. Overall, our results show that IFs provide complementary process observability into how MAS reach their outcomes, including error recovery, propagation, and IF-based process differences that final task success alone does not expose.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了多agent系统在执行任务过程中遇到的隐性故障（IFs）及其对最终任务结果的潜在影响。通过分析1,828个执行轨迹，发现IFs在成功和失败的轨迹中分别占54.3%和75.2%。研究开发了错误类型和吸收机制的分类，并通过反事实重放进一步研究IF修复对结果的影响。提出了一种新的基于IF的成本的强化学习算法IF-GRPO，用于在成功轨迹中优化过程奖励。实验结果显示IF-GRPO在准确性和过程指标方面有一定的改进，同时强调了任务性能、IF数量和成本、以及IF密度之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 探讨多agent系统在执行任务时遇到的隐性故障如何影响最终任务结果，以及通过利用这些隐性故障提高过程可观测性。
AI.method: 通过对多个多agent系统配置的轨迹进行分析，定义和分类错误类型和吸收机制。使用反事实重放技术考察IFI修复后对最终结果的影响。设计并实现了一个基于IF成本的强化学习算法IF-GRPO。
AI.result: IF-GRPO算法在准确性和过程指标方面显示出一定的改进。进一步揭示了任务性能、IF数量和成本、以及IF密度之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，IFs提供了对多agent系统如何达到最终结果的额外过程可观测性，包括错误恢复、传播和IF基础的过程差异。最终，通过IFs实现了过程中的补充观测，而不仅仅依赖于任务最终成功/失败。

title: MPIG: Multi-angle Polarization Image Generation from a Single Polarization Observation
summary: Polarization imaging provides informative cues for material analysis, scene understanding, and visual perception. However, acquiring complete polarization observations typically requires specialized hardware and multi-angle measurements, thereby increasing system complexity and limiting practical deployment. In this work, we address the problem of predicting the missing $45^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $135^\circ$ polarization views from a single $0^\circ$ observation by leveraging a learned scene prior. To this end, we propose MPIG (Multi-angle Polarization Image Generation), a Swin Transformer-based framework that couples cross-angle feature interaction with residual decoding to predict angle-dependent intensity variations while preserving shared scene structure. Specifically, measured Stokes differences and polarization-strength-aware supervision guide the recovery of polarization modulation, orientation, and magnitude, while low-rank factorization further reduces the decoding cost. We also construct HighPol, a large-scale real-world polarization dataset comprising 5,474 groups of high-resolution four-angle polarization images collected from diverse indoor and outdoor scenes. Experimental results demonstrate improved image and polarization accuracy, achieving 29.729 dB PSNR, 0.9505 SSIM, and $21.514^\circ$ AoLP MAngE while requiring 85.86 M parameters and 1.126 T FLOPs. Furthermore, downstream validation on glass and semantic-segmentation tasks suggests that the generated polarization images can preserve task-relevant information, demonstrating the effectiveness of MPIG and the practical utility of predicted polarization observations for downstream vision applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为MPIG的框架，利用Swin Transformer从单一0度观察中预测45度、90度和135度的偏振视图，同时保持场景结构的一致性，提高了偏振图像的准确性和下游任务的有效性。
AI.motivation: 偏振成像在材料分析、场景理解和视觉感知中提供了重要线索，但获取完整的偏振观测通常需要专门的硬件和多角度测量，增加了系统复杂性，限制了实际应用。因此，研究旨在通过利用学习到的场景先验从单个视角预测缺失的角度来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 研究提出了一种基于Swin Transformer的方法，名为MPIG。该方法通过交叉角度特征交互与残差解码相结合，预测角度相关的强度变化，同时保持场景结构的一致性。通过测量的Stokes差异和偏振强度感知的监督来指导偏振调制、方向和幅度的恢复，使用低秩因子分解进一步降低解码成本。
AI.result: 在实验中，MPIG框架取得了显著的性能提升，达到了29.729 dB PSNR、0.9505 SSIM和21.514° AoLP MAngE。并且在玻璃和语义分割任务上进行了下游验证，表明生成的偏振图像可以保留任务相关的信息，验证了MPIG的有效性和预测的偏振观察在下游视觉应用中的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的MPIG框架能够有效地从单一视角重建多角度偏振图像，提高了偏振图像的准确性和在下游任务中的应用效果。

title: SNO-PI: Label-Scarce SNOMED CT Entity Linking with Pre-trained Encoders and Curated Terminology Knowledge
summary: We present SNO-PI, the top-performing submission on SNOMED International's SNOMED CT Entity Linking Benchmark as of 18 October 2026. SNO-PI achieves a macro character IoU of 0.5387, outperforming the organisers' reference system (0.4582; based on the 2024 challenge winner's approach) by 18% relative. Linking clinical mentions to SNOMED CT is a zero- and few-shot problem over a very large label space: the 272 annotated MIMIC-IV discharge summaries cover only 6,595 of the roughly 219,000 eligible concepts, and a third of those occur only once. This motivates a design built on transfer from pre-trained models and human-curated knowledge. SNO-PI combines high-recall span proposal, SapBERT candidate retrieval and listwise ensemble reranking with three BERT-family encoders, each further pre-trained with masked language modelling on unlabelled MIMIC-IV notes and then on SNOMED CT synonyms and hierarchy before task fine-tuning. We find that curated knowledge helps most on concepts never seen in training, yet these concepts remain the main source of error.

AI.tldr: SNO-PI 在 SNOMED 国际 SNOMED CT 实体链接基准测试中表现最优，宏观字符 IoU 达到 0.5387，比主办方参考系统高 18%。该系统结合了具有高召回率的命名实体识别、基于 SapBERT 的候选检索和三组 BERT 变体的列表式重新排名。
AI.motivation: 临床摘要中的实体链接问题在大规模标签空间上是一个零样本和少样本问题。由于大部分概念仅出现一次，在缺乏足够训练数据的情况下，为了从预训练模型和人工策划的知识中获益，设计了 SNO-PI，以提高模型在未见概念上的表现。
AI.method: SNO-PI 采用了高召回率的命名实体识别，结合 SapBERT 候选检索和三组 BERT 变体的列表式重新排名。每个 BERT 变体都经过特定的预训练，包括在未标注的 MIMIC-IV 笔记上进行掩码语言模型训练，然后在 SNOMED CT 同义词和层级结构上进行进一步训练，最后用于任务微调。
AI.result: SNO-PI 在基准测试中表现出色，宏观字符 IoU 达到 0.5387，比主办方参考系统提高了 18%%。
AI.conclusion: SNO-PI 通过结合高召回率的命名实体识别、基于 SapBERT 的候选检索和多模型的重新排名，以及利用未标注数据和 SNOMED CT 模型进一步训练，显著提升了未见概念的实体链接准确性。

title: Are Self-Evolving Agents Continual Learners?
summary: Large language model agents are often deployed in environments where new knowledge, tools, and workflows keep arriving. Such an agent is therefore expected to adapt continually, learning new tasks as they arrive without forgetting earlier ones. This resembles the continual learning problem, but at a pace that conventional gradient updates cannot sustain. Nonparametric self-evolving agents are a natural alternative: they adapt by rewriting their own harness, such as prompts, memory, and skills, from task feedback while the model weights stay frozen. We study whether such agents are effective continual learners across four drifting task streams that shift in topic, workflow, or domain (built from BIRD, BFCL, and ScienceWorld). Evaluating three representative methods spanning experience retrieval and self-modification (ReasoningBank, GEPA, and Meta-Harness), we find that although self-evolution improves aggregate performance on most streams, higher plasticity consistently comes at the cost of stability. Specifically, self-modifying methods apply global edits to a shared prompt or workspace, interfering with unseen tasks and overwriting earlier knowledge as the stream shifts. Conversely, similarity-based memory retrieval localizes updates across distant domains, but still retrieves foreign memories on unseen tasks and suffers from retrieval collision when similar queries require conflicting workflows. These findings show that current self-evolving agents remain incomplete continual learners.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察了非参数自演化代理在四个不断变化的任务流中的持续学习能力。尽管自我演化可以在大多数任务流中改善总体性能，但更高的可塑性往往伴随着稳定性下降。研究发现，自我修改方法会对共享提示或工作空间进行全局修改，从而干扰未见过的任务并覆盖早期知识；而基于相似性的记忆检索虽然能在不同领域定位更新，但在未见过的任务上仍检索到外来记忆，并且在需要不同工作流程的相似查询时会遇到检索冲突。
AI.motivation: 研究设计旨在解决大型语言模型在不断接收新知识、工具和工作流程的环境中面临的持续学习挑战。
AI.method: 研究评估了三种代表性的方法：ReasoningBank、GEPA和Meta-Harness，这些方法分别代表了经验检索和自我修改。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，尽管自我演化可以在大多数任务流中改善总体性能，但更高的可塑性往往伴随着稳定性下降。自我修改方法会对共享提示或工作空间进行全局修改，从而干扰未见过的任务并覆盖早期知识；而基于相似性的记忆检索虽然能在不同领域定位更新，但在未见过的任务上仍检索到外来记忆，并且在需要不同工作流程的相似查询时会遇到检索冲突。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实，目前的自我演化代理仍不足以成为完美的持续学习者。需要进一步研究改进策略以增强这些代理的稳定性和可塑性之间的平衡。

title: CoRe-WM: Conditioned Response-State World Modeling for Longitudinal Treatment-Response Prediction in Breast DCE-MRI
summary: Pathologic complete response (pCR) after neoadjuvant chemotherapy is a key prognostic indicator in aggressive breast cancer, yet existing prediction approaches either rely on pretreatment imaging alone, missing the patient's evolving response, or optimize multi-visit classifiers under direct outcome supervision, coupling representation learning with the clinical endpoint. We formulate longitudinal pCR prediction as a world-modeling problem and propose Conditioned Response-state World Modeling (CoRe-WM), which learns a latent state-transition model that predicts the next imaging state from the observed sequence. The transition function is conditioned on patient clinical profile and assigned therapy through additive shift and feature-wise modulation, enabling patient- and treatment-specific dynamics. A Factorized Response State pathway further decouples treatment-response dynamics from imaging appearance by encoding the structural prior that response manifests primarily in lesion morphology. After pretraining, all parameters are frozen and a linear readout predicts pCR at each clinical decision point. We evaluate CoRe-WM on I-SPY2 under five-fold cross-validation and assess cross-cohort transfer on I-SPY1. CoRe-WM achieves the highest discrimination among all evaluated methods at every prospective decision point, and demonstrates robust cross-cohort transfer. Ablation studies identify patient-profile conditioning and the factorized response pathway as the principal contributors. These results establish world-model-based representation learning as a promising framework for outcome prediction in oncology and beyond.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为CoRe-WM的全新方法，用于预测乳腺癌患者的病理完全缓解情况。
AI.motivation: 现有预测方法要么依赖于术前影像数据，忽略患者病情变化；要么在直接观察最终结果的多轮分类器中优化，结合了表征学习和临床终点。研究者认为，纵向pCR预测应形成一个纵向建模问题，从而更好地捕捉患者随时间病情演变的动态。
AI.method: 研究者开发了一种名为Conditioned Response-state World Modeling (CoRe-WM) 的方法。该方法通过深度学习患者观察到的影像序列来预测下一个影像状态，并将转换函数根据患者特征和治疗方式进行条件化，从而能够捕捉患者和治疗特异性动态。此外，该方法还包括一个Factorized Response State路径，通过空间结构先验将治疗反应动态与影像外观分离。
AI.result: CoRe-WM在I-SPY2数据集上进行了五折交叉验证，并评估了I-SPY1数据集上跨 cohort 的应用。CoRe-WM 在各个临床决策点的区分度最高，且展示了稳健的跨组间转移。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，基于世界模型的方向表示学习方法有可能成为肿瘤学和其他领域结果预测的有希望的框架。

title: HarnessRL: Co-Evolving Policies with a Just-in-Time Training Harness for Open-Ended RL
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) trains policies for open-ended generation with natural-language criteria as rewards, but these rewards can become ineffective as training progresses. We identify two failure modes. Under non-discriminative rewards, scores collapse to uniformly low or high values due to insufficient exploration or a mismatch between task difficulty and policy capability. Under spurious rewards, higher scores do not correspond to better responses. Both reflect a training configuration whose task sampling, exploration, and evaluation stay fixed as the policy evolves. We introduce HarnessRL, a training-time harness that co-evolves with the policy through three interfaces for task sampling, rollout guidance, and rubric criteria. HarnessRL maintains a training-time memory from which a harness evolver retrieves within-task history and cross-task evidence. Using this evidence, the evolver attributes each reward failure to the interface whose update can address it. It then runs a proposer and just-in-time critic loop in which the critic accepts a candidate update only after measuring its effect on the current frozen policy, returning rejected candidates for revision. We also curate Rubric-Mix-10k, a five-domain training and evaluation suite for open-ended RL across medical, science, writing, role-play, and instruction-following tasks. On Rubric-Mix-10k, HarnessRL outperforms the strongest baselines by 2.8 to 3.1 points across both 4B and 9B model scales and nearly halves the training steps to its best checkpoint. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Tongyi-ConvAI/Qwen-Character/tree/main/HarnessRL.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过引入HarnessRL框架，解决了基于评语的强化学习中性能下降的问题，并在多个领域展示了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 提出HarnessRL的原因在于当前的基于评语的强化学习方法会在训练过程中失效，表现为奖励失效、非区别性奖励或幻象奖励，这些都反映了任务采样、探索和评估配置不变性。
AI.method: HarnessRL通过三种接口与策略共同进化，分别是任务采样、采样引导和评语标准。引入了一种训练时内存，持续记录任务内外信息，并通过观察这些信息来判断哪种接口的更新能够解决奖励失效的问题。接着通过提案者与即时批评者的循环，对提出的更新效果进行评估，接受有效的更新。
AI.result: 在Rubric-Mix-10k（一个涉及五个领域的强化学习测试套件）上，HarnessRL相较于最强基线模型提高了2.8到3.1分，并且将到达最佳模型所需训练步骤的数量几乎减少了一半。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，HarnessRL在提升基于评语的强化学习的质量和效率方面具有很大的潜力。

title: Minimum-Cost Robust Evidence Certificates for Horn Reasoning under Correlated Source Failures
summary: A small justification for a rule-based conclusion may disappear when a source is withdrawn, and multiple derivations need not provide independent evidence. We study minimum-cost certificates that preserve a Horn conclusion under every withdrawal of at most k source domains. Evidence records remain distinct from asserted facts, supporting replicated attestations and overlapping failure dependencies. Transversals of minimal-support footprints characterize robustness and explain why disjoint-proof requirements can reject valid certificates. An exact procedure alternates weighted evidence selection with a source-failure oracle. A rule-closed counterinterpretation yields a globally valid selection cut without enumerating supports or failure scenarios. We prove correctness, finite termination, and cost optimality, establish coNP-completeness of unrestricted verification and NP-completeness of synthesis for every fixed budget, and identify a tractable reachability restriction. Experiments on controlled benchmarks, reachability graphs, and ontology-derived instances demonstrate that our counterinterpretation-guided synthesis achieves up to 92% optimum coverage within practical resource bounds, outperforming scenario expansion and general abduction while confirming the necessity of transversal-based reasoning over proof-packing heuristics.

AI.tldr: 该研究关注最小成本证书，确保在最多移除k个来源领域时，Horn结论仍然成立。通过最小化支持足迹的交集来增强鲁棒性，提出了精确的证据选择过程，并通过实验验证了该方法的有效性和成本优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的证据记录与事实声明缺乏区分，导致重复的证实和重叠的故障依赖关系。为了提升系统的鲁棒性，该研究旨在找到一种最小成本的验证方法，通过交替选择加权证据与来源故障预测来优化证书的生成。
AI.method: 研究采用了一种交替选择加权证据和来源故障预测的方法，以生成鲁棒性的最小成本证书。该方法通过最小支持足迹的交集来解释结论的稳定性，并通过反证法来确保选择的切割是全球有效的。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在控制基准、可达性图和本体实例的数据集上，能够达到高达92%的最佳覆盖率，并在资源范围内比场景扩展和一般先验推断表现出更好的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的方法能够高效且成本地生成最小化成本证书，对于Horn结论的验证具有更高的鲁棒性和有效性。

title: Edge Deployable Lightweight Framework for Real-Time Driver Safety System with Integrated Lane Departure and Traffic Sign Recognition
summary: Lane departure and traffic-sign negligence are leading contributors to road accidents, particularly in regions with non-standardized signage and limited annotated data. Existing Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) solutions are often developed as disjointed submodules, are rarely validated for real-time operation, and struggle to balance accuracy with low-latency inference for embedded deployment. We address these gaps with a unified, edge-deployable ADAS framework that simultaneously performs lane-departure warning (LDW) and traffic-sign detection and recognition (TSD/TSR), and validate the proposed system on automotive-class devices. Our framework combines a lightweight, lane-segmentation-driven LDW, which includes a drivable-area fallback for degraded markings, with a two-stage TSD/TSR pipeline consisting of efficient sign localization followed by fine-grained classification, designed to preserve accuracy at embedded latency. To support region-specific deployment under data scarcity, we curate a 35-class local traffic-sign dataset and introduce a generalized augmentation and balancing profile, expanding the corpus from 359 images to 8,750 samples. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, the integrated system sustains 15 FPS end to end (32 FPS for LDW and 18 FPS for TSD/TSR). The TSD/TSR branch achieves 97.4 mAP for detection and 95.6% validation accuracy (93.1% on a local real-world set) while maintaining an approximately 13.9 M parameter footprint. Relative to recent methods that target a single task or report results only on desktop-class GPUs, our approach delivers both LDW and TSD/TSR with real-time performance on edge hardware, providing a practical pathway to low-cost, field-ready ADAS in resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种统一的边缘部署ADAS框架，集成了车道偏离警告和交通标志检测与识别功能，适用于资源受限的场景，并展示了在嵌入式硬件上的实时性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的ADAS解决方案往往缺乏整体性，难以在保证实时操作和低延迟的同时兼顾准确性。本文旨在弥补这一缺口，通过一个综合性的框架解决车道偏离和交通标志识别的问题。
AI.method: 该框架结合了一个轻量化的车道分割驱动的车道偏离警告模块，并利用有效的标志定位后进行精细化分类，设计时保留了嵌入式低延迟的需求。通过构建一个包含35类本地交通标志的数据集，并引入通用的数据增强和平衡策略，扩大了数据集规模。
AI.result: 该系统在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上的端到端帧率为15 FPS，车道偏离警告模块为32 FPS，交通标志检测与识别模块为18 FPS。这些标志检测和识别分支在不同场景下的平均精度达到97.4 mAP和95.6%的验证准确性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法在资源受限环境下提供了实时的车道偏离警告和交通标志检测与识别性能，为低成本、可现场应用的ADAS系统提供了一条实际可行的道路。

title: The Geometry of Agent Memory: Forecasting Retrieval-Bound Memory Failures, and Characterizing Its Limits
comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. Accepted as a poster at the Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems (PALM) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Workshop version: https://openreview.net/forum?id=xP0xvmQZhB
summary: We study whether geometric relationships between conversation turns, memory texts, and queries can predict answer correctness before generation. We evaluate four memory implementations with dense or hybrid retrieval and one observation-summary comparator. We embed these texts in a shared space. A logistic classifier uses 25 features describing query proximity, memory-conversation correspondence, and conversation structure. On LongMemEval-small, pooled AUROC is 0.640 over 2,367 question-system pairs, below a question-difficulty baseline of 0.655. Performance varies by question type: geometry reaches 0.841 on single-session-assistant questions, but system identity alone reaches 0.826. After controlling for difficulty and identity, geometry adds no statistically established pooled improvement (delta = +0.002, 95% CI [-0.010, 0.014]). A fixed-store context-selection experiment finds higher accuracy with proximity-ranked memories than with random subsets, consistent with ordinary retrieval relevance. On LoCoMo, nearest-turn similarity has modest predictive value for single-hop questions and near-chance estimates for several other categories. Training uses correctness labels; prediction uses pre-answer features and no additional LLM generation call. The results characterize associations between memory representations and correctness, rather than establish a reliable deployment diagnostic. In particular, embedding proximity does not verify fact coverage or distinguish memory-construction, retrieval, and generation errors.

AI.tldr: 研究了对话转录、记忆文本和查询之间的几何关系是否可以预测答案的正确性，结果在部分情况下有一定的预测效果。
AI.motivation: 探讨利用几何关系预测答案正确性以优化对话系统的效果。
AI.method: 使用四种不同的记忆实现方法（包括密集检索和混合检索），并评估了观察摘要比较器的表现。在共享空间中嵌入文本，使用逻辑分类器分析查询接近度、记忆对话对应性及对话结构等25个特征。
AI.result: 在LongMemEval-small数据集上，综合AUC值为0.640，低于难题基准0.655。不同问题类型的表现差异显著，几何关系在单一会话助手问题上达到0.841，而系统身份单一就达到了0.826。控制难度和身份后，几何关系没有统计上的显著改进。近似排名的记忆比随机子集表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，记忆表示与正确性的关联性远不及其作为部署诊断工具的实用价值，空间嵌入的接近度未能验证事实覆盖面，也不能区分记忆构建、检索和生成错误。

title: Benefit-Targeted Routing and Bounded Revision for LLM-Based Evidence Screening in Manufacturing Supplier Discovery
summary: An evidence-review system must allocate additional model judgments and control their use. We study these software decisions on 6,164 frozen manufacturing source-task pairs. Benefit-targeted routing learns recovered agreement minus newly introduced disagreement. On the original 300-case test, 60 consultations yield 202/231 agreements with two human references versus 189/218 for a logistic-risk router. An additional 300 cases were independently annotated twice using equal frozen evidence. Without retraining the historical policies, the corresponding counts are 164/190 versus 163/193; the differences do not resolve an advantage. Strict scalar-Ridge controls share preprocessing, regularization and fitting, and remain inconclusive. Quotation and requested-state replacement gates retain rejected cases and budget costs; their joint gate rejects one original and two additional consultations without changing primary outcomes. Evidence ablations, fusion and bounded updates supply further controls. A completed 200-pair identity audit yields 97.45 percent weighted merge precision after eight author adjudications. This audits a provisional map, while prospective company-disjoint performance remains untested.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了一种基于证据审查的系统在6,164个制造源任务配对上的表现，通过对比不同策略如受益导向路由、阻塞门和证据消融等，评估了系统在不同场景下的决策效果。
AI.motivation: 为了改进证据审查系统的决策效率和准确性，研究通过实际案例分析，探索了不同的策略在不同条件下的表现。
AI.method: 研究团队使用了6,164个制造源任务配对作为数据集，针对具体的软件决策问题，通过对比不同的策略（如受益导向路由、阻塞门和证据消融等），来评估系统的表现。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，受益导向路由策略在初次试验中表现出色，但在后续独立标注的新案例中并没有明显的优势。阻塞门策略和证据消融措施也没有显著提高系统的整体性能。身份审计表明系统在初步整合后具有较高的准确度，但未来的独立公司绩效测试尚未进行。
AI.conclusion: 研究指出，尽管存在一些初步改进，但现有的策略仍然无法显著提升系统的整体性能。未来的独立测试和新策略研究将是改进的方向。

title: CASE: Complementary Articulation-Aware Speech Encoder to Enhance Speech-Driven 3D Facial Animation
summary: General-purpose self-supervised speech encoders provide strong acoustic representations, but their pretraining objectives are not explicitly aligned with the visible articulatory dynamics required by speech-driven 3D facial animation. We propose CASE (Complementary Articulation-aware Speech Encoder), a complementary speech encoder adapted by contrastively aligning short speech clips with continuous 3D lip-mesh VQ-VAE latents. After adaptation, the geometry branch is removed, and the audio-only CASE representation is fused with the baseline SSL speech representation through residual cross-attention, while retaining the motion-decoder architecture and objective. Across four VOCASET baselines, CASE reduces mean lip vertex error by 2.8-6.0%, and mean full-face vertex error decreases in every system. Under the same fusion protocol, CASE yields lower mean LVE than the unadapted AV-SE stream on all four generators, with model-dependent margins. Because adaptation uses Korean speech-geometry pairs and evaluation uses English VOCASET, the result is consistent with cross-language downstream transfer under a shared English-pretrained audio-visual prior.

AI.tldr: CASE 提出了一个互补的语音编码器，它通过对比的方式将短语音片段与连续的3D嘴唇网格 VQ-VAE 潜变量对齐。经过适应后，几何分支被移除，音频仅 CASE 表征与基线 SSL 语音表示通过残差交叉注意力进行融合，保持了运动解码器架构和目标。CASE 在四个 VOSCASET 基线中，减少平均嘴唇顶点误差 2.8% 至 6.0%，并且在所有四个生成器上比未适应的 AV-SE 流程具有更低的平均 LVE。
AI.motivation: 通用的自我监督语音编码器虽然提供了强大的声学表示，但它们的预训练目标与用于语音驱动3D面部动画所需的可见发音动力学不完全对齐。因此，提出了 CASE，通过对比学习对齐短语音片段与连续的3D嘴唇网格 VQ-VAE 潜变量来进行适应。
AI.method: CASE 采用对比学习的方式，将短语音片段与连续的3D嘴唇网格 VQ-VAE 潜变量对齐。经过适应后，几何分支被移除，音频仅 CASE 表征与基线 SSL 语音表示通过残差交叉注意力进行融合，保持了运动解码器架构和目标。
AI.result: 在四个 VOSCASET 基线中，CASE 减少了平均嘴唇顶点误差 2.8% 至 6.0%，并且在所有四个生成器上比未适应的 AV-SE 流程具有更低的平均 LVE。
AI.conclusion: CASE 的结果表明，通过对比学习对齐短语音片段与连续的3D嘴唇网格 VQ-VAE 潜变量的适应过程能够改进语音驱动的 3D 面部动画。此外，研究结果还显示了在共享的英语预训练音频-视觉先验下的跨语言下游传递的一致性。

title: WenSight-Decision-1 for Direct Decisions under E-commerce Rules
summary: E-commerce decisions require applying natural-language rules to the available case evidence. We introduce WenSight-Decision-1, a shared model that scores supplied options directly from rules and case information for six operational tasks, with examples spanning six languages. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B with reference options as supervision, using the same option scores for training and inference. On 1,440 synthetic operational cases reserved for final evaluation, accuracy rises from 61.60% for Qwen3.5-9B to 92.92% for WenSight-Decision-1 under identical inputs and scoring. Joint fine-tuning improves all six tasks, bringing heterogeneous operational judgments under a common decision interface.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为WenSight-Decision-1的共享模型，该模型能够在六种操作任务中直接从规则和案例信息中评分，并通过在Qwen3.5-9B上进行联合微调提升了准确性，最终在1,440个合成的操作案例上的表现从61.60%提高到了92.92%。
AI.motivation: 为了改进电子商务决策过程中的自然语言规则应用，并提供一个统一的操作决策接口，以提高多语言环境下的决策准确性和一致性。
AI.method: 开发了一个基于Qwen3.5-9B的WenSight-Decision-1模型，通过对模型进行细调，并使用参考选项作为监督信息来直接评分。
AI.result: 在1,440个合成的操作案例上的测试中，WenSight-Decision-1模型的准确率从未经微调的Qwen3.5-9B的61.60%提高到了92.92%。表明该模型在多种任务和多语言环境下具有较好的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合微调的方法，WenSight-Decision-1模型改进了六种操作任务的表现，实现了对不同操作判断的统一接口，提高了决策的一致性和准确性。

title: CODA: Cohort- and Drift-aware Foundation Model for Multimodal Clinical Reasoning
summary: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse clinical tasks. However, existing approaches predominantly operate at the individual sample level and fail to model the interplay between population-level cohort patterns and patient-specific variation that underlie real-world clinical reasoning. In practice, clinicians routinely reason through patient cohorts sharing similar demographic, physiological, or pathological characteristics, while accounting for patient-specific deviations from the group prototype. Motivated by this gap, we propose CODA, a cohort- and drift-aware foundation model for multimodal clinical reasoning. CODA explicitly integrates cohort structure into the modeling pipeline through two complementary mechanisms: cohort-aware population stratification and drift-aware individual adaptation. In particular, we leverage reinforcement learning to discover clinically meaningful patient cohorts, and further model each patient's deviation from cohort prototypes as a structured drift signal encoding fine-grained individual heterogeneity. These cohort- and drift-aware representations are incorporated into the foundation model to enable reasoning that is simultaneously informed by population-level patterns and sensitive to individual-level variation. Extensive experiments on real-world electronic health record (EHR) benchmarks demonstrate that CODA achieves consistent effectiveness and strong generalizability across diverse clinical tasks, including closed-QA, open-QA, and report generation.

AI.tldr: CODA 是一种通过整合组间结构和个体适应来提高临床推理能力的多模态基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的临床推理方法大多仅关注个体样本，难以捕捉组间模式与个体差异之间的联系，受此启发，提出了 CODA 模型。
AI.method: CODA 采用了强化学习来发现具有临床意义的患者组，并通过组原型和结构化漂移信号建模个体差异。
AI.result: 在真实世界电子健康记录基准测试上的实验证明，CODA 在多种临床任务中展示了持续的有效性和强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CODA 能够同时在群体层面上提供信息并在个体层面上保持敏感性，从而提高了临床推理的质量。

title: MCSplat: Multi-View Photometric and Geometric Consistent Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Driving Scenes
comment: 24 pages, 14 figures, 6 tables; Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Driving-scene reconstruction via feed-forward Gaussian splatting from sparse multi-view images remains challenging due to two factors. First, cross-camera photometric inconsistency, caused by variations in exposure, ISP, and illumination, can be incorrectly absorbed into Gaussian geometry. Second, unreliable local geometric supervision arises from normal-based constraints near depth discontinuities. To address these issues, we present \textbf{MCSplat}, a multi-view consistent feed-forward Gaussian splatting framework for driving scenes. MCSplat constructs a canonical appearance space from depth-guided multi-camera correspondences to decouple geometry learning from camera-specific appearance. A multi-scale Bilateral Grid Transformer restores raw camera appearance from canonical renderings, enabling photometric supervision without contaminating Gaussian geometry. To improve local geometric reliability, we estimate Fisher-information-based uncertainty from photometric sensitivity and use it to adaptively weight surface-oriented self-supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction quality and generalization across driving datasets. Geometry-oriented evaluations further reveal enhanced cross-view depth consistency and local surface-normal agreement, while qualitative results show fewer geometric artifacts and more coherent structures across overlapping views.

AI.tldr: MCSplat通过多视图一致的前向Gaussian绘制框架解决了驾驶场景重建中的光照不一致和几何约束不足问题，通过构建标准外观空间、多尺度双边网络恢复原始图像外观、以及基于Fisher信息的自监督加权实现高质量的跨视图深度一致性和局部表面法线一致性。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在解决驾驶场景重建中的光照不一致和几何约束不足的问题，以提高重建质量并提升模型的泛化能力。
AI.method: MCSplat采用了多视图一致的前向Gaussian绘制框架，利用深度引导的多摄像机对应关系构建标准外观空间，分离几何学习与摄像机特定的外观；通过多尺度双边网格变换器从标准渲染恢复原始图像外观，确保外观监督不污染Gaussian几何；通过光度敏感性的Fisher信息估计表面方向自监督加权，增强局部几何可靠性。
AI.result: 实验表明，MCSplat相比现有方法在重建质量上有所提升，并能更好地泛化到驾驶场景数据集中。几何一致性评估显示跨视角深度一致性增强，局部表面法线一致性提高。定性结果显示更少的几何失真和更连贯的结构，尤其是在重叠视图中。
AI.conclusion: MCSplat为驾驶场景重建提供了一种有效的解决方案，通过多视图一致性重建策略提高了重建质量和几何一致性。

title: TeleASR-Amharic: A Benchmark for Robust Amharic ASR in Realistic Telecommunication Conditions
comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Workshop W8 TrustAudio: Workshop on Secure, Safe, and Privacy-Preserving Speech and Audio AI
summary: The real-world usability of ASR models remains challenging, particularly for low-resource languages, where existing speech resources are often collected in clean studio environments. In this work, we introduce TeleASR-Amharic, a benchmark for evaluating Amharic ASR under various acoustic and telecommunication conditions. We analyze the major degradations observed in real telecommunications recordings and develop a benchmark that covers multiple channel conditions, environmental disturbances, and telecom-domain variations. Our results show that telecommunication degradation can substantially reduce recognition performance, making even high-performing ASR models impractical under severe conditions. For example, the WER of the best-performing model increases from 0.23 to 0.79 under severe telecommunication degradation, corresponding to a relative increase of 243% in recognition errors. We further investigate the effects of different noise and channel distortions and show that scaling training data and applying carefully designed telecommunication-aware augmentation substantially improve robustness. In particular, our best training configuration achieves a 23.6% relative WER reduction under extreme noise conditions. Together with the release of our telecommunications-domain data, these findings provide a reproducible benchmark for measuring progress in Amharic ASR while highlighting open challenges in developing robust speech technologies for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究引入了针对阿姆哈拉语的TeleASR-Amharic基准，重点评估在不同通信和声学条件下ASR模型的表现，发现电信通信降级严重影响了识别性能，通过增加训练数据和电信环境适配增强，识别错误明显减少。
AI.motivation: 当前ASR模型在低资源语言的实际使用中面临挑战，尤其是在嘈杂的通信环境下。为此，研究者提出了TeleASR-Amharic基准，以真实通信录音为依据，评估在各类声学与通信条件下阿姆哈拉语ASR系统的性能，目的是促进相关技术的发展和应用。
AI.method: 研究者分析了实际通信录音中的主要降噪情况，并构建了一个包含多种信道条件、环境干扰和电信应用差异的评估基准。通过增加训练数据量并应用精心设计的电信意识增强技术，提高了模型的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，严重的通信降级导致识别性能大幅下降。最佳模型在恶劣通信条件下的词错误率（WER）从0.23增加到0.79，增加了243%的识别错误。通过调整训练数据和电信环境适配增强技术，识别错误率显著降低23.6%。
AI.conclusion: 这项研究不仅提供了衡量阿姆哈拉语ASR系统性能的可重复基准，还指出了在真实通信环境下开发鲁棒语音技术面临的挑战。

title: Motor compound fault diagnosis using an attention-based cross-talk architecture
summary: As physical AI increasingly relies on sensing to understand physical systems, reliable condition monitoring of industrial machinery has become more important. Motors are ubiquitous in industrial systems, and increasing system complexity raises the likelihood of simultaneous faults. Accordingly, compound fault diagnosis that identifies multiple fault components and their severities is increasingly required. Because different fault components jointly affect the same vibration signal, their severity classification can be formulated as related tasks, making multi-task learning (MTL) suitable for exploiting shared information. However, conventional shared-trunk architectures force tasks to share a common representation, potentially causing negative transfer because fault components are characterized by different time-frequency regions. To address this issue, this study proposes a Residual Neural Dimension Reductor with Time-Frequency Channel Attention (RNDR-TFCA), an attention-enhanced cross-talk architecture for multi-output compound fault diagnosis. RNDR-TFCA preserves task-specific feature extractors while selectively exchanging information across tasks. Time-frequency attention emphasizes informative intra-task regions, while channel attention enhances useful inter-task information after nonlinear feature fusion. Experiments on a rotor-bearing system with inner-race fault, outer-race fault, misalignment, and unbalance showed that RNDR-TFCA achieved a macro F1 score of 0.898, outperforming single-task, multi-class, shared-trunk, and cross-talk baselines. Ablation experiments confirmed the benefit of jointly applying both attention mechanisms. RNDR-TFCA required 713 K parameters and 170.42 MMACs, only slightly higher than RNDR. Channel-expanded baselines still underperformed RNDR-TFCA, indicating that the gain was not simply attributable to increased model capacity.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种Residual Neural Dimension Reductor with Time-Frequency Channel Attention (RNDR-TFCA)，用于多输出复合故障诊断。该模型通过时间频率注意力机制和通道注意力机制在不牺牲特征提取器特定性的同时增强了任务间的交互信息，实验表明其性能优于其他基线。
AI.motivation: 鉴于工业系统中电机的普遍性和系统复杂性导致的故障可能性增加，需要对多个故障组件及其严重性进行复合故障诊断。虽然传统的共享主干结构可以共享信息，但它可能会导致负迁移，因为不同的故障组件具有不同的时间和频率特征。
AI.method: 为了应对这一问题，研究提出了RNDR-TFCA，一种带有时间频率通道注意机制的注意力增强交叉通信架构。它在不牺牲特定任务特征提取器的情况下，通过时间频率注意机制和通道注意机制在非线性特征融合后增强了跨任务的信息。
AI.result: 在包含内圈故障、外圈故障、偏心和不平衡的旋转轴承系统上的实验表明，RNDR-TFCA 在宏观 F1 得分上达到了 0.898，超过了单一任务、多类、共享主干结构和其他通信基线的性能，消融实验也证实了同时应用两种注意机制的好处。此外，RNDR-TFCA 的参数量和 MACs 仅略微超过 RNDR，但扩展通道的基线仍然表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 总之，RNDR-TFCA 在多输出复合故障诊断中展示了优越的性能和效果，证明了其在工业系统中实际应用的可能性。

title: Local Evidence, Global Failure: Diagnosing Speech-Vision Temporal Composition in Audio-Visual Language Models
summary: Audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) can fail at full-video speech-vision decisions even when useful visual evidence is locally recoverable. We introduce Temporal Evidence Decomposition (TED), a training-free diagnostic framework that separates local visual verification from speech-relative aggregation. Automatic speech recognition supplies a transcript and utterance interval. TED queries audio-free windows with the transcript for Temporal Alignment and Forecasting, or answer candidates for Cross-Modal Temporal Binding, then aggregates evidence relative to that interval. Across four frozen AV-LLMs on SVHalluc, Temporal Forecasting accuracy rises from 29.3-33.7% under full-video questioning to 79.3-82.2% with TED. Query replacement reduces recovery; the observed anchor remains beneficial when temporal-region availability is held fixed. Physical-isolation and timing-shortcut controls test alternative explanations. The findings distinguish locally recoverable evidence from successful full-video decisions, motivating explicit separation of narration content, utterance timing, and time-indexed visual evidence.

AI.tldr: Temporal Evidence Decomposition (TED) 提供了一种训练无损的诊断框架，用于分离局部视觉验证和基于演讲的时间累积。通过四款冻结的音频-视觉大型语言模型（AV-LLMs）在 SVHalluc 数据集上的测试，显示了 TED 在时间预测准确性上的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 为了克服传统的 AV-LLMs 在处理需要结合视觉和音频信息的决策时的局限性
AI.method: TED 采用自动语音识别生成的转录文本和断言时段，通过时间对齐和预测以及跨模态时间绑定，分隔局部视觉验证并基于给定的时段进行证据积累。
AI.result: 在 SVHalluc 数据集上，TED 达到了 79.3-82.2% 的时间预测准确性，显著高于（29.3-33.7%）全视频问答下的表现。
AI.conclusion: TED 通过物理隔离和时间捷径测试，证明了其在区分局部可恢复的证据与完整视频决策成功方面的重要性，促进了对叙述内容、话语时间及其视觉证据时间索引的明确分离研究。

title: Training Negatives Still Matter After Calibrating Answerability Readouts
summary: Answerability readouts predict whether a passage supplies an answer, but whether calibration can compensate for removing negative passages during training remains unclear. We present a controlled study of how training-negative construction affects calibrated prediction, ranking, and downstream answer retention. We compare native training, which retains negative passages, with empty training, which removes them, holding questions, labels, positive examples, and model weights fixed. Both are calibrated on the same labeled native examples. On SQuAD 2.0 and RepLiQA, native-trained logistic readouts at selected depths achieve lower Brier loss for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Gemma-2-9B-it, with or without output scores. Native fusion also outperforms calibrated output alone. Post-hoc AUROC analysis shows better ranking under native training, beyond what threshold adjustment alone can explain. On the official SQuAD 2.0 development set, native readout policies improve F1 over empty policies but retain more answers to unanswerable questions. The advantage varies by estimator and depth, while RepLiQA's text shortcuts limit claims about contextual understanding. Unfinished generations prevent complete answer-level evaluation, although worst-case bounds preserve the native-empty F1 gains. Our findings show that training negatives affect ranking and downstream decisions even after common calibration, without establishing a universal advantage for native training.

AI.tldr: 该研究对比了在保留负样本和删除负样本两种训练方式下预测、排序和下游答案保留性能的影响，发现使用原始训练方法的逻辑读取在两个数据集上具有更低的Brier损失，并且原始融合方法优于单独使用校准输出。尽管存在未完成的生成，原始读取策略在F1得分上仍然优于空训练策略。
AI.motivation: 探索校准能否弥补训练过程中去除负样本对预测和排序性能的影响，评估原始训练（保留负样本）和空训练（去除负样本）对于下游任务的影响。
AI.method: 该研究在SQuAD 2.0和RepLiQA数据集上进行对照实验，将两种训练方式的模型进行比较，同时保持问题、标签、正样本和模型权重相同，统一校准标准。
AI.result: 研究表明，使用原始训练方法的逻辑读取在SQuAD 2.0和RepLiQA上具有更低的Brier损失，并且原始融合方法优于单独使用校准输出。后验AUROC分析显示在原始训练下具有更好的排序性能。在SQuAD 2.0的官方开发集上，原始读取策略在F1得分上优于空训练策略，尽管存在未完成生成，仍保持了原始-空训练的F1收益。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，训练负样対排名和下游决策有影响，即使进行了校准，但尚未证明原始训练的普遍优势。

title: When Should AI Chime In? Benchmarking Timely Contribution of Proactive Agents in Multi-Party Chat
summary: Proactive agents can support group collaboration by surfacing useful information without waiting to be asked, but even relevant contributions can be disruptive if poorly timed. In this work, we isolate the timing question: given a fixed candidate contribution such as a clarification or relevant fact, when should an AI agent chime in? We introduce PITCH (Proactive Intervention Timing in CHat), to our knowledge the first benchmark with large-scale human judgments of proactive agent timing collected from participants in the same unscripted multi-party conversations they took part in. To collect high-quality judgments, we design a novel interface in which 2-4 people chat synchronously, author candidate AI contribution messages, place their own and others' contributions into the chat history, and then deliberate as a group about the best placement for each message. PITCH contains 384 candidate contributions and 1,091 judgments, each marking an ideal turn, an acceptable window, or that a contribution should not appear, from 89 participants engaged in 35 conversations. Evaluating 15 models across 28 configurations, we find that while models can place contributions well when given the entire conversation history, they systematically chime in too early when asked to decide live as the conversation unfolds: best-turn accuracy falls from 57.8% to 19.0%, with nearly half of placements occurring before every participant's acceptable window. In comparison, lay humans deciding live are more accurate (23.7% vs 19.0%), and fewer of their placements are premature (39.7% vs 46.4%). Model reasoning traces show that 93% of intervention justifications cite relevance, while almost none consider waiting. By providing a human-grounded benchmark, our work reveals gaps in agents' ability to integrate into group settings and points towards proactive agents that can reason explicitly about appropriate timing.

AI.tldr: 研究引入了PITCH基准，该基准基于人类在未脚本的多人群聊中的判断，评估了主动介入的时间选择。尽管模型在完整的对话历史中表现出色，但在实时决策中经常过早介入。
AI.motivation: 探索主动代理在群组协作中的最佳介入时机，以提高信息的及时性和相关性，同时避免干扰。
AI.method: 设计了一个新颖的界面，允许参与者同步聊天、生成候选AI贡献信息、在对话历史中放置信息，并集体讨论最佳插入点。通过这个过程，收集了大量高质量的人类判断数据。
AI.result: 评估了15个模型在28种配置下的表现，发现模型在提供完整对话历史时表现良好，但在实时决策中过早介入，准确率急剧下降。相比之下，人类用户的实时决策准确率略高，且较少出现过早介入的情况。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，当前的主动代理在实时决策中未能有效调和信息相关性和适时性的平衡，提出了未来研究需更加重视适时性判断的问题。

title: LateMatch: Breaking the Interaction Bottleneck via Cacheable Matching for Efficient Visual Localization
summary: Visual localization is critical for embodied agents, but deploying state-of-the-art deep feature matchers on edge devices is fundamentally limited by their massive computational cost. Standard deep matchers tightly interleave intra-image context building and inter-image matching at every layer, creating a severe interaction bottleneck. Localizing a single query against K database images forces the system to execute the full network K independent times with no capacity for caching. To break this bottleneck, we advocate for a paradigm shift toward cacheable image matching. We realize this paradigm with LateMatch, a versatile approach that restructures existing matchers by deferring inter-image interaction to their final layers. By isolating intra-image processing into offline-cacheable Context Blocks, only a small set of Interaction Blocks must be executed online. To further optimize LateMatch, we introduce E-SToRE (Entropy-guided Spatial Token Reduction and Expansion). E-SToRE leverages the decreasing Shannon entropy of the late Interaction Blocks to dynamically reduce token counts just prior to cross-image interaction. Evaluated across HPatches, ScanNet, MegaDepth, ETH-3D, and Aachen, LateMatch reduces effective computational cost by over 2x compared to standard deep matchers, while E-SToRE yields an additional 10% to 14% savings with negligible degradation in accuracy.

AI.tldr: LateMatch 是一种图像匹配方法，通过后置交互和上下文块的离线缓存来减少计算成本，E-SToRE 进一步通过动态减少交互块中的 token 数量来优化 LateMatch，两种方法结合可在保持准确性的前提下显著减少计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有深度匹配器的计算成本高，无法在边缘设备上高效运行，因此需要开发一种新的匹配方法以降低计算成本。
AI.method: LateMatch 将图像匹配过程中的跨图像交互延迟到最终层，并将图像内部处理作为可以在离线状态下缓存的 Context Blocks；E-SToRE 则通过在进行跨图像交互前利用 Shannon 互信息动态减少 token 数量来进一步优化 LateMatch。
AI.result: LateMatch 在 HPatches、ScanNet、MegaDepth、ETH-3D 和 Aachen 数据集上有效计算成本相较于标准深度匹配器减少了超过 2 倍，而 E-SToRE 可额外节省 10% 至 14% 的计算成本，同时对准确性影响不大。
AI.conclusion: LateMatch 和 E-SToRE 提供了一种新的图像匹配方法，不仅有效地降低了计算成本，而且保持了高精度。

title: AfriGuard: Safety and Robust Refusal For African Languages
summary: Large language models (LLMs) designed to interact with users are typically trained to respond appropriately to harmful or toxic content. However, ensuring appropriate responses becomes more challenging in diverse linguistic and cultural contexts, where safety risks may be expressed or interpreted differently. Building safe AI systems therefore requires detecting safety risks, understanding their nature, and responding appropriately, while accounting for linguistic and cultural variations that add complexity to each stage. In this work, we introduce AfriGuard, a culturally grounded multilingual dataset for studying harmful intent, safety-category understanding, and refusal behavior across 10 African languages and English. Our findings reveal that guardrail models underperform both open- and closed-source LLMs on safety-intent and safety-category classification, while models show limited understanding of appropriate safety behavior, scoring below 60% F1. We further find that models often fail to respond appropriately to unsafe prompts not because they explicitly refuse, but because they produce linguistically inadequate responses that result in incidental non-assistance rather than proper refusals. Finally, using AfriGuard, we develop efficient guardrail models that achieve performance competitive with models up to 30x larger, introduce refusal detectors that improve average performance by 43.9% over existing detectors, and demonstrate that supervised fine-tuning can substantially improve overall safety performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究引入了一个多语言数据集AfriGuard，评估大型语言模型在不同文化和语言背景下处理有害意图和理解安全类别的能力，发现模型在这些任务上的性能不佳，并提出改进措施以提高安全性。
AI.motivation: 由于不同语言和文化的差异性，大型语言模型在应对有害或不道德的内容时面临的挑战增加。因此，研究旨在通过创建一个文化背景下的多语言数据集，来增强AI系统对多样语境中安全风险的理解和处理能力。
AI.method: 研究者创建了一个名为AfriGuard的多语言数据集，涵盖了10种非洲语言和英语。利用这个数据集，研究者评估了现有语言模型在识别有害意图、理解安全性类别以及拒绝行为方面的表现。同时，提出了两种改进措施来提高模型的安全性能。
AI.result: 研究发现，现有的防护模型在安全意图和安全类别分类任务上表现不如开源和闭源的大语言模型。模型在适当的安全行为理解上也表现不足，F1分数低于60%。进一步发现，模型往往由于产生语言不符合要求的响应而未能适当回应不安全的提示，而不是直接拒绝。使用AfriGuard数据集，研究者开发了高效的安全防护模型，性能与更大规模的模型相当，还引入了改进的拒绝检测器，平均性能提升了43.9%。
AI.conclusion: 研究认为，通过使用符合文化背景的数据集，可以显著提高大型语言模型在处理多样文化和语言背景下安全风险上的性能。同时，监督下的微调对提升整体安全性能有很大的促进作用。

title: TESS: LLM-guided Translation, Exploration, Simulation, and Search for Embodied Task Planning
comment: EMNLP 2026 findings. Code will be released at https://github.com/woyut/TESS_EMNLP26
summary: In this work we focus on the problem of embodied task planning, which requires an agent to accomplish a complex task by separating it into atomic actions. Recent studies have developed LLM-based methods to address this problem. However, the executability and correctness of the generated plans remain suboptimal in complex environments and tasks. On the other hand, classical search algorithms have the potential to solve the planning problems perfectly, yet they require fully observable environments, known state transitions and goal state, which are often unattainable in general task domains. Therefore, we propose to implement an LLM-guided search algorithm that makes the search process possible and efficient by incorporating LLMs' commonsense knowledge. Our method leverages LLMs to (1) translate natural language instructions into formatted goal conditions, (2) facilitate efficient exploration in partially observable environments, (3) implement a rule-based world simulator, and (4) prune the space of candidate actions to improve search efficiency. Experimental results on VirtualHome and ALFWorld demonstrate its superior performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合大规模语言模型（LLM）的指导搜索算法来解决具身任务规划问题，该算法通过利用LLM的常识知识使其在部分可观测环境中有效并且高效。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM方法在复杂环境中生成的执行计划和正确性不足，而经典搜索算法虽然理论上能完美解决规划问题，但在一般任务领域中很难应用。因此，本文提出了一种结合LLM的指导搜索算法。
AI.method: 该方法利用LLM进行任务指令自然语言到格式化目标条件的转换，促进部分可观测环境中的高效探索，构建基于规则的世界模拟器，并剪枝候选操作以提高搜索效率。
AI.result: 在VirtualHome和ALFWorld实验中，该方法表现出优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一个将LLM融入搜索算法以实现复杂任务规划的新方法，这为未来的研究提供了新的思路和方法。

title: Painting Change Map as guidance for generating painting processes
summary: Digital art generation has undergone a massive paradigm shift, moving from static image synthesis to dynamic video generation that can mimic the human painting process. While existing models can synthesize visually stunning time-lapses of paintings being created or "unpainted," they largely treat the creative process as a black box. Current conditioning mechanisms are either too rigid, relying on static geometric cues like Canny edges or depth maps, or too holistic, utilizing simple scalar progress variables that offer no localized control. Consequently, users lack the agency to steer how a painting evolves over time. In this work, we argue that true control over the video generation of artwork requires a joint understanding of two fundamental dimensions: where an artist acts, and when those actions take place. To achieve this, we introduce the Painting Change Map, a novel spatio-temporal control mechanism that explicitly tracks normalized structural changes across a 1,000-timestep continuum, a resolution sufficient to capture fine-grained stroke-level changes while remaining computationally tractable. By mapping localized visual differences into an encoded RGB space, our representation enables fine-grained guidance for both the forward painting and reverse unpainting processes. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates the efficacy of our approach. We outperform existing control baselines and achieve competitive or superior results compared to state-of-the-art painting methods. Furthermore, under oracle conditions, our method surpasses all baselines by a significant margin. Code is available at https://github.com/Markus-Pobitzer/painting-change-map.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了Painting Change Map，这是一种新型的空间时间控制机制，可以准确跟踪绘画变化，并提供细腻的指导，无论是正向绘画还是逆向“绘画”，实验表明其性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有模型将创意过程视为黑盒，缺乏对绘画时间细粒度控制的能力，用户无法有效地引导绘画的演变。因此，需要开发一种新的控制机制，以提供更细致的控制。
AI.method: 引入了Painting Change Map，这是一种新的时空控制机制，能准确捕捉从静态到动态绘画过程中的结构变化，并将其映射到一个1000帧的时间连续体上，实现细粒度控制。
AI.result: 在基准测试中，该方法的表现优于现有控制基线，并且在所有基线中表现出显著领先。同时，对于正向绘画和逆向“绘画”过程，提供了细腻的指导。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，对于视频生成艺术作品的真实控制需要理解和掌握两个基本维度：艺术家的行为位置和行为发生的时间。提出了Painting Change Map是一种有效的解决方案。

title: Mitigating Reward Hacking in Preference Reward Models with Evolving Penalties
summary: Reinforcement learning for language models has moved from preference reward models to verifiable rewards, which sustain much longer optimization. Preference models are prone to reward hacking: the policy raises their score without improving response quality, or even while degrading it. Yet for open-ended tasks, where quality can neither be verified nor fully written down as rubrics, they remain valuable. We introduce Dynalize, which mitigates reward hacking online, during policy training. Periodically and asynchronously, a language model analyzes training rollouts and writes penalties for undesirable behaviors that the reward model appears to reward; a judge applies them to every rollout. In clinical counseling and creative writing, training on the reward model alone raises its score continuously but ultimately leads to a decline in external benchmarks. Dynalize sustains longer training and results in improved downstream performance. For example, we find that our method suppresses patterns incentivized by preference models that, without penalties, spread to most responses, and even to the model's reasoning, which the reward model does not explicitly score. Furthermore, we show that its gains hold in multi-turn training, and even after we retrain the reward model on the discovered behaviors.

AI.tldr: Dynalize 通过在线缓解奖励作弊，提高了长期训练效果和下游任务性能，特别是在开放性任务中，避免了偏好奖励模型中的奖励劫持问题。
AI.motivation: 偏好奖励模型易发生奖励劫持，导致回应质量下降；为了改善这一问题，作者引入了Dynalize，其可以在训练过程中识别并惩罚不良行为，从而在开放性任务中维持更长的训练时长和更好的下游表现。
AI.method: Dynalize 通过语言模型定期分析训练回放，并为奖励模型未能惩罚的不良行为写入惩罚措施。生成的惩罚措施会被法官应用到每个回放中以进行检测。
AI.result: 在临床咨询和创意写作等开放性任务中使用Dynalize，能避免奖励劫持带来的质量下降问题，并且能够持续较长时间的训练，最终提升下游任务的性能。此外，在多轮训练中同样表现出色，即使训练奖励模型时已知这些发现的行为也无法改变其长期效果。
AI.conclusion: Dynalize 在长时间训练中能有效缓解奖励劫持问题，提升模型在开放性任务中的表现。该方法特别适用于那些没有明确评分标准的长期优化场景，同时也展示了在多轮训练中的持续效果。

title: EvoSkill v2: Fully Agentic Skill Evolution from Benchmark Adaptation to a Stateful Evolver
summary: EvoSkill v2 is a three-agent system that edits the instructions (skills) an agent is given, leaving its model and harness intact. The user starts a run by describing a benchmark and supplying a grader, which a benchmark adaptor turns into a benchmark-specific plugin. A solver attempts the tasks, and an evolver reads the solver's training rollouts and rewrites the skills at each epoch.
