We implement the evolver as one stateful coding agent with a bash tool for the whole run, unlike the two most common designs among the skill optimizers we surveyed: a sequence of single model calls, as in SkillOpt, and an agent that starts afresh each round, as in SkillBoost. We also measure how much the solver's rollouts vary from one attempt to the next, give the evolver several attempts per training task, and accept every epoch's skills instead of selecting among them on noisy scores. With fine-grained ground truth, EvoSkill v2's skills raised the held-out pass rate above the stronger of SkillOpt and SkillBoost by 7.7 percentage points on SpreadsheetBench v2 and by 5.4 on $τ^3$-bench banking. In both benchmarks and both feedback settings, EvoSkill v2's evolver cost less per percentage point of held-out pass rate gained than either baseline's optimizer. EvoSkill v2 also enables a less capable model to improve its own skills, demonstrated by a gain of up to 21.5 percentage points in the $τ^3$-bench banking experiment where Claude Haiku 5.5 powers both solver and evolver.

AI.tldr: EvoSkill v2 是一个三代理系统，能够编辑指令（技能），而无需更改代理的模型和框架。它通过改进后的演化优化方式提高了代理在基准测试中的通过率。
AI.motivation: EvoSkill v2 的设计旨在改进技能优化的方法，通过减少试错成本并提高代理的表现，特别是在处理复杂任务时。
AI.method: EvoSkill v2 采用了一种新颖的方法，即使用一个状态化的编码代理来持续优化技能，而不是在每次训练时重新初始化或调用单个模型。
AI.result: EvoSkill v2 在 SpreadsheetBench v2 和 τ³-bench banking 这两个基准测试中的提交率分别提高了 7.7 个百分点和 5.4 个百分点，且每获取一个百分点的提升，相对于基线优化器的成本更低。
AI.conclusion: EvoSkill v2 的设计有效提高了代理解决任务的能力，且在资源效率方面优于现有的技能优化方法，尤其是在使用能力较弱的模型时也表现出色。

title: Only Means Only: what a harmonization benchmark score averages over
comment: 18 pages including references, 3 figures in the paper and 1 in the supplement. The supplement is included as an ancillary file and published with the preprint record, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23404530
summary: Image harmonization methods adjust the colour and lighting of an object pasted into a photograph so that it looks native to its new scene, and they are ranked by average error on one benchmark whose test images are real photographs with one object recoloured. One photograph can yield several such test images, and the benchmark promises that no photograph appears in both the training and the test split. We find that 1,399 photographs do, and the composites built on them are a quarter of the test set. Duplicate checks over file names or bytes miss this, because every composite is a different file. On that quarter the three methods we score end to end read two to five times lower error than on the rest, but most of the gap is composition rather than the sharing: the shared composites come almost entirely from one of the benchmark's four source collections, and inside that collection the gap falls to about one and a half times. An official score is therefore an average over two populations, mixed in a proportion the benchmark does not report. We release a test list of 5,581 composites whose construction identities do not appear in training, with four confirmed near-duplicate pairs disclosed rather than removed, adoptable without retraining at the price of one rescore per checkpoint. We leave open whether the sharing itself changes what a model learns.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，基准测试中用于评估图像谐调方法的测试集中有1,399张照片重复使用，占测试集的四分之一。这导致在这些重复照片上评估的方法表现出比其他照片更低的误差，尽管大部分差距来自于合成分，并非数据共享本身。研究者提供了新的测试集，以解决这一问题。
AI.motivation: 为了评估图像谐调方法的有效性，需要基准测试中使用的测试集没有重复且独立于训练集。然而，研究发现基准测试中存在重复照片的问题，影响了评估结果的准确性。
AI.method: 通过严格审查基准测试集中的照片文件名和二进制数据，检查是否存在重复照片。对于存在的重复照片，重新构建一个新的测试集，确保没有重复的照片。
AI.result: 研究发现，基准测试中用于评估图像谐调方法的测试集中有1,399张照片重复使用，占测试集的四分之一。重新构建的新测试集解决了重复照片导致的问题，确保了评估方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 虽然共享数据本身可能不会改变模型学习的内容，但为了确保评估的准确性，需要避免数据集中的重复照片。研究者向社区提供了新的测试集以供使用，并建议未来研究应注意这一问题。

title: ReAnchor: Reusing Rejected Verifier States for Diffusion Drafting
summary: Block diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by generating multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. However, each pass produces only a fixed-length block from a single target-generated anchor, limiting how far the draft can extend. Meanwhile, target verification computes hidden states even at positions beyond the first rejection, but these states are typically discarded rather than reused. We propose ReAnchor, a training-free method that reanchors a pretrained drafter at shifted positions using discarded verifier states to generate parallel draft blocks. These blocks improve predictions within the original block and extend coverage beyond its endpoint. At sampling temperature of T=0, ReAnchor achieves its largest average gains on Gemma 4-12B, improving acceptance length by 19.4% and decoding speed by 17.9% across eight benchmarks. Averaged equally over four target models and eight benchmarks, it improves acceptance length by 15.2% and decoding speed by 13.4% with pretrained DFlash drafters.

AI.tldr: ReAnchor 提出了一种无需训练的方法，通过利用验证器丢弃的状态在预训练的草案生成器上进行重新锚定，生成并行草案块。这种技术在模型接受长度和解码速度方面表现出显著的改进。
AI.motivation: 当前的草案生成器和目标验证机制存在限制，如固定长度和仅在初始拒绝位置计算隐藏状态。ReAnchor 的提出旨在增强草案生成的覆盖范围并改进生成质量。
AI.method: ReAnchor 方法无需重新训练模型，直接利用验证器丢弃的状态进行重新锚定，生成多个平行的草案块，从而改善原始草案块内的预测和扩展覆盖范围。
AI.result: 在 T=0 的采样温度下，ReAnchor 通过提高接受长度和解码速度，在 Gems 4-12B 模型上取得了显著的效果。在四种目标模型和八种基准测试中，它能够提高 15.2% 的接受长度和 13.4% 的解码速度，使用预训练的 DFlash 草案生成器时效果更为显著。
AI.conclusion: ReAnchor 通过简单的机制大幅改进了草案生成质量和解码效率，在各种模型和基准测试中均表现出色。

title: Global probabilistic forecasting of air pollution
summary: Fine particulate matter (PM2.5) refers to particulate matter with an aerodynamic diameter of 2.5 micrometre or less. It comes from human activities, such as traffic and industry, and from wildfires, desert dust and gases emitted by vegetation. Short-term exposure to it accounts for about a million deaths a year. Operational forecasts run on grids tens of kilometres wide, which hide the pollution breathed by nearly two hundred million people a day. Machine learning has transformed weather forecasting, but data-driven forecasts of air pollution still blur extremes and lose skill as the air travels. Here we introduce Foehn, a generative model that learns from global kilometre-scale estimates of PM2.5 and computes where the air comes from. Over a year of retrospective forecasts, it outperforms the operational forecast at three stations in four and forecasts at the scale of this hidden exposure. Its ensembles are calibrated, and their mean detects local pollution extremes four days ahead as well as the operational forecast does one day ahead. Such forecasts could warn the millions whom coarse maps miss, once kilometre-scale data are available in real time.

AI.tldr: Foehn 是一种生成模型，通过学习全球范围内的 PM2.5 千米级估计，并计算空气的来源，实现了对隐藏暴露区域的预报，优于现有的运营预报，能够提前四天检测到局部污染极端情况。
AI.motivation: 针对现有预报模型因粗略网格和数据缺失导致的局限性，提出 Foehn 旨在提供更精细化且准确的空气污染预测，以提醒更多受到污染影响的人们。
AI.method: Foehn 使用机器学习技术，基于全球千米级 PM2.5 估计数据，精确追踪空气的来源路径，并生成预测结果。
AI.result: Foehn 在过去一年的回测中，在三个站点的预报中表现优于现有运营预报，且其集合预测能够提前四天检测本地污染极端情况，与现有预报一天提前检测的情况相媲美。
AI.conclusion: Foehn 模型为提高空气污染预报的精度和提前时间提供了可能，但需等待实时的千米级数据支持。

title: ATLAS: Attention-Guided Test-Time Latent Selection for Compositional Visual Autoregressive Generation
summary: Visual autoregressive models produce convincing images but can misassign attributes and spatial relations. Searching multiple generation paths can improve composition, yet completing every candidate is costly. We introduce ATLAS, a training-free framework that uses the frozen generator's internal attention to guide search before final images are available. Within-prompt diagnostics identify attention-derived scores that predict final compositional preferences on Infinity, with category-dependent transfer to Switti. ATLAS uses these on-the-fly signals to progressively concentrate computation on promising trajectories. It maintains multiple coarse alternatives, prunes candidates without decoding at intermediate scales, and reserves image-space evaluation for a final choice among partial trajectories. ATLAS scales effectively on both backbones, achieving higher mean scores on the evaluated T2I-CompBench and GenEval categories as more computation is devoted to search. At the largest tested budget, the targeted T2I-CompBench mean improves by over 10% relative to each backbone. Separate profiles show over 50% less generation time than completing and evaluating all candidates at equal initial counts, alongside lower peak allocated GPU memory. Relative time savings are larger at the higher tested candidate count. Together, these results support scalable compositional search: additional sampling expands exploration, while attention-guided selection limits continuation cost without parameter updates or gradient-based optimization.

AI.tldr: ATLAS 是一种无需训练的框架，它利用冻结生成器内部的注意力机制在最终图像生成前引导搜索，通过诊断注意力分数预测最终的构图偏好，适用于不同模型并节省计算资源。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉自回归模型虽能生成逼真图像，但有时会错误分配属性或空间关系。通过探索多个生成路径可以改善图像的整体构图，但每个候选路径的生成成本颇高。ATLAS 的引入旨在加速这一过程，同时保持高质量生成。
AI.method: ATLAS 通过使用冻结生成器的内部注意力机制来辅助图像生成前的搜索过程。该方法在不影响最终质量的前提下，利用注意力分数实时指导搜索方向，避免不必要的计算，从而提高了整体的生成效率。
AI.result: 实验表明，ATLAS 相较于原有模型在多个评测基准（T2I-CompBench 和 GenEval）上获得了更高的平均得分，尤其是在较大的计算预算下，T2I-CompBench 的相对改善超过了 10%。同时，ATLAS 也显著减少了生成时间和 GPU 内存使用量。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS 提供了一种无训练需求的图像生成优化方法，通过即时指导搜索路径，有效地减少了计算成本和时间，证明了通过合理分配计算资源实现有效搜索的可能性。

title: BERT Is Already a Denoiser: Cheaply Unlocking Iterative Generation in Masked Language Models
summary: Masked language models (MLMs) such as BERT are typically used for representation learning despite their denoising pretraining. We test whether this capability supports conditional generation without diffusion training. Our decoder repeatedly predicts masked tokens and commits high-confidence predictions using a cosine schedule. It requires no diffusion timestep or reverse-diffusion objective. Frozen BERT already exhibits substantial denoising capability, reconstructing 61.0%, 37.5%, and 24.4% of masked tokens at 15%, 45%, and 60% corruption, respectively, although generation deteriorates sharply as visible context disappears. This capability alone does not yield task-directed generation: frozen BERT reaches only 11.0% on ARC-Easy and 4.2% on MMLU. Ordinary MLM adaptation, however, rapidly converts the same architecture into a usable generator. Full adaptation reaches 28.2% and 24.6%, respectively, while parameter-efficient adaptation substantially reduces unmatched outputs. On open-ended conditional generation, full MLM adaptation reaches BLEU/ROUGE-L of 0.163/0.583 on QQP and 0.107/0.327 on Quasar-T, placing it in the same broad performance range as published BERT models trained through diffusion without explicit diffusion training. Finally, applying the same generative interface to stronger masked representations substantially improves performance: RoBERTa-large reaches 44.2% on ARC-Easy and 33.8% on MMLU. These results separate three components of masked iterative generation: pretraining supplies the representation and denoising operator, task adaptation determines what the model generates, and an iterative commitment rule supplies the decoding process. Explicit diffusion training is therefore not necessary to obtain effective iterative conditional generation from pretrained MLMs in the settings studied here.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了掩码语言模型（如BERT）在无需逆向扩散训练的情况下进行条件生成的能力。通过冻结模型和任务适应，模型展示了从掩码中重建可见上下文的能力，但性能仅限制于基本水平。更强的掩码表示则显著提升生成性能。
AI.motivation: 研究探讨了掩码语言模型在生成任务中的潜力，以及哪些因素对生成质量起决定作用。
AI.method: 研究首先利用冻结掩码语言模型（如BERT），然后对模型进行任务适应，测试其生成能力；同时，将相同生成界面应用于更强的掩码表示，观察性能变化。
AI.result: 研究发现，冻结的掩码语言模型只能生成较少的掩码填充部分，任务适应提高了生成性能，而使用更强的掩码表示能显著提升模型在开放条件生成上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论表明，仅通过预训练和任务调整即可实现有效的迭代条件生成，而无需显式的逆向扩散训练。

title: Claim Laundering: When Agent Decision Models Trust Records Over Reality
summary: Agent decision models select actions in a single forward pass from inputs that combine environmental observations with the agent's own record of previous actions. When an action fails silently, these sources can conflict: the record reports success, but the environment shows that the step did not take effect. We ask which source determines the next decision. Across Android screen traces, ALFWorld, and WebShop, we construct paired states that independently vary the observation, the logged action, and an explicit success claim. In all 12 configurations of four decision models and three domains, records have a larger average effect on commitment decisions than observations; after claimed-but-failed steps, the models still stop, advance, or purchase in 53-100% of cases. Yet the relevant evidence is often represented internally: linear probes on intermediate hidden states distinguish successful from failed steps on held-out apps, tasks, and goals (AUROC 0.77-1.00), and activation patching reveals increasing influence from records in later layers. We use this signal in EVIGATE, an intermediate-layer veto that requires no additional forward pass and adds 0.04-2.0% serving latency. Under injected silent failures, EVIGATE improves task success by 18.7 points in live ALFWorld agents, 5.0 in WebShop, and 5.1 in a phone simulator, and in WebShop and the simulator it also outperforms random vetoes at the same rate. Its effectiveness depends on representative calibration states: gates calibrated on offline counterfactual states do not transfer reliably to live agent trajectories.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在Android屏幕轨迹、ALFWorld和WebShop等环境中构建状态配对，发现动作记录比观察值更影响决策，并通过中间层 veto (EVIGATE) 实现了任务成功率的提升，尤其是在处理未检测到的失败动作时。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能体决策模型在面对环境观察与行动记录之间的不一致性时，往往依赖于行动记录，这可能导致决策错误。为此，研究者构建了一种基于中间层的干预机制EVIGATE，以提高决策准确性。
AI.method: 研究者设计并实现了一种EVIGATE干预机制，该机制在中间层对行动记录进行审查，以判断这些记录是否代表了真实的环境状态。研究中涵盖了四个不同类型的决策模型，以及三个不同的应用场景。通过构造状态配对进行分析，并应用线性和激活图探针来区分成功的和失败的步骤。
AI.result: 在不同的场景测试中，EVIGATE机制显示出显著的性能提升。例如，在ALFWorld、WebShop和基于手机模拟器测试中，其任务成功率分别提高了18.7点、5.0点和5.1点，且在WebShop和模拟器环境下，EVIGATE优于随机干预。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，行动记录在智能体决策中扮演着关键角色，而EVIGATE机制为提高决策模型的稳定性提供了一种有效方法。同时，研究也表明，干预机制的效果依赖于代表性较强的校准状态，这些状态应从离线的假设场景中获得，以确保在实际运行中的可靠性。

title: A 3D-Driven Framework for Moving-Camera Perspective-to-360° Video Generation
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Project page: https://pano3d-video.github.io/
summary: Turning a moving-camera perspective video into a 360° video requires more than just generating content outside the input frame: observations revealed over time must be preserved, unseen regions completed, and the resulting scene kept consistent as the camera viewpoint changes. Existing methods assign these different requirements to a single conditional video model, requiring them to be jointly learned from panoramic video data. We instead present a modular, 3D-driven framework that distributes these three responsibilities across specialized components, all connected through a shared scene representation. Input observations are reconstructed explicitly in 3D, while a pretrained panoramic image model completes unobserved content from a selected panoramic render. This generated content is lifted into the shared 3D scene, where it remains spatially anchored across camera viewpoints. Without requiring any additional panoramic-video training, our framework achieves state-of-the-art input-view fidelity, perceptual quality, and geometric consistency on a static-scene subset of the Argus evaluation set. These results support our decomposed, 3D-driven formulation as a promising alternative to direct video generation in this setting.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种模块化且基于3D的框架，将移动摄像机视角的视频转换为360°视频，该框架将三个主要任务分配给专门组件，并通过共享场景表示相连接。实验结果表明，该方法在场景一致性、感知质量和输入视角保真度方面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过单个条件视频模型联合学习这三种需求，但带来了训练难度和模型复杂性。本研究旨在通过模块化框架来简化问题，使得不同任务由相应的组件负责，从而提高整体性能。
AI.method: 提出了一种模块化且基于3D的方法，将构建场景的三个主要任务分离：三维重建输入观察；使用预训练的全景图像模型填充无法观察到的内容；将生成的内容整合到共享的3D场景中，保持空间一致性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在Argus评估集的静止场景部分，在场景一致性、感知质量和输入视角保真度方面达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建议了一种新的方法，为解决移动摄像机视角转为360°视频的问题提供了有效的分解和3D导向的解决方案。

title: Conducting Reliable Keyword Estimation with Unreliable ASR in Police Audio Data
summary: Extracting insights from large audio data sets using human transcription is expensive and time-consuming. Off-the-shelf Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems offer an easy-to-use scalable alternative, but systematic transcription errors, especially in domain-specific settings, can bias downstream analyses and lead to unreliable conclusions. We investigate whether imperfect ASR transcripts can still be used to obtain statistically valid keyword frequency estimates by combining model outputs with a small set of human-labeled examples, following Prediction Powered Inference and Design-based Supervised Learning frameworks. We evaluate this approach on police radio communications from Baltimore and Chicago, a domain in which keyword distributions could provide valuable insights into police activity, but off-the-shelf ASR systems exhibit systematic errors on operationally important terminology. Using bootstrap-based confidence interval coverage as our evaluation metric, we find that our approach substantially increases the number of domain-specific keywords that can be analyzed with statistically valid confidence intervals, from 43.0% using ASR alone and 27.2% using only a small set of human-labeled transcriptions to 56.2% in the Baltimore dataset, with similar improvements observed in Chicago data. Our results demonstrate that post-hoc error correction can improve statistical validity of downstream analyses even for poor-quality transcriptions, offering an avenue for better leveraging off-the-shelf ASR models for large-scale speech analysis.

AI.tldr: 通过结合ASR模型输出和少量的人工标注示例，该研究证明了即使在ASR系统存在系统性错误的情况下，仍可以提高基于关键词的统计分析的准确性。
AI.motivation: 解决利用自动语音识别（ASR）系统进行大规模语音数据分析时，由于系统性错误导致的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 结合预测驱动的推理和基于设计的监督学习框架，使用少量人类标注转录与ASR模型输出相结合的方法。
AI.result: 在波士顿和芝加哥的警用无线电通信数据集中，通过该方法能够用统计上有效的置信区间分析的领域特定关键词比例从ASR单独分析的43.0%或仅靠少量人工标注的27.2%提高到56.2%。
AI.conclusion: 后验错误校正可以在即便使用质量较差的转录数据下，提高下游分析的统计有效性，提供了一个更好地利用现成的ASR模型进行大规模语音分析的新途径。

title: OrderGPT: Generation Order as a Learnable Modeling Choice
summary: Generative modeling of discrete data has two popular paradigms: autoregressive models such as GPT, which factorize a sequence in a left-to-right (L2R) order, and masked diffusion models, which are essentially any-order autoregressive modeling. Rather than competing methods, these are the two extreme points of a single axis -- the generation order. For structured discrete domains without a natural traversal, both extremes may be suboptimal, yet the intermediate choice -- a single well-adapted order -- remains largely unexplored. We introduce OrderGPT, which builds on Any-Order GPT to learn a task-level generation order without canonical-order supervision. Our key observation is that predicting variables from randomly sampled reveal prefixes produces recurring attention patterns in the backbone that provide a model-dependent signal of predictive dependencies. We aggregate this signal into a reciprocal dependency graph and use a spectral teacher to derive continuous generation priorities. A lightweight OrderMLP integrated into the GPT backbone learns to predict these priorities from attention, incorporating order learning into the architecture within a single training run. Training gradually shifts toward the learned order, which is then frozen for subsequent autoregressive training and generation. The same mechanism adapts across modalities: adaptively it recovers near-L2R dependency structure in language, learns anatomically organized factorizations on human pose, and discovers a factorization on tabular data that places statistically and semantically related fields nearby, while improving downstream modeling metrics across all domains. The code is available at https://github.com/Chenhe-yang/OrderGPT/.

AI.tldr: OrderGPT 引入了一种基于 Any-Order GPT 的自适应生成顺序方法，能够在无自然顺序的结构化离散域中学习任务级别的生成顺序，无需监督。
AI.motivation: 传统生成模型在无自然顺序的结构化离散域中效果不佳，OrderGPT 旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: OrderGPT 含有自适应学习生成顺序的轻量级层 OrderMLP，并利用谱教师从注意力模式中提取预测依赖关系，形成依赖图以确定生成优先级。
AI.result: 实验表明，OrderGPT 在语言、人体姿态和表格数据上的依赖结构学习更为优化，提升下游建模效果。
AI.conclusion: OrderGPT 通过自适应生成顺序改进了无自然顺序结构化离散域的生成模型性能。

title: PolarVis: A Dataset and Diffusion Framework for RGB-to-Polarization Perception in Adverse Driving Scenes
summary: Reflections, glare, transparent structures, and material-dependent appearance variations can introduce ambiguity into RGB-based visual perception in vehicle-relevant environments. Polarization provides complementary reflection- and material-sensitive information, but its acquisition requires dedicated sensing hardware. This paper presents RGB-P Wild, a real-world dataset containing 10,000 paired RGB and four-angle linear-polarization image sets, together with PolarVis, a diffusion-based framework for recovering polarization representations from a single RGB image. PolarVis combines hierarchical RGB feature extraction, diffusion-based feature refinement, four angle-specific decoders, and multi-scale attention recalibration to reconstruct polarization intensity images at $0^\circ$, $45^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $135^\circ$. On RGB-P Wild, PolarVis achieves a normalized-domain MSE of 0.0465, a PSNR of 27.83 dB, and an SSIM of 0.8597. Compared with the released PolarAnything model under the adopted evaluation protocol, PolarVis obtains an AoLP error of $25.66^\circ$ and a DoLP MAE of 0.0404, compared with $46.03^\circ$ and 0.1084, respectively. Cross-dataset evaluation on vehicle-mounted imagery further examines transfer beyond the training domain. In downstream evaluation, a frozen PCDNet achieves AP50/AP50:95 of 86.3%/59.1% on 990 RGBP-Car test images using PolarVis-generated polarization, compared with 87.0%/59.8% using measured polarization. These results indicate that RGB-derived polarization retains useful polarimetric information for the evaluated perception tasks, while remaining distinct from calibrated physical polarization measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了RGB-P Wild 数据集和PolarVis框架，该框架能够从单个RGB图像中恢复 polarization 代表，实验结果表明其在多个评价指标上优于已有模型，同时在下游任务中仍能提供有用的信息。
AI.motivation: 由于 RGB 视觉感知在涉及车辆的环境中会受到反射、眩光、透明结构和材料相关性变化的影响，引入了 RGB-P Wild 数据集以及 PolarVis 框架来解决这一问题。该框架通过结合层次RGB特征提取、基于扩散的特征精炼、四个特定角度的解码器和多尺度注意力重新校准，可重建四个角度的偏振强度图像。
AI.method: 该研究构建了RGB-P Wild 数据集，其中包含10,000对RGB和四角度线性偏振图像，并开发了PolarVis框架。该框架利用单个RGB图像恢复偏振表示，通过多阶段处理（包括特征提取、特征精炼、特定角度解码以及跨尺度注意机制校准），生成四角度偏振强度图像。
AI.result: PolarVis 在RGB-P Wild 数据集上的实验结果表明，其在归一化领域的MSE为0.0465、PSNR为27.83 dB、SSIM为0.8597。与释放的PolarAnything模型相比，PolarVis 的角度偏振误差（AoLP）为25.66°，对比差异度偏振误差（DoLP）MAE为0.0404，分别优于46.03°和0.1084。在车辆安装图像的跨数据集评估中，PolarVis 的泛化能力得到了进一步验证。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，从RGB图像推导出的偏振特性保留了评估任务中的有用参数，同时与校准的物理偏振测量结果保持区别。PolarVis 框架为偏振成像提供了一种新的方法，并且在不同评价任务中展现了其优越性。

title: The Development of Sycophancy in Language Models: Tracing Vulnerabilities from Pretraining to Post-Training
summary: Language models can change a committed answer to accommodate a user's opinion or pushback without new evidence. However, when this behaviour develops during training and what a released model inherits from earlier stages remain unclear. We follow 741 checkpoints of 30 open model lineages, from early pretraining to released models. We plant initial verdicts on moral scenarios and measure how far a model follows a user's stated opinion or abandons its verdict under pressure. In most lineages the behaviour is present before post-training, and its average strength changes in either direction, at different stages across lineages. A clearer pattern emerges at the level of individual questions. Beyond responses without pressure, pretraining behaviour predicts little of which questions a released model yields on. That pattern forms during post-training: on routes with supervised fine-tuning, the fine-tuning checkpoint predicts part of it and the preference-optimization checkpoint most of it. A sibling trained from the same base along another route predicts far less: for Tülu-3 8B, its own preference-stage checkpoint removes 85% of the remaining prediction error, a sibling 19%. Internal states add predictive information without changing this ranking. Similar average scores conceal different vulnerabilities, and training history matters for auditing a released model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型在训练过程中如何调整其初始观点以适应用户意见，发现这种行为在训练的早期阶段已存在，并且其强度会随训练阶段变化。进一步分析表明，预训练阶段的行为对最终模型的选择性问题没有预测能力，而训练后期的监督微调和偏好优化阶段则能较好预测模型的行为。
AI.motivation: 研究指出现有语言模型在训练过程中存在一种调整初始观点以满足用户需求的能力，这种能力在模型发布的阶段已经存在，但其具体变化和预测机制尚不清楚。因此，本文旨在更详细地了解这种行为的发展过程及其与模型训练阶段的关系。
AI.method: 本文通过跟踪30个公开模型系列的741个训练阶段，植入初始道德案例，测量模型在面对用户压力时更改其观点的程度。通过对不同问题和模型训练阶段的对比分析，揭示了这种行为的发展模式。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，这种适应用户意见的行为在训练早期阶段就已经存在，且能够在不同的训练过程中产生变化。这种行为的预测能力在训练的后期阶段有所增强，特别是在使用监督微调和偏好优化等方面的训练策略时。研究表明，同一基线训练的不同模型之间的预测能力存在明显区别。
AI.conclusion: 本研究强调了在审计发布的语言模型时，需要考虑其完整的训练历史，而不是仅仅依赖于其初始行为或单一训练阶段的数据。

title: CXBench: A Benchmark for Process-Compliant LLM Agents in Regulated Customer-Experience Workflows
summary:
Tool-using language agents increasingly perform regulated customer-service workflows, where a correct final state is insufficient: agents must also provide disclosures, obtain consent, and follow required procedures. Existing tool-agent benchmarks largely score final business states, accepting trajectories that reach correct outcomes through non-compliant processes.
  We introduce cxbench, a benchmark that evaluates outcome and process compliance separately across six regulated domains. Each task combines a customer request, a tool-based environment, and explicit process requirements. Rule cards link cited regulatory obligations to observable trace evidence. A hybrid grader combines deterministic checks for ordering and authority with an LLM judge for semantic requirements. We define a false-pass as an outcome-pass run that fails process checks.
  Across seven models and 120 tasks, 55.5% of the 840 retained executions are false-passes, representing 80.1% of outcome-passing runs; only 13.8% pass both checks. Process-inclusive evaluation changes the observed model ordering and exposes differences hidden by outcome-only scoring. cxbench makes these failures inspectable through trace-linked criteria.

AI.tldr: cxbench 是一种评估工具，在六个监管领域中分别评估结果和过程合规性。它通过混合评分器结合确定性检查和语言模型判断来确保合规性，其中55.5%的运行结果为假通过。
AI.motivation: 现有的工具-代理基准主要关注最终的业务状态，而不是过程的合规性。新的cxbench基准旨在解决这一问题，通过分别评估结果和过程合规性来提供更全面的评估。
AI.method: cxbench通过混合评分器结合确定性检查和语言模型判断来评估结果和过程的合规性。它定义了假通过的概念，即结果通过但过程检查失败的运行。
AI.result: 在七个模型和120个任务上，cxbench发现55.5%的运行结果为假通过，80.1%的结果通过运行在过程检查中失败；只有13.8%的运行通过了两种检查。
AI.conclusion: cxbench改变了观察到的模型排序，并揭示了仅通过结果评分所隐藏的差异，它通过链接的踪迹证据使这些失败变得可见。

title: RAHF-Net: Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion for LiDAR-Assisted RGB Semantic Segmentation
summary: This paper studies LiDAR-assisted RGB semantic segmentation, where LiDAR point-cloud features improve dense pixel-wise predictions in the RGB image plane rather than 3D point labels or detections. Existing 2D fusion methods often project point clouds into shallow depth/range maps and apply spatially uniform fusion, discarding rich 3D structure and ignoring the range-dependent reliability of outdoor LiDAR. We propose RAHF-Net, a Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion Network. Its Cylindrical-to-Perspective (C2P) module projects pretrained cylindrical voxel features into the image plane, preserving structured 3D semantic priors. A Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion (RAHF) module then uses a soft depth-derived range mask to perform LiDAR-guided geometric enhancement in reliable near-field regions and visual-context enhancement in sparse far-field regions. On KITTI-360, RAHF-Net achieves 65.76 mIoU, outperforming representative RGB-only and RGB-LiDAR baselines, including CMX by 1.45 points. Experiments on DELIVER further demonstrate improved robustness under adverse weather, illumination degradation, and sensor corruption.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion Network (RAHF-Net)，用于LiDAR辅助的RGB语义分割，能够在二维RGB图像中利用LiDAR点云特征进行精细化的像素级预测，而不依赖于3D点标签或检测。这种网络在KITTI-360数据集上的表现优于现有baseline，尤其是在恶劣天气和传感器故障等情况下表现更好。
AI.motivation: 现有2D融合方法将点云投影到浅景深/距离图，并进行空间均匀融合，忽略了丰富的3D结构信息和室外LiDAR的范围相关可靠性，因此提出RAHF-Net来改进融合策略。
AI.method: RAHF-Net包含Cylindrical-to-Perspective (C2P) 模块与Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion (RAHF) 模块。C2P模块将预训练的圆柱体体素特征投射到图像平面，保留了结构化的3D语义先验；RAHF模块通过基于深度的范围掩码，在可靠近场区域进行LiDAR导向的几何增强，并在稀疏远场区域进行视觉上下文增强。
AI.result: 在KITTI-360数据集上，RAHF-Net实现了65.76的mIoU，并且在DELIVER数据集的实验中，展示了在恶劣天气、光照退化和传感器故障等条件下的更强鲁棒性，优于现有的RGB-only和RGB-LiDAR baseline，尤其是比CMX高出了1.45分。
AI.conclusion: RAHF-Net通过融合LiDAR和RGB数据，提出了新的融合方法，为未来的三维场景理解提供了新的思路和技术支持。

title: Hierarchical Token Merging with Recursive Autoencoders for Unsupervised Grammar Induction
summary: Hierarchical abstraction is a fundamental principle across many data modalities, enabling complex sequences to be represented compositionally at multiple levels. Learning such hierarchies directly from data, without explicit structural supervision, remains a central challenge in representation learning. We investigate whether meaningful hierarchical structure can emerge from compression alone. While autoencoders learn compressed representations through reconstruction, this objective does not necessarily favour meaningful compositional structure. We study this challenge through unsupervised grammar induction, where the underlying hierarchy can be evaluated explicitly. We introduce a hierarchical token-merging autoencoder that recursively combines adjacent tokens into increasingly abstract representations, compressing entire sequences through a variational information bottleneck. The model jointly learns representations and hierarchical structure by marginalising over possible binary trees using dynamic programming. To address training instability, we combine independently trained models through unsupervised consensus and distillation. Experiments on a synthetic, ambiguous grammar demonstrate the emergence of meaningful hierarchical structure without structural supervision. The resulting model achieves 93% grammatical parse-validity and 93% exact reconstruction on held-out sequences, compared with 42% parse-validity for the strongest trivial baseline. These findings establish a proof of concept for hierarchical token merging as a mechanism for unsupervised structure discovery and abstraction learning.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，通过压缩可以直接产生有意义的层次结构，而无需明确的结构监督。引入了一种层次化标记合并自编码器，该模型通过变分信息瓶颈压缩序列，并通过动态规划对可能的二叉树进行联合学习，从而同时学习表示和层次结构。
AI.motivation: 当前挑战在于如何直接从数据中学到层次结构，而无需明确的结构监督。探索自编码器在无需明确监督的情况下是否可以学习具有意义的层次结构。
AI.method: 提出了一种层次化标记合并自编码器，该模型通过变分信息瓶颈压缩序列，并通过动态规划对可能的二叉树进行联合学习。
AI.result: 在合成的模糊语法上，该模型证明了在没有结构监督的情况下可以自动生成有意义的层次结构。实验结果显示，与最强的简单基线相比，该模型在保留有效性和精确重建方面表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为无监督结构发现和抽象学习提供了一个概念证明，证明了层次化标记合并作为机制的有效性。

title: Productive State-Space Exploration for Multi-turn RL in LLM Agents
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Large Language Model (LLM) agents in multi-turn, long-horizon environments remains challenging due to inefficient action selection and repetitive behavioral patterns. In particular, agents often become trapped in high-confidence yet unproductive behaviors, repeatedly executing invalid actions or entering action loops that hinder task completion. We observe that these frequently violate environment preconditions, revealing a mismatch between the agent's representation of the internal state and the dynamics of the underlying environment. In addition, repetitive high-confidence actions lead to cyclical behaviors that provide little to no progress towards the goal. We argue that addressing these challenges requires more productive task-aligned exploration to improve the agent's understanding of environment dynamics. Motivated by intrinsic curiosity-driven exploration, we propose a conditional state-space exploration framework that balances task completion with intrinsic information-seeking behavior. Specifically, we introduce an intrinsic reward that penalizes actions whose observation duplicates prior state memory. This provides the benefit of reducing redundant behaviors and encouraging state-space coverage without relying on a general information-theoretic measure. Strong experimental results demonstrate that our approach substantially improves policy learning in multi-turn environments, mitigating invalid actions and repetitive loops.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的探索框架，通过减少重复行为和促进状态空间覆盖来改进大语言模型代理在多轮、长期环境中的学习策略。
AI.motivation: 为了提高大语言模型代理在多轮、长期环境中的性能，解决因高置信度无效行为导致的陷阱，通过激励好奇心驱动的探索，平衡任务完成和内在信息寻求行为。
AI.method: 提出了一个条件状态空间探索框架，引入了一个惩罚重复观察的内在奖励，不依赖通用的信息论度量。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在多轮环境中显著提高了策略学习，减少了无效操作和重复循环。
AI.conclusion: 研究通过好奇心驱动探索有效提升了大语言模型代理在多轮环境中的任务完成能力，为未来研究提供了新的视角。

title: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
summary: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, enabling more effective interactive visual content creation for users. However, existing methods often exhibit noticeable drift after only a few editing turns, manifesting in two aspects: 1) unstable visual quality, with accumulating artifacts and degraded details; and 2) inconsistent image content, with unintended changes to preserved regions and prior edits. To address these challenges, we propose MT Forcing, a novel training paradigm for multi-turn image editing with unified multimodal models (UMMs) based on autoregressive diffusion. Specifically, we propose Single-Turn Distribution Matching Distillation (Single-Turn DMD), which supervises student self-rollouts with a teacher that applies cumulative edits to the source image in a single turn, providing visual-quality guidance without recursive error accumulation. Additionally, we introduce Teacher-Forcing Guidance, which supervises history-dependent transitions on reference trajectories during warmup and as a regularizer during distillation, encouraging cross-turn content consistency beyond what per-turn distribution matching alone can ensure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the multi-turn image editing capabilities of UMMs, yielding more stable visual quality and stronger cross-turn consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的多轮图像编辑训练范式MT Forcing，通过单一轮次分布匹配蒸馏（Single-Turn DMD）和教师力指导（Teacher-Forcing Guidance）来提高多轮图像编辑的稳定性和跨轮次的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在多轮图像编辑过程中容易出现视觉质量不稳定和内容不一致的问题。为了应对这些问题，提出了MT Forcing以提升多轮图像编辑的效果。
AI.method: 通过单一轮次分布匹配蒸馏（Single-Turn DMD）和教师力指导（Teacher-Forcing Guidance），利用自回归扩散（autoregressive diffusion）和统一多模态模型（UMMs）进行训练。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，MT Forcing显著提高了UMMs的多轮图像编辑能力，增强了视觉质量的稳定性以及跨轮次的一致性。
AI.conclusion: MT Forcing为多轮图像编辑提供了一种有效的训练方法，通过单一轮次分布匹配蒸馏和教师力指导，可以更好地保持编辑过程中的视觉质量和内容一致性。

title: HoloCosm: Beyond Single-Metric Benchmark Compression Across Multiple Metrics
summary: Benchmark compression reduces evaluation cost by selecting a small set of samples. Existing methods typically guide selection using a single metric, although benchmarks often assess models along multiple dimensions. We find that model rankings are often weakly correlated across metrics, indicating that different metrics capture distinct aspects of model performance. Samples selected for one metric do not reliably preserve scores and rankings on others when used for compressed evaluation. At 80\% compression, each of the five single-metric baselines yields higher reconstruction error than equal-size random sampling in over 70\% of cross-metric comparisons. To address this challenge, we present HoloCosm, which jointly minimizes normalized score-reconstruction error across source models and metrics while constraining ranking distortion. We evaluate HoloCosm across multiple compression rates on 15 language, multimodal, VLA, and agent benchmark configurations with 85 component metrics. With 80\% compression, HoloCosm outperforms Random, the strongest baseline overall: average NMAE drops by 35.3\% to 0.236, worst-component NMAE drops by 39.5\% to 0.330, and average Spearman correlation rises from 0.884 to 0.915. In addition, HoloCosm remains competitive with existing baselines in single-metric evaluation. We will release our code and experimental results.

AI.tldr: HoloCosm通过联合最小化按比例的分数重建误差并约束排名失真，在压缩评估中表现出色，尤其是在跨多个指标的情况下。它在80%的压缩率下，显著优于其他基准方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准压缩方法通常依据单一性能指标来选择样本，但在多维的模型评估指标下，模型排名在不同指标间高度相关性不足，导致用一个指标选择的样本在其他指标下的排名和分数恢复表现不佳。为解决这一问题，作者开发了HoloCosm.
AI.method: HoloCosm的方法是联合优化跨来源模型和指标的标准化分数重建误差，并限制排名的扭曲。该方法在多个压缩率下，对语义、多模态、VLA和代理基准配置中的85个组件指标进行评估。
AI.result: 在80%的压缩率下，HoloCosm与随机抽样的基线方法相比，平均NMAE降低了35.3%至0.236，最差组件的NMAE降低了39.5%至0.330，平均斯皮尔曼相关系数提高了0.884至0.915。同时，HoloCosm在单一指标评估中保持了与现有基线方法的竞争力。
AI.conclusion: HoloCosm解决了单一指标选择样本后的多重指标下排名和分数恢复效果差的问题，证明了其在压缩评估中优化多维度模型性能的有效性。

title: EmbodiedWorld-200K: Toward Embodied World Agents via Embodied-Planning Dataset and Interactive World Models
summary: Building embodied agents that can perceive, reason, and act across diverse 3D worlds is a central research direction toward artificial general intelligence. Yet most existing work remains confined to specific tasks in a single scene and transfers poorly to new environments, leaving general embodied agents for open-world settings under-explored. We refer to such agents as Embodied World Agents (EWAs), whose defining property is the ability to understand diverse visual environments and execute general actions in open-world conditions. To advance EWA research, we study open-world embodied navigation-planning and release EmbodiedWorld-200K, a large-scale dataset of over 200K samples spanning diverse scenes. Each example is equipped with multi-level annotations, ranging from low-level camera-motion trajectories to high-level semantic instructions. The dataset also provides unified evaluation splits and task-specific metrics, supporting offline pretraining and fair evaluation of EWAs. Beyond offline supervision, a defining characteristic of an EWA is its interaction with the environment; training solely on offline data is therefore insufficient, especially for generalizing to scenes not covered in the training distribution. Building dedicated real interactive environments, however, is often prohibitively expensive. To address this, we propose a novel training scheme that employs a video world model as a low-cost environment proxy and performs interactive reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training of the EWA within it. Empirically, pretraining on EmbodiedWorld-200K substantially improves the open-world embodied planning ability of the EWA, and further RL post-training inside a world model yields clear gains on out-of-distribution scenes. The dataset, baseline checkpoints, and training and evaluation code are available at https://xiaokunfeng.github.io/EmbodiedWorld-200K/.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一种能理解多样视觉环境并在开放世界条件下执行通用行动的类人代理（EWAs），并提出了一个大的数据集EmbodiedWorld-200K。通过在该数据集上进行预训练，并在视频世界模型中进行交互强化学习，从而提升EWA的开放世界导航能力。
AI.motivation: 当前大部分的类人代理研究局限于单个场景中的特定任务，并且难以在新环境中迁移，因此，开放世界的类人代理研究仍处于探索阶段。
AI.method: 该研究创建了一个包含超过20万个样本的大规模数据集EmbodiedWorld-200K，每个样本都带有多层次的注释，用以支持离线预训练和公平评估；提出了一个新颖的训练方案，利用视频世界模型作为低成本环境代理，并在其中进行交互强化学习。
AI.result: 通过在这大尺寸数据集上的预训练，以及在世界模型中的交互强化学习，研究进一步增强了EWA在未见过的场景中的开放世界导航能力。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的EmbodiedWorld-200K数据集、交互强化学习方法和视频世界模型在开放世界环境下的学习和适应方面为EWA研究提供了一个重要的基础和新思路。

title: UniState: Unifying Memory and Intervention for Controllable World Simulation
summary: World models offer increasingly rich environments for exploration, yet intervening in a world while observing the consequences from freely chosen viewpoints remains challenging. We tackle these challenges by introducing UniState, a framework for controllable world simulation built on a unified world-state representation. This representation unifies spatial memory and user interventions. Users specify object motion directly within spatial memory, while independently choosing the camera trajectory from which the resulting world state is observed. This unification makes the relationship between the scene and the requested changes explicit, removing ambiguity between object motion and viewpoint change from the control specification. Crucially, specifying an intervention does not require prescribing every resulting movement: the video model can synthesize additional motion within controlled objects and plausible interactions with their surroundings. We develop training and sampling strategies that help generated videos follow the specified object motion and camera trajectory while preserving this capacity to generate responses beyond the prescribed transformations. Experiments demonstrate more accurate joint object and camera control than the existing methods, alongside qualitative evidence that intervention-induced scene changes persist across rollouts.

AI.tldr: UniState是一种用于可控世界模拟的框架，采用统一的世界状态表示，结合空间记忆和用户干预，允许用户直接在空间记忆中指定物体运动，同时独立选择观测视角。该方法提高了场景控制的准确性，并能在给定约束下生成额外的物体运动和合理互动。
AI.motivation: 传统的世界模型只能在固定视角下进行控制，难以实现同时控制物体运动和视角的变化。本文提出UniState框架来解决此问题，并通过实验验证其有效性和优越性。
AI.method: UniState框架通过统一的世界状态表示将空间记忆和用户干预相结合，允许用户在空间记忆中直接指定物体的运动，并独立选择观测视角。此方法可通过视频模型在给定约束下生成附加的物体运动和合理的周围互动，同时保持控制物体和视角的能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，UniState框架在物体和相机控制的准确性方面优于现有方法，并且干预引起的场景变化可以在多个时间步骤中保持不变。
AI.conclusion: UniState框架提供了一种有效的解决同时控制物体运动和视角问题的方法，并且具有生成额外运动和合理互动的能力。未来的研究可以进一步探索该框架在其他应用场景中的潜力。

title: EpiLens: Lightweight RAG for Epidemiological Knowledge Acquisition
summary: To prepare for future outbreaks, researchers need to know what studies have been done and what data they use. Mapping a large literature by hand is slow, while large language models alone can misstate or conflate sources. We present EpiLens, a lightweight, open-source retrieval-augmented generation package that applies a fixed retrieval template and output schema to every paper in a corpus and links outputs to source passages. We build a corpus of 2,297 papers from the sources of a multi-pathogen parameter study and evaluate EpiLens's paper-classification workflow against 214 manually labelled papers. Without task-specific training data, the classifier matches or exceeds the tested supervised and zero-shot baselines across four tasks. The study's early extraction sheets cite published sources for 327 estimates. We link each estimate to a cited document or to corpus studies included by a review. Then, we use the classifier's labels to compare the papers associated with different parameters and pathogens. EpiLens labels more papers linked to reproduction numbers than fatality risks as model-based (54% versus 22%, compared with 62% versus 24% in the manual labels). The gap is consistent with the frequent use of transmission models to estimate reproduction numbers and persists within each of five pathogens compared. Beyond the contrast between parameters, the model-based share of papers linked to incubation-period estimates differs by pathogen: 55% for SARS-CoV-2 versus 6% for mpox.

AI.tldr: EpiLens是一种轻量级的开源检索增强生成包，能够应用固定的检索模板和输出模式处理文献集中的每篇论文，并链接输出到原始段落。在评估中，EpiLens的分类工作流程在四个任务上超过了或与经过特定任务训练的数据相当的基线相当。相关研究表明，模型基线在估计传染数方面提供了更多的信息，但在估计其他参数方面则较少。
AI.motivation: 为了应对未来的疫情爆发，研究人员需要了解已有的研究和数据。手动文献映射速度慢，而大型语言模型容易产生错误或混淆信息。
AI.method: 创建了一个包含2297篇论文的语料库，利用EpiLens对这些论文进行分类与关联研究。利用分类器的标签来比较与不同参数和病原体关联的论文。
AI.result: 分类器匹配或超过了四个任务的测试基线，无论是监督学习还是零样本学习。与人工标签相比，更多关联于繁殖数而不是致死率的论文被认为是基于模型的。
AI.conclusion: EpiLens验证了其在处理大规模文献集时的有效性和准确性，特别是在参数估计中模型基线的重要性。

title: ABACUS: Program-Guided Multistep Reasoning over Frozen Judgment Models
summary: Judgment models answer semantic questions by scoring a finite set of candidate outcomes. Can reusable programs turn these local decisions into powerful multistep reasoning? We introduce \method, a framework that jointly constructs judgment schemas and composition programs for frozen judgment models. A generative teacher designs the procedure offline; the judgment model resolves local semantic questions online, and the saved program composes its decisions into an answer. We study three allocations of design effort between humans and the teacher, focusing on construction through a shared interface. We instantiate the framework with Kev. On three selected BIG-Bench Hard tasks, nine independently constructed programs solve all 450 executions of 150 development inputs. A separate deployment study freezes three programs after development-set reference-agreement refinement and evaluates them on 600 held-out questions. These programs achieve near-perfect 99.67\% macro accuracy, versus 64.00\% for direct Kev and 68.80\% for final-answer-only Qwen3.5-4B. They attain comparable observed accuracy to Qwen's unrestricted response policy (99.07\%) with an \textbf{8.43-fold online speedup}: 0.255 versus 2.150 seconds per question. These results show how reusable programs can substantially expand the reasoning capability of a compact judgment model while keeping its parameters fixed.

AI.tldr: 研究提出了一种框架，能够将局部决策转化为多步推理，并通过一个共享接口进行设计。该框架通过程序化设计提升了一个紧凑型判断模型的推理能力，同时保持其参数固定。
AI.motivation: 为了增强判断模型的推理能力，研究设计了一种框架，通过程序化设计将局部决策转化为多步推理。
AI.method: 该方法包括两个阶段：生成阶段，由生成教师设计程序，人类在线解决局部语义问题；运行阶段，判断模型保存决策程序并组成答案。研究通过共享界面展示了三种设计努力分配方案。
AI.result: 该框架在三个预选的大规模基准测试难题上展示出了显著的效果，经过开发集上的参考一致性校正，独立构建的程序成功解决了所有450个执行任务。部署实验中，三个程序在600个验证集问题上的准确率为99.67%，相较于直接使用的Kev（64.00%）和仅最终答案的Qwen3.5-4B（68.80%）有了显著提升。此外，与Qwen的无限制响应策略相比，这些程序实现相当的观察准确率（99.07%），但在线速度提高了8.43倍。
AI.conclusion: 这种方法通过程序化设计，扩展了紧凑型判断模型的推理能力，同时保持了模型参数的固定。

title: From Label Priors to Task Evidence: Efficient Long-Video Frame Selection via Bayesian GRPO
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face significant scalability challenges in long-video understanding due to quadratic attention complexity and context window constraints. Existing retrieval-based approaches typically rely on supervised learning from static keyframe annotations. However, these label priors often fail to align with the actual information required by downstream MLLMs for complex reasoning, creating a misalignment between the training target and inference needs. To bridge this gap, we propose a probabilistic framework that reformulates frame selection as latent-variable inference. We first initialize a lightweight policy using supervised learning to capture general visual saliency. Then, we treat a frozen MLLM as a task environment and use its answer likelihood as dense task evidence to refine the policy via Bayesian Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Within this formulation, the negative log-likelihood (NLL) over ground-truth answer tokens provides a principled dense reward, while a prior-matching KL term preserves semantic consistency with the elicited label prior. This process transitions the selection principle from static label priors to task evidence. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench demonstrate that our selector achieves competitive accuracy with MLLM-based scorers while retaining the inference efficiency of lightweight methods. The selector is trained once with a frozen MLLM environment and transfers directly to multiple downstream MLLMs without retraining. Code is available at \url{github.com/Miraclecsc/Frame_Selection_GRPO}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种概率框架，将帧选择重新定义为潜在变量推断，通过监督学习初始化轻量级策略，并利用冻结的大型语言模型作为任务环境来优化策略，这种方法在Video-MME、MLVU、LongVideoBench上的实验表明，能够与大型语言模型基分计算器相比保持竞争力，并具有轻量方法的推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于检索的方法依赖于静态关键帧注解的监督学习，无法与下游任务需求对齐，本文通过提出一种基于概率框架的方法，目标是使帧选择策略从静态标签先验过渡到任务证据，改善模型性能
AI.method: 本文方法首先通过监督学习初始化一个轻量级策略，后续通过贝叶斯多组相对策略优化（GRPO）和任务环境中的大型语言模型来优化政策。方法中包含一个负对数似然（NLL）作为原则性的密集奖励，并结合先验匹配的KL项保持语义一致性。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench上的实验结果表明，该选择器在与大型语言模型基分计算器相比的性能相当，同时保持了轻量方法的推理效率。并且训练一次后，可以无缝地转移到不同的下游大型语言模型而无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法在视频长视频理解和处理方面取得了显著进展，改善了模型的性能和通用性。

title: TokenGate: Adapting LLMs for Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill with Learned Token Pruning
summary: Expert human readers process large inputs (e.g., code repositories and long documents) by skimming to closely read only what matters. On the other hand, language models process all input tokens through each model layer, resulting in significant processing costs for long-context inputs. We introduce TokenGate, a small, drop-in component that extends existing trained models to enable end-to-end learnable token pruning over long-context inputs for fast and memory-efficient prefill. To enable end-to-end learning despite the non-differentiable top-K operator for token pruning, we introduce token-gated attention, a mechanism inspired by Mixture-of-Experts that re-weights attention logits using token importance scores. Across diverse tasks, TokenGate achieves $1.4$-$11.3\times$ faster time-to-first token (TTFT) and $1.5$-$3.4\times$ lower peak memory at no accuracy degradation for prefill in transformers. Compared to the best-performing prior methods for token-pruning, TokenGate gives up to $6.4\times$ faster prefill and $2\times$ lower peak memory. TokenGate natively extends both standard transformers (e.g., Qwen3) and hybrid-attention models (e.g., Qwen3.5) with simple lightweight adaptation comparable to standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning. We make our code available at: https://github.com/tokengate-models/TokenGate.

AI.tldr: TokenGate 是一个轻量级可插入组件，用于在一端到端学习中实现长上下文输入的标记剪枝，从而加速前缀填充并降低峰值内存消耗，而无需牺牲准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的语言模型在处理长上下文输入时存在显著的计算成本，而人类读者则通过略读快速识别关键信息。为此，文章旨在通过引入TokenGate组件，减少模型处理长输入的时间和内存消耗。TokenGate能够实现灵活的标记剪枝，并且在多种任务中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.method: TokenGate 通过引入 token-gated attention 机制，利用 token 重要性评分重新加权注意力值，以实现端到端学习，即使在剪枝操作不可微的情况下也能训练模型。此外，TokenGate 可以直接扩展标准的 Transformer 模型和混合注意力模型。
AI.result: TokenGate 在不同的任务中达到了 1.4-$11.3 	imes$ 的更快时间到第一个标记（TTFT）和 1.5-$3.4 	imes$ 的更低峰值内存消耗，而不会降低前缀填充的准确性。相比于现有的最佳标记剪枝方法，TokenGate 可以提供高达 $6.4 	imes$ 的更快前缀填充速度和 $2 	imes$ 的更低峰值内存消耗。
AI.conclusion: TokenGate 有效地提高了 Transformer 模型在长上下文输入上的性能，不仅通过剪枝操作大幅降低了计算和内存成本，而且保持了模型的精度，为未来的模型设计提供了新的思路。

title: GLOBE: Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit via Unit-Sphere Trajectories
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve problem solving, but models often keep generating after the correct answer is already reachable; the extra steps raise serving costs and may replace a correct intermediate result with an incorrect one. We propose GLOBE (Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit), an online, training-free algorithm that terminates the model's CoT process early. GLOBE embeds each completed reasoning segment as a point on a unit sphere and reads the shape of the resulting semantic trajectory. GLOBE first applies a trial phase that generates short trial answers in a separate branch, stopping the main stream on an accepted trial after checking confidence against a threshold. If generation continues, a trajectory phase stops the stream once this path repeatedly reverses direction with little net progress. On five benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, tool calling, and agent memory, GLOBE cuts output tokens by 49.7% and active end-to-end wall time (E2E) by 51.0% across two models, and achieves a five-task average of 80.58%, comparable to Full CoT.

AI.tldr: GLOBE通过一种在线、无需训练的算法在模型的Chain-of-Thought过程中早期终止，减少输出token和活跃的端到端时间。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在达到正确答案后仍继续生成，造成成本增加和潜在的错误覆盖。为了解决这些问题，提出了GLOBE方法。
AI.method: GLOBE将每个完成的推理段嵌入到单位球上，并阅读由此形成的语义轨迹的形状。首先进行试用阶段，生成简短的试回答，并在检验置信度达到阈值后接受试回答。如果生成继续，则在路径阶段，一旦发现路径反复逆转且几乎没有进步则停止。
AI.result: 在数学推理、工具调用和智能体记忆等五个基准测试上，GLOBE在两个模型上的输出token减少49.7%，活跃的端到端时间为51.0%，五个任务的平均得分为80.58%，表现接近完整CoT。
AI.conclusion: GLOBE能够有效提前结束Chain-of-Thought过程，显著降低计算成本，且在多个基准测试中的表现与完整Chain-of-Thought相当。

title: Preserving the Manifold: Frozen Expert Alignment for Label-Efficient SAR Scene Understanding
comment: 10 pages. A shorter version of this work was presented at the ECCV 2026 Workshop TerraBytes II: Towards Global Datasets and Models for Earth Observation (non-archival)
summary: Cross-modal alignment of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery to natural language is constrained by two distinct failures. The first is modality mismatch: text encoders pre-trained on optical imagery, such as CLIP, cannot be efficiently fine-tuned on SAR, because active microwave backscatter is physically incompatible with passive optical reflectance and the available SAR caption datasets are orders of magnitude too small to bridge this gap without substantially degrading the learned semantic manifold. The second is physical forgetting: SAR encoders pre-trained on large-scale self-supervised objectives encode radar physics that are progressively erased when the encoder is fine-tuned for text alignment on limited caption data. A single design principle addresses both failures: keep both encoders frozen and learn only a constrained, structure-preserving bridge. Our Frozen Expert framework aligns a frozen CROMA SAR encoder with a frozen CLIP text encoder via a lightweight constrained residual bridge. We formally define physical forgetting via Procrustes disparity and show our bridge preserves SAR geometry significantly better than fine-tuning (disparity: 0.210 vs. 0.351). We validate generality across multiple SAR backbones and text encoders. On zero-shot SAR scene classification, our approach outperforms fine-tuned baselines using up to 8x less training data: DFC2020 (+10.3% R@1, +15.5% mAP), EuroSAT-SAR (+15.7% R@1, +12.2% mAP), BigEarthNet-MM (+14.7% R@1). These results establish frozen manifold alignment as a principled, data-efficient alternative to fine-tuning in high-disparity cross-modal settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种冻结专家框架，通过冻结SA，R编码器和CLIP文本编码器，并学习一个轻量级且结构保持的约束桥梁来实现跨模态对齐。实验表明，该方法在零样本SAR场景分类中表现优于微调基线，使用最多8倍少的训练数据。
AI.motivation: 解决合成孔径雷达（SAR）图像与自然语言对齐的两个主要挑战：模态不匹配和物理遗忘。模态不匹配是指预训练在光学成像上的文本编码器不适合SAR图像的微波回波特性，而SAR图像的标注数据规模小。物理遗忘是指预训练在大规模自监督目标上的SAR编码器在为文本对齐进行有限标注数据的微调时，会逐渐丧失雷达物理特性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为‘冻结专家’（Frozen Expert）的框架，通过冻结SAR和CLIP编码器来避免模态不匹配和物理遗忘问题，并利用一个轻量级且结构保持的约束桥梁进行跨模态对齐。
AI.result: 在零样本SAR场景分类任务中，本文的方法表现优于微调基线，使用最多8倍少的训练数据：DFC2020 (+10.3% R@1, +15.5% mAP)，EuroSAT-SAR (+15.7% R@1, +12.2% mAP)，BigEarthNet-MM (+14.7% R@1)。
AI.conclusion: 本文的工作展示了在高差异跨模态设置中，冻结流形对齐作为一种原理性和数据高效的方法的可行性，为基于约束残差桥梁的跨模态对齐提供了一种新思路。

title: Monsoon: Scalable Spontaneous Speech Collection for Low-Resource ASR in 50 Languages
summary: For most languages, automatic speech recognition (ASR) is limited less by model architecture than by a lack of accurately transcribed spontaneous speech. We present Monsoon, a framework for collecting such data at scale. It elicits unscripted conversations between paired contributors, screens recordings with automated classifiers, corrects transcripts over five levels of human review, and selects segments for lexical and acoustic coverage. It has collected speech in 50 languages; we analyse seven 3,500-hour corpora. At equal volume, its quality stages reduce semantic word error rate (WER) by 10-39% relative to a conventional protocol. Compared with an architecture-matched baseline trained on public corpora, Whisper fine-tuned on Monsoon performs comparably on the baseline's own test sets and reduces semantic WER by 20-44 points on conversational benchmarks. The gains transfer to a second architecture and grow with data volume. We release the framework, its quality-control models, and the fine-tuned models.

AI.tldr: Monsoon是一个大规模收集准确转录自发对话数据的框架，能够显著提高语言自动语音识别系统的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动语音识别系统在大多数语言中受限于没有足够准确的自发性语言转录数据，因此开发了Monsoon框架来大规模收集和处理此类数据。
AI.method: Monsoon通过对语言对进行未经预设脚本的对话收集，使用自动化分类器筛选录音，经过五级人工校验，挑选出能覆盖词汇和声学覆盖的片断。
AI.result: Monsoon成功收集了50种语言的数据，并分析了七个3,500小时的语料库。其质控阶段在同等规模下将语义词错误率（WER）降低了10-39%。对比于与之匹配架构的基准模型，在公共语料库上训练的Whisper模型，在Monsoon语料库上进行微调后，语义WER降低了20-44点。性能提升可以跨不同架构进行转移，并且随着数据量的增加而增加。
AI.conclusion: Monsoon框架证明了其在收集高质量自发性语言转录数据方面的有效性，并且其模型和质量控制模型被公开，为提高自动语音识别系统的性能提供了新的途径。

title: On the Benefits of Uncertainty Estimation for Species Classification: A Case Study on Optimizing Expert re-Annotation
summary: Automated identification of diatoms from microscopic images is a cornerstone of large-scale freshwater biomonitoring, yet the high diversity of species and strong class imbalance pose significant challenges for reliable classification. In this study, we develop a ResNet-18 baseline for a 759-class diatom dataset and investigate how calibrated confidence estimates support selective classification to reduce expert workload without sacrificing taxonomic integrity. While the initial model exhibits overconfidence with an Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of 0.117, post-hoc temperature scaling (T = 2.12) dramatically improves reliability, lowering the ECE to 0.055.By leveraging these calibrated probabilities within a triage framework, we demonstrate that a Selective Macro-F1 score of 99.01% can be maintained at 66.2% coverage (rejection threshold $τ$ = 0.934). Qualitative analysis reveals that the system effectively functions as an intelligent filter, consistently deferring rare taxa-such as AAMB and AASI-and ambiguous morphologies for expert review. Our findings, supported by the torch-uncertainty framework, highlight the potential of simple calibration techniques to make automated diatom identification practical and robust, prioritizing the preservation of rare species metrics essential for ecological assessment. To support reproducibility, our code, environment specifications, and calibration results are available anonymously at https://anonymous.4open. science/r/greenprwksp-B53D/README.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于ResNet-18的759类硅藻数据集基础模型，并通过温度校准提高了分类器的可靠性。利用校准后的概率在分类中减少专家的工作量，同时保持分类的完整性。
AI.motivation: 由于硅藻种类丰富且类别严重不平衡，自动化识别面临着巨大挑战。本文通过开发基于ResNet-18的模型，结合校准技术以减轻专家的工作负担，同时保证分类的准确性。
AI.method: 研究首先建立了一个ResNet-18的基础模型，然后通过温度校准提升模型的校准误差，最后在三明治框架下进行选择性分类。
AI.result: 模型初始的校准误差为0.117，通过温度校准后降低至0.055，同时在选择性宏F1分数为99.01%的情况下，覆盖率为66.2%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了温度校准技术在硅藻自动化识别中的应用潜力，有助于实现自动化识别的实用性和鲁棒性，强调了对稀有物种指标的保护对于生态评估的重要性。

title: DragonMoCap: Monocular Video-based Motion Capture for Diverse Dragon Topologies
summary: This work explores monocular motion capture for dragon-type characters, which currently relies on manual keyframing due to the lack of high-quality datasets and parametric models. The primary obstacle lies in the extreme topological diversity across dragon rigs, where varying joint counts and naming conventions render traditional fixed-template regressors inapplicable. To address this, we introduce DragonMoCap, a novel framework that treats the target rig as a dynamic input rather than a fixed prior. By deliberately scoping the framework to the most prevalent production topologies, we ensure high-fidelity results across diverse morphologies. The core of our approach is the design of language-grounded joint query tokens, which establish a dual-property representation: ensuring intra-rig discriminability while maintaining cross-rig similarity. We further propose a non-parametric query-token retrieval mechanism to enable zero-shot adaptation to unseen rigs without retraining. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that DragonMoCap consistently outperforms HMR-style baselines across diverse dragon topologies. The practical utility of our framework is further evidenced by its integration into professional animation workflows, highlighting its potential for real-time industrial applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究旨在解决龙型角色的一眼动捕捉问题，提出了DragonMoCap框架，通过将目标骨架作为动态输入，设计了语言引导的关节查询令牌，并引入了非参数化的查询令牌检索机制，成功应用于不同形态的龙骨架，超越了传统的固定模板回归器。
AI.motivation: 目前龙型角色的一眼动捕捉依赖于手工关键帧，因为缺乏高质量的数据集和参数模型，以及极端的拓扑多样性带来的挑战。为此，研究提出了DragonMoCap框架。
AI.method: 研究设计了语言引导的关节查询令牌，建立了一种既具有内部歧义性又保持跨骨架相似性的表示方法。同时，提出了一种非参数化的查询令牌检索机制，使框架能够零样本适应未知骨架。
AI.result: 该框架在各种龙型骨架上表现出色，持续优于HMR型基线，进一步验证其在专业动画工作流程中的实际用处。
AI.conclusion: DragonMoCap框架的成功展示为未来的一眼动捕捉提供了新的思路，并有望应用于实时的工业应用中。

title: RESIN: Multi-Chain Reasoning with Entity-Structured Indexing
summary: Multi-chain reasoning is a challenging task not only because the multi-chain evidence is dispersed, but also because different parts of reasoning may require distinct, interacting chains of support. Flat retrieval can flood a model with loosely related text, whereas early selection of a single reasoning path can discard evidence that becomes useful only after other facts are considered. We introduce RESIN (Reasoning with Entity Structured Indexing), which uses structure to locate evidence while keeping the original source as the basis for reasoning. RESIN decomposes a question into focused one-hop needs, retrieves a small set of source-grounded units for each hop, and places only this relevant evidence in a compact reasoning buffer. The buffer preserves alternative supports until final composition, making intermediate decisions explicit without forcing a brittle path. On the full HolisQA benchmark, RESIN achieves 82.92 context recall and 76.70 answer relevancy over all questions, with higher reported CR and AR across five domains and higher F1 in four domains than the published baselines. Ablations show that both typed evidence diversity and hop-wise decomposition are essential, supporting a clear conclusion: Precise evidence organization and delayed commitment make multi-chain reasoning effective and auditable. Our code is available at https://github.com/RamonMeng/RESIN.

AI.tldr: RESIN通过结构化索引证据，将问题分解为聚焦的一跳需求，检索出与之相关的少量源本单位，将其放入紧凑的推理缓冲区中。这种方法保留了多种可能性直到最终组合，避免了僵化的路径选择，显著提高了多链推理的有效性和可追溯性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法无法有效处理多链推理中的分散证据与不同推理部分的交互需求。RESIN的设计旨在通过结构化索引来有针对性地检索证据，以保持推理的灵活性与准确性，同时提供清晰的过程记录。
AI.method: RESIN先将问题分解为具体的步骤，即‘一跳需求’，然后针对每个步骤检索特定的单元并与原文保持关联。所有相关的证据都放入了紧凑的推理缓冲区中，直至最终组合。这种方法允许在具体推理阶段做出选择，而不必早于必要时确定单一论证路径。
AI.result: 在全面的HolisQA基准测试中，RESIN展示了82.92的上下文召回率和76.70的答案相关性，超过所有领域内的报告值，且在四个领域中的F1分数也优于发布的基线模型。消融实验还表明类型化的证据多样性和按步骤分解都是至关重要的。
AI.conclusion: RESIN的设计通过精确的证据组织和延迟承诺，使其成为多链推理的有效且易审计的解决方案。这一方法强调了结构化索引在多链推理中的重要性，支持了更灵活的推理路径和更可靠的推理结果。

title: GraphEvoResearcher: Graph-Aware Training-Free Self-Reflective Reasoning for Cost-Bounded Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Multi-hop question answering (QA) requires models to chain intermediate conclusions while remaining cost-aware. Existing training-free self-reflective protocols (generate -> critique -> revise) improve accuracy but operate on a flat token stream: revisions cannot identify which prior step is unreliable, and early stopping cannot exploit structural convergence. We introduce GraphEvoResearcher, a training-free protocol that lifts EvoResearcher's self-reflective meta-reward onto an explicit reasoning graph - nodes are intermediate conclusions/evidence and edges encode support, contradict, and depends_on. A graph-aware meta-reward combines correctness, efficiency, reflection, diversity, and four structural signals (connectivity, acyclicity, branch coverage, path convergence) to decide whether to revise, backtrack, or stop. A graph-convergence early-stop terminates when evidence branches converge on a single conclusion. On a real LLM (DeepSeek), over GSM8K, MATH, and BBH (n=50 each), GraphEvoResearcher reaches 98%, 92%, and 82% respectively, the highest of all baselines, with the largest gains on the hardest set (MATH: +24 pp over single-shot, +12 pp over flat reflection), while keeping construction cost bounded at ~2 steps / 4.5-5 nodes. Our results indicate the structural signal of a reasoning graph is most valuable exactly where single-step reasoning is unreliable.

AI.tldr: GraphEvoResearcher 是一个无需训练的协议，它将 EvoResearcher 的元奖励提升到显式的推理图上，通过结构信号来决定是否需要修改、回溯或停止，从而在三个真实的数据集上取得了最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 目前的自反思协议在处理多跳问答时只能在扁平的标记流上进行操作，无法识别早期哪些步骤不可靠，而 GraphEvoResearcher 利用图结构来克服这个问题，特别在单一推理不可靠的地方表现出更优的表现。
AI.method: GraphEvoResearcher 通过构造一个图，其中节点表示中间结论和证据，边表示支持、反驳和依赖关系，结合正确性、效率、反思、多样性以及连通性、无环性、支路覆盖和路径收敛等结构信号来决定是否需要修订或停止。
AI.result: 在 DeepSeek 这个真实的语言模型上，GraphEvoResearcher 在三个数据集 GSM8K、MATH 和 BBH 上分别达到了 98%、92% 和 82%，这是所有基线中的最高成绩，尤其是对最难的数据集 MATH 来说增幅最大，同时保持构建成本在约每 2 步 4.5-5 个节点的范围内。
AI.conclusion: GraphEvoResearcher 通过引入结构信号来优化自反思过程并提升了模型对复杂问题的理解能力，特别是在单一推理不可靠时表现更佳，这为未来的多跳问答模型的设计提供了新思路。

title: A New Hope for PRNU on Modern Smartphones? Evidence That Device-Specific Fingerprints Survive Computational Photography
summary: Photo Response Non-Uniformity (PRNU) is widely regarded as the most reliable marker for source camera identification. Recent studies, however, report high correlations between images and fingerprints from different modern smartphones, which calls into question the discriminative power of PRNU on these devices. Using 30 recent smartphones under controlled acquisition conditions (e.g., no digital zoom), we investigate whether the fingerprint itself is at fault or the way it is compared. We find that a component shared by all fingerprints of the same model inflates the standard signed peak-to-correlation energy (sPCE). To counter this, we propose $Δ$sPCE: the sPCE between a query image and a candidate camera's fingerprint, minus the mean sPCE between that image and the fingerprints of the remaining candidates, in the spirit of T-norm score normalization. $Δ$sPCE improves attribution accuracy, suggesting that the device-specific PRNU signal is still present. Although the limited dataset size and the dependence of $Δ$sPCE on the candidate camera set currently restrict operational applicability, these results suggest that PRNU-based attribution of modern smartphones remains feasible when fingerprints are compared appropriately.

AI.tldr: 提出的ΔsPCE方法通过消除指纹之间的系统偏差，提高了基于PRNU识别现代智能手机的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的PRNU方法在识别来自不同型号现代智能手机的图像时表现出不足，因为不同制造商生产的手机可能会产生相似的PRNU指纹，导致误识别。
AI.method: 本研究在受控环境下对30款最新智能手机进行了实验，采用ΔsPCE方法，即对查询图像与候选设备指纹之间的sPCE值进行调整，以去除系统偏差。
AI.result: 研究表明，尽管由于数据集较小和ΔsPCE方法对候选设备集的依赖性限制了其实用性，但通过ΔsPCE方法仍能提高现代智能手机基于PRNU的识别准确性。
AI.conclusion: ΔsPCE方法表明，即使在指纹相似的情况下，基于PRNU的现代智能手机识别仍然是可行的，但需要更多研究来扩大候选集的范围并提高方法的实用性。

title: Safety Mid-Training: Internalizing LLM Safety as a Foundational Capability
summary: Safety alignment for large language models (LLMs) is primarily performed during post-training, while recent work has also begun incorporating safety data into pre-training. Yet safety can degrade when later training no longer includes safety data, and gains in safety often come at the cost of general capability. This tension suggests that safety and general reasoning should not be treated as separate training goals. We instead view safety as an LLM capability that can be learned through a reasoning structure shared with general tasks. Both require the model to understand intent or task goals, apply relevant knowledge, and reason about potential consequences. We introduce safety mid-training, a stage between pre-training and post-training that jointly develops safety and general reasoning through this shared structure. Given safety and utility prompts, the base model generates structured documents and reasoning traces that are then used for mid-training. Safety mid-training reduces average attack success rate (ASR) by 72% to 81% relative to Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B base models, while also improving general capability. The benefits persist through subsequent post-training. After general-only SFT, mid-trained models largely retain their safety, achieving lower ASR than the baselines without sacrificing general capability. They also retain safety under general-only GRPO without safety rewards, while subsequent RL reaches a better safety-utility frontier when initialized from the mid-trained models. Together, these results suggest that learning safety and general reasoning within a shared mid-training stage can reduce the safety-utility trade-off and make safety more robust to subsequent training.

AI.tldr: 介绍了在LLM预训练和后训练之间引入中间训练阶段的方法，通过共享的推理结构同时学习安全和一般推理能力，从而减少安全与一般能力之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 当前的安全对齐主要在后训练阶段进行，但可能导致安全性能下降和减少一般能力，本文提出了一种在预训练和后训练之间引入中间训练阶段的新方法，旨在同时增强安全性和一般推理能力。
AI.method: 通过安全和实用性提示，基模型生成结构化的文档和推理痕迹，然后在中间训练阶段利用这些内容进行训练。
AI.result: 中间训练阶段降低了平均攻击成功率（ASR）高达72%至81%，同时也提高了模型的一般能力，即使在后续只进行一般调优时，中间训练后的模型仍然保留了较高的安全性能。与其他方法相比，使用中间训练模型初始化进一步的强化学习时，获得了更优的安全与实用性平衡。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法表明，在共享的中间训练阶段学习安全和一般推理能力可以降低安全-实用性权衡，使安全性在后续训练中更加稳健。

title: ClueFlow: Learning Long-Horizon Search through Attributed Research-State Transitions
summary: Long-horizon search requires agents to acquire relevant evidence and integrate it into an evolving research state. Existing methods maintain research states to guide exploration or assign turn-level progress signals, yet grounding these signals in explicit, attributable state changes remains underexplored. We introduce ClueFlow, which learns long-horizon search from attributed research-state transitions. ClueFlow constructs Source-State-Final attribution chains that connect evidence-acquiring browser actions, Evidence and Candidate updates, and the final answer supported by those updates. During search, ClueFlow records typed state changes and potentially supporting browser actions, then applies gold-conditioned semantic validation and source tracing after execution. We use this attribution to guide both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. During SFT, attribution selects which decisions receive supervision with their original interaction contexts. During Turn-PPO, the same attribution augments outcome-based turn advantages with credit assigned along the Source-State-Final chains. Transition-level validation also recovers useful supervision from gold-consistent state changes in trajectories with incorrect final answers. We evaluate ClueFlow across two Qwen backbones and four search benchmarks spanning live-web and fixed-corpus settings, observing consistent gains from SFT and further improvements from PPO. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, ClueFlow achieves 60.0% accuracy on BrowseComp and 72.0% on BrowseComp-Plus. In controlled BrowseComp-Plus experiments, attribution-guided SFT matches all-turn exact-context SFT using about 30% of the training tokens, while attribution-guided PPO outperforms outcome-only PPO by 4.1 pp. These results demonstrate that state-transition attribution enables efficient supervision and effective credit assignment for long-horizon search agents.

AI.tldr: ClueFlow通过学习归因的研究状态转化来指导长期搜索，通过源-状态-最终结果链路追踪证据搜寻和答案生成过程中的决策，从而提高监督微调（SFT）和增强学习（PPO）的效果，特别是在Qwen模型上表现显著。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在搜索过程中对长期状态的管理中，缺乏对状态变化的归因和指导，ClueFlow旨在填补这一空白，通过学习归因的研究状态转化，提升监督学习和强化学习的方法效果。
AI.method: ClueFlow通过记录并分析类型化状态变化及支持的浏览器行动，在执行后进行黄金状况下的语义验证和来源追踪，然后根据获得的归因来指导监督微调和增强学习算法。
AI.result: 使用ClueFlow，监督微调和增强学习都能获得性能提升。例如，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B在BrowseComp和BrowseComp-Plus的数据集上分别取得了60.0%和72.0%的准确率。此外，在控制实验中，ClueFlow的监督微调和增强学习表现优于标准方法。
AI.conclusion: ClueFlow证明了状态转换归因的有效性，可以实现高效监督、有效的信用分配，对长期搜索代理的有效性给予了有力支持。

title: UBD-Bench: Benchmarking and Analyzing Unimodal Branch Degradation in Multimodal Perception for Autonomous Driving
summary: Multimodal perception improves autonomous-driving performance by combining complementary sensor information. However, stronger multimodal predictions do not necessarily imply stronger representations in each modality-specific branch. Such branch-level weaknesses can remain hidden in conventional output-level evaluation. We introduce UBD-Bench, a systematic benchmark for studying unimodal branch degradation (UBD) in multimodal perception. UBD-Bench uses a Paired Frozen-Branch Probe to compare the task-relevant representation quality of the same modality after independent unimodal training and multimodal joint training under matched decoding conditions. Across four autonomous-driving perception tasks and 10 models, we find that Camera branches consistently degrade after multimodal joint training, whereas LiDAR branches exhibit weaker and more model-dependent changes, revealing a pronounced modality asymmetry. Hierarchical probing further shows that Camera-branch degradation extends from the visual backbone through the Camera-to-BEV pathway and is most severe at the pre-fusion Camera BEV representation. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce unimodal-to-multimodal distillation at the degraded representation. This intervention consistently improves both Camera-branch Probe performance and full-model performance across all four tasks. These results show that multimodal gains can coexist with degraded unimodal representations, highlighting branch-level representation quality as an important dimension for evaluating and improving multimodal perception.

AI.tldr: 引入UBD-Bench作为研究多模态感知中单一模态分支退化（UBD）的基准，发现相机分支在多模态联合训练后退化严重，而LiDAR分支退化较弱且模型依赖性强。基于此诊断提出退化表示的单模态到多模态精炼方法，能够提升相机分支和全模型的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的评估方法仅关注最终输出，未能检测到各模态分支中的潜在问题。因此，作者旨在通过UBD-Bench来研究和量化这种退化现象，以提升多模态感知的性能。
AI.method: 使用Paired Frozen-Branch Probe来比较相同模态在独立单模态训练和多模态联合训练后的任务相关表示质量。此外，通过层次化探针进一步分析相机分支退化的具体情况。
AI.result: 研究发现相机分支在多模态联合训练后退化明显，而LiDAR分支则表现出较弱且模型依赖性强的退化，揭示了明显的模态不对称性。在相机分支退化最严重的预融合相机BEV表示处引入单模态到多模态精炼，能有效改善相机分支和完整模型的效果。
AI.conclusion: 多模态增益与退化的单模态表示共存，表明分支级表示质量是评价和改进多模态感知的重要维度。

title: ASTOR: Benchmarking and Improving Autoformulation for Soft-Constraint Optimization with a Formal Grammar
summary: Real-world decision problems combine two qualitatively different kinds of constraints: requirements that must be satisfied, called hard constraints, and preferences that can be violated, called soft constraints. Because these problems are often posed to decision-makers in natural language, large language models offer a natural tool for assisting with their solution. This has given rise to autoformulation, which focuses on using LLMs to translate natural-language descriptions of decision problems into executable mathematical optimization models. However, this research often neglects soft constraints like those proposed by consumers, managers, and planners, despite the fact that many practical problems require modeling them explicitly. We introduce ASTOR, an inference-time framework that maps a natural-language decision problem to a grammar-guided abstract syntax tree (AST) before deterministically compiling the resulting representation into executable optimization code. We also introduce SoftOR, a unified benchmark of natural language problems which focuses on soft constraint formulations. On SoftOR, ASTOR achieves the best aggregate accuracy among comparable single-request and multi-agent LLM methods while remaining competitive on standard autoformulation benchmarks that include only hard constraints. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/astor-softor-iclr-E34C/README.md.

AI.tldr: ASTOR 引入了一种推理时框架，将自然语言决策问题映射到语法导向的抽象语法树 (AST)，然后将该表达式编译成可执行的优化代码。此外，还提出了 SoftOR，一个专注于软约束规范的统一基准。ASTOR 在 SoftOR 上的总体准确性优于可比的单请求和多智能体大型语言模型方法，并且在只包含硬约束的标准自动形式化基准上具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 许多实际问题需要明确建模软约束，而现有的研究往往忽视了这一点。ASTOR 旨在更好地处理这些软约束，以提高决策问题的解决质量。
AI.method: ASTOR 通过将自然语言决策问题映射到一个语法导向的抽象语法树 (AST)，然后将生成的表示形式编译成可执行的优化代码，以处理软约束。
AI.result: 在 SoftOR 的基准测试中，ASTOR 达到了最高的整体准确性。同时，它在包括仅仅硬约束的标准自动形式化基准上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: ASTOR 提供了一种有效的方法来处理自然语言决策问题中的软约束，为其提供了更好的决策支持。此外，SoftOR 提供了一个有用的基准来评估未来的方法。

title: Map-Distribution Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Agent Pathfinding
summary: Designing capable neural policies for multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF), which map local observations to action distributions, represents an important challenge in multi-agent learning, with practical relevance to scalable collective automation problems such as warehouse logistics. In contrast to prior studies focusing primarily on individual policy design, this study explores a meta-level Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approach to learning-based MAPF. Specifically, given a collection of compact yet high-performing experts specialised for different map distributions, our architecture learns a router that selectively fuses their outputs according to each agent's local situation. We instantiate and validate this MoE approach with a commonly used graph neural network-based policy as well as a newly developed recursive action-token refinement model. Combined with supervised and reinforcement learning fine-tuning of the experts, our experiments show that MoE generally improves upon the pretrained policy and outperforms existing leading methods. At the same time, our findings reveal that appropriately trained, parameter-matched monolithic models still outperform MoE, highlighting a nuanced role for map-distribution MoE for MAPF.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种混合专家（MoE）方法来解决多智能体路径规划问题，通过结合各专长于不同地图分布的专家模型，并通过局部情况选择性融合其输出，改进了预训练的神经网络政策，并且在监督学习和强化学习的微调下，MoE方法比现有领先方法表现更佳。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体路径规划（MAPF）研究主要集中在个体策略的设计上，而该研究旨在探索一种多智能体路径规划的元级混合专家（MoE）方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种混合专家体系结构，该体系结构基于图神经网络的政策和新开发的递归行动代币精炼模型。通过结合各专长于不同地图分布的专家模型，并根据每个智能体的局部情况选择性融合其输出，以此来改进预训练的神经网络策略。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，混合专家（MoE）方法在监督学习和强化学习的微调下能够优于现有的领先方法，但同时也揭示了地图分布匹配的单模型依然优于MoE。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体路径规划中，混合专家架构是一种有潜力改进现有方法并提升智能体群体处理复杂任务能力的方法。然而，不同类型的智能体仍需要根据具体地图分布类型进行调整和优化。

title: Test-Time Scaling of Text-to-Image Flow Matching Models with Noise-Rejuvenated Sequential Monte Carlo
summary: Test-time scaling of diffusion models with sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) has become a promising strategy for sampling under user-specified rewards, such as human preference scores. However, the standard SMC framework typically relies on stochastic proposals and therefore does not directly transfer to flow matching models, in which inference is governed by deterministic ODEs. In this work, we introduce noise-rejuvenated SMC, an inference-time scaling method tailored for text-to-image flow matching models. Our key idea is to perturb each resampled particle by changing its source noise and constructing a new intermediate state using its current endpoint estimate. This moves the particle to another state that remains representable under the flow-matching interpolation form, enabling particle exploration without converting the sampler to an SDE. We further introduce a look-ahead mechanism to refine resampled particles before weighting. Experiments on Stable Diffusion 3, FLUX.1-dev, and Z-Image demonstrate consistent improvements in reward-guided generation, while ablation studies validate the contributions of noise rejuvenation and look-ahead refinement. Code is available at https://github.com/shermanlian/NR-SMC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种噪音复新的SMC方法，用于文本到图像的流匹配模型，该方法能在不将采样器转化为SDE的情况下进行粒子重采样，从而实现粒子探索和 reward 指引生成性能的提高。
AI.motivation: 现有的SMC方法依赖于随机提案，不适合流匹配模型，而流匹配模型的推理由确定性的ODEs来控制。为了提高基于奖励的方向生成性能，作者提出了噪音复新的SMC方法。
AI.method: 该方法包括对每个重采样的粒子施加噪声复新，通过其当前末端估计值生成新的中间状态，从而重新定位粒子到另一状态，该状态在流匹配插值形式下仍可表示。此外，还引入了一个前瞻机制，以在加权之前细化重采样粒子。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion 3, FLUX.1-dev, 和Z-Image上的实验结果表明，与传统的SMC相比，该方法能够实现更一致的奖励导向生成性能改进。
AI.conclusion: 本文介绍的噪音复新的SMC方法能够在不将sampler转化为SDE的情况下实现粒子探索，并通过实验验证了其有效性和实用性，代码已经开源。

title: AfriBED: a Speech Recognition Bias Evaluation Dataset for Low Resource African Languages
comment: accepted at 2026 IEEE Spoken language Technology Workshop Demo Track
summary: Despite advancements in automatic speech recognition systems (ASR), current systems exhibit speaker-attribute bias, i.e., their speech recognition performance is biased against certain speakers based on their demographic attributes such as gender, accents, and speaker type. However, accurately assessing speaker attribute bias in a given ASR system requires the availability of a bias evaluation dataset with comparable speech across subgroups of a speaker attribute. In this paper, we introduce African speech Bias Evaluation Dataset (AfriBED), a novel speech recognition bias evaluation dataset for two low resource African languages, Bemba and Nyanja, to detect and estimate gender and speaker-type bias for ASR systems. The dataset comprises 9 hours of speech with 3928 utterances recorded by 80 speakers for Bemba, while the Nyanja set includes 6260 utterances with approximately 18 hours of speech recorded by 127 speakers. The results of our baseline experiments demonstrate that the datasets are useful for examining gender and speaker-type attribute bias in the target languages.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了African Speech Bias Evaluation Dataset (AfriBED)，这是一个针对贝姆巴和尼亚尼亚两种低资源非洲语言的噪声数据集，用于检测和估计性别和说话者类型的偏见。实验结果表明，该数据集对于目标语言中的性别和说话者类型属性偏见是有用的。
AI.motivation: 由于现有的ASR系统存在基于性别、口音和说话者类型的语料库偏差，因此需要一个准确评估此类偏见的方法。AfriBED的数据集旨在解决这一问题，特别是在资源不足的语言中。
AI.method: 该数据集通过使用来自Bemba和Nyanja语言80名贝姆巴说话者和127名尼亚尼亚说话者的声音记录构建。这些记录涵盖了9小时和大约18小时的对话。
AI.result: 基线实验结果表明，该数据集可以有效地评估贝姆巴和尼亚尼亚语言中的性别和说话者类型偏见。
AI.conclusion: AfriBED数据集为研究ASR系统中的低资源非洲语言的性别和说话者类型偏见提供了有价值的工具。

title: Procedural Memory for Language Agents: A Neurosymbolic Perspective on Explicit Goal Structure
summary: Large language models remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks requiring procedural reasoning. We argue that a key cause is the absence of explicit procedural memory: accessible, modifiable knowledge of how tasks are accomplished, distinct from semantic and episodic memory. Goal-Oriented Graphs offer such a representation, encoding goals and prerequisite dependencies as inspectable symbolic structure. We examine their construction, the challenges they pose, and principles for integrating them with neural reasoning.
