AI.tldr: 该研究旨在通过引入明示性的程序记忆（如目标导向图）来改进大型语言模型在长时间问题解决中的可靠性，特别是涉及程序推理的任务。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在解决长时间任务，尤其是需要程序推理的任务时表现不稳定，原因在于缺乏程序记忆等机制。
AI.method: 研究者提出了目标导向图的概念，用于编码目标和前置依赖关系，作为可检视的符号结构。同时研究了这种图的构建方法及其带来的挑战，并探讨了如何将目标导向图与神经推理进行整合。
AI.result: 目前，作者正在探索和解决目标导向图在与神经推理结合使用时遇到的具体挑战，并提出潜在的整合策略。
AI.conclusion: 研究认为目标导向图是一种有潜力的方法，能够增强语言模型在复杂任务中的表现，但具体实现和优化方案仍需要进一步研究。

title: Multimodal-Conditioned Latent Diffusion Models for Spatiotemporal Brain MRI Forecasting
summary: Spatiotemporal forecasting of 3D anatomical changes is a critical generative vision challenge for modeling Alzheimer's Disease (AD) progression. While brain MRI forecasting from single-modality data has advanced, other key complementary multimodal biomarkers remain underutilized. In this work, we propose the Multimodal-Conditioned Latent Diffusion Model (MC-LDM), a novel framework for patient-specific brain MRI synthesis. MC-LDM leverages multimodal biomarkers---MRI, tau-PET, Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR), and APOE4---during training, but relies only on baseline MRI, APOE4, and patient metadata at inference, reflecting realistic clinical availability. Our contributions are threefold: (1) a Latent Diffusion Model (LDM) fine-tuned via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for data-efficient learning; (2) a multimodal conditioning that integrates molecular and clinical signals to model heterogeneous disease trajectories; and (3) auxiliary predictors estimating unobserved multimodal biomarkers from MRI features and patient covariates to condition the diffusion model, removing the need for these assessments at inference. Trained on 1,355 visits from 852 subjects in the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), MC-LDM reduces average regional volumetric MAE by 18% over the second-best baseline on an independent test set of 664 visits. To our knowledge, MC-LDM represents the first diffusion-based framework to leverage multimodal priors for MRI forecasting. This conceptual advancement enables patient-specific trajectory generation that captures aspects of AD heterogeneity not observable from structural anatomy alone, bridging the gap between rich multimodal supervision and the strict constraints of routine clinical deployment. Code is available at: https://github.com/antonioscardace/MC-LDM.

AI.tldr: MC-LDM 提出了一种新颖的方法，用于患者特定的 MRI 合成，通过利用多种生物标志物并在推理时仅依赖基础 MRI 和 APOE4，提高了区域体积 MAE 并首次在基于扩散的框架中利用了多种先验知识。
AI.motivation: 当前的单模态 MRI 预测方法未能充分利用其他互补的多模态生物标志物，MC-LDM 的目标是通过结合多种生物标志物来提高 MRI 预测的准确性。
AI.method: MC-LDM 采用了一种 Latent Diffusion Model 被细调为数据高效学习；通过低秩适应（LoRA），引入了多模态条件；并添加了辅助预测器来估计 MRI 特征和患者变量中的未观测到的多模态生物标志物。这种方法显著降低了 AD 进展中的区域体积预测误差。
AI.result: 在 Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) 数据集上训练的 MC-LDM 预测结果优于其他基线方法，特别是在独立测试集上，平均减少了 18% 的区域体积 MAE。
AI.conclusion: MC-LDM 是第一个利用多种先验知识进行 MRI 预测的基于扩散的方法，它展示了多模态信号如何帮助生成患者特定的 AD 路径，并弥合了丰富的多模态监督与实际临床部署的严格限制之间的差距。

title: SpecMRL: Redesign Matryoshka Representation Learning within Parametric Spectrum
summary: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) is designed to support flexible representation sizes by jointly optimizing nested prefixes. While effective, this design lacks an explicit constraint to ensure that the leading portion provides a suitable compact encoding. To address this, we propose SpecMRL, which reorganizes the feature space to enable more effective prefix readout. Specifically, we extend MRL with a parameter-derived spectral basis organized with feature importance. SpecMRL otherwise follows standard MRL, with prefix readout performed in the learned spectral space. Experiments on MTEB show that SpecMRL outperforms MRL at all evaluated reduced dimensions, with larger gains under more aggressive compression. These results suggest that the learned spectral basis better prioritizes informative directions, enabling more effective representation compression. Notably, SpecMRL extends the performance frontier of MRL, surpassing full-dimensional MRL with only half the embedding dimensions.

AI.tldr: SpecMRL 通过重新组织特征空间，增强了表示学习的前缀读取效果，实验表明 SpecMRL 在所有压缩维度下性能均优于 MRL，尤其在更剧烈的压缩下优势明显。
AI.motivation: 当前的 Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) 设计虽然有效，但缺乏确保前缀提供适合紧凑编码的显式约束。SpecMRL 的引入正是为了解决这一问题。
AI.method: SpecMRL 通过引入参数衍生的谱基作为特征重要性的组织形式，使前缀读取能够在学习到的谱空间中进行。
AI.result: 在 MTEB 上的实验显示，SpecMRL 在所有评估的压缩维度下均优于 MRL，特别是在更剧烈的压缩条件下，性能提升更为显著。此外，SpecMRL 仅使用 MRL 半数的嵌入维度便达到了更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: SpecMRL 通过优化特征空间的组织，改善了 MRL 的表示压缩效果，为高效率表示学习提供了新的解决方案。

title: TimesJev: Thinking Fast on Time Series with System 1 Sufficiency
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for time series reasoning, while models that reason over time series are usually with long chains of thought. However, this process often consumes thousands of tokens, directly leading to substantial latency during inference. In contrast, System 1 models such as Jev make decisions instantly and can naturally be an alternative, but raw time series are not compatible with the embedding space of these models, thus hindering the reasoning performance, especially when input series contain thousands of numeric points. In this paper, we make a very early attempt to propose a time series System 1 model, namely TimesJev. Specifically, we first formalize System 1 sufficiency in time series reasoning, which motivates a compressed representation for time series with key frequency patterns preserved. To construct this representation, we derive a dimension reduction objective that combines (i) a sufficiency divergence that measures the core information lost during compression, and (ii) a realizability divergence that quantifies the incompatibility of the System 1 model to the optimal prediction given this representation. We optimize this objective by learning time series compression with a gating mechanism for sufficiency, and then aligning the selected representation with the embedding space for realizability. Finally, experiments on 13 datasets demonstrate that TimesJev outperforms reasoning models by over 62% with 62.9% less inference time than their fine-tuned versions on average.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为TimesJev的时间序列System 1模型，通过保留关键频率模式并优化维度减少目标，在压缩时间序列的同时保持其核心信息，从而提高推理性能并减少推理时间。
AI.motivation: 探讨在时间序列推理中如何采用System 1模型进行高效决策，以及如何在这类模型中嵌入时间序列数据，以解决因长链推理导致的延迟问题。
AI.method: 论文首先提出了时间序列System 1模型的必要性，接着定义了一个结合重要性损失和可实现性的压缩目标，通过门控机制学习时间序列压缩，并将选择的表示与嵌入空间对齐。最后，通过13个数据集的实验验证了TimesJev的效果。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，TimesJev在平均减少了62.9%的推理时间的同时，对比推理模型的性能提高了62%以上。
AI.conclusion: 提出了TimeJev模型，证明了在时间序列推理中利用System 1模型进行高效推理的可行性，并实验证明了其有效性和优越性。

title: PRIMA: Pose Refined Inductive Motion Adapter for Zero Shot Social Bodily Behavior Recognition
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026)
summary: Recognizing fine-grained bodily behaviors, such as self-grooming, postural shifts, and backchanneling, is a useful intermediate step for computational social signal analysis. But the behaviors that matter vary across social contexts, and retraining a model for each new taxonomy is expensive. Vision-language models (VLMs) can adapt to new categories through text prompts, yet they lack sensitivity to body structure and often confuse subtle postural distinctions. We propose PRIMA (Pose Refined Inductive Motion Adapter), a lightweight module that injects a body-structure prior into frozen VLMs using human pose as a training-time supervisory signal, requiring no pose input at inference. PRIMA separates a model-specific projection head from a shared core that encodes transferable body-configuration knowledge; adapting to a new VLM requires retraining only the head. We train PRIMA on a micro-action dataset and evaluate entirely through zero-shot prompting. The adapter improves recognition on its training domain, transfers to additional VLM backbones at different scales with the core frozen, and generalizes to two unseen target datasets from social psychology and daily activity recognition. In a supporting downstream study, the improved behavior predictions also yield higher correlations with human ratings of rapport and dominance in a collaboration context. Within the scope of the tested models and indoor datasets, the results indicate that pose-guided training can produce body-structure priors that generalize across unseen behavior vocabularies and can be partially reused across VLM backbones while preserving RGB-only inference.

AI.tldr: PRIMA 提出了一种轻量级模块，通过人类姿态注入体结构先验到冻结的视觉-语言模型中，无需推理时输入姿态，能够提高细粒度身体行为识别的性能，并促进模型在多个视觉-语言模型基础架构之间的迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有方法识别社交信号中的细粒度身体行为昂贵且效率低下，而视觉-语言模型（VLM）依赖文本提示进行新类别的适应，但缺乏对身体结构的敏感性且容易混淆微妙的姿势差异。因此，提出 PRIMA 模块解决这些问题。
AI.method: PRIMA 使用冻结合成型的 VLMs，通过人类姿态作为训练时的 supervisory 信号注入体结构先验。该模块将模型特定的投影头和共享的核心（编码转移的身体配置知识）分开，只需重新训练头部即可适应新的 VLM。PRIMA 在一个微动作用数据集上进行训练，并仅通过零样本提示进行评估。
AI.result: PRIMA 在训练领域内提高了身体行为识别，冻结核心的同时将基础架构不同的 VLM 转移到了不同规模上，且能够推广到两个未见的目标数据集从社会心理学和日常活动识别领域。
AI.conclusion: PRIMA 的结果表明，姿态导向的训练可以产生跨未见行为词汇表通用的体结构先验，并可在 Visual-Language 模型基础架构之间部分重用，同时保持仅 RGB 推理。

title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
summary: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately $1.86\times$ end-to-end inference speedup and a $66\times$ reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.

AI.tldr: MemT-1.0是一种新的架构，通过将记忆内化为模型计算的一部分，推动了基础模型的记忆能力。该模型采用了Gated DeltaNet-2和Mixture-of-Storage扩展内存容量，并通过两阶段训练实现高效存储和快速推理，同时保持了良好的通用能力。
AI.motivation: 当前的模型在处理长历史信息时存在挑战，特别是需要依赖外部存储时。MemT-1.0的目标是将内存内部化，使其成为基础模型的一部分，从而使模型能够持续积累和利用信息。
AI.method: MemT-1.0基于Metis架构，使用Gated DeltaNet-2处理稳定的时间戳级记忆更新，并引入Mixture-of-Storage以扩展内存容量。通过两阶段训练，先进行持续预训练，再进行后训练，模型利用了大量训练数据和高效的训练与推理基础设施。
AI.result: MemT-1.0模型在网络参数和检索增强方法上都表现出色。在128K历史长度下，MemT-1.0-Nano相比全上下文KV缓存实现了大约1.86倍的端到端推理加速和66倍的持续存储减少。此外，模型通过内化检索过程化的经验，提高了执行性任务的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 这项研究通过内部化内存极大地改进了模型的记忆能力，这代表着记忆本生演化的实用步骤。

title: Understanding When Reflective Prompt and Skill Optimization Helps on Locally Served Reasoning Models: A Two-Model Study of GEPA and SkillOpt
summary: Reflective text-space optimizers such as GEPA and SkillOpt have reported large gains on frontier and mid-size models. We test replication across two reasoning-native target-serving configurations: DeepSeek V4 Flash through DwarfStar and Qwen3.8-27B through LM Studio. For each target, we evaluate the same held-out tasks and four conditions - minimal baseline, GEPA prompt, SkillOpt skill, and manually engineered prompt - on HotpotQA (n=500 per condition) and MATH-500 (n=250). In the primary Qwen v2 rerun under the same frozen protocol, GEPA selects the HotpotQA seed and exactly reproduces baseline behavior, whereas SkillOpt's validation gain reverses into held-out degradation. On MATH-500, GEPA raises exact match from 0.828 to 0.904 while reducing latency but increasing token consumption, so lower response time does not imply lower token cost. DeepSeek likewise shows its strongest GEPA effect on MATH-500 (0.852 to 0.908). Across both targets, GEPA's strongest gains occur on MATH-500, while neither optimizer improves the HotpotQA baseline. Optimization is therefore task- and method-dependent, and validation gains may reverse on held-out evaluation. An earlier Qwen run is retained as serving-sensitivity evidence. These results suggest that textual headroom for a model-task pair and the observed effect of a text-space optimizer are more informative when decomposed into content/reasoning, answer-realization/evaluator alignment, and serving-completion/reliability. The cross-benchmark pattern further suggests that optimization may benefit from low-ambiguity, actionable evaluation signals.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两种Reasoning-native 的目标服务配置对GEPA和SkillOpt进行了复制测试，结果显示这些优化器在不同的任务和模型上表现出不同的效果。
AI.motivation: 研究显示了GEPA和SkillOpt等反思型文本空间优化器在处理前沿和中等规模模型时可以带来显著的改进。作者旨在验证这些优化器在两个不同的Reasoning-native目标服务配置（DeepSeek V4 Flash through DwarfStar和Qwen3.8-27B通过LM Studio）下的表现，并探索优化效果的可移植性和任务依赖性。
AI.method: 在每个目标上评估相同的保留任务和四种条件：最小基线、GEPA提示词、SkillOpt技能和人工设计的提示词。分别在HotpotQA和MATH-500上进行评估。
AI.result: GEPA在MATH-500上表现最佳，能够提高准确度并减少延迟，但同时增加了令牌消耗。SkillOpt在某些情况下反而在保留数据上表现下降。不同优化器对HotpotQA和MATH-500任务的优化效果显示出了明显差异，这表明优化效果在不同的任务和方法上是依赖的。
AI.conclusion: 优化效果取决于任务和方法，验证增益可能在保留评估上逆转。研究结果建议，对于模型任务对的文本头顶室和文本空间优化器的影响，分析内容/推理，答案实现/评估者对齐，以及服务完成/可靠性更有信息价值。此外，跨基准的模式提示优化可能需要低模糊性的、具体的评估信号。

title: PCXR-Copilot: Device-aware pediatric chest radiographic analysis with segmentation, suppression, and edema-related cues
summary: Patients admitted to pediatric ICU and cardiac ICU often require intensive perioperative support and frequent chest radiography to monitor support devices, extravascular lung water, and body-wall edema. Radiographic interpretation and analysis is often difficult due to superimposed anatomic and iatrogenic structures that obscure clinically relevant signals. While deep learning can provide decision support, translation to pediatric radiographs is still limited by high device burden and scarcity of pediatric datasets with clinically grounded device annotations. To address this gap, we first introduce PediaDeviceSeg-1K, a curated dataset of 1,000 anterior-posterior radiographs of pediatric CICU patients with clinically grounded, fine-grained annotations of common ICU devices. To our best knowledge, this is the first publicly available pediatric CICU CXR resource with clinically grounded device annotations for device-focused benchmarking. Building on PediaDeviceSeg-1K, we further present PCXR-Copilot, a device-aware pipeline that outputs lung and device masks, optional device-suppressed views, and edema-related visualization maps and scalar indices. The full pipeline has been integrated and runs in real time within the TWIST platform at Boston Children's Hospital, demonstrating feasibility for real-world clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 介绍了用于新生儿和心脏ICU患者的PediaDeviceSeg-1K数据集，并结合该数据集开发了PCXR-Copilot设备感知管道，可以实时提供肺部和设备的分割掩膜、可选的设备抑制视图以及水肿相关的可视化图和标量指标，该管道已在波士顿儿童医院的TWIST平台中实现。
AI.motivation: 儿科ICU和心脏ICU患者需要频繁进行胸片检查以监测支持设备，但这往往受到解剖和医疗结构的干扰，使得影像分析变得困难。为了解决这一问题，本文旨在创建一个包含临床基于设备注释的儿科ICU胸片数据集，并开发了一个设备感知的管道。
AI.method: 1. 创建了一个包含1000张带有临床基于设备注释的儿科ICU胸片数据集PediaDeviceSeg-1K。该数据集用于设备定位的基准测试。2. 开发了PCXR-Copilot设备感知管道，该管道输出肺部和设备的分割掩膜，可选的设备抑制视图，以及水肿相关的可视化图和标量指标。该管道能够在TWIST平台上实时运行。
AI.result: PCXR-Copilot设备感知管道能够实时提供肺部和设备的分割掩膜，可选的设备抑制视图，以及水肿相关的可视化图和标量指标。该管道已经在波士顿儿童医院的TWIST平台上实现了实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过创建PediaDeviceSeg-1K数据集并开发PCXR-Copilot设备感知管道，提高了针对儿科ICU患者的胸片分析能力，为临床实际应用提供了技术支持。

title: RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development
summary: Beyond basic tool use and coding skills, effectively incorporating visual references into agentic generation is equally essential for applying AI agents to real-world productivity tasks. We study this crucial capability through webpage development, a practical and readily evaluable setting in which existing benchmarks remain largely idealized: they typically focus on reconstructing visual targets or generating webpages from textual instructions alone, overlooking the more common workflow of developing from visual examples. Specifically, we introduce RefCraft, a benchmark comprising 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks that combine natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages. Agents must selectively interpret and utilize these references while rendering, visually inspecting, and iteratively refining their outputs. We evaluate the resulting open-ended artifacts using independently verifiable keypoints and complementary programmatic and VLM judges. Across nine frontier (M)LLMs, the strongest system achieves an overall score of only 52.12 out of 100, revealing that visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation remains a substantial challenge for current models in practical webpage-development settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为RefCraft的基准，包含300个结合了自然语言指令和1-5个参考网页截图的网页开发任务，旨在评估AI代理在实际网页开发场景中利用视觉参考的能力。多个前沿的（M）LLMs系统表现不佳，表明当前模型在面对此类问题时仍面临挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前的AI代理基准主要集中在重建视觉目标或仅从文本指令生成网页，忽略了从视觉示例开发的需求，因此研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 研究引入了RefCraft基准，包含300个网页开发任务，任务结合了自然语言指令和1-5个参考网页的屏幕截图。参与评估的AI代理需要依据这些参考信息，结合自然语言指令来调整和优化输出。
AI.result: 在九个前沿的（M）LLMs中，最强系统的表现仅为52.12分（满分100），这表明当前的AI模型在处理需要利用视觉参考的网页开发场景中仍存有挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了视觉参考在实际网页开发中的重要性，并表明当前模型在这类应用中的表现仍有很大的提高空间，未来的研究需要专门针对此类特性进行改进。

title: AuDQ: Auditable Data Quality through Agentic Rule Discovery
summary: High-stakes tabular pipelines rely on scattered, static quality checks that are hard to evolve and audit against policy intent. Regulated domains particularly suffer as the LLM-era automation raises expectations for traceability and accountability. We propose a vision for an ontology-grounded, repository-native data quality layer in which rules are first-class artifacts: versioned, provenance-linked to governance texts, and re-playable through immutable execution traces. As a first step toward validating this vision, we present a concrete implementation of its agentic rule-discovery core with two rule acquisition modes (Full-Agentic and Guided) and a human-in-the-loop (HITL) review interface. We define an evaluation framework and run experiments addressing whether our fully autonomous, divide-and-conquer agentic rule discovery produces rules of the same quality and diversity as those specified by a human expert, reporting preliminary results on two real world industry datasets in the finance and retail domains.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于本体的数据质量层，允许规则作为一等实体存在，具有版本控制、溯源链接至治理文本以及不可变执行轨迹等功能。通过验证其代理规则发现核心，实现了自主和指导两种规则获取模式，并利用人机循环审查界面进行评估。
AI.motivation: 当前高风险的数据管道依赖于分散的、静态的质量检查，难以适应政策变化且审计困难。随着大规模语言模型时代来临，对可追踪性和问责制的期望提高，为了解决这些问题，研究提出了一个基于本体的数据质量层。
AI.method: 研究首先提出了基于本体的数据质量层的框架，包括规则作为一等实体的版本控制、溯源链接和不可变执行轨迹等功能。然后实现了代理规则发现的核心，包含自主和引导两种规则获取模式，并设计了一个基于人机循环审查的人机互动界面。最后，通过实验评估了自主模式生成规则的质量和多样性。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，自主模式生成的规则在质量和多样性上达到了与人类专家指定规则相当的水平，且成功应用于金融和零售行业的实际数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为高风险数据管道的动态质量管理和自动化规则发现提供了一种新的解决方案，证明了代理规则发现的有效性和可行性。

title: SlimFormer++: Token Mixing Where It Matters for Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation
summary: To determine where computation is needed in volumetric segmentation networks, we analyze block-level redundancy and stage-wise token-mixer contribution. Centered Kernel Alignment reveals high input-output representational similarity within blocks of representative convolutional, hybrid, and Transformer-style segmentation networks. Similarity-guided pruning reduces their parameter counts by 39-75% while decreasing mean Dice by less than 0.4 percentage points. To examine token mixers within blocks, we introduce Anatomical Relation Distortion, which quantifies how bypassing a mixer distorts feature relations between labeled anatomical positions. Applied to an unpruned candidate architecture, Centered Kernel Alignment indicates high representational redundancy in intermediate encoder mixers, whereas Anatomical Relation Distortion shows that they contribute little and the bottleneck mixer most. These findings motivate SlimFormer++, which uses Selective Mixing blocks with windowed Mamba mixing in the first encoder stage and only residual channel MLPs in deeper stages. At the bottleneck, Augmented Mixing injects similarity-weighted sparse long-range context into the axial taps of a depthwise convolution at cost linear in voxel count. Evaluated against 12 baselines across eight public CT, MRI, and ultrasound datasets (1,809 cases), SlimFormer++ achieves the highest mean Dice (87.84%) and lowest mean HD95 (6.50 mm) with the fewest parameters (5.98 million). These results support stage-aware token mixing as a design strategy for improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in volumetric segmentation. The source code is available at https://github.com/WHHHHHY822/SlimFormerPlusPlus

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析块级冗余和阶段式令牌混合器贡献，提出了一种新颖的轻量化卷积、混合及Transformer风格分割网络架构——SlimFormer++。该架构在12个基线模型和8个公共CT、MRI和超声波数据集上表现出最高的 Dice值和最低的HD95，同时参数量最少。
AI.motivation: 为了解决分割网络中计算需求的定位问题，文献分析了块级冗余和阶段式令牌混频器的贡献，并提出了一种新的网络架构 SlimFormer++，以优化分割任务中的精度-效率权衡。
AI.method: 通过使用Centered Kernel Alignment进行输入-输出表示相似性分析，并引入Anatomical Relation Distortion量化省略混频器对特征关系的影响。基于这些分析结果，设计了Selective Mixing blocks、windowed Mamba mixing、depthwise convolution等模块构建SlimFormer++。
AI.result: 对比12个基线模型，SlimFormer++在8个公共数据集上的Dice值最高（87.84%），HD95最低（6.50 mm），且参数量最少（5.98百万）。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，阶段感知的令牌混频器是一种提高分割任务中精度-效率权衡的设计策略。

title: KEEP-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation in Context Compression
summary: Context compression improves long-context efficiency but may introduce faithfulness issues through an information bottleneck. Existing evaluations rely on QA metrics, but a reader can still answer correctly from an unfaithful compression, so these metrics underestimate such loss. To bridge this gap, we introduce KEEP-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that directly assesses compression faithfulness with 4,102 cases across three challenging settings that require keeping evidence for plausible reference resolutions, explicit qualifiers, and minority perspectives. Experiments show that even with tailored prompting, the strongest models remain unreliable: despite context windows exceeding 100K tokens and inputs averaging only 3.1K tokens, the best open-weight model (31B) preserves all required evidence in only 66.8% of cases, and the best proprietary model in only 61.6%. Performance also varies sharply across evidence structures, so conclusions from limited structures may be biased. We further introduce a metric, Evidence Preservation Return (EPR), to relate evidence recall to inference FLOPs, and find that it peaks at moderate scales (4B-8B), where recall remains low. Additional output budget mainly benefits already strong models and widens capability gaps, yet the stronger preservation of these models comes at a steep computational cost. These findings highlight the importance for future work to investigate compressors with strong information preservation under a small computation budget, rather than relying on a large output budget or model scaling.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为KEEP-Bench的基准测试，直接评估压缩保真度。尽管使用了大量上下文，即使经过定制提示，最佳模型在保留必要证据方面仍然不可靠。研究表明，更多的输出预算主要提升了强大模型的能力，但同时也带来了高昂的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的评估方法依赖于问答指标，但这些指标无法准确衡量不忠实压缩带来的损失。为解决这一问题，作者提出了KEEP-Bench基准测试，直接评估压缩保真度。
AI.method: 构建了KEEP-Bench基准测试，包括4,102个测试案例，涵盖三个具有挑战性的场景，以评估不同类型证据的保存情况。通过实验评估了不同规模模型的证据保存性能。
AI.result: 尽管使用了超过100K的上下文窗口，最好的公开权重模型和最好的专有模型在保留必要证据方面的成功率分别为66.8%和61.6%。研究表明，额外的输出预算主要提高了现有强大模型的能力，但增加了计算成本。
AI.conclusion: 当前的最佳模型在保持证据方面仍然不可靠，且根据证据结构的不同，性能差异很大。因此，未来的研究应关注在小计算预算下具有良好信息保留能力的压缩器，而不是依赖于大输出预算或模型规模。

title: Decision4Rec: A Jev-Inspired Framework of Decision Models on Knowledge and Active Graphs for Multi-Agent Recommender Systems
summary: Decision models, such as the commercial Jev, are language models that return one probability for each option of a question instead of generating text. We present Decision4Rec, an open and modular framework that makes decision models useful for recommendation. A knowledge graph writes the logs of each recommendation scenario as short statements on a defined scale, such as "sold: top 10%". A pool of agents, proposes candidates, and a residual ranker keeps the best 30. A decision model, trained once on real choices of three scenarios, reads them through one interface of typed questions, and a fusion step combines its answers with the score of the ranker. Any model with this interface can be used, and we run the commercial Jev, the released open Kev and Kev models trained by us on recommendation requests. The framework with a trained 4B decision model is 25 to 36% above the best trained baseline in NDCG@10 in three sparse Amazon catalogues, one of them never used to train the decision model, and almost tie with baselines on the dense Steam dataset. Most of the gain comes from the pool, and with a trained recommender it comes from what the agents know about its candidates rather than from new candidates. The 27B decision model adds to the pool 5 to 6% above the 0.8B model in three of four domains. A trained 0.8B open model beats the released Jev in eleven of fifteen settings and is never worse. On MovieLens-1M, a dense domain never seen in training, the gain is 5 to 7%. Code, configurations and trained models are available at https://github.com/marcopoli/decision4rec and https://huggingface.co/m-polignano.

AI.tldr: 决策框架 Decision4Rec 通过集成池、残差排名器和决策模型来改进推荐系统的性能，实验证明其在稀疏和稠密数据集上均优于基准模型。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在将决策模型（如 Jev）引入推荐系统中，以提高推荐质量，特别是在处理稀疏数据集时。
AI.method: Decision4Rec 框架包含知识图谱记录推荐场景的日志、池、残差排名器和决策模型。所有模型都通过一个类型化的问答接口与决策模型交互，最后通过融合步骤合并其答案与排名器的得分。
AI.result: 在三种稀疏亚马逊目录上，带有训练过的 4B 决策模型的框架比最佳基线高出 25% 到 36% 的 NDCG@10。基于 0.8B 开放模型的表现优于发布的 Jev 在 11 中的 15 种设置中，且从未表现更差。在电影评论数据集 MovieLens-1M 上，一个从未见过训练数据的稠密领域，开放模型的改进幅度为 5% 到 7%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，Decision4Rec 框架能够显著提高推荐系统的性能，特别是在稀疏数据集上，而其开放模型在与 Jev 的比较中表现出更强的性能。

title: GroundedVDR: Grounding Video-to-Web Evidence Dependencies in Video Deep Research
summary: Video large multimodal models have improved at identifying cross-frame visual evidence and conducting open-web retrieval, as reflected in recent video deep research (VDR) benchmarks. However, existing VDR benchmarks primarily evaluate tool-use trajectories and final responses without verifying whether a model actually uses the temporal video information or the retrieved web evidence. To fill this gap, we introduce \method{}, an evidence-grounded benchmark with three features. First, it combines human review with restricted-access probing across multiple models to exclude questions answerable from parametric knowledge or a single information source. Second, each question carries structured video-to-web evidence annotations that link the relevant video segments to their supporting web evidence. Third, its evaluation protocol separately scores video grounding, web evidence grounding, and final-answer correctness. Across eight multimodal agent systems, the best reaches 76.0\% answer accuracy, yet none recovers the complete required web evidence for more than 8\% of questions. Our benchmark is publicly available at \url{https://huggingface.co/datasets/hh721/vdr_temp}.

AI.tldr: 该研究介绍了一个新的基准方法，旨在评估视频和网络证据的使用情况，同时排除参数化知识和单一信息源影响，强调了视频和网络证据的独立评估。
AI.motivation: 现有的VDR基准主要评估工具使用轨迹和最终答案，但未验证模型是否实际上利用了视频的时序信息和检索到的网络证据。新方法旨在填补这一空白，通过结合人工审查和访问限制的探针来排除参数化知识和单一信息源的影响，确保对视频和网络证据的综合有效利用进行评估。
AI.method: 方法包括三个方面：1）结合人工审查与访问限制的多模型探针，排除可由参数化知识或单一信息源回答的问题；2）每个问题带有结构化的视频到网络证据标注，将相关的视频片段与其支持的网络证据进行链接；3）评估协议分别对视频定位、网络证据定位以及最终答案准确性进行评分。
AI.result: 在八个跨模态代理系统中，最佳结果达到了76.0%的答案准确率，然而，没有一个系统能够为超过8%的问题提供完整的所需网络证据。
AI.conclusion: 该基准方法为评估跨模态代理利用视频和网络证据的能力提供了一个新的框架，有助于促进这一领域的研究进步。

title: Competing Learning in Hybrid Architectures
summary: Many modern language models have adopted hybrid architectures that incorporate both linear-time recurrence and softmax attention. Modern recurrence layers provide a highly expressive mixing mechanism while ensuring high throughput by compressing contextual information into a fixed-size state, but underperform softmax attention in contextual information retrieval. In this paper, we reveal a Competing Learning phenomenon where different kinds of mixers compete to learn the same function, and when any layer learns a function, it suppresses the corresponding learning signal for other layers. Layer attribution analysis reveals that under typical data distributions, modern recurrence learns retrieval functions faster than softmax attention, causing attention to fail to learn retrieval in most cases. Stopping weight updates in recurrence in the middle of training helps attention learn retrieval. Based on these results, we propose a staged training procedure for pre-training hybrid architectures on natural language. Empirical results on models up to 1B parameters show that our method results in substantial improvement in language modeling loss, common-sense reasoning, as well as a wide range of retrieval-related tasks across different context lengths.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了混合架构中线性递归和softmax注意力之间的竞争学习现象，提出了阶段化预训练方法，显著改善了语言模型性能。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型的混合架构虽然提高了表达能力，但递归层和softmax注意力在处理上下文信息时存在差距。本文通过揭示学习竞争现象，提出优化预训练过程以改进整体性能。
AI.method: 通过实验揭示混合模型中递归层和softmax注意力的学习竞争现象，并提出停用递归权重更新的阶段化预训练方法。
AI.result: 阶段化预训练方法在模型参数量不超过1亿的情况下展示了显著改进，具体表现在语言建模损失、常识推理以及各种检索相关的任务上。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法可以在阶段中停止递归层的权重更新，以协助softmax注意力学习，从而在较大规模的语言模型中提升其性能。

title: FinSafeGuard: A Quality-Driven Synthetic Dataset for Financial AI Safety
summary: Generating high-quality synthetic datasets at scale remains a fundamental challenge for training specialized AI systems in data-scarce domains. We present a comprehensive methodology that produces 14.3 million quality-filtered synthetic training examples from a structured taxonomy of 632,000 scenario specifications. Our four-stage pipeline ad- dresses critical challenges in synthetic data quality, diversity, and realism through: (1) systematic pre-generation research establishing optimal generation parameters via diminishing returns analysis, (2) conditional auto evolution mechanisms that remediate low-diversity batches during generation, (3) a two-layer semantic deduplication architecture combining lexical and embedding-based methods, and (4) LLM-as-Judge quality evaluation filtering samples based on behavioral correctness and tuple fidelity. Empirical analysis across three domains (Banking, Insurance, Financial Services) demonstrates domain-specific deduplication patterns ranging from 9.9% to 40.6%, with output generation modes exhibiting highest redundancy. Our batch size optimization reveals mode-specific diversity saturation thresholds, enabling principled allocation strategies. The complete pipeline reduces 26.4M raw samples to 14.3M high-confidence examples through merge (20.9% reduction), semantic deduplication (18.7% reduction), and quality-based filtering (15.9% reduction), providing a reproducible framework for domain-specific synthetic data generation with rigorous quality control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全面的方法，生成了1430万高质量过滤的合成训练示例，这些示例来自包含632000种场景规范的结构化分类。该方法通过一个四阶段管道解决合成数据的质量、多样性和真实性问题，最终减少到1430万高质量合成数据。
AI.motivation: 在数据稀缺领域，生成大规模高质量合成数据集是训练专门的AI系统的关键挑战。本文提出的方法通过生成大规模的合成数据解决了这一问题，为这些领域提供了可复制的框架。
AI.method: 该方法包括四个阶段：系统预生成研究以确定生成参数，条件自进化机制以弥补生成过程中多样性不足的问题，两层语义去重架构结合词汇和嵌入方法，以及基于行为正确性和元组保真度的LLM法官质量评估筛选样本。
AI.result: 在银行、保险和金融服务三个领域进行了实证分析，显示了领域特异性的去重模式，从9.9%到40.6%不等。通过对批处理大小的优化，发现了模式特定的多样性饱和阈值，为有原则的分配策略提供了依据。最终，完整管道将2640万原始样本减少到1430万高质量示例。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法为特定领域的合成数据生成提供了可重用的框架，并且具有严格的质量控制。

title: From Seeing to Reporting: A Theory of Reliable Visual Set Generation in Vision-Language Models
comment: 56 pages, 6 figures. Code, prompts, configuration and all 67,364 stored model responses: https://github.com/shijunzhe/vlm-set-reporting
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are asked to report what they see: to count objects, box them, parse a screen or pick a click target (GUI grounding). We argue that reporting is part of the visual task, not merely its formatting. In a dense scene with 173 shapes, GPT-6.1 lists 173 records that match every shape, yet the counts it states in the same response sum to 188. From Seeing to Reporting (FSR) is a theory of visual reporting and a set of inference-time procedures that improve the reports of frozen VLMs. It models reporting as a chain from responses to decoded records, constructed sets and task answers, linked by task-compatible matching. The chain gives exact relations for deleting records, averaging their coordinates and switching readouts, and it splits the error of one answer chosen among several calls into missing candidates, lost representatives and wrong choices. These relations guide procedures for counting, detection, document layout, screen parsing and GUI grounding that use the task specification and a shipped configuration, without requiring labels from the target task. On 50 dense synthetic scenes, a one-call reporting-and-decoding protocol cuts per-type count error by 85.2% for GPT-6.1 and 98.8% for Claude Sonnet 5.5. On 600 ScreenSpot-Pro items, a GUI-grounding tier that combines three models lowers the miss rate from 13.67% for GPT-6.1's two-stage zoom to 9.33%, against 12.67% for three such zooms combined by a cluster vote at about the same cost. A plain vote over the same three models misses 12.33%: the other models supply the candidates, and selecting among them turns those candidates into fewer misses. We release the protocols, the stored responses and the analysis code.

AI.tldr: From Seeing to Reporting (FSR) 是一种改进视觉报告的理论框架和推理时的程序，该理论通过链接从响应到解码记录、构建集和任务答案的链子来增强冻结的视觉语言模型的报告准确性。在多个场景中，FSR 显著降低了错误率。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在视觉任务中需要报告所见内容，包括计数对象、框选物体、解析屏幕或选择点击目标等。因此，报告不仅仅是视觉任务的格式化，而是视觉任务本身的一部分。然而，传统的视觉语言模型在处理复杂场景时可能会产生错误，例如重复记录、遗漏目标或错误选择。
AI.method: FSR 方法通过构建一条从响应到记录、集合和任务答案的链子来改进报告的准确性。该方法包括删除错误记录、平均坐标和切换读出等关系，这些关系被用来规范计数、检测、文档排版、屏幕解析和 GUI 地锚等任务。
AI.result: 在 50 个稠密合成场景中，FSR 通过一次调用报告和解码协议将 GPT-6.1 和 Claude Sonnet 5.5 的每种类型计数错误降低了 85.2% 和 98.8%。在 600 个 ScreenSpot-Pro 项目中，结合三个模型的 GUI 地锚层级将 GPT-6.1 两次放大之间的错过率降低至 9.33%，而仅有一个模型组合的错过率为 12.67%，结合相同三个模型的简单投票仍错过 12.33%。
AI.conclusion: FSR 提供了改进视觉语言模型报告准确性的理论框架和推理程序，并展示了在多场景中显著降低误差的效果。该方法为开发者提供了一种无需目标任务标签的方法，以提高视觉报告的准确性。

title: LatComm: Reusable Context Compression for Latent Communication between Large Language Models
summary: Systems that combine several large language models (LLMs) often use one context for many questions. When the context is passed between models as text, the receiving model processes all of its tokens again for every question. Avoiding this cost requires a context representation that is compact, reusable across questions, and readable by a different LLM. Existing compression and latent communication methods each provide only some of these properties. We introduce LatComm, a Latent Communication interface that provides all three by separating encoding from reading: the context is encoded once without the question, and the receiver selects what to read for each question. A frozen context encoder LLM compresses the context into a fixed-size packet and sends it to a different frozen receiver LLM, which reads the packet through cross-attention, with gates computed from its prompt. On 12 multiple-choice question-answering datasets, LatComm improves average accuracy over single-vector baselines by up to 10.2 points. On QuALITY, it reduces the receiver's input by 57x and answers the questions of an article 3x faster.

AI.tldr: LatComm提供了一种在多个大型语言模型之间有效传递上下文信息的方法，通过分离编码和读取过程，减少了输入大小和处理时间，提高了问答准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的压缩和潜在通信方法只能提供上述三个关键属性中的部分，而LatComm通过分离上下文编码和读取过程，一次性编码上下文，并允许接收模型针对每个问题选择性地读取，从而实现了紧凑、可重用且可读的上下文表示。
AI.method: LatComm的方法包括：1) 使用冻结的上下文编码器生成固定大小的上下文包；2) 使用冻结的接收模型通过交叉注意力机制读取包，并根据提示计算门控机制；3) 评估了LatComm在多种多个选择题问答数据集上的表现。
AI.result: LatComm在多个选择题问答数据集上平均提高了10.2个百分点的准确率；在QuALITY数据集上，减少接收模型的输入大小57倍，并将回答文章中问题的速度提高了3倍。
AI.conclusion: LatComm提供了一种有效的上下文传递方案，提高了多模型系统处理复杂任务的效率和准确性。

title: CUA-Lite: An Open Platform for Computer Use Agents
summary: Open resources for computer use agents (CUAs) -- environments, datasets, and models -- remain scattered: without a standard, these resources cannot be integrated and scaled; additionally, evaluation, RL, and SFT cannot share one infrastructure. We present CUA-Lite, an open platform for developing CUAs, built around three standardized abstractions: (1) Unified environment interface, under which we integrate 12 benchmarks across desktop, browser, and mobile, plus lightweight VM-free sandboxes that replicate OSWorld's desktop at much lower cost, providing over 30,000 verifiable tasks. (2) Unified supervised data format, into which we convert the major public CUA datasets, from GUI grounding and understanding to full rollouts, and record our fresh rollouts from frontier CUAs on these verifiable environments. (3) Model harnesses shared across evaluation, RL, and SFT, one per model and implemented for 14 model families. Each harness runs its model in these computer environments, producing the rollouts that evaluation and RL consume, or renders stored supervised data into the model's own training format for SFT. We release reference scores across the integrated benchmarks, and show that RL and SFT through the same harness improve open-weight models. We release our dataset, code, and models, and the platform is open to contributions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了CUA-Lite，一个用于开发计算机使用代理的开源平台，通过标准化接口、数据格式和模型工具箱，整合了广泛的标准环境、数据集和模型，旨在促进CUA的相关领域研究。
AI.motivation: 当前CUA资源分散且没有标准，无法集成和扩展，评估、强化学习（RL）和超精细调整（SFT）也无法共享基础设施。CUA-Lite旨在解决这些问题，通过标准化环境接口、数据格式和模型工具箱，提高CUA的互操作性和可扩展性。
AI.method: CUA-Lite平台包括三个标准化抽象：统一的环境接口，通过集成计算机桌面、浏览器和移动设备的12个基准，提供轻量级的虚拟机免费沙箱，以及统一的监督数据格式，将主要的公共CUA数据集转换为适应环境。此外，还为评估、RL和SFT提供了共享的模型框架。
AI.result: CUA-Lite平台整合了广泛的基准和数据集，为各领域研究提供了统一的标准化环境和工具箱。通过该平台的参考评分界定了基准，展示了通过相同架构进行RL和SFT可改善开放权重模型。
AI.conclusion: CUA-Lite平台的发布有望促进CUA领域的发展，提供一个标准化的基础设施，促进各种研究间的合作，提升当前CUA研究的互操作性和可扩展性。

title: ReDT: Resolution-Decoupled Visual Geometry Transformer
summary: We introduce ReDT, a feed-forward visual geometry transformer designed to scale multi-view reconstruction to high-definition (HD) inputs. Existing visual geometry transformers are typically trained at fixed, standard definition (SD) resolutions and exhibit degraded reconstruction quality and poor computational scaling to high input resolutions. While recent efficient architectures reduce the complexity of inter-frame attention, expensive intra-frame and encoder attention remain largely unaddressed, making HD reconstruction impractical with existing architectures. ReDT addresses both limitations with a resolution-aware architecture designed to scale to high-resolution inputs. The key idea of ReDT is to first map each view to a fixed-size set of basis tokens, compute correspondences in this compact constant-size basis space, and then project the outputs back to the original resolution for dense prediction. By decoupling the internal representation from input resolution during attention, ReDT substantially reduces the computational cost of high-resolution 3D reconstruction and improves model performance at all resolutions. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets spanning SD to FHD (2K) show that ReDT outperforms state-of-the-art visual geometry transformers in both reconstruction quality and computational efficiency. For instance, on the ETH3D (2K) dataset, ReDT achieves a $16\times$ speedup, a $34\%$ reduction in peak GPU memory usage, and a $33\%$ reduction in chamfer distance over VGGT-$Ω$. \href{https://redt.github.io}{Project Website.}

AI.tldr: ReDT 通过将每个视图映射到固定大小的基础标记集，并在紧凑的常量大小空间中计算对应关系，实现了高分辨率输入下的密集预测，显著降低了高分辨率3D重建的计算成本，同时提高了所有分辨率下的模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉几何变换器在输入分辨率提高时重建质量下降，计算成本增加。ReDT 创新性地设计了一种分辨率感知架构，能够将高分辨率输入有效处理。
AI.method: ReDT 的关键是将每个视图映射到固定大小的基础标记集，并在紧凑的常量大小空间中计算对应关系。然后，将输出投影回原始分辨率进行密集预测。这种方法提高了在不同分辨率下模型的性能。
AI.result: 实验表明，ReDT 相比 VGGT-Ω 在 ETH3D (2K) 数据集上具有 16 倍的速度提升，GPU 内存使用降低 34%，chamfer 距离减少 33%。
AI.conclusion: ReDT 提供了一种有效提高高分辨率输入下 3D 重建性能的方法，为视觉几何变换器领域的研究提供了新的解决方案。

title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.

AI.tldr: 通过引入OpenVLHarness，一种基于能力和持久多模态记忆的多模态推理框架，该研究增强了模型在需要外部知识和数值测量的视觉推理任务中的性能。与无工具基线相比，OpenVLHarness在22个基准测试中提高了9.7-12.6分，特别是在使用Qwen3-VL-8B，Kimi K3和GPT-6 Astra时表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉推理任务中取得了快速进展，但许多任务需要难以仅通过内部推理获得的证据。本文引入了一个新的框架OpenVLHarness，旨在通过集成多模态感知和外部知识来提升模型在这些任务上的表现。
AI.method: OpenVLHarness采用了能力层和持久多模态记忆的架构设计，结合了各种工具接口和证据渲染，提供了对异构后端的一致访问，并将工具输出转换为模型可读的观察结果。编码接口能够执行生成的程序，对存储的数据进行计算，结合多种工具的结果。
AI.result: 在22个基准测试上进行的实验表明，OpenVLHarness在包含8个开放和专有的后端中，与无工具基线相比，平均得分提高了9.7-12.6分，特别是在使用Qwen3-VL-8B，Kimi K3和GPT-6 Astra时表现优异。并且在中等推理强度下，与基模型、Codex和Visual Sketchpad相比，OpenVLHarness在最大努力下的性能提高了7.7-8.5分，同时成本低于模型标记的37%。
AI.conclusion: OpenVLHarness通过集成多模态感知和外部知识，显著提升了模型在复杂视觉推理任务中的表现，并展示了其在广泛后端模型上的强适应性和高效性。

title: From Code to Playable Systems: CEGame-Bench for Long-Horizon Game Creation Agents
summary: A game ships when a player can launch it, finish it, and return to a saved world, none of which a successful build guarantees, yet game-creation agents are mostly tested on one engine or on one-prompt browser games. We present CEGame-Bench, the first long-horizon benchmark for complete-game creation across five production engines: Defold, Godot, Roblox Studio, Unity, and Unreal Engine. Agents build each game from an empty project and a design document in runs averaging up to 295 steps and 65M tokens; the document doubles as a contract, and a hidden evaluator accepts a game only by real-input play. Under four scaffolds, agents earn most integration points but usually under half the gameplay points, and their games reach the ending in only 16% of runs, while references built by engineers with coding agents score near the maximum, which places this artifact-to-play gap in the agents. No two engines rank configurations alike (Kendall's tau 0.14-0.62), and the same game usually scores higher on Unity and Unreal Engine, which check more before play. We release Game Completion Boost, an agent skill for requirement-driven playtesting and repair that raises the execution-based score of three models by 14.1-24.3 points.

AI.tldr: CEGame-Bench 是首个支持跨五种生产引擎（Defold, Godot, Roblox Studio, Unity, Unreal Engine）的完整游戏创建基准，评估了多个游戏生成代理的表现，揭示了这些代理在实际输入测试中的表现不足，并发布了新技能 Game Completion Boost 来提升评分。
AI.motivation: 现有测试多局限于单个引擎或浏览器游戏，CEGame-Bench旨在提供一个全面的游戏创建基准，以促进更多跨平台的游戏开发，减少开发过程中可能出现的问题。
AI.method: CEGame-Bench通过在多个引擎上从空项目和设计文档开始构建游戏，评估了各游戏生成代理。评估包括设计文档的合同作用和隐藏评估器通过实际输入游戏来进行验收。使用多种框架测试代理表现。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，多数代理在集成和游戏性得分上表现较差，并且只有16%的运行达到游戏结局。参照工程师构建的游戏在多个引擎上得分接近满分。此外，通过发布 Game Completion Boost 技能提高了部分模型的表现。
AI.conclusion: CEGame-Bench为跨平台游戏开发提供了一个新的评估标准，展示了代理技术当前的限制，并为进一步研究和发展指明了方向。Game Completion Boost 的引入有助于改善代理在实际游戏开发中的表现。

title: Modaliff: A Unified Token Diffusion Model for Any-to-Any Generation
summary: Any-to-any generation seeks a single model that translates flexibly among text, image, and audio, yet existing approaches either require fully aligned multimodal tuples or a shared representation that suppresses modality-specific structure. We introduce Modaliff, a novel token-based diffusion model that learns from widely available bimodal pairs while preserving each modality in its native latent sequence. Modaliff assembles conditions and targets into a unified token sequence, with per-token attributes to disambiguate token identities and role-based positional embedding to preserve each modality's internal structure across sequence layouts. This design enables a single denoiser to support diverse generation tasks without task-specific architectural changes or a shared cross-modal latent space. Beyond one-to-one generation, Modaliff supports multiple conditions either by combining single-condition predictions at inference or by lightweight finetuning on captions that jointly describe multiple inputs. Experiments across text, image, and audio show that Modaliff achieves the best fidelity among any-to-any models on most generation tasks while using substantially fewer parameters and training data.

AI.tldr: Modaliff 是一种新型的基于令牌的扩散模型，能够从普遍存在且双边的模态对中学习，同时保持每种模态在其原生的潜在序列中的特性。该模型支持多种条件的灵活生成任务，而不需要特定任务的架构更改或共享跨模态的潜在空间。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态生成方法要么需要完全对齐的多模态元组，要么需要一个抑制特定模态结构的共享表示。这些限制使得模型在灵活处理不同模态之间的转换时受到限制。因此，研究团队引入了 Modaliff，旨在提高多模态生成的灵活性和效性。
AI.method: Modaliff 采用一种新颖的设计，将条件和目标组合成统一的令牌序列，并为每个令牌定义属性以区分令牌身份，同时使用基于角色的位置嵌入来保持每种模态在序列布局中的内部结构。此外，它通过组合单条件预测或对集中描述多个输入的字幕进行轻量级微调，支持多种条件。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Modaliff 在大多数生成任务中实现了最佳保真度，使用了远少于参数和训练数据的数量。
AI.conclusion: 这表明 Modaliff 能够在无需特定任务架构变化或共享跨模态潜在空间的情况下支持多种生成任务。

title: Reliable Before Profitable: QuantHarness for Governing Financial Strategy Development with LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents can turn natural-language financial research requests into executable and backtested strategies, but a successful run may still implement the wrong rule, use information unavailable at decision time, or obscure how repairs and candidate selection changed the strategy. Because these failures arise throughout development, final code and performance metrics alone are insufficient to establish either fidelity to the request or the validity of the development process. We therefore address the reliability of financial strategy development at the trajectory level: the system must control how intermediate outputs become downstream state and preserve the evidence needed to justify the terminal outcome. We introduce QuantHarness, a two-layer agent harness in which a finance-specific Workflow structures specification, data grounding, construction, testing, and review, while Harness Core enforces stage-specific information, action, and commitment boundaries. We also introduce FinRelBench, a benchmark that evaluates strategy-development reliability through execution success, requirement satisfaction, and runtime evidence. QuantHarness achieves the highest Task Success at 90.72\%, compared with 74.23\%--84.54\% for the comparison systems. Controlled stress tests show that its boundaries contain targeted violations, while structured run records improve evidence retrieval and support decision replay under the evaluated protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的框架QuantHarness，它通过控制中间输出的转换过程和保留必要的证据来提高金融策略开发过程的可靠性。与对比系统相比，QuantHarness在任务成功方面表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 自然语言生成的金融研究请求到可执行和回测策略的过程中可能会出现各种失误，这些失误无法仅通过最终代码和性能指标来验证策略的忠实度和开发过程的有效性。为了提高这一过程的可靠性，本文提出了一种新的框架QuantHarness。
AI.method: QuantHarness由两层代理构成：财务专用的工作流（Workflow）层负责规格说明、数据绑定、构建、测试和审查，核心层（Harness Core）则确保各阶段的信息、行动和承诺边界。
AI.result: QuantHarness在任务成功方面达到了90.72%，而对比系统的表现范围为74.23%至84.54%。受控压力测试显示，其边界能够包含目标违规行为，结构化的运行记录则有助于提高证据检索并支持决策重放。
AI.conclusion: QuantHarness框架通过限制各阶段的边界并记录中间过程，成功地提高了金融策略开发过程中的可靠性。

title: Residential Construction Image Dataset Using CSI Divisions for Deep Learning-based Object Detection
summary: Accurate recognition of construction site elements is essential for the application of deep learning (DL) in the construction industry. Despite rapid advances in computer vision, the adoption of DL in construction has been limited by the lack of structured, publicly available datasets aligned with established industry standards. To address this gap, we introduce the Residential Construction Dataset Using CSI Divisions (ResCD-CSI) image dataset, a manually labeled image benchmark organized according to the divisional structure defined by the Construction Specifications Institute (CSI). The dataset comprises high-resolution images collected from active residential construction sites across the United States, capturing diverse building components, materials, and equipment under real-world conditions. In total, 16,365 objects spanning 14 major CSI divisions were precisely annotated using bounding boxes, ensuring consistency and reliability for object detection tasks. By aligning with the CSI divisional framework, ResCD-CSI establishes a standardized resource that bridges construction practice with computer vision research and supports the development of Artificial Intelligence-driven solutions for residential construction monitoring.

AI.tldr: ResCD-CSI 是一个包含16,365个物体标注的图像数据集，物体分布在14个主要的CSI分类下，遵循美国住宅建筑工地实际情况，支持AI驱动的住宅建筑监控解决方案的发展。
AI.motivation: 通过提供符合建筑行业标准的、结构化的、公开的数据集，解决深度学习在建筑行业中应用受限的问题。
AI.method: 创建了ResCD-CSI图像数据集，该数据集包含从美国各个住宅建筑工地收集的高分辨率图像，进行手动标注，使用边界框精确地标注物体。
AI.result: ResCD-CSI 数据集为物体检测任务提供了标准化资源，支持基于计算机视觉的研究与人工智能驱动的建筑监控解决方案的发展。
AI.conclusion: ResCD-CSI 数据集的创建填补了建筑行业在DL应用中公开数据集的空白，为相关研究和应用提供了重要支持。

title: MoveBench: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Sports and Health Coaching
summary: Despite rapid advances in large language models (LLMs), their deployment in the sports and health domain remains high-risk due to the absence of domain-specific evaluation benchmarks. Existing general-purpose benchmarks (e.g., MMLU and HELM) primarily assess broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities, but fail to capture critical domain requirements such as exercise safety, physiological appropriateness, personalization, and actionable coaching quality. This gap is particularly concerning in fitness and health applications, where incorrect or unsafe recommendations can lead to physical harm. To address this limitation, we introduce MoveBench, the first comprehensive benchmarking framework specifically designed for evaluating LLMs in sports and health coaching. The proposed benchmark integrates heterogeneous task formats, including multiple-choice questions (MCQs) and open-ended question answering (OpenQA), grounded in real-world user scenarios and paired with structured rubrics emphasizing safety compliance, scientific validity, and training logic. Through large-scale evaluation of 15 diverse LLMs on 809 questions with 5,012 rubric-level criteria, our results reveal substantial performance variability, particularly in safety awareness, structured program design, and personalization capability, highlighting a critical gap between knowing and doing. Our work establishes a foundational evaluation standard for sports and health LLM applications and provides a reproducible framework for advancing safe, reliable, and context-aware AI-driven coaching systems. Open resources are available at https://github.com/SatoSakula/MoveBench.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对大型语言模型在体育和健康领域的应用缺口，提出了第一个专门用于评估此类模型的基准框架MoveBench，涉及多种任务并关注安全性、科学性和训练逻辑。
AI.motivation: 现有的通用评估基准无法充分捕捉特定领域的关键要求，如运动安全、生理适宜性、个性化和可操作的教练质量。特别是在健身和健康应用中，不正确的建议可能导致身体伤害，因此需要专门的评估标准保证模型应用的安全和可靠性。
AI.method: 研究设计了一个结合多种任务格式（多项选择题和开放式问答）的基准框架，这些问题基于真实场景，并配以结构化的评判标准突出安全合规性、科学有效性和训练逻辑。通过大规模评估15种不同的大型语言模型，以5,012个评判标准来衡量其表现。
AI.result: 研究发现，性能在安全性意识、结构化课程设计和个人化能力方面存在显著差异，这凸显了理论知识与实践能力之间的重要差距。这项工作为体育和健康领域的大型语言模型应用奠定了评估基准，并提供了一个可复制的框架，以推动安全、可靠、情境感知的人工智能教练系统的发展。
AI.conclusion: MoveBench为体育和健康领域的大型语言模型提供了首个专门的评估标准，确立了评价这些AI驱动教练系统的框架，旨在提升其安全性、可靠性和适用性。

title: Tricking Synthetic Image Detectors with Amortized Generative Attacks
summary: Rapid advances in image synthesis have increased the need for reliable synthetic-image detectors, yet their robustness to transferable attacks remains incomplete and understudied. Existing evaluations generally examine whether an attack constructed against one detector transfers to another, but rarely isolate how its effectiveness changes when the attacked images originate from different generators. We conduct a systematic evaluation of three representative attacks: two iterative perturbation-based methods, MIG and MuMoDIG, and the amortized generative attack Tricker. Across four detectors and five generators spanning diverse architectures, we introduce a two-axis evaluation protocol that independently varies the surrogate detector used to construct or train the attack and the generator supplying its input images. We assess attack effectiveness, cross-detector transferability, perceptual quality, runtime, and interaction with common post-processing operations. We revisit Tricker and show that its data and training requirements can be substantially reduced, enabling broader and more efficient evaluation. Our results demonstrate that transferability is not a detector-only property: the input-generator distribution strongly influences both evasion effectiveness and attacked-image quality. MIG and MuMoDIG exhibit pronounced dependence on the detector--generator pair, whereas Tricker provides more uniform white-box evasion and image quality. We additionally observe that post-processing maintains the asymmetric transferability topology. These findings expose a neglected dimension of attack evaluation and motivate transfer-aware protocols that jointly account for detector and generator variation. We will release our code, evaluation data, and trained attack models with a responsible-use statement.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统地评估了三种攻击方法在不同生成器上的效果和跨检测器的迁移能力，展示了输入-生成器分布对攻击效果和图像质量的影响。
AI.motivation: 随着图像合成技术的发展，提高合成图像检测器的鲁棒性变得尤为重要，特别是在考虑攻击在不同生成器生成的图像上迁移的效果。
AI.method: 研究采用了两种迭代扰动方法MIG和MuMoDIG，以及一种递归生成攻击Tricker，并设计了一个基于两个轴的评估框架，分别变化攻击模型构建时使用的检测器和提供输入图像的生成器。
AI.result: 研究发现，攻击的迁移性不只是检测器的属性，输入-生成器分布对攻击效果和图像质量有显著影响。MIG和MuMoDIG在特定检测器-生成器组合上表现得特别依赖，而Tricker提供更一致的白盒逃逸效果和图像质量。同时发现，后处理操作保持了攻击迁移性不对称的拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了攻击评估的一个被忽视的维度，并强调了需要制定防转移协议以考虑检测器和生成器的变化。

title: On Counting Graphs for Modal Logic with Counting
summary: In this paper, we study the theoretical computational complexity of counting trees and graphs that are classified positively by a graph neural networks, or said equivalently that satisfy a given formula of modal logic with counting. We also study convergence.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了由图神经网络分类为正的树和图的计数理论计算复杂性，以及这些图满足给定模态逻辑公式（带有计数）的情况。此外，还研究了收敛性。
AI.motivation: 本文研究的动机在于，通过图神经网络和模态逻辑公式（特别是带计数的逻辑）来理解和分析图结构的存在性和计数问题。这对于理解复杂的图学习任务的理论基础具有重要意义。
AI.method: 研究通过数学证明和理论分析来探讨计数问题的复杂性，同时研究相关图结构的收敛行为。
AI.result: 研究得出了在给定图神经网络及其对应的逻辑公式下，计数树和图的问题的理论计算复杂性结果，并分析了这些问题的收敛性。
AI.conclusion: 本文的结论是，给定特定的图神经网络模型及其逻辑属性，可以准确地计算符合条件的图或树的数量，同时研究了这些计算过程的收敛性问题。

title: DiffGround: Semantic Difference-Guided Zero-Shot Video Question Grounding
comment: This paper is accepted by ACCV 2026. We plan to publicly release the source code at https://github.com/steven413d/DiffGround
summary: Video Question Grounding (VideoQG) requires both accurate question answering and precise temporal localization. Existing supervised methods rely on costly temporal annotations, while existing zero-shot approaches are primarily designed for Video Question Answering (VQA) and are not optimized for temporal grounding. We propose DiffGround, an action-driven zero-shot framework built upon frozen Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Our framework first predicts an answer-relevant action cue that transforms the input question into an explicit semantic target for grounding. Action Cue converts a reasoningoriented question into an action-centric retrieval query. Guided by the action cue, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) efficiently selects informative keyframes for reasoning. Finally, we introduce Semantic Diff Refinement, a training-free temporal refinement method that exploits semantic differences between neighboring SigLIP2 embeddings to recover complete action segments from sparse predictions. Extensive experiments on NExT-GQA and STAR show that DiffGround consistently outperforms existing zero-shot and supervised methods, establishing a new state of the art for Video Question Grounding.

AI.tldr: DiffGround 是一个基于动作驱动的零样本框架，利用冻结的多模态大型语言模型来预测与回答相关的行为线索，进而通过视觉-语言模型高效地选取关键帧进行推理，引入了语义差异细化方法来提高时间定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的监督方法需要昂贵的时序标注，而现有零样本方法主要用于视频问答（VQA），未专门针对时间定位优化。因此，研究一种能够在较少或无需时序标注的情况下，同时实现准确答案和精确时间定位的方法是必要的。
AI.method: DiffGround 使用冻结的多模态大型语言模型，首先预测与回答相关的行为线索，然后通过视觉-语言模型高效地选取关键帧进行推理。引入了语义差异细化方法，通过邻近 SigLIP2 嵌入的语义差异来恢复完整的行为片段。
AI.result: 在 NExT-GQA 和 STAR 上进行了广泛实验，证明 DiffGround 一致地优于现有的零样本和监督方法，确立了视频问题定位的新基准。
AI.conclusion: DiffGround 在不依赖大量时序标注的情况下，通过动作驱动的零样本方法成功实现了精确的视频问题答案定位，展示了其在视频问题识别方面的优越性能。

title: LLMs Prompted for Legal Context Refuse More: Overrefusal from Small On-Premises LLMs in Criminal Legal Context
summary:
Confidentiality requirements increasingly push legal professionals toward small, on-device LLMs that keep case data in-house, used for everyday tasks such as summarization, translation, and reformulation. Following standard prompting guidance, a user naturally states their role (``I am a lawyer...''). We show that this innocuous habit has an unexpected cost: such authority framing can make the model selectively refuse legitimate requests, introducing bias through uneven access to assistance. We evaluate four modern small open-weight LLMs on benign legal-domain prompts to measure this over-refusal.
  Surprisingly, we find that authority-style prefixes (''I am legal counsel working for a national supreme court'', ''I'm a defense lawyer'') systematically increase refusal rates by 2--20x over the no-prefix baseline, while a known role-play jailbreak prefix shows mixed effects, sharply increasing refusals in some models and barely shifting them in others. The finding suggests that small on-prem deployable LLMs are unstable under contextual framings that a real institutional user might naturally introduce, and further investigation is essential to minimize opportunities for bias.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了将自我身份作为法律专业人士（如律师或法律顾问）在小型本地部署的语言模型上的影响，发现这种权威风格的前缀显著提高了模型拒绝请求的比率，这可能导致认知偏差。
AI.motivation: 探讨在法律行业中使用小型本地语言模型时发现的意外成本，特别是在法律专业人士（如律师或法律顾问）自我标识可能导致模型选择性拒绝请求，从而引入潜在偏见的问题上。
AI.method: 作者通过评估四个现代小型开放权重语言模型在良性法律领域提示上的表现来测量这种过度拒绝的现象。
AI.result: 结果显示，使用权威风格的前缀（如'我是国家最高法院的法律顾问'或'我是辩护律师'）会在某些模型中将拒绝请求率提高2-20倍，而已知的角色扮演‘解禁’前缀则显示出混合效果。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，实际机构用户可能自然引入的上下文框架（如身份表述）会使小型本地部署的语言模型变得不稳定，进一步研究是必要的，以最小化偏见的风险。

title: ViMoLa: Discrete Motion Tokens for Language-Guided Video Generation
summary: Language-guided video generation often captures scene content while missing the requested motion. We present ViMoLa (Video Motion Language), which predicts a motion prior from language and injects it into a frozen image-to-video backbone. A spatial vector-quantized autoencoder compresses dense trajectories into 64 tokens from a 512-entry codebook; a 28M-parameter transformer predicts the tokens from text; and zero-gated cross-attention adapters condition every frozen Wan~2.2 DiT block through forward hooks. Trained on 462K videos from Something-Something~v2 and Kinetics-400, ViMoLa raises directional accuracy from 0.287 to 0.442 (chance 0.250), with similar measured generative quality. Across-prompt shuffled codes achieve 0.283, supporting the importance of prompt-matched token content. A low-rank adapter reaches 0.428 at 1.45% additional forward-pass FLOPs, and reusing the tokenizer and language model with newly trained CogVideoX adapters raises accuracy from 0.301 to 0.398. Control remains imperfect: oracle codes reach 0.531, compound-motion gains are smaller, and the adapter does not explicitly preserve token-to-patch assignments.

AI.tldr: ViMoLa通过语言引导预测运动先验并注入冻结的图像到视频骨干网络中，通过空间向量量化自编码器和大参数变压器压缩和预测密集轨迹，提高了定向准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的语言指导视频生成方法常常捕捉场景内容但忽略了所需的运动，ViMoLa旨在通过结合语言理解和视频生成技术，更好地满足用户的运动需求。
AI.method: ViMoLa使用空间向量量化自编码器将密集轨迹压缩成64个tokens，并利用一个包含28M参数的变压器从文本中预测这些tokens。通过零门交叉注意力适配器，在每个冻结的Wan~2.2 DiT块中进行条件控制。
AI.result: 在462K来自Something-Something~v2和Kinetics-400的数据集上进行训练，ViMoLa将方向准确性提高到0.442（偶势力0.250），同时保持了类似的质量生成效果。随机打乱代码的准确率达到0.283，表明匹配的提示与token内容的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管ViMoLa在许多方向上取得了成功，但它对控制的掌握并不完全，如oracle代码能达到0.531的准确性，且复合运动提升较小，适配器没有明确保留token-to-patch的对应关系。

title: Fairness or Fallacy? Mapping the Landscape of AI Bias in Disease Detection
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) has several transformative effects on healthcare, like to facilitate clinicians in disease detection and to manage patient care with enhanced precision. Due to the increasing complexity of medical data and the growing volume of diagnostic images, the substantial computational power needed to process such information creates both opportunities and challenges. To accomplish this objective, numerous methodologies have been proposed to integrate AI into disease detection systems. All these methodologies consider different aspects of clinical diagnosis, considering key parameters such as the type of AI model employed, the nature of input data, and the population demographics being analysed. In this paper, we review different state-of-the-art techniques which have been proposed for various areas of disease detection, specifically focusing on bias identification and mitigation. The proposed solutions are distinguished based on the type of input data they utilize, the architecture of model, and type of bias (algorithmic bias, demographic bias, model bias, and deployment bias). The time frame chosen to filter out relevant studies is between 2015 and 2026. Eventually, we review 23 related articles out of 64,389 analyzed from seven different digital libraries. The obtained results guide us to reach a conclusion with respect to state-of-the-art selected studies. Furthermore, these results reveal significant research gaps that can assist researchers in addressing AI-related bias in medical diagnosis. By prioritizing explainability, data diversity, and fairness in algorithmic design, as well as equitable access for affected patient populations, they can utilize available healthcare resources more effectively.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了2015年至2026年之间提出的不同先进技术在疾病检测领域的应用，重点关注如何识别和减轻算法偏差、人口统计学偏差、模型偏差和部署偏差。通过分析23篇相关文章，本文提出了关于如何利用解释性、数据多样性及算法设计中的公平性来更有效地使用健康保健资源的结论，同时也指出了关键的研究缺口。
AI.motivation: 随着医疗数据复杂性和诊断图像数量的增加，计算能力的需求也在增长，这为通过人工智能(AI)进行疾病检测提供了新的机会和挑战。
AI.method: 作者通过从七个不同的数字图书馆筛选出64,389篇相关研究中的23篇文章，系统地评估了现有的最先进的技术，并根据输入数据类型、模型架构和偏差类型（算法偏差、人口统计学偏差、模型偏差和部署偏差）来区分提出的解决方案。
AI.result: 研究结论和研究缺口的识别表明，应优先考虑算法的解释性、数据的多样性以及算法设计中的公平性，以更有效地利用健康保健资源。
AI.conclusion: 本文的结论建议，通过优化算法、提高数据的多样性和公平性，可以更好地弥合研究缺口，从而减轻医疗诊断中的AI相关偏差。

title: CheXFuse: Guided Differential Joint Attention Fusion for Robust Multimodal Chest X-Ray Classification in Data-Scarce Medical Settings
summary: A central challenge in multimodal learning is how to fuse modalities that differ substantially in predictive strength. When one modality provides a much stronger representation than another, indiscriminate cross-modal interaction can introduce weak, redundant, or unstable signals, limiting or even degrading performance relative to the strongest unimodal representation. To address this problem, we propose CheXFuse, a multimodal fusion framework based on Guided Differential Joint Attention (GuDJA). CheXFuse combines image and text token representations within a joint multimodal sequence, where learned token guidance emphasizes informative representations and differential attention reduces less useful attention responses. We evaluate CheXFuse on the Indiana University (IU) Chest X-ray dataset, using binary (normal vs. abnormal) classification as the downstream task. Experiments are conducted under both original-report and masked-report settings, with the latter serving as a controlled stress test under reduced textual informativeness. CheXFuse with GuDJA achieves the strongest mean overall performance across the evaluated baselines and ablations, reaching 95.73% accuracy, 95.79% F1-score, 96.54% recall, and 95.28% sensitivity at 95% specificity (Sens@95Spec) with original reports, and 95.58%, 95.60%, 95.60%, and 94.34%, respectively, under masked reports. These results suggest that GuDJA provides a promising fusion strategy under asymmetric or partially reduced modality informativeness.

AI.tldr: CheXFuse 通过 GuDJA 方法在Indiana University 胸部X射线数据集上实现了性能提升，特别是在文本信息减少的情况下。
AI.motivation: 提出了CheXFuse框架来解决多模态学习中由于模态间预测强度差异导致的问题，当一种模态提供的表示比另一种强时，无差别的跨模态交互可能会引入弱、冗余甚至不稳定的信号。
AI.method: CheXFuse框架基于Guided Differential Joint Attention (GuDJA)，结合图像和文本标记表示于联合多模态序列中。经过训练的标记引导强调了有价值的信息表示，不同注意力减少了对不太有用的注意力响应。
AI.result: 在Indiana University Chest X-ray数据集上，使用二元分类作为下游任务，CheXFuse与GuDJA在原报告和蒙面报告设置下分别达到了95.73%的准确率，95.79%的F1分数，96.54%的召回率，95.28%的敏感度（在95%特异性下），以及在蒙面报告下的95.58%，95.60%，95.60%，和94.34%的性能。
AI.conclusion: GuDJA 提供了在模态信息不对称或部分减少情况下的多模态融合策略，具有良好的融合性能。

title: Towards More Granular Reasoning: Mapping the DSA Transparency Database Taxonomy to Platform Terms and Conditions Using Large Language Models
summary: Article 24(5) of the Digital Services Act (DSA) requires providers of online platforms to submit every content moderation decision they make, with a corresponding Statement of Reasons (SoR), to the DSA Transparency Database (DSA-TDB). Such decisions are classified against seventeen high-level attribute categories that categorize the primary reason for the moderation decision. Because over 99.8% of statements cite a violation of the provider's own terms and conditions rather than a legal provision, the database is overwhelmingly a record of contractual enforcement using catch-all reporting; however, whether its categories actually describe those contractual rules well has not been examined. In this paper, we map the terms and conditions (T&C) of 31 designated online services against the DSA-TDB's high-level category taxonomy using a few-shot GPT-4.1 classifier over 447 policy documents. The analysis concerns how T&C rules are represented in the taxonomy, not how they are enforced. Two findings emerge. First, high-level category applicability varies sharply by service type: unsafe products account for 17.5% of e-commerce assignments and 0.2% of adult-platform assignments, and negative effects on civic discourse reaches 9.9% within the Meta family but is absent from adult platforms, Booking.com, and Wikipedia. Second, the categories have notable overlap among sub-category specifications, which makes assigning a single high-level category to a decision difficult. We argue that catch-all reporting is plausibly in part a consequence of the DSA-TDB's schema and attribute design, and recommend a schema that is differentiated by service type with more mandatory attributes derived inductively from platform governance language.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了31个指定在线服务的条款和条件(T&C)如何映射到《数字服务法案》透明数据库(DSA-TDB)的高阶类别分类表中，结果显示服务类型对高阶类别适用性差异显著，且分类存在显著重叠，使其不易单一分类。
AI.motivation: 提出研究动机是为了探讨条款和条件(T&C)在《数字服务法案》透明数据库中的映射情况，以及这些分类是否准确描述了合同规则；并通过指出当前分类方法的不足，提出改进建议。
AI.method: 使用几次GPT-4.1分类器对447个政策文件进行了分类，以映射31个指定在线服务的条款和条件。
AI.result: 研究发现，服务类型对高阶类别适用性差异显著，且分类存在显著重叠，使得单一分类困难；同时，认为这种分类方法的部分原因是《数字服务法案》透明数据库的设计。
AI.conclusion: 论文建议改进数据库的架构设计，使分类更加区分服务类型，并引入更多由平台治理语言归纳出的强制性属性。

title: Recurrent Vision Transformers for Event-Based Spacecraft Pose Estimation Under Slow Relative Motions
summary: Vision-based object pose estimation is vital for conducting spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO). Recent research has demonstrated the robustness of event cameras against the harsh lighting conditions that often occur in orbit, thanks to the extremely high dynamic range of event sensors. However, event-based spacecraft pose estimation (EBSPE) suffers when the relative motion between the chaser and target is slow, since the event rate drops significantly, leading to data with low signal-to-noise ratio. Unfortunately, for safety reasons, real RPO trajectories often involve slow relative motions (e.g., down to 1 mm/s), and operating under low illumination exacerbates the problem. Addressing slow relative motions is thus crucial to raise the practicality of EBSPE. To this end, we propose using recurrent vision transformers (RVT) for EBSPE. The key idea is to exploit recurrent memory to capture longer-term information across sparse event streams, and to learn the temporal attention span from full trajectories rather than fixing the time window. We developed an RVT-based heatmap regressor to produce 2D-3D correspondences for pose estimation, which was validated on real event data collected under slow relative motions representative of RPO trajectories. Results indicate the superior pose estimation accuracy and stability of our RVT-based method, relative to previous per-event-frame-based or fixed-time-window EBSPE methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于循环视觉变换（RVT）的事件基空间对接姿态估计方法，能够处理慢相对运动和低光照条件，通过捕捉稀疏事件流中的长期信息和学习时间注意力跨度，提高了姿态估计的准确性和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的事件基空间对接姿态估计（EBSPE）方法在慢相对运动情境下表现不佳，尤其是在低光照条件下，因此需要一种新的方法来提高其在这些条件下的实用性和准确性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于RVT的事件基空间对接姿态估计方法，利用循环记忆捕捉稀疏事件流中的长期信息，并学习从完整轨迹中得出的时间注意力跨度。
AI.result: 在模拟的低相对速度条件下，RVT方法在姿态估计准确性方面表现明显优于现有的基于单个事件帧的方法或固定时间窗口的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了一种能够有效处理低相对运动和低光照条件的事件基空间对接姿态估计方法，有望提高空间对接操作的实际应用可行性。

title: CoRS: Fast Neural Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling via Composite Interval State Reuse
summary: Neural solvers for the Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) typically refresh graph representations and update feasibility after every operation--machine decision. However, only feasibility must remain exact at every step, whereas graph encoding is substantially more expensive and can potentially be refreshed less frequently. We present CoRS, which decouples them: an interval-level graph representation is reused across multiple sequential decisions, while a stepwise feasibility state is updated after every action. This two-timescale design amortizes graph encoding without parallelizing action generation or relaxing scheduling constraints. CoRS further develops a feasibility-preserving composite-interval decoding scheme with dynamic constraint tracking and boundary state synchronization, which reduces representation refresh frequency while maintaining continuous feasible schedule construction. Furthermore, to alleviate representation staleness caused by interval-level state reuse, CoRS introduces enhanced static features as a compensation mechanism. By providing more comprehensive structural information of the scheduling problem, these features improve the model's perception of overall problem characteristics. Extensive experiments on synthetic and multiple public FJSP benchmarks demonstrate that CoRS significantly reduces inference time while maintaining competitive solution quality, achieving favorable speed-quality trade-offs under tight wall-clock budgets and low-latency scenarios.

AI.tldr: CoRS 提出了一种解 Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) 的方法，通过解耦操作和机器决策之间的图形重新表示和可行性检查，减少图形编码的频率，同时保持可行的时间表构建，并通过增强静态特征提高模型对整体问题特性的感知。
AI.motivation: 传统的FJSP神经求解器在每一步操作-机器决策后都会刷新图形表示并重新检查可行性，这可能导致图形编码的高成本。CoRS旨在通过两阶段设计——使用跨多个决策的区间级图形表示以及逐步更新可行性状态——来降低图形表示的刷新频率，同时保持可行的时间表构建，并通过引入增强的静态特征进一步提高模型对问题结构的理解。
AI.method: CoRS 采用了两阶段设计，利用区间级图形表示而不是每一步都进行图形刷新，并用逐步更新的可行性状态来平衡这种设计。此外，它还引入了一种保持可行性的复合区间解码方案，该方案结合了动态约束跟踪和边界状态同步，以进一步减少表示刷新的频率。为了减轻区间级状态重用导致的表示陈旧，CoRS还引入了增强的静态特征。
AI.result: 实验证明，CoRS在合成数据和多个公开的FJSP基准上的推理时间显著减少，同时保持了竞争力的解决方案质量，实现了严格的墙钟预算和低延迟场景下的速度与质量之间的良好权衡。
AI.conclusion: CoRS 通过更有效的图形重构策略和增强的静态特征显著提高了 FJSP 的求解效率，同时保持了解的质量，适用于实时应用。

title: Where Do the Gaussians Go? Foreground Attraction for Camera-Based Weakly Supervised 3D Occupancy
summary: Camera-based 3D semantic occupancy models can be trained without 3D labels by rendering their predictions into the images and supervising them with 2D pseudo labels. In sparse Gaussian representations trained this way, Gaussian positions are learned only through pixel-wise rendering losses, which we hypothesize give small foreground objects little weight. In trained GaussianFlowOcc models, the Gaussian density on foreground voxels is on average only 1.62 times that on background voxels. We propose a training-only foreground attraction loss that back-projects foreground pseudo-label pixels with pseudo depth and pulls nearby Gaussians toward these 3D points, favoring Gaussians that already predict the target class; the inference network is unchanged. On Occ3D-nuScenes, the loss raises this concentration to 2.40 over three seeds. Over three seeds, the mean foreground IoU increases from 6.29 to 6.96 and is higher for each seed, whereas the change in mean mIoU (13.53 to 13.82) is within the seed-to-seed variation of the baseline. Single-run ablations further indicate that pseudo-label targets outperform targets placed at ground-truth voxels and that acting on the Gaussian positions alone is not sufficient, and a single-seed test shows that the model degrades less when fewer Gaussians are kept at inference.

AI.tldr: 通过将预测渲染至图像并使用2D伪标签进行监督训练的相机基3D语义占用模型，在稀疏高斯表示中，高斯位置仅通过像素级渲染损失学习，我们假设这给了小尺寸前景物体较小的权重。提出了一种仅在训练阶段使用的前景吸引损失，可以提高前景的浓度和IOU。
AI.motivation: 当前基于2D伪标签的相机基3D语义占用模型在处理小尺寸前景物体时效果欠佳。
AI.method: 提出了一个仅在训练阶段使用的前景吸引损失，该损失将前景伪标签像素与其伪深度一起进行反投影，并将附近的高斯分布拉向这些3D点。
AI.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes数据集上，该方法使得背景高斯分布的浓度提高了1.62倍至2.40倍，三种子实验中前景IOU从6.29提高到了6.96，且单运行消融实验表明该方法优于在真实体素上放置目标的方法。当保留的高斯数量较少时，模型在推理阶段的性能下降较少。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一个有针对性的训练损失，显著改善了基于2D伪标签的相机基3D语义占用模型在处理小尺寸前景物体时的表现。

title: Machina Pauliana: A neuro-symbolic approach to the actio pauliana in Dutch insolvency law
summary: Applying a legal provision frequently requires both structured rule-based reasoning and sensitivity to open-textured terms developed in case law. The actio pauliana of Article 42 of the Dutch Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet, Fw), which allows an insolvency practitioner to avoid transactions that prejudice creditors, requires both. We present a neuro-symbolic model of Article 42 Fw. Its symbolic core is written in Catala in a literate style that keeps statute and formalisation aligned and was developed through pair programming, with open-textured terms represented as boolean inputs where neural components couple to the symbolic solver. A neural routine structures a case's natural-language facts into boolean and date inputs. Neural subroutines resolve the open-textured terms through case-based reasoning over Dutch civil judgments, retrieved through a pipeline that filters on the requirement being resolved and expands along the procedural chain of a case. Segmenting and labelling those judgments attains high precision and recall against a manually annotated gold standard of 100 judgments. On ten hand-annotated cases the neuro-symbolic model handles most criteria reasonably but struggles with the knowledge requirement. Retrieval depth shows no clear quantitative effect, although retrieved judgments provide explicit grounding in prior case law.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种神经符号模型，用于处理荷兰破产法第42条（Actio pauliana），结合了规则基础推理与处理开放文本术语的能力，通过案例法推理解决并展示了高精度和召回率。
AI.motivation: 解决法律应用中结构化规则推理与处理开放文本术语之间的挑战，特别是荷兰破产法第42条（Actio pauliana）中遇到的实际问题。
AI.method: 该模型结合了符号计算和神经计算，使用Catala编写，自然语言事实通过神经程序结构化，使用神经子程序结合案例法推理解决开放文本术语。
AI.result: 模型在100个案例的语义标注上达到了高精度和召回率，但在知识需求评估上表现不佳。通过案例法检索相关判决，提供先行案例法的明确支持。
AI.conclusion: 该神经符号模型在处理开放文本术语方面展示了潜力，但需要进一步优化知识需求评估部分。

title: Confidence-Guided Pseudo-Label Refinement for Unsupervised Cross-Domain Person Re-Identification
summary: Unsupervised cross-domain person re-identification remains challenging because domain shifts generate noisy pseudo labels that are reinforced during iterative adaptation. Existing clustering-based methods often rely on limited reliability cues or global confidence criteria and may impose hard identity supervision on ambiguous target samples. To address these limitations, we propose CGPLR, a confidence-guided pseudo-label refinement framework for unsupervised domain-adaptive person re-identification. CGPLR estimates sample-level reliability by jointly modeling centroid compatibility, local neighborhood consistency, separation from the strongest competing cluster and temporal assignment stability. The resulting confidence distribution is used to derive cluster-adaptive upper and lower thresholds for a three-way selective decision. Reliable assignments are preserved, recoverable samples are reassigned only when an alternative cluster receives sufficient geometric and neighborhood support and highly ambiguous samples are deferred from hard identity supervision. The learning objective adapts to these decisions through confidence-weighted supervision for preserved samples, cautious corrected-label weighting for reassigned samples and label-free representation consistency for deferred samples. CGPLR achieves 76.4% Rank-1 accuracy and 47.6% mean average precision (mAP) on Market-1501 to MSMT17, and 95.1% Rank-1 accuracy and 87.7% mAP on MSMT17 to Market-1501, demonstrating effective reliability-aware selective adaptation. The code is available at https://github.com/Sundas058/CGPLR.

AI.tldr: CGPLR 提出了一种新的无监督跨域人员再识别方法，通过联合建模样本可靠性，确保可靠的分配得以保留，可通过适当支持重新分配不可靠的分配，并对高度模糊的样本采取无监督策略。
AI.motivation: 当前的无监督跨域人员再识别方法面临难以处理的挑战，特别是由于域移位导致生成的伪标签质量较差，且现有的聚类方法可能在处理模糊目标样本时过于依赖直接的身份监管，因此提出了 CGPLR 框架。
AI.method: CGPLR 使用了一个可靠性估计机制来解决域移位带来的问题，该机制联合考虑了质心兼容性、局部邻域一致性、竞争簇的分离、时间和分配稳定性等因素，以动态优化判别阈值，从而实现三阶段的选择性决策。
AI.result: CGPLR 在 Market-1501 到 MSMT17 和 MSMT17 到 Market-1501 的测试上分别达到 76.4% 的 Rank-1 准确率和 47.6% 的 mAP，与现有方法相比展示了更高的性能。
AI.conclusion: CGPLR 已证明了在无监督域适应型人员再识别任务上的可靠性意识选择性适应的有效性，未来的工作将考虑如何进一步改善高度模糊样本的支持机制。

title: Beyond Static Leaderboards: Capability-Focused Evaluation with Structural Diversity for Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Static public benchmarks for time series foundation models (TSFMs) typically have fixed and narrow test distributions. Their repeated reuse encourages benchmark-specific tuning, making reported performance reflect adaptation to the fixed test set rather than genuine forecasting generalization. In addition, a single aggregate score cannot fully characterize model capabilities across distinct temporal structures and input relationships. We propose CaFE (Capability-Focused Evaluation), a refreshable evaluation extension grounded in original benchmark data that enriches static benchmarks with structural diversity and enriches single-score black-box evaluation with multi-dimensional, capability-oriented assessment. CaFE first profiles the original benchmark and defines eight Structural Features (SFs) that characterize its temporal structure. For each SF, it resamples the original data according to its structural support, removes edge-of-distribution samples, and augments the retained samples by varying the SF's salience, producing samples with different structural profiles. After filtering out out-of-distribution samples while preserving diversity, CaFE yields a refreshed evaluation set. TSFMs are then evaluated on this set using both conventional forecast-error metrics and intervention-response metrics, giving each model a per-feature capability profile alongside endpoint accuracy. Experiments on GIFT-Eval and FEV-Mini20 show that CaFE yields stable evaluation results and reveals per-feature strengths and weaknesses that a single aggregate score hides. Moreover, on genuine data filtered by structural condition, models selected by CaFE outperform those chosen by the aggregate leaderboard. CaFE therefore makes model selection conditional on the structural response of interest.
