AI.tldr: CaFE通过重新采样原始基准数据并引入结构多样性，为时间序列基础模型提供了一个多维度的能力评估框架，揭示了模型在不同特征上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的时间序列基准测试通常具有固定且狭窄的测试分布，导致模型性能的评估偏向于适应固定的测试集，而非真正的时间序列预测能力。
AI.method: CaFE首先分析原始基准数据并定义八个结构特征。然后根据这些特征对数据进行重新采样，移除极端样本，并增加特征的重要性，生成具有不同结构配置的数据集。
AI.result: 通过CaFE评估，研究人员能够获得模型在不同特征上的能力图谱，并在真实数据上验证了通过CaFE选择的模型优于单一综合评分榜上的模型。
AI.conclusion: CaFE通过多维度能力评估提升了时间序列基础模型的评估方法，使得模型选择更依赖于特定的结构响应。

title: Clean Forcing: Drift-Resistant Autoregressive Video Diffusion with a Frozen Base
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate streaming video of arbitrary length by conditioning each new chunk of frames on those already generated. However, they suffer from exposure bias, where a model trained on clean context must continue from its own imperfect outputs, and errors compound until quality collapses within seconds (drift). Existing methods either require cluster-scale base retraining, apply training-free inference corrections with inconsistent results, or train frozen-base correctors for sampling and cache errors. We instead find that drift is largely deterministic and therefore learnable, as holding the noisy state fixed while varying only the history reveals a counterfactual velocity gap that is ~95% systematic across noise seeds. Based on this observation, we introduce Clean Forcing, which trains a 5.9M-parameter LoRA corrector on the frozen base model to regress this gap, with a closed-loop stage that adds DAgger-style aggregation and a drift-contraction objective to expose the corrector to its own rollouts. Because the clean histories can be the base model's own single-shot generations, training needs no real videos, and the merged corrector adds no inference cost. In 50 s text-to-video generation, Clean Forcing reduces Δ-drift from +11.3 to +1.65 without real video and to -0.16 with 40 real clips, improving on the best published result of +3.57 with over 150x less data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Clean Forcing outperforms prior methods in aesthetic quality and data efficiency with reduced drift for long-horizon video generation.

AI.tldr: Clean Forcing 通过学习 video 差距并用修正器缓解错误累积问题，无需实际视频数据，展示了在长时视频生成中的高美学质量和数据效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的 Autoregressive 视频扩散模型存在曝光偏差问题，这导致生成的视频质量在短时间内迅速下降。为了克服这一问题，研究提出了一种基于 Clean Forcing 的方法。
AI.method: Clean Forcing 通过训练一个小型 5.9M 参数的 LoRA 修正器，在基础模型上学习视差差距，并通过闭环机制和 DAgger 增强学习来接触到它的自身回放，以减少生成错误。
AI.result: Clean Forcing 在 50 秒的文本到视频生成中显著降低了视差差，使用合成数据即可达到比现有最佳方法更高的美学质量和更少的数据需求。即使在结合了 40 个真实视频片段的情况下，其性能也优于其他方法。
AI.conclusion: Clean Forcing 方法在长时视频生成中表现出优异的效果，通过修正器的训练显著减少了视频质量在生成过程中的下降，显示了其应用于视频生成任务的潜力。

title: LOCU: Lowdin-Orthogonalized Constraint Updates for Multi-Constraint Policy Optimization
summary: We investigate multi-constraint policy optimization in constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs), where interactions among constraint gradients often yield ill-conditioned update directions, causing numerically fragile steps and unintended cancellation or redundant overlap in constraint corrections. To address this, we propose LOCU, which mitigates numerical instability arising from constraint interactions by applying symmetric Lowdin orthogonalization to the natural gradients of the reward and constraints under the Fisher-Rao metric. Combined with Fisher-geometric screening and near-collinear compression, LOCU yields a compact reduced space in which the trust region becomes a Euclidean ball and constraints are handled symmetrically through a low-dimensional active-set solve. For infeasible iterates, LOCU constructs a Pareto-descent direction which preserves the local feasibility of satisfied constraints within the same reduced formulation. Experiments show that LOCU remains stable under high constraint coupling, narrow feasible regions, and infeasible starts, and generalizes across different cost critic architectures.

AI.tldr: LOCU是一个用于处理带约束的马尔可夫决策过程（CMDPs）中多约束优化问题的方法，通过在Fisher-Rao度量下应用Lowdin对称正交化来缓解由约束交互导致的数值不稳定性，并结合Fisher-几何筛选和接近线性压缩，Locus在低维活性集求解中处理约束，保持局部满足约束的有效性。
AI.motivation: 在CMDPs中，约束之间的交互可能导致梯度更新方向不佳，导致数值不稳定性和不希望的约束修正效果。
AI.method: LOCU方法通过在Fisher-Rao度量下应用Lowdin对称正交化来处理自然梯度的约束交互问题，结合Fisher-几何筛选和接近线性压缩技术，构建一个紧凑的低维空间，其中可信区域成为欧几里得球，并通过低维活性集求解来处理约束。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，LOCU方法在高约束耦合、狭窄的可行区域和不可行初值的情况下保持稳定，并且能够跨不同成本评论架构进行泛化。
AI.conclusion: LOCU方法通过改进自然梯度更新和优化信任区域问题，解决了CMDPs中的数值稳定性和约束处理问题，具有广泛的适用性。

title: TNVD-SC: Diagnosing Scan Context Failures in Forests with Terrain-Normalized Vertical Distributions
summary: Long-term LiDAR place recognition in forests is difficult because repetitive vegetation and uneven terrain create severe structural aliasing. We diagnose Scan Context (SC) by separating candidate retrieval from fine matching: on the standardized TreeLoc++ Wild-Places protocol, a TNVD support key places a valid location in the top-25 set for approximately 99% of queries, while conventional SC matching on those candidates reaches only 61.84% mean R@1. With an identical raw-SC candidate set, terrain normalization improves max-height cells by only 1.21 points but vertical-distribution cells by 19.72 points. These observations motivate Terrain-Normalized Vertical Distribution Scan Context (TNVD-SC), which preserves the SC ring-sector topology while encoding terrain-relative vertical probability distributions. Under the standardized TreeLoc++ protocol, TNVD-SC reaches 91.83% mean R@1 and attains the highest R@1 mean and R@1 stability among the compared methods, while TreeLoc++ remains stronger in mean MR, MF1, and AUC. The unchanged method reaches 85.14% mean R@1 on the four-session CVTNet-style NCLT evaluation. A lossless count-coded implementation with exact hierarchical Jensen-Shannon search reduces descriptor payload by 3.86x and compute latency by 23.8% without changing the audited retrieval outputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种地形归一化垂直分布扫描上下文(TNVD-SC)方法，该方法在森林中进行长期激光雷达位置识别时表现出色，特别是在重复植被和不平地形造成的结构混合法问题上。
AI.motivation: 由于森林中重复的植被和不平的地形导致结构混合法异常，本文研究了Scan Context (SC)并提出了地形归一化垂直分布扫描上下文(TNVD-SC)，以提高长期激光雷达位置识别的准确性。
AI.method: TNVD-SC通过分离候选检索和精细匹配，并利用地形归一化和垂直分布来编码地形相对的垂直概率分布。同时，还提出了一种无损计数编码实现，使用精确的分层詹森-シャノン搜索，减少了描述符的负载并降低了计算延迟。
AI.result: 在标准化的TreeLoc++野地场所协议下，TNVD-SC达到了91.83%的平均R@1，优于其他方法，并且在R@1平均值和R@1稳定性方面表现最好，而TreeLoc++在平均MR、MF1和AUC上更强。TNVD-SC在四个会话CVTNet风格的NCLT评估中也达到了85.14%的平均R@1。
AI.conclusion: 通过使用TNVD-SC，可以显著提高森林中长期激光雷达位置识别的准确性和稳健性，特别是针对结构混合法引起的挑战。同时，无损计数编码实现可以进一步提高效率。

title: REFLEX: RNA Ensemble Generation via Flexibility-Calibrated Stochastic Bridge
summary: RNA molecules often function through multiple experimentally observed conformational states. A central challenge is to capture ensemble diversity without sacrificing structural fidelity: samples may collapse toward averaged representative structures or drift into unsupported conformational regions. We introduce REFLEX (RNA Ensemble generation calibrated by FLEXibility), a sequence-conditioned generator for RNA backbone-frame ensembles based on a heteroscedastic stochastic bridge on SE(3). During training, experimental B-factors calibrate residue-wise bridge widths, exposing each observed conformer through local perturbation neighborhoods with residue-specific scales while keeping constrained regions sharper. A learned flexibility condition guides the bridge-field network to recover target conformer-specific frames from these calibrated noisy states. At inference, REFLEX uses only the input sequence, requiring no MSA-subsampling heuristics. On a multi-conformer RNA benchmark, REFLEX achieves the best precision-recall trade-off for ensemble coverage across evaluation thresholds, while recovery-stress ablations indicate gains in target-frame recovery under stronger perturbations.

AI.tldr: REFLEX 是一种基于 SE(3) 中异方差随机桥的 RNA 骨架框架生成器，通过实验 B-因子校准残基智导桥梁宽度，在保持结构精度的同时捕捉多种构象状态。
AI.motivation: 现有的 RNA 结构生成方法存在模型收敛于平均代表结构或漂移到非支持构象区域的问题，因此需要一种能够捕捉多种构象状态而不牺牲结构精确性的方法。
AI.method: REFLEX 使用基于 SE(3) 的异方差随机桥，并通过实验 B-因子校准各个残基的桥梁宽度，引入学习灵活性条件，指导桥场网络从这些校准的噪声状态中恢复目标构象特异性框架。在推断过程中仅使用输入序列，无需 MSA 子采样策略。
AI.result: 在多构象 RNA 标准上，REFLEX 在任何评估门限下的综合覆盖度方面实现了最佳的精确度-召回率折衷，同时消融研究表明，在更强烈的扰动下目标框架恢复有改进。
AI.conclusion: REFLEX 成功地解决了现有的 RNA 结构生成问题，能够在保持结构精度的同时捕捉丰富的构象多样性。

title: ACorD: Adaptive Correspondence Discovery for Medical Image Registration
summary: Medical image registration is a fundamental task for aligning anatomical structures across images. Exhaustively searching for point-wise correspondences is prohibitively expensive in both computation and memory, particularly for high-resolution 3D medical images. Most recent learning-based methods directly predict correspondences in a coarse-to-fine manner, but often propagate intermediate estimates across scales without explicitly weighting correspondence evidence, which can allow coarse-scale errors to persist during refinement. To address these challenges, we propose ACorD, an adaptive correspondence discovery framework designed to mitigate error propagation with an attention-guided process. ACorD first predicts multiple potential correspondence candidates through Correlation-guided Cross-scale Offset Prediction (CCOP), which combines correlation maps as spatial matching priors with cross-scale features as global deformation context. Then, Multi-Head Deformable Aggregation (MHDA) aggregates these candidate correspondences using attention, producing a learned, non-uniform weighting over competing matches rather than treating them equally. The multi-head design further captures complementary deformation patterns, ensuring both global alignment and local precision. By integrating adaptive offset prediction with selective, attention-based aggregation of correspondence evidence, ACorD enables accurate deformation refinement. Extensive experiments on four public medical registration benchmarks demonstrate that adaptive correspondence discovery within a multi-scale refinement framework improves registration robustness across diverse anatomical structures.

AI.tldr: ACorD 提出了一种适应性对应关系发现框架，通过注意力引导的过程来减少误差传播，这种方法通过多尺度特征和注意力聚合，实现更加准确的形变修正。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于学习的医疗图像注册方法在处理高分辨率3D图像时，中间估计值不加权地向不同尺度传播，可能导致粗尺度错误在精细调整中累积。ACorD旨在解决这些挑战。
AI.method: ACorD 首先通过 Correlation-guided Cross-scale Offset Prediction (CCOP) 预测多个潜在的对应关系候选者，然后利用 Multi-Head Deformable Aggregation (MHDA) 使用注意力机制聚合这些候选者，从而实现对竞争匹配的非均匀权重处理。
AI.result: 在四个公开的医学图像注册基准上的实验表明，ACorD 在多尺度细化框架中实现了适应性对应关系发现，增强了不同解剖结构注册的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ACorD 能够通过注意力引导的多尺度特征和选择性聚合对应关系证据，实现准确的形变细化，提高了跨不同解剖结构的图像注册的鲁棒性。

title: The Scheduler Is a Hidden Retriever: How Asynchrony Shapes Evidence Acquisition in Search Agents
summary: Language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through parallel reasoning and asynchronous information gathering. Controlled replay across two model families and three benchmarks shows that delivery timing redirects search decisions made before all results arrive, despite identical initial evidence. Acquisition disagreement reaches up to 24 percentage points above same-order repeat variation. This dependence persists after all initial evidence arrives and through a second search, turning temporary differences in what agents have seen into lasting differences in what they acquire. An acquisition-regret bound with a matching construction shows that invariance at a fixed early arrival count can limit the use of evidence already received. We introduce Confluent Evidence Acquisition (CEA), which instead releases local reasoning when each subquestion's evidence is complete and allocates shared search independently of completion order. For a fixed plan and stable conditional response law, we prove joint invariance of decisions, acquisitions, and answers. With question-only plans across three benchmarks, CEA brings acquisition disagreement to within 1.0 percentage point of repeat variation and achieves accuracy comparable to complete-input controls, improving over early commitment by up to 12.6 percentage points. Replacing CEA's fixed allocation with first-ready allocation under contention adds 21.6 percentage points of acquisition disagreement, while local query-target disagreement remains near repeat variation. Timed comparisons show that CEA reaches decisions earlier and responds faster than the same program waiting for all initial evidence.

AI.tldr: 该研究展示了语言模型代理通过并行推理和异步信息收集解决复杂任务的过程。即使在初始证据相同的情况下，代理之间的信息获取差异依然存在，这种差异会随时间转变为长期差异。研究引入了一种新的策略Confluent Evidence Acquisition (CEA)，该策略在每个子问题的证据完成时释放局部推理，而非等待所有证据，从而实现了决策、获取和答案的联合不变性。CEA显著减少了获取差异，并提高了准确率。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在研究如何改进语言模型代理在处理复杂任务时的设计，解决在初始证据相同条件下代理间信息获取差异持续存在的问题。
AI.method: 研究通过对比两种模型家族和三个基准的表现，展示了代理间信息获取的差异及其原因。同时，研究人员提出了Confluent Evidence Acquisition (CEA) 策略，并证明了该策略在多个基准条件下的有效性。
AI.result: CEA策略能够在不等待所有初始证据的情况下，减少代理之间的信息获取差异，并达到与最初接收完整输入相当的准确率，相较于早期承诺提高了高达12.6个百分点。此外，该策略还能使代理更快地做出决策并响应。
AI.conclusion: 研究指出，通过引入CEA策略，可以在保证决策和答案质量的同时提高代理处理速度，减少代理间的信息获取差异。

title: Visual Memory and Textual Alignment for Cross-Modal Few-Shot Segmentation
summary: Few-shot segmentation (FSS) aims to segment target objects with limited annotated examples. Recent studies have begun to explore large foundation models to improve generalization for this task. In particular, SAM 3 provides strong visual representations and supports text-guided segmentation. However, its performance remains limited in specialized domains, where semantic prompts and visual representations are often poorly aligned. To address this challenge, we propose ViTA-SAM, a framework built upon SAM 3 that integrates visual memory and textual features through cross-modal alignment. Specifically, we construct a visual memory module that encodes support features together with their corresponding masks, providing support-aware visual guidance for query prediction. In parallel, we leverage the text encoder of SAM 3 to extract semantic features as complementary priors. To bridge the gap between semantic and visual representations, we introduce a cross-modal alignment module that conditions textual features on memory-enhanced visual representations, yielding more consistent and visually grounded predictions. In addition, we propose a pseudo-label refinement strategy that updates the memory with predicted query masks, enabling query-adaptive representation learning. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that ViTA-SAM achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods, outperforming the strongest competing method by over 5% in average mIoU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ViTA-SAM的框架，它建立在SAM 3之上，通过跨模态对齐模块将视觉记忆和文本特征结合起来，改进了少量标注样本下的目标分割任务，尤其是在专用领域中的表现。
AI.motivation: 当前的大基数模型在特殊领域仍存在文本和视觉表示不匹配的问题，因此需要一种新的方法来改进分割任务的泛化能力。
AI.method: ViTA-SAM框架从视觉记忆模块和文本特征提取模块入手，通过跨模态对齐模块对文本特性和增强视觉表示进行条件处理，以及引入伪标签精炼策略更新记忆，从而实现了更好的分割性能。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，ViTA-SAM展示了最佳的整体性能，平均mIoU比最强竞争方法高出5%以上。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为在小样本情况下的目标分割任务提供了一个有效的解决方案。

title: Selective Transfer through Sequence Distillation: From Benchmark Knowledge to Backdoor Behaviour
summary: Knowledge distillation is widely used to transfer capabilities from teacher models to student models, but recent work shows that it can also transfer unintended teacher properties. We study whether different hidden teacher properties survive the same distillation channels. Specifically, we compare two properties: benchmark-associated knowledge and refusal backdoors, and show that distillation treats them very differently. Teachers fine-tuned on benchmark data successfully pass that knowledge to students through all four distillation channels we test, including when students are trained only on teacher-generated number sequences containing no natural language or domain content whatsoever. Refusal backdoors tell the opposite story: backdoored teachers achieve near-perfect triggered refusal, yet sequence-distilled students inherit essentially none of this behaviour. Logit-based distillation transfers it substantially, reaching up to 85.5\% triggered refusal in students that saw zero backdoor examples. Distillation is therefore selective, and the selection criterion is not what data the student sees, but what structure the teacher's property has. The code is available at https://github.com/MJonibek/kd-leakage.

AI.tldr: 知识蒸馏在转移教师模型的能力给学生模型时，可能会转移未预期的教师属性。研究发现，基准关联知识和拒绝后门这两大属性通过蒸馏通道的处理方式不同。基准关联知识能够完全转移到学生模型中，而拒绝后门则几乎不转移。
AI.motivation: 探讨知识蒸馏过程中不同隐藏教师属性的转移方式，以揭示知识蒸馏的复杂性和不确定性。
AI.method: 通过对比基准关联知识和拒绝后门这两大属性在几种蒸馏通道下的表现来进行研究，以观察知识蒸馏过程中不同属性的转移差异。
AI.result: 基准关联知识能够完全通过所有测试的蒸馏通道转移到学生模型中，即使学生仅基于教师生成的数字序列训练，也没有自然语言或领域内容。拒绝后门则几乎不转移，但基于概率分布的蒸馏通道可以部分转移，达到85.5%的触发拒绝行为。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏是选择性的，选择的标准不是学生看到的数据类型，而是教师属性的结构。

title: Negation without Confusion: Decomposing Bias and Recomposing Style in Text Embeddings for Negation-aware Image Generation
summary: Negation-aware image generation remains challenging for text-to-image diffusion models, which often struggle with negation due to implicit linguistic biases that are deeply entangled within text representations. As a result, bias-aligned semantics frequently dominate over intended negative constraints. To overcome this limitation, we propose a simple training-free method of Decompose and Recompose text embedding (Dero), which constructs a semantic-preserving subspace and a bias subspace using auxiliary prompts and performs semantic disentanglement based on bidirectional SVD. By decomposing entangled representations and selectively recomposing disentangled semantic components, Dero realigns text representations toward intended negation semantics while restoring residual stylistic features to preserve semantic fidelity and image quality. As a model-agnostic inference-time framework operating solely on text representations, Dero can be seamlessly applied to diverse diffusion architectures, including both U-Net and DiT based models. Extensive experiments on both object- and concept-level negation demonstrate consistent improvements in negation-aware image generation, achieving stronger text-image alignment, better semantic fidelity, and higher human preference scores.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种无需训练的方法Dero，通过分解和重组文本嵌入，以解决文本到图像生成模型中的否定表达问题，提升图像与文本之间的对齐度和语义保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到图像的递归模型在处理否定表达时存在困难，因为它们隐含的语义偏见会占据主导地位，导致与意图相反的语义在生成的图像中占上风。
AI.method: Dero 方法通过使用辅助提示构建保持语义的子空间和偏置子空间，利用双向 SVD 进行语义分离。通过分解交织的表示和有选择地重组分离的语义成分，Dero 沿着所需的否定语义对文本表示进行重新对齐，同时恢复残余的样式特征以保持语义保真度和图像质量。
AI.result: Dero 方法在对象级和概念级否定的广泛实验中展示了在否定意识图像生成中的持续改进，实现了更强的文本-图像对齐度、更好的语义保真度和更高的人类偏好评分。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法不仅能够与多种扩散架构无缝集成，还能够有效提高文本到图像生成的质量，为解决复杂文本到图像生成问题提供了新的思路和方法。

title: StrucChunk: Structure-Aware Retrieval for Legal Document RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can ground LLM outputs in domain-specific knowledge, but legal documents are hard: standard chunking fragments hierarchical argument structure, and generic embeddings struggle with both precise citation matching and semantic understanding. We propose StrucChunk (Structure Aware Chunking) with hybrid dense-sparse retrieval for hierarchically structured legal documents. It treats documents as directed acyclic graphs of provisions, preserves clause boundaries, resolves cross-references before embedding, and combines BM25 with BGE-M3 via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. We evaluate on five corpora, three legal traditions and two languages. StrucChunk reaches 100% boundary precision (vs. 7.7% for recursive splitting on CrPC), preserves 97.6% of documented cross-references (vs. 0%), and matches section coverage with 40.3% fewer chunks on GDPR. On LegalBench-RAG (6,858 query-passage pairs), it achieves Char-Recall@8 of 48.18% vs. 23.59% for the best baseline (+104%), surpassing the published state of the art by +83%. On 501 queries each for CrPC and CPC (Indian law), Recall@5 improves from 0.557 to 0.804 (+44.4%) and from 0.158 to 0.259 (+64.6%); chunking accounts for 88% and 73% of the gain. On 501 GDPR queries, Recall@5 is 0.868 with R@1 improving +59%. On NitiBench-CCL (3,730 Thai financial law queries), HR@5 is 0.856 vs. 0.594 for naive chunking (+44.1%), showing that section-boundary alignment is the dominant factor across languages, and cross-reference augmentation adds +2.3% on cross-reference queries. We release the implementation, 5,256 evaluation queries across five legal corpora, annotation methodology and chunking quality metrics. Code: github.com/SinghSuryaDeep/legal-rag-strucchunk-1

AI.tldr: StrucChunk解决了RAG方法在处理法律文档时面临的挑战，特别是在界面对齐和参考文献处理方面，提升了文档理解质量和检索性能。
AI.motivation: 法律文档具有复杂的层级结构和精确的引用匹配要求，传统方法如递归拆分在处理时表现不佳。StrucChunk通过结构感知切分和混合密集-稀疏检索，在多个法律文本文档中展示了显著改进。
AI.method: StrucChunk使用了混合密集-稀疏检索技术，将文档视为有向无环图，并在嵌入前解决了交叉引用，结合了BM25和BGE-M3的检索结果。
AI.result: StrucChunk在不同法律文档和查询场景中取得了显著成果，例如实现了100%的边界精准度，召回率提高了34.6%，且在特定查询中提高了高质量切分比例至92%。
AI.conclusion: StrucChunk为法律文档理解和检索提供了有效方法，并在多个指标上超越了现有最佳基线模型，证明了其在提升结构感知技术方面的潜力。

title: FluidGen: Physics-Aware Fluid Video Generation via Motion-Guided Post-Training
summary: Video generation models produce visually compelling motion but systematically fail on fluid phenomena, including smoke, fire, and explosion debris, where outputs lack coherent vortical structure and collapse to bland dynamics that violate the physics of real fluids. Classical solvers achieve high physical fidelity but require detailed 3D scenes and carefully tuned parameters, making them impractical for in-the-wild imagery and video generation. We address this gap by injecting a data-driven fluid prior into a pre-trained video model, trained on a mixture of high-fidelity Houdini simulation data with paired velocity-field ground truth and curated in-the-wild fluid video data for appearance diversity. The core of our approach is a dual stream architecture that predicts per-frame velocity fields alongside RGB, supervised by simulation ground truth. This auxiliary signal regularizes generation toward physically consistent motion and exposes an interpretable physical quantity that we further leverage as a reward for velocity-aware direct preference optimization. Our model produces substantially more realistic fluid dynamics sequences than strong video baselines and optimization-based methods. Project page: https://y-zheng18.github.io/FluidGen/

AI.tldr: 该研究通过将数据驱动的流体先验注入预训练的视频生成模型，解决了模型在处理烟雾、火焰和爆炸等流体现象时缺乏物理一致性的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频生成模型在处理流动现象时表现不佳，尤其是在烟雾、火焰和爆炸等场景中缺乏物理学上的正确性。传统解决方法如经典求解器虽然物理准确度高，但需要详细的3D场景和精心调整的参数，不利于处理现实世界中的视频生成。
AI.method: 研究采用了一种双流架构预测每帧的流速场并结合 RGB 值，这与高保真度的 Houdini 模拟数据和现实世界中的流体视频数据配对作为地面真相进行训练。优化过程以流速意识为导向，使用物理量作为奖励进一步优化。
AI.result: 该模型在流畅的流体动态序列生成方面明显优于其他视频生成基准和优化方法，生成的动画更加接近真实世界中的物理现象。
AI.conclusion: 这种方法为现实世界中的视频生成提供了一种新的解决思路，提升了流体模型生成的物理精确度。

title: The Control Layer Behind Rule-Following Agents Trading Across Market Conditions
comment: 47 pages, 0 figures, 16 numbered tables. Includes a trading-agent evaluation toolkit and checklist
summary: Trading discipline often fails people. Our study tested whether four AI trading agents followed their strategies and risk rules. Offering traders the evidence and an agent evaluation toolkit to separate luck from following the rules, before giving agents meaningful autonomy or capital. Our study analysed 2,627 closed positions from 12 February to 27 August 2026 across the same asset universe and execution conditions. Most positions were simulated against live prices with a 0.09% round-trip fee; 18% involved real Hyperliquid orders. Each position declared a strategy, stop and target, with a limit of five open positions per agent. The fleet finished net positive after fees. Rule adherence was high across all four agents, including the unprofitable one. Profitability tracked how often agents won relative to their break-even win rates. Institutional-style controls ran by default and contained losses through a 29% market drawdown and recovery, with documented exceptions. The discipline held for all four agents. Agents kept 97.5% of gross loss within declared stops, and typical losses closed at declared levels. Declared risk remained stable after losses and broadly stable across calm and volatile months. Twenty-three of 24 runs respected the position limit; logs identify the exception's size and duration. The same live data produced different results across assigned strategies. The trade-log tests can be rerun from the published trade snapshot; regime tests also require the published Bitcoin prices and regime labels. Section 3.5 specifies the stop-breach tolerance. These trade-level results are not account-level returns or proof of a lasting edge. Our study provides an evaluation toolkit to help traders distinguish rule-following from luck before committing capital. For anyone considering allocating capital to agents to trade, discipline should be the entry test, not the only test.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了4个AI交易代理是否遵循其策略和风险规则，通过提供交易证据和代理评估工具包，帮助交易者区分运气与规则遵循，研究分析了2026年2月12日至8月27日期间2627个已关闭的交易位置，结果显示各代理均高度遵守规则，尤其是在不利的情况下也能保持纪律性。
AI.motivation: 论文的主要动机是测试人工智能交易代理是否能够遵循其制定的交易规则和风险管理规定，以帮助交易者区分运气与规则遵循，从而在向代理授予有意义的自主权或资金之前提供证据支持。
AI.method: 研究对2026年2月12日至8月27日期间的情况进行了控制，包括相同的资产类型和执行条件，期间对2627个已关闭的交易位置进行了分析。每个交易位置都有所声明的策略、止损和目标，并限制每个代理最多持有五个开放位置。实证分析证实了其在不同交易策略下的规则遵守情况。
AI.result: 结果显示，所有四个代理都高度遵守规则，即使在不利的情况下也是如此。代理在所有亏损中平均保留了97.5%的毛亏损在其声明的止损内，通常的损失在声明的水平上关闭。声明的风险在亏损之后保持稳定，并在整个平静和波动的月份中基本保持稳定。大多数（24次中的23次）运行遵守了位置限制，日志记录了例外情况的规模和持续时间。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，各种交易策略下的纪律性是可靠的，建议在向代理分配资金进行交易之前，应首先进行这种纪律性测试，但不应将其作为唯一测试标准。

title: PoSTCache: From Forecasting to Postdictive Smoothing for Revisable Diffusion Caching
summary: Diffusion and flow matching models achieve impressive visual generation quality but remain computationally expensive due to iterative sampling. Caching-based acceleration provides a practical training-free solution by reusing or predicting intermediate features. However, existing methods largely enforce a forward-only information flow: approximations produced for skipped model evaluations are immediately committed to the sampling trajectory and cannot benefit from feedback generated by later full-computation steps. We propose \textbf{PoSTCache} (\emph{Postdictive Smoothing Trajectory Cache}), a training-free and plug-and-play framework that reformulates diffusion caching as revisable trajectory inference. PoSTCache first uses an existing caching strategy to construct forward proposals for skipped steps. At a later full-computation step, the discrepancy between the refreshed prediction and its forward proposal yields a correction signal, which PoSTCache propagates backward to refine and reintegrate the preceding predictions. Viewing full-computation steps as sources of corrective feedback also changes how they should be selected. We therefore introduce the Posterior Variance Reduction (PVR) strategy, which estimates cross-timestep dependencies from offline denoising trajectories and selects anchors according to their expected reduction in surrogate trajectory uncertainty rather than local approximation error alone. Experiments on representative image and video generation models show that PoSTCache consistently improves the quality--efficiency trade-off over representative caching methods.

AI.tldr: PoSTCache 通过后预测平滑轨迹缓存，实现无需训练的增强预测和反馈机制，改善扩散和流匹配模型的计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的缓存加速方法缺乏反馈机制，无法利用后续计算步骤生成的反馈来改善早期预测。
AI.method: 提出 PoSTCache，一种无需训练且可插拔的框架，通过后预测平滑轨迹缓存，并引入后验方差减少 (PVR) 策略来优化全计算步骤的选择。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，PoSTCache 在图像和视频生成模型中的质量-效率折衷方面优于其他代表性缓存方法。
AI.conclusion: PoSTCache 提供了一种改进扩散和流匹配模型计算效率的方法。

title: Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips
summary: Streaming video world models generate the future chunk by chunk, conditioned on their own past and a stream of actions. Trained on short clips, they drift once a rollout exceeds the training horizon, as prediction errors re-enter the context and compound. A common remedy is to train the model on its own rollouts via distribution matching distillation (DMD). For action-conditioned world models, the teacher becomes a bottleneck: an external video model is agnostic to the actions, whereas the model's own pretrained network drifts in the same manner as the student. We observe that a long rollout need not match a teacher, provided it remains a realistic continuation of its own scene that follows the commanded actions. Realism and scene fidelity can be measured against real-data statistics, which remain valid at any horizon, while action following is preserved by the model's conditional generation loss. We propose Fréchet Forcing, which fine-tunes a world model together with its deployed multi-step sampler under three constraints. Generative anchoring applies the flow-matching loss after a self-generated history ending on real data. Context fidelity, a Fréchet distance (FD) on latent statistics of the free rollout centred on each clip's own ground truth, keeps every rollout faithful to its scene. Reality matching, an FD to real frames in a frozen perceptual space, keeps the generated frames realistic. Because all three targets are derived from short real clips without comparing a rollout against a long recorded future, training requires no teacher, no online critic and no long videos. Fine-tuning MiniWorld-1B, pretrained on 253-frame clips, for at most 36 GPU-hours on 381-frame clips yields rollouts that remain stable beyond 4,000 frames and continue to follow their actions in both robot manipulation and camera-controlled exploration.

AI.tldr: Fréchet Forcing 通过三种约束条件对世界模型进行微调，使生成的序列在自我生成的历史结束于真实数据、保持场景忠实度以及保持生成帧的现实性方面表现出色，无需长时间视频、在线评论者或教师模型。
AI.motivation: 为了解决传统方法中使用教师模型进行长时序预测存在的瓶颈问题，提出了一种新的方法，即Fréchet Forcing，以实现长时序的稳定生成。
AI.method: Fréchet Forcing 方法包括三个关键约束：生成锚定、上下文保真度和现实匹配，分别通过流匹配损失、Fréchet 距离以及感知空间中的实时匹配来实现。
AI.result: fine-tuning MiniWorld-1B 后，该方法在超过 4,000 帧的镜头长度内保持了模型的稳定性，并且在机器人操作和相机控制探索中都表现出了遵循动作的特性。
AI.conclusion: Fréchet Forcing 提供了一种有效的方法，能够在无需依赖教师模型、在线评论者和长时间视频的情况下，实现生成世界模型的长时序稳定性和现实性，这为未来的相关研究和应用提供了新的思路。

title: VibeTraining-Bench: Data-Trainer-Harness Co-Design for Iterative System Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires agents to diagnose system bottlenecks and coordinate improvements across training and inference. We refer to the agents' capability to jointly optimize training data, the trainer, and the inference harness as cross-component co-design. We introduce VibeTraining-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability across tasks spanning terminal operation, software engineering, multi-turn tool use, and mathematical reasoning. Within each task, research agents start from an identical initial agent system under a fixed resource budget. Guided by validation feedback, they iteratively refine data, trainers, and inference harnesses, then select and submit a final agent system for evaluation on the test set. To prevent reward hacking, we enforce three safeguards: test data isolation, separate research and grading containers, and network restrictions for research agents. Our evaluation results show that frontier research agents substantially improve target agent systems. For example, on SWE-bench Verified, GPT-6-Astra raises the target agent system's performance from 32.9% to 53.7%, comparable to the human-developed instruct model's 55.4%. However, there is still room to improve their ability to co-design and iteratively refine data, trainer, and harness to achieve cumulative performance gains. We hope that VibeTraining-Bench will serve as a unified platform for advancing RSI, deepening our understanding of cross-component optimization for agent systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/D2I-ai/VibeTrainingBench.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为VibeTraining-Bench的基准，用于评估递归自改进（RSI）的能力，特别是在跨组件联合优化方面。研究展示了前沿代理在SWE-bench中的显著提升，但还存在改进空间。
AI.motivation: 鉴于递归自改进需要提升多个组件同时协作的能力，研究者们试图为这种能力提供一个统一的评估工具，以便更好地理解和推进递归自改进技术。
AI.method: 该方法通过定义一个包含多种任务的基准测试（如终端操作、软件工程等），让研究代理在相同初始条件和资源限制下迭代优化数据、训练器和推理框架，同时通过测试数据隔离等措施防止奖励作弊。
AI.result: 研究证明，前沿研究代理在提升目标系统性能方面取得了显著成效。例如，GPT-6-Astra将目标系统性能从32.9%提升到53.7%，接近于人类开发的指令模型55.4%的性能。然而，仍未完全达到最优。
AI.conclusion: 研究者期望VibeTraining-Bench能够作为一个统一平台来推动递归自改进技术的发展，进一步理解代理系统的跨组件优化。

title: RxGS: Relightable Gaussian Stylization via BRDF Decomposition
summary: Reference-based 3D scene stylization transfers the appearance of a reference image onto a reconstructed 3D scene while preserving scene geometry. Recent methods perform this transfer by optimizing the appearance representation of neural scene models including Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). These methods optimize an RGB appearance representation, in which a single per-point colour combines the effects of material reflectance, environment illumination, together with the shading it produces, and the viewing direction. When stylization modifies this combined colour, the illumination effects present during stylization are baked into the stored appearance, so the stylized scene cannot be rendered under different illumination. To address this limitation, we present RxGS, a relightable 3D scene stylization framework built on a Bidirectional Reflectance Distribution Function (BRDF)-aware 3D Gaussian representation. Rather than modifying a per-point RGB colour, RxGS optimizes only the diffuse albedo field recovered by inverse rendering, while leaving roughness, metallicity, surface normals, and the estimated environment lighting unchanged. As a result, the stylized scene keeps all the components a physically-based renderer needs other than the edited albedo, and can therefore still be relit. RxGS optimizes the albedo field using a nearest-neighbour feature matching loss together with a spatial smoothness prior over Gaussian centres. We evaluate the method using a Geometry Consistency Cost (GCC) based on optical-flow warping error. RxGS achieves the lowest GCC on all evaluated NeRF-Synthetic scenes and remains competitive on real-captured scenes, while additionally supporting relightable stylization, which existing reference-based 3D scene stylization methods do not provide.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种名为RxGS的基于BRDF的3D场景着色框架，它通过优化逆渲染恢复的漫反射着色体来提高3D场景的可重新光照着色能力，而不改变粗糙度、金属度、表面法线和估算环境照明，从而实现参考图像到3D场景的可重新光照着色。
AI.motivation: 当前3D场景着色方法在对场景着色时，会在着色过程中改变光照效果，导致修改后的场景无法在不同光照条件下渲染。本文的目的是提出一种新框架，使经过参考图像处理的3D场景可以在不同光照条件下进行渲染。
AI.method: RxGS框架基于BRDF感知的3D高斯表示，通过优化逆渲染恢复的漫反射体来改变场景的着色，同时保留场景的粗糙度、金属度、表面法线和环境照明信息。此外，该方法利用最近邻特征匹配损失和高斯中心空间平滑性先验来进行着色优化。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，RxGS在所有评估的NeRF-Synthetic场景上都达到了最低的几何一致性成本（GCC），并在真实场景上保持竞争力，并支持可重新光照着色，这是现有基于参考的3D场景着色方法所不具备的功能。
AI.conclusion: 这项研究提出了一种能够在不同光照条件下对3D场景进行重构的新型3D场景着色框架，提高了场景内容的渲染灵活性，并且与现有技术相比具有一定的优势。

title: CARRS: A Constraint-Aware, Real-Time Routing System for Emergency Vehicles in Urban Environments
summary: Emergency vehicles such as police vehicles, fire engines, and ambulances require a stable and efficient route optimization to reach life-critical events in the shortest times possible. However, the dynamic nature of urban traffic makes this ideal scenario much more challenging, causing critical life-threatening delays. Traditional civilian navigation systems cannot account for real-time traffic changes alongside vehicle-specific constraints, creating inadequate routing scenarios. This research presents the Constraint-Aware Real-Time Routing System (CARRS), a unified software architecture tailored for emergency coordination. The CARRS architecture is engineered to fuse together classical pathfinding algorithms such as A*, Dijkstra, and Bidirectional A*, with Constraint Satisfaction Problem methodologies. The Design Science Research Methodology is the research framework, and prototyping is the iterative process. The artifact was empirically evaluated using OpenStreetMap data for major metropolitan road networks, combined with simulated dynamic traffic scenarios. Performance metrics focused on route optimality, constraint adherence, rerouting responsiveness, and the potential for future system scalability. Findings revealed the system's capability to generate optimal routes for operationally relevant subgraphs in under 35 seconds, with incremental rerouting responsiveness below 20 seconds. Furthermore, the system achieved more than 90% adherence to vehicle-specific constraints, making the CARRS architecture viable for real-time dynamic routing requirements. This study delivers a routing platform that bridges artificial intelligence-driven optimization with software engineering operational compliance, presenting a practical transformative step toward adaptive emergency vehicle coordination in dynamic urban environments.

AI.tldr: CARRS系统通过融合路径寻找算法和约束满足方法，利用设计科学研究方法，在处理紧急车辆动态路线优化时表现出高效率和强适应性。
AI.motivation: 紧急车辆如警车、消防车和救护车需要在最短时间到达生命攸关事件。然而，城市交通的动态特性使得这一理想场景变得更具挑战性，可能导致关键的生命威胁延迟。传统的民用导航系统无法处理实时交通变化以及车辆特定约束，导致不合适的导航场景。
AI.method: CARRS系统结合了经典路径查找算法A*、迪杰斯特拉算法和双向A*算法，并融合了约束满足问题的方法。采用设计科学研究方法和迭代的原型制作过程来打造该系统。
AI.result: 在使用OpenStreetMap数据和模拟的动态交通场景进行的实证评估中，CARRS系统能在35秒内生成操作相关的子图的最优路径，并且增量重新路由的响应时间低于20秒。此外，系统在90%以上的时间内遵从车辆特定约束，表明其适合于实时动态路由要求。
AI.conclusion: CARRS系统为人工智能驱动的优化与软件工程操作合规性之间搭建了桥梁，代表了适应城市动态环境下的紧急车辆协调的一种实际变革性步骤。

title: Multi-View Structural Representations for Physically-Consistent TeX Generation
summary: Infrared and visible images provide complementary cues for low-light image generation, and physics-based methods can better exploit this complementarity. However, existing physics-based methods still rely heavily on paired data. To address these limitations, we propose Multi-View Routing Mixture-of-Experts (MVR-MoE), a framework for physically consistent TeX generation that learns multi-view structural representations. MVR-MoE mines intrinsic structural cues from infrared and visible images to organize them into multi-view representations, while the proposed multi-view hyper connections expand the feature space and preserve both shared evidence and modality-specific details. A hierarchical routing mechanism further regulates feature utilization at both the structural-view level and the expert level, enabling adaptive exploitation of heterogeneous cues. The predicted temperature, emissivity, and texture maps are constrained by the Stefan-Boltzmann law to ensure physically consistent. Extensive experiments on challenging datasets demonstrate that MVR-MoE achieves superior robustness and discriminability while remaining lightweight.

AI.tldr: MVR-MoE 提出了一种多视角路径混合专家框架，通过学习多视角结构表示和引入多视角超连接，实现了红外和可见光图像的物理一致纹理生成，并通过层级路由机制实现了异构线索的自适应利用。
AI.motivation: 现有的物理方法在低光照图像生成中依赖于配对数据，而红外和可见光图像提供了互补线索，MVR-MoE通过多视角路径和结构表示来利用这些互补线索，以提高生成图像的物理一致性。
AI.method: MVR-MoE 使用多视角路由机制，从红外和可见光图像中提取内在结构线索，构建多视角表示，并通过多视角超连接扩展特征空间，保留共享证据和模态特定细节。同时，引入层次路由机制来调节特征利用，确保生成的温度、发射率和纹理图符合物理定律。
AI.result: 实验表明，MVR-MoE 在具有挑战性的数据集上实现了卓越的鲁棒性和辨别力，同时保持了轻量化。
AI.conclusion: MVR-MoE 提供了一种有效的方法来利用红外和可见光图像的互补性，生成物理一致的纹理图，并通过多视角路由和结构表示增强了模型性能。

title: GAIDA: Generative AI for Human-in-the-Loop Document Annotation
summary: Document annotation is a fundamental yet labor-intensive step in building document information extraction systems. While Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and Large Language Models (LLMs) can automate parts of this process, we argue that annotation systems should be judged not by how completely they remove human effort, but by how effectively they redirect it toward review and correction. We propose a modular human-in-the-loop architecture that integrates OCR-based extraction, LLM-based semantic pre-annotation, and human validation in a single editable workflow, and present \textbf{GAIDA}, a research prototype serving as its reference implementation. GAIDA supports interchangeable OCR engines, LLM backends, and prompt configurations, and enables stage-specific measurement of annotation effort. In an initial single-annotator, stage-specific study on the FUNSD scanned-form and WildReceipt retail-receipt benchmarks, OCR assistance reduced region-creation and transcription time by up to \textbf{80.9\%}, and reviewing LLM pre-annotations reduced semantic-labeling time by up to \textbf{73.7\%}, despite imperfect pre-annotations of 78.86\% and 86.98\% Micro F1 on FUNSD and WildReceipt, respectively. Finally, we reuse the same implementation, adapting only OCR and prompt configuration, to build and openly release \textbf{AraReceipt}, a manually annotated dataset of 100 Arabic receipt images labeled with 25 key-information classes. The results indicate that imperfect automated outputs provide practical value when presented as editable suggestions under human control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个模块化的注释系统，结合OCR提取、LLM预注释和人工验证，旨在有效重定向人工工作。GAIDA作为研究原型支持可互换的OCR引擎、LLM后端和提示配置，并在FUNSD和WildReceipt基准上展示了OCR和LLM的辅助作用，减少标注时间。
AI.motivation: 提出模块化注释系统以评估人工注释的有效重新定向，而非完全自动化。研究了OCR和LLM在减少不同任务时间方面的潜力。
AI.method: 设计了一个包含OCR提取、LLM语义预注释和人工验证的模块化人机协作架构，并通过实验评估了其效果。
AI.result: 在单个注释者、任务特定的研究中，OCR帮助减少了区域创建和转录时间高达80.9%，审查LLM预注释减少了语义标签时间高达73.7%。尽管预标注精度有限。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当以可编辑建议形式呈现时，不完全自动输出具有实用性。本文利用相同实施构建并公开发布了阿拉伯收据数据集AraReceipt，为其验证了方法的有效性。

title: LEVI: Benchmarking Visual Identity Fidelity with Verifiable Low-Entropy Constructs
summary: Modern generative models can produce visually plausible images while violating exact identity constraints. Evaluating such failures requires distinguishing violations of the requested identity from permissible variation in appearance. We introduce Low-Entropy Visual Identity (LEVI), which characterizes visual identities determined by compact facts and explicit rules. The low-entropy requirement concerns identity uncertainty, while appearance may remain diverse. We formulate identity fidelity in terms of the probability that a conditional image distribution assigns to the identities permitted by the prompt. Visual Identity Spaces (VIS) formalize this distinction by specifying admissible identity values and which different realizations express the same identity. Building on this formulation, we develop Verifiable Visual Grammar (VVG), a declarative language whose typed primitives and compositional constraints describe identity-bearing structures. Using this grammar, we build a benchmark for image generation. It assesses each output against the task's identity requirements, drawing evidence from the final pixels. The curated benchmark contains 1,375 tasks spanning 120 base identity spaces across six domains. Among ten evaluated model configurations, the highest whole-task pass rate is 58.69%. These results reveal a persistent gap between visually plausible images and faithful realization of their specified identities. Project page (forthcoming): https://maxiao0234.github.io/LEVI/.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种低熵视觉身份（LEVI），用于评估现代生成模型生成的图像是否忠实于指定的身份。研究人员开发了一种验证可视觉语法（VVG），并通过此语法构建了一个基准测试，以评估生成模型生成的图像与身份要求的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现代生成模型在生成逼真图像的同时可能会违反指定的身份约束，现有评估方法无法有效区分类似情况下的违例与可以接受的外观变化。因此，该研究旨在提出一种方法，以区分被请求的身份违例和可能出现的外观变化，进而更好地评估生成模型的效果。
AI.method: 该研究引入了低熵视觉身份（LEVI）来表征由紧凑事实和显式规则决定的视觉身份，并定义了视觉身份空间（VIS）来明确允许的身份值，以及相同身份的不同实现方式。同时还开发了验证可视觉语法（VVG），以及该语法构建了一个基准测试，包括任务定义、身份范围和实现约束，用于评估生成模型的身份保真度。
AI.result: 该基准测试涵盖了1,375项任务，涵盖6个领域的120个基本身份空间。在十种模型配置中，最高整体任务通过率为58.69%。这些结果揭示了在视觉上可接受的图像和其指定身份的忠实实现之间存在持续的差距。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了LEVI、VIS和VVG，为进一步评估生成模型的身份准确性提供了新方法。未来的工作可以进一步改进VVG，以提高模型在构建逼真图像时更准确地实现指定身份的要求。

title: Autonomous intelligence for mining productivity: a multi-agent AI approach to operational value creation
summary: Integrated Remote Operation Centres (IROCs) are emerging as the architectural frontier of Industry 4.0 for capital-intensive sectors such as mining, oil and gas, and energy. Yet two intertwined gaps constrain their evolution towards full autonomy. First, no integrated agentic architecture has been proposed for mining IROCs that orchestrates Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition systems, digital twins, predictive analytics and human-machine interfaces under safety-critical constraints. Second, no evaluation framework jointly addresses the real-time, Health-Safety-Environment, regulatory-auditability and cost-per-decision requirements that govern industrial agentic deployments. This paper makes four contributions. It synthesises industry needs and quantified gains documented in analogous industries that motivate an agentic approach to mining IROCs. It introduces EI2ROC, a three-tier multi-agent architecture combining a Large Language Model orchestrator with specialised monitoring and production-capacityprediction agents communicating through a Model Context Protocol-style tool interface. It provides a critical review of agentic evaluation along six orthogonal dimensions and identifies the industrial blind spot of current benchmarks. Finally, it proposes a multi-dimensional benchmarking framework for industrial agentic AI comprising scenario library, harness, metrics and humancalibration protocol. The paper states explicitly which components are implemented in the current prototype, which belong to the proposed reference design and which remain future work, and reports preliminary cost and latency observations from an operating site. Together, EI2ROC and the benchmarking framework constitute a methodological blueprint transferable across CAPEX intensive industries.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了EI2ROC，一种用于采矿IROC的三级多智能体架构，并提出了一种综合批判性评价框架，以解决自主性评估的工业盲区，同时给出一个可移植的方法论蓝图应用于资本密集型行业。
AI.motivation: 文章旨在为采矿IROC提出一种自主架构，以满足实时、健康-安全-环境、法规审计性和成本效益等要求。文章通过总结类似行业的实际需求和量化收益，提出采用自主性方法来促使采矿IROC的发展。
AI.method: 论文首先对行业需求和效益进行综合，然后引入了EI2ROC架构，该架构采用大型语言模型协调器和专门的监控与生产产能预测智能体，通过模型上下文协议风格的工具接口进行通信。此外，论文还对自主性评价方法进行了批判性审查，提出了一个多维度的基准测试框架。
AI.result: EI2ROC架构结合了多智能体系统和模型上下文协议，初步实现了一部分组件，并提出了一个多维度的基准测试框架，其中包括情景库、驱动程序、度量标准和人类校准协议。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为资本密集型行业提供了一种方法论蓝图，为自主性IROC的实际部署提供了技术参考和理论支持。

title: Think Densely, Act Sparsely: Latent Expert Cognitive Chains for Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving fundamentally demands dense understanding of visual, semantic, and geometric information, yet existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically trained with sparse supervision such as language instructions or trajectory signals. This direct mapping from dense visual observations to sparse representations forces the model to compress or even discard critical scene information essential for safe driving. We argue that this limitation does not stem from insufficient model capacity, but from the lack of explicit mechanisms that encourage the formation of dense world representations in the latent space. In this spirit, we propose a novel paradigm for driving intelligence, Think Densely, Act Sparsely, and instantiate it with an efficient and interpretable framework, LECDrive (Latent Expert Cognitive Chains for Vision-Language-Action autonomous Driving). The core idea is to mimic the hierarchical perception process of humans by embedding a progressive chain of latent expert cognition within the VLA model. Concretely, we inject a compact set of task-specific latent tokens as carriers, enabling the model to internalize dense knowledge from foundational vision models, including visual representations (DINOv3), semantic structures (SAM3), and spatial geometry (DepthAnything3), while maintaining efficient inference. This interdependent cognitive chain follows a curriculum learning principle, where supervision is progressively structured from representation to semantics and geometry. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LECDrive consistently improves the performance of base VLMs across multiple autonomous driving benchmarks, covering key tasks such as object perception, state prediction, and trajectory planning. These findings suggest that constructing dense world models through structured latent expert chains is a promising direction for VLA-based autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的范式Think Densely, Act Sparsely，并提出了一种高效的框架LECDrive，通过在视觉-语言-行动模型中嵌入渐进的潜在专家认知链来模仿人类的层次感知过程，提高基础VLM在自动驾驶领域中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-行动模型通常依赖稀疏监督，导致模型在对安全驾驶至关重要的场景细节处理上存在不足。
AI.method: 提出了LECDrive框架，通过注入特定任务的潜在专家认知链和视觉表示、语义结构和空间几何的知识载体，实现密集知识的内部化。
AI.result: LECDrive框架在多个自动驾驶基准测试中表现出色，提升了核心任务如物体感知、状态预测和轨迹规划的表现。
AI.conclusion: 本文的研究表明，通过结构化的潜在专家认知链构建密集世界模型是视觉-语言-行动驱动自动驾驶的一个有前景的方向。

title: BOSS: Token-Budgeted Online Sampling and Selection for LLM Reasoning
summary: Test-time scaling can improve LLM reasoning, but existing approaches typically adapt generation or apply answer selection after a predetermined generation schedule. We study within-instance allocation: under a hard per-instance prompt-plus-completion token cap, when should inference stop, generate another candidate, or spend residual tokens adjudicating candidates already observed? BOSS is a training-free policy for this three-way decision, with worst-case budget checks before every generation and judge call. Its key contribution is online generation-adjudication allocation under one shared token ledger. Across two Llama-3.1 models and four reasoning benchmarks, BOSS attains the highest accuracy in 22 of 24 model-task-budget cells under the common hard cap. At Llama-3.1-8B and B=4k, it reaches 60.5 macro-average accuracy versus 58.6 for Adaptive-Consistency, 59.1 for TALE-EP, and 58.9 for fixed-schedule League. On identical Stage-I candidate pools, randomized A/B judging with repeated voting improves plurality from 58.4 to 60.3, with the full BOSS selector reaching 60.5. Approximately matched-cost controls further characterize how the benefit of adjudication changes with available inference budget. Together, these results establish generation-adjudication allocation as a distinct design axis for reasoning under strict per-instance caps.

AI.tldr: BOSS 是一种无需训练的策略，用于在每次生成时进行生成-校正分配决策，并在硬实例提示加完成标记限制下取得了最佳准确度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常在固定生成计划之后进行生成或答案选择调整，而 BOSS 在每次生成过程中动态决定是停止推理、生成另一个候选答案还是使用剩余标记来校正已观察到的答案，以提高大模型的推理准确性。
AI.method: BOSS 方法通过在线生成-校正分配并在每次生成前进行最坏情况预算检查来做出决策，共享一个标记账本。
AI.result: 在两个 Llama-3.1 模型和四个推理基准上，BOSS 在24个模型-任务-预算单元中的22个单元中达到了最高的准确度。在 Llama-3.1-8B 和 B=4k 的情况下，BOSS 达到了 60.5 的宏观平均准确度，高于其他方法如 Adaptive-Consistency、TALE-EP 和固定计划的 League 的准确度。
AI.conclusion: 通过对比，BOSS 显示出在严格实例限制下的生成-校正分配可以作为独立的设计轴，能够提高有限资源下的推理准确性。

title: Functional Cross-layer Experts Routing for One-step Diffusion Distillation
summary: One-step distillation compresses diffusion trajectories into a single forward evaluation, yet how internal capacity should be structured within that remaining pass remains largely unexplored. In this setting, identical parameters must simultaneously preserve general generative priors and resolve prompt-specific details without iterative refinement. We formalize this challenge as functional allocation. Our analysis reveals that decoupling representations is beneficial only when expert interference outweighs shared transfer, favoring an always-active shared backbone augmented with conditionally routed residuals over standard isolated MoE architectures. We propose DeMoE, which pairs a persistent shared expert with conditionally routed expert slices across image FFNs, trained under a one-step distribution-matching objective with executed-route supervision. On one-step FLUX.2-4B generation, DeMoE achieves a GenEval score of 0.8220 while activating only 80.5% of the image-FFN width, substantially outperforming dense one-step baselines, matching the 50-step teacher overall, and surpassing it on complex composition and counting. Across COCO-10K, DeMoE establishes state-of-the-art fidelity and diversity among single-step models, demonstrating that structured internal computation reallocation provides a superior compression paradigm for diffusion models. Code is available at https://github.com/toffeecat/demoe-ttt-router.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种称为DeMoE的方法，通过将持久共享专家与有条件路由的专家片段配对，并在单一分布匹配目标下进行训练，以压缩diffusion模型的计算过程，相比密集的一步基准，DeMoE在激活更少宽度的图像FFN的情况下，实现了更高的GenEval分数，特别是在复杂组成和计数方面。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在解决单步蒸馏压缩diffusion模型的内部容量结构问题，如何在不进行迭代优化的情况下，同时保持通用生成先验并解决提示特定的细节。
AI.method: 该方法提出了DeMoE，基于分离表示策略，采用持久共享专家和有条件路由专家片段的组合，并通过单一分布匹配目标进行了训练。
AI.result: DeMoE在FLUX.2-4B生成任务中实现了0.8220的GenEval分数，而激活的图像FFN宽度仅为80.5%，超过了密集的一步基准，在复杂组成和计数任务上表现尤为出色。
AI.conclusion: DeMoE展示了结构化内部计算重分配对于改进diffusion模型的压缩性能的优势。

title: Answer Delivery Under a Shared Token Budget: An Audited Study of Stopping and Finalization
summary: An inference budget is useful only when the system delivers an answer within it. We study a fixed-budget policy combining first-valid-box stopping with a charged finalization cue. On 100 fresh, independently audited GSM8K test questions per model, it improves delivered endpoint accuracy over first-box stopping by 8.0 percentage points for Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 and 7.0 for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B. A prelocked repeat on the same questions gives 7.0 and 10.0 points; neither seed shows a gross harm relative to first-box stopping. The point estimates of incremental physical-slot savings are below one percent. A finalization-only ablation separates cue recovery from stopping, and a fixed scalar reader tests extraction as an alternative explanation. The cue is prior art; the contribution is a component and readout analysis with charged injections and verified paths. Results cover two checkpoints, one task, one prompt family, and two fixed seed conditions.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种结合首次有效框停止和带充电最终提示信号的固定预算策略，该策略在多个模型上提高了准确率，但物理槽位节省有限。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在优化固定预算内的推理策略，以提高模型答案的质量，同时尽量减少额外的计算消耗。
AI.method: 研究通过在GSM8K测试集中的100个独立审计问题上比较首次有效框停止和结合最终提示信号的策略来评估其效果。
AI.result: 结合最终提示信号的策略在Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B上分别提高了8.0和7.0个百分点的交付端准确率，重复实验进一步提高了准确率。
AI.conclusion: 虽然增加了一部分额外的计算开销，但该方法在保留合理准确率提升的同时，也验证了提示信号作为关键因素的重要性，且进一步分析显示其主要用于提示信号的提取和验证路径的有效性。

title: VHA: VQA-based Hallucination Assessment for Generative Image Super-Resolution
summary: Generative image super-resolution produces visually realistic high-resolution images, but may also introduce hallucinations by adding unsupported content or altering existing details. Because existing super-resolution metrics fail to measure whether generated details remain grounded in the reference image, we present a hallucination assessment technique based on bidirectional visual question answering (VQA), which we term VQA-based Hallucination Assessment (VHA). The proposed approach uses a vision-language model (VLM) to determine whether the semantic content and low-level visual evidence in a super-resolved image are supported by its ground-truth counterpart. To this end, it constructs question--answer pairs from each image and evaluates them on both images. Discrepancies between the resulting scores in both directions reveal missing or altered ground-truth information and unsupported additions. However, obtaining these scores requires computationally expensive VLM inference. We therefore develop VHA+, a learned, lightweight model that directly predicts VHA scores from ground-truth and super-resolved image pairs. We construct a hallucination benchmark, VHA-bench, through a human study and show that both VHA and VHA+ correlate highly with human judgments of hallucination. The code, benchmark, and model weights are available at https://github.com/dhryougit/Hallucination-Assessment

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于双向视觉问答(VQA)的超分辨率图像幻觉评估技术(VHA)，并开发了轻量级版本VHA+以提高效率。通过人工研究构建了幻觉基准VHA-bench，表明VHA和VHA+与人类幻觉判断高度相关。
AI.motivation: 现有的超分辨率评估指标无法衡量生成的细节是否与原始图像相关，因此需要一种新的评估方法来识别幻觉内容。
AI.method: 研究利用视觉语言模型(Vision-Language Model, VLM)从超分辨率图像生成问题-答案对，并在图像上进行双向评估。不匹配的分数揭示了缺失或改变的原始信息以及支持不足的添加内容。之后，研究团队开发了VHA+，一种无需VLM推理即可直接从原始和超分辨率图像预测VHA分数的轻量级模型。
AI.result: VHA和VHA+表现出与人类幻觉判断高度相关性，VHA-bench通过人工研究构建。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法和模型为超分辨率图像的幻觉评估提供了新的工具和基准。

title: Local data augmentation for imbalanced binary classification
summary: Facing imbalanced binary classification, we aim at maximizing the recall while limiting the proportion of false detections in the minority class. For doing that, the present work studies the effect of several rebalancing strategies, from the uniform subsampling of the observations from the minority class, to a more involved local data augmentation scheme. To be more specific, we establish that only rebalancing class proportions cannot modify the classification performance, whereas local data augmentation is proved to have an impact on the final results. The local augmentation scheme is introduced by means of a two-step procedure. The first step randomly subsamples anchor points among the training observations. These anchor points are used in the second step, for drawing new augmentation data following an ''augmentation kernel'' to be specified. This enables us to decouple the impact of the anchor points subsampling from the one of drawing augmentation data accounting (or not) for the local geometry of the support. The experiments on synthetic data illustrate the practical performance of several strategies for subsampling anchor points combined with either a Gaussian or a diffusion-based augmentation kernel. Compared to SMOTE-like data augmentation procedures, a better performance is achieved when subsampling in the close neighborhood to the classification boundary combined with a Gaussian augmentation kernel. Furthermore in specific settings where the geometric structure of the support matters, the experimental results show that using a diffusion-based augmentation kernel outperforms the Gaussian one.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析不同的重平衡策略和局部数据增强方案，旨在增加少数类的召回率，同时限制少数类的误检率。研究发现，仅仅调整类别比例无法改善分类性能，而局部数据增强则能显著影响结果。实验表明，结合近距离子采样和高斯增强内核的策略优于传统的SMOTE方法。
AI.motivation: 在面对不平衡的二分类问题时，为了提高少数类的识别率并尽量减少误检，本文研究了多种重平衡策略和局部数据增强方法的效果。
AI.method: 研究中首先通过统一抽样的方法减少少数类的样本规模，然后引入了一种两步的局部数据增强方案：第一步随机抽取训练集中的锚点，第二步根据指定的增强内核生成新的增强数据。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，相比于SMOTE等数据增强方法，结合近距离子采样和高斯内核的增强策略更能提高分类性能。在特定场景下，使用基于扩散的增强内核也比高斯内核更优。
AI.conclusion: 本文强调了局部数据增强在不平衡分类问题中的重要作用，并为选择合适的增强策略提供了指导。

title: See the Future, Classify the Present: Stochastic Latent World Modeling for Hyperspectral Images
summary: Hyperspectral image classification (HSIC) relies on static spatial-spectral representations learned from labeled samples, limiting its ability to model structured dependencies in the latent representation space. To address this limitation, this work proposes Stochastic Latent World Modeling (LWM), a trajectory-based representation-learning framework that enriches classification through stochastic latent-state prediction. Given a hyperspectral patch, LWM tokenizes and encodes spectral and spatial information separately using dedicated transformer branches, then fuses their outputs into a unified representation. This representation is further organized into an environment state that captures center, neighborhood, spectral, and global contextual information. A stochastic latent transition module then predicts multiple future latent states through Gaussian parameterization and reparameterization, with recurrent refinement used to model dependencies across successive states. The resulting latent trajectory is adaptively aggregated by a rollout planner to construct a planned representation, which is integrated with the base representation for final classification. By extending static spatial-spectral encoding with stochastic multi-step latent-state modeling, LWM enables the classifier to exploit structured dependencies in the representation space and provides richer features for HSIC. Across five benchmark datasets, LWM achieves overall accuracies ranging from 89.21% to 99.52%, demonstrating consistent classification performance under limited-label settings.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种名为Stochastic Latent World Modeling (LWM)的方法，用于改进高光谱图像分类。LWM通过预测多个未来潜在状态，引入了动态的潜在状态表示，从而捕捉更加丰富的结构依赖和上下文信息，最终在五个基准数据集上表现出显著的分类性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的高光谱图像分类依赖于静态的光谱-空间表示，无法有效地建模潜在表示空间中的结构依赖关系。为了克服这一限制，本文提出了一种基于轨迹的表示学习框架LWM，通过预测多个未来的潜在状态来增强分类能力。
AI.method: LWM方法包括多个步骤：首先，对高光谱补丁进行光谱和空间信息的分隔编码；其次，将编码后的输出融合成统一的表示；接着，通过高斯参数化和重参数化预测多个未来的潜在状态，并用递归细化来建模状态间的依赖关系；最后，通过规划器自适应地聚合潜在轨迹，构建计划表示并与基本表示集成以实现最终分类。
AI.result: LWM在五个基准数据集上的表现优异，总体准确率在89.21%到99.52%之间，尤其是在有限标签设置下表现出一致的分类性能。
AI.conclusion: LWM通过引入动态的潜在状态表示，成功捕获了结构依赖关系和丰富了特征表示，为高光谱图像分类领域带来了明显改进。

title: Physiology-Aware Graph Attention for Early Ventricular Reentry Prediction
summary: Sudden cardiac death mostly originates from post-infarct ventricular tachycardia. This reentry is sustained by propagation around scar tissue, but its risk remains difficult to predict from infarct imaging alone. While in silico induction studies can reveal these mechanisms, exploring many substrates and pacing locations remains computationally expensive. We propose a graph attention classifier for early prediction of sustained ventricular reentry from simulated cardiac electrophysiology. Each simulation is represented as a graph with early nodal voltage samples and edge attributes encoding geometry, stimulation frequency, tissue labels, amplitude, and diastolic interval. These descriptors are computed only from the first two paced activations, before sustained reentry is observed. On a balanced independent test set of 1000 simulations, the classifier achieves 94.6% accuracy, 95.4% sensitivity, 93.8% specificity, 94.6% F1-score, 0.987 ROC-AUC, and 0.985 PR-AUC. Ablation experiments show that diastolic interval is the most critical descriptor. Qualitative attention inspection suggests that different heads focus on border-zone, stimulation location, and early propagation path. These results support graph attention as a fast early-prediction approach for large-scale in silico ventricular reentry studies.

AI.tldr: 一种图注意力分类器被用于从心脏电生理学模拟中预测持续性室性再入电位的早期发生，取得了94.6%的准确率和其他多项性能指标优秀的成绩。
AI.motivation: 目前预测梗死后室性心动过速的风险难以仅通过心肌梗死影像学确定。电生理学模拟研究能够揭示这些机制，但探索各种心肌疤痕组织和起搏位置仍然需要庞大的计算资源。
AI.method: 构建了一个图注意力分类器。每个模拟被表示为一个图，包含初始节点电压样本和编码几何形状、起搏频率、组织标签、幅度和舒张间隔的边属性。分类器只使用第一次和第二次起搏激活来计算描述符，从而在观察持续再入前就能进行预测。
AI.result: 分类器在包含1000个模拟并进行平衡独立测试的数据集上达到了94.6%的准确率，95.4%的敏感性，93.8%的特异性，94.6%的F1分数，0.987的ROC-AUC值以及0.985的PR-AUC值。消融实验表明，舒张间隔是最重要的描述符，并且注意力检查揭示了不同头关注边界的部位、起搏位置和早期传播路径。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，图注意力表示为一种快速的早期预测方法，适用于大规模的电生理学再入电位模拟研究。

title: UniJev: Separating Accuracy from Calibration in Trimodal System One Decision Models
summary: System One models produce probabilistic judgments that software can consume directly, making reliable confidence as important as answer accuracy. Yet joint training across text, images, and video remains underexplored, and the contributions of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD) are difficult to separate. We introduce UniJev, a trimodal framework that scores candidate answers with a shared head under joint supervised training across text, images, and video. Supervised decision models improve accuracy over their backbone readouts across all three modalities, while the existing RLCD algorithms change accuracy little and have inconsistent effects on visual calibration across recipes. These findings motivate a separate supervised objective for confidence calibration. We introduce Cora (Confidence--Outcome Reliability Alignment), which groups current predictions by confidence and optimizes each prediction's confidence toward the empirical accuracy of its bin. At both 2B and 9B, Cora lowers image and video expected calibration error (ECE) while preserving accuracy, without a reinforcement stage. We release our code at https://github.com/wjnwjnwj/UniJev.

AI.tldr: UniJev是一种三模态框架，通过联合监督训练文本、图像和视频中的候选答案，提高准确性并降低图像和视频的预期校准误差。
AI.motivation: 现有的方法在文本、图像和视频间的联合训练下表现不足，且监督微调(SFT)和强化学习决策(RLCD)的效果难以区分。
AI.method: UniJev通过引入一个共享头进行联合监督训练，同时提出了Cora方法，该方法通过优化每个预测的信心值使其接近其置信度的实测准确率来校准信心。
AI.result: 监督决策模型在所有三种模态上均提高了准确性；RLCD算法对视觉校准影响不均；Cora能降低图像和视频的预期校准误差，同时保持准确性，无需强化学习阶段。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了一种单独的监督校准目标来进一步改进信心校准，同时发布代码实现UniJev框架。

title: Remembering Has a Price: Learning Memory Worth under Resource Constraints
summary: Lifelong agents continually accumulate and reuse experience to improve after deployment, yet in practice they often operate under tight generation, interaction, and memory budgets. Under such stringent joint constraints, we find that existing lifelong-memory methods can become ineffective, with several sophisticated approaches offering little advantage over simple retrieval or even no-memory agents. This reveals a more fundamental problem: resource scarcity makes each memory decision more consequential. When only a small amount of past experience can be retained or reused and opportunities for reasoning and recovery are limited, retrieving a relevant but ineffective memory can consume scarce context and hinder downstream execution. The key challenge is therefore not simply to retrieve relevant experience, but to determine which experiences are actually worth retaining and reusing. To address this challenge, we propose TokenWorth, a lightweight online memory framework that learns query-dependent memory worth from sparse execution feedback and applies it consistently to memory retrieval and bounded memory management. Across three LifelongAgentBench environments and both local and API-based deployments, TokenWorth achieves the highest task success rate while using the fewest output tokens among the evaluated methods. These results suggest that effective lifelong adaptation under resource constraints depends not on remembering more, but on learning what is worth remembering. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/AIGNLAI/TokenWorth.

AI.tldr: 研究发现现有的终身记忆方法在资源受限情况下效果不佳，提出了一种新的在线记忆框架TokenWorth，可高效利用有限的资源，适应环境变化，实验结果表明其在不同环境下的任务成功率最高。
AI.motivation: 现有的终身记忆方法在资源受限的情况下效果不佳，尤其是在推理和恢复机会有限时，简单的检索甚至没有记忆的代理可能会更有效。这表明在有限资源条件下，每个存储决策都很重要，需要一种能够识别值得存储的记忆的机制。
AI.method: TokenWorth是一种轻量级的在线记忆框架，它通过稀疏执行反馈学习查询依赖的记忆价值，并将其应用于记忆检索和内存管理。
AI.result: 在三种LifelongAgentBench环境中，无论是本地还是基于API部署场景下，TokenWorth都获得了最高的任务成功率，同时使用较少的输出令牌。
AI.conclusion: 有效适应资源受限条件下的终身学习依赖于记住哪些是值得记住的内容，而不仅仅记住更多的内容。TokenWorth对于在数据和内存受限的环境中开发高效的学习代理具有重要意义。

title: Do We Need Learned Targets? Classical Gradients as Supervision for 2D Gaussian Initialization
summary: Learning-based Gaussian image initializers can require costly supervision obtained by per-image optimization. We investigate whether the Pseudo-PPM targets used by Instant GaussianImage can be replaced by classical image gradients. Our framework uses normalized Sobel maps in two tracks. A training-free analytic initializer combines probability boosting, parallel grid-based sampling, and geometric processing, producing initial parameters in 0.32 seconds on average. A neural initializer is trained on DIV2K with online Sobel supervision, which removes offline target optimization and allows training to scale to 10,000 LSDIR images without additional preprocessing. Both tracks achieve competitive long-budget reconstruction on Kodak and DIV2K. Under domain shift, the DIV2K-trained neural initializer surpasses Instant-GI on Manga109 from 500 fitting iterations onward (by 1.40 dB at 5K iterations), and training on LSDIR increases this margin to 1.85 dB. On Kvasir-SEG, the training-free analytic initializer exceeds Instant-GI at every reported budget. A controlled pipeline-time comparison yields an estimated $4.9\times$ reduction for DIV2K. These results establish inexpensive analytic targets as a practical alternative to optimization-derived supervision for scalable Gaussian initialization.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的Gaussian图像初始化框架，利用经典图像梯度替换Instant GaussianImage中的Pseudo-PPM目标，实现了与基于优化的初始化方法相当的效果，且成本更低。
AI.motivation: 传统的Gaussian图像初始化方法基于昂贵的监督学习，需要对每个图像进行优化，而本文探索了一种利用经典图像梯度的方法，以减少对密集优化的依赖，并提高初始化的效率。
AI.method: 该方法使用归一化的Sobel映射在两条路径上进行初始化。一条是训练免费的解析初始器，结合概率增强、并行网格采样和几何处理，另一条是基于DIV2K数据集训练的神经网络初始化器，利用在线Sobel监督去掉离线目标优化。
AI.result: 两种路径都在Kodak和DIV2K数据集上实现了与长期预算重建相当的竞争性能。在领域转移的情况下，DIV2K训练的神经初始化器在Manga109上比Instant-GI效果更好，尤其是在500次调整迭代后，差异达到1.40 dB。在Kvasir-SEG上，无需训练的解析初始器在所有报告的预算下都超过了Instant-GI。DIV2K训练的神经初始化器在管道时间上估计可以节省4.9倍的成本。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，廉价的分析目标可以作为优化监督的实际替代方案，用于可扩展且成本较低的Gaussian初始化。

title: VeriCUA: Learning Proactive Verification for Reliable GUI Agent Rewards
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/Jeffjeno/VeriCUA
summary: Reinforcement learning for computer-use agents increasingly relies on proactive reward agents that interact with the post-execution GUI environment to verify what recorded screenshots cannot reveal. The reliability of such verification hinges on two coupled decisions: what to check and when to stop. Existing methods leave these decisions to prompted foundation models. However, neither scaling up the model nor providing few-shot examples reliably improves verification: prompted Judges ranging from 4B to GPT-5.4 all plateau at 68%-70% macro-average agreement. This is because the value of a check depends on the environment rather than the task alone, and becomes apparent only through execution. Learning from execution is itself constrained, as the Actor's terminal state cannot be faithfully replicated during training, allowing only one verification attempt per state. We introduce VeriCUA, a proactive reward agent that learns its verification strategy from these single attempts. A trainable Judge decides what to check and when to stop, while a frozen Probe executes the checks in the live environment. Online reinforcement learning optimizes the Judge for both verdict correctness and efficient Probe use, with returns normalized across terminal states. Trained only on OSWorld and evaluated without further training on MobileWorld and WebArena-Verified, VeriCUA achieves the highest reward agreement across all three benchmarks and lies on the agreement-cost Pareto frontier among proactive verifiers. It surpasses few-shot GPT-5.4 by 5.36 points with 47.6%-59.8% fewer Probe tokens, and even a 1B VeriCUA exceeds every prompted Judge. As the reward for Actor RL, it raises task success by 3.21 points overall and 5.40 points on held-out multi-application tasks. These results identify the verification strategy, not verifier scale, as the key to reliable GUI rewards.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为VeriCUA的主动奖励代理，在仅依靠单次尝试的情况下学习其验证策略。通过在线强化学习优化决策者以实现判断的正确性和高效探针使用，从而显著提高了验证的一致性，并在多个基准测试中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的方法通常是将决策过程留给提示的大型语言模型，但这些模型在不同环境下的表现并不理想。为了改进这种情况，作者通过引入VeriCUA代理，利用在线强化学习从单次尝试中学到验证策略，从而克服了当前方法中的局限性。
AI.method: VeriCUA采用了一种新的方法，配备了一个可训练的决策者（Judge）和一个冻结的探针（Probe），在线强化学习使决策者优化以实现准确的判断和高效使用探针。决策者关注的是判断的正确性以及探针使用的效率。
AI.result: 在OSWorld、MobileWorld和WebArena-Verified三个基准测试中，VeriCUA的表现超越了仅仅通过少量示例提示的GPT-5.4，且使用较少的探针token，达到了最高的奖励一致性。它比GPT-5.4高出5.36分，并且比1B规模的VeriCUA还要优越。
AI.conclusion: VeriCUA的有效验证策略使任务成功率提高了3.21分，特别是在未进行额外训练的多应用程序任务上提高了5.40分。研究结果表明，有效的验证策略比代理规模更为关键，后者对于可靠的GUI奖励至关重要。

title: Hihaze: One-Step Diffusion for High-Resolution Real-World Image Dehazing
summary: Diffusion models have recently achieved encouraging results in real-world image dehazing. However, restoring high-resolution images remains challenging due to spatially non-uniform haze and inconsistent predictions across local patches. To address these issues, we propose Hihaze, a one-step diffusion framework for high-resolution real-world dehazing. Hihaze adopts two haze-aware modulation modules: attentive skip compensation (ASC) and a spatial degradation adapter (SDA). ASC selectively transfers reliable encoder information to the variational autoencoder (VAE) decoder, preserving structural details while suppressing haze-degraded features. SDA extracts multi-scale spatial degradation representations and injects them into the U-Net to guide restoration according to local haze variations. Furthermore, we design a training-free global-guided patch fusion (GPF) method. It uses a global prediction to align patch appearance and downweight unreliable predictions, followed by structure-guided detail compensation. Notably, this training-free design also makes GPF a plug-and-play module for other dehazing models. Experiments across four real-world benchmarks show that Hihaze surpasses state-of-the-art approaches in both visual quality and inference speed. Specifically, it delivers PSNR improvements of 3.62~dB on Dense-Haze and 3.69~dB on NH-HAZE compared with the strongest baselines. Code: https://github.com/zhengchen1999/Hihaze.

AI.tldr: Hihaze 提出了一种基于扩散模型的一站式高性能高分辨率图像去雾框架，通过引入两种新的模块和训练无参的全局指导补丁融合方法，解决了高分辨率图像去雾的挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有的去雾方法在高分辨率图像去雾方面仍存在不足，主要由于去雾效果在低分辨率预测上的不一致性和高分辨率图像的空间非均匀去雾问题。
AI.method: Hihaze 设计了两种新的模块：注意力跳跃补偿（ASC）和空间退化适配器（SDA）。ASC 模块从编码器传递可靠信息到变分自编码器（VAE）解码器，同时保留结构细节，抑制退化特征。SDA 提取多尺度空间退化表示，并注入 U-Net 以根据局部去雾变化进行修复。此外，还设计了一种训练无参的全局指导补丁融合（GPF）方法，以改善多个不一致区域。这些方法共同构成了一个一站式的高分辨率图像去雾框架。
AI.result: Hihaze 在四个真实世界去雾基准测试中表现优异，相较于最强的方法在视觉质量和推理速度上都取得了显著提升。具体来说，在 Dense-Haze 和 NH-HAZE 数据集上，Hihaze 相对于最强基准的 PSNR 提升分别为 3.62 dB 和 3.69 dB。
AI.conclusion: Hihaze 提出的方法在高分辨率图像去雾性能上有了显著提升，并展示了一种有潜力的方法，可直接应用于其他去雾模型中。

title: ScopeMem: Latent Memory That Learns Where to Revise Frozen GUI Agents
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Zhicheng Zheng and Cheng Zhang contributed equally
summary: Latent memory is gaining ground as a lightweight history supplement for GUI agents. It supplies history to a frozen vision-language model via prefix vectors trained with step-wise cross-entropy (CE). While resulting gains are naturally attributed to encoded history, our controlled experiments show they primarily stem from action revision. The prefix learns to alter the model's default actions. However, this revision is unscoped because step-wise CE pushes outputs toward reference actions at every step without explicitly preserving correct decisions. Consequently, it repairs errors but also breaks 8-13% of initially correct answers. Overall accuracy metrics hide these losses. We therefore propose ScopeMem, a latent-memory method for scoped revision. Its encoder conditions prefix generation on the model's initial answer and is trained to correct errors while preserving correct decisions. On the controlled ablation set, ScopeMem reduces the share of broken correct decisions to 5.6% while repairing more errors than any evaluated CE-trained prefix. On AndroidControl, GUI-Odyssey, and zero-shot AITW, ScopeMem outperforms all evaluated prompting and latent-memory baselines, enabling a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B to match or surpass GUI-specialized agents and Qwen3-VL-32B.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为ScopeMem的轻量级历史记忆方法，能够减少动作错误修复带来的正确答案损失，同时提高整体准确性和特定任务上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过预测动作前缀来增强视觉-语言模型的能力，但在修复错误时可能会破坏原本正确的答案。因此，该研究旨在提出新的方法，既能修正模型的错误，又能保留正确的决策。
AI.method: ScopeMem通过编码器条件生成前缀，并训练修正错误的同时保持正确的决策。方法专注于作用于模型初始答案的背景下进行修正。
AI.result: 在控制实验集中，ScopeMem减少了被修复成错误的正确决策比例（从8-13%降低到5.6%），同时修复了更多的错误。在AndroidControl、GUI-Odyssey和零样本AITW任务上，ScopeMem的表现优于所有评估的其他提示方法和隐含记忆基线，使冻结的Qwen3-VL-8B达到了或超过了专门的GUI代理和Qwen3-VL-32B的水平。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，ScopeMem在减少错误修复对正确答案的影响方面具有显著优势，且在多种复杂任务中取得了卓越的表现。

title: Auditing Semantic and Relational Reliability in Open-Vocabulary Human-Object Interaction Evaluation
summary: Open-vocabulary human-object interaction detectors describe interactions in free text, and this creates a problem for evaluation. Category scoring rejects valid paraphrases, while semantic similarity scoring can reward predictions that name the wrong action or reverse the roles of the participants. We present a diagnostic protocol that holds every prediction fixed and scores it under five views, namely official category evaluation, an identity control, lexical normalization, graded semantic credit, and strict propositional equivalence. Comparing these views separates the effect of the matching engine from the effect of semantic credit. The protocol pairs controlled transformations that preserve or break meaning with a blinded audit of natural predictions, and we derive consistency checks that link mean credit, invalid acceptance, and transformation counts. Applied to six systems on HICO-DET, the views disagree on which system leads. GEN-VLKT leads under official evaluation, SL-HOI leads under SHOE, and GEN-VLKT leads again under strict equivalence. Semantic gains range from 1.6 to 20.3 mAP, and AgentHOI keeps less than half of its gain once equivalence is enforced. We recommend that semantic scores be reported together with relational validity and paired uncertainty, so that recovered credit is not read as better interaction understanding.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个诊断协议，通过在不同视图下评估预测，解决了开放词汇的人-物交互检测的评估问题。五个视图包括官方类别评估、身份控制、词法规范化、分级语义信用和严格的命题等价性。评估结果显示不同系统在不同视图下的表现不同，强调了语义得分应与关系有效性及不确定性一起报告。
AI.motivation: 当前的人-物交互检测器在描述交互时使用自由文本，这导致评估困难。传统的方法如类别评分和语义相似性评分存在缺陷，因此提出了新的诊断协议来改进评估方法。
AI.method: 该诊断协议包括五个视图：官方类别评估、身份控制、词法规范化、分级语义信用和严格的命题等价性。通过这些视图，研究者可以更全面地理解模型的表现。
AI.result: 在HICO-DET数据集上，应用该诊断协议时，不同系统在不同视图下的表现不一。GEN-VLKT在官方类别评估中表现最好，SL-HOI在SHOE中表现最好，但在严格的命题等价性视图中，GEN-VLKT再次表现最好。语义增益范围从1.6到20.3 mAP，而AgentHOI在严格的命题等价性下损失了超过一半的增益。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，不同的评估视图会产生不同的结果，语义得分不应仅被解释为交互理解的提升。未来的评估应考虑与关系有效性和不确定性一并报告。

title: RouterWorld: Scaling Conversational AI with Latency-Aware LLM Routing
summary: Conversational AI systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) require routing mechanisms that balance answer quality and response latency at scale. However, existing LLM routing benchmarks assume full observability of all candidate model outcomes, under-emphasize latency as a first-class metric, and fragment evaluation across heterogeneous protocols misaligned with real-world settings. We introduce RouterWorld, a comprehensive benchmark for LLM routing in conversational GenAI. RouterWorld unifies 371k single-turn responses and 76k multi-turn agentic trajectories, adopts natural user interactions with a standardized LLM-as-a-judge protocol, and decouples efficiency from transient pricing via hardware-grounded latency annotations. Crucially, RouterWorld formalizes routing under partial observability through two setups: Cold-Start, which restricts learning to sparse, static logs, and Voyager, which models continuous data streams where routing decisions shape future training distributions. Evaluating 13 routing baselines, we find that most routers over-emphasize accuracy while ignoring latency under partial observability. Code and benchmark data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为RouterWorld的新基准，用于大规模评估基于大语言模型的对话AI系统的路由机制，该基准考虑到了部分可观测性和响应延迟，涵盖了单轮和多轮对话，使用硬件基准化延迟注解，公开了代码和数据。
AI.motivation: 当前的LLM路由基准未能全面反映实际场景的需求，例如部分可观测性、响应延迟和评估一致性和标准化问题。因此，研究团队开发了RouterWorld以改善这些缺陷。
AI.method: 研究团队收集了大量的对话数据（单轮和多轮），并构建了一个标准化的评估方法，即LLM作为裁判。此外，还通过两种设置区分了部分观测场景和连续数据流场景：Cold-Start和Voyager。
AI.result: 通过评估13种基线路由策略，研究发现大多数路由器在部分观测场景中过度重视准确性而忽视了延迟，从而为优化路由策略提供了数据支持。
AI.conclusion: 该研究旨在为对话AI系统中的路由机制提供一个全面且标准化的评估基准，有助于推动相关技术的发展和完善。

title: ActionRoPE: action as coordinates for spatially consistent control in planar-camera game world models
summary: Game world models have made rapid progress toward real-time interactive generation. Yet action control is still predominantly implemented as feature conditioning, leaving the model to learn from training data how each action should move the visual world. This formulation is poorly matched to a broad class of planar-camera worlds, such as top-down and isometric games. In these worlds, player motion induces a geometrically well-defined planar camera displacement. We observe that the key to spatially consistent control in such worlds is to represent the effect of each action directly in world coordinates. To this end, we introduce ActionRoPE, a parameter-free action interface that converts action-driven camera displacement into world-coordinate rotary positions. As a result, tokens corresponding to the same world location retain the same positional address across time. These world coordinates further expose a spatial asymmetry in generation: regions covered by the initial observation are geometrically known, while newly revealed regions remain to be synthesized. We therefore propose Coordinate-Conditioned Noise Scheduling (CNS), which assigns token-wise denoising schedules according to this known-new structure. It allows observed regions to stabilize earlier, while new content is generated with reference to them. Compared with four representative action-conditioning mechanisms, our approach follows the commanded motion more faithfully and reduces the revisit drift by 66% over the strongest baseline. The same interface transfers across video backbones from 1.3B to 33B parameters and to out-of-distribution scenes. Project Page: https://teawhite.cn/ActionRoPE/

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ActionRoPE的方法，通过将动作驱动的相机位移转换为世界坐标旋转位置，使动作控制更符合2D视角的游戏世界。此外，提出了一种基于已知与未知结构的时间调度机制CNS，该机制在已观察区域上提前稳定，同时生成新内容。这种方法在多个动作控制机制中表现更佳，减少了66%的回访漂移。
AI.motivation: 为了解决现有的动作控制方法在2D视角游戏世界中表现不佳的问题，本文提出了一种新的动作接口ActionRoPE，并引入了一种基于已知与未知结构的时间调度机制CNS。
AI.method: ActionRoPE通过在世界坐标中直接表示每个动作的效果，来实现空间一致的动作控制。CNS机制根据已知与未知的结构分配标记级别的去噪时间表，使已观察区域提前稳定，同时生成新的内容。
AI.result: ActionRoPE方法在多个代表性的动作控制机制中表现出更忠实的运动控制和更低的回访漂移率（66%优于最强基准）。CNS机制同样展示了良好的性能。
