To address these shortcomings, we propose a novel metric called Scaled Overlap (SO), which adapts a non-parametric data-copying test for facial recognition and extends it to the identity level. By leveraging a multi-model setup that compensates for errors in individual classifiers, it provides insights into the true strength of identity leakage. Our analysis identifies leaking datasets (CemiFace, SFace2, IDNet) with the most acute leakage introduced by generative model conditioning in CemiFace, demonstrates that real datasets do not contribute equally to generator training, and shows that the majority of synthetic images are drawn from multiple identities rather than relying on a single identity. Ultimately, our study provides new insights into the quality of synthetic datasets and gives more reliable techniques to help the community ensure the trustworthiness of synthetic data.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个新的指标称为缩放重叠(SO)，旨在评估合成数据集中身份泄露的质量。研究发现，生成模型的条件过程会导致合成样本过于相似于训练集中的样本，从而削弱隐私保护效果。通过多模型设置，SO 能够提供关于实际数据集对生成器训练贡献的见解，并指出合成数据集中身份的合并情况。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于解决生成模型的局限性及其训练过程对合成数据质量的影响，特别是针对身份泄露的风险。
AI.method: 研究提出了一个名为 Scaled Overlap (SO) 的新指标，该指标是对非参数化数据复制测试的改进版本，适用于面部识别。SO 结合了多模型设置来弥补单一分类器错误，以评估合成数据中的身份泄露问题。
AI.result: 研究表明，SO 能够更准确地识别合成数据集中身份泄露的问题，并指出 CemiFace、SFace2、IDNet 等数据集中存在高泄露风险。此外，证实了实际数据集对生成器的训练贡献不均等，大部分合成图像来自多个身份。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过引入 SO 指标和多模型设置，提供了有关合成数据质量的新见解，帮助社区更好地确保合成数据的可信度。

title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
summary: Spatial intelligence requires agents to actively acquire visual evidence and integrate observations into a coherent representation of the three-dimensional world. Yet spatial question answering offers limited evidence of whether models can construct accurate metric maps through autonomous exploration. We introduce SpatialScout, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents on active object-level 3D mapping. SpatialScout comprises 80 diverse indoor scenes containing 3,140 target objects. Given an object inventory, RGB observations, camera calibration, and camera poses, agents control a camera to explore each scene and estimate object centers in a shared coordinate frame. The task requires coordinating viewpoint selection, cross-view association, geometric estimation, and map revision under bounded interaction budgets. Evaluation jointly measures localization accuracy and target coverage through object-scale overlap scores that penalize missing predictions. Experiments with frontier VLMs reveal substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated model, Claude Opus 5.5, achieves a mean overlap score of 41.71%, with 47.23% of targets exceeding an intersection-over-union (IoU) threshold of 0.5 and only 3.25% exceeding 0.9. These results reveal a substantial gap between recovering coarse object layouts and constructing complete, precise metric maps. SpatialScout provides a quantitative testbed for developing agents that build reliable 3D spatial representations through active perception. Code is available at https://github.com/JesseZZZZZ/SpatialScout.

AI.tldr: SpatialScout 是一个用于评估视觉-语言模型（VLM）在主动构建物体级别 3D 地图方面的基准测试，它揭示了当前最强模型在准确构建详细且精确的3D地图方面存在显著局限性。
AI.motivation: 为了评估视觉-语言模型在自主探索环境下构建三维地图的能力，以及揭示目前模型在构建详细准确的三维地图时存在的局限性，研究人员开发了 SpatialScout。
AI.method: SpatialScout 包括 80 个室内场景，共计 3,140 个目标物体。模型需要利用物体清单、RGB 观察、相机校准和相机姿势自主控制相机探索场景，并在共享坐标框架中估算物体中心。评估通过目标覆盖分数（考虑 IOU 阈值）联合测量定位准确性和目标覆盖度。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，当前最强的模型 Claude Opus 5.5 的平均重叠得分为 41.71%，仅 3.25% 的目标物体超过 0.9 的 IOU 阈值，大多数物体覆盖分数低于 0.5，显示出在恢复粗略的物体布局和构建完整精确的三维地图之间存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: SpatialScout 为通过主动感知开发能构建可靠三维空间表示的代理提供了量化测试床。

title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
summary: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个名为WildAWM的框架，通过合成可控环境和任务来训练通用计算机使用代理（CUAs），支持多种交互接口，并通过执行基础的质量门控解决三个核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 目前的代理学习主要依赖于人类的数据，但这在实际系统中会带来安全挑战。野AWM旨在实现这种学习在实际环境中的扩展，同时解决环境合成中的关键难题。
AI.method: 通过集成图形用户界面、模型上下文协议服务和命令行接口，WildAWM 构建了支持多种交互方式的可执行环境。此外，提出了执行为基础的质量门控方法，用于保证任务的可解性、足够的难度和验证的可靠性。
AI.result: WildAWM 合成了341个长期环境任务对，能够要求超过100个代理步骤来解决，即使是前沿模型也只能解决其中的60%。两种不同规模的Qwen模型在8个不同分布的数据集中都取得了显著改进，表明在WildAWM合成环境中学习有助于对未见任务的广泛泛化。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果表明，通过合成环境进行学习可以有效地训练并泛化到实际的计算机使用任务，同时保证了数据的开放性和可靠性。

title: DCR-TSF: Dual-Level Compositional Reasoning with Triadic Spherical Fusion for Training-Free Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 14 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables
summary: Zero-shot composed image retrieval (ZS-CIR) aims to retrieve a target image that reflects an intended textual modification while maintaining semantic consistency with a reference image. Existing training-free ZS-CIR methods typically rely on fine-grained generated target descriptions, which often overemphasize reference-specific visual details and lead to appearance-biased retrieval. Moreover, since these descriptions are generated through multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the direct influence of the original image-text query can be weakened in the final retrieval representation. In this paper, we propose DCR-TSF, a training-free ZS-CIR framework that combines Dual-level Compositional Reasoning (DCR) and Triadic Spherical Fusion (TSF). DCR generates fine- and coarse-grained descriptions from the reference image and modification text, capturing complementary target-side semantics across different granularities. To preserve the original image-text query information, TSF constructs a composed-query anchor by spherically interpolating the reference image feature and modification text feature, and fuses it with the fine- and coarse-grained representations using a weighted Karcher mean on the unit hypersphere. The resulting final query representation balances detailed visual evidence, high-level semantic abstraction, and direct preservation of the original composed query. Extensive experiments on CIRCO, CIRR, and Fashion-IQ demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为DCR-TSF的无需训练的零样本图像检索框架，通过结合双层成分推理（DCR）和三元球融合（TSF），生成精化和粗粒度描述，增强图像文本查询信息，取得了目前训练-free ZS-CIR方法的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法倾向于依赖细粒度生成的目标描述，这会增加视觉偏置并减弱原始图像文本查询的影响。因此，本研究提出利用双层成分推理和三元球融合在维持参考图像语义一致性的同时，提高语义描述的准确性和多样性。
AI.method: DCR-TSF框架包括两个主要组件：(1) 双层成分推理DCR从参考图像和修改文本中产生精化和粗粒度描述，捕获不同粒度的目标侧语义；(2) 三元球融合TSF构建一个球形插值锚点，该锚点融合参考图像特征和修改文本特征，并结合精化和粗粒度表示，最终生成保持详细视觉证据、高层语义抽象和原始组合查询直接信息的查询表示。
AI.result: 在CIRCO、CIRR和Fashion-IQ数据集上进行的大量实验表明，该方法在训练-free ZS-CIR方法中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法为零样本图像检索领域的研究提供了一种有效的方法，展示了如何通过增强描述的多样性和准确性来减轻视觉偏置问题。

title: ProteinGeoBench: Frontier Structural-Biology Agents Are Fluent at Lookup but Lost in Geometry
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Benchmark and tasks: https://github.com/Protege-AI/ProteinGeoBench
summary: Frontier agents retrieve structural metadata well and compute geometry from coordinates less reliably. We ask how much of a benchmark score reflects that gap and how much reflects the evaluation configuration around the model. We study ProteinGeoBench, a suite of 131 protein-structure tasks, using 4,249 rollouts from four frontier models and 4,486 further trials across 26 models. Three of the four frontier models fall within 0.031 of one another (0.785 to 0.816) with no difference between them resolved, while the fourth scores 0.707 and all three gaps to it exclude zero. Three of the four do better on metadata lookup than on numeric calculation. The fourth is slightly better on numeric. Numeric tasks are 28 of the 131 but half of the twelve tasks that all four models fail. The ranking also depends on the evaluation budget: with one run per task, 23.9% of bootstrap replicates put a different model first. On a selected 15-task slice, removing network access lowers scores more than blocking eight structural-database domains, but the two contrasts were graded in different passes and cannot be cleanly decomposed. Swapping in each model's own command-line agent changes scores by -0.071 to +0.086, a comparison too small to rule out moderate harness effects. Across 26 models, numeric performance rises with non-numeric performance rather than staying flat. The experiments use different task subsets, so they cannot rank model, harness, access and task composition against one another. Evaluations should report results by task family, along with the number of runs, the harness and the access conditions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，前沿代理在结构元数据检索方面表现良好，但在进行数值计算时不太可靠。尽管有四种前沿模型，但它们之间的差距仍然存在，特别是在数值任务和结构数据库访问方面，这对基准分数的影响很大。
AI.motivation: 作者通过研究ProteinGeoBench，一个包含131个蛋白质结构任务的测试套件，旨在探讨基准分数中包含的差异大小，以及这些差异是否仅由模型本身性能差异引起，还是由于评估配置的影响。
AI.method: 作者使用了4,249次来自四个前沿模型的实验和4,486次进一步实验，共26个模型。他们通过改变模型运行条件，如网络访问、任务子集等，来比较不同因素对评估结果的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现，三个前沿模型之间在元数据检索和数值计算上有明显差异，其中一个模型（得分0.707）明显低于其他三个模型（0.785至0.816）。在数值任务上，四个模型中只有一个表现较好，而大部分任务（占总数的一半）都是所有四个模型都无法完成的。此外，评估预算也影响排名。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论认为，模型的实际性能可能比单凭基准分数显示的情况更复杂，同时也强调了透明报告实验条件的重要性。

title: Toolkit for Facial Deidentification
comment: 3 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. This work was presented as a poster at the 6th IEEE International Conference on BioInspired Processing (BIP 2024), poster session, Liberia, Costa Rica, December 4-6, 2024
summary: This work presents a novel open-source toolkit designed for the evaluation of face deidentification techniques with available evaluation models. The framework provides a complete evaluation pipeline, including preprocessing, deidentification, and performance assessment, based on data utility, image quality, and identity protection metrics. It supports a variety of datasets, enabling researchers to easily benchmark new deidentification techniques. Results show the effectiveness of some techniques on maintaining privacy while preserving image utility. The toolkit is aimed at unifying future research by providing a standard evaluation framework for privacy-enhancing technologies in facial biometrics. Implementation is available at github.com/blazm/deid-toolkit.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出了一种开源工具包，用于评估面部去标识化技术。工具包支持多种数据集，包含预处理、去标识化和性能评估，旨在促进隐私保护技术的统一研究。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏一个统一的工具来评估面部去标识化技术，该工具包的开发是为了填补这一空白，帮助研究人员评估不同技术的效果。
AI.method: 该工具包提供了一个包含数据预处理、图像去标识化和性能评估的完整流程，使用数据可用性、图像质量和身份保护指标进行评估。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，某些去标识化技术在保护隐私的同时能够保持图像的有用性，为评价不同技术的有效性提供了依据。
AI.conclusion: 该开源工具包计划作为一个标准的评估框架被广泛采用，以推动面部生物特征识别中隐私增强技术的研究。

title: Can It Actually Work? Synthesizing Functional CAD Mechanisms
summary: While LLM agents can generate visually plausible CAD assemblies, these designs often fail to fulfill their intended physical functions. We study functional CAD design, a setting where agents interpret underspecified requests to construct and iteratively revise mechanisms that satisfy functional requirements in physical simulation. Verifying these requirements is nontrivial: different candidate mechanisms may realize the same function through entirely different components, controls, and operating sequences. To bridge this gap, we propose FunCAD-Harness, a framework that translates abstract requirements into candidate-specific physical tests and uses simulation feedback to guide design revisions. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce FunCADBench, a benchmark spanning 46 mechanism families with interdependent and multi-step operations. Experiments across frontier LLM agents show that FunCAD-Harness exposes subtle mechanical failures invisible to visual inspection, substantially improving functional success rates over standard simulation-augmented baselines. Ultimately, our work marks a step toward CAD agents capable of translating human intent into working mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为FunCAD-Harness的框架，用于功能CAD设计，通过将抽象要求转化为特定候选机制的物理测试，并利用模拟反馈指导设计修订，从而在机械性能方面取得了显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的大型语言模型虽然能生成视觉上合理的CAD装配图，但这些设计往往无法满足其预期的物理功能。研究提出FunCAD-Harness框架旨在解决这一问题，使其能够更好地理解和实现人类对机械装置的实际需求。
AI.method: FunCAD-Harness框架包含两个主要部分：一是将抽象要求转化为针对不同候选机制的具体物理测试；二是利用模拟反馈来指导设计的迭代修订。研究还引入了FunCADBench基准测试，该基准包含46种机械家族，涵盖了多个步骤和相互依赖的操作。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，FunCAD-Harness框架能够显著提高机械装置的功能成功率，超出标准的模拟增强基线。尤其是在功能需求复杂的机械装置上，该框架能够识别出难以通过视觉检查发现的机械缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，通过引入FunCAD-Harness框架，可以推动CAD代理系统朝着能够将人类意图转化为可工作的机械装置方向发展。

title: Same Simulation, Different Evidence: Where Retrieved Tool Output Costs LLM Agents Accuracy
summary: LLM agents that compute the right answer can still answer wrongly. Agent harnesses increasingly keep long tool outputs out of the context window, saving them to files that the agent searches or reads on demand. We ask where this costs accuracy with a real scientific tool: PHREEQC, a widely used geochemistry simulator from the USGS, whose reports reach 846.8k characters and whose determinism lets every printed value be traced. Agents use it to answer 158 execution-verified multiple-choice items. When agents read the simulator's report through a section index rather than in context, GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.2 lose 11.3 and 7.9 points of accuracy, while Claude Opus 4.6 and Claude Sonnet 4.6 show no detectable cost. Re-running all 11,007 logged simulator calls shows that both GPT models compute the keyed value about as often as before; what changes is the evidence they answer from. Under retrieval they often skip the report, answer from their own higher-precision output files, and misround to a neighboring option, a failure we call evidence substitution. With the simulation held fixed, retrieval still costs GPT-5.2 9.4 points. For GPT-5.4, more frequent correct simulations mask an evidence-use loss of about ten points, leaving a net change indistinguishable from zero. Naming the authoritative output raises accuracy by 6.3-7.9 points over plain retrieval for the three GPT models; for GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.2, inlining outputs that fit works as well, while asking for correct rounding does not. Context-management choices in agent harnesses should be judged by where accuracy is lost, not only by final accuracy.

AI.tldr: LLM代理能够准确计算，但当它们不直接阅读长输出报告而依赖于索引或其他高级输出文件时，准确性可能会下降。这主要是因为证据替换的问题，即代理采用更高精度但未正确四舍五入的输出文件来回答问题。
AI.motivation: 文章探讨了在科学计算工具（如PHREEQC）的长输出报告被分割或存储为文件的情况下，给定LLM代理（如GPT模型和Claude模型）带来的准确度影响。
AI.method: 通过使用真实的科学计算工具（PHREEQC）及其大规模的执行验证问题集进行实验测试。并比较了不同模型在保存报告整文本与仅保存索引及使用更高精度但不完全四舍五入输出文件的情况下的性能。
AI.result: 结果显示，GPT-5.1和GPT-5.2减少了几个点的准确性，Claude Opus 4.6和Claude Sonnet 4.6则不受影响。重新运行所有模拟调用显示，两者计算结果的频率几乎没有变化，但它们更多地依赖于自己的高精度输出文件来回答问题，从而导致四舍五入不正确并选择邻近选项。即使模拟固定不变，GPT-5.2仍降低了9.4个点的准确性。而对GPT-5.4而言，更频繁的正确模拟掩盖了证据使用减少约10个点的损失，最终结果无法区分。
AI.conclusion: 文章得出结论认为，在代理控制器中对于上下文管理的选择应该被评估为是否会导致准确性的降低，而不仅仅是最终的准确度。同时也表明了如何命名权威输出可以帮助提高准确度，但简单地包括能放入上下文中的高精度输出同样有效。

title: DeOverlay: A Benchmark and Source-Anchored Flow for Video Overlay Removal
summary: Video overlay removal aims to recover scenes obscured by subtitles, titles, and logos while preserving surrounding content. Existing methods use temporal propagation or source-conditioned generation, but can leave residual overlays and distort scene structure when useful source information is obscured. We propose DeOverlay, a source-anchored flow model that reconstructs the clean video from the source latent with fixed source guidance. Specifically, we train a shared velocity network along paired source-to-clean paths using region-weighted flow matching, enabling successive cor- rections from intermediate states. To select local source cues, we develop visibility-normalized temporal aggregation that excludes masked positions and averages the remaining observations. Global source context and edit-region embeddings complement these cues through additive condi- tioning, retaining a single video-token sequence. To evaluate scene recovery across diverse overlay conditions, we introduce DVTE-Bench, comprising 1,631 paired videos across eight text-overlay categories, with OCR-screened clean targets, frame-aligned pixel masks, and a common evaluation protocol. Experiments on the complete release show that DeOverlay outperforms four baselines on all five reconstruction and perceptual metrics, reducing Mask LPIPS and Mask VFID by 58.3% and 70.3%, respectively, relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. Additional qualitative examples demonstrate the removal of graphic logos and stickers. We will make the complete benchmark, evaluation code, and test outputs availabl. Project page:https://yahooo-m.github.io/DVTE-Bench/

AI.tldr: DeOverlay 提出了一种基于源锚定的流模型，通过固定源引导从源潜在中重建干净视频，从而去除视频中的字幕、标题和标志，且在多种场景下表现优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频叠加去除方法在处理被遮挡的源信息时可能会留下残留的叠加内容或扭曲场景结构，因此需要一种新的方法来改善这种情况。
AI.method: DeOverlay 方法包括训练共享速度网络、采用区域加权流匹配，以及引入可见性归一化的时间聚合和全局源上下文及编辑区域嵌入的加成条件，最终形成一个单一的视频令牌序列。
AI.result: DeOverlay 在完整发布和五项重建及感知度量上优于四种基线，Mask LPIPS 和 Mask VFID 分别降低了 58.3% 和 70.3%。并且展示了去除图形标志和贴纸的更多定性示例。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一个名为 DVTE-Bench 的基准数据集，并展示了 DeOverlay 在去除视频叠加方面的有效性，同时提供了完整的基准测试、评估代码和测试输出。

title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
summary: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了世界模型在未见过的状态-动作组合中的动态重组合表现，提出了一种新的基准，并发现了当前模型在重组合下的普遍失败。
AI.motivation: 由于现有工作模型在未观察到的具体状态-行动组合之外的表现欠缺研究，本文旨在填补这一空白，研究数据覆盖、动力学泛化和下游规划性能之间的关系。
AI.method: 本文通过引入AnyGoal基准，该基准从广泛使用的世界模型环境构建而成，包括各种任务变体和动态重组合测试，评估了不同模型家族的表现。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，当前世界模型在动力学重组中表现出明显的失败，特别是在状态和行动的组合未在专家轨迹中充分代表的情况下。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了世界模型面临的挑战，为进一步提高其新规划任务的泛化能力奠定了基础。

title: Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network for Asymmetric EEG-Eye Movement Emotion Recognition
summary: EEG-eye movement emotion recognition can support mental-health monitoring and adaptive interfaces, but most fusion models treat the two signals as parallel features, classify each window alone and degrade when eye data are lost. We propose the Context-Aware Topological Distillation Graph Network (CTD-GNet), in which EEG features form the nodes of an electrode graph, and eye movements and preceding windows modulate its edges, nodes and readout, the edges through electrode-specific prompts. Bidirectional distillation of the graph, node relations and predictions couples this multimodal teacher with a single-window EEG student, improving the teacher and aligning the two graphs 35-fold. In leave-one-subject-out tests on SEED and SEED-IV against 17 baselines, CTD-GNet has the highest mean accuracy, 84.91% and 76.17%, significantly above 9 and 6 of 13 eye-based baselines after Holm correction, the smallest cross-subject spread among multimodal models and the highest worst-subject accuracy. It is the most accurate model at every rate of missing eye data on SEED-IV, keeps 66.1% on SEED without eye data, more than any EEG-only model, and stays 9.3 and 11.9 points above all single-window fusion models under eye-movement noise of one standard deviation. On film clips unseen in training, it leads on SEED with 77.1%.

AI.tldr: CTD-GNet 提出了一个结合脑电信号和眼动信号的情感识别网络，通过图网络模型捕捉和利用这两种信号之间的时序和关系信息，能够在多样测试情况下表现出最优的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在处理脑电信号和眼动信号的情感识别时往往将两者视为平行特征，这种处理方式在眼动数据缺失时会导致性能下降。CTD-GNet 旨在通过一个上下文感知的拓扑蒸馏图网络来改进这种处理方式。
AI.method: CTD-GNet 由一个用于捕捉脑电信号模式的图网络和通过眼动和前期窗口信号调制的节点进行互动构成。采用双向蒸馏方法将图、节点关系和预测结果关联，形成一个多模态教师与单一窗口的EEG学生模型。
AI.result: 与 SEED 和 SEED-IV 数据集中的17个基线模型对比，CTD-GNet 在多个指标上表现最佳，如最大平均准确率（84.91% 和 76.17%）、最小不同被试间的偏差、以及对任何眼动缺失率表现出强大的鲁棒性，并在非训练视频中也保持出色的性能。
AI.conclusion: CTD-GNet 开创性地解决了情感识别中眼动信号缺失的问题，展示了在多种情况下的强大性能和较高的鲁棒性。

title: Train An Imaginative Agent
summary: A seemingly reasonable push in Sokoban can make the puzzle unsolvable. To avoid such mistakes, an agent has to anticipate the consequences of its actions before execution, especially when feedback from the real environment is sparse or actions are irreversible. We introduce Agentic Imagination (Agima), a training framework that trains an agent to imagine before acting, i.e. to be imaginative. Agima trains a single omni model to propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason over these imagined futures to decide what to execute in the real environment. Rather than committing to a single plan, the agent can simulate a sequence of actions, explore alternatives, and compare possible futures. We first use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to unify policy and world modeling within a single omni model. This enables the agent to predict future outcomes and perform basic forms of imagination, such as forward thinking and counterfactual branching. We then use agentic reinforcement learning (RL) to teach the agent to reason with its imagined futures and use them effectively for planning. Across four environments spanning Maze2D, Sokoban, Pacman, and PushT, Agima generalizes to harder settings unseen during training. Trained with SFT alone on two-box Sokoban, Agima solves 40% of four-box puzzles while seeing the real board only once every five moves, compared with an action-only planner that only solves 2%. After RL, new behaviors emerge in how Agima uses its imagination: it learns a new unified format that was unseen during the SFT stage, learns to conduct forward thinking only when necessary, and branches more frequently at critical decision points. An agent that can picture where its actions lead can learn when and where to look ahead, that is, to plan. Project page: https://agima.net/.

AI.tldr: Agima 是一种训练框架，该框架训练智能体在行动前进行想象，从而预测未来并进行规划。Agima 使用监督微调和代理强化学习相结合的方法，在四个不同环境中表现出强大的适应性和规划能力。
AI.motivation: 当前代理在执行动作时缺乏前瞻性想象，容易因执行不合理推力而导致谜题不可解。为了解决这一问题，引入了 Agima，以提高代理对未来情况的预见性和规划能力。
AI.method: Agima 使用了监督微调 (SFT) 和代理强化学习 (RL) 结合的方法。SFT 训练单个多任务模型执行行为预测和世界建模，而 RL 则帮助代理在想象的未来中进行推理和规划。
AI.result: Agima 在包括 Maze2D、Sokoban、Pacman 和 PushT 在内的多种环境中展示了强大的性能，尤其在 Sokoban 这一谜题环境中，即使只有每五个动作才观察一次真实棋盘，也能解决 40% 的四箱谜题，相比之下，仅执行动作的规划器几乎无法解决问题。
AI.conclusion: Agima 证明了通过想象未来的状态并进行有效规划能够显著提高代理的适应性和性能，在实际应用中具有潜在的广阔前景。

title: RGB--Event Object Detection Across Operating Frequencies via Reliability-Supervised Routing and Asymmetric-Resolution Fusion
summary: Autonomous vehicles must detect objects faster than a frame camera delivers images. Event cameras record brightness changes with microsecond resolution, so RGB--event detectors can decide between frames, at an operating frequency, the rate of decisions, far above the frame rate. As this rate rises, each decision receives a sparser event window, and the reliability of the events relative to the frame varies over the scene and over time. Existing detectors weight the sensors per sample and encode the frame at the reduced event resolution. Reliability-supervised routing assigns a fusion weight to every location and supervises it with targets from the losses of two single-modality classifiers used only in training, moving loss-based supervision of fusion weights from whole samples to individual locations. Asymmetric-resolution fusion lets the frame carry the decision where the events fail: it encodes the frame at native resolution and pools every feature level onto the event grid, reusing all pretrained weights. On the DSEC-Det dataset, routing halves the accuracy loss from 20 to 180 Hz, from 6.3 to 3.1 mAP, and lowers it in every seed. The resulting detector, ERA-Det, sets a new state of the art at 63.2 mAP, 3.7 mAP above FlexEvent, leads at every operating frequency, and at 180 Hz is more accurate than FlexEvent at 20 Hz. On two DAVIS346 datasets, the router lowers the frame weight at night and in low light and raises it when the events vanish. ERA-Det upgrades released FlexEvent weights in 5,000 iterations on one GPU.

AI.tldr: 一种新的事件驱动检测器ERA-Det利用可靠性监督路由和非对称分辨率融合，在不同操作频率下提高了自主车辆的物体检测性能，特别是在低频下优于FlexEvent。
AI.motivation: 现有的RGB-事件检测器未能有效利用高频率决策带来的更多事件窗信息，导致可靠性降低。而ERA-Det通过可靠性监督路由和非对称分辨率融合解决了这一问题，提高了决策的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: ERA-Det首先使用事件相机获取微秒级别的亮度变化信息，然后通过可靠性监督路由分配每个位置的融合权重，监督来自两个单一模态分类器的损失以训练模型。非对称分辨率融合方法允许帧数据在事件数据失败时支持决策过程，通过在网络的每个特征层上池化帧特征并映射到事件网格上来实现。
AI.result: 在DSEC-Det数据集上，ERA-Det在20Hz和180Hz下的mAP分别为63.2和3.7，分别优于FlexEvent在180Hz和20Hz下的表现。在DAVIS346数据集上，夜间和低光照条件下的帧权重降低，事件消失时帧权重增高。最终ERA-Det比FlexEvent在所有操作频率下更胜一筹，特别是在180Hz下比FlexEvent在20Hz时的精度更高。
AI.conclusion: ERA-Det通过引入可靠性监督路由和非对称分辨率融合方法，显著提高了事件驱动检测的性能，特别是在低频应用中大幅改进了准确度，为自动驾驶领域的物体检测开辟了新的可能性。

title: Transfer Learning for Power Outage Detection Task with Limited Training Data
summary:
Early detection of power outages is crucial for maintaining a reliable power distribution system. This research investigates the use of transfer learning and language models in detecting outages with limited labeled data. By leveraging pretraining and transfer learning, models can generalize to unseen classes.
  Using a curated balanced dataset of social media tweets related to power outages, we conducted experiments using zero-shot and few-shot learning. Our hypothesis is that Language Models pretrained with limited data could achieve high performance in outage detection tasks over baseline models. Results show that while classical models outperform zero-shot Language Models, few-shot fine-tuning significantly improves their performance. For example, with 10% fine-tuning, BERT achieves 81.3% accuracy (+15.3%), and GPT achieves 74.5% accuracy (+8.5%). This has practical implications for analyzing and localizing outages in scenarios with limited data availability.
  Our evaluation provides insights into the potential of few-shot fine-tuning with Language Models for power outage detection, highlighting their strengths and limitations. This research contributes to the knowledge base of leveraging advanced natural language processing techniques for managing critical infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索了使用迁移学习和语言模型在有限标注数据下检测停电的可能性，通过零样本和少样本学习实验，发现少数样本微调能显著提高语言模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 由于停电对电力分配系统的重要影响，及时检测停电至关重要。传统模型在有限标注数据下性能较低，因此研究旨在探索语言模型在较少标注数据下进行停电检测的有效性。
AI.method: 研究人员使用了一个包含社交媒体停电相关推文的平衡数据集，进行了零样本和少样本学习实验。他们利用预训练模型进行少数样本微调，并评估了模型在停电检测任务中的表现。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，少数样本微调能显著提高BERT和GPT等语言模型的性能。具体来说，对于BERT模型，经过10%的微调后，准确率达到81.3%（增加15.3%），对于GPT模型，准确率达到74.5%（增加8.5%）。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出的结论表明，少数样本微调的语言模型在停电检测任务中具有潜在优势，这为在数据有限的场景下管理关键基础设施提供了新的思路。

title: GeoNaviDiff: Transferring Disentangled Semantic Controls to Diffusion Features via Local Riemannian Navigation
summary: Disentangled real-image manipulation requires factor-specific semantic control while preserving image fidelity and non-target content. StyleSpace $S$ provides interpretable controls but is limited by GAN inversion, whereas diffusion models offer stronger image realization without an explicit factorized control basis. We introduce GeoNaviDiff, an unsupervised cross-space framework that transfers disentangled StyleSpace interventions to local Riemannian trajectories in diffusion $h$-space. GeoNaviDiff constructs reconstruction-decoupled supervision by extracting a spherical Log-map tangent from a matched StyleGAN reconstruction-edit pair and parallel-transporting it to the real-image diffusion state. A shared, factor-conditioned Navigator predicts this tangent at inference, while norm-preserving geodesic realization and source-anchored rollout stabilize the reverse process without edited references or factor-specific models. Experiments across multiple datasets show that GeoNaviDiff outperforms the compared methods in fidelity, factor selectivity, edit locality, and trajectory smoothness.

AI.tldr: GeoNaviDiff通过将风格空间干预转移到扩散h空间的局部里emann轨迹上来实现解纠缠的图像编辑，在保持图像保真度的同时提高了因子选择性、编辑局部性和轨迹平滑度。
AI.motivation: 为了解决现有技术在保持图像保真度和非目标内容的同时实现因子特定语义控制的问题，提出了GeoNaviDiff框架。
AI.method: GeoNaviDiff通过在没有显式因子化控制基础的情况下从StyleGAN重建-编辑配对中提取球形Log-map切线，并将其平行运输到真实图像的扩散状态，建立了解耦重构监督。同时，使用共享因子条件指南针预测该切线，实现保范量测地线重建和来源锚定点滚动来稳定反过程。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，GeoNaviDiff在多个数据集中的保真度、因子选择性、编辑局部性和轨迹平滑度方面优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: GeoNaviDiff提供了一种新的方法，可以在不编辑参考或特定因子模型的情况下进行解纠缠图像编辑，同时保持保真度和非目标内容。

title: Transformer-based segmentation of prosodic boundaries in Brazilian Portuguese
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, submitted to an IEEE conference
summary: Automatic prosodic segmentation identifies boundaries between speech units from acoustic and linguistic evidence. Although recent deep learning approaches have produced strong results for English, automatic segmentation for Brazilian Portuguese (BP) still relies mostly on rule-based or traditional machine-learning methods. This paper presents SAMPA, a Whisper-based segmenter that transcribes BP speech while inserting explicit markers for terminal prosodic boundaries. We fine-tune Whisper large-v3 on manually segmented recordings from the NURC-SP dataset and evaluate different training and test-time filtering configurations, including out-of-distribution testing on the MuPe-Diversidades dataset. SAMPA achieves competitive boundary-detection performance across settings, with the best models reaching F1=0.731 on the held-out test split and F1=0.796 on MuPe-Diversidades. Finally, through n-gram and acoustic-visual analyses, we show that our model follows morphosyntactic, semantic, and prosodic cues for detecting prosodic boundaries.

AI.tldr: 提出了基于Whisper的SAMPA模型，以自动进行巴西葡萄牙语的音节分割，该模型在不同设置下表现良好，尤其是在MuPe-Diversidades数据集上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的英语自动音节分割方法在巴西葡萄牙语上的应用仍有限，且多依赖于基于规则或传统机器学习的方法。因此，本文提出了一个新的基于Whisper的模型SAMPA，以改善对巴西葡萄牙语自动音节分割的性能。
AI.method: 作者利用手动分割的NURC-SP数据集对Whisper Large-v3进行微调，并评估了不同的训练和测试时间过滤配置，包括在MuPe-Diversidades数据集上的超分布测试。此外，通过n-gram和声学-视觉分析来验证模型在检测音节边界时考虑到了形态学、语义和语音学的线索。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，通过不同的配置，SAMPA模型在测试集上达到了0.731的F1分数，在MuPe-Diversidades数据集上的表现尤为突出，F1分数达到了0.796。
AI.conclusion: 总体而言，SAMPA模型提供了一种有效的方法来实现巴西葡萄牙语的自动音节分割，并且通过对不同语言线索的利用，表现出良好的跨数据集泛化能力，为进一步研究提供了有价值的见解。

title: How Robust Are Prognostic Radiomic Features? Comparing Selection Techniques on Pooled Glioblastoma Cohorts
summary: Radiomic survival studies in glioblastoma report heterogeneous prognostic features, but how much of this stems from the methodology itself is rarely examined. We analysed the association of 463 radiomic, anatomical and clinical features from pre-treatment MRI with overall survival in 705 IDH-wildtype glioblastoma patients from three public cohorts, using three techniques: a log-rank test after median split, univariate Cox regression (both Benjamini-Hochberg corrected) and an XGBoost regressor interpreted with SHAP. The log-rank test selected 99 features, Cox regression 72 and SHAP its top 20; five were selected by all three: age, a peritumoural T2 texture feature, the number of connected peritumoural mask components and two image-level intensity maxima. The two survival tests shared 51 features, about half of the SHAP top 20 were also selected by either test, and where selections overlapped, effect directions agreed. Many selections were PyRadiomics diagnostic descriptors that are not restricted to tumour voxels. Analytical pipeline choices, including ranking method, pre-filtering and descriptor handling, can substantially influence which features appear prognostic.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析705例IDH野生型胶质母细胞瘤患者的预治疗MRI影像，使用不同的统计学方法识别与生存率关联的特征，发现不同方法的选择结果存在差异，强调了分析管道选择对特征选择的影响。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在评估不同影像学特征在胶质母细胞瘤患者生存率预测中的作用，以及不同的分析方法如何影响这些特征的选择，从而识别出真正具有临床意义的特征。
AI.method: 研究使用了三个不同的特征选择方法：中位数分组后的log-rank检验、未校正的Cox回归以及基于SHAP的方法。分析了463个放射学、解剖学和临床特征。研究还探讨了分析管道中的一些选择（如排序方法、预筛选和描述符处理）对特征选择的影响。
AI.result: 三种方法总共选择了不同的特征组，log-rank检验选择了99个特征，Cox回归选择了72个特征，而SHAP选择了其最具有影响力的20个特征。五个特征（年龄、肿瘤周围的T2纹理特征、肿瘤周边区域连通组件的数量以及两个图像级强度最大值）被三种方法共同选中。虽然log-rank检验和Cox回归共享了51个特征，但SHAP的前20中只有大约一半被这两种方法选中。此外，研究还发现一些影像诊断描述符被多个方法选中，这些描述符不受肿瘤体素的限制。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论是，不同的分析方法会在胶质母细胞瘤患者的生存率预测中选择不同的特征，表现出显著的不一致性。因此，选择不同的分析管道（包括排序方法、预筛选和描述符处理）可能会极大影响哪些特征被视为具有预测性。

title: PnP-Transformer: A Neural Pose Solver for 6D Object Pose Estimation
summary: We present PnP-Transformer, a neural pose solver designed as an iterative-free, differentiable alternative to classical PnP-RANSAC algorithms. PnP-Transformer regresses the 6D object pose by processing predicted semi-dense 2D-3D correspondence fields alongside confidence scores, while mapping geometric inputs into a continuous latent space. To evaluate its practical utility, we integrate PnP-Transformer into a zero-shot 6D pose estimation pipeline, where the correspondence module and pose solver are trained separately. PnP-Transformer achieves a 41.2% mean AR score with low latency (0.46 s/obj) on seven core BOP benchmark datasets, surpassing all prior baselines (such as RayPose with 39.1% AR) but one (Co-op with 58.4% AR). When the pose solver is replaced with EPnP-RANSAC (similar to Co-op) while keeping the correspondence module unchanged, the RANSAC alternative outperforms PnP-Transformer on six of the seven datasets by reaching 52.2% mean AR at a cost of an additional 60 ms per object, revealing an accuracy-latency trade-off. Code and pretrained models are available: https://github.com/ebylmz/pnp-transformer

AI.tldr: PnP-Transformer 是一种无需迭代的端到端可微分方法，通过处理预测的半密集 2D-3D 对应关系场和置信度分数来回归 6D 对象姿态，实现了在 BOP 基准数据集上的优异表现。
AI.motivation: 为了克服传统 PnP-RANSAC 算法的迭代特性带来的低效率和鲁棒性问题，提出了一种无需迭代且可微分的 PnP-Transformer 方法。
AI.method: PnP-Transformer 通过预测的半密集 2D-3D 互对应关系场和置信度分数进行 6D 对象姿态的回归，将几何输入映射到连续的潜在空间中。
AI.result: PnP-Transformer 在七个核心 BOP 基准数据集上实现了 41.2% 的均值 AR 分数，以较低的延迟 (0.46 秒/对象) 远超大多数基准线方法。
AI.conclusion: 尽管 RANSAC 替代方法在六个数据集上提供了更高的 52.2% 的均值 AR 分数，但在延迟方面有额外的成本，表明精度和延迟之间的权衡问题。

title: TriTD: Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution Distillation for Real-Time Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion has emerged as a leading paradigm for efficient video generation, yet its practical deployment remains bottlenecked by the trade-off between generation quality and inference efficiency. We attribute this bottleneck to three error sources in AR rollouts: the base model error, the train-inference distribution mismatch, and the upstream error propagation. Building on this decomposition, we derive closed-form upper bounds on the per-step and cumulative errors, providing a principled basis for jointly optimizing generation quality and inference efficiency. Guided by this analysis, we propose TriTD, a Tri-Partite Trajectory-Distribution co-optimized distillation framework with three complementary modules. First, for ODE initialization, we adopt a Next-Node Trajectory Distillation (NTD) objective, which shortens the supervision horizon and admits a lower regression-error floor. Second, we introduce Chunk-Graded Noising (CGN), a monotonically non-decreasing per-chunk noising schedule that helps narrow the expected train-inference noise mismatch and removes redundant KV-cache updates, yielding substantial speedups at no quality cost. Third, we propose Orthogonal-Parallel DMD (OP-DMD), a distribution-matching loss that retains the original DMD supervision while introducing an additional regression constraint in the orthogonal subspace to suppress off-axis drift, improving both training stability and final generation quality. Extensive experiments show that TriTD consistently surpasses existing baselines in visual quality while reaching a real-time throughput of 26.8 FPS on a single H100 GPU, delivering a balanced quality-efficiency solution for interactive streaming video generation.

AI.tldr: TriTD引入了三项创新方法NTD、CGN和OP-DMD，分别优化了ODE初始化、减少训练推理噪声偏差和提高生成质量，最终在保持实时生成质量的同时实现了26.8 FPS的速度。
AI.motivation: 由于AR视频扩散模型存在生成质量与推理效率之间的权衡问题，TriTD旨在通过优化三个关键错误来源（基模型误差、训练推理分布不匹配和上游错误传播）来提升视频生成效果。
AI.method: TriTD框架包括三个模块：Next-Node Trajectory Distillation（NTD）、Chunk-Graded Noising（CGN）和Orthogonal-Parallel Distributed Mathematical Dynamics（OP-DMD）。NTD通过缩短监督窗口和降低回归误差边界来优化ODE初始化；CGN通过逐步增加噪声强度来减少训练/推理噪声偏差并实现显著的提速；OP-DMD添加了一个正交子空间中的额外回归约束以抑制非轴向漂移，从而提升了训练稳定性和最终生成质量。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与其他现有基线相比，TriTD在保持高视觉质量的同时达到了26.8 FPS的实时吞吐率，提供了一种兼顾质量与效率的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: TriTD提出了一种独特的高效视频生成框架，通过优化关键设计步骤提高了生成质量并加速了推理过程，特别是对于实时交互视频生成应用而言具有重要意义。

title: Learning Goal-Conditioned Subgoals through Frozen Hierarchical World Models
summary: Hierarchical world models plan over long horizons by passing predicted states from a coarse model to a lower-level controller. Choosing these states can be expensive: the upper-level planner repeatedly differentiates through candidate macro-action trajectories. We replace this search with a lightweight goal-conditioned network trained through the frozen high-level predictor. The network supplies a conditioning vector, while the predictor generates the next latent waypoint. Training uses hindsight goals and state-prediction losses on offline trajectories, without search-solution targets or macro-action labels. Inference retains an autoregressive high-level rollout, but requires no high-level candidate optimization. We evaluate this approach on the shared-latent HWM checkpoints distributed with H-JEPA, using three backbone seeds and three head initializations per backbone. With a common evaluation protocol, mean success is 70.4% on Cube, 48.7% on Push-T, 100.0% on FourRoom, and 71.1% on Visual AntMaze. The method improves over the corresponding HWM search baseline on three environments and has the same mean on Push-T. Dedicated measurements on an NVIDIA L40S give 1.28-4.39x end-to-end speedups for batched evaluation. Ablations identify state-adaptive conditioning as a consistent contributor, while predictor-mediated subgoals and unrestricted conditions have environment-dependent benefits.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种轻量级的目标条件网络替代高层面规划器中的搜索过程，用于层次世界模型。通过使用后见目标和静止状态预测损失进行训练，该方法在不同环境中取得了较好的性能，并且在某些环境中有超过基线的表现，同时带来了1.28-4.39倍的端到端速度提升。
AI.motivation: 为了解决传统层次世界模型中高层面规划器进行搜索时计算成本高的问题，研究者提出了一种新的方法，旨在降低计算成本并提高规划效率。
AI.method: 该方法通过训练一个轻量级的目标条件网络来替代高层面规划器中重复的搜索过程。网络提供一个条件向量，而高层面的预测器生成下一个潜在的短期目标（latent waypoint）。训练中使用后见目标和静态状态预测损失，在不依赖搜索解或宏动作标签的情况下进行。
AI.result: 该方法在多种环境中进行了评估，数据显示其在Cube、Push-T、FourRoom和Visual AntMaze上的平均成功率分别为70.4%、48.7%、100.0%和71.1%，在某些环境上优于对应的搜索基线，并且实现了1.28-4.39倍的端到端速度提升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了一种有效的方法，通过使用目标条件网络来减少层次世界模型中高层面规划的计算成本。此方法不仅提高了效率，还在多个环境中的表现优于传统的方法。

title: HP-PnP-Flow: Hybrid Time Scheduling and Projection for Plug-and-Play Image Restoration via Flow Matching
summary: Image restoration is a fundamental inverse problem that seeks to recover high-quality images from degraded observations. Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods provide a flexible framework for integrating pretrained denoisers into iterative reconstruction, whereas flow matching offers an efficient generative modeling approach based on continuous-time ODE dynamics. Very recently, Martin et al.\ (ICLR, 2025) developed a PnP-Flow method, which integrates the PnP framework with flow matching through a time-dependent denoiser constructed from a pretrained flow matching model.By incorporating a different time schedule and an additional pixel-space projection operator, this paper proposes a novel efficient PnP-Flow algorithm (HP-PnP-Flow) that enjoys rigorous convergence guarantees under mild assumptions, without imposing restrictive conditions on iterates required by the aforementioned work. Numerical experiments on CelebA and AFHQ-Cat demonstrate that the newly proposed HP-PnP-Flow algorithm significantly outperforms PnP-Flow on several restoration tasks such as denoising, deblurring, super-resolution, random inpainting, and box inpainting. Notably, our algorithm achieves comparable or better reconstruction quality with substantially fewer iterations, reducing the iteration count from $500$ to $100$ for deblurring and super-resolution on AFHQ-Cat.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的高效PnP-flow算法（HP-PnP-Flow），在多个图像恢复任务上实现了与PnP-Flow相当甚至更好的重建质量，并显著减少了迭代次数。
AI.motivation: 研究提出了一种结合PnP框架和流匹配方法的新算法，旨在提高图像恢复任务的效果，尤其是减少迭代次数。
AI.method: 该方法通过对预训练流匹配模型的时间依赖去噪器进行改编，并引入了不同的时间调度和像素空间投影算子，从而实现高效的PnP-flow算法。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，HP-PnP-Flow在去噪、除模糊、超分辨率、随机补丁和框补丁等图像恢复任务上，能实现与PnP-Flow相当甚至更好的重建效果，同时显著减少迭代次数。
AI.conclusion: 提出的HP-PnP-Flow算法在保证收敛性的基础上，提供了高效且实用的图像恢复解决方案，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Wan-Alpha++: Animating a Single RGBA Asset into Controllable Transparent Video Effects
summary: RGBA video generation is essential for creating compositable visual assets in filmmaking, game development, and digital content production. However, generating high-quality RGB appearance alongside temporally coherent transparency remains a significant challenge. Existing text-to-RGBA video methods often entangle RGB and alpha distributions and offer limited control over the precise appearance of a target asset. In addition, incorporating image conditioning typically suffers from the emergence-disappearance effects, which fail existing first-frame or first-and-last-frame conditions due to their fully transparent boundary frames. To address these issues, we present Wan-Alpha++, a unified framework that brings controllable RGBA video generation to both text- and image-to-video diffusion backbones through a shared RGBA latent space, extending our conference version Wan-Alpha from the text-conditioned setting to image-conditioned generation with an interior reference frame. Our method first learns shiftable RGB-alpha distributions while preserving the pretrained RGB prior. Specifically, we introduce a transparency-aware bidirectional diffusion objective to produce distinguishable RGBA latent representations, and a transparency-guided mean sampler that shifts the noise distribution to improve transparency generation and enable spatial controllability. Building upon this RGBA generation prior, we introduce temporal phase reparameterization for image-conditioned effect generation. By cyclically transforming a zero-positive-zero alpha pattern into a positive-zero-positive pattern, it relocates visible content to both temporal boundaries, facilitating effective appearance conditioning with limited RGBA data.

AI.tldr: Wan-Alpha++ 提出了一个统一框架，在文本和图像到视频的扩散模型中实现可控的 RGBA 视频生成，通过共享的 RGBA 潜在空间。方法首先学习可移动的 RGB-Alpha 分布，同时保留预训练的 RGB 先验。引入透明度感知的双向扩散目标来生成可区分的 RGBA 潜在表示，并使用透明度引导的均值采样移动噪声分布，以改进透明度生成并实现空间控制。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本和图像到视频的方法在生成高保真RGB外观和可调节的透明度时存在困难，而传统的条件方法在边界透明帧上无效。为此，Wan-Alpha++ 设计了一种可以控制的 RGBA 视频生成框架，通过透明度感知的双向扩散目标和透明度引导的均值采样来解决这些问题。
AI.method: Wan-Alpha++ 通过引入透明度感知的双向扩散目标和透明度引导的均值采样机制来实现可控的RGBA视频生成。此外，该方法还通过循环变换零正零α模式为正零正模式来建立时间相位重新参数化，从而使可见内容迁移到时间边界，从而有效地使用有限的RGBA数据进行外观控制。
AI.result: 通过此方法，Wan-Alpha++ 实现了更高质量的RGBA视频生成。它可以根据需要控制RGB和透明度，从而提高生成的视觉质量，并解决了传统方法的边界透明帧问题。
AI.conclusion: Wan-Alpha++ 代表了在可控纹理生成方面的突破，通过一个统一的框架支持文本和图像条件生成。此方法为电影制作、视频游戏开发和数字内容生产等领域的高质量视觉资产创建提供了新的可能。

title: GeoEdit: Adversarial De-Evidencing for Silent Geoprivacy Protection via Image Editing
summary: Recent efforts have demonstrated the strong capabilities of Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) in geographic reasoning. By jointly analyzing subtle visual cues, these models can infer the locations of photos, thus enabling doxing even by non-expert adversaries. Existing defense methods struggle to balance the shareability of photos with effective protection, and often fail to sufficiently disrupt the implicit geo-evidence chains embedded in scene semantics. To this end, we propose GeoEdit, an adversarial de-evidencing framework for silent geoprivacy protection via image editing. Specifically, we apply minimal edits to high-risk evidence anchors in the image, thereby disrupting the underlying spatial reasoning chains while preserving overall scene semantics. We identify these anchors by combining structured knowledge with adversarially discovered geographic cues. To further navigate the large editing action space, we adopt a learnable policy to iteratively refine editing decisions, distilling successful trajectories into transferable natural-language insights for consistent and efficient editing. Evaluated on LifePhotoBench, GeoEdit achieves strong protection against 6 mainstream MLRMs, outperforming visual perturbation baselines by over 0.59 in image fidelity.

AI.tldr: GeoEdit 是一种通过最小化图像编辑以破坏地理证据链但仍保留场景语义的对抗去证据化框架，从而保护地理隐私。
AI.motivation: 现有的防御方法难以平衡照片的可分享性和有效的保护，GeoEdit 提供了一种新的方法来解决这一问题。
AI.method: GeoEdit 通过结合结构化知识和对抗发现的地理线索来识别高风险的证据锚点，并通过一个可学习的策略在编辑动作空间中进行迭代优化，以实现高效的编辑。
AI.result: GeoEdit 在 LifePhotoBench 上实现了对 6 种主流 MLRM 的强大保护，与视觉扰动基线相比，在图像保真度上高出 0.59。
AI.conclusion: GeoEdit 为图像编辑提供了一种新的应用途径，通过最小化编辑影响同时保护照片中的地理隐私。

title: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents increasingly act over streaming omni-modal observations spanning screenshots, audio, video, interaction history, and device states. However, exposing this complete context uniformly at every step ignores that relevance is transient and sparse: the signal determining one action can become clutter at the next. Because executed actions feed back into the context, these errors compound into Sequential Distraction, driving the agent into irreversible trajectory drift. We formulate the underlying requirement as Focused Perception: a representation that is step-adaptive, action-sufficient, and non-intrusive. We realize this in FocusGUI, a lightweight adapter that dynamically prioritizes multimodal channels against a step-specific decision reference. Instead of uniformly processing all inputs, it compresses the most relevant evidence into a compact latent and subtly injects it into the frozen decoder's embeddings, guiding the model's attention without altering its native parameter space. FocusGUI trains from action supervision alone, requiring neither modality-relevance labels nor backbone fine-tuning. Across four omni-modal backbones, it raises overall Type Match by +33.2 and Exact Match by 3.0 times over the frozen backbone on average, and Type Match by +30.1 over the strongest existing enhancement method.

AI.tldr: 提出了FocusGUI，这是一种轻量级的适配器，能够在多模态输入中动态优先处理关键信息，不改变模型的参数空间，通过行为监督训练提高了整体性能。
AI.motivation: 为了解决传统方法在处理实时多模态观测时忽视了信号的瞬时性和稀疏性，导致代理无法有效地聚焦于当前任务的问题。
AI.method: FocusGUI是一个通过在每一步动态调整多模态通道优先级，只压缩最相关的证据，并将其注入冻结解码器的嵌入中来指导模型注意的轻量级适配器。
AI.result: 在四个全模态基础模型上，FocusGUI比冻结的基础模型提高了整体Type Match率33.2%，并提高了300%的Exact Match率，比最强的现有增强方法提高了Type Match率30.1%。
AI.conclusion: FocusGUI能够在不修改基础模型参数的情况下显著提高跨模态代理的性能，并且只需要行为监督即可进行训练，无需其他额外标注或模型微调。

title: ExMR: Extremity Motion Refinement for Monocular Human Motion Capture
comment: Extended version of the 3DV 2026 paper "Improving 3D Foot Motion Reconstruction in Markerless Monocular Human Motion Capture". 17 pages main paper + 4 pages supplementary material. Project page and video: https://twehrbein.github.io/exmr-website/
summary: Detailed hand and foot articulation is important for animation and motion analysis, yet remains challenging to recover from monocular video. Recent expressive video methods infer hand articulation from shared whole-body representations. Our conference work suggests that this underexploits local evidence: the Foot Motion Refinement (FootMR) module refines ankle rotations from foot keypoints, improving reconstruction even when the initial estimator receives the same keypoints. We extend this principle to hands with the Hand Motion Refinement (HandMR) module. Because 2D finger keypoints are often missing or unreliable, HandMR combines image features of a pretrained hand reconstruction model with initial arm and hand rotations to refine elbows, wrists, and fingers. We integrate FootMR and HandMR into ExMR (Extremity Motion Refinement), a system for reconstructing 3D body, hand, and foot motion from monocular video. An initial temporal estimator predicts whole-body motion, after which both refiners revisit local evidence to predict residual joint rotations. Experiments on ARCTIC, MOYO, RICH, and MOOF show that ExMR outperforms state-of-the-art methods in hand and foot reconstruction, reducing hand per-vertex error and ankle joint angle error on MOYO by 19% and 18%, respectively, relative to the strongest competitor. Code will be made available for research purposes. Project page: https://twehrbein.github.io/exmr-website/

AI.tldr: ExMR通过结合足部和手部的局部证据，提高了从单目视频中重建3D肢体动作的精度，特别是在手部和脚踝的重建上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 传统的从全身影像推断手部动作的方法可能忽视了局部特征的重要性。为了改进这一问题，提出了FootMR和HandMR两种模块，通过利用局部信息，提高了手部和脚踝重建的准确性。
AI.method: ExMR系统包含两个关键模块：FootMR和HandMR。FootMR模块可以细化踝关节旋转，HandMR模块结合预先训练的手部重建模型的图像特征与初始手臂和手的旋转来细化肘部、手腕和手指的旋转。
AI.result: ExMR系统在ARCTIC、MOYO、RICH和MOOF数据集上的实验显示，相比于最强的竞争对手，它在手部重建中减少手的每顶点误差和踝关节角度误差分别达到了19%和18%。
AI.conclusion: ExMR系统展示了利用局部证据改进手和脚的3D肢体动作重建的潜力，为单目视频分析提供了新的解决方案。

title: RoAR-VAE: Improving Latent Diffusability through Robust Prediction
summary: An effective visual tokenizer must preserve image fidelity while producing latents that downstream diffusion models can learn efficiently. Prior work improves latent diffusability through semantic alignment or joint tokenizer--diffusion training. Revisiting REPA-E, a representative approach, we find that removing its diffusion objective and dedicated generative blocks while retaining semantic prediction from corrupted latents yields comparable downstream generation performance under a matched setting. This observation motivates a general principle of robust prediction: generation-relevant information should remain recoverable from corrupted latents. We instantiate this principle with two complementary objectives. RobustAlign predicts pretrained semantic features from corrupted latents to preserve high-level structure, while RobustRecon reconstructs the clean image to retain fine-grained spatial and appearance information. Together, they form Robust Alignment and Reconstruction VAE (RoAR-VAE). Our analysis suggests that robust prediction improves diffusability by making useful information more accessible in high-variance latent directions, which diffusion models tend to learn earlier. Empirically, RoAR-VAE improves average generation benchmark performance by 2.19 points over the strongest baseline tokenizer under the same training budget, while improving small-text reconstruction accuracy by 16.93 percentage points over FLUX.1-VAE. These results demonstrate that RoAR-VAE achieves a favorable balance between reconstruction fidelity and downstream generative learnability.

AI.tldr: 提出了RobustAlignment and Reconstruction VAE (RoAR-VAE) 方法，通过预测从损坏的潜在空间中恢复高阶结构和重建清晰图像来提高图像的扩散性能，从而在不牺牲解码准确性的前提下提高下游生成学习能力。
AI.motivation: 为了找到一种在保持图像还原性的同时使潜在向量易于下游扩散模型学习的方法，作者通过对比先前方法并提出了一种新原则：生成相关的信息应能够从损坏的潜在向量中恢复。
AI.method: 作者设计了两个互补的目标，RobustAlign 用于从损坏的潜在向量中预测预训练的语义特征，从而保留高级结构；RobustRecon 用于重构干净的图像，保留精细的空间和外观信息。将这两个目标结合起来形成了 RoAR-VAE。
AI.result: 与最强的基线图像标注器相比，RoAR-VAE 在相同的训练预算下，平均生成基准测试性能提高了 2.19 点，小文本重构精度提高了 16.93 个百分点。这表明 RoAR-VAE 在重建保真度和下游生成学习能力之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: RoAR-VAE 的设计和实验结果表明，通过改进的潜在表示更能促进下游扩散模型的学习，而不牺牲图像重构的质量。

title: SAR2Net: Learning Spatially Anchored Representations for Retrieval-Guided Cross-Stain Alignment
summary: Achieving spatial alignment between whole-slide images(WSIs) across stains is essential for integrating morphology and molecular information, yet it remains challenging due to extreme resolution, tissue fragmentation, and large nonlinear deformations. Conventional registration pipelines depend on global pre-alignment and spatial consistency, which often collapse under such distortions. We present SAR2Net, a framework that learns spatially anchored representations and reformulates cross-stain alignment as a region-level feature retrieval problem. Instead of estimating explicit transformations, SAR2Net learns pointwise representations encoding the relative spatial relationships to tissue landmarks. Given landmarks and arbitrary coordinates, it predicts spatially anchored features that serve as deformation-invariant descriptors of tissue topology. A twostage retrieval framework then establishes correspondences between slides, even when global alignment is infeasible. Experiments on biopsy-oriented HE-IHC datasets show that SAR2Net achieves robust region-level alignment under severe tissue distortions, outperforming previous methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Shentl/SAR2Net.

AI.tldr: SAR2Net 提出了一种新的框架，用于在极端分辨率、组织碎片化和大型非线性变形的情况下实现不同染色整张组织切片图像之间的空间对齐。
AI.motivation: 在病理学中，需要将整片图像（WSIs）不同染色之间的空间对齐以整合组织形态和分子信息，但高分辨率、组织碎片化和大范围非线性变形使得这一过程充满挑战。
AI.method: SAR2Net 通过学习与组织地标点相关的空间化表示，将跨染色对齐重新定义为区域级别的特征检索问题，避免直接估计显式变换，而是预测不变于变形的空间化特征以描述组织拓扑学。
AI.result: 实验表明，SAR2Net 能够在严重组织变形的情况下实现稳健的区域级对齐，并超越了先前的方法。
AI.conclusion: SAR2Net 提供了一种有效的方法来解决跨染色的图像对齐问题，特别是在病理学中整合组织形态和分子信息的应用场景中显现出优越性。

title: RECAP: Reciprocal Sparse Attention and Hierarchical Caching for Efficient Video Diffusion
summary: Diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos but remain computationally expensive. Sparse attention and temporal caching reduce computation within and across denoising steps, respectively, offering a natural composition. However, predictions produced with sparse attention become sources for temporal reuse, coupling their errors along the sampling trajectory. We observe that improving the accuracy of these sources recovers fidelity without changing the reuse schedule, and that sparsification errors remain directionally aligned across nearby steps, suggesting that correction information can be shared rather than recomputed. These observations motivate RECAP, a training-free method that couples sparse attention with hierarchical caching through reciprocal correction, adaptively coordinated by online error feedback. Cached dense refinement corrects omitted interactions in current sparse estimates, while fresh sparse statistics track input changes and regulate the aging correction. The resulting predictions then renew the sources for whole-step prediction reuse, allowing prediction history to advance between dense refreshes. We evaluate RECAP on multiple video diffusion models against sparse-attention methods, caching methods, and their direct compositions. On HunyuanVideo at 720p 5-second generation, RECAP achieves a 3.05x speedup and outperforms all tested direct compositions in both fidelity and inference speed.

AI.tldr: RECAP提出了一种无需训练的方法，通过耦合稀疏注意力与分层缓存，并通过在线误差反馈适应性协调，提高了预测速度和保真度。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意和时间缓存虽能减少计算量，但会因错误累积影响预测质量。研究发现，通过共享而非重新计算修正信息，可提高稀疏预测的准确性。
AI.method: RECAP通过引入基于在线误差反馈的分层缓存机制，提供了一种无需训练的修正方法。缓存包括密集修正来纠正当前稀疏估计未考虑到的交互，以及稀疏统计更新以响应输入变化，调节修正的老化。
AI.result: 在HunyuanVideo 720p 5秒生成场景下，RECAP相比直接组合的稀疏注意方法、缓存方法，实现了3.05倍的速度提升，并在保真度和推理速度上表现出色。
AI.conclusion: RECAP方法有效提高了视频生成的整体预测质量和速度，展示了稀疏注意力与缓存机制结合的优势。

title: XGLASS: X-Ray, Gaze and Language Assisted Slice Sequencing for CT Volumes
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 24 pages, including references and supplementary material. Code and checkpoint: https://github.com/michaelgloeckler/XGLASS
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve remarkable performance on 2D medical images, such as X-rays or pathology images, while 3D VLMs that directly process CT/MRI volumes lag behind due to limited 3D training data and the predominance of 2D foundation architectures. To leverage powerful 2D VLMs for analyzing medical volumes, which contain hundreds of slices, it is therefore necessary to focus only on those few slices, which are diagnostically relevant. To enable such a prioritization, we propose XGLASS, a method that transfers medical expertise from 2D X-rays to 3D CT for task-aware slice prioritization. XGLASS uses disease-conditioned importance maps derived from language-aligned radiologist gaze on X-rays and spatially aligns them with coronal CT projections, bringing gaze priors and CT content into a shared 2D representation. The fused gaze-prior/CT projection is then used to predict a disease-specific ordering of axial slices, prioritizing diagnostically relevant slices. XGLASS significantly improves budgeted retrieval over 2D and 3D-native baselines, achieving a top-10 hit rate up to 75.9% for the best-performing disease. In practice, this means that after inspecting only the top 10 slices (4.17% of a 240-slice scan), XGLASS identifies a diagnostically relevant slice in more than 75% of cases. For downstream slice-wise finding classification, an XGLASS-selected 30-slice candidate set reduces model calls by 87.5% while improving F1 by 11.3 percentage points over all-slice inference, 4.2 points over the strongest 2D selector, and remains competitive with 3D-native selectors while requiring up to 130.8 times less time and 10.9 times less GPU memory per finding, supporting its use as a lightweight preselector for volumetric CT analysis. The code and pretrained checkpoint are available on https://github.com/michaelgloeckler/XGLASS.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为XGLASS的方法，通过从2D X光图像中转移医学专家知识，适应3D CT图像，实现了针对任务感知的切片优先级排序，显著提升了预算检索性能，减少了模型调用次数，同时降低了计算资源的需求。
AI.motivation: 目前，3D Vision-Language模型在处理CT/MRI图像上效果不佳，原因之一是缺乏3D训练数据和2D基础架构的主导地位。通过XGLASS方法，利用从2D X光图像中学习到的医学专业知识，对包含数百张切片的3D医疗图像进行诊断，可以实现切片优先级排序，从而节省计算资源并提高诊断效率。
AI.method: XGLASS方法包括四个主要步骤：1）利用语言对齐的放射科医生在X光图像上的目光注意力生成疾病条件下的重要性图；2）将这些重要性图与冠状CT投影空间对齐；3）结合目光先验信息和CT内容，预测疾病特异性的轴向切片排序；4）根据预测的结果优先处理诊断相关切片。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，XGLASS方法在预算检索方面显著优于2D和3D本地基线。对于表现最好的疾病，XGLASS的前10个切片命中率达到了75.9%。此外，使用XGLASS选择的30个候选切片集比所有切片推理减少模型调用次数87.5%，F1分数提高了11.3个百分点；与表现最强的2D选择器相比提升了4.2个百分点；而且其计算时间和GPU内存消耗分别减少了约130.8倍和10.9倍。
AI.conclusion: XGLASS方法展示了在医疗3D图像分析中，利用从2D X光图像中转移的医学专业知识来实现任务感知的切片优先级排序的成功案例，是当前提高3D图像分析效率的有效方法之一。

title: Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Autoregressive Diffusion Transformers have emerged as a powerful paradigm for long video generation. However, they are often constrained by prohibitive computational overhead and substantial memory footprints. This inefficiency arises from dense computation mechanisms that allocate uniform processing resources across all spatiotemporal regions, failing to leverage the inherent temporal redundancy of video where motion is typically confined to sparse areas. In this paper, we propose Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention (DASA), a unified framework that shifts from dense computation to sparse, motion-driven generation to eliminate both storage and computational redundancies. Inspired by video codec principles, our approach explicitly decouples video content into dynamic and static regions. To mitigate memory bottlenecks, we selectively compress the historical KV cache by retaining only dynamic features within the generated chunk. Furthermore, to reduce computational overhead, we employ a region-level computation allocation strategy based on localized dynamics. Additionally, a dynamics-guided distillation method is introduced to enhance performance via a lightweight distillation training process. Experiments on VBench demonstrate that our approach accelerates autoregressive video generation by 2.16x, while preserving high visual fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Dynamics-Aware Sparse Attention (DASA)的统一框架，通过将密集计算转换为基于运动的稀疏生成，消除了存储和计算冗余，加速了自回归视频生成，同时保持了视觉保真度。
AI.motivation: 传统自回归扩散变换器在长视频生成中表现出强大的能力，但存在计算开销大和内存占用高的问题。DASA框架旨在通过基于运动的稀疏生成，减少存储和计算冗余，提高自回归视频生成的效率。
AI.method: DASA框架通过以下步骤提高自回归视频生成的效率：(1) 通过视频编解码原理，将视频内容区分为动态和静态部分；(2) 通过保留仅动态特征的方法压缩历史KV缓存，减少内存瓶颈；(3) 基于局部动态性进行区域级计算分配，减少计算开销；(4) 引入动态指导的蒸馏方法，在轻量化训练过程中提升性能。
AI.result: 在VBench上的实验结果表明，DASA框架可以将自回归视频生成速度提升2.16倍，同时保持高的视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: DASA框架通过动态引导的稀疏注意力机制和计算分配策略，有效地降低了自回归视频生成的计算和存储成本，提升了视频生成的效率。

title: TIM: Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model for Longitudinal Radiology Report Generation
summary: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) aims to translate medical images into diagnostic text, reducing radiologists' workload and standardizing clinical documentation. Nonetheless, existing approaches mainly focus on single-timepoint analysis and fail to capture temporal disease evolution across longitudinal examinations. While recent longitudinal RRG (LRRG) approaches incorporate historical data, they often combine images from different time points within a single representation space, leading to blurred semantics and inconsistent temporal reasoning. In this work, we propose a Temporal Decoupling with Iterative Mutual-Refinement Model (TIM), a two-stage framework that explicitly decouples spatial pathology from temporal progression and iteratively refines reports through mutual feedback. Stage I performs temporal-decoupled representation learning, separating temporal evolution patterns from disease-specific features and generating radiology reports for both prior and current studies. Stage II introduces a mutual report refinement mechanism that identifies diagnostic inconsistencies within prior reports and iteratively rectifies both prior and current reports through error-sensitive feedback. Experiments on the Longitudinal-MIMIC dataset demonstrate that TIM surpasses existing single-image and longitudinal baselines, achieving new state-of-the-art performance across both language and clinical metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/yihengd/TIM.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了TIM模型，这是一种两阶段框架，旨在通过时间解耦和迭代互反馈机制改进纵向医学报告生成。该模型在Longitudinal-MIMIC数据集上的实验表明，它在语言和临床指标方面超过了现有基线，达到新的人工智能性能水平。
AI.motivation: 现有的医学报告生成方法主要关注单一时间点分析，难以捕捉随时间演变的疾病进展。TIM模型旨在解决这个问题，通过时间解耦和迭代互反馈，提高报告的一致性和准确性。
AI.method: TIM模型包括两个阶段：第一阶段进行时间解耦表示学习，将时间进化模式与疾病特定特征分开，并生成先前和当前研究的放射学报告。第二阶段引入了一种报告互反馈机制来识别先前报告中的诊断不一致，并通过敏感错误反馈迭代纠正两者。
AI.result: TIM模型在Longitudinal-MIMIC数据集上的实验表明，它在语言和临床指标方面超过了现有的单一图像和纵向基线，达到了新的AI现有技术水平。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，TIM模型在医学报告生成方面提供了有效的解决方案，尤其是在处理长时段数据时，具有更高的准确性和一致性。

title: From Cause to Effect: Generating Intermediate Event Chains in Videos
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. Project page: https://ridouaneg.github.io/ccg
summary: Video-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual recognition but struggle with causal reasoning. Current evaluations are flawed: multiple-choice QA allows shortcuts, and open-ended QA lacks robust automatic evaluation. We introduce Causal Chain Generation (CCG), a novel task where models have to generate the sequence of intermediate events connecting a cause and an effect. This structured setup demands genuine reasoning and enables reliable automatic scoring. We accompany this task with two complementary metrics: SODA-Embedding, which measures the semantic matching of a generated chain against a reference, and Causal-QA, which probes the chain's causal coherence by asking whether it contains the specific causal facts needed to reconstruct the narrative. We provide two test sets: SF20K-CC, a manually annotated diagnostic on 20 short films, and CMD-CC, a movie clip benchmark derived from audio descriptions. Our analysis reveals that state-of-the-art VLMs struggle with narrative causality understanding, frequently hallucinating or omitting key events. To address this, we fine-tune VLMs with GRPO using a composite reward that combines a format reward, SODA-Embedding, and Causal-QA accuracy, demonstrating substantial improvements over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的任务Causal Chain Generation (CCG)，以评估模型在因果推理方面的表现，而不是当前的评估方法。研究提供了两个测试集，发现当前的Video-Language Models (VLMs) 在因果推理方面表现不佳，并提出了一种使用GRPO进行微调的方法以提高其表现。
AI.motivation: 当前的视频-语言模型（VLMs）在视觉识别方面表现出色，但在因果推理方面存在困难。现有的评估方法存在缺陷，因此提出Causal Chain Generation (CCG)任务来更好地评估模型的因果推理能力。
AI.method: 研究引入了CCG任务，该任务要求模型生成连接原因和结果的事件序列。该任务包含两个互补的评估指标：SODA-Embedding和Causal-QA。研究还提供了两个测试集：SF20K-CC和CMD-CC，并对当前的VLMs模型进行了细调以提高其在因果推理方面的能力。
AI.result: 在研究中，当前的最佳VLMs模型在事件连贯性理解方面表现不佳，经常会胡言乱语或遗漏关键事件。通过使用GRPO进行模型微调，研究人员实现了显著的改进。
AI.conclusion: 细调后的VLMs模型在因果关系理解方面比以前的基线模型表现出了显著的改进。这表明CCG任务能够可靠地评估模型的因果推理能力，并且细调方法是有效的。

title: CARNet: End-to-End Coupled Association-Recognition Network for Fine-Grained Multi-Drone Collaborative Detection
summary: Multi-drone collaborative detection aims to enhance target recognition by leveraging complementary observations from overlapping aerial viewpoints. Existing approaches typically follow a two-stage pipeline that first establishes cross-view correspondences and then performs fusion-based recognition. However, this decomposition suffers from inconsistent optimization objectives, redundant pairwise modeling, and irreversible error propagation, where incorrect associations inevitably undermine subsequent recognition performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Coupled Association-Recognition Network (CARNet), a unified framework that jointly optimizes cross-view target association and recognition fusion through a shared target-pair representation. To improve association reliability in densely populated scenes with visually similar targets, CARNet explicitly incorporates spatial cues into pairwise relation modeling. Moreover, we introduce two complementary causal-inspired intervention strategies: the first enhances cross-view association by emphasizing appearance-confusing pairs, while the second bolsters the robustness of fusion-based recognition by learning stable multi-view representations under incomplete visual evidence. In addition, we present MDMT-CD, a fine-grained extension of the MDMT dataset that enriches the original vehicle annotations with detailed category labels, providing the first benchmark specifically designed for multi-drone collaborative vehicle detection. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CARNet consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. The MDMT-CD dataset and source code will be available at https://github.com/bigdreaming11/CARNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CARNet的统一框架，旨在通过共享的目标对表示同时优化跨视图目标关联和融合检测，以提高多无人机协同检测中的目标识别性能。CARNet通过引入空间线索来增强稠密场景中的关联可靠性，并通过学习在不完整视觉证据下的稳定多视角表示来增强融合检测的鲁棒性。此外，还引入了MDMT-CD数据集作为用于多无人机协同车辆检测的基准数据。
AI.motivation: 为了解决现有方法存在的不一致优化目标、冗余成对建模和不可逆的错误传播问题，以及在稠密场景中目标识别性能易受错误关联影响的问题。
AI.method: CARNet框架通过共享的目标对表示来同时优化跨视图目标关联和融合检测，引入空间线索增强关联可靠性，并利用因果启发的干预策略来提高多视角表示的鲁棒性。MDMT-CD数据集详细标注了车辆类别，用于评估多无人机协作检测性能。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，CARNet在多种场景下的多无人机协同检测任务中优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的方法和数据集为多无人机协同检测领域的研究提供了新的思路和基准，能够有效提高检测性能。

title: MCDA: Multi-View Graph Contrastive Learning with Dynamic Topology Augmentation for Functional MRI Analysis
summary: Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) is a vital non-invasive tool for diagnosing brain disorders and uncovering pathological mechanisms. However, existing graph contrastive learning (GCL) methods often underexploit augmentation histories across training epochs and the relationships among different augmented views. In this paper, we introduce a topology-guided Multi-view graph Contrastive learning framework with Dynamic graph topology Augmentation (MCDA) for fMRI analysis. Unlike traditional GCL that uses fixed noise or edge-dropping, MCDA employs a Dynamic Augmentation Update (DAU) module that iteratively refines the augmented topology. Specifically, we incorporate self-aware and cross-sample augmentation strategies to simultaneously capture individual-specific functional signatures and inter-subject heterogeneity. We then design a topology-guided multi-view graph contrastive learning scheme that explores interrelationships not only between the original network and its augmented views, but also across different augmented views to maximize structural information preservation. We characterize the score-level optimization directions and establish a lower bound for the contrastive objective. The framework combines classification and contrastive losses for brain disorder diagnosis and examines discriminative functional connectivity patterns as potential biomarkers. Experiments on two public rs-fMRI datasets comprising 1,236 subjects demonstrate that MCDA outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. The code has been made publicly available at: \url{https://github.com/goodcodingagoodboy/MCDA}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于拓扑引导的多视图图对比学习框架（MCDA），通过动态图拓扑增强模块优化rs-fMRI分析，改善了现有方法对脑疾病诊断的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前的图对比学习方法在利用训练批次的历史信息和不同增强视图的关系上有所不足，通过开发MCDA框架解决了这些问题。
AI.method: MCDA框架通过迭代优化增强拓扑，融合自我感知和跨样本增强策略来捕获个体功能特征和组间异质性，并通过拓扑引导的多视图图对比学习方案最大化结构信息保留。
AI.result: 在两个公共rs-fMRI数据集上的实验表明，MCDA方法在脑疾病诊断方面优于现有的最新方法。
AI.conclusion: MCDA框架通过优化图对比学习增强了rs-fMRI的分析能力，为脑疾病诊断提供了更有力的工具。

title: TriScore: Post-Hoc Out-of-Distribution Detection with Energy, Boundary Probes, and Transform Consistency
summary: Post-hoc out-of-distribution detection usually relies on a single signal extracted from a frozen classifier, such as confidence, energy, features, or gradients. This dependence becomes fragile under classifier-level adversarial shift, where the shift can preserve the detector's chosen cue while changing the model's decision behavior. We investigate whether this failure mode can be mitigated by combining complementary detection criteria instead of selecting a single score. We introduce TriScore, a post-hoc OOD detector that combines three ID-calibrated signals from the same frozen backbone: an energy prior, a boundary-fragility score, and a transform-consistency score. These signals are standardized on ID validation data and fused by an input-dependent ID-residual gate, requiring no OOD labels, auxiliary model, training, or stored feature bank. Across four ImageNet-scale backbones, TriScore achieves the best mean AUROC among 15 post-hoc baselines under a non-adaptive adversarial-shift protocol, while remaining competitive on standard OOD benchmarks. Ablations show that the gains come from combining complementary cues rather than optimizing a single detector signal. These results support multi-criterion post-hoc detection as a practical route toward more robust OOD detection under classifier-level shift. The source code is publicly available at github.com/gursoyege/TriScore.

AI.tldr: TriScore 是一种多标准后验 OOD 检测器，它通过结合能量先验、边界脆弱性得分和变换一致性得分这三种来自同一冻结架构的标淮化信号来检测 OOD 样本，无需 OOD 标签、辅助模型、训练或存储特征库，从而在具有非适应性对抗变换协议下，实现了 15 种后验基线中最好的平均 AUC-ROC 性能。
AI.motivation: 当前的 OOD 检测方法依赖单一信号，容易在模型决策行为发生变化时失效。TriScore 通过结合改进的检测标准，能更好地应对分类器水平的对抗性变化。
AI.method: TriScore 使用三种改进的检测标准：能量先验、边界脆弱性得分和变换一致性得分，这些标准是从相同的冻结模型中提取并标准化后的，使用输入依赖的 ID 残差门将它们融合，以实现 OOD 检测。
AI.result: TriScore 在 ImageNet 规模的四个架构上实现了平均 AUC-ROC 最高的表现，并且在标准 OOD 基准测试中保持竞争力。消融实验表明，性能提升主要来自于结合多种互补的指标，而不是优化单一的检测信号。
AI.conclusion: TriScore 作为一种多标准的后验 OOD 检测方法，在对抗性变化下提供了更为稳健的 OOD 检测，未来的研究可以将其扩展以进一步提高 OOD 检测的鲁棒性。

title: HGASurv: Hierarchical Granularity-Aware Integration for Multimodal Survival Prediction
summary: Objective: Multimodal survival prediction jointly analyzes histopathological whole-slide images (WSIs), genomic profiles, and clinical variables to stratify patients by risk. However, existing approaches often inadequately account for granularity differences across modalities, particularly in spatial organization and feature dimensionality. To address these challenges, we propose HGASurv, which introduces a hierarchical WSI encoding module and a clinical-guided graph propagation module for granularity-aware multimodal integration. Methods: The hierarchical WSI encoding module maps WSI patch features onto a spatial grid using their original coordinates and applies parallel convolutions to construct representations at patch, local-neighborhood, and regional scales. Genomic signature embeddings then query these scale-specific WSI representations through cross-modal co-attention, producing signature-conditioned morphological features. The clinical-guided graph propagation module uses clinical variables to define patient-similarity edges and propagates fused image-genomic node embeddings with graph attention, integrating clinical information through topology rather than feature concatenation. Results: Across three TCGA cohorts, HGASurv achieved the strongest overall C-index performance, with ablation studies supporting the complementary contributions of the hierarchical WSI encoding and clinical-guided graph propagation modules. Conclusion and Significance: By introducing hierarchical WSI encoding and clinical-guided graph propagation, HGASurv unifies multi-scale pathology representation with topology-based clinical integration in a hierarchical granularity-aware framework. This design shows that matching representation and integration mechanisms to modality-specific granularity improves multimodal survival prediction.

AI.tldr: HGASurv 通过引入层次组织的病理图像编码模块和临床指导的图传播模块，实现了对患者风险分层的多模态生存预测，提高了跨模态信息整合的效果。
AI.motivation: 当前的多模态生存预测方法在处理不同模态间的粒度差异（特别是在空间组织和特征维度方面）时不够充分。HGASurv 提出了解决这一问题的方法，旨在增强对不同模态数据的整合能力。
AI.method: HGASurv 使用了层次组织的 WSI 编码模块和临床指导的图传播模块。WSI 编码模块将 WSI 分块特征映射到原始坐标的空间网格上，并通过并行卷积构建贴片、局部邻域和区域尺度的表示。通过跨模态关注层查询规模特定的 WSI 表示，生成签名条件下的形态学特征。图传播模块利用临床变量定义患者相似边，并通过图注意力传播融合的图像-基因组节点嵌入。
AI.result: HGASurv 在TCGA三个队列中实现了最强的整体C指数性能，在消融研究中支持了层次组织的 WSI 编码和临床指导的图传播模块的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入层次组织的 WSI 编码和临床指导的图传播，HGASurv 构建了一个分层次粒度感知的框架，实现了多尺度病理表示和基于拓扑的临床集成。该设计表明，将表示和集成机制与特定模态的粒度相匹配，可以改善多模态生存预测的效果。

title: From Legacy to Contemporary: Scalable Color Modernization for Long Video
summary: Bringing legacy video back to contemporary screens does not necessarily make it look contemporary. Earlier imaging pipelines often leave color casts, muted chroma, weak con- trast, and tonal imbalance, while correcting these character- istics still relies heavily on expert colorists and scales poorly to long, multi-shot videos. We formulate long video color modernization, a task that updates the chromatic and tonal appearance of legacy color footage while preserving scene content and coherence across frames and shots. We introduce a scalable, training-free framework that jointly modernizes grids of temporally adjacent keyframes using a pretrained text-guided image editing model, producing coherent con- temporary references without paired supervision. Compact shot-specific color transforms then propagate these adjust- ments throughout each shot, preserving spatial structure and temporal stability. We conduct a multidimensional evaluation on diverse legacy videos spanning five decades. We combine a human evaluation of perceived modernness with quantita- tive measures of content fidelity, temporal stability, percep- tual quality, and efficiency, and introduce Source-Weighted Inter-shot Grade Consistency (SW-IGC) to assess grade co- herence across shots. On our evaluation set, our frame- work achieves the highest perceived modernness while re- maining competitive across complementary measures, open- ing a path toward the systematic study of long video color modernization. Code is available at https://github.com/jiwoomood/ Video_Color_Modernization.git

AI.tldr: 该研究针对老电影色彩还原提出了一个无监督框架，旨在更新彩色片段的色彩和色调外观，同时保持场景内容和帧间一致性，并通过多维度评估验证其效果。
AI.motivation: 当前的方法修正老电影色彩缺陷依然依赖于专家且难以扩展到长时间多镜头视频，因此需要一种新的方法来解决这个问题。
AI.method: 研究提出了一种无监督的文字指导图像编辑模型框架，能够协同更新时间相邻的关键帧，然后通过紧凑的片段特定色彩转换在整个片段中传播这些调整，保持空间构架和时间稳定性。
AI.result: 在五十年跨度的多种老电影上的多维度评估中，该框架展示了良好的效果，特别是在感知现代性上得分最高，同时在其他相关指标上表现也很出色。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为进一步系统地研究长时间视频色彩现代化奠定了基础，并公开了代码。

title: One Fact, Many Places: Redundant Evidence in Long Visual Documents Breaks Single-Gold Evaluation of Retrieval, Citation and Attribution
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures; includes supplementary material. Code, data and editable figure sources provided as ancillary files
summary: Document understanding is increasingly judged on where an answer comes from, scored against annotated gold locations as if each fact lived in one place. In long visual documents, a fact often lives in several places: a chart value is restated in the text, a key figure reappears in the summary. We ask how often such copies occur in standard benchmarks and what they do to evaluation. We annotate 420 questions from MMLongBench-Doc and MMDocRAG with the locations that independently establish each required fact, checked by two independent reviewers. Copies are common and often cross-modal: 19.5% of MMLongBench-Doc test questions have a strict copy outside the gold, and in 28% of MMDocRAG questions a non-gold candidate alone supplies a required fact. Single-gold scoring then fails in three predictable ways. A retriever that finds a copy is scored as a miss: page recall@1 of text and visual retrievers is underestimated by 13-24 points on questions with a cross-page copy. A model that cites a copy is scored as citing wrongly: crediting equivalent evidence reverses 11% of pairwise orderings among 65 competitive MMDocRAG systems. Masking the gold region leaves the fact available elsewhere: with a copy in the input, 41-56% of correct answers across four models survive it yet fail once every annotated instance is masked. Set-level masking with automatically found copies closes 78% of the gap to masking every annotated instance at matched granularity (three models); an unverified key-string rule lowers survival at least as far but masks three times the area. We release the annotations and redundancy-aware metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析MMLongBench-Doc和MMDocRAG标准基准中的冗余信息，发现副本在长文档中的普遍存在，并指出了单金评分方法在副本存在情况下的三个常见问题：检索器找到副本会被错误评估，引用副本被视为引用错误，隐藏金区域能使正确答案在几个模型中得以存活，但并不总是成功。本文还提出了冗余意识度量标准。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在解决当前文档理解评估方法中忽视文本与视觉元素之间频繁复制的问题，目的是提高对长文档中事实提取的全面性和准确性。
AI.method: 作者根据双盲审核标注了420个来自MMLongBench-Doc和MMDocRAG的问题中独立支持每个必需事实的位置，并研究了副本对评价的影响。
AI.result: 发现：副本较为常见且跨模态存在；单金评分在存在副本时会低估准确率，副本会被错误评估为错引用，遮蔽金区域并不能总使正确答案存活，自动找到副本进行设置级遮蔽可以显著减少遮蔽金区域对正确答案存活率的影响。
AI.conclusion: 作者建议采用新的冗余意识度量标准以评估文档理解中的副本问题，同时提交了副本标注和新的评估标准。

title: Policy-Adaptive Credit Assignment for Spatial Reasoning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Image-based spatial reasoning requires perception, decomposition, and inference, but the stage that limits accuracy can change during training. Answer-level rewards neither localize failures to individual stages nor provide discriminative group-relative feedback when all rollouts receive the same reward. Process supervision provides intermediate feedback, but fixed weights cannot adapt reward allocation to these changing bottlenecks. To address this gap, we propose CALIPER, an adaptive process-reward framework supported by SpatialTrace, a corpus of stage-decomposed spatial reasoning traces.
